In closed-loop experiments with model predictive control (MPC), caSSM reduces tracking error by 52%, demonstrating improved performance against Koopman and SSM based MPC and practical deployability on hardware continuum robots.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人具有高维、非线性动力学特性，且常与驱动机制相互耦合。谱子流形（SSM）降维法已成为将高维非线性动力系统简化为低维不变流形的主流方法。本文提出的控制增强型谱子流形（caSSM）通过将控制输入显式纳入状态表征，扩展了该方法体系，使模型能够捕捉非线性状态-输入耦合关系。该模型训练仅需基于执行器增强状态的受控衰减轨迹，从而消除了传统SSM控制方法通常需要的额外驱动校准步骤。我们为肌腱驱动躯干机器人建立了紧凑的caSSM模型，实现了实时控制，并将开环预测误差较现有方法降低40%。在模型预测控制（MPC）闭环实验中，caSSM使跟踪误差减少52%，其性能优于基于Koopman和SSM的MPC方法，并验证了在硬件连续体机器人上的实际部署能力。
tldr: The paper introduces control-augmented Spectral Submanifolds (caSSMs) to improve the control of continuum robots by explicitly incorporating control inputs into state representation, reducing open-loop prediction error by 40% and closed-loop tracking error by 52% compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了控制增强的光谱子流形（caSSMs），通过将控制输入显式纳入状态表示来改进连续体机器人的控制，与现有方法相比，开环预测误差减少了40%，闭环跟踪误差减少了52%。

title: Instrument-Splatting++: Towards Controllable Surgical Instrument Digital Twin Using Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-quality and controllable digital twins of surgical instruments are critical for Real2Sim in robot-assisted surgery, as they enable realistic simulation, synthetic data generation, and perception learning under novel poses. We present Instrument-Splatting++, a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework that reconstructs surgical instruments as a fully controllable Gaussian asset with high fidelity. Our pipeline starts with part-wise geometry pretraining that injects CAD priors into Gaussian primitives and equips the representation with part-aware semantic rendering. Built on the pretrained model, we propose a semantics-aware pose estimation and tracking (SAPET) method to recover per-frame 6-DoF pose and joint angles from unposed endoscopic videos, where a gripper-tip network trained purely from synthetic semantics provides robust supervision and a loose regularization suppresses singular articulations. Finally, we introduce Robust Texture Learning (RTL), which alternates pose refinement and robust appearance optimization, mitigating pose noise during texture learning. The proposed framework can perform pose estimation and learn realistic texture from unposed videos. We validate our method on sequences extracted from EndoVis17/18, SAR-RARP, and an in-house dataset, showing superior photometric quality and improved geometric accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines. We further demonstrate a downstream keypoint detection task where unseen-pose data augmentation from our controllable instrument Gaussian improves performance.
summary_zh: 高质量且可控的手术器械数字孪生体对于机器人辅助手术中的"真实到仿真"(Real2Sim)至关重要，它们能实现新颖姿态下的逼真模拟、合成数据生成与感知学习。本文提出Instrument-Splatting++，一种基于单目视觉的3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)框架，可将手术器械重建为高保真度的全可控高斯资产。我们的流程始于部件级几何预训练——将CAD先验知识注入高斯基元，使表征具备部件感知的语义渲染能力。基于预训练模型，我们提出语义感知的姿态估计与跟踪方法(SAPET)，从无位姿标注的内窥镜视频中恢复每帧6自由度位姿与关节角度：其中仅通过合成语义训练的夹爪尖端网络提供鲁棒监督，宽松正则化则抑制异常关节状态。最后，我们引入鲁棒纹理学习(RTL)，通过交替执行位姿优化与鲁棒外观学习，有效缓解纹理学习过程中的位姿噪声。该框架能从无位姿视频中同时完成姿态估计与真实纹理学习。我们在EndoVis17/18、SAR-RARP及内部数据集提取的序列上验证方法，其重建的光度质量与几何精度均超越现有最优基线。进一步的下游关键点检测实验表明，利用本方法生成的可控器械高斯资产进行新姿态数据增强，能有效提升任务性能。
tldr: Instrument-Splatting++ is a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for creating high-fidelity, controllable digital twins of surgical instruments from unposed endoscopic videos, enabling realistic simulation and synthetic data generation.
tldr_zh: Instrument-Splatting++ 是一种单目3D高斯溅射框架，用于从无姿态内窥镜视频中创建高保真、可控的手术器械数字孪生，实现逼真的模拟和合成数据生成。

title: Strain-Parameterized Coupled Dynamics and Dual-Camera Visual Servoing for Aerial Continuum Manipulators
summary: Tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators (TD-ACMs) combine the maneuverability of uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) with the compliance of lightweight continuum robots (CRs). Existing coupled dynamic modeling approaches for TD-ACMs incur high computational costs and do not explicitly account for aerial platform underactuation. To address these limitations, this paper presents a generalized dynamic formulation of a coupled TD-ACM with an underactuated base. The proposed approach integrates a strain-parameterized Cosserat rod model with a rigid-body model of the UAV into a unified Lagrangian ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework on $\mathrm{SE}(3)$, thereby eliminating computationally intensive symbolic derivations. Building upon the developed model, a robust dual-camera image-based visual servoing (IBVS) scheme is introduced. The proposed controller mitigates the field-of-view (FoV) limitations of conventional IBVS, compensates for attitude-induced image motion caused by UAV lateral dynamics, and incorporates a low-level adaptive controller to address modeling uncertainties with formal stability guarantees. Extensive simulations and experimental validation on a compact custom-built prototype demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework in real-world scenarios.
summary_zh:
摘要：
肌腱驱动空中连续体机械臂（TD-ACM）将无人飞行器（UAV）的机动性与轻型连续体机器人（CR）的柔顺性相结合。现有TD-ACM耦合动力学建模方法计算成本高昂，且未明确考虑空中平台的欠驱动特性。针对这些局限性，本文提出了一种具有欠驱动基座的耦合TD-ACM广义动力学建模方法。该方法将应变参数化的Cosserat杆模型与无人机刚体模型集成到$\mathrm{SE}(3)$上的统一拉格朗日常微分方程（ODE）框架中，从而消除了计算密集的符号推导。基于所建模型，进一步提出了一种鲁棒的双摄像头基于图像的视觉伺服（IBVS）方案。该控制器缓解了传统IBVS的视场（FoV）限制，补偿了由无人机横向动力学引起的姿态诱导图像运动，并引入底层自适应控制器以处理建模不确定性，同时提供形式化稳定性保证。在紧凑型定制原型机上开展的广泛仿真与实验验证表明，所提框架在实际场景中具有高效性与鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper presents a dynamic modeling approach for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators (TD-ACMs) that integrates a strain-parameterized Cosserat rod model with a UAV's rigid-body model, and introduces a robust dual-camera visual servoing scheme to address field-of-view limitations and attitude-induced image motion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于肌腱驱动空中连续体机械臂（TD-ACM）的动态建模方法，该方法将应变参数化的Cosserat杆模型与无人机的刚体模型相结合，并引入了一种鲁棒的双摄像头视觉伺服方案，以解决视野限制和姿态引起的图像运动问题。

title: EndoVGGT: GNN-Enhanced Depth Estimation for Surgical 3D Reconstruction
summary: Accurate 3D reconstruction of deformable soft tissues is essential for surgical robotic perception. However, low-texture surfaces, specular highlights, and instrument occlusions often fragment geometric continuity, posing a challenge for existing fixed-topology approaches. To address this, we propose EndoVGGT, a geometry-centric framework equipped with a Deformation-aware Graph Attention (DeGAT) module. Rather than using static spatial neighborhoods, DeGAT dynamically constructs feature-space semantic graphs to capture long-range correlations among coherent tissue regions. This enables robust propagation of structural cues across occlusions, enforcing global consistency and improving non-rigid deformation recovery. Extensive experiments on SCARED show that our method significantly improves fidelity, increasing PSNR by 24.6% and SSIM by 9.1% over prior state-of-the-art. Crucially, EndoVGGT exhibits strong zero-shot cross-dataset generalization to the unseen SCARED and EndoNeRF domains, confirming that DeGAT learns domain-agnostic geometric priors. These results highlight the efficacy of dynamic feature-space modeling for consistent surgical 3D reconstruction.
summary_zh: 可变形软组织的精确三维重建对于手术机器人感知至关重要。然而低纹理表面、镜面高光和器械遮挡常导致几何连续性断裂，这对现有固定拓扑方法提出了挑战。为此，我们提出以几何为中心的EndoVGGT框架，其配备的形变感知图注意力模块（DeGAT）摒弃静态空间邻域，转而动态构建特征空间语义图以捕捉连贯组织区域间的长程关联。该方法能跨遮挡鲁棒地传播结构线索，增强全局一致性并改善非刚性形变恢复。在SCARED数据集上的大量实验表明，本方法显著提升重建保真度，PSNR和SSIM分别较现有最优方法提高24.6%和9.1%。值得注意的是，EndoVGGT对未见过的SCARED和EndoNeRF领域展现出强大的零样本跨数据集泛化能力，证实DeGAT学习到了领域无关的几何先验。这些结果凸显了动态特征空间建模在实现稳定手术三维重建中的有效性。
tldr: EndoVGGT introduces a GNN-enhanced depth estimation framework for surgical 3D reconstruction, featuring a Deformation-aware Graph Attention (DeGAT) module that dynamically constructs feature-space semantic graphs to improve consistency and deformation recovery in challenging surgical environments.
tldr_zh: EndoVGGT提出了一种用于手术3D重建的GNN增强深度估计框架，其Deformation-aware Graph Attention (DeGAT)模块动态构建特征空间语义图，以在具有挑战性的手术环境中提高一致性和变形恢复能力。

title: Characterization of Constraints in Flexible Unknown Environments
summary: This paper presents an online path planning algorithm for safe autonomous manipulation of a flexibly constrained object in an unknown environment. Methods for real time identification and characterization of perceived flexible constraints and global stiffness are presented. Used in tandem, these methods allow a robot to simultaneously explore, characterize, and manipulate an elastic system safely. Navigation without a-priori knowledge of the system is achieved using constraint exploration based on local force and position information. The perceived constraint stiffness is considered at multiple poses along an object's (system) trajectory. Using stiffness eigenvector information, global stiffness behavior is characterized and identified using an atlas of simple mechanical constraints, such as hinges and planar constraints. Validation of these algorithms is carried out by simulation and experimentally. The ability to recognize several common simple mechanical constraints (such as a flexible hinge) in real time, and to subsequently identify relevant screw parameters is demonstrated. These results suggest the feasibility of simultaneous global constrain/stiffness exploration and safe manipulation of flexibly constrained objects. We believe that this approach will eventually enable safe cooperative manipulation in applications such as organ retraction and manipulation during surgery
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于未知环境中柔性约束物体安全自主操作的在线路径规划算法。研究提出了实时识别与表征感知柔性约束及全局刚度的方法。这些方法协同使用时，可使机器人安全地同步完成弹性系统的探索、表征与操作任务。通过基于局部力和位置信息的约束探索，实现了无需系统先验知识的导航。研究在物体（系统）运动轨迹的多个位姿处考量感知约束刚度，利用刚度特征向量信息，通过简单机械约束（如铰链和平面约束）的图册来表征和识别全局刚度行为。通过仿真和实验验证了这些算法的有效性，实时识别多种常见简单机械约束（如柔性铰链）并确定相关螺旋参数的能力得到证实。研究结果表明，同步实现全局约束/刚度探索与柔性约束物体安全操作具有可行性。我们相信该方法最终将能实现手术中器官牵拉等应用场景下的安全协同操作。
tldr: This paper introduces an online path planning algorithm for autonomous manipulation of flexibly constrained objects in unknown environments, featuring real-time identification of flexible constraints and global stiffness. It demonstrates feasibility in recognizing common mechanical constraints and safe manipulation, with potential applications in surgical robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在线路径规划算法，用于在未知环境中自主操作柔性约束物体，实时识别柔性约束和全局刚度。展示了识别常见机械约束和安全操作的可行性，潜在应用于手术机器人。

title: Training-free Detection and 6D Pose Estimation of Unseen Surgical Instruments
summary: Purpose: Accurate detection and 6D pose estimation of surgical instruments are crucial for many computer-assisted interventions. However, supervised methods lack flexibility for new or unseen tools and require extensive annotated data. This work introduces a training-free pipeline for accurate multi-view 6D pose estimation of unseen surgical instruments, which only requires a textured CAD model as prior knowledge. Methods: Our pipeline consists of two main stages. First, for detection, we generate object mask proposals in each view and score their similarity to rendered templates using a pre-trained feature extractor. Detections are matched across views, triangulated into 3D instance candidates, and filtered using multi-view geometric consistency. Second, for pose estimation, a set of pose hypotheses is iteratively refined and scored using feature-metric scores with cross-view attention. The best hypothesis undergoes a final refinement using a novel multi-view, occlusion-aware contour registration, which minimizes reprojection errors of unoccluded contour points. Results: The proposed method was rigorously evaluated on real-world surgical data from the MVPSP dataset. The method achieves millimeter-accurate pose estimates that are on par with supervised methods under controlled conditions, while maintaining full generalization to unseen instruments. These results demonstrate the feasibility of training-free, marker-less detection and tracking in surgical scenes, and highlight the unique challenges in surgical environments. Conclusion: We present a novel and flexible pipeline that effectively combines state-of-the-art foundational models, multi-view geometry, and contour-based refinement for high-accuracy 6D pose estimation of surgical instruments without task-specific training. This approach enables robust instrument tracking and scene understanding in dynamic clinical environments.
summary_zh:
摘要：
目的：手术器械的精确检测与六维姿态估计对众多计算机辅助介入技术至关重要。然而，有监督方法对新器械或未见器械缺乏适应性，且需要大量标注数据。本研究提出一种无需训练的流程，仅需纹理化CAD模型作为先验知识，即可实现未见手术器械的多视角六维姿态精确估计。方法：该流程包含两个核心阶段。首先在检测阶段，通过预训练特征提取器生成各视角下的物体掩膜提案并计算其与渲染模板的相似度评分，通过跨视角匹配检测结果、三角化为三维实例候选，并利用多视角几何一致性进行筛选。其次在姿态估计阶段，采用带跨视角注意力的特征度量评分对姿态假设集进行迭代优化与评分，最终通过新型多视角遮挡感知轮廓配准（最小化未遮挡轮廓点的重投影误差）完成最优假设的精细化调整。结果：在MVPSP数据集真实手术场景下的严格测试表明，该方法在受控条件下可获得与有监督方法相当的毫米级精度姿态估计，同时保持对未见器械的完全泛化能力。这些结果验证了手术场景中无需训练、无标记物检测与跟踪的可行性，并揭示了手术环境特有的技术挑战。结论：我们提出了一种创新且灵活的流程，通过融合前沿基础模型、多视角几何与基于轮廓的精细化策略，无需任务特定训练即可实现手术器械的高精度六维姿态估计。该方法为动态临床环境中的器械追踪与场景理解提供了鲁棒解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces a training-free pipeline for 6D pose estimation of unseen surgical instruments using multi-view geometry and contour-based refinement, achieving accuracy comparable to supervised methods without requiring annotated data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的流程，用于通过多视角几何和基于轮廓的细化来估计未见手术器械的6D姿态，无需标注数据即可达到与监督方法相当的精度。

title: Seeing Through Smoke: Surgical Desmoking for Improved Visual Perception
summary: Minimally invasive and robot-assisted surgery relies heavily on endoscopic imaging, yet surgical smoke produced by electrocautery and vessel-sealing instruments can severely degrade visual perception and hinder vision-based functionalities. We present a transformer-based surgical desmoking model with a physics-inspired desmoking head that jointly predicts smoke-free image and corresponding smoke map. To address the scarcity of paired smoky-to-smoke-free training data, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that blends artificial smoke patterns with real endoscopic images, yielding over 80,000 paired samples for supervised training. We further curate, to our knowledge, the largest paired surgical smoke dataset to date, comprising 5,817 image pairs captured with the da Vinci robotic surgical system, enabling benchmarking on high-resolution endoscopic images. Extensive experiments on both a public benchmark and our dataset demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in image reconstruction compared to existing dehazing and desmoking approaches. We also assess the impact of desmoking on downstream stereo depth estimation and instrument segmentation, highlighting both the potential benefits and current limitations of digital smoke removal methods.
summary_zh: 微创手术和机器人辅助手术高度依赖内镜成像，但电凝和血管封闭器械产生的手术烟雾会严重降低视觉感知能力，并阻碍基于视觉的功能实现。我们提出了一种基于Transformer的手术去烟模型，该模型采用物理启发的去烟头联合预测无烟图像和对应的烟雾图。为了解决成对烟雾-无烟训练数据稀缺的问题，我们开发了一个合成数据生成管道，将人工烟雾模式与真实内镜图像混合，产生了超过80,000个成对样本用于监督训练。我们进一步整理了据我们所知目前最大的成对手术烟雾数据集，包含5,817对使用达芬奇机器人手术系统采集的图像对，能够对高分辨率内镜图像进行基准测试。在公共基准数据集和我们数据集上的广泛实验表明，与现有的去雾和去烟方法相比，本方法在图像重建方面达到了最先进的性能。我们还评估了去烟对下游立体深度估计和器械分割的影响，突出了数字去烟方法的潜在优势和当前局限性。
tldr: The paper presents a transformer-based surgical desmoking model that jointly predicts smoke‑free images and smoke maps, trained on over 80 k synthetic and 5 817 real da Vinci endoscopic pairs, achieving state‑of‑the‑art image reconstruction and improving downstream depth estimation and instrument segmentation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于Transformer的手术烟雾去除模型，能够同时预测无烟图像和烟雾分布图，基于超过8万张合成和5817张真实达芬奇内镜图像对进行训练，实现了先进的图像重建并提升了后续深度估计和器械分割的性能。

title: IP-SAM: Prompt-Space Conditioning for Prompt-Absent Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Prompt-conditioned foundation segmenters have emerged as a dominant paradigm for image segmentation, where explicit spatial prompts (e.g., points, boxes, masks) guide mask decoding. However, many real-world deployments require fully automatic segmentation, creating a structural mismatch: the decoder expects prompts that are unavailable at inference. Existing adaptations typically modify intermediate features, inadvertently bypassing the model's native prompt interface and weakening prompt-conditioned decoding. We propose IP-SAM, which revisits adaptation from a prompt-space perspective through prompt-space conditioning. Specifically, a Self-Prompt Generator (SPG) distills image context into complementary intrinsic prompts that serve as coarse regional anchors. These cues are projected through SAM2's frozen prompt encoder, restoring prompt-guided decoding without external intervention. To suppress background-induced false positives, Prompt-Space Gating (PSG) leverages the intrinsic background prompt as an asymmetric suppressive constraint prior to decoding. Under a deterministic no-external-prompt protocol, IP-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance across four camouflaged object detection benchmarks (e.g., MAE 0.017 on COD10K) with only 21.26M trainable parameters (optimizing SPG, PSG, and a task-specific mask decoder trained from scratch, alongside image-encoder LoRA while keeping the prompt encoder frozen). Furthermore, the proposed conditioning strategy generalizes beyond COD to medical polyp segmentation, where a model trained solely on Kvasir-SEG exhibits strong zero-shot transfer to both CVC-ClinicDB and ETIS.
summary_zh: 提示条件化基础分割模型已成为图像分割的主导范式，其中显式的空间提示（如点、框、掩码）引导掩码解码。然而，许多实际部署需要完全自动化的分割，造成了结构性不匹配：解码器期望的提示在推理时不可用。现有适配方法通常修改中间特征，无意中绕过了模型的原生提示接口，从而削弱了提示条件化解码能力。我们提出了IP-SAM，该方法从提示空间视角重新审视适配问题，通过提示空间条件化实现。具体而言，一个自提示生成器（SPG）将图像上下文提炼为互补的内在提示，作为粗粒度区域锚点。这些线索通过SAM2冻结的提示编码器投影，在无需外部干预的情况下恢复提示引导解码。为了抑制背景引起的误报，提示空间门控（PSG）利用内在背景提示作为解码前的非对称抑制约束。在确定性无外部提示协议下，IP-SAM在四个伪装目标检测基准上实现了最先进的性能（例如，在COD10K上MAE为0.017），仅需21.26M可训练参数（优化SPG、PSG和从头训练的任务特定掩码解码器，同时使用图像编码器LoRA并保持提示编码器冻结）。此外，所提出的条件化策略可泛化至医学息肉分割领域，仅在Kvasir-SEG上训练的模型即可展现出向CVC-ClinicDB和ETIS的强零样本迁移能力。
tldr: IP‑SAM adapts a prompt‑conditioned SAM2 segmenter to fully automatic (prompt‑absent) camouflaged object detection via a self‑prompt generator and prompt‑space gating, achieving state‑of‑the‑art results on four benchmarks and zero‑shot transfer to medical polyp segmentation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出IP‑SAM，通过自提示生成器和提示空间门控将提示条件化的SAM2模型适配到无提示的伪装目标检测，在四个基准上取得先进性能并展示对医学息肉分割的零样本迁移。

title: Probe-to-Grasp Manipulation Using Self-Sensing Pneumatic Variable-Stiffness Joints
summary: Grasping deformable objects with varying stiffness remains a significant challenge in robotics. Estimating the local stiffness of a target object is important for determining an optimal grasp pose that enables stable pickup without damaging the object. This paper presents a probe-to-grasp manipulation framework for estimating the relative stiffness of objects using a passive soft-rigid two-finger hybrid gripper equipped with self-sensing pneumatic variable-stiffness joints. Each finger of the gripper consists of two rigid links connected by a soft pneumatic ring placed at the joint, enabling both compliant interaction and controllable joint stiffness via internal pressurization. By measuring the pressure inside the pneumatic ring, we can estimate the interaction force during contact. Building on this, we propose a practical probing strategy to infer relative object stiffness by correlating the estimated normal force with known gripper closing displacement. We validate the self-sensing model through stiffness characterization experiments across bending angles and pressure ranges, and demonstrate stiffness-aware probing-and-grasping in real-life applications: selecting grasp locations on fruits with spatially varying stiffness. The proposed system offers a minimal, low-cost sensing approach for stiffness-aware soft manipulation while retaining probing and grasping capability.
summary_zh: 抓取具有不同刚度的可变形物体仍然是机器人领域的一个重要挑战。估计目标物体的局部刚度对于确定最佳抓取位姿至关重要，这样可以在稳定拾取物体的同时避免损坏物体。本文提出了一种基于探针到抓取的操作框架，使用配备自感测气压可变刚度关节的被动软硬混合两指夹持器来估计物体的相对刚度。夹持器的每个手指由两个刚性连杆组成，通过放置在关节处的气软环连接，通过内部加压实现顺应性交互和可控的关节刚度。通过测量气软环内部的压力，我们可以估计接触时的相互作用力。在此基础上，我们提出了一种实用的探测策略，通过将估计的法向力与已知的夹持器闭合位移相关联来推断物体的相对刚度。我们通过在弯曲角度和压力范围内进行的刚度表征实验验证了自感测模型，并展示了在现实应用中的刚度感知探测与抓取：针对具有空间刚度变化的水果选择抓取位置。该系统提供了一种最小化、低成本的刚度感知软体操作传感方法，同时保留了探测和抓取能力。
tldr: The paper proposes a probe‑to‑grasp framework that uses a soft‑rigid hybrid gripper with self‑sensing pneumatic variable‑stiffness joints to infer an object’s relative stiffness, enabling stable grasping of deformable items like fruit.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种探测‑抓取框架，利用带有自感压气动可变刚度关节的软‑硬混合夹持器推断物体的相对刚度，从而实现对可变形物体（如水果）的稳固抓取。

title: PoseDreamer: Scalable and Photorealistic Human Data Generation Pipeline with Diffusion Models
summary: Acquiring labeled datasets for 3D human mesh estimation is challenging due to depth ambiguities and the inherent difficulty of annotating 3D geometry from monocular images. Existing datasets are either real, with manually annotated 3D geometry and limited scale, or synthetic, rendered from 3D engines that provide precise labels but suffer from limited photorealism, low diversity, and high production costs. In this work, we explore a third path: generated data. We introduce PoseDreamer, a novel pipeline that leverages diffusion models to generate large-scale synthetic datasets with 3D mesh annotations. Our approach combines controllable image generation with Direct Preference Optimization for control alignment, curriculum-based hard sample mining, and multi-stage quality filtering. Together, these components naturally maintain correspondence between 3D labels and generated images, while prioritizing challenging samples to maximize dataset utility. Using PoseDreamer, we generate more than 500,000 high-quality synthetic samples, achieving a 76% improvement in image-quality metrics compared to rendering-based datasets. Models trained on PoseDreamer achieve performance comparable to or superior to those trained on real-world and traditional synthetic datasets. In addition, combining PoseDreamer with synthetic datasets results in better performance than combining real-world and synthetic datasets, demonstrating the complementary nature of our dataset. We will release the full dataset and generation code.
summary_zh: 获取用于3D人体网格估计的标注数据集具有挑战性，原因在于深度模糊以及从单目图像标注3D几何的固有困难。现有数据集要么是真实的，包含手动标注的3D几何但规模有限，要么是合成的，由3D引擎渲染提供精确标签，但存在照片真实感不足、多样性有限以及生产成本高的问题。在本工作中，我们探索了第三条路径：生成式数据。我们提出了PoseDreamer，这是一种利用扩散模型生成大规模带3D网格标注的合成数据集的新颖管道。我们的方法结合了可控图像生成与直接偏好优化的控制对齐、基于课程的难例挖掘以及多阶段质量过滤。这些组件自然地维持了3D标签与生成图像之间的对应关系，同时优先考虑挑战性样本以最大化数据集效用。使用PoseDreamer，我们生成了超过50万个高质量合成样本，在图像质量指标上相比基于渲染的数据集实现了76%的提升。在PoseDreamer上训练的模型性能与在真实世界和传统合成数据集上训练的模型相当或更优。此外，将PoseDreamer与合成数据集结合使用比将真实世界与合成数据集结合使用效果更好，证明了我们数据集的互补性。我们将发布完整的数据集和生成代码。
tldr: PoseDreamer introduces a diffusion‑model based pipeline that generates massive photorealistic human images paired with precise 3D mesh annotations, outperforming conventional rendering datasets and enabling models trained on it to reach state‑of‑the‑art accuracy.
tldr_zh: PoseDreamer提出了一种基于扩散模型的可扩展pipeline，能够生成大规模高保真人体图像并附带精确的3D网格标注，在图像质量指标上比传统渲染数据集提升76%，并使训练模型达到或超越现有最佳性能。

title: Functional Force-Aware Retargeting from Virtual Human Demos to Soft Robot Policies
summary: We introduce SoftAct, a framework for teaching soft robot hands to perform human-like manipulation skills by explicitly reasoning about contact forces. Leveraging immersive virtual reality, our system captures rich human demonstrations, including hand kinematics, object motion, dense contact patches, and detailed contact force information. Unlike conventional approaches that retarget human joint trajectories, SoftAct employs a two-stage, force-aware retargeting algorithm. The first stage attributes demonstrated contact forces to individual human fingers and allocates robot fingers proportionally, establishing a force-balanced mapping between human and robot hands. The second stage performs online retargeting by combining baseline end-effector pose tracking with geodesic-weighted contact refinements, using contact geometry and force magnitude to adjust robot fingertip targets in real time. This formulation enables soft robotic hands to reproduce the functional intent of human demonstrations while naturally accommodating extreme embodiment mismatch and nonlinear compliance. We evaluate SoftAct on a suite of contact-rich manipulation tasks using a custom non-anthropomorphic pneumatic soft robot hand. SoftAct's controller reduces fingertip trajectory tracking RMSE by up to 55 percent and reduces tracking variance by up to 69 percent compared to kinematic and learning-based baselines. At the policy level, SoftAct achieves consistently higher success in zero-shot real-world deployment and in simulation. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling contact geometry and force distribution is essential for effective skill transfer to soft robotic hands, and cannot be recovered through kinematic imitation alone. Project videos and additional details are available at https://soft-act.github.io/.
summary_zh:
摘要：

我们提出了SoftAct框架，旨在通过显式推理接触力来指导软体机械手完成类人操作技能。利用沉浸式虚拟现实技术，我们的系统采集了丰富的人类演示数据，包括手部运动学、物体运动、密集接触区域以及详细的接触力信息。与传统的重定向人类关节轨迹方法不同，SoftAct采用两阶段力感知重定向算法。第一阶段将演示的接触力归因于各人类手指，并按比例分配给机械手指，从而建立人类与机械手之间的力平衡映射。第二阶段通过将基线末端执行器姿态跟踪与测地线加权接触优化相结合进行在线重定向，利用接触几何和力矩信息实时调整机械手指尖目标。该方法使软体机械手能够重现人类演示的功能意图，同时自然地适应极端的形态不匹配和非线性柔顺性。我们在一套接触丰富的操作任务上对SoftAct进行了评估，使用了一款定制的气动非拟人化软体机械手。与基于运动学和基于学习的基线方法相比，SoftAct的控制器将指尖轨迹跟踪均方根误差降低高达55%，将跟踪方差降低高达69%。在策略层面，SoftAct在零样本真实世界部署和仿真中均实现了更高的成功率。这些结果表明，显式建模接触几何和力分布对于向软体机械手进行有效的技能转移至关重要，且无法仅通过运动学模仿来恢复。项目视频和更多细节请访问https://soft-act.github.io/。
tldr: SoftAct introduces a two-stage, force-aware retargeting method that maps human hand demonstrations with contact forces to soft robot hands, achieving substantially improved tracking accuracy and zero‑shot real‑world manipulation.
tldr_zh: SoftAct 引入了一种两阶段、力感知的重定位方法，将人类手部演示中的接触力映射到软体机器人手，实现了显著的跟踪精度提升和零样本真实世界操作。

title: A virtual-variable-length method for robust inverse kinematics of multi-segment continuum robots
summary: This paper proposes a new, robust method to solve the inverse kinematics (IK) of multi-segment continuum manipulators. Conventional Jacobian-based solvers, especially when initialized from neutral/rest configurations, often exhibit slow convergence and, in certain conditions, may fail to converge (deadlock). The Virtual-Variable-Length (VVL) method proposed here introduces fictitious variations of segments' length during the solution iteration, conferring virtual axial degrees of freedom that alleviate adverse behaviors and constraints, thus enabling or accelerating convergence. Comprehensive numerical experiments were conducted to compare the VVL method against benchmark Jacobian-based and Damped Least Square IK solvers. Across more than $1.8\times 10^6$ randomized trials covering manipulators with two to seven segments, the proposed approach achieved up to a 20$\%$ increase in convergence success rate over the benchmark and a 40-80$\%$ reduction in average iteration count under equivalent accuracy thresholds ($10^{-4}-10^{-8}$). While deadlocks are not restricted to workspace boundaries and may occur at arbitrary poses, our empirical study identifies boundary-proximal configurations as a frequent cause of failed convergence and the VVL method mitigates such occurrences over a statistical sample of test cases.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新的鲁棒方法，用于求解多段连续体机械臂的逆运动学（IK）。传统的基于雅可比矩阵的求解器，尤其是在从中性/静止构型初始化时，往往收敛缓慢，并且在某些条件下可能无法收敛（死锁）。本文提出的虚拟变长度（VVL）方法在求解迭代过程中引入段长度的虚构变化，赋予系统虚拟轴向自由度，从而缓解不利行为和约束条件，进而实现或加速收敛。本文进行了全面的数值实验，将VVL方法与基于雅可比矩阵和阻尼最小二乘的IK基准求解器进行比较。在超过$1.8\times 10^6$次随机试验中，涵盖了二至七段机械臂，所提方法的收敛成功率比基准方法最高提升20%，在相同精度阈值（$10^{-4}-10^{-8}$）下平均迭代次数减少40-80%。虽然死锁不仅限于工作空间边界且可能发生在任意姿态，但我们的实证研究表明，接近边界的构型是收敛失败的常见原因，VVL方法在测试案例的统计样本中减轻了此类问题的发生。
tldr: The paper presents a Virtual‑Variable‑Length (VVL) method that adds fictitious length changes to each segment during inverse‑kinematics iteration, thereby giving virtual axial degrees of freedom that greatly improve convergence and prevent deadlocks in multi‑segment continuum robots, outperforming standard Jacobian‑based and Damped‑Least‑Square solvers in over 1.8 million random tests.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种虚拟可变长度（VVL）方法，在逆运动学迭代过程中对每段引入虚构的长度变化，赋予虚拟轴向自由度，从而显著提升多段连续体机器人的收敛成功率并避免死锁，在超过180万次随机测试中优于传统的Jacobian和阻尼最小二乘求解器。

title: Robust Autonomous Control of a Magnetic Millirobot in In Vitro Cardiac Flow
summary: Untethered magnetic millirobots offer significant potential for minimally invasive cardiac therapies; however, achieving reliable autonomous control in pulsatile cardiac flow remains challenging. This work presents a vision-guided control framework enabling precise autonomous navigation of a magnetic millirobot in an in vitro heart phantom under physiologically relevant flow conditions. The system integrates UNet-based localization, A* path planning, and a sliding mode controller with a disturbance observer (SMC-DOB) designed for multi-coil electromagnetic actuation. Although drag forces are estimated using steady-state CFD simulations, the controller compensates for transient pulsatile disturbances during closed-loop operation. In static fluid, the SMC-DOB achieved sub-millimeter accuracy (root-mean-square error, RMSE = 0.49 mm), outperforming PID and MPC baselines. Under moderate pulsatile flow (7 cm/s peak, 20 cP), it reduced RMSE by 37% and peak error by 2.4$\times$ compared to PID. It further maintained RMSE below 2 mm (0.27 body lengths) under elevated pulsatile flow (10 cm/s peak, 20 cP) and under low-viscosity conditions (4.3 cP, 7 cm/s peak), where baseline controllers exhibited unstable or failed tracking. These results demonstrate robust closed-loop magnetic control under time-varying cardiac flow disturbances and support the feasibility of autonomous millirobot navigation for targeted drug delivery.
summary_zh: 无束磁微纳机器人在微创心脏治疗领域具有巨大潜力；然而，在搏动性心脏血流中实现可靠的自主控制仍面临挑战。本研究提出了一种视觉引导控制框架，能够在生理相关流动条件下实现磁微纳机器人在离体心脏模型中的精确自主导航。该系统集成了基于UNet的定位模块、A*路径规划模块以及针对多线圈电磁驱动设计的滑模干扰观测控制器（SMC-DOB）。虽然阻力采用稳态CFD模拟进行估计，但控制器在闭环运行过程中能够补偿瞬态搏动干扰。在静态流体中，SMC-DOB实现了亚毫米级精度（均方根误差RMSE = 0.49 mm），优于PID和MPC基线控制器。在中等搏动流（峰值7 cm/s，20 cP）条件下，与PID相比，RMSE降低37%，峰值误差降低2.4倍。在增强搏动流（峰值10 cm/s，20 cP）和低粘度条件（4.3 cP，峰值7 cm/s）下，RMSE仍保持在2 mm以下（0.27体长），而基线控制器则出现跟踪不稳定或失效。这些结果证明了在时变心脏血流干扰下闭环磁控制的鲁棒性，并支持了用于靶向药物递送的自主微纳机器人导航的可行性。
tldr: This paper introduces a vision‑guided autonomous control framework for magnetic millirobots in an in‑vitro heart phantom, combining UNet‑based localisation, A* path planning and an SMC‑DOB sliding‑mode controller to achieve sub‑millimetre tracking under pulsatile cardiac flow.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉引导的磁力微型机器人自主控制框架，结合UNet定位、A*路径规划与SMC‑DOB滑模控制器，在体外心脏模型中实现亚毫米级追踪精度，能够在脉动的心脏血流环境下精准导航。

title: AffordTissue: Dense Affordance Prediction for Tool-Action Specific Tissue Interaction
summary: Surgical action automation has progressed rapidly toward achieving surgeon-like dexterous control, driven primarily by advances in learning from demonstration and vision-language-action models. While these have demonstrated success in table-top experiments, translating them to clinical deployment remains challenging: current methods offer limited predictability on where instruments will interact on tissue surfaces and lack explicit conditioning inputs to enforce tool-action-specific safe interaction regions. Addressing this gap, we introduce AffordTissue, a multimodal framework for predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions as dense heatmaps during cholecystectomy. Our approach combines a temporal vision encoder capturing tool motion and tissue dynamics across multiple viewpoints, language conditioning enabling generalization across diverse instrument-action pairs, and a DiT-style decoder for dense affordance prediction. We establish the first tissue affordance benchmark by curating and annotating 15,638 video clips across 103 cholecystectomy procedures, covering six unique tool-action pairs involving four instruments (hook, grasper, scissors, clipper) and their associated tasks: dissection, grasping, clipping, and cutting. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvement over vision-language model baselines (20.6 px ASSD vs. 60.2 px for Molmo-VLM), showing that our task-specific architecture outperforms large-scale foundation models for dense surgical affordance prediction. By predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions, AffordTissue provides explicit spatial reasoning for safe surgical automation, potentially unlocking explicit policy guidance toward appropriate tissue regions and early safe stop when instruments deviate outside predicted safe zones.
summary_zh: 手术动作自动化在实现类似外科医生的灵巧控制方面进展迅速，主要得益于示教学习和视觉-语言-动作模型的进步。虽然这些方法在桌面实验中已取得成功，但将其转化为临床应用仍面临挑战：现有方法对器械在组织表面交互位置的预测能力有限，且缺乏明确的条件输入来强制执行工具-动作特定的安全交互区域。为解决这一空白，我们提出了AffordTissue，一个多模态框架，用于在胆囊切除术中预测工具-动作特异性的组织可操作区域并以密集热图形式输出。我们的方法结合了捕获多视角下工具运动和组织动态的时序视觉编码器、支持跨不同器械-动作对泛化的语言条件机制，以及用于密集可操作性预测的DiT风格解码器。我们通过整理和标注103例胆囊切除手术的15,638个视频片段，建立了首个组织可操作性基准数据集，涵盖涉及四种器械（钩抓钳、抓取钳、剪刀、止血夹钳）的六个独特工具-动作对及其相关任务：剥离、抓取、夹闭和切割。实验表明，我们的模型相比视觉-语言模型基线取得了显著提升（20.6像素ASSD vs. 60.2像素的Molmo-VLM），证明我们的任务特定架构在密集手术可操作性预测方面优于大规模基础模型。通过预测工具-动作特异性的组织可操作区域，AffordTissue为安全手术自动化提供了明确的空间推理能力，有望实现针对适当组织区域的明确策略指导，并在器械偏离预测安全区域时实现早期安全停止。
tldr: AffordTissue introduces a multimodal VLA framework for predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions during cholecystectomy, creating the first tissue affordance benchmark with 15,638 video clips and demonstrating significant improvements over baseline vision-language models.
tldr_zh: AffordTissue引入了一个多模态VLA框架，用于预测胆囊切除术中特定工具-动作组合的组织affordance区域，创建了首个包含15,638个视频剪辑的组织affordance基准数据集，并展示了相对于基线视觉语言模型的显著改进。

title: A Flow Matching Framework for Soft-Robot Inverse Dynamics
summary: Learning the inverse dynamics of soft continuum robots remains challenging due to high-dimensional nonlinearities and complex actuation coupling. Conventional feedback-based controllers often suffer from control chattering due to corrective oscillations, while deterministic regression-based learners struggle to capture the complex nonlinear mappings required for accurate dynamic tracking. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an inverse-dynamics framework for open-loop feedforward control that learns the system's differential dynamics as a generative transport map. Specifically, inverse dynamics is reformulated as a conditional flow-matching problem, and Rectified Flow (RF) is adopted as a lightweight instance to generate physically consistent control inputs rather than conditional averages. Two variants are introduced to further enhance physical consistency: RF-Physical, utilizing a physics-based prior for residual modeling; and RF-FWD, integrating a forward-dynamics consistency loss during flow matching. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework reduces trajectory tracking RMSE by over 50% compared to standard regression baselines (MLP, LSTM, Transformer). The system sustains stable open-loop execution at a peak end-effector velocity of 1.14 m/s with sub-millisecond inference latency (0.995 ms). This work demonstrates flow matching as a robust, high-performance paradigm for learning differential inverse dynamics in soft robotic systems.
summary_zh: 学习软体连续体机器人的逆动力学仍具挑战性，这主要归因于高维非线性和复杂的驱动耦合。传统的基于反馈的控制器常因修正振荡而产生控制抖振，而基于确定性回归的学习器难以捕捉精确动态跟踪所需的复杂非线性映射。受这些局限性的启发，我们提出了一种用于开环前馈控制的逆动力学框架，将系统的微分动力学学习为生成式传输映射。具体而言，逆动力学被重新表述为条件流匹配问题，并采用Rectified Flow（RF）作为轻量级实例来生成物理一致的输入而非条件平均值。为进一步增强物理一致性，引入了两种变体：RF-Physical利用基于物理的先验进行残差建模；RF-FWD在流匹配过程中集成前向动力学一致性损失。大量评估表明，与标准回归基线（MLP、LSTM、Transformer）相比，我们的框架将轨迹跟踪均方根误差降低了50%以上。该系统在峰值末端执行器速度达1.14 m/s时保持稳定开环执行，推理延迟低于1毫秒（0.995 ms）。本工作展示了流匹配作为学习软体机器人系统差分逆动力学的鲁棒高性能范式的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a flow matching framework for learning inverse dynamics of soft continuum robots, reformulating the problem as conditional flow matching using Rectified Flow to generate physically consistent control inputs, achieving over 50% RMSE reduction and sub-millisecond inference latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于学习软体连续体机器人逆动力学 Flow Matching 框架，将问题重新表述为条件流匹配，使用 Rectified Flow 生成物理一致的控制输入，实现了超过 50% 的 RMSE 降低和亚毫秒级推理延迟。

title: Unlocking Positive Transfer in Incrementally Learning Surgical Instruments: A Self-reflection Hierarchical Prompt Framework
summary: To continuously enhance model adaptability in surgical video scene parsing, recent studies incrementally update it to progressively learn to segment an increasing number of surgical instruments over time. However, prior works constantly overlooked the potential of positive forward knowledge transfer, i.e., how past knowledge could help learn new classes, and positive backward knowledge transfer, i.e., how learning new classes could help refine past knowledge. In this paper, we propose a self-reflection hierarchical prompt framework that unlocks the power of positive forward and backward knowledge transfer in class incremental segmentation, aiming to proficiently learn new instruments, improve existing skills of regular instruments, and avoid catastrophic forgetting of old instruments. Our framework is built on a frozen, pre-trained model that adaptively appends instrument-aware prompts for new classes throughout training episodes. To enable positive forward knowledge transfer, we organize instrument prompts into a hierarchical prompt parsing tree with the instrument-shared prompt partition as the root node, n-part-shared prompt partitions as intermediate nodes and instrument-distinct prompt partitions as leaf nodes, to expose the reusable historical knowledge for new classes to simplify their learning. Conversely, to encourage positive backward knowledge transfer, we conduct self-reflection refining on existing knowledge by directed-weighted graph propagation, examining the knowledge associations recorded in the tree to improve its representativeness without causing catastrophic forgetting. Our framework is applicable to both CNN-based models and advanced transformer-based foundation models, yielding more than 5% and 11% improvements over the competing methods on two public benchmarks respectively.
summary_zh: 为了持续提升模型在手术视频场景解析中的适应性，近期研究通过增量更新模型使其逐步学习分割日益增多的手术器械。然而，现有工作持续忽略了正向知识迁移的潜力，即过去知识如何帮助学习新类别，以及逆向知识迁移的潜力，即学习新类别如何助力完善旧知识。本文提出了一种自反思层级提示框架，旨在释放类别增量分割中正向和逆向知识迁移的力量，目标是熟练学习新器械、提升常规器械的现有技能并避免旧器械的灾难性遗忘。我们的框架基于一个冻结的预训练模型构建，该模型在训练过程中自适应地为新类别附加器械感知提示。为了实现正向知识迁移，我们将器械提示组织为层级提示解析树，以器械共享提示分区作为根节点，n部件共享提示分区作为中间节点，器械独特提示分区作为叶节点，使可复用的历史知识暴露给新类别以简化其学习过程。相反，为了促进逆向知识迁移，我们通过有向加权图传播对现有知识进行自反思精炼，检查树中记录的知识关联以提升其代表性，同时避免灾难性遗忘。我们的框架适用于基于CNN的模型和先进的基于Transformer的基础模型，在两个公开基准数据集上分别比竞争方法提升了超过5%和11%。
tldr: This paper proposes a self‑reflection hierarchical prompt framework that enables incremental learning of new surgical instrument classes in video segmentation by leveraging forward and backward knowledge transfer, achieving over 5% and 11% improvements on two public benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自反射层级提示框架，通过正向和反向知识迁移实现外科手术器械视频分割的增量学习，在两个公开基准上取得了超过5%和11%的显著提升。

title: Elastomeric Strain Limitation for Design of Soft Pneumatic Actuators
summary:
Modern robots embody power and precision control. Yet, as robots undertake tasks that apply forces on humans, this power brings risk of injury. Soft robotic actuators use deformation to produce smooth, continuous motions and conform to delicate objects while imparting forces capable of safely pushing humans. This thesis presents strategies for the design, modeling, and strain-based control of human-safe elastomeric soft pneumatic actuators (SPA) for force generation, focusing on embodied mechanical response to simple pressure inputs.
  We investigate electroadhesive (EA) strain limiters for variable shape generation, rapid force application, and targeted inflation trajectories. We attach EA clutches to a concentrically strain-limited elastomeric membrane to alter the inflation trajectory and rapidly reorient the inflated shape. We expand the capabilities of EA for soft robots by encasing them in elastomeric sheaths and varying their activation in real time, demonstrating applications in variable trajectory inflation under identical pressure sweeps.
  We then address the problem of trajectory control in the presence of external forces by modeling the pressure-trajectory relationship for a concentrically strain-limited class of silicone actuators. We validate theoretical models based on material properties and energy minimization using active learning and automated testing. We apply our ensemble of neural networks for inverse membrane design, specifying quasi-static mass lift trajectories from a simple pressure sweep. Finally, we demonstrate the power of multiple pressure-linked actuators in a proof-of-concept mannequin leg lift.
summary_zh:
现代机器人体现了力量与精确控制。然而，当机器人执行对人体施加力量的任务时，这种力量带来了伤害风险。软体机器人执行器通过变形产生平滑、连续的运动，贴合精细物体，同时施加能够安全推动人类的力量。本论文提出了针对人力安全弹性体软气动执行器（SPA）的设计、建模与应变控制策略，重点关注其对简单压力输入的具身机械响应。

我们研究了电粘附（EA）应变限制器，用于可变形状生成、快速力量施加和有针对性的充气轨迹。我们将EA离合器连接到同心应变受限的弹性薄膜上，以改变充气轨迹并快速重新定向充气形状。我们通过将EA封装在弹性护套中并实时改变其激活状态来扩展EA在软机器人中的应用，展示了在相同压力扫描下可变轨迹充气的应用。

随后，我们通过建立同心应变受限硅胶执行器类的压力-轨迹关系模型，来解决存在外力情况下的轨迹控制问题。我们利用主动学习和自动化测试，基于材料特性和能量最小化对理论模型进行了验证。我们将神经网络集成应用于逆向薄膜设计，从简单的压力扫描中指定准静态质举轨迹。最后，我们通过概念验证的假人抬腿实验展示了多个压力联动执行器的效能。
tldr: The thesis introduces electroadhesive strain limiters and modeling methods for soft pneumatic actuators to achieve safe, variable shape generation and force control, demonstrating applications like variable trajectory inflation and a proof‑of‑concept leg lift.
tldr_zh: 本论文提出电粘附应变限制器及软气动执行器的建模方法，实现安全、可变形状生成与力控制，并展示了可变轨迹充气与仿人腿部抬起等应用。

title: Simulation-Driven Evolutionary Motion Parameterization for Contact-Rich Granular Scooping with a Soft Conical Robotic Hand
summary: Tool-based scooping is vital in robot-assisted tasks, enabling interaction with objects of varying sizes, shapes, and material states. Recent studies have shown that flexible, reconfigurable soft robotic end-effectors can adapt their shape to maintain consistent contact with container surfaces during scooping, improving efficiency compared to rigid tools. These soft tools can adjust to varying container sizes and materials without requiring complex sensing or control. However, the inherent compliance and complex deformation behavior of soft robotics introduce significant control complexity that limits practical applications. To address this challenge, this paper presents the development of a physics-based simulation model of a deformable soft conical robotic hand that captures its passive reconfiguration dynamics and enables systematic trajectory optimization for scooping tasks. We propose a novel physics-based simulation approach that accurately models the soft tool's morphing behavior from flat sheets to adaptive conical structures, combined with an evolutionary strategy framework that automatically optimizes scooping trajectories without manual parameter tuning. We validate the optimized trajectories through both simulation and real-robot experiments. The results demonstrate strong generalization and successfully address a range of challenging tasks previously beyond the reach of existing approaches. Videos of our experiments are available online: https://sites.google.com/view/scoopsh
summary_zh: 基于工具的舀取在机器人辅助任务中至关重要，能够与不同尺寸、形状和物态的物体进行交互。最近的研究表明，柔性可重构的软体机器人末端执行器能够在舀取过程中自适应地调整形状，以保持与容器表面的持续接触，与刚性工具相比提高了效率。这些软体工具能够适应不同的容器尺寸和材质，无需复杂的传感或控制。然而，软体机器人固有的柔顺性和复杂的变形行为带来了显著的控制复杂性，限制了实际应用。为应对这一挑战，本文提出开发一种基于物理的可变形软体锥形机器人手仿真模型，该模型能够捕捉其被动重构动力学特性，并实现舀取任务的系统化轨迹优化。我们提出了一种新颖的基于物理的仿真方法，能够准确模拟软体工具从平面薄片到自适应锥形结构的形变行为，并结合进化策略框架实现舀取轨迹的自动优化，无需手动参数调整。我们通过仿真和真实机器人实验验证了优化后的轨迹。结果表明，该方法具有很强的泛化能力，并成功解决了以往方法无法处理的一系列具有挑战性的任务。实验视频可在以下网址查看：https://sites.google.com/view/scoopsh

title: Bilinear Model Predictive Control Framework of the OncoReach, a Tendon-Driven Steerable Stylet for Brachytherapy
summary: Steerable needles have the potential to improve interstitial brachytherapy by enabling curved trajectories that avoid sensitive anatomical structures. However, existing modeling and control approaches are primarily developed for custom needle designs and are not directly applicable to stylets compatible with commercially available clinical needles. This paper presents a bilinear model predictive control (MPC) framework for a tendon-driven steerable stylet integrated with a standard brachytherapy needle. \textcolor{black}{A geometric bilinear model is formulated with three virtual inputs (an insertion speed and two bending rates) which are mapped to physically realizable inputs consisting of the insertion speed and the associated tendon tensions.} The approach is validated through simulations and physical insertion experiments in tissue-mimicking phantom material using image-based tip tracking. While open-loop model validation yielded estimation errors below $2$~mm, corresponding to $3\%$ of the inserted needle length, and closed-loop fixed-target tracking achieved an error as low as $1.45$~mm, corresponding to $1.7\%$ of the inserted length, experiments showed larger position errors in certain bending directions, reaching $8.3$~mm, or $7.8\%$ of the inserted length. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of fixed-target positioning and moving-target trajectory tracking for clinically compatible steerable brachytherapy systems, while highlighting necessary areas for future improvements in calibration and sensing.
summary_zh: 可转向针有可能通过实现能够避开敏感解剖结构的弯曲轨迹来改善近距离组织间放疗。然而，现有的建模和控制方法主要是针对定制针头设计的，并不直接适用于与临床商用针头兼容的套管。本文提出了一种用于集成标准近距离放疗针的肌腱驱动可转向套管的双线性模型预测控制（MPC）框架。建立了几何双linear模型，包含三个虚拟输入（插入速度和两个弯曲速率），这些虚拟输入被映射到由插入速度和相关的肌腱张力组成的物理可实现输入。该方法通过使用基于图像的尖端跟踪在仿组织体模材料中进行仿真和物理插入实验来验证。开环模型验证得到的估计误差低于2 mm，相当于插入针长度的3%，闭环固定目标跟踪实现的误差低至1.45 mm，相当于插入长度的1.7%，然而实验表明在某些弯曲方向上存在更大的位置误差，达到8.3 mm或插入长度的7.8%。总体而言，研究结果表明临床兼容的可转向近距离放疗系统进行固定目标定位和移动目标轨迹跟踪是可行的，同时指出了未来在标定和传感方面需要改进的领域。
tldr: A bilinear model predictive control framework is proposed for a tendon‑driven steerable stylet that couples with a standard brachytherapy needle, enabling curved insertion trajectories; the approach is validated in simulation and tissue‑mimicking phantom experiments, achieving sub‑centimeter tracking errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于标准近距离治疗针的腱驱动可弯曲尖端的二次模型预测控制框架，通过仿真和仿体实验验证了其在亚厘米范围内实现曲线插入轨迹的可行性。

title: Control Architecture and experimental validation of a Novel Surgical Robotic Instrument
summary: Minimally invasive surgery (MIS) reduces patient trauma and shortens recovery time; however, conventional laparoscopic instruments remain constrained by limited range of movements. This work presents the control architecture of a 4-DOF flexible laparoscopic instrument integrating distal bending, independent distal head rotation, shaft rotation, and a gripper, while maintaining a 10 mm diameter compatible with standard trocars. The actuation unit and SpaceMouse teleoperation are implemented on Raspberry Pi 5 with Motoron controllers. An analytical scissor-linkage model is derived and parameterized. The predicted jaw opening corresponds to CAD measurements (MAE 0.13{\textdegree}) and OptiTrack motion capture (MAE 1.43{\textdegree}). Integration with the ATHENA parallel robot is validated through a simulated pancreatic surgery procedure.
summary_zh:
摘要：
微创手术（MIS）可减少患者创伤并缩短恢复时间；然而，传统腹腔镜器械仍受限于运动范围有限。本研究提出了一种4自由度柔性腹腔镜器械的控制架构，该器械集成远端弯曲、独立远端头部旋转、轴旋转和夹爪功能，同时保持10 mm直径以兼容标准 trocar。致动单元和SpaceMouse遥操作系统在配备Motoron控制器的Raspberry Pi 5上实现。推导并参数化了解析剪刀连杆模型。预测的钳口开度与CAD测量结果一致（平均绝对误差0.13°），与OptiTrack运动捕捉结果相符（平均绝对误差1.43°）。通过模拟胰腺手术流程验证了与ATHENA并联机器人的集成效果。
tldr: This paper presents a 4-DOF flexible laparoscopic instrument with distal bending, rotation, and gripper capabilities, controlled via Raspberry Pi 5 and validated through CAD and motion capture experiments integrated with a parallel robot for simulated pancreatic surgery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种4自由度柔性腹腔镜器械，具有末端弯曲、旋转和夹持器功能，采用树莓派5控制，并通过CAD和运动捕捉实验验证，集成到并联机器人中进行了模拟胰腺手术验证。

title: EvoGymCM: Harnessing Continuous Material Stiffness for Soft Robot Co-Design
summary: In the automated co-design of soft robots, precisely adapting the material stiffness field to task environments is crucial for unlocking their full physical potential. However, mainstream platforms (e.g., EvoGym) strictly discretize the material dimension, artificially restricting the design space and performance of soft robots. To address this, we propose EvoGymCM (EvoGym with Continuous Materials), a benchmark suite formally establishing continuous material stiffness as a first-class design variable alongside morphology and control. Aligning with real-world material mechanisms, EvoGymCM introduces two settings: (i) EvoGymCM-R (Reactive), motivated by programmable materials with dynamically tunable stiffness; and (ii) EvoGymCM-I (Invariant), motivated by traditional materials with invariant stiffness fields. To tackle the resulting high-dimensional coupling, we formulate two Morphology-Material-Control co-design paradigms: (i) Reactive-Material Co-Design, which learns real-time stiffness tuning policies to guide programmable materials; and (ii) Invariant-Material Co-Design, which jointly optimizes morphology and fixed material fields to guide traditional material fabrication. Systematic experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate that continuous material optimization boosts performance and unlocks synergy across morphology, material, and control.
summary_zh: 在软体机器人的自动化协同设计中，精确地将材料刚度场与任务环境相匹配对于释放其全部物理潜能至关重要。然而，主流平台（如EvoGym）严格地将材料维度离散化，人为地限制了软体机器人的设计空间和性能。为此，我们提出了EvoGymCM（连续材料EvoGym），这是一个基准测试套件，正式将连续材料刚度与形态和控制一起确立为一等设计变量。与现实世界的材料机制一致，EvoGymCM引入了两种设置：(i) EvoGymCM-R（响应式），受具有动态可调刚度的可编程材料驱动；和(ii) EvoGymCM-I（恒定式），受具有恒定刚度场的传统材料驱动。为了应对产生的高维耦合问题，我们制定了两种形态-材料-控制协同设计范式：(i) 响应式材料协同设计，学习实时刚度调整策略以指导可编程材料；和(ii) 恒定式材料协同设计，联合优化形态和固定材料场以指导传统材料制造。在各种任务中的系统实验表明，连续材料优化提升了性能，并在形态、材料和控制之间释放了协同效应。
tldr: EvoGymCM introduces continuous material stiffness as a first‑class design variable in soft‑robot co‑design, offering reactive and invariant material settings, and shows performance gains across diverse tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出EvoGymCM基准，将连续材料刚度作为软体机器人协同设计的核心变量，包含可编程可调和传统不变刚度两种设置，并在多种任务中验证了性能提升。

title: Fine-Grained Action Segmentation for Renorrhaphy in Robot-Assisted Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Fine-grained action segmentation during renorrhaphy in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy requires frame-level recognition of visually similar suturing gestures with variable duration and substantial class imbalance. The SIA-RAPN benchmark defines this problem on 50 clinical videos acquired with the da Vinci Xi system and annotated with 12 frame-level labels. The benchmark compares four temporal models built on I3D features: MS-TCN++, AsFormer, TUT, and DiffAct. Evaluation uses balanced accuracy, edit score, segmental F1 at overlap thresholds of 10, 25, and 50, frame-wise accuracy, and frame-wise mean average precision. In addition to the primary evaluation across five released split configurations on SIA-RAPN, the benchmark reports cross-domain results on a separate single-port RAPN dataset. Across the strongest reported values over those five runs on the primary dataset, DiffAct achieves the highest F1, frame-wise accuracy, edit score, and frame mAP, while MS-TCN++ attains the highest balanced accuracy.
summary_zh: 细粒度动作分割是在机器人辅助部分肾切除术中进行肾缝合术时，对视觉相似且持续时间可变的缝合手势进行帧级识别的过程，同时存在严重的类别不平衡问题。SIA-RAPN基准数据集在50个使用da Vinci Xi系统采集的临床视频上定义了这一问题，并标注了12个帧级标签。该基准数据集比较了基于I3D特征构建的四种时序模型：MS-TCN++、AsFormer、TUT和DiffAct。评估采用平衡准确率、编辑分数、重叠阈值为10、25和50时的段级F1、帧级准确率以及帧级平均精度均值。除了在SIA-RAPN数据集上针对五个发布划分配置的主要评估外，该基准数据集还在一个单独的单孔RAPN数据集上报告了跨域结果。在主要数据集上五次运行中报告的最优值中，DiffAct实现了最高的F1、帧级准确率、编辑分数和帧级平均精度均值，而MS-TCN++获得了最高的平衡准确率。
tldr: This paper introduces a fine‑grained action segmentation benchmark for renorrhaphy in robot‑assisted partial nephrectomy, comparing four temporal models on a dataset of 50 clinical da Vinci Xi videos with 12 frame‑level labels, where a diffusion‑based model (DiffAct) achieves the best performance across most metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个针对机器人辅助部分肾切除术中肾缝纫的细粒度动作分割基准，使用50个da Vinci Xi临床视频并标注12类帧级标签，比较了四种时序模型，其中基于扩散的DiffAct在大多数指标上表现最优。

title: Benchmarking CNN- and Transformer-Based Models for Surgical Instrument Segmentation in Robotic-Assisted Surgery
summary:
Accurate segmentation of surgical instruments in robotic-assisted surgery is critical for enabling context-aware computer-assisted interventions, such as tool tracking, workflow analysis, and autonomous decision-making. In this study, we benchmark five deep learning architectures-UNet, UNet, DeepLabV3, Attention UNet, and SegFormer on the SAR-RARP50 dataset for multi-class semantic segmentation of surgical instruments in real-world radical prostatectomy videos. The models are trained with a compound loss function combining Cross Entropy and Dice loss to address class imbalance and capture fine object boundaries. Our experiments reveal that while convolutional models such as UNet and Attention UNet provide strong baseline performance, DeepLabV3 achieves results comparable to SegFormer, demonstrating the effectiveness of atrous convolution and multi-scale context aggregation in capturing complex surgical scenes. Transformer-based architectures like SegFormer further enhance global contextual understanding, leading to improved generalization across varying instrument appearances and surgical conditions.
  This work provides a comprehensive comparison and practical insights for selecting segmentation models in surgical AI applications, highlighting the trade-offs between convolutional and transformer-based approaches.
summary_zh: 在机器人辅助手术中准确分割手术器械对于实现上下文感知的计算机辅助干预至关重要，这些干预包括器械跟踪、工作流分析和自主决策。本研究在SAR-RARP50数据集上对五种深度学习架构（UNet、DeepLabV3、Attention UNet和SegFormer）进行了基准测试，用于对真实根治性前列腺切除术视频中的手术器械进行多类别语义分割。模型使用结合交叉熵和Dice损失的复合损失函数进行训练，以解决类别不平衡问题并捕获精细的物体边界。实验表明，虽然卷积模型（如UNet和Attention UNet）提供了强大的基准性能，但DeepLabV3取得了与SegFormer相当的结果，证明了空洞卷积和多尺度上下文聚合在捕获复杂手术场景中的有效性。基于Transformer的架构（如SegFormer）进一步增强了全局上下文理解能力，从而在不同的器械外观和手术条件下实现了更好的泛化效果。本研究为外科人工智能应用中分割模型的选择提供了全面的比较和实践指导，突出了卷积方法和基于Transformer方法之间的权衡。
tldr: The study benchmarks five deep learning models (UNet, Attention UNet, DeepLabV3, SegFormer) for multi-class segmentation of surgical instruments in robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy videos, finding transformer-based SegFormer and DeepLabV3 comparable, and provides insights for selecting models in surgical AI applications.
tldr_zh: 该研究在机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术视频中，对五种深度学习模型（UNet、Attention UNet、DeepLabV3、SegFormer）进行多类手术器械分割基准测试，发现基于变换器的SegFormer和DeepAlabV3性能相当，并为手术AI中的模型选择提供参考。

title: A three-dimensional morphoelastic model for self-oscillations in polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments
summary: We introduce a three-dimensional model for polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments operating in a fluid environment under an electric field. The formulation builds on a morphoelastic framework for inextensible and unshearable rods, such that the filament's activity is encoded in electric-field-induced spontaneous curvatures, while hydrodynamic interactions are captured via a local approximation of Stokes flows. We employ this framework to investigate the prototypical case of a filament with elliptic cross-section clamped at its base. Under a constant and uniform electric field aligned with its axis, the filament undergoes flutter instability beyond a critical field strength, as revealed by a linear stability analysis. Depending on the model parameters, the instability is characterized by either two- or three-dimensional self-sustained oscillations. We further examine this behaviour through numerical simulations in the post-critical regime, showing that flutter may develop into large amplitude planar oscillations or more complex three-dimensional motions, through a secondary bifurcation. Although the study represents a first step towards extending state-of-the-art models for polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments to three dimensions, the richness of the resulting dynamics achievable under time-independent forcing underscores the potential of the proposed actuation mechanism for the design of biomimetic cilia and soft robotic systems.
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们引入了一个用于聚电解质水凝胶丝的三维模型，该模型在电场作用下的流体环境中工作。该公式基于不可伸长且不可剪切杆的形态弹性框架，将丝的活动由电场诱导的自发曲率编码，而流体动力学相互作用则通过斯托克斯流的局部近似来捕捉。我们利用该框架研究了一个具有椭圆截面、底端固定的聚电解质水凝胶丝的典型情况。在沿丝轴方向的均匀恒定电场作用下，丝在超过临界电场强度时会发生颤振失稳，线性稳定性分析揭示了这一点。根据模型参数的不同，失稳表现为二维或三维自持振荡。我们进一步通过后临界状态的数值模拟研究了这种行为，表明颤振可能通过二次分岔发展为大幅平面振荡或更复杂的三维运动。虽然该研究是朝着将聚电解质水凝胶丝的最新模型扩展到三维方向迈出的第一步，但时不变驱动下所能实现的丰富动力学特性凸显了所提出的驱动机制在仿生纤毛和软体机器人系统设计中的潜力。
tldr: A 3D morphoelastic rod model for polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments under electric fields predicts flutter instability and self‑sustained planar or 3‑D oscillations, suggesting a new actuation mechanism for biomimetic cilia and soft robots.
tldr_zh: 该研究提出了一个三维形态弹性杆模型，用于描述聚电解质水凝胶纤维在电场作用下的行为，预测了颤振不稳定性和自维持的平面或三维振荡，为仿生纤毛和软体机器人的设计提供了新的驱动机制。

title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Muscle-Actuated Robots via Generalized Actuator Networks
summary: Tendon drives paired with soft muscle actuation enable faster and safer robots while potentially accelerating skill acquisition. Still, these systems are rarely used in practice due to inherent nonlinearities, friction, and hysteresis, which complicate modeling and control. So far, these challenges have hindered policy transfer from simulation to real systems. To bridge this gap, we propose a sim-to-real pipeline that learns a neural network model of this complex actuation and leverages established rigid body simulation for the arm dynamics and interactions with the environment. Our method, called Generalized Actuator Network (GeAN), enables actuation model identification across a wide range of robots by learning directly from joint position trajectories rather than requiring torque sensors. Using GeAN on PAMY2, a tendon-driven robot powered by pneumatic artificial muscles, we successfully deploy precise goal-reaching and dynamic ball-in-a-cup policies trained entirely in simulation. To the best of our knowledge, this result constitutes the first successful sim-to-real transfer for a four-degrees-of-freedom muscle-actuated robot arm.
summary_zh: 肌腱驱动配合软体肌肉驱动能够实现更快、更安全的机器人，同时可能加速技能习得。然而，由于固有的非线性、摩擦和滞后特性，这些系统在实践中很少使用，因为这些特性使建模和控制变得复杂。到目前为止，这些挑战阻碍了策略从仿真到真实系统的迁移。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个仿真到现实的流程，通过学习这种复杂驱动的神经网络模型，并利用成熟的刚体仿真来模拟臂部动力学和与环境的交互。我们的方法称为广义执行器网络（Generalized Actuator Network，GeAN），它可以直接从关节位置轨迹学习，而无需力矩传感器，从而实现跨多种机器人的驱动模型辨识。通过在PAMY2（一种由气动人工肌肉驱动的肌腱驱动机器人）上使用GeAN，我们成功部署了完全在仿真中训练的精确目标到达和动态杯中球策略。据我们所知，这是首次成功实现四自由度肌肉驱动机械臂的仿真到现实迁移。
tldr: This paper presents GeAN, a neural network-based sim-to-real transfer method for muscle-actuated robots that learns actuation models from joint position trajectories without torque sensors, demonstrating successful policy transfer on a pneumatic artificial muscle robot (PAMY2) for goal-reaching and ball-in-a-cup tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GeAN，一种基于神经网络的肌腱驱动机器人模拟到现实迁移方法，该方法无需扭矩传感器即可从关节位置轨迹学习驱动力模型，并在气动人工肌肉机器人PAMY2上成功实现了目标到达和杯中球等策略的迁移。

title: Kinematics of continuum planar grasping
summary: This paper presents an analytical framework to study the geometry arising when a soft continuum arm grasps a planar object. Both the arm centerline and the object boundary are modeled as smooth curves. The grasping problem is formulated as a kinematic boundary following problem, in which the object boundary acts as the arm's 'shadow curve'. This formulation leads to a set of reduced kinematic equations expressed in terms of relative geometric shape variables, with the arm curvature serving as the control input. An optimal control problem is formulated to determine feasible arm shapes that achieve optimal grasping configurations, and its solution is obtained using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle. Based on the resulting optimal grasp kinematics, a class of continuum grasp quality metrics is proposed using the algebraic properties of the associated continuum grasp map. Feedback control aspects in the dynamic setting are also discussed. The proposed methodology is illustrated through systematic numerical simulations.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一个分析框架，用于研究软体连续体机械臂抓取平面物体时的几何形态。机械臂中心线和物体边界均被建模为光滑曲线。抓取问题被表述为运动学边界跟随问题，其中物体边界作为机械臂的"影曲线"。该表述导致一组以相对几何形状变量表示的简化运动方程，其中机械臂曲率作为控制输入。建立了最优控制问题以确定实现最优抓取构型的可行机械臂形状，并利用庞特里亚金最大值原理求解该问题。基于所得到的最优抓取运动学，提出了一类利用相关连续体抓取映射代数性质的连续体抓取质量度量指标。此外还讨论了动态环境下的反馈控制方面。通过系统数值仿真验证了所提方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces an analytical framework for modeling the geometry and kinematics of a soft continuum arm grasping a planar object, treating the grasp as a boundary‑following problem, solving an optimal control problem via Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle, and defining grasp quality metrics from the continuum grasp map.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分析软连续体手臂抓取平面物体的几何与运动学框架，将抓取问题转化为边界跟踪问题，利用Pontryagin极大值原理求解最优抓取形态，并基于连续体抓取映射的代数属性提出抓取质量指标。

title: Warm-Started Reinforcement Learning for Iterative 3D/2D Liver Registration
summary:
Registration between preoperative CT and intraoperative laparoscopic video plays a crucial role in augmented reality (AR) guidance for minimally invasive surgery. Learning-based methods have recently achieved registration errors comparable to optimization-based approaches while offering faster inference. However, many supervised methods produce coarse alignments that rely on additional optimization-based refinement, thereby increasing inference time.
  We present a discrete-action reinforcement learning (RL) framework that formulates CT-to-video registration as a sequential decision-making process. A shared feature encoder, warm-started from a supervised pose estimation network to provide stable geometric features and faster convergence, extracts representations from CT renderings and laparoscopic frames, while an RL policy head learns to choose rigid transformations along six degrees of freedom and to decide when to stop the iteration.
  Experiments on a public laparoscopic dataset demonstrated that our method achieved an average target registration error (TRE) of 15.70 mm, comparable to supervised approaches with optimization, while achieving faster convergence.
  The proposed RL-based formulation enables automated, efficient iterative registration without manually tuned step sizes or stopping criteria. This discrete framework provides a practical foundation for future continuous-action and deformable registration models in surgical AR applications.
summary_zh: 术前CT与术中腹腔镜视频之间的配准在微创手术的增强现实(AR)导航中起着至关重要的作用。近年来，基于学习的方法已达到了与基于优化方法相当的配准误差，同时具有更快的推理速度。然而，许多有监督方法产生的是粗略对齐，需要额外的基于优化的细化，从而增加了推理时间。我们提出了一种离散动作强化学习(RL)框架，将CT到视频的配准表述为一个序贯决策过程。一个共享特征编码器从有监督姿态估计网络预热启动，以提供稳定的几何特征和更快的收敛速度，从CT渲染图像和腹腔镜帧中提取特征表示，而RL策略头学习在六个自由度上选择刚性变换并决定何时停止迭代。在公开腹腔镜数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法达到了15.70 mm的平均目标配准误差(TRE)，与有监督优化方法相当，同时实现了更快的收敛。所提出的基于强化学习的配准方法实现了自动化、高效的迭代配准，无需手动调整步长或停止标准。这一离散框架为外科AR应用中未来连续动作和可变形配准模型提供了实用的基础。
tldr: A warm-started reinforcement learning approach for 3D CT to 2D laparoscopic video liver registration achieves similar target registration error to supervised methods but with faster convergence, enabling automated iterative alignment without manual step size or stopping criteria.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种温启动的强化学习方法，用于三维CT与二维腹腔镜视频的肝脏配准，实现了与监督方法相当的配准误差且收敛更快，实现了无需人工设定步长和停机准则的自动迭代对齐。

title: Identifying Inductive Biases for Robot Co-Design
summary: Co-designing a robot's morphology and control can ensure synergistic interactions between them, prevalent in biological organisms. However, co-design is a high-dimensional search problem. To make this search tractable, we need a systematic method for identifying inductive biases tailored to its structure. In this paper, we analyze co-design landscapes for soft locomotion and manipulation tasks and identify three patterns that are consistent across regions of their co-design spaces. We observe that within regions of co-design space, quality varies along a low-dimensional manifold. Higher-quality regions exhibit variations spread across more dimensions, while tightly coupling morphology and control. We leverage these insights to devise an efficient co-design algorithm. Since the precise instantiation of this structure varies across tasks and is not known a priori, our algorithm infers it from information gathered during search and adapts to each task's specific structure. This yields $36\%$ more improvement than benchmark algorithms. Moreover, our algorithm achieved more than two orders of magnitude in sample efficiency compared to these benchmark algorithms, demonstrating the effectiveness of leveraging inductive biases to co-design.
summary_zh: 协同设计机器人的形态与控制可以确保它们之间的协同交互，这在生物有机体中普遍存在。然而，协同设计是一个高维搜索问题。为了让这个搜索变得可处理，我们需要一种系统性的方法来识别针对其结构的归纳偏置。本文分析了软体运动和操作任务的协同设计景观，并识别出了在其协同设计空间各个区域中一致的三种模式。我们观察到，在协同设计空间的区域内，质量沿着低维流形变化。高质量区域表现出分布在更多维度上的变化，同时形态与控制之间存在紧密耦合。我们利用这些见解来设计一种高效的协同设计算法。由于这种结构的具体实现因任务而异，且事先未知，我们的算法从搜索过程中收集信息并进行推断，以适应每个任务的具体结构。这比基准算法多获得了36%的改进。此外，我们的算法与这些基准算法相比实现了超过两个数量级的样本效率提升，展示了利用归纳偏置进行协同设计的有效性。
tldr: The paper proposes a method to uncover task‑specific inductive biases in robot co‑design by analyzing co‑design landscapes, showing that high‑quality designs lie on low‑dimensional manifolds, and uses these insights to build an efficient algorithm that yields 36% performance gains and over 100× better sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过分析协同设计空间，识别出高质量机器人设计位于低维流形上，从而提炼归纳偏置，构建高效协同设计算法，实现36%性能提升和超过两个数量级的采样效率提升。

title: Social Learning Strategies for Evolved Virtual Soft Robots
summary: Optimizing the body and brain of a robot is a coupled challenge: the morphology determines what control strategies are effective, while the control parameters influence how well the morphology performs. This joint optimization can be done through nested loops of evolutionary and learning processes, where the control parameters of each robot are learned independently. However, the control parameters learned by one robot may contain valuable information for others. Thus, we introduce a social learning approach in which robots can exploit optimized parameters from their peers to accelerate their own brain optimization. Within this framework, we systematically investigate how the selection of teachers, deciding which and how many robots to learn from, affects performance, experimenting with virtual soft robots in four tasks and environments. In particular, we study the effect of inheriting experience from morphologically similar robots due to the tightly coupled body and brain in robot optimization. Our results confirm the effectiveness of building on others' experience, as social learning clearly outperforms learning from scratch under equivalent computational budgets. In addition, while the optimal teacher selection strategy remains open, our findings suggest that incorporating knowledge from multiple teachers can yield more consistent and robust improvements.
summary_zh: 优化机器人的身体和大脑是一个耦合的挑战：形态决定了哪些控制策略是有效的，而控制参数则影响形态的执行表现。这种联合优化可以通过进化和学习过程的嵌套循环来实现，其中每个机器人的控制参数是独立学习的。然而，一个机器人学习到的控制参数可能包含对其他机器人有价值的信息。因此，我们引入了一种社会学习方法，机器人可以利用同伴的优化参数来加速自身的大脑优化。在这个框架内，我们系统地研究了教师的选择（决定从哪些以及多少个机器人学习）如何影响性能，我们在四个任务和环境中的虚拟软体机器人上进行了实验。由于机器人优化中身体和大脑的紧密耦合，我们特别研究了从形态相似的机器人继承经验的效果。我们的结果证实了借鉴他人经验的有效性，因为在相同的计算预算下，社会学习明显优于从零开始学习。此外，虽然最优的教师选择策略尚未确定，但我们的研究结果表明，融合多位教师的知识可以获得更一致且更稳健的改进。
tldr: The paper introduces a social learning approach for virtual soft robots where robots can learn from optimized control parameters of peers to accelerate brain optimization, and systematically investigates teacher selection strategies based on morphological similarity, showing clear performance gains over learning from scratch.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种社会学习框架，让虚拟软体机器人能够借鉴同辈优化后的控制参数以加速自身脑部优化，研究了基于形态相似性的教师选择策略，实验表明相比从零学习，性能显著提升。

title: Towards Patient-Specific Deformable Registration in Laparoscopic Surgery
summary: Unsafe surgical care is a critical health concern, often linked to limitations in surgeon experience, skills, and situational awareness. Integrating patient-specific 3D models into the surgical field can enhance visualization, provide real-time anatomical guidance, and reduce intraoperative complications. However, reliably registering these models in general surgery remains challenging due to mismatches between preoperative and intraoperative organ surfaces, such as deformations and noise. To overcome these challenges, we introduce the first patient-specific non-rigid point cloud registration method, which leverages a novel data generation strategy to optimize outcomes for individual patients. Our approach combines a Transformer encoder-decoder architecture with overlap estimation and a dedicated matching module to predict dense correspondences, followed by a physics-based algorithm for registration. Experimental results on both synthetic and real data demonstrate that our patient-specific method significantly outperforms traditional agnostic approaches, achieving 45% Matching Score with 92% Inlier Ratio on synthetic data, highlighting its potential to improve surgical care.
summary_zh: 不安全的手术治疗是一个关键的健康问题，通常与外科医生经验、技能和情境感知的局限性有关。将患者特异性3D模型整合到手术视野中可以增强可视化、提供实时解剖导航并减少术中并发症。然而，由于术前和术中器官表面之间存在变形和噪声等差异，在普通外科手术中可靠地配准这些模型仍然具有挑战性。为了克服这些挑战，我们引入了第一种患者特异性非刚性点云配准方法，该方法利用一种新颖的数据生成策略来优化个体患者的治疗效果。我们的方法结合了Transformer编码器-解码器架构、重叠度估计和专用匹配模块来预测密集对应关系，随后使用基于物理的算法进行配准。合成数据和真实数据的实验结果表明，我们的患者特异性方法显著优于传统通用方法，在合成数据上实现了45%的匹配得分和92%的内点比例，凸显了其改善手术治疗的潜力。
tldr: The paper proposes the first patient‑specific non‑rigid point‑cloud registration method for laparoscopic surgery, using a Transformer‑based encoder‑decoder with overlap estimation and a physics‑based step, and demonstrates superior matching performance on synthetic and real data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了首个针对腹腔镜手术的患者特异性非刚性点云配准方法，采用基于Transformer的编码器-解码器结构进行重叠估计和匹配，随后使用物理算法进行配准，并在合成和真实数据上展示了优异的匹配性能。

title: ASGNet: Adaptive Spectrum Guidance Network for Automatic Polyp Segmentation
summary: Early identification and removal of polyps can reduce the risk of developing colorectal cancer. However, the diverse morphologies, complex backgrounds and often concealed nature of polyps make polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images highly challenging. Despite the promising performance of existing deep learning-based polyp segmentation methods, their perceptual capabilities remain biased toward local regions, mainly because of the strong spatial correlations between neighboring pixels in the spatial domain. This limitation makes it difficult to capture the complete polyp structures, ultimately leading to sub-optimal segmentation results. In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive spectrum guidance network, called ASGNet, which addresses the limitations of spatial perception by integrating spectral features with global attributes. Specifically, we first design a spectrum-guided non-local perception module that jointly aggregates local and global information, therefore enhancing the discriminability of polyp structures, and refining their boundaries. Moreover, we introduce a multi-source semantic extractor that integrates rich high-level semantic information to assist in the preliminary localization of polyps. Furthermore, we construct a dense cross-layer interaction decoder that effectively integrates diverse information from different layers and strengthens it to generate high-quality representations for accurate polyp segmentation. Extensive quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate the superiority of our ASGNet approach over 21 state-of-the-art methods across five widely-used polyp segmentation benchmarks. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/CSYSI/ASGNet.
summary_zh: 早期发现和去除息肉可以降低结直肠癌的发生风险。然而，息肉形态多样、背景复杂且常常具有隐蔽性，使得结肠镜图像中的息肉分割极具挑战性。尽管现有的基于深度学习的息肉分割方法表现优异，但其感知能力仍偏向于局部区域，这主要是因为空间域中相邻像素之间存在较强的空间相关性。这一局限性使得难以捕获完整的息肉结构，最终导致分割结果不佳。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为ASGNet的新型自适应频谱引导网络，通过将频谱特征与全局属性相结合来解决空间感知的局限性。具体而言，我们首先设计了一个频谱引导的非局部感知模块，用于同时聚合局部和全局信息，从而增强息肉结构的可辨识性并精细化其边界。此外，我们引入了一个多源语义提取器，用于整合丰富的高层语义信息，以辅助息肉的初步定位。进一步地，我们构建了一个密集跨层交互解码器，能够有效整合来自不同层的多样化信息并进行强化，从而生成高质量的表示，以实现精确的息肉分割。大量定量和定性结果表明，我们的ASGNet方法在五个广泛使用的息肉分割基准数据集上优于21种最先进的方法。代码将在 https://github.com/CSYSI/ASGNet 上公开可用。
tldr: ASGNet introduces an adaptive spectrum‑guidance network that combines spectral and global features to improve polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images, outperforming 21 state‑of‑the‑art methods on five benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ASGNet提出了一种自适应频谱引导网络，通过融合频谱特征与全局属性提升结肠镜图像中息肉的分割精度，在五个数据集上超过了21种最先进的分割方法。

title: Contact-Aware Planning and Control of Continuum Robots in Highly Constrained Environments
summary: Continuum robots are well suited for navigating confined and fragile environments, such as vascular or endoluminal anatomy, where contact with surrounding structures is often unavoidable. While controlled contact can assist motion, unfavorable contact can degrade controllability, induce kinematic singularities, or introduce safety risks. We present a contact-aware planning approach that evaluates contact quality, penalizing hazardous interactions, while permitting benign contact. The planner produces kinematically feasible trajectories and contact-aware Jacobians which can be used for closed-loop control in hardware experiments. We validate the approach by testing the integrated system (planning, control, and mechanical design) on anatomical models from patient scans. The planner generates effective plans for three common anatomical environments, and, in all hardware trials, the continuum robot was able to reach the target while avoiding dangerous tip contact (100% success). Mean tracking errors were 1.9 +/- 0.5 mm, 1.2 +/- 0.1 mm, and 1.7 +/- 0.2 mm across the three different environments. Ablation studies showed that penalizing end-of-continuum-segment (ECS) contact improved manipulability and prevented hardware failures. Overall, this work enables reliable, contact-aware navigation in highly constrained environments.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人非常适合在受限且脆弱的环境中导航，例如血管或腔内解剖结构，因为与周围结构的接触通常是不可避免的。虽然受控接触可以辅助运动，但不良接触可能会降低可控性、引发运动学奇异性或带来安全风险。我们提出了一种接触感知规划方法，该方法评估接触质量，惩罚危险交互，同时允许良性接触。该规划器生成运动学可行的轨迹和接触感知的雅可比矩阵，可用于硬件实验中的闭环控制。我们通过在来自患者扫描数据的解剖模型上测试集成系统（规划、控制和机械设计）来验证该方法。该规划器为三种常见解剖环境生成了有效的规划方案，并且在所有硬件实验中，连续体机器人都能够到达目标同时避免危险的尖端接触（100%成功率）。三种不同环境下的平均跟踪误差分别为1.9 ± 0.5 mm、1.2 ± 0.1 mm和1.7 ± 0.2 mm。消融研究表明，对连续体节段末端（ECS）接触进行惩罚可以提高可操作性并防止硬件故障。总体而言，这项工作实现了在高度受限环境中的可靠接触感知导航。
tldr: The paper introduces a contact‑aware planning and control framework for continuum robots in highly constrained anatomical environments, which evaluates contact quality to penalize hazardous interactions while permitting benign contact, and validates the approach on patient‑derived anatomical models achieving 100% task success and sub‑millimeter tracking errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种接触感知的规划与控制方法，用于在受限解剖环境中导航连续体机器人，通过评估接触质量来惩罚危险交互并允许良性接触，在患者解剖模型上验证后实现了100%的任务成功率和亚毫米级跟踪误差。

title: Factor Graph-Based Shape Estimation for Continuum Robots via Magnus Expansion
summary: Reconstructing the shape of continuum manipulators from sparse, noisy sensor data is a challenging task, owing to the infinite-dimensional nature of such systems. Existing approaches broadly trade off between parametric methods that yield compact state representations but lack probabilistic structure, and Cosserat rod inference on factor graphs, which provides principled uncertainty quantification at the cost of a state dimension that grows with the spatial discretization. This letter combines the strength of both paradigms by estimating the coefficients of a low-dimensional Geometric Variable Strain (GVS) parameterization within a factor graph framework. A novel kinematic factor, derived from the Magnus expansion of the strain field, encodes the closed-form rod geometry as a prior constraint linking the GVS strain coefficients to the backbone pose variables. The resulting formulation yields a compact state vector directly amenable to model-based control, while retaining the modularity, probabilistic treatment and computational efficiency of factor graph inference. The proposed method is evaluated in simulation on a 0.4 m long tendon-driven continuum robot under three measurement configurations, achieving mean position errors below 2 mm for all three scenarios and demonstrating a sixfold reduction in orientation error compared to a Gaussian process regression baseline when only position measurements are available.
summary_zh: 从稀疏、有噪声的传感器数据重建连续体机械臂的形状是一项极具挑战性的任务，这是由于这类系统的无限维特性所致。现有方法大致在两类方法之间权衡：一类是产生紧凑状态表示但缺乏概率结构的参数化方法；另一类是在因子图上进行Cosserat杆推理的方法，该方法提供了原则性的不确定性量化，但代价是状态维度随空间离散化而增长。本文通过在因子图框架内估计低维几何可变应变（GVS）参数化的系数，结合了两种范式的优势。一种由应变场的Magnus展开推导出的新型运动学因子，将封闭形式的杆件几何编码为将GVS应变系数与主干姿态变量相联系的先验约束。所得公式产生了一个可直接用于模型预测控制的紧凑状态向量，同时保留了因子图推理的模块化、概率处理和计算效率优势。所提方法在三种测量配置下针对一根0.4米长的腱驱动连续体机器人进行了仿真评估，三种场景下的平均位置误差均低于2毫米，且与高斯过程回归基线相比，仅使用位置测量时方向误差降低了六倍。
tldr: This paper introduces a factor graph‑based shape estimation method for tendon‑driven continuum robots that combines a low‑dimensional Geometric Variable Strain (GVS) parameterization with a novel Magnus‑expansion‑derived kinematic factor, achieving sub‑2 mm position errors and a sixfold reduction in orientation error over a Gaussian‑process baseline in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于因子图的连续体机器人形状估计方法，利用几何可变应变（GVS）参数化和Magnus展开推导的运动因子，在模拟中实现了位置误差低于2 mm，且方向误差比高斯过程回归降低约六倍。

title: HyKey: Hyperspectral Keypoint Detection and Matching in Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Purpose: 3D reconstruction in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) enables enhanced surgical guidance through improved visualisation, tool tracking, and augmented reality. However, traditional RGB-based keypoint detection and matching pipelines struggle with surgical challenges, such as poor texture and complex illumination. We investigate whether using snapshot hyperspectral imaging (HSI) can provide improved results on keypoint detection and matching surgical scenes. Methods: We developed HyKey, a HYperspectral KEYpoint detection and description model made up of a hybrid 3D-2D convolutional neural network that jointly extracts spatial-spectral features from HSI. The model was trained using synthetic homographic augmentation and epipolar geometry constraints on a robotically-acquired dual-camera RGB-HSI laparoscopic dataset of ex-vivo organs with calibrated camera poses. We benchmarked performance against established RGB-based methods, including SuperPoint and ALIKE. Results: Our HSI-based model outperformed RGB baselines on registered RGB frames, achieving 96.62% mean matching accuracy and 67.18% mean average accuracy at 10 degree on pose estimation, demonstrating consistent improvements across multiple evaluation metrics. Conclusion: Integrating spectral information from an HSI cube offers a promising approach for robust monocular 3D reconstruction in MIS, addressing limitations of texture-poor surgical environments through enhanced spectral-spatial feature discrimination. Our model and dataset are available at https://github.com/alexsaikia/HyKey-Hyperspectral-Keypoint-Detection
summary_zh: 目的：3D重建在微创手术（MIS）中能够通过改善可视化、工具跟踪和增强现实来增强手术指导。然而，传统的基于RGB的关键点检测和匹配流程在处理手术挑战时存在困难，例如纹理缺失和复杂光照。我们研究是否使用快照式高光谱成像（HSI）能够在关键点检测和手术场景匹配方面提供更好的结果。方法：我们开发了HyKey，一个高光谱关键点检测与描述模型，由混合3D-2D卷积神经网络组成，能够从HSI中联合提取空间-光谱特征。该模型使用合成单应性增强和极线几何约束进行训练，基于机器人获取的离体器官双摄像头RGB-HSI腹腔镜数据集，并配备已校准的相机姿态。我们与成熟的RGB方法（包括SuperPoint和ALIKE）进行了性能基准测试。结果：我们的基于HSI的模型在已注册的RGB帧上优于RGB基线方法，实现了96.62%的平均匹配精度和67.18%的平均精度（在姿态估计的10度阈值下），并在多个评估指标上展现出持续的性能提升。结论：整合来自HSI立方体的光谱信息为微创手术中的稳健单目3D重建提供了一种有前景的方法，通过增强光谱-空间特征区分能力来解决纹理匮乏的手术环境限制。我们的模型和数据集可在https://github.com/alexsaikia/HyKey-Hyperspectral-Keypoint-Detection获取。

title: Trustworthy Endoscopic Super-Resolution
summary: Super-resolution (SR) models are attracting growing interest for enhancing minimally invasive surgery and diagnostic videos under hardware constraints. However, valid concerns remain regarding the introduction of hallucinated structures and amplified noise, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings. We propose a direct and practical framework to make SR systems more trustworthy by identifying where reconstructions are likely to fail. Our approach integrates a lightweight error-prediction network that operates on intermediate representations to estimate pixel-wise reconstruction error. The module is computationally efficient and low-latency, making it suitable for real-time deployment. We convert these predictions into operational failure decisions by constructing Conformal Failure Masks (CFM), which localize regions where the SR output should not be trusted. Built on conformal risk control principles, our method provides theoretical guarantees for controlling both the tolerated error limit and the miscoverage in detected failures. We evaluate our approach on image and video SR, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting unreliable reconstructions in endoscopic and robotic surgery settings. To our knowledge, this is the first study to provide a model-agnostic, theoretically grounded approach to improving the safety of real-time endoscopic image SR.
