Experiments on AbdomenAtlas 3.0 demonstrate consistent gains over classical multimodal foundation models and report-supervised baselines in both segmentation accuracy and lesion-level localization.
summary_zh: 将放射学报告描述对应到三维CT体数据对于可验证的临床解读至关重要，但由于自由文本叙述与体解剖结构之间的语义-空间鸿沟，这一任务仍具有挑战性。现有的报告辅助方法和视觉-语言定位方法通常依赖于短语级对齐或密集像素监督，导致病灶级对应关系有限且定位精度欠佳。我们提出GLeVE——一种结合解剖先验验证与基于八叉树的自回归细化的图引导病灶定位框架。GLeVE将每个病灶描述视为语义原子单元，通过关系感知图推理编码器官归属、属性及病灶间关系，从而生成具有判别性的病灶级查询。具有区域级验证的解剖感知候选生成实现了文本与病灶的一对一对齐，而分层八叉树细化则逐步改善边界描绘。在AbdomenAtlas 3.0上的实验表明，该方法在分割精度和病灶级定位方面均持续优于经典多模态基础模型与报告监督基线。
tldr: GLeVE proposes a graph-guided framework for grounding radiology report descriptions to 3D CT lesions, using relation-aware graph reasoning, anatomy-aware verification, and octree-based refinement to improve lesion-wise alignment and segmentation accuracy.
tldr_zh: GLeVE提出了一种图引导的框架，用于将放射学报告描述与3D CT病灶进行关联，通过关系感知图推理、解剖学感知验证和八叉树细化，改进了病灶级别的对齐和分割精度。

title: GALAR-TemporalNet v2: Anatomy-Guided Dual-Branch Temporal Classification with Bidirectional Mamba and Dual-Graph GCN for Video Capsule Endoscopy -- after competition results
summary: Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) poses a challenging multi-label temporal classification problem, requiring simultaneous localization of 8 anatomical regions and detection of 9 pathological findings across tens of thousands of frames. We present GALAR-TemporalNet v2, a hierarchical temporal model that addresses three core challenges: extreme class imbalance, long-range temporal dependencies, and pathology--anatomy entanglement. Our architecture combines windowed self-attention for local modeling, a Dual-Graph GCN for global frame relationships, and Bidirectional Mamba for selective boundary context encoding. A novel anatomy prototype residual pathway decouples pathological deviation signals from normal organ appearance, and a frame-level GCN skip connection stabilizes training of visually confusable rare classes. The competition version, GALAR-TemporalNet, achieved an overall mAP@0.5 of 0.2644 and mAP@0.95 of 0.2353 on the RARE-VISION test set. Following the competition, the redesigned GALAR-TemporalNet v2 -- incorporating a restructured pathology branch, refined loss functions, and extended post-processing -- improved these results to mAP@0.5 of 0.3409 and mAP@0.95 of 0.3333.
summary_zh: 视频胶囊内窥镜（VCE）构成了一项具有挑战性的多标签时序分类问题，要求在数万帧图像中同时定位8个解剖区域并检测9种病理发现。我们提出GALAR-TemporalNet v2，一种分层时序模型，用于应对三个核心挑战：极端类别不平衡、长程时序依赖以及病理-解剖特征纠缠。该架构结合了用于局部建模的窗口自注意力机制、用于全局帧关系的双图图卷积网络（Dual-Graph GCN）以及用于选择性边界上下文编码的双向Mamba模块。一条新颖的解剖原型残差通路将病理偏离信号与正常器官外观相解耦，而帧级GCN跳跃连接则稳定了视觉上易混淆的少见类别的训练。竞赛版本GALAR-TemporalNet在RARE-VISION测试集上取得了总体mAP@0.5为0.2644、mAP@0.95为0.2353的结果。竞赛结束后，重新设计的GALAR-TemporalNet v2——整合了重构的病理分支、优化的损失函数以及扩展的后处理——将这些结果提升至mAP@0.5为0.3409、mAP@0.95为0.3333。
tldr: This paper presents GALAR-TemporalNet v2, a hierarchical temporal model for multi-label classification in Video Capsule Endoscopy, combining windowed self-attention, Dual-Graph GCN, and Bidirectional Mamba to address class imbalance, long-range dependencies, and pathology-anatomy entanglement, achieving significant mAP improvements over a competition baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GALAR-TemporalNet v2，一种用于视频胶囊内镜多标签分类的层次化时序模型，结合了窗口自注意力、双图GCN和双向Mamba，以解决类别不平衡、长程依赖以及病理-解剖纠缠问题，相比竞赛基线取得了显著的mAP提升。

title: VISTA: Validation-Guided Integration of Spatial and Temporal Foundation Models with Anatomical Decoding for Rare-Pathology VCE Event Detection -- after competition results
summary: Capsule endoscopy event detection is challenging because clinically relevant findings are sparse, visually heterogeneous, and evaluated at the event level rather than by frame accuracy. We propose VISTA, a metric-aligned multi-backbone framework for the RAREVISION task. VISTA combines EndoFM-LV for temporal context and DINOv3 ViTL/16 for frame-level visual semantics, followed by a Diverse Head Ensemble (DHE), Validation-Guided Weighted Fusion (VGWF), and Anatomy-Aware Temporal Event Decoding (ATED). The original official submission achieved hidden-test temporal mAP@0.5 of 0.3530 and mAP@0.95 of 0.3235. After the competition, extending local threshold refinement with a global coarse search improved performance to 0.3726 mAP@0.5 and 0.3431 mAP@0.95, ranking Team ACVLab second in the post-competition evaluation.
summary_zh: 胶囊内镜事件检测具有挑战性，因为临床相关发现稀疏、视觉异质性高，并且需要在事件层面而非逐帧精度上进行评估。我们提出VISTA——一种面向RAREVISION任务的度量对齐多骨干框架。VISTA结合了用于时序上下文的EndoFM-LV和用于帧级视觉语义的DINOv3 ViTL/16，随后采用多样头部集成（DHE）、验证引导加权融合（VGWF）以及解剖感知时序事件解码（ATED）。原始官方提交在隐藏测试集上达到时序mAP@0.5为0.3530、mAP@0.95为0.3235。赛后，通过全局粗略搜索扩展局部阈值优化，性能提升至mAP@0.5为0.3726、mAP@0.95为0.3431，使Team ACVLab在赛后评估中位列第二。
tldr: VISTA is a multi-backbone framework combining temporal (EndoFM-LV) and spatial (DINOv3) foundation models with a diverse head ensemble and validation-guided fusion for rare-pathology video capsule endoscopy event detection, achieving second place in a post-competition evaluation.
tldr_zh: VISTA是一个多骨干框架，结合了时间（EndoFM-LV）和空间（DINOv3）基础模型，配备多样头集成和验证引导融合，用于罕见病理视频胶囊内窥镜事件检测，在赛后评估中获得第二名。

title: Hollow Needle Puncture Mechanics for Biopsy Sampling
summary: Biopsy sampling relies on hollow needles that puncture soft tissues by propagating and opening a cylindrical crack, yet the mechanics governing this coring process remain only partially understood. Motivated by this gap, we develop a simple, energy based model for puncture by blunt hollow needles, grounded in brittle fracture mechanics and extended to include frictional interactions at the needle tissue interface. The model describes puncture as the competition between the fracture energy and the elastic energy. This energetic balance is controlled by the interplay among needle geometry (radius and wall thickness), material properties (toughness and elastic modulus), and interfacial parameters (adhesion and friction). This model provides semi analytical predictions for five key quantities, core size, frictionless force, frictional force slope, critical insertion depth, and critical insertion force. Model predictions are validated against experiments, demonstrating that friction significantly improves force estimation and alters the puncture regime. These results offer quantitative insight into the mechanics of tissue coring and force generation during biopsy, providing a predictive foundation for needle design, sampling performance, and real time control in robotic biopsy and needle insertion systems.
summary_zh: 活检取样依赖于中空针头，通过传播并张开柱状裂纹来穿刺软组织，然而控制这一取芯过程的力学机制仍未被完全理解。针对这一空白，我们基于脆性断裂力学，建立了一个简洁的能量模型，用于描述钝头中空针头的穿刺过程，并将其扩展至包含针-组织界面的摩擦相互作用。该模型将穿刺描述为断裂能与弹性能之间的竞争。这种能量平衡受针头几何参数（半径和壁厚）、材料属性（韧性和弹性模量）以及界面参数（粘附和摩擦）的相互作用所调控。模型为五个关键量——取芯尺寸、无摩擦力、摩擦力斜率、临界插入深度和临界插入力——提供了半分析预测。模型预测结果与实验数据得到验证，表明摩擦显著提升了力的估算精度并改变了穿刺机制。这些结果为活检过程中组织取芯和力生成的力学机制提供了定量洞见，为机器人活检及针头插入系统中的针头设计、取样性能及实时控制奠定了预测基础。
tldr: This paper develops an energy-based model for blunt hollow needle puncture mechanics, incorporating fracture and friction to predict core size, forces, and critical insertion depth, validated experimentally.
tldr_zh: 本文开发了一个基于能量的钝空心针穿刺力学模型，结合断裂和摩擦作用，预测核心尺寸、力和临界插入深度，并通过实验验证。

title: Echo4DIR: 4D Implicit Heart Reconstruction from 2D Echocardiography Videos
summary: Reconstructing 4D (3D+t) cardiac geometry from sparse 2D echocardiography is highly desirable yet fundamentally challenged by geometric ambiguity and temporal discontinuity. To tackle these issues, we propose Echo4DIR, a novel test-time 4D implicit reconstruction framework. Specifically, we learn robust 3D shape priors from statistical shape models (SSMs) via a cardiac conditional SDF, constructing an Epipolar Mask Encoder module with epipolar cross attention to effectively fuse multi-view features. To bridge the synthetic-to-real domain gap, we introduce a self-supervised SDF-tailored differentiable rendering strategy for patient-specific 3D shape adaptation using uncalibrated clinical masks without requiring 3D ground truth. Crucially, the inherent continuity of implicit representation overcomes sparse observations, enabling anatomically reliable geometry at arbitrary resolutions. Furthermore, to empower our framework with physically continuous 4D extension, we introduce a Radial SDF Alignment strategy that strictly locks shape evolution to the predicted velocity field, fundamentally eliminating mesh drift. Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real clinical datasets demonstrate that Echo4DIR achieves state-of-the-art 4D cardiac mesh reconstruction, notably yielding an impressive clinical overlap of up to 98.35% Dice and 96.75% IoU.
summary_zh: 从稀疏二维超声心动图重建四维（3D+t）心脏几何结构极具吸引力，但面临几何模糊性和时间不连续性的根本挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出Echo4DIR——一种新颖的测试时四维隐式重建框架。具体而言，我们通过心脏条件符号距离函数从统计形状模型（SSMs）中学习鲁棒的三维形状先验，并构建带有极线交叉注意力的极线掩码编码器模块，以有效融合多视图特征。为弥合合成域与真实域之间的差距，我们引入了一种自监督的、专为SDF定制的可微渲染策略，利用未校准的临床掩码实现患者特定三维形状的自适应，无需三维真值。关键在于，隐式表示固有的连续性克服了稀疏观测的限制，能够在任意分辨率下生成解剖学上可靠的几何结构。此外，为赋予框架物理连续的4D扩展能力，我们提出径向SDF对齐策略，将形状演化严格锁定到预测的速度场中，从根本上消除网格漂移。在合成基准和真实临床数据集上的大量实验表明，Echo4DIR实现了最先进的四维心脏网格重建，在临床指标上取得了令人瞩目的重叠率，Dice达到98.35%，IoU达到96.75%。
tldr: Echo4DIR proposes a test-time 4D implicit reconstruction framework that uses statistical shape models and epipolar cross attention to reconstruct 3D+t cardiac geometry from sparse 2D echocardiography videos, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with self-supervised adaptation and radial SDF alignment.
tldr_zh: Echo4DIR 提出了一种测试时4D隐式重建框架，利用统计形状模型和极线交叉注意力从稀疏的2D超声心动图视频中重建3D+t心脏几何结构，通过自监督适应和径向SDF对齐实现了最先进的精度。

title: Universal CT Representations from Anatomy to Disease Phenotype through Agglomerative Pretraining
summary: Computed tomography (CT) is a central to three-dimensional medical imaging, yet CT-based artificial intelligence remains fragmented across task-specific models for segmentation, classification, registration, and report analysis. Here we present FlexiCT, a family of CT foundation models trained by agglomerative continual pretraining on 266,227 CT volumes from 56 publicly available datasets, forming a large-scale public resource for CT representation learning. FlexiCT uses agglomerative pretraining across three stages: two-dimensional axial pretraining, three-dimensional anatomical pretraining and report-guided semantic alignment. This training strategy supports slice-level, volume-level and vision-language analysis. Across five downstream task families (segmentation, classification, registration, vision-language understanding and clinical retrieval), FlexiCT matches or exceeds prior task-specific approaches on multiple benchmarks. Its embeddings further organize CT scans along gradients associated with various tumor stages, suggesting that CT foundation models can capture imaging features relevant to disease phenotype characterization. Code is available at https://github.com/ricklisz/FlexiCT
summary_zh: 计算机断层扫描（CT）是三维医学影像的核心技术，然而基于CT的人工智能仍分散于针对分割、分类、配准及报告分析等特定任务的独立模型中。本文提出FlexiCT——一组CT基础模型，通过在56个公开数据集的266,227个CT体数据上进行聚合式连续预训练形成，为CT表征学习构建了大规模公共资源。FlexiCT采用三阶段聚合预训练策略：二维轴向预训练、三维解剖预训练以及报告引导的语义对齐。该训练策略支持切片级、体数据级及视觉-语言分析。在五个下游任务族（分割、分类、配准、视觉-语言理解及临床检索）中，FlexiCT在多个基准上达到或超越了先前的特定任务方法。其嵌入表示还能沿不同肿瘤分期梯度对CT扫描进行组织，表明CT基础模型可捕获与疾病表型表征相关的影像特征。代码详见https://github.com/ricklisz/FlexiCT。
tldr: FlexiCT is a family of CT foundation models pretrained agglomeratively on 266K CT scans across three stages (axial, anatomical, vision-language), achieving state-of-the-art on multiple downstream tasks including segmentation, classification, registration, and clinical retrieval, and capturing tumor-stage-related imaging features.
tldr_zh: FlexiCT是一系列CT基础模型，通过聚合式连续预训练在26.6万张CT扫描上（轴向、解剖、视觉-语言三个阶段）训练，在分割、分类、配准和临床检索等多个下游任务上达到或超越先前任务专用模型，并能捕捉与肿瘤分期相关的影像特征。

title: ChronoMedKG: A Temporally-Grounded Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for Clinical Reasoning
summary:
Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) treat disease associations as static facts, but temporal information is crucial for clinical reasoning, e.g., a symptom diagnostic of one disease at age 3 may imply a different disease at age 13. Existing KGs such as PrimeKG, Hetionet, and iKraph do not encode when a finding becomes clinically relevant over the course of a disease. This limits their usefulness for longitudinal clinical reasoning and retrieval augmentation.
  We introduce ChronoMedKG, a temporal biomedical knowledge graph that contains 460,497 evidence-linked triples (filtered from 13M raw extractions) covering 13,431 diseases. Each association is tied to temporal components like onset window or progression stage, which are backed by PMID-traceable evidence and a multi-signal credibility score. The graph is constructed through a disease-autonomous multi-agent pipeline in which multiple frontier LLMs independently extract knowledge from PubMed and PMC literature. Only those relations are kept that are supported by multi-model consensus, survive credibility filtering, as well as ontology alignment.
  ChronoMedKG scored 92.7% agreement against Orphadata and adds temporal grounding for 6,250 diseases absent from HPOA, Orphadata, and Phenopackets, including 1,657 Orphanet-coded rare diseases. We further introduce ChronoTQA, a benchmark of 3,341 questions across eight task types (six temporal plus two static controls), with a 12-question supplementary probe. Frontier LLMs lose roughly 30 points moving from static to temporal questions; ChronoMedKG retrieval rescues 47-65% of their long-tail failures, against 17-29% for HPOA-RAG. As such, ChronoMedKG provides a crucial temporal axis for retrieval-augmented clinical systems that was previously absent.
summary_zh:
生物医学知识图谱将疾病关联视为静态事实，但时间信息对于临床推理至关重要，例如，3岁时某种疾病的诊断症状可能暗示13岁时另一种疾病。现有的知识图谱（如PrimeKG、Hetionet和iKraph）并未编码在疾病过程中某一发现何时具有临床相关性。这限制了它们在纵向临床推理和检索增强中的实用性。

我们提出ChronoMedKG，一个时间生物医学知识图谱，包含460,497个证据关联三元组（从1300万原始提取中过滤得到），涵盖13,431种疾病。每个关联都与时间成分（如发病窗口或进展阶段）相关联，这些成分由可追溯至PMID的证据和多信号可信度评分支持。该图谱通过一种疾病自主的多智能体管道构建，其中多个前沿大语言模型独立从PubMed和PMC文献中提取知识。仅保留那些得到多模型共识支持、通过可信度过滤以及本体对齐的关系。

ChronoMedKG与Orphadata的一致率达到92.7%，并为HPOA、Orphadata和Phenopackets中缺失的6,250种疾病增加了时间基础，其中包括1,657种Orphanet编码的罕见病。我们进一步推出ChronoTQA，一个包含3,341个问题、覆盖八种任务类型（六种时间任务和两种静态对照任务）的基准测试，并附有12个问题的补充探测。前沿大语言模型从静态问题转向时间问题时，性能下降约30个百分点；ChronoMedKG检索挽回了其47%至65%的长尾失败，而HPOA-RAG仅挽回17%至29%。因此，ChronoMedKG为检索增强的临床系统提供了此前缺失的关键时间轴。
tldr: ChronoMedKG is a temporally-grounded biomedical knowledge graph with over 460k evidence-linked triples, constructed via a multi-LLM pipeline, and a benchmark (ChronoTQA) showing that frontier LLMs lose 30 points on temporal questions but retrieval from ChronoMedKG rescues 47-65% of failures.
tldr_zh: ChronoMedKG是一个基于时间的生物医学知识图谱，包含超过46万条证据关联的三元组，通过多LLM管道构建；并提出了一个基准ChronoTQA，显示前沿LLM在时间问题上下降30分，但ChronoMedKG的检索可挽救47-65%的失败。

title: VRXU-net: A Deep Learning Approach for Brain Ischemic Stroke Lesion Detection and Segmentation in T1W MRI
summary: When the blood supply to the brain is obstructed by a clot, oxygen delivery to brain tissues becomes insufficient, leading to cellular necrosis. In healthcare settings, accurately identifying and delineating ischemic lesion boundaries is essential for treatment and surgical planning. However, ischemic stroke lesions vary widely in shape, size, and location, and in grayscale MRI modalities such as T1W they may resemble surrounding brain structures. This makes lesion detection and segmentation a challenging task for clinicians. This study introduces a novel VRU-Net architecture, derived from visual features, residual connections, and a U-shaped network, for detecting and segmenting ischemic stroke lesions in 3D magnetic resonance imaging scans. The proposed method first uses a modified VGG model to identify ischemic stroke in separate 2D slices. Then, a U-shaped segmentation model with residual blocks segments the lesion in each slice. This procedure is applied independently to the axial, sagittal, and coronal planes, and the final output is generated by aggregating the three segmentation results. To improve both performance and processing speed, a high-performance classifier is applied before the segmentation model in a sequential framework. This strategy reduces unnecessary segmentation of non-lesion slices and improves overall accuracy. In addition, decomposing 3D images into 2D slices reduces model complexity while allowing information from three anatomical planes to support more accurate lesion localization. The proposed model is trained on the Anatomical Tracings of Lesions After Stroke dataset and outperforms state-of-the-art models in terms of accuracy and Dice coefficient. Moreover, the segmentation output provides feedback that helps the classification model reduce false-positive predictions.
summary_zh: 当大脑的血液供应因血凝块而受阻时，脑组织的氧气输送不足，导致细胞坏死。在医疗环境中，准确识别并描绘缺血性病变边界对于治疗和手术规划至关重要。然而，缺血性卒中病变在形状、大小和位置上差异很大，且在T1W等灰度MRI模态中，它们可能与周围脑结构相似。这使得病变检测和分割成为临床医生面临的一项挑战性任务。本研究提出了一种新颖的VRU-Net架构，该架构基于视觉特征、残差连接和U形网络，用于在三维磁共振成像扫描中检测和分割缺血性卒中病变。该方法首先使用改进的VGG模型在单独的二维切片中识别缺血性卒中，然后利用带有残差块的U形分割模型对每个切片中的病变进行分割。该过程独立应用于轴位、矢状位和冠状位平面，最终输出通过聚合三个分割结果生成。为了提升性能和处理速度，在顺序框架中于分割模型之前应用了一个高性能分类器。这一策略减少了对非病变切片的不必要分割，并提高了整体准确性。此外，将三维图像分解为二维切片降低了模型复杂度，同时允许来自三个解剖平面的信息支持更准确的病变定位。所提出的模型在中风后病变解剖追踪数据集上进行训练，在准确性和Dice系数方面均优于现有最先进模型。而且，分割输出提供的反馈有助于分类模型减少假阳性预测。
tldr: This paper proposes VRXU-net, a deep learning architecture combining VGG, residual connections, and U-Net for detecting and segmenting ischemic stroke lesions in T1W MRI, using multi-planar aggregation and a classifier to reduce unnecessary segmentation. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ATLAS dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VRXU-net，一种结合VGG、残差连接和U-Net的深度学习架构，用于在T1W MRI中检测和分割缺血性卒中病灶，采用多平面聚合和分类器减少不必要的分割。在ATLAS数据集上达到了最先进的性能。

title: A Generalized Nash Equilibrium-Seeking Scheme for Trauma Resuscitation
summary: Trauma resuscitation is a clinical process for treating life-threatening physiological disorders in safety-critical environments, driven by the experience of healthcare workers (HCWs). Designing and optimizing quantifiable metrics that accurately capture HCW decisions may augment current resuscitation procedures with the potential to improve patient outcomes. This motivates our socio-technical formulation of trauma resuscitation as a distributed generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE)-seeking game with coupled inequality constraints. This method is optimized over a time-varying communication graph. We introduce novel insights from clinical experience to model HCWs behavior. This work facilitates the best possible resuscitation outcome given HCWs workloads, schedules, competencies, and limited resources.
summary_zh: 创伤复苏是在安全关键环境中治疗危及生命生理紊乱的临床过程，由医护人员（HCWs）的经验驱动。设计和优化能够准确捕捉HCW决策的可量化指标，可能增强当前的复苏流程，从而改善患者预后。这促使我们采用社会技术视角，将创伤复苏建模为具有耦合不等式约束的分布式广义纳什均衡（GNE）求解博弈。该方法在时变通信图上进行优化。我们引入来自临床经验的新见解来建模HCW行为。这项工作有助于在给定HCW工作量、排班、能力及有限资源条件下实现最佳复苏结局。
tldr: This paper formulates trauma resuscitation as a distributed generalized Nash equilibrium-seeking game with coupled constraints, optimized over time-varying communication graphs, to model healthcare worker decisions and improve patient outcomes.
tldr_zh: 本文将创伤复苏建模为一个具有耦合约束的分布式广义纳什均衡博弈，并在时变通信图上进行优化，以模拟医护人员的决策并改善患者预后。

title: Automated Detection of Urological Events in Bladder Pressure Signals with a Two-Stage Machine Learning Framework Validated on External Datasets
summary: Objective: Conventional urodynamics (UDS) provide critical diagnostic information, but requires invasive dual catheterization and manual labeling of clinically important events. Wireless, catheter-free bladder function tests are becoming available for home use, but only provide vesical pressure (Pves). We developed a machine learning framework that was trained and externally validated on UDS data for automated urological event classification from single-channel (Pves) recordings. Methods: We analyzed 118 annotated UDS traces segmented into 0.8-second Pves intervals. Using the discrete wavelet transform, we extracted 55 statistical features per segment. Consecutive segments (233,338 segments; three classes) sharing the same class, abdominal (ABD), detrusor overactivity (DO), or voiding contraction (VOID), were grouped into events, and median feature aggregation was applied to derive event-level representations. Using an imbalanced dataset, we trained a two-stage multilayer perceptron (MLP): Stage 1 distinguished VOID vs non-VOID, and Stage 2 classified non-VOID into ABD and DO. The model was trained on two independent datasets and externally validated on a third independent dataset. Additional cross-dataset training-validation permutations were performed to assess generalizability. Performance was evaluated using accuracy, F1-macro, sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC). Results: Stage 1 (VOID vs. non-VOID) achieved 84% accuracy (balanced accuracy 76%), F1-macro 0.74, and AUC 0.85, while Stage 2 (ABD vs. DO) reached 90% accuracy (balanced accuracy 80%), F1-macro 0.80, and AUC 0.87. Permutation feature importance indicated that most features contributed meaningfully. Conclusion: Our machine learning approach enables accurate automated detection of urological events from Pves, demonstrating feasibility for single-channel monitoring and future ambulatory applications.
summary_zh:
摘要：
目的：传统尿动力学检查（UDS）可提供关键诊断信息，但需进行侵入性双导管插管并手动标注临床重要事件。无线、无导管的膀胱功能测试已逐渐用于家庭场景，但仅能提供膀胱压（Pves）。我们开发了一种机器学习框架，该框架基于UDS数据进行训练与外部验证，以实现从单通道（Pves）记录中自动分类泌尿系统事件。方法：我们分析了118条已标注的UDS曲线，将其分割为0.8秒的Pves时间段。通过离散小波变换，提取每个时间段的55项统计特征。将具有相同类别（腹部[ABD]、逼尿肌过度活动[DO]或排尿收缩[VOID]）的连续时间段（共233,338个时间段，三类）归并为事件，并采用中位数特征聚合方法导出事件级表示。利用不平衡数据集，训练了一个两阶段多层感知器（MLP）：第一阶段区分VOID与非VOID，第二阶段将非VOID进一步分类为ABD和DO。模型在两个独立数据集上进行训练，并在第三个独立数据集上进行外部验证。此外，还进行了交叉数据集训练-验证排列以评估泛化能力。性能评估采用准确率、宏平均F1分数、敏感性、特异性及曲线下面积（AUC）。结果：第一阶段（VOID与非VOID）达到84%准确率（平衡准确率76%），宏平均F1分数0.74，AUC 0.85；第二阶段（ABD与DO）达到90%准确率（平衡准确率80%），宏平均F1分数0.80，AUC 0.87。排列特征重要性分析表明，大多数特征均具有显著贡献。结论：我们的机器学习方法能够基于Pves实现泌尿系统事件的精准自动检测，证明了单通道监测及未来动态应用的可行性。
tldr: The paper presents a two-stage machine learning framework (MLP) that uses discrete wavelet transform features from single-channel vesical pressure signals to classify urological events (abdominal, detrusor overactivity, voiding) with external validation, achieving 84% and 90% accuracy in two stages.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种两阶段机器学习框架（MLP），利用离散小波变换特征从单通道膀胱压力信号中分类泌尿事件（腹部、逼尿肌过度活动、排尿），并通过外部验证，两阶段分别达到84%和90%的准确率。

title: From Baseline to Follow-Up: Counterfactual Spine DXA Image Synthesis in UK Biobank Using a Causal Hierarchical Variational Autoencoder
summary: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) is widely used for large-scale skeletal assessment, yet learning controllable and interpretable factor-specific anatomical variation remains challenging. We propose a metadata-conditioned causal hierarchical variational autoencoder (CHVAE) for causally consistent generation of anteroposterior (AP) spine DXA images from the UK Biobank (UKB). The model is trained on 3,743 raw AP spine scans from the first imaging visit and conditioned on basic participant attributes and lumbar morphometry. Causal consistency is evaluated in a baseline-to-follow-up setting using abduction--action--prediction (AAP): latent variables are abducted from baseline images, age is intervened to the repeat-imaging value, and the resulting counterfactual follow-up morphometry is compared with observed repeat-imaging measurements. Results show strong absolute-level agreement for key vertebral morphometry variables under age intervention, supporting intervention-aligned synthesis of anatomically plausible DXA images.
summary_zh: 双能X线吸收测定法（DXA）广泛应用于大规模骨骼评估，但学习可控且可解释的因子特异性解剖变异仍具挑战。我们提出一种元数据条件化的因果分层变分自编码器（CHVAE），用于从英国生物银行（UKB）中因果一致地生成前后位（AP）脊柱DXA图像。该模型基于首次影像访问中的3,743张原始AP脊柱扫描图像进行训练，并以基本参与者属性和腰椎形态测量为条件。因果一致性在基线到随访的设置中采用溯因-行动-预测（AAP）框架进行评估：从基线图像中溯因潜变量，将年龄干预至重复影像时的数值，并将由此得到的反事实随访形态测量与观测到的重复影像测量结果进行比较。结果显示，在年龄干预下，关键椎体形态测量变量具有强绝对水平一致性，支持可生成解剖学合理DXA图像的干预对齐合成。
tldr: This paper proposes a causal hierarchical variational autoencoder (CHVAE) for generating counterfactual spine DXA images by intervening on age, demonstrating anatomically plausible synthesis in a baseline-to-follow-up setting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种因果层次变分自编码器（CHVAE），通过对年龄进行干预来生成反事实的脊柱DXA图像，并在基线-随访设置中展示了解剖学上合理的合成结果。

title: Seizure-Semiology-Suite (S3): A Clinically Multimodal Dataset, Benchmark, and Models for Seizure Semiology Understanding
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in general video understanding, their capacity to interpret involuntary, and spatio-temporally evolving pathologic motor behaviors such as seizure semiology remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce Seizure-Semiology-Suite, a clinically grounded dataset and benchmark for fine-grained, structured seizure semiology understanding. The dataset includes 438 seizure videos annotated with over 35,000 dense labels covering 20 ILAE-defined semiological features. Building on this dataset, we propose a seven-task hierarchical benchmark that systematically evaluates MLLMs from low-level visual perception to temporal sequencing, narrative report generation, and seizure diagnosis. To enable clinically meaningful evaluation of generated reports, we further introduce the Report Quality Index for Seizure Semiology (Seizure-RQI). Extensive baselines across 11 open-weight MLLMs reveal systematic weaknesses in laterality reasoning, temporal localization, symptom sequencing, and clinically faithful reporting. We show that seizure-specific fine-tuning substantially improves performance across tasks, and that a two-stage neuro-symbolic framework achieves an F1 score of 0.96 on epileptic versus non-epileptic seizure classification. Seizure-Semiology-Suite establishes a rigorous benchmark for evaluating multimodal models in safety-critical medical video understanding and guides the development of clinically reliable, domain-adaptive multimodal intelligence.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在通用视频理解方面已展现出卓越能力，但其解读非自主且时空演变的病理性运动行为（如癫痫发作症状学）的能力尚未得到充分验证。为填补这一空白，我们提出Seizure-Semiology-Suite——一个基于临床实践的数据集与基准测试，用于细粒度、结构化的癫痫发作症状学理解。该数据集包含438个癫痫发作视频，标注了超过35,000个密集标签，涵盖20种由ILAE定义的语义学特征。基于此数据集，我们构建了一个七任务分层基准，系统评估MLLMs从低级视觉感知到时序推理、叙述性报告生成及癫痫诊断的能力。为实现生成的临床意义报告评估，我们进一步引入癫痫症状学报告质量指数（Seizure-RQI）。对11个开源权重的MLLMs进行的广泛基线测试揭示了其在偏侧性推理、时间定位、症状排序及临床忠实报告方面的系统性缺陷。研究表明，针对癫痫的特异性微调可显著提升各项任务性能，而一个两阶段神经符号框架在癫痫与非癫痫发作分类中达到了0.96的F1分数。Seizure-Semiology-Suite为评估多模态模型在安全关键的医学视频理解中的表现建立了严格基准，并指导了临床可靠、领域自适应的多模态智能的发展。
tldr: This paper introduces a multimodal dataset (438 seizure videos with 35,000+ labels) and a seven-task benchmark to evaluate multimodal LLMs on fine-grained seizure semiology understanding. It also proposes a Report Quality Index (Seizure-RQI) and shows that domain-specific fine-tuning and a neuro-symbolic framework improve performance significantly.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个多模态数据集（438个癫痫发作视频，超过35,000个标签）和一个七任务基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在细粒度癫痫发作症状学理解上的表现，并提出了报告质量指数（Seizure-RQI），展示了领域微调和神经符号框架能显著提升性能。

title: PathNavigate: A Training-Free Pathology Agent with Surprise-Guided Scan and Shared Slide Memory for Whole-Slide Image VQA
summary: Whole-slide image visual question answering (WSI-VQA) frames pathology as an extreme-context search problem: to answer a free-form clinical query, a system must first navigate a gigapixel slide under a strict inspection budget to locate sparse, high-resolution evidence. Existing approaches largely fall into two paradigms: i) supervised pathology multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and agents can absorb localization and reasoning into learned modules, but they often couple navigation to task-specific supervision and retraining, limiting their practicality; ii) training-free pathology agents avoid this cost by keeping core models frozen, but often follow a question-first design, constructing the initial candidate set mainly from query-conditioned relevance. This can miss decisive morphology that is not named in the question, and force heavier inference-time scaffolding. To address this challenge, we introduce PathNavigate, a training-free pathology agent built around a scan-search-readout routine. Before question matching, PathNavigate scans the current slide at low magnification with a shared online memory module over frozen pathology features, producing a slide-specific surprise field that marks an abnormal-region pool. It then applies question-conditioned PLIP relevance only within this pool to select high-magnification search targets. Finally, it extracts local high-magnification evidence and answers with a frozen perceptor-adjudicator stack, using the same online memory as slide-level context. Experiments on WSI-VQA and SlideBench-BCNB show that the proposed scan-search-readout design improves answer accuracy and yields more interpretable evidence-selection trajectories with higher efficiency.The code is available online.
summary_zh: 全切片图像视觉问答（WSI-VQA）将病理分析定义为一个极端上下文搜索问题：为了回答一个自由形式的临床查询，系统必须首先在严格的检查预算下导航千兆像素级别的切片，以定位稀疏的高分辨率证据。现有方法主要分为两种范式：i）有监督的病理多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和智能体可以将定位与推理吸收到学习模块中，但它们通常将导航与任务特定的监督和重新训练耦合，限制了其实用性；ii）免训练的病理智能体通过保持核心模型冻结来避免这一成本，但通常采用问题优先的设计，主要根据查询条件相关性构建初始候选集。这可能会遗漏问题中未提及的关键形态学特征，并迫使在推理时增加更多的支撑结构。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了PathNavigate——一种基于扫描-搜索-读出流程构建的免训练病理智能体。在问题匹配之前，PathNavigate在低放大倍数下扫描当前切片，并利用共享的在线记忆模块对冻结的病理特征进行操作，生成一个切片特有的异常场，用于标记异常区域池。随后，它仅在此池内应用基于问题的PLIP相关性，以选择高放大倍数的搜索目标。最后，它提取局部高分辨率证据，并通过冻结的感知器-裁决器堆栈进行回答，使用相同的在线记忆作为切片级上下文。在WSI-VQA和SlideBench-BCNB上的实验表明，所提出的扫描-搜索-读出设计提高了答案准确性，并生成了更具可解释性且效率更高的证据选择轨迹。代码已在线公开。
tldr: PathNavigate is a training-free pathology agent for whole-slide image VQA that uses a surprise-guided scan and shared slide memory to improve efficiency and interpretability in answering clinical queries under a strict inspection budget.
tldr_zh: PathNavigate 是一种无需训练的病理学智能体，用于全切片图像视觉问答，通过惊奇引导扫描和共享切片记忆，在严格检查预算下提高回答临床查询的效率和可解释性。

title: Exploiting Longitudinal Context in Clinician-Verified Interactive Lesion Tracking
summary: Tracking tumor lesions across serial CT scans is essential for oncological response assessment. Existing automated methods face a fundamental trade-off: end-to-end trackers achieve high automation but offer no opportunity to correct silent tracking failures, while decoupled registration-segmentation pipelines permit user verification yet discard the lesion's prior appearance, limiting accuracy in ambiguous cases. In this work, we propose a Verified Tracking paradigm: a clinician verifies a registration-proposed prompt, which the model leverages alongside the baseline lesion appearance to resolve segmentation ambiguities. We present a unified framework combining early spatial prompt fusion with latent temporal difference weighting for longitudinally-informed segmentation. To address data scarcity, we leverage large-scale synthetic pretraining, proving essential for exploiting longitudinal context, improving performance by up to 4.5 Dice points over training from scratch. Our approach secured first place in the MICCAI autoPET IV challenge. We further curate and release PanTrack, a new longitudinal pancreatic cancer benchmark, to assess out-of-distribution generalization. Experiments show that our model outperforms prior work in both fully automatic and the proposed verified tracking setting offering a clinically safe middle ground between automation and control. Code, model and dataset will be released at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/LongiSeg
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在连续CT扫描中追踪肿瘤病灶对于肿瘤治疗应答评估至关重要。现有自动化方法面临一个根本性的权衡：端到端追踪器虽然自动化程度高，但无法纠正无声的追踪失败；而解耦的配准-分割流程允许用户验证，却忽略了病灶的先验外观，在模糊病例中限制了准确性。本研究提出一种验证追踪范式：临床医生验证配准生成的提示，模型结合该提示与基线病灶外观来解决分割模糊性。我们提出一个统一框架，将早期空间提示融合与潜在时间差异加权相结合，实现纵向信息驱动的分割。为解决数据稀缺问题，我们利用大规模合成预训练，证明其对利用纵向上下文至关重要，相比从头训练性能提升高达4.5个Dice点。我们的方法在MICCAI autoPET IV挑战赛中荣获第一名。我们还整理并发布了PanTrack——一个新的纵向胰腺癌基准数据集，用于评估分布外泛化性能。实验表明，在完全自动化和所提出的验证追踪设置下，我们的模型均优于先前工作，在自动化与控制之间提供了一个临床安全的中间地带。代码、模型和数据集将在https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/LongiSeg 发布。
tldr: This paper proposes a Verified Tracking paradigm for longitudinal lesion tracking in CT scans, combining registration-based prompts with clinician verification and a unified segmentation framework using synthetic pretraining, achieving first place in the MICCAI autoPET IV challenge.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于CT扫描中纵向病灶追踪的验证追踪范式，结合基于配准的提示与临床医生验证，并利用合成预训练的统一分割框架，在MICCAI autoPET IV挑战中获得第一名。

title: A Proactive Multi-Agent Dialogue Framework for Assessing Social Language Disorder Traits in Autism
summary: Characteristic linguistic behaviors associated with Social Language Disorder (SLD) in autism spectrum disorder, including echoic repetition, pronoun displacement, and stereotyped media quoting, are largely absent from spontaneous conversation and only emerge under specific conversational conditions. In structured clinical assessments, this latency means that questioning strategy selection is a critical yet underappreciated determinant of how much diagnostic information a conversation yields. Whether large language models (LLMs) can be guided to proactively select questioning strategies that systematically surface these latent traits remains largely unexplored. Here we present TPA (Think, Plan, Ask), a proactive multi-agent dialogue framework applied to the language assessment component of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule Module 4 (ADOS-2), in which a doctor agent explicitly reasons about which traits remain unobserved before selecting a clinically grounded strategy and generating a targeted question. A patient agent grounded in real ADOS-2 clinical data enables reproducible evaluation without real patient participation, validated across three independent experiments confirming adequate fidelity to real patient language. Evaluated on 484 episodes from 35 patients, TPA outperforms six competitive dialogue planning baselines across all primary metrics, achieving 82.1% SLD trait coverage, 16.6% higher than automated replay of real clinical dialogues conducted by trained clinicians (65.5%), with substantially greater per-turn diagnostic efficiency (AUCC: 0.628 vs. 0.458, absolute gain +0.170). These results demonstrate that proactive questioning strategy selection substantially improves the efficiency of automated SLD trait assessment, with direct implications for scalable AI-assisted clinical screening.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自闭症谱系障碍中与社交语言障碍（SLD）相关的典型语言行为，包括回声性重复、代词错用和刻板媒体引用，在自发对话中基本不出现，仅在特定对话条件下才会显现。在结构化临床评估中，这种潜伏性意味着提问策略的选择是决定一次对话能获取多少诊断信息的关键但被低估的因素。大型语言模型（LLMs）能否被引导主动选择提问策略，以系统性地揭示这些潜在特征，目前仍缺乏研究。本文提出了TPA（思考、计划、提问）框架——一种应用于自闭症诊断观察量表第2版模块4（ADOS-2）语言评估部分的主动式多智能体对话框架，其中医生智能体在基于临床策略选择并生成针对性问题之前，会明确推理哪些特征尚未被观察到。患者智能体基于真实的ADOS-2临床数据构建，无需真实患者参与即可实现可复现的评估，并通过三项独立实验验证，证明其能充分忠实于真实患者的语言特征。在来自35名患者的484个对话片段上评估，TPA在所有主要指标上均优于六种竞争性对话规划基线，实现了82.1%的SLD特征覆盖率，比经过培训的临床医生进行的真实临床对话自动回放（65.5%）高出16.6%，且每次对话的诊断效率显著更高（AUCC：0.628 vs. 0.458，绝对提升+0.170）。这些结果表明，主动式提问策略选择能显著提升自动化SLD特征评估的效率，对可扩展的AI辅助临床筛查具有直接意义。
tldr: This paper proposes TPA, a proactive multi-agent dialogue framework that uses LLMs to systematically elicit latent social language disorder traits in autism by having a doctor agent reason about unobserved traits and select clinically grounded questioning strategies, outperforming clinical baselines in trait coverage and diagnostic efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TPA，一种主动式多智能体对话框架，利用大语言模型通过医生智能体推理未观察到的特征并选择基于临床的提问策略，系统性地引出自闭症中潜在的社会语言障碍特征，在特征覆盖率和诊断效率上优于临床基线。

title: ExpOS: Explainable Open-Surgery Skills Assessment Using 3D Hand Reconstruction
summary: Timely and transparent feedback is essential for effective surgical training, yet current assessment remains dependent on expert observation, limiting scalability and opportunities for autonomous practice. We present ExpOS, an explainable framework for data-driven assessment of open-surgery skills designed to enable automatic, feedback-oriented evaluation. Rather than relying on expert-defined metrics, ExpOS learns discriminative temporal patterns directly from motion data and identifies the segments and behaviors most predictive of skill level. We trained and evaluated the method on 221 videos of medical students performing three open-surgery tasks. Hand poses and tool detections were extracted from each frame to derive kinematic descriptors and global motion statistics. Spatiotemporal hand-tool dynamics were modeled using a temporal convolutional backbone with attention-based pooling to generate frame-level importance maps. These representations were fused with global motion statistics to predict skill level and to provide interpretable feedback. ExpOS provides multi-level explainability by identifying when informative events occur through attention weights and which motion characteristics most influence predictions through global feature analysis. Across tasks, the framework achieved strong correlation with expert ratings, with best performance on fascial closure (r = 0.778, R2 = 0.74). These results demonstrate that combining weakly-supervised temporal importance learning with interpretable motion statistics enables scalable and actionable surgical skill assessment.
summary_zh: 及时透明的反馈对于有效的外科训练至关重要，然而当前的评估仍依赖专家观察，限制了可扩展性和自主练习的机会。我们提出ExpOS，一个可解释的数据驱动开放手术技能评估框架，旨在实现自动化的、面向反馈的评价。ExpOS不依赖专家定义的指标，而是直接从运动数据中学习具有判别性的时间模式，并识别最能预测技能水平的分段和行为。我们在221段医学生执行三项开放手术任务的视频上训练并评估了该方法。从每帧中提取手部姿态和工具检测信息，以推导运动学描述符和全局运动统计量。使用基于注意力池化的时间卷积骨干网络对时空手-工具动态进行建模，生成帧级重要性图。这些表示与全局运动统计量融合，以预测技能水平并提供可解释的反馈。ExpOS通过注意力权重识别信息事件发生的时间，并通过全局特征分析明确哪些运动特征对预测影响最大，从而提供多层级可解释性。在各项任务中，该框架与专家评分高度相关，在筋膜闭合任务中表现最佳（r = 0.778，R² = 0.74）。这些结果表明，将弱监督时间重要性学习与可解释的运动统计量相结合，能够实现可扩展且可操作的外科技能评估。
tldr: ExpOS is an explainable framework for open-surgery skills assessment that learns discriminative temporal patterns from motion data using a temporal convolutional backbone with attention-based pooling, achieving strong correlation with expert ratings and providing interpretable feedback.
tldr_zh: ExpOS是一个用于开放手术技能评估的可解释框架，通过带注意力池化的时间卷积骨干网络从运动数据中学习判别性时间模式，与专家评分达到强相关性，并提供可解释的反馈。

title: Know You Before You Speak: User-State Modeling for LLM Personalization in Multi-Turn Conversation
summary: Personalized dialogue requires more than recalling explicit user histories: systems also need to infer hidden user states that evolve through interaction and shape appropriate response strategies. Existing memory- and profile-based methods primarily reuse observable user information, offering limited support for modeling user-state dynamics or selecting actions based on how they shape future user states. We propose PUMA (Prospective User-state Modeling for Action selection), a framework grounded in the Free Energy Principle (FEP) that formulates personalization as decision-making under partial observability, centered on an explicit user state model that captures latent user states and their action-conditioned dynamics. At each turn, PUMA maintains a belief over the user's hidden state, refines the user state model for observation generation and action-conditioned state transition, and selects dialogue actions by minimizing expected free energy, balancing epistemic and pragmatic objectives under a unified criterion. This formulation shifts personalization from passive memory retrieval to model-based decision-making over user evolution. We instantiate PUMA on healthcare-oriented counseling and motivational interviewing benchmarks with latent state annotations for rigorous evaluation. Experiments show that PUMA improves long-horizon dialogue outcomes while maintaining strong response quality, and a cross-dataset study demonstrates more reliable user-state estimation and next-state prediction.
summary_zh: 个性化对话不仅需要回忆显式的用户历史：系统还需推断通过交互演化并塑造适当响应策略的隐藏用户状态。现有基于记忆和档案的方法主要复用可观察的用户信息，在建模用户状态动态或基于状态对未来的塑造作用来选择动作方面支持有限。我们提出PUMA（面向动作选择的预期用户状态建模），这是一个基于自由能原理（FEP）的框架，将个性化建模为部分可观测条件下的决策问题，核心是一个显式的用户状态模型，可捕捉潜在用户状态及其受动作调节的动态。在每一轮对话中，PUMA维护对用户隐藏状态的信念，优化用于观测生成和动作调节状态转移的用户状态模型，并通过最小化预期自由能来选择对话动作，在统一准则下平衡认知与实用目标。这种形式化将个性化从被动的记忆检索转变为基于模型的用户演化决策。我们在面向医疗保健的咨询和动机性访谈基准上实例化PUMA，并附带潜在状态标注以进行严格评估。实验表明，PUMA能在保持强响应质量的同时改善长期对话结果，跨数据集研究也展示了更可靠的用户状态估计和下一状态预测能力。
tldr: Proposes PUMA, a framework using the Free Energy Principle for user-state modeling in personalized multi-turn dialogue, applied to healthcare counseling, improving long-horizon outcomes.
tldr_zh: 提出PUMA框架，基于自由能原理进行用户状态建模，用于多轮对话个性化，应用于医疗咨询，提升长期对话效果。

title: Catching MRI outliers: unsupervised detection and localization of MRI artefacts and clinical anomalies using deep learning
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into radiotherapy workflows, yet such pipelines remain vulnerable to out-of-distribution image data that may introduce unexpected behavior in clinical tasks. Deep learning-based anomaly detection for pelvic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains largely unexplored, and transparent evaluation of its feasibility for full automation is limited. We developed and evaluated a fully automated, unsupervised anomaly-detection framework for pelvic and brain MRI. A two-stage framework was trained on reference images from public datasets: LUND-PROBE for pelvic MRI, and IXI, fastMRI, and fastMRI+ for brain MRI. In the first stage, MRI slices were compressed into discrete tokens; in the second, the distribution of normal tokens was modeled. Anomaly evidence was estimated by combining perceptual image differences with token-surprisal scores based on negative log-likelihood. Automated detection was evaluated on pelvic MRI with synthetic global and real clinical anomalies, and on brain MRI with clinically annotated fastMRI+ abnormalities. Sensitivity, specificity, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and false-positive behavior in held-out normal cases were assessed. The framework achieved robust detection across hidden evaluation cohorts, with AUCs of 0.97 (95% CI, 0.95-0.98) and 0.81 (95% CI, 0.74-0.87) for pelvic and brain MRI, respectively. Heatmap analysis showed strong spatial agreement between detected anomalies and ground-truth locations, supporting localization accuracy and interpretability. These results support the potential of unsupervised anomaly detection as an automated MRI quality-control layer for radiotherapy workflows, with transparent visualization of image regions likely to compromise downstream AI-based tasks.
summary_zh: 人工智能正日益融入放射治疗工作流程，但这类流程仍易受分布外影像数据的影响，这些数据可能在临床任务中引发意外行为。基于深度学习的盆腔磁共振成像异常检测仍基本未得到探索，且对其全自动化可行性的透明评估十分有限。我们开发并评估了一个用于盆腔和脑部MRI的完全无监督异常检测框架。该两阶段框架使用来自公共数据集的参考图像进行训练：盆腔MRI使用LUND-PROBE数据集，脑部MRI使用IXI、fastMRI和fastMRI+数据集。第一阶段将MRI切片压缩为离散令牌；第二阶段对正常令牌的分布进行建模。通过将感知图像差异与基于负对数似然的令牌惊讶分数相结合，估计异常证据。在含有合成全局异常和真实临床异常的盆腔MRI上，以及含有临床标注fastMRI+异常的脑部MRI上，评估了自动检测性能。评估指标包括敏感性、特异性、受试者工作特征曲线下面积以及保留正常病例中的假阳性行为。该框架在隐藏评估队列中实现了稳健检测，盆腔MRI和脑部MRI的AUC分别为0.97（95% CI，0.95-0.98）和0.81（95% CI，0.74-0.87）。热图分析显示，检测到的异常与真实位置之间具有强空间一致性，支持定位准确性和可解释性。这些结果支持无监督异常检测作为放射治疗工作流中自动化MRI质量控制层的潜力，并能够透明可视化可能危及下游基于AI任务的图像区域。
tldr: An unsupervised deep learning framework for detecting and localizing anomalies in pelvic and brain MRI, achieving high AUC scores and spatial localization accuracy, proposed as a quality-control layer for radiotherapy workflows.
tldr_zh: 一种无监督的深度学习框架用于检测和定位盆腔和脑部MRI中的异常，取得了高AUC分数和空间定位精度，作为放射治疗工作流程的质量控制层。

title: EPPC-OASIS: Ontology-Aware Adaptation and Structured Inference Refinement for Electronic Patient-Provider Communication Mining in Secure Messages
summary: Secure patient-provider messages contain clinically important communication behaviors that are difficult to characterize manually at scale. The Electronic Patient-Provider Communication (EPPC) framework provides an ontology for coding these behaviors, but automated extraction remains challenging because predictions must preserve fine-grained code/sub-code structure while grounding annotations in message text. We developed EPPC-OASIS, an ontology-aware adaptation approach for structured EPPC extraction, and combined it with deployable inference-refinement procedures designed to improve the coherence of final annotations. EPPC-OASIS augments supervised fine-tuning with a Wasserstein alignment objective that encourages alignment between model representation neighborhoods and EPPC ontology-derived neighborhoods, while inference refinement uses verification, self-consistency, hybrid correction, and selection or ensembling to address residual prediction errors. We evaluated the framework on a de-identified corpus of secure patient-provider messages against prompting, supervised fine-tuning, preference-based, and robustness-oriented baselines across multiple open-weight language models. Across model families, the best deployable pipeline achieved 77.13% Code+Sub-code F1 and 63.83% Triplet F1, corresponding to modest but consistent absolute gains of +1.39 and +2.12 F1 points over the strongest supervised fine-tuning baseline. These results suggest that ontology-aware adaptation with structured inference refinement can support scalable retrospective EPPC mining, although external validation is needed before operational use.
summary_zh: 安全医患信息中包含具有临床重要性的沟通行为，这些行为难以通过人工方式大规模标注。电子医患沟通（EPPC）框架提供了对这些行为进行编码的本体，但自动提取仍面临挑战，因为预测结果必须保留细粒度的代码/子代码结构，同时将注释锚定在消息文本中。我们开发了EPPC-OASIS，一种面向本体的结构化EPPC提取自适应方法，并将其与旨在提升最终注释一致性的可部署推理优化流程相结合。EPPC-OASIS通过Wasserstein对齐目标增强监督微调，该目标鼓励模型表征邻域与EPPC本体派生邻域之间的对齐；而推理优化则利用验证、自一致性、混合校正以及选择或集成策略来处理残留预测误差。我们在一个去标识化的安全医患消息语料库上，基于多个开放权重语言模型，将本框架与基于提示词、监督微调、偏好优化及鲁棒性导向的基线方法进行了对比评估。在各模型系列中，最佳可部署流水线实现了77.13%的代码+子代码F1分数和63.83%的三元组F1分数，相较于最强的监督微调基线，获得了虽温和但一致的绝对增益，分别提升+1.39和+2.12个F1百分点。这些结果表明，结合结构化推理优化的本体感知自适应方法能够支持可扩展的回顾性EPPC挖掘，但在投入实际应用前仍需进行外部验证。
tldr: EPPC-OASIS is an ontology-aware adaptation and inference refinement framework for automatically extracting clinically important communication behaviors from secure patient-provider messages, achieving modest but consistent improvements over strong baselines.
tldr_zh: EPPC-OASIS 是一个本体感知自适应与推理精炼框架，用于从安全的医患消息中自动提取具有临床意义的沟通行为，相比强基线取得了温和但一致的改进。

title: PrivFusion: A Privacy-preserving Multi-Agent Framework for Harmonizing Distributed Datasets
summary: The growing availability of clinical data has increased the use of machine learning, yet centralized data aggregation is often infeasible for sensitive health information. Federated Learning (FL) offers a distributed alternative, but its adoption is limited by substantial heterogeneity across institutional datasets, making harmonization a critical but frequently overlooked prerequisite for multi-site analytics. We introduce PrivFusion, a privacy-preserving multi-agent framework that automates the harmonization of structured datasets prior to federated training. PrivFusion uses agents to analyze local data, cluster semantically similar features across sites, and provide iterative transformation recommendations until alignment is achieved. Evaluation across four heterogeneous COVID-19 datasets demonstrates that PrivFusion effectively and efficiently harmonizes multi-site data while substantially reducing manual effort.
summary_zh: 摘要：临床数据的日益普及推动了机器学习的广泛应用，但对于敏感健康信息而言，集中式数据聚合往往不可行。联邦学习（FL）提供了一种分布式替代方案，但其应用受到各机构数据集之间显著异质性的限制，这使得数据统一成为多站点分析中关键但常被忽视的前提条件。我们提出PrivFusion——一种隐私保护的多智能体框架，能够在联邦训练前自动实现结构化数据集的统一。PrivFusion利用智能体分析本地数据，跨站点聚类语义相似的特征，并提供迭代式的转换建议直至数据对齐。在四个异质性COVID-19数据集上的评估表明，PrivFusion能够高效且有效地实现多站点数据统一，同时显著减少人工工作量。
tldr: PrivFusion is a privacy-preserving multi-agent framework that automates the harmonization of structured clinical datasets across heterogeneous sites before federated learning, reducing manual effort and enabling effective multi-site analytics.
tldr_zh: PrivFusion 是一个隐私保护的多智能体框架，在联邦学习之前自动协调异构临床机构的结构化数据集，减少人工工作并实现有效的多站点分析。

title: SliceWorld: A Predictive and Controllable World-State Model for CT Report Generation
summary: CT report generation (CTRG) requires models to summarize three-dimensional anatomical context and pathological findings from hundreds of axial slices. Existing methods typically learn a direct image-to-text mapping, providing limited mechanisms for modeling how CT evidence evolves across slices or how reports respond to controlled changes in latent lesion-related factors. We propose SliceWorld, a CT-specific world-state framework that treats an axial CT scan as an ordered sequence along the z-axis. SliceWorld encodes prefix CT evidence into factor-aware latent states containing anatomy, lesion, and uncertainty components, and projects these states into world tokens used for multi-step future-slice feature prediction, lesion-factor intervention, and LLM-based report generation. The model is first pretrained on CT slice sequences with predictive, factor-aware, and counterfactual objectives, and is then fine-tuned on paired CT-report data. Experiments on M3D-Cap and CT-RATE show that SliceWorld improves natural language generation metrics and clinically oriented automatic evaluation. Further analyses demonstrate multi-horizon future-slice prediction, measurable factor alignment, reduced-slice robustness, and selective lesion-sensitive report modulation.
summary_zh:
摘要：
CT报告生成需要模型从数百个轴向切片中总结三维解剖背景和病理发现。现有方法通常学习直接的图像到文本映射，缺乏对CT证据如何跨切片演变或报告如何响应潜在病变相关因素的可控变化进行建模的机制。我们提出SliceWorld，一个面向CT的世界状态框架，将轴向CT扫描视为沿z轴的有序序列。SliceWorld将前缀CT证据编码为包含解剖、病变和不确定性组件的因子感知潜在状态，并将这些状态投影到世界令牌中，用于多步未来切片特征预测、病变因子干预和基于LLM的报告生成。该模型首先在CT切片序列上使用预测性、因子感知和反事实目标进行预训练，然后在配对的CT-报告数据上进行微调。在M3D-Cap和CT-RATE上的实验表明，SliceWorld改善了自然语言生成指标和临床导向的自动评估。进一步分析证明了多视野未来切片预测、可测量的因子对齐、减少切片的鲁棒性以及选择性病变敏感的报告调制。
tldr: SliceWorld introduces a world-state framework for CT report generation that models axial slices as sequences, learns latent factor-aware states for anatomy, lesion, and uncertainty, and enables future-slice prediction, lesion intervention, and LLM-based report generation, achieving improved metrics on public benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SliceWorld提出了一种用于CT报告生成的世界状态框架，将轴向切片视为序列，学习包含解剖、病灶和不确定性的因子感知潜在状态，并实现未来切片预测、病灶干预和基于LLM的报告生成，在公开基准上取得了更好的指标。

title: Optimizing Digital Therapeutic Interventions: Online Learning under Endogenous Adherence
summary: A critical challenge facing clinicians managing chronic disease interventions is sustaining long-run patient health given limited information and resources. Digital therapeutics (DTs) provide a cost-effective way to manage interventions at scale through repeated interactions (e.g. daily treatment recommendations), but patient success is highly dependent on their adherence. Behavioral psychology suggests that both treatment recommendations and past adherence affect future adherence, yet existing decision support frameworks for DTs model only recommendation effects or treat adherence as exogenous context, leaving a key gap in model and algorithm development. To address this gap, we present a DT decision support framework that captures both recommendation and adherence effects, allowing clinicians to better plan treatment recommendations. We model a patient's time-varying capacity for engagement with treatment using a linear dynamical system (LDS) that captures both recommendation and adherence effects, endogenously connected to adherence behavior with a logit link. We establish finite-time identification guarantees for this model, extending LDS results to our setting. Next, we propose an optimism-based algorithm, UCB-BOLD, for online treatment selection and prove that it achieves sublinear regret. We evaluate UCB-BOLD against benchmarks via ablation studies on a synthetic patient cohort generated using micro-randomized trial data. DT decision support tools can include dynamical models to enable decision makers to efficiently use the data in DT settings to improve patient health through effective resource allocation. While myopic or heuristic approaches suffice for some patient types, the benefits of explicitly planning around recommendation and adherence effects are significant for others; UCB-BOLD achieves 2-3x lower conditional value-at-risk regret than the next-best benchmark.
summary_zh: 摘要：临床医生在管理慢性病干预时面临的一个关键挑战是，在信息和资源有限的情况下维持患者的长期健康。数字疗法（DTs）通过重复互动（如每日治疗建议）提供了一种经济有效的规模化干预管理方式，但患者的成功高度取决于其依从性。行为心理学表明，治疗建议和过去的依从性都会影响未来的依从性，然而现有的数字疗法决策支持框架仅建模建议效应，或将依从性视为外生背景，导致模型与算法开发存在关键空白。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种数字疗法决策支持框架，该框架同时捕捉建议效应和依从性效应，使临床医生能够更好地规划治疗建议。我们使用线性动力系统（LDS）对患者随时间变化的治疗参与能力进行建模，该系统同时捕捉建议效应和依从性效应，并通过logit连接内在地与依从行为相关联。我们为该模型建立了有限时间辨识保证，将LDS的结果推广至我们的场景。接下来，我们提出一种基于乐观主义的在线治疗选择算法UCB-BOLD，并证明其实现了次线性遗憾。我们通过消融研究，在基于微随机试验数据生成的合成患者队列上，将UCB-BOLD与基准方法进行比较评估。数字疗法决策支持工具可包含动态模型，使决策者能够有效利用数字疗法场景中的数据，通过优化资源配置改善患者健康。虽然短视或启发式方法对某些患者类型已足够，但对其他患者而言，围绕建议效应和依从性效应进行明确规划的好处显著；UCB-BOLD的条件风险价值遗憾比次优基准方法低2-3倍。
tldr: This paper proposes a decision support framework for digital therapeutics that models the dynamic interplay between treatment recommendations and patient adherence using a linear dynamical system, and introduces an online learning algorithm (UCB-BOLD) with finite-time guarantees and sublinear regret.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个数字疗法的决策支持框架，使用线性动态系统建模治疗建议与患者依从性之间的动态相互作用，并引入了一种具有有限时间保证和次线性遗憾的在线学习算法（UCB-BOLD）。

title: ChainLearn: A Blockchain-Based Capacity-Aware Framework for Federated Ensemble Learning
summary:
Federated learning is used in medical imaging where privacy prohibits centralizing data. Standard federated algorithms assume homogeneous hardware, identical architectures, and centralized aggregation, which fails when hospitals have unequal compute resources. We propose capacity-aware coordination: measure each hospital's throughput, assign capacity-appropriate architectures (MobileNetV3-Small, EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50), and combine predictions via weighted ensemble. Weak and strong hospitals can participate without forcing uniform architectures.
  We separate on-chain policy from off-chain learning. A Solidity contract stores hospital registration, benchmark hashes, metrics, and weights. Hospitals train locally and submit only hashes and scalars (not parameters). Weighted ensemble inference is computed off-chain.
  Experiments on PneumoniaMNIST and DermaMNIST (5 seeds, 3 non-IID levels) show our method achieves lower or equal calibration error versus equal-weight ensemble and competitive accuracy versus FedAvg, FedProx, and FedMD. Communication overhead is 224 bytes per round, a reduction of over 912,000x compared to FedAvg.
summary_zh:
联邦学习用于医学影像领域，其中隐私保护禁止数据集中化。标准联邦算法假设同构硬件、相同架构以及集中式聚合，当医院计算资源不均时便无法适用。我们提出容量感知协调机制：测量每家医院的吞吐量，分配与容量匹配的架构（MobileNetV3-Small、EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50），并通过加权集成融合预测结果。弱医院和强医院无需强制统一架构即可参与。  
我们将链上策略与链下学习分离。Solidity合约存储医院注册信息、基准哈希、指标和权重。医院在本地训练，仅提交哈希值和标量（而非参数）。加权集成推理在链下计算。  
在PneumoniaMNIST和DermaMNIST数据集上的实验（5个随机种子、3个非独立同分布水平）表明，与等权集成相比，我们的方法实现了更低或相等的校准误差，与FedAvg、FedProx和FedMD相比具有竞争力的准确率。通信开销为每轮224字节，相较于FedAvg降低了超过912,000倍。
tldr: ChainLearn proposes a blockchain-based federated ensemble learning framework that assigns heterogeneous architectures to hospitals based on their compute capacity, using on-chain policy for coordination and off-chain training to drastically reduce communication overhead while maintaining accuracy on medical imaging benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ChainLearn 提出了一种基于区块链的联邦集成学习框架，根据医院的计算能力为其分配异构架构，通过链上策略协调和链下训练大幅降低通信开销，同时在医学影像基准上保持准确性。

title: ProofAgent Harness: Open Infrastructure for Adversarial Evaluation of AI Agents
summary: AI agents are entering high-risk production settings, where they use tools, retain context, follow policies, handle private data, and interact with users over multiple turns. Yet many evaluation methods still judge isolated outputs or static tasks, missing failures that emerge through trajectory, pressure, and adversarial interaction. We introduce ProofAgent Harness, open infrastructure for scalable, auditable, and adversarial AI agent evaluation. The harness provides evaluation infrastructure around an agent: it curates evaluation intelligence, runs adversarial multi-turn trials, captures behavioral traces, applies post-hoc multi-juror scoring, resolves disagreement, and produces evidence-linked reports. Its open design allows developers and researchers to extend domains, traps, metrics, juror personas, scoring rules, and reporting formats. At its core is Adversarial Multi-Juror Scoring with Turn-Level Audit, which evaluates completed agent behavior under pressure using calibrated juror personas, consensus checks, and turn-level evidence. Experiments across customer support, medical triage, privacy and security, and code generation agents show that strong agents fail selectively through weak metrics, fragile turns, unsafe reframing, and manipulation paths. We also find that a small quantized local Harness LLM can challenge production agents powered by best-in-class large LLMs, suggesting that evaluation capability emerges from the full harness pipeline rather than model scale alone. ProofAgent Harness turns AI agent evaluation from a static score into scalable adversarial evaluation infrastructure: repeatable, evidence-backed, extensible, and actionable before deployment.
summary_zh: AI智能体正进入高风险生产环境，它们在此环境中使用工具、保留上下文、遵循政策、处理私有数据，并通过多轮交互与用户协作。然而，许多评估方法仍仅评判孤立输出或静态任务，未能捕捉到从轨迹、压力与对抗交互中涌现的失败案例。我们提出ProofAgent Harness（验证智能体框架），这是一套可扩展、可审计且支持对抗性评估的开源基础设施。该框架围绕智能体提供评估基础设施：它汇集评估情报、运行对抗性多轮试验、捕获行为轨迹、实施事后多裁判评分、解决分歧并生成附带证据的评估报告。其开放设计允许开发者和研究者扩展领域、陷阱、指标、裁判角色、评分规则及报告格式。其核心是“带回合级审计的对抗性多裁判评分”，该方法使用校准后的裁判角色、共识检查及回合级证据，在压力条件下评估已完成智能体行为。针对客服、医疗分诊、隐私安全及代码生成智能体的实验表明，强智能体会因薄弱指标、脆弱回合、不安全重构及操纵路径而出现选择性失效。我们还发现，一个小型量化本地框架大语言模型能够挑战由顶尖大型大语言模型驱动的生产级智能体，这表明评估能力源自完整的框架流程而非单纯模型规模。ProofAgent Harness将AI智能体评估从静态分数转化为可扩展的对抗性评估基础设施：可重复、有证据支撑、可扩展，且在部署前即可付诸行动。
tldr: ProofAgent Harness is an open infrastructure for adversarial evaluation of AI agents, using multi-turn trials, adversarial scoring, and evidence-linked reports to detect failures that static evaluations miss, demonstrated across domains including medical triage.
tldr_zh: ProofAgent Harness 是一个用于 AI 代理对抗性评估的开放基础设施，通过多轮对抗测试、对抗性评分和证据链接报告来检测静态评估遗漏的失败，并在医疗分诊等多个领域进行了验证。

title: RoboHitch: Learning Visual Affordance from Disordered Keypoints for Hitch Knots Tying
summary: Robotic manipulation of deformable linear objects (DLOs) presents significant challenges due to complex dynamics and frequent self-occlusions. Existing robotic knot tying methods typically rely on precise topological state tracking with ordered keypoints and explicit edge connectivity. This reliance makes them prone to failures due to tracking drift and topology mismatch caused by repeated bending and crossings during knot formation.To address these limitations, we introduce RoboHitch, a novel framework that learns to perform hitch knot tying from human demonstrations using only disordered 3D keypoints and RGB images. This eliminates the need for explicit topological order, allowing for more flexible manipulation. Our method employs a dynamic Graph Autoencoder to extract geometric features from untracked keypoints, complemented by a Convolutional Autoencoder that captures essential visual context. A bidirectional cross-attention mechanism then fuses these modalities to jointly predict pick and place affordances, facilitating implicit reasoning about the rope's state and enabling knot tying under occlusion.Real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our approach, successfully completing hitch knots in scenarios with self-occlusions.
summary_zh: 摘要：由于复杂的动力学特性和频繁的自遮挡，机器人操作可变形线性物体（DLOs）面临重大挑战。现有的机器人打结方法通常依赖于精确的拓扑状态跟踪，需使用有序关键点和显式边连接。这种依赖使其容易因跟踪漂移以及打结过程中反复弯曲和交叉导致的拓扑不匹配而失效。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了RoboHitch——一个新颖的框架，它能从人类演示中仅利用无序的3D关键点和RGB图像学习执行系结打结。这消除了对显式拓扑顺序的需求，实现了更灵活的操作。我们的方法采用动态图自编码器从未跟踪的关键点中提取几何特征，并辅以卷积自编码器捕获必要的视觉上下文。随后，双向交叉注意力机制融合这些模态，共同预测抓取与放置的可行性，从而隐式推理绳索状态，并实现遮挡下的打结。真实世界实验证明了我们方法的有效性和泛化能力，成功完成了存在自遮挡场景中的系结打结。
tldr: RoboHitch proposes a framework for robotic hitch knot tying using disordered 3D keypoints and RGB images, bypassing the need for explicit topological ordering by fusing geometric and visual features with cross-attention.
tldr_zh: RoboHitch 提出了一种使用无序3D关键点和RGB图像进行机器人打结的框架，通过交叉注意力融合几何和视觉特征，绕过了显式拓扑排序的需求。

title: EchoVQA: Enabling Conversational Assistance for Point-of-Care Cardiac Ultrasound
summary: Point-of-care transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) enables cardiac assessment in virtually any clinical setting, yet its diagnostic utility remains constrained by the expertise required for image acquisition and interpretation. Visual question answering (VQA) offers a promising paradigm for bridging this expertise gap through interactive clinical assistance, but existing echocardiography VQA datasets are limited in scale, restricted to high-quality images, and only cover a few views. We introduce EchoVQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset for echocardiography, comprising 14,299 images and 74,819 question-answer pairs. The dataset integrates public sources (EchoNet-Dynamic, CAMUS) with our own point-of-care acquisitions from two handheld probes (Lumify, Clarius), spanning diverse views and including both high-quality and suboptimal images. Uniquely, EchoVQA includes acquisition guidance questions to help users optimize transducer positioning toward a diagnostic apical 4-chamber view for left ventricular ejection fraction estimation -- a challenging task for novice operators in point-of-care settings. We further develop a parameter-efficient method based on multimodal learnable prompts achieving state-of-the-art performance on most benchmarks, including EchoVQA, with significantly less trainable parameters than existing state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_zh: 床旁经胸超声心动图（TTE）几乎可在任何临床环境中实现心脏评估，但其诊断效用仍受限于图像采集与解读所需的专业经验。视觉问答（VQA）提供了一种通过交互式临床辅助来弥合这一专业差距的有前景范式，但现有的超声心动图VQA数据集规模有限、仅局限于高质量图像，且仅覆盖少数切面。我们提出了EchoVQA，这是首个大规模超声心动图VQA数据集，包含14,299张图像和74,819个问答对。该数据集整合了公开来源（EchoNet-Dynamic、CAMUS）以及我们使用两种手持探头（Lumify、Clarius）自行采集的床旁数据，涵盖多种切面，并同时包含高质量和次优图像。独特之处在于，EchoVQA包含了采集指导性问题，旨在帮助用户优化探头定位，以获得用于左心室射血分数评估的诊断性心尖四腔心切面——这对于床旁环境中的新手操作者而言是一项具有挑战性的任务。我们进一步开发了一种基于多模态可学习提示的参数高效方法，在包括EchoVQA在内的大多数基准测试中达到了最先进性能，且其可训练参数远少于现有最先进方法。
tldr: EchoVQA introduces the first large-scale VQA dataset for echocardiography, including acquisition guidance questions, and proposes a parameter-efficient multimodal prompt method achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: EchoVQA 提出了首个大规模超声心动图 VQA 数据集，包含采集指导问题，并采用参数高效的多模态提示方法，在基准测试中达到最优性能。

title: HiMed: Incentivizing Hindi Reasoning in Medical LLMs
summary: Medical large language models hold promise for reducing healthcare disparities, yet Hindi remains severely underrepresented. While medical LLMs excel in high-resource languages, their performance degrades sharply in Hindi, particularly on Indian systems of medicine. We argue that robust cross-lingual medical transfer requires Hindi reasoning. To this end, we introduce HiMed, a Hindi reasoning medical corpus and benchmark suite covering both Western and Indian medicine. We further propose HiMed-8B, a Hindi-form medical reasoning LLM, through the design of decaying scaffolding reward. Extensive experiments demonstrate improvement in Hindi medical reasoning performance and reduction in the English--Hindi accuracy gap. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each training stage and reward component. All data and code are available on GitHub: https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HiMed.
summary_zh: 摘要：医学大语言模型有望减少医疗保健中的不平等现象，但印地语仍严重缺乏代表性。尽管医学大语言模型在高资源语言中表现出色，但在印地语中性能急剧下降，尤其是在印度传统医学体系中。我们论证了稳健的跨语言医学迁移需要印地语推理能力。为此，我们提出了HiMed——一个涵盖西方医学与印度医学的印地语推理医学语料库及基准测试套件。我们进一步通过设计衰减支架奖励机制，提出了HiMed-8B——一个印地语形式的医学推理大语言模型。大量实验表明，该模型在印地语医学推理性能上有所提升，并缩小了英语与印地语之间的准确率差距。消融实验验证了每个训练阶段和奖励组件的贡献。所有数据和代码均可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HiMed。
tldr: HiMed introduces a Hindi reasoning medical corpus and benchmark (HiMed) and a Hindi-form medical reasoning LLM (HiMed-8B) using decaying scaffolding reward to improve Hindi medical reasoning and reduce the English-Hindi accuracy gap.
tldr_zh: HiMed 引入了一个印地语推理医学语料库和基准（HiMed），以及一个印地语医学推理大语言模型（HiMed-8B），通过衰减脚手架奖励来提升印地语医学推理性能并缩小英印精度差距。

title: OmniEgo-R$^2$: A Routed Reasoning Framework for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026
summary: The 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis, CVPR 2026 evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over egocentric videos across surgery, industry, extreme sports, and animal perspective. We achieved second place in both the Source-Limited and Open-Source tracks. In this report, we formulate EgoCross as a robust cross-domain embodied video reasoning problem rather than a simple multiple-choice visual question answering task. We identify three key challenges: (C1) temporal boundary ambiguity, where critical state transitions are sparsely sampled and often occur between frames; (C2) cross-domain semantic granularity mismatch, where the same capability requires different domain-specific visual grammar; and (C3) decision instability under close options, where long multimodal reasoning can select unsupported distractors or produce malformed outputs. To address them, we propose OmniEgo-R$^2$ (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning), a unified routed reasoning pipeline consisting of temporal-evidence normalization, domain-agnostic capability routing, structured perception--dynamics--decision reasoning, boundary-aware option verification, and defensive answer calibration. OmniEgo-R$^2$ uses the Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT checkpoints on each EgoCross domain as the visual-language backbone, and wraps them with lightweight test-time reasoning and parsing programs. Our final submissions obtain 66.35% overall accuracy in the Source-Limited track and 66.77% in the Open-Source track, ranking second in both leaderboards.
summary_zh: 摘要：在CVPR 2026 EgoVis举办的首届跨域EgoCross挑战赛中，旨在评估多模态大语言模型能否对涵盖手术、工业、极限运动及动物视角的自我中心视频进行推理。我们在“有限源”和“开源”两个赛道均获得第二名。本报告中，我们将EgoCross定义为一个稳健的跨域具身视频推理问题，而非简单的多项选择视觉问答任务。我们识别出三个关键挑战：(C1) 时间边界模糊性，即关键状态转换采样稀疏且常发生于帧间；(C2) 跨域语义粒度不匹配，即相同能力需要不同领域特定的视觉语法；(C3) 近似选项下的决策不稳定性，即长程多模态推理可能选中无依据的干扰项或产生畸形输出。为此，我们提出OmniEgo-R²（全域自我中心路由推理），一种统一的路由推理流程，包含时间证据归一化、域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动力学-决策推理、边界感知选项验证及防御性答案校准。OmniEgo-R²以每个EgoCross领域上的Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT检查点作为视觉语言主干，并通过轻量级测试时推理与解析程序进行封装。最终提交结果在有限源赛道取得66.35%总体准确率，开源赛道取得66.77%，在两个排行榜均位列第二。
tldr: This paper presents OmniEgo-R², a routed reasoning framework for cross-domain egocentric video reasoning, achieving second place in the CVPR 2026 EgoCross Challenge across surgery, industry, sports, and animal domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出OmniEgo-R²，一种用于跨领域第一人称视频推理的路由推理框架，在CVPR 2026 EgoCross挑战赛中（涉及手术、工业、极限运动及动物视角）获得第二名。

title: MDIA: A Multi-Agent Diagnostic Intelligence Pipeline on HealthBench Professional
summary: Most reported gains on agentic-LLM clinical benchmarks are often attributed to prompt engineering, yet our results suggest that larger improvements can come from architectural and engine-level design. We present MDIA, a Multi-agent Diagnostic Intelligence Agent implemented as a 7-node specialty-routed clinical reasoning graph, on the full HealthBench Professional benchmark (n = 525), on a non-fine-tuned LLM. MDIA achieves 0.6272 under OpenAI's GPT-5.4-2026-03-05, which is +3.72 pp above the performance of OpenAI's ChatGPT for Clinicians. The experimental work shows that performance lift is attributable to system architecture: specialty routing, multi-turn context preservation, drug-state safety gating, site-filtered search, length-aware synthesis, and engine-level reliability. These findings support the view that agentic clinical benchmark performance is shaped both by the underlying foundation model and the orchestration architecture. Nevertheless, we also noticed notable differences when using other models as a grader; in particular, when using Gemini 2.5 Pro, MDIA scored 0.6585, which suggests that the choice of grader is a source of variability. Robust evaluation of LLMs would therefore require assessment across several independent grader models.
summary_zh: 大多数关于智能体LLM临床基准测试的性能提升常被归因于提示工程，但我们的结果表明，更大的改进可来自架构和引擎级设计。我们提出了MDIA（多智能体诊断智能体），该智能体在非微调大语言模型上实现了7节点专业路由临床推理图，并在完整的HealthBench Professional基准测试（n=525）上进行评估。在OpenAI的GPT-5.4-2026-03-05模型下，MDIA达到0.6272分，比OpenAI的ChatGPT for Clinicians高出3.72个百分点。实验结果表明，性能提升归因于系统架构：专业路由、多轮上下文保留、药物状态安全门控、站点过滤搜索、长度感知合成以及引擎级可靠性。这些发现支持了以下观点：智能体临床基准性能既受底层基础模型影响，也受编排架构影响。然而，我们也注意到，使用其他模型作为评分模型时存在显著差异；特别是当使用Gemini 2.5 Pro时，MDIA得分为0.6585，这表明评分模型的选择是变异性来源之一。因此，对LLM的稳健评估需要跨多个独立评分模型进行评测。
tldr: MDIA is a 7-node multi-agent clinical reasoning architecture that outperforms prompt engineering approaches on HealthBench, demonstrating that system architecture (specialty routing, context preservation, safety gating) is a major driver of benchmark performance.
tldr_zh: MDIA 是一种7节点多智能体临床推理架构，在HealthBench上优于提示工程方法，表明系统架构（专业路由、上下文保留、安全门控）是基准性能的主要驱动因素。

title: SurgRFO: Foundation Model Based Compositional Synthesis of Critical Retained Foreign Objects in Intraoperative Chest X-rays
summary: Critical retained foreign objects (RFOs) on intraoperative chest radiographs are rare but high-risk events. Their scarcity limits robust automated detection model training and generalization. We introduce SurgRFO, a two-stage synthesis framework for generating realistic RFO-present intraoperative chest X-rays. In Stage 1, a Roentgen chest X-ray foundation model is fine-tuned on surgical-domain images to generate realistic RFO-free backgrounds that preserve anatomy, indwelling lines and tubes, and intraoperative imaging characteristics. In Stage 2, a lightweight generator trained on localized RFO patches from limited positive cases synthesizes diverse RFO instances, which are composited onto generated backgrounds using conditional Poisson fusion to improve photometric consistency. We evaluate SurgRFO through (i) a blinded clinician study assessing realism and clinical plausibility, and (ii) downstream detection experiments in which synthesized data are used to augment Faster R-CNN, YOLOv8, and RetinaNet. SurgRFO consistently improves sensitivity at low false-positive-per-image (FPPI) operating points on internal and external test sets. Clinician ratings indicate that the synthesized images achieve realism comparable to real intraoperative images. Ablation analyses further examine fusion strategies and synthesis scale. Ethical safeguards for synthetic surgical data are also discussed.
summary_zh: 术中胸片中残留异物（RFO）是罕见但高风险的临床事件。其稀缺性限制了稳健的自动化检测模型训练与泛化能力。我们提出SurgRFO——一种两阶段合成框架，用于生成逼真的术中胸片（含RFO）。第一阶段，对基于X光胸片的基础模型在手术域图像上进行微调，以生成不含RFO的逼真背景，同时保留解剖结构、留置管路和术中影像特征。第二阶段，利用从有限阳性病例中提取的局部RFO补丁训练轻量级生成器，合成多样化的RFO实例，并通过条件泊松融合将其合成到生成背景上，以提升光度一致性。我们通过以下方式评估SurgRFO：（i）评估真实性和临床合理性的盲法临床研究；（ii）下游检测实验，使用合成数据增强Faster R-CNN、YOLOv8和RetinaNet模型。SurgRFO在内部和外部测试集上的低假阳性率（FPPI）工作点持续提升了灵敏度。临床医生评级表明，合成图像达到了与真实术中图像相当的真实性。消融分析进一步探讨了融合策略和合成规模。本文还讨论了合成手术数据的伦理保障。
tldr: SurgRFO is a two-stage framework that uses a fine-tuned foundation model to generate realistic intraoperative chest X-rays without foreign objects, then composites synthetic retained foreign objects onto them via a lightweight generator and conditional Poisson fusion, improving downstream detection model sensitivity for these rare but critical events.
tldr_zh: SurgRFO是一个两阶段框架，先使用微调的基础模型生成无异物残留的真实术中胸部X光片，再通过轻量级生成器和条件泊松融合将合成的残留异物合成到背景上，从而提升下游检测模型对此类罕见但关键事件的灵敏度。

title: Parameter-Efficient VLMs for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy: Medical Image Generation and Clinical Visual Question Answering
summary: The major limitations of gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopy AI systems arise from a shortage of annotated data, strict privacy policies, and significant bottlenecks in conventional model fine-tuning. Such limitations impede the successful application of sophisticated AI models in clinical practice, particularly affecting the reliability and scalability of diagnosis. In this paper, we present a dual-pipeline PEFT model that addresses two fundamental problems: medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) and the generation of privacy-preserving synthetic data. For clinical VQA, we adopt the Florence-2 vision-language model. Leveraging PEFT enhances model interpretability while substantially reducing the computational cost of training. Simultaneously, we employ Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with Stable Diffusion 2.1 to generate high-quality GI images that enhance training databases without violating patient privacy. This research utilized the Kvasir-VQA dataset. Our Florence-2 VQA model achieved ROUGE-1 of 0.92, ROUGE-L of 0.91, and BLEU score improvements from 0.08 to 0.24. Fine-tuning on private datasets consistently showed better results than fine-tuning on public datasets. The rank-4 LoRA synthesis achieved optimal performance with a fidelity score of 0.290, an agreement score of 0.730, and a Frechet BiomedCLIP Distance (FBD) of 1450, reducing computational costs by almost 90 percent. This framework improves the clinical potential of AI in GI endoscopy. Compared to FLUX, MSDM, and Kandinsky 2.2, our model demonstrates superior FBD and strong semantic alignment. While other models lead in Fidelity or Agreement, our lower FBD indicates better image-text coherence. These results establish our approach as a robust solution for enhancing VQA and synthetic data generation in clinical AI.
summary_zh: 胃肠道内窥镜人工智能系统的主要局限性在于标注数据不足、严格的隐私政策以及传统模型微调中的显著瓶颈。这些限制阻碍了复杂人工智能模型在临床实践中的成功应用，尤其影响了诊断的可靠性和可扩展性。本文提出了一种双管道参数高效微调（PEFT）模型，用于解决两个基本问题：医学视觉问答（VQA）和隐私保护合成数据的生成。在临床VQA方面，我们采用了Florence-2视觉语言模型，利用PEFT增强了模型的可解释性，同时大幅降低了训练的计算成本。同时，我们采用低秩适应（LoRA）与稳定扩散2.1生成高质量胃肠道图像，在不违反患者隐私的情况下增强训练数据库。本研究使用了Kvasir-VQA数据集。我们的Florence-2 VQA模型达到了ROUGE-1为0.92、ROUGE-L为0.91，BLEU评分从0.08提升至0.24。在私有数据集上的微调效果始终优于在公开数据集上的微调。秩为4的LoRA合成实现了最优性能，保真度得分为0.290，一致性得分为0.730，弗雷歇生物医学CLIP距离（FBD）为1450，计算成本降低近90%。该框架提升了人工智能在胃肠道内窥镜中的临床潜力。与FLUX、MSDM和Kandinsky 2.2相比，我们的模型表现出更优的FBD和较强的语义对齐能力。虽然其他模型在保真度或一致性方面领先，但我们更低的FBD表明其图像-文本一致性更好。这些结果确立了我们的方法作为增强临床人工智能中VQA和合成数据生成的稳健解决方案。
tldr: This paper proposes a dual-pipeline parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) framework for GI endoscopy, combining Florence-2 for medical VQA and LoRA-adapted Stable Diffusion for privacy-preserving synthetic image generation, achieving strong performance on the Kvasir-VQA dataset with significantly reduced computational cost.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于胃肠道内窥镜的双管道参数高效微调（PEFT）框架，结合Florence-2进行医学视觉问答和LoRA适配的Stable Diffusion进行隐私保护合成图像生成，在Kvasir-VQA数据集上实现了强劲性能并大幅降低了计算成本。

title: From Theory to Decision Rule: Calibrating the Noisy-Label Crossover for Vision-Language Model Weak Supervision Across Three Medical-Imaging Benchmarks
summary: Classical noisy-label theory predicts that downstream performance under weak supervision is bounded above by the labeler's accuracy, implying a sharp crossover: once a gold-trained classifier matches the labeler, weak labels stop helping and start hurting. The prediction is theoretical; what is missing is a benchmark calibration that turns it into an instance-level statement for modern foundation-model labelers. We provide such a calibration for BiomedCLIP-generated weak labels on three medical-imaging benchmarks (PCAM, ISIC, NIH-CXR) and six downstream architectures spanning an 11x parameter range. The crossover predicted by theory appears at ng~100 on PCAM, 20-50 on ISIC, and 250-500 on NIH-CXR; weak labels above the crossover degrade AUC by up to -0.10. The location is architecture-invariant for four of five pretrained architectures, and a within-family DenseNet sweep (2.5x parameters, identical pretraining) supports the view that the labeler, not the student, is the dominant constraint. The calibration in turn produces a decision rule operable from 10-20 gold labels: compare gold-only AUC to VLM accuracy on the user's gold set. A structured-vs-random noise sign flip on NIH-CXR shows that the rate-only formulation of the bound is incomplete and identifies a concrete refinement (label-space projection) that future benchmarks can be designed to test.
summary_zh: 经典噪声标签理论预测，在弱监督下的下游性能以标注者的准确率为上界，这意味着一个尖锐的交叉点：一旦金标训练的分类器达到与标注者相同的水平，弱标签便不再有益，反而开始有害。该预测是理论性的；当前缺失的是将其转化为针对现代基础模型标注者的实例级表述所需的基准校准。我们针对BiomedCLIP生成的弱标签，在三个医学影像基准（PCAM、ISIC、NIH-CXR）以及跨越11倍参数范围的六种下游架构上提供了这样的校准。理论预测的交叉点出现在：PCAM上约ng~100，ISIC上20-50，NIH-CXR上250-500；超过交叉点的弱标签会使AUC最多降低-0.10。对于五种预训练架构中的四种，交叉点位置与架构无关；而同一族内的DenseNet扫描（参数范围2.5倍，预训练方式相同）支持了这样的观点：标注者（而非学生模型）是主导约束因素。该校准进而产生了一条可在10-20个金标样本下操作的决策规则：比较仅使用金标的AUC与用户金标集上VLM的准确率。NIH-CXR上的结构噪声与随机噪声符号翻转表明，该边界的仅基于比率的表述是不完整的，并指出了具体的改进方向（标签空间投影），未来可设计基准对其进行测试。
tldr: This paper empirically calibrates the theoretical noisy-label crossover for BiomedCLIP-generated weak labels on three medical imaging benchmarks, finding architecture-invariant crossover points and deriving a practical decision rule using only 10-20 gold labels.
tldr_zh: 本文在三个医学影像基准上实证校准了BiomedCLIP生成的弱标签的理论噪声标签交叉点，发现交叉点具有架构不变性，并推导出仅需10-20个金标准标签的实用决策规则。

title: Calibrating Probabilistic Object Detectors with Annotator Disagreement
summary: High degrees of disagreement among annotators can exist for ambiguous objects, e.g. in medical images, underscoring the challenges of establishing ground truth annotations in object detection tasks. Despite this, all existing object detectors implicitly require access to ground truth annotations for either training or evaluation. The fundamental questions we target are: How can we learn an object detector with multiple annotators' annotations but without objective ground truth annotations due to object ambiguity, and how can we enable the learned detector to express meaningful model predictive uncertainties in detecting ambiguous objects? To answer these questions, we present an interpretable approach to calibrate probabilistic object detectors, where the calibration goal is to align the class confidence and bounding box variance estimates to the annotators' annotation distribution. We introduce an efficient yet effective framework to calibrate probabilistic object detectors by designing four evaluation metrics to measure calibration errors regarding classification and localization, and proposing a train-time calibration and post-hoc calibrator, all without the need to access any ground truth. This framework is generalizable to many existing probabilistic object detectors, such as the YOLO families and two-stage detectors. Empirical results with real-world and synthetic datasets of medical and natural images demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed framework with three popular object detectors.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
对于存在歧义的物体（例如医学影像中的物体），标注者之间可能出现高度分歧，这凸显了在目标检测任务中建立真实标注所面临的挑战。尽管如此，现有的所有目标检测器在训练或评估时都隐式地需要访问真实标注。我们针对的基本问题是：如何在多个标注者的标注存在、但由于物体歧义而缺乏客观真实标注的情况下，学习一个目标检测器？又如何使学习到的检测器在检测歧义物体时能够表达有意义的模型预测不确定性？为回答这些问题，我们提出了一种可解释的方法来校准概率目标检测器，其校准目标是将类别置信度和边界框方差估计与标注者的标注分布对齐。我们引入了一个高效且有效的框架来校准概率目标检测器，该框架通过设计四个评估指标来衡量分类和定位的校准误差，并提出了训练时校准和后处理校准器，所有这些都不需要访问任何真实标注。该框架可推广到许多现有的概率目标检测器，例如YOLO家族和两阶段检测器。在包含真实世界和合成数据集的医学与自然图像上的实验结果表明，所提出的框架在三种流行的目标检测器上均表现出优越的性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework to calibrate probabilistic object detectors by aligning class confidence and bounding box variance with multiple annotators' distributions, eliminating the need for ground truth annotations, and demonstrates effectiveness on medical and natural image datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种校准概率目标检测器的框架，通过将类别置信度和边界框方差与多个标注者的分布对齐，无需真实标注，并在医学和自然图像数据集上验证了有效性。

title: Learning, locomotion, and navigation of soft synthetic snakes in three-dimensional, heterogeneous environments
summary: Limbless terrestrial animals exhibit exceptional locomotor versatility and control, currently unmatched by engineered counterparts. Here, we introduce a computational framework that enables soft synthetic snakes to navigate unstructured, heterogeneous 3D terrains. Our approach is grounded in bio-inspired actuation and sensing models that reduce the control complexity inherent to high-degree-of-freedom, continuum bodies. These models are integrated into a reinforcement learning architecture to derive environment-traversing policies. Training first occurs in simplified, homogeneous terrains to learn locomotion primitives. These are then composed into adaptive strategies for complex landscapes. We demonstrate robustness by deploying a snake in high-fidelity 3D environments reconstructed from real-world imaging, achieving reliable navigation. Overall, this work provides a physically-realistic simulation platform and practical insights for the control of continuum systems in natural terrains.
summary_zh: 摘要：无肢陆地动物展现出卓越的运动多样性与控制能力，目前尚无工程学对应物可与之匹敌。本文提出一种计算框架，使软体合成蛇能够在无结构、异质的三维地形中导航。该方法基于仿生驱动与感知模型，降低了高自由度连续体固有的控制复杂度。将这些模型融入强化学习架构，以推导穿越地形的策略。首先在简化的均质地形中进行训练，学习运动基元，随后将其组合为适应复杂地形的自适应策略。通过将蛇部署在由真实世界成像重建的高保真三维环境中，我们验证了其鲁棒性，实现了可靠导航。总体而言，本工作为自然地形中连续体系统的控制提供了物理真实的仿真平台及实用见解。
tldr: This paper presents a computational framework for soft synthetic snakes that combines bio-inspired actuation and sensing models with reinforcement learning to navigate complex 3D terrains, demonstrating robustness in high-fidelity environments reconstructed from real-world data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种计算框架，将仿生驱动和传感模型与强化学习相结合，使软体合成蛇能够在复杂的3D地形中导航，并在从真实世界数据重建的高保真环境中展示了鲁棒性。
