在结构化环境中运行的LLM智能体失败方式更偏向操作层面而非对话层面，其可靠性取决于对环境的程序性知识。先前的自我改进方法在积累自然语言指导时，并未验证每条新内容是否保留先前正确行为，因此修复某条轨迹的记录可能无声地倒退另一条轨迹。我们提出GRASP（门控回归感知技能提议器），该方法将智能体改进视为对有限技能库的一系列编辑操作，仅在候选技能通过硬性回归预算约束下、对平衡保留测试集产生净改进时，才予以接纳。我们在两个基于FHIR的临床基准上，对五种基础模型（gpt-oss-120b、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、GPT-4.1、GPT-5.4）评估了GRASP。在MedAgentBench上，GRASP将gpt-oss-120b从40.6%提升至88.8%，超出五个自我改进基线中最强者21.0个百分点，并将其他所有基础模型提升17.2至40.3个百分点。消融实验表明，性能提升归因于比较性提议生成、接纳门控机制和硬性回归预算，而非技能编写本身——未经验证的技能编写与不使用技能相比毫无优势。该机制可推广至临床领域之外，在四个非临床环境中的三个上提升了智能体性能，仅在行动空间开放的环境中持平。冻结的技能库可在模型间迁移，其中来自较强模型的技能能使较弱执行器超越其自主学习能力，反之则不成立，这一非对称性未被任何无门控基线复现。
tldr: GRASP introduces a regression-aware skill proposer that ensures net improvement in LLM agents by accepting only skills that pass a hard regression budget, achieving significant gains on clinical and other benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GRASP 提出了一种具有回归意识的技能提议器，通过仅接受通过硬性回归预算的技能来确保 LLM 代理的净改进，在临床及其他基准上取得了显著提升。

title: SURGENT: A Surgical Multi-Agent Assistance System Across the Perioperative Workflow
summary: The intricate nature of modern surgical care necessitates intelligent systems that can synthesize extensive patient records, support collaborative decision-making, and provide transparent, auditable reasoning across the entire perioperative workflow. Although web-based Large Language Models (LLMs) possess advanced reasoning capabilities, they are ill-equipped for surgical applications due to critical limitations: input length constraints, incomplete memory management, and limited traceability. To address this issue, we present SURGENT, a surgical multi-agent assistance system that combines a Tree-of-Thought planner, multi-department collaboration agents, and retrieval-augmented reasoning with clinical guidelines and biomedical literature. SURGENT features a novel memory design that manages both long-term patient histories and short-term working summaries, enabling more complete, contextualized, and consistent reasoning. Experimental evaluations across five key perioperative tasks - case analysis, surgical plan simulation, safety monitoring, complication risk assessment, and rehabilitation guidance - show that SURGENT outperforms baseline LLMs and existing medical multi-agent frameworks, yielding recommendations more closely aligned with patient histories. Ablation studies further highlight the advantage of DeepSeek as a locally deployable backbone model, enabling privacy-preserving deployment without reliance on centralized services. These results position SURGENT as a practical and trustworthy advancement toward intelligent, equitable, and secure surgical assistance systems.
summary_zh: 现代外科诊疗的复杂性要求智能系统能够综合处理海量患者记录、支持协作决策，并在整个围手术期工作流程中提供透明可溯的推理过程。尽管基于网络的大型语言模型具备高级推理能力，但由于输入长度限制、不完善的记忆管理以及有限的可追溯性等关键缺陷，它们难以适用于外科应用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SURGENT——一种外科多智能体辅助系统，该系统结合了思维树规划器、多科室协作智能体，以及基于临床指南和生物医学文献的检索增强推理。SURGENT采用创新的记忆设计，可同时管理长期患者病史和短期工作摘要，从而实现更完整、更具情境意识且更一致的推理。在五项关键围手术期任务（病例分析、手术方案模拟、安全监控、并发症风险评估及康复指导）上的实验评估表明，SURGENT优于基线大型语言模型及现有医学多智能体框架，其生成建议与患者病史的契合度更高。消融实验进一步凸显了DeepSeek作为本地可部署骨干模型在隐私保护部署方面的优势，无需依赖集中式服务。这些结果将SURGENT定位为迈向智能、公平且安全的外科辅助系统的实用可信进展。
tldr: SURGENT is a surgical multi-agent system that combines a Tree-of-Thought planner, multi-department collaboration agents, and retrieval-augmented reasoning with a novel memory design to improve perioperative decision-making, outperforming baseline LLMs and existing medical multi-agent frameworks.
tldr_zh: SURGENT是一个手术多智能体系统，结合了思维树规划器、多部门协作智能体和检索增强推理，并采用新颖的记忆设计来改善围手术期决策，在多项任务上优于基线大语言模型和现有医疗多智能体框架。

title: SafeRx-Agent: A Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Safe and Explainable Medication Recommendation
summary: Medication recommendation predicts medications for patient visits, but existing methods still face two key challenges. At the model level, traditional drug recommendation methods only predict structured drug codes with limited evidence grounding, while LLM agents can use richer clinical context but may lack safety verification and traceability. At the task level, existing benchmarks often use broad medication categories, which ignore subgroup-level safety differences and can lead to risk overestimation. We introduce the first fine-grained medication recommendation setting based on fourth-level ATC code generation. We propose Safe Prescription Agent (SafeRx-Agent), a knowledge-grounded multi-agent framework that uses patient context, external clinical knowledge, and safety verification to recommend traceable medication sets. Experimental results on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets show that SafeRx-Agent improves fine-grained medication prediction accuracy while controlling drug interactions, contraindications, and medication set size.
summary_zh: 药物推荐旨在预测患者就诊时的用药方案，但现有方法仍面临两个关键挑战。在模型层面，传统药物推荐方法仅能预测结构化的药物代码且依据有限，而大语言模型智能体虽可利用更丰富的临床上下文，却可能缺乏安全验证与可追溯性。在任务层面，现有基准测试常使用宽泛的药物类别，忽略了亚组层面的安全性差异，可能导致风险高估。我们提出了首个基于四级ATC代码生成的细粒度药物推荐设定，并设计了Safe Prescription Agent（SafeRx-Agent）——一个基于知识的智能多智能体框架，通过结合患者上下文、外部临床知识与安全验证，推荐可追溯的药物组合。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验结果表明，SafeRx-Agent在提升细粒度药物预测准确性的同时，有效控制了药物相互作用、禁忌症及药物组合规模。
tldr: SafeRx-Agent introduces a fine-grained medication recommendation framework using multi-agent LLMs with clinical knowledge grounding and safety verification, achieving improved prediction accuracy and safety on MIMIC datasets.
tldr_zh: SafeRx-Agent 提出了一个基于多智能体大语言模型的细粒度药物推荐框架，结合临床知识基础和安全性验证，在 MIMIC 数据集上实现了更高的预测准确性和安全性。

title: DefSynUS: Real-time Patient-specific Intrahepatic Vessel Identification via Deformation-Aware CT-US Domain Adaptation
summary: Purpose: Laparoscopic ultrasound (LUS) enhances the safety of liver surgery by visualizing intrahepatic vessels in real-time. Still, vessel identification remains difficult due to probe constraints, complex vascular structure, and tissue deformation. This work aims to enable real-time, patient-specific vessel identification that remains robust under deformation through deformable ultrasound augmentation. Methods: Preoperative CT vessel annotations are used to generate synthetic ultrasound data via optimized physics-based rendering, coupled with domain adaptation to intraoperative ultrasound. The rendering is trained end-to-end for vessel identification and patient-specificity, eliminating the need for preoperative ultrasound. A deformation-aware augmentation simulates realistic intraoperative motion and tissue deformation within the rendering pipeline. Results: In abdominal phantom and limited clinical feasibility experiments (single-case clinical evaluation), the framework achieved real-time intrahepatic vessel-branch identification, maintaining performance under new patient poses. Conclusion: The framework enables real-time vessel identification without preoperative ultrasound and supports technical feasibility, but multi-patient validation is still needed for generalizability and clinical feasibility.
summary_zh:
摘要：
目的：腹腔镜超声（LUS）通过实时可视化肝内血管提高肝脏手术的安全性。然而，由于探头限制、复杂血管结构与组织变形，血管识别仍然困难。本研究旨在通过可变形超声增强，实现实时、患者特异性且能够在变形条件下保持鲁棒性的血管识别。方法：利用术前CT血管标注，通过优化的基于物理的渲染生成合成超声数据，并结合域适应技术适配术中超声。渲染过程经过端到端训练，实现血管识别与患者特异性，无需术前超声。在渲染流程中引入变形感知增强，模拟术中的真实运动与组织变形。结果：在腹部体模及有限临床可行性实验（单病例临床评估）中，该框架实现了肝内血管分支的实时识别，并在新患者体位下保持性能。结论：该框架无需术前超声即可实现实时血管识别，验证了技术可行性，但其普适性与临床可行性仍需多患者验证。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for real-time, patient-specific intrahepatic vessel identification in laparoscopic ultrasound by generating synthetic ultrasound from preoperative CT via deformation-aware domain adaptation, achieving robustness to tissue deformation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个框架，通过术前CT生成合成超声并利用变形感知领域自适应，实现腹腔镜超声中实时、患者特异性的肝内血管识别，对组织变形具有鲁棒性。

title: Robust Cross-Domain Generalization Using Unlabeled Target Data with Source-Domain Supervision
summary: It is often desirable to generalize medical imaging AI models trained with dense annotations to data acquired from different ultrasound scanners or clinical sites; however, retraining these models with new annotations is often difficult and costly. We examine this challenge in pediatric wrist fracture assessment using point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS), where fractures are common and can be effectively triaged via ultrasound. AI has shown radiologist-level performance for fracture detection, often aided by high-quality bony structure segmentation. However, due to significant domain shifts, models perform poorly on data from other centers or probes, and obtaining segmentation labels across devices is impractical due to manual annotation effort and data privacy concerns. To address this, we propose a target-informed self-supervised pretraining and model-ensemble strategy. Specifically, our approach combines masked image modeling (MIM) and contrastive learning to learn target-domain structural representations without labels, and introduces a confidence-aware infusion head to adaptively integrate predictions. The source dataset, collected with a Philips Lumify probe, contained dense labels, while the target dataset, acquired with a TeleMED portable probe, was unlabeled. The datasets were kept strictly separate throughout the entire process. Our method used labeled source data for supervised training and leveraged target-domain pretraining to improve generalization. On 318 images from 62 pediatric POCUS videos, this approach significantly improved cross-device performance, achieving over 6% Dice improvement on the target domain versus the baseline. These results demonstrate a label-efficient and privacy-preserving approach for cross-device-robust ultrasound AI, offering a framework that can be extended to multi-center studies or federated learning setups.
summary_zh: 摘要：将具有密集标注的医学影像AI模型泛化到来自不同超声设备或临床中心的数据通常是有益的；然而，使用新标注重新训练这些模型往往困难且成本高昂。我们在儿童腕部骨折评估中利用床旁超声（POCUS）探讨了这一挑战——骨折在此类场景中常见，且可通过超声有效分诊。AI已在骨折检测中展现出放射科医生级别的性能，这通常得益于高质量的骨骼结构分割。然而，由于显著的领域偏移，模型在其他中心或探头的数据上表现欠佳，而由于人工标注工作量与数据隐私问题，跨设备获取分割标注不切实际。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种目标信息引导的自监督预训练与模型集成策略。具体而言，我们的方法结合了掩码图像建模（MIM）和对比学习，无需标签即可学习目标域的结构表示，并引入了一个置信度感知融合头来自适应地整合预测结果。源数据集（使用Philips Lumify探头采集）包含密集标注，而目标数据集（使用TeleMED便携式探头采集）则为无标注数据。在整个过程中，两个数据集严格保持分离。我们的方法使用带标签的源数据进行监督训练，并利用目标域预训练来提升泛化能力。在来自62个儿童POCUS视频的318张图像上，该方法显著改善了跨设备性能，与基线相比，目标域上的Dice系数提升了超过6%。这些结果表明，这是一种标签高效且保护隐私的跨设备鲁棒超声AI方法，所提供的框架可扩展至多中心研究或联邦学习设置中。
tldr: This paper proposes a target-informed self-supervised pretraining and model-ensemble strategy (combining masked image modeling and contrastive learning) to improve cross-device generalization of ultrasound fracture detection models without requiring target-domain labels, achieving over 6% Dice improvement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种目标域自监督预训练与模型集成策略（结合掩码图像建模和对比学习），在不需目标域标签的情况下提升超声骨折检测模型跨设备泛化能力，在目标域上Dice提升超过6%。

title: BCER Agent: Reliable Long-Horizon MRI Workflow Execution via Compilation, Artifact Binding, and Bounded Local Recovery
summary: Many recent medical VLM and agent studies are benchmarked on 2D images or comparatively short tool-calling exchanges, whereas real MRI analysis typically demands long, interdependent pipelines that operate on 3D/4D volumetric data. Under these conditions, reactive tool-calling agents are prone to cascading breakdowns triggered by faulty intermediate references, mismatched tool arguments, and limited control over cross-step dependencies. To address this, we introduce BCER (Brain-Cerebellum-Extremity-Reflector), a controller architecture aimed at dependable long-horizon MRI workflow execution. BCER decouples high-level planning from execution and provides bounded local recovery. We assess BCER on a multi-organ MRI benchmark covering brain, prostate, and cardiac tasks with both short- and long-chain workflows, using matched task contracts across controller variants and several backbone models. Relative to reactive baselines, BCER yields consistent improvements in end-to-end execution, with the most pronounced gains observed on long-chain workflows. BCER additionally enables auditability by maintaining explicit links between final outputs and intermediate artifacts and measurements. Code and benchmark are released at https://github.com/Albertlongzi/BCER.
summary_zh: 许多近期的医学视觉语言模型（VLM）与智能体研究均基于2D图像或相对较短的工具调用交互进行基准测试，而实际的MRI分析通常需要处理3D/4D体积数据的长程、相互依赖的流水线。在此类条件下，反应式工具调用智能体容易因错误的中间引用、不匹配的工具参数以及对跨步骤依赖关系控制不足而引发级联故障。为解决这一问题，我们提出BCER（大脑-小脑-肢体-反射器），一种旨在可靠执行长程MRI工作流的控制器架构。BCER将高层规划与执行解耦，并提供有界局部恢复能力。我们在涵盖脑部、前列腺和心脏任务的多器官MRI基准上评估了BCER，测试了短链和长链两种工作流，并采用跨控制器变体和多种骨干模型的匹配任务契约。与反应式基线相比，BCER在端到端执行上取得了一致的改进，其中在长链工作流上的增益最为显著。此外，BCER通过维护最终输出与中间产物及测量值之间的显式链接，实现了可审计性。代码和基准测试已在 https://github.com/Albertlongzi/BCER 发布。
tldr: BCER introduces a controller architecture for dependable long-horizon MRI workflow execution that decouples high-level planning from execution and provides bounded local recovery, showing consistent improvements over reactive baselines, especially on long-chain tasks.
tldr_zh: BCER 提出了一种用于可靠长程 MRI 工作流执行的控制器架构，将高层规划与执行解耦并提供有界局部恢复，在长链任务上相比反应式基线有一致改进。

title: Lensless wide-field 3D fiber endoscopy through scattering media using synthetic wavelength holography
summary: Minimally invasive imaging with fiber optic endoscopes is crucial for in vivo visualization of tissue morphology, particularly because visualizing structural changes in tissue can support applications such as the early diagnosis of tumors. However, the imaging performance of conventional fiber endoscopes is limited when additional scattering layers are present between the target and the distal end of the endoscope. This limitation is particularly relevant in biomedical settings, where targets such as early stage lesions are obscured by scattering tissue. To address this challenge, we present a lensless endoscopic imaging approach based on synthetic wavelength holography (SWH). SWH is a computational imaging technique in which two optical fields acquired at closely spaced wavelengths are combined to synthesize a field at a longer synthetic wavelength. As the field at the longer synthetic wavelength is less sensitive to path length perturbations, this approach can enable endoscopic recovery of holographic information despite modal scrambling within the fiber and scattering in the intervening tissue. In addition, because the synthetic field is assembled from scattered optical fields with larger optical étendue, our approach can extend the endoscopic field of view (FoV) beyond that set by the numerical aperture of the fiber. In this paper, we present the first demonstration of an SWH-based lensless endoscope using a multicore multimode fiber. We experimentally recover three-dimensional images of objects hidden behind single scattering layers and through real biological tissue, with a spatial resolution of $\approx 500~μm$. We further demonstrate recovery of object information over an extended FoV of 46° without any distal optics. These results suggest a practical path toward extending fiber endoscopy for wide-field, three-dimensional imaging through scattering media.
summary_zh: 摘要：利用光纤内窥镜进行微创成像对于组织形态的体内可视化至关重要，尤其是因为可视化组织结构变化可以支持诸如肿瘤早期诊断等应用。然而，当目标与内窥镜远端之间存在额外的散射层时，传统光纤内窥镜的成像性能会受到限制。这一局限性在生物医学环境中尤为突出，因为诸如早期病变等目标会被散射组织遮挡。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于合成波长全息术（SWH）的无透镜内窥镜成像方法。SWH是一种计算成像技术，它将两个在相邻波长下获取的光场进行组合，以合成一个更长合成波长的光场。由于较长合成波长的光场对光程扰动不敏感，该方法能够在光纤内的模式串扰和中间组织散射的情况下，实现全息信息的内窥镜恢复。此外，由于合成光场是由具有更大光学扩展量的散射光场组合而成，我们的方法能够将内窥镜视场（FoV）扩展到光纤数值孔径所设定的范围之外。在本文中，我们首次展示了基于SWH的无透镜内窥镜，其使用多芯多模光纤实现。我们实验性地恢复了隐藏在单次散射层后方以及穿透真实生物组织的物体三维图像，空间分辨率约为500微米。我们进一步展示了在无任何远端光学元件的情况下，在46°的扩展视场上恢复物体信息的能力。这些结果表明，通过散射介质实现宽场三维成像的光纤内窥镜扩展技术具有实际应用前景。
tldr: This paper presents a lensless endoscopic imaging method using synthetic wavelength holography to achieve wide-field 3D imaging through scattering media, demonstrated with a multicore multimode fiber and showing 500 μm resolution and a 46° field of view without distal optics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于合成波长全息术的无透镜内窥镜成像方法，能够在散射介质中实现宽视场三维成像，通过多芯多模光纤进行实验验证，实现了约500微米的空间分辨率和46°扩展视场，且无需远端光学器件。

title: Treatment-Conditioned Diffusion for Forecasting Neurodegenerative Disease Progression
summary: Forecasting the progression of neurodegenerative diseases, such as Parkinson's disease, is essential for effective long-term planning and personalized therapeutic intervention. Existing systems typically produce scalar clinical scores that ignore the rich structure of longitudinal neuroimaging, while traditional generative approaches suffer from a loss of anatomical details and blurring subtle progression patterns. To address this, we introduce a novel treatment-conditioned diffusion framework that predicts high-fidelity future brain states by conditioning the generative process on patients' screening DaTscan images and levodopa equivalent daily dose over one year. The pipeline uses a Transformer-based encoder to represent non-linear, time-dependent pharmacological dynamics and optimizes generation through a multi-weight region-of-interest mask that focuses on biologically critical areas. Experimental evaluation shows that our framework maintains sharp anatomical boundaries and significantly improves clinical fidelity relative to the baseline, achieving 14.0% lower MSE, 7.2% lower MAE, and 4.9% higher SSIM.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
预测神经退行性疾病（如帕金森病）的进展对于有效的长期规划和个性化治疗干预至关重要。现有系统通常生成忽略纵向神经影像丰富结构的标量临床评分，而传统生成式方法则存在解剖细节丢失及细微进展模式模糊化的问题。为解决上述问题，我们提出一种新颖的治疗条件扩散框架，通过将生成过程条件化为患者一年内的筛查DaTscan图像和左旋多巴等效日剂量，从而预测高保真未来脑部状态。该流程采用基于Transformer的编码器来表征非线性、时间依赖的药理学动态，并通过多权重感兴趣区域掩膜聚焦于生物学关键区域以优化生成过程。实验评估表明，我们的框架保持了清晰的解剖边界，并显著提升了相对于基线的临床保真度，取得了MSE降低14.0%、MAE降低7.2%、SSIM提高4.9%的效果。
tldr: A treatment-conditioned diffusion framework that predicts high-fidelity future brain states for neurodegenerative disease progression, using DaTscan images and levodopa dosage, with a Transformer encoder and ROI mask, achieving significant improvements in MSE, MAE, and SSIM.
tldr_zh: 一种治疗条件扩散框架，用于预测神经退行性疾病进展的高保真未来脑状态，利用DaTscan图像和左旋多巴剂量，采用Transformer编码器和ROI掩码，在MSE、MAE和SSIM上取得了显著改进。

title: Towards the automated segmentation of epicardial and mediastinal fats: A multi-manufacturer approach using intersubject registration and random forest
summary: The amount of fat on the surroundings of the heart is correlated to several health risk factors such as carotid stiffness, coronary artery calcification, atrial fibrillation, atherosclerosis, cancer incidence and others. Furthermore, the cardiac fat varies unrelated to the overall fat of the subject, and, therefore, it reinforces the quantitative analysis of these adipose tissues as being essential. Clinical decision support systems are computer programs capable of evaluating information and providing a corresponding diagnosis or data to complement the physicists' analyses. The aim of this work is to propose a method capable of fully automatically segmenting two types of cardiac adipose tissues that stand apart from each other by the pericardium on CT images obtained by the standard acquisition protocol used for coronary calcium scoring. Much effort was devoted to promote minimal user intervention and ease of reproducibility. The methodology proposed in this work consists of a registration, which will roughly adjust input images to a standard, an extraction of features related to pixels and their surrounding area and a segmentation step based on data mining classification algorithms that define if an incoming pixel is of a certain type. Experimentations showed that the achieved mean accuracy for the epicardial and mediastinal fats was 98.4% with a mean true positive rate of 96.2%. In average, the Dice similarity index was equal to 96.8%.
summary_zh:
摘要：
心脏周围脂肪量与多种健康风险因素相关，如颈动脉僵硬、冠状动脉钙化、房颤、动脉粥样硬化、癌症发病率等。此外，心脏脂肪的变化与受试者的全身脂肪无关，因此，对这些脂肪组织进行定量分析显得尤为重要。临床决策支持系统是一类计算机程序，能够评估信息并提供相应的诊断或数据，以辅助物理师的分析。本研究旨在提出一种方法，能够基于用于冠状动脉钙化评分的标准采集协议获得的CT图像，全自动分割两种通过心包膜相互分隔的心脏脂肪组织。研究致力于最大程度减少用户干预并提高可重复性。所提出的方法包括：通过配准将输入图像大致调整至标准状态，提取与像素及其周围区域相关的特征，以及基于数据挖掘分类算法的分割步骤，该步骤判断输入像素是否属于特定类型。实验结果表明，心外膜和纵隔脂肪的平均准确率达到98.4%，平均真阳性率为96.2%，平均Dice相似指数为96.8%。
tldr: This paper proposes a fully automatic method for segmenting epicardial and mediastinal adipose tissues from CT images using inter-subject registration and random forest classification, achieving high accuracy (98.4% accuracy, 96.8% Dice similarity).
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种全自动方法，通过跨受试者配准和随机森林分类从CT图像中分割心外膜和纵隔脂肪组织，达到了高准确率（98.4%准确率，96.8% Dice相似度）。

title: Genetically Aligned Patient Representations Improve Hematological Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal alignment of histopathology encoders with transcriptomic and genomic data has been shown to significantly improve performance in downstream diagnostic tasks. Hematological cytology is unique in that visual single-cell evaluation is often paired with cytogenetics and molecular genetics for blood cancer diagnosis. In this study, we present a framework to align single white blood cell images with chromosomal aberrations (karyotype) and somatic mutations from targeted gene panels. Our training strategy follows a two-stage approach: (i) self-supervised, vision-only pretraining of a transformer aggregator using an iBOT head on a cohort of over 1500 patients, and (ii) genetic alignment via supervised contrastive loss on acute myeloid leukemia patients. Our genetically aligned patient encoder improves hematological diagnostic tasks, outperforming slide-level histopathology foundation models. Additionally, the model provides off-the-shelf retrieval capabilities for diseases and genetic alterations. Incorporating genetic data into patient encoders increases the quality of patient representations, providing a framework that aligns with clinical diagnostic workflows and paves the way for future multimodal hematology-specific AI. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/marrlab/GenBloom.
summary_zh: 摘要：将组织病理学编码器与转录组和基因组数据进行多模态对齐已被证明能显著提升下游诊断任务的性能。血液细胞学的独特之处在于，血液癌症诊断中通常将视觉单细胞评估与细胞遗传学和分子遗传学相结合。在本研究中，我们提出一个框架，用于将单个白细胞图像与染色体畸变（核型）及来自靶向基因 panels 的体细胞突变进行对齐。我们的训练策略采用两阶段方法：（i）在超过1500名患者的队列上，使用 iBOT 头部对 Transformer 聚合器进行自监督、仅视觉的预训练；（ii）通过针对急性髓系白血病患者的监督对比损失进行遗传对齐。经遗传对齐的患者编码器改善了血液学诊断任务，性能优于基于切片水平的组织病理学基础模型。此外，该模型为疾病和遗传改变提供了即用型检索能力。将遗传数据整合到患者编码器中提高了患者表征的质量，提供了一个与临床诊断工作流程一致性的框架，并为未来多模态血液学专用人工智能铺平了道路。代码和模型权重可在 https://github.com/marrlab/GenBloom 获取。
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage framework that aligns single white blood cell images with genetic data (karyotype and mutations) using self-supervised pretraining and supervised contrastive loss, improving hematological diagnostic tasks and outperforming slide-level foundation models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段框架，将单个白细胞图像与遗传数据（核型和突变）对齐，采用自监督预训练和监督对比损失，提升了血液学诊断任务性能，并超越了全切片级基础模型。

title: Pocket-Dentist: On-Device Dental Image Understanding via Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Evaluations of dental vision-language models remain fragmented across datasets, task definitions and metrics, and often ignore their computational cost. This limits their widespread deployment for dental screening outside specialist centres, where timely inference, limited hardware, and local handling of patient images are vital for practical, privacy-preserving clinical prescreening. Here we present Pocket-Dentist, an efficiency-aware benchmark for dental multimodal question answering that brings together three datasets spanning approximately 1,159 patients, five task types and seven metrics. Across typical 14 VLMs, our results reveals an interesting observation: compact VLMs (e.g., 2B-parameter models) outperform larger VLMs in accuracy while requiring substantially lower computational costs in dental image understanding. Deployed locally on an iPhone 17 Pro, our finetuned compact VLM Pocket-Dentist-2B processed each sample in 4.31 s, reducing latency by 4.9-fold and memory use by 2.3-fold compared with a 7B baseline.
summary_zh: 牙科视觉语言模型的评估在数据集、任务定义和指标上仍然零散，且常常忽略其计算成本。这限制了它们在专科中心之外的牙科筛查中广泛部署——而在这些场景中，及时推理、有限的硬件条件以及患者图像的本地处理对于实现实用且保护隐私的临床预筛查至关重要。在此，我们提出Pocket-Dentist，一个面向牙科多模态问答的效率感知基准，该基准整合了涵盖约1159名患者、五种任务类型和七项指标的三个数据集。在典型的14个视觉语言模型上，我们的结果揭示了一个有趣的现象：紧凑型视觉语言模型（例如2B参数模型）在牙科图像理解中不仅准确率超过较大模型，而且计算成本显著降低。在iPhone 17 Pro本地部署时，我们微调的紧凑型视觉语言模型Pocket-Dentist-2B处理每个样本仅需4.31秒，与7B基线模型相比，延迟降低4.9倍，内存使用减少2.3倍。
tldr: Pocket-Dentist introduces an efficiency-aware benchmark for dental multimodal question answering, showing that compact VLMs (e.g., 2B parameters) outperform larger models in accuracy while being computationally cheaper, and demonstrates deployment on an iPhone 17 Pro.
tldr_zh: Pocket-Dentist 提出了一个面向牙齿多模态问答的效率感知基准，证明紧凑型视觉语言模型（如2B参数）在准确率上优于更大模型且计算成本更低，并在iPhone 17 Pro上进行了部署演示。

title: Same Question, Different Source, Different Answer: Auditing Source-Dependence in Medical Multi-Source RAG
summary: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system deployed over a multi-author institutional corpus can give a different answer to the same question depending on which source it retrieves -- a failure mode the dominant single-gold-answer paradigm cannot diagnose. We argue that source-dependence is a missing axis of NLP evaluation, and that auditing it means shifting the unit of evaluation from answer correctness to the inter-source relationship. We make this concrete in transplant patient education, where institutional sources demonstrably disagree, releasing three artefacts: TransplantQA, a benchmark of real patient questions, each answered by grounding generation in multiple institutional handbooks as candidate sources; HERO-QA, a hierarchical retrieval strategy that grounds and audits each answer; and a structured-output judge that scores inter-source relationships on a validated 5-label taxonomy. At scale, better retrieval reveals far more disagreement than prior estimates suggested -- understating its prevalence, not its intensity. The framework is domain-agnostic and transfers to legal and educational RAG: measuring source-dependence is a responsibility for deployed multi-source NLP generally.
summary_zh: 部署在多作者机构语料库上的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，会根据其检索到的不同来源对同一问题给出不同答案——这种失效模式是当前占主导地位的单一黄金答案范式无法诊断的。我们认为源依赖性（source-dependence）是自然语言处理评估中缺失的一个维度，而对其进行审计意味着将评估单位从答案正确性转向来源间关系。我们在移植患者教育领域将这一观点具体化，该领域的机构来源之间存在明显分歧，并发布三项成果：TransplantQA，一个真实患者问题基准数据集，每个问题通过将生成过程基于多个机构手册作为候选来源来作答；HERO-QA，一种层级化检索策略，用于对每个答案进行基础生成和审计；以及一个结构化输出评判器，用于在经验证的5标签分类体系上对来源间关系进行评分。在规模化应用下，更好的检索揭示出的分歧远多于先前估计——低估了其普遍性，而非严重性。该框架是领域无关的，并适用于法律和教育领域的RAG：衡量源依赖性是一般性部署型RAG系统的责任。
tldr: This paper identifies source-dependence in multi-source RAG systems as a missing evaluation axis, and introduces benchmarks (TransplantQA, HERO-QA) and a judge for auditing inter-source disagreement in medical contexts, showing that retrieval improvements reveal more disagreement than previously estimated.
tldr_zh: 该论文指出多源RAG系统中的源依赖性是一个被忽视的评估维度，并引入了基准（TransplantQA、HERO-QA）和评估器，用于审计医学背景下源间的不一致性，发现更好的检索揭示了比先前估计更多的分歧。

title: Counterfactual Evaluation Reveals Hidden Capability Profiles in Clinical LLMs and Agents
summary: Two clinical AI systems can score nearly identically on coverage-based rubrics yet behave radically differently when their patient inputs change: one updates its recommendations to match the new clinical signal, while the other produces the same output regardless. We introduce the Causal Sensitivity Score (CSS), a pre-registered interventional metric that mutates oncology tumor-board cases along five clinically meaningful dimensions - biomarker flips, prior-treatment failures, biomarker removals, surgery-status changes, and stage perturbations - and scores whether each model updates its recommendations in the pre-registered correct direction using a {0, 0.5, 1.0} scale. Benchmarked against the Consensus Match Score (CMS), a coverage-based weighted recall metric, six frontier models from three labs evaluated in single-shot inference across 224 cases rank in nearly opposite orders: all six models change rank, the CMS-worst model becomes CSS-best, and one upper-mid CMS model ranks last on CSS. We further surface a universal safety blind spot: every frontier model fails on surgery-status interventions (at most 17.2% CSS on Family D), a finding CMS does not expose. The metric also transfers to tool-using agents: in a ReAct-style experiment, tool use improves CSS for five of six models (+2.5 to +20.3 percentage points), yet the lowest-CSS model retrieves the same chart sections and still fails to update its recommendations - revealing a structural responsiveness deficit visible only under counterfactual evaluation. Cross-judge replication and three-rater medical-professional validation confirm the aggregate findings. Interventional pre-registered metrics like CSS complement coverage-based evaluation for clinical AI agents: they capture responsiveness that coverage metrics miss and offer a candidate dense reward signal for future agentic RL systems.
summary_zh: 两个临床AI系统在基于覆盖率的评估标准上得分几乎相同，但当患者输入发生变化时，它们的行为却截然不同：一个会更新其建议以匹配新的临床信号，而另一个则无论输入如何都产生相同的输出。我们提出了因果敏感性评分（CSS），这是一种预先注册的干预性指标，它沿五个临床有意义的维度——生物标志物翻转、既往治疗失败、生物标志物移除、手术状态变化和分期扰动——对肿瘤多学科诊疗病例进行变异，并使用{0, 0.5, 1.0}的评分标准评估每个模型是否在预先注册的正确方向上更新其建议。以基于覆盖率的加权召回指标——共识匹配评分（CMS）为基准，来自三个实验室的六个前沿模型在单次推理中对224个病例的评估结果近乎完全相反的排序：所有六个模型排名均发生变化，CMS最差的模型成为CSS最佳模型，而一个CMS中上水平的模型在CSS中排名垫底。我们进一步揭示了一个普遍的安全盲点：每个前沿模型在手术状态干预上均失败（D族病例CSS最高仅为17.2%），而这一发现是CMS无法暴露的。该指标同样适用于使用工具的主体：在一个ReAct风格的实验中，工具使用提升了六个模型中五个的CSS（+2.5至+20.3个百分点），然而CSS最低的模型检索了相同的图表片段后仍未能更新其建议——这揭示了一种仅在反事实评估下才能显现的结构性响应缺陷。跨评判者的复现以及三位医学专业人员的验证确认了总体发现。像CSS这样的干预性预先注册指标补充了临床AI主体的基于覆盖率评估：它们捕捉了覆盖率指标遗漏的响应性，并为未来的主体强化学习系统提供了一种候选密集奖励信号。
tldr: Introduces the Causal Sensitivity Score (CSS) for counterfactual evaluation of clinical LLMs and agents, revealing hidden capability profiles that coverage-based metrics (e.g., CMS) fail to capture, including universal safety blind spots and structural responsiveness deficits.
tldr_zh: 提出了因果敏感性分数（CSS），用于对临床大语言模型和智能体进行反事实评估，揭示了覆盖率指标（如CMS）无法捕获的隐藏能力特征，包括普遍的安全盲点和结构性响应缺陷。

title: Shaft-integrated Force Sensing with Transformer-based Dynamics Compensation for Telesurgery
summary: Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery (RAMIS) enhances surgeon dexterity, with newer platforms leveraging haptic feedback to further improve performance. Such force information has broader potential to inform performance assessment, tactile localization, and surgical autonomy. This motivates the need for accessible approaches to integrating force sensing into RAMIS tools. This work presents a method for integrating a six-axis commercial force sensor into the distal end of a standard cable-driven surgical instrument, enabling end-effector force measurement while preserving the original mechanical functionality of the device. The proposed design emphasizes reproducibility and accessibility for research applications, requiring no specialized manufacturing tools. A transformer neural network integrates force sensor measurements with robot state information to aid estimation of applied forces at the end-effector, compensating for internal cable forces arising from actuation. Our proposed approach achieved normalized errors below 6%, and generalized to unseen conditions better than purely proximal data-driven sensing approaches. High internal cable forces caused sensor saturation and reduced axial force observability, which can degrade performance along the tool's major axis and under higher load conditions. Given current levels of performance, the balance of system integrability and performance enables applications and research into timely topics of haptic feedback, skill assessment, and force-informed autonomy in RAMIS. Videos and code are available at https://enhanced-telerobotics.github.io/shaft force sensing.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人辅助微创手术（RAMIS）提升了外科医生的操作灵活性，新一代平台利用触觉反馈进一步改善手术表现。此类力信息在绩效评估、触觉定位及手术自主性方面具有更广泛的应用潜力，这促使人们需要开发将力传感集成到RAMIS工具中的可行方法。本研究提出了一种方法，将六轴商用力传感器集成到标准缆线驱动手术器械的远端，从而在保持设备原有机械功能的同时实现末端执行器力测量。该设计强调面向研究应用的可重复性与可获取性，无需专用制造工具。采用变压器神经网络将力传感器测量值与机器人状态信息相结合，辅助估计作用于末端执行器的外力，并补偿驱动产生的内部缆线力。所提出的方法实现了低于6%的归一化误差，且在未见工况下的泛化能力优于纯近端数据驱动传感方法。高内部缆线力会导致传感器饱和并降低轴向力可观测性，从而在工具主轴方向及高负载条件下削弱性能。基于当前性能水平，系统集成性与性能的平衡使得RAMIS中触觉反馈、技能评估及力信息驱动的自主性等前沿课题的应用与研究成为可能。相关视频及代码见 https://enhanced-telerobotics.github.io/shaft force sensing。
tldr: This paper presents a method to integrate a six-axis commercial force sensor into the distal end of a cable-driven surgical instrument for robot-assisted telesurgery, using a transformer neural network to compensate for internal cable forces and achieve low-error end-effector force estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种将六轴商用力传感器集成至线驱手术器械远端的方法，利用Transformer神经网络补偿内部缆绳力，实现低误差的末端力估计，适用于远程手术机器人。

title: Astra: a generalizable report generation foundation model for 3D computed tomography
summary: CT interpretation requires radiologists to review hundreds of volumetric slices per examination, making reporting time-consuming and highly expertise-dependent. Automated CT report generation offers a promising route to improving clinical efficiency, yet the field still lacks a generalizable CT report generation foundation model that supports multi-region reporting and remains robust across external real-world cohorts. Intrinsic inconsistencies in reporting style and diagnostic terminology across cohorts make naive joint training prone to noisy textual supervision, thereby limiting model generalizability. Here we present Astra, a generalizable CT report generation foundation model trained on 90,678 thoracoabdominal CT-report pairs (CTRgDB) with 353,671 abnormalities spanning eight organ systems. By harmonizing report style and further refining diagnostic consistency via reinforcement learning, Astra achieves style-consistent and diagnostically accurate report generation across diverse anatomical regions and institutions. Evaluating on CTRgDB and six external cohorts, Astra achieves state-of-the-art performance with a 44.1% average improvement in fine-grained diagnostic metrics (P<0.001). In real-world clinical workflows, Astra assistance accelerates chest report drafting by 29.6% and improves abdominal report completeness by 11.3% (P<0.001). Furthermore, Astra also demonstrates broad utility as a foundation for CT AI development, improving downstream diagnostic performance and scaling vision-language pretrain through high-quality report synthesis. Overall, Astra serves as a broadly accessible clinical assistant and a pivotal infrastructure for the next generation of AI-powered healthcare.
summary_zh: CT解读需要放射科医师每次检查审阅数百个容积切片，导致报告撰写耗时且高度依赖专业知识。自动CT报告生成为提高临床效率提供了有前景的途径，但该领域仍缺乏支持多区域报告并在外部真实世界队列中保持稳健性的通用CT报告生成基础模型。不同队列间报告风格和诊断术语的内在差异使得简单的联合训练容易受到嘈杂的文本监督影响，从而限制了模型的泛化能力。本文提出Astra——一个基于90,678对胸腹部CT-报告配对（CTRgDB）、涵盖八个器官系统共353,671项异常的通用CT报告生成基础模型。通过协调报告风格并利用强化学习进一步优化诊断一致性，Astra能够针对不同解剖区域和机构生成风格一致且诊断准确的报告。在CTRgDB和六个外部队列上的评估显示，Astra在细粒度诊断指标上实现了平均44.1%的提升（P<0.001），达到当前最优性能。在实际临床工作流程中，Astra辅助将胸部报告草拟速度提升29.6%，并将腹部报告完整性提高11.3%（P<0.001）。此外，Astra作为CT人工智能开发的基础也展现出广泛实用性——通过高质量报告合成改善下游诊断性能并扩展视觉-语言预训练。总体而言，Astra可作为广泛适用的临床助手及下一代人工智能医疗的关键基础设施。
tldr: Astra is a generalizable CT report generation foundation model trained on 90,678 thoracoabdominal pairs, using style harmonization and reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art diagnostic accuracy across multiple cohorts, accelerating clinical reporting by ~30% and improving report completeness.
tldr_zh: Astra是一个在90,678对胸腹部CT报告上训练的可泛化CT报告生成基础模型，通过风格统一和强化学习实现跨多个队列的最先进诊断准确性，使临床报告速度提升约30%并提高报告完整性。

title: Generalistic or Specific Embeddings, Which is Better? An Empirical Study on Search for Clinical Coding in Non-English Languages
summary: Sentence-embedding models for semantic search are overwhelmingly developed and evaluated on English corpora. When applied to clinical retrieval in other languages -- particularly retrieval of ICD-10-CM / CIE-10 codes -- recall degrades in ways often masked by aggregate benchmarks. We study whether large generative language models can serve as data factories to close this gap. We build a two-stage retriever (bi-encoder followed by cross-encoder reranker), fine-tuned from a Spanish biomedical encoder (PlanTL-GOB-ES/bsc-bio-ehr-es) on Gemini-generated synthetic data covering English, Spanish, Catalan, Italian, Portuguese and French, and evaluate against BioBERT-ST and the un-tuned Spanish encoder. The bi-encoder alone matches BioBERT-ST on MRR (0.876 vs. 0.866) and overtakes it on R@3 (0.650 vs. 0.626) and R@5 (0.804 vs. 0.790) without English biomedical pretraining. Adding a cross-encoder reranker lifts aggregate R@5 to 0.822 and dominates on four of five languages (+0.017 Spanish, +0.033 Catalan, +0.018 French, +0.037 Portuguese) at the cost of a small English regression. The trade-off is clinically acceptable: Portuguese reaches R@5 = 0.829 vs. BioBERT-ST's 0.714. Contributions: an open recipe for building domain-specific medical retrievers from LLM-generated data; quantification of the learning gain (MRR 0.755 to 0.876, +15.9% with ~19,500 synthetic pairs); and a characterisation of where gains concentrate by language and rank.
summary_zh: 句子嵌入模型在语义搜索中的开发与评估 overwhelmingly 集中在英文语料上。当应用于其他语言的临床检索——尤其是ICD-10-CM/CIE-10代码检索时——召回率下降，这种下降往往被聚合基准所掩盖。我们研究大型生成语言模型能否作为数据工厂来弥合这一差距。我们构建了一个两阶段检索器（双编码器后接交叉编码器重排序器），基于Gemini生成的覆盖英语、西班牙语、加泰罗尼亚语、意大利语、葡萄牙语和法语的合成数据，对西班牙语生物医学编码器（PlanTL-GOB-ES/bsc-bio-ehr-es）进行微调，并与BioBERT-ST及未调优的西班牙语编码器进行对比。仅使用双编码器，在不依赖英文生物医学预训练的情况下，即在MRR（0.876 vs 0.866）上匹敌BioBERT-ST，并在R@3（0.650 vs 0.626）和R@5（0.804 vs 0.790）上超越后者。加入交叉编码器重排序器后，聚合R@5提升至0.822，并在五种语言中的四种上占据优势（西班牙语+0.017，加泰罗尼亚语+0.033，法语+0.018，葡萄牙语+0.037），仅以英语小幅回退为代价。这一权衡在临床上是可接受的：葡萄牙语的R@5达到0.829，而BioBERT-ST为0.714。贡献包括：一种基于大语言模型生成数据构建领域专用医学检索器的开放方案；学习增益的量化（MRR从0.755提升至0.876，利用约19,500个合成对实现+15.9%的增长）；以及按语言和排序位置对增益集中区域的刻画。
tldr: This paper investigates using large language models to generate synthetic training data for improving multilingual clinical code retrieval (ICD-10-CM) across Spanish, Catalan, Italian, Portuguese, and French, demonstrating that a fine-tuned bi-encoder plus cross-encoder reranker outperforms English-pretrained baselines on most languages.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了使用大语言模型生成合成训练数据，以改进多语言临床代码检索（ICD-10-CM），涵盖西班牙语、加泰罗尼亚语、意大利语、葡萄牙语和法语，结果表明微调的双编码器加交叉编码器重排序在大多数语言上优于基于英语预训练的基线模型。

title: Generating Reports or Repeating Templates? Measuring and Mitigating Template Collapse in 3D CT Report Generation
summary: Modern 3D medical vision-language models (VLMs) can generate fluent radiology-style text while exhibit critically low pathology detection and output diversity, collapsing to generic templates that under-report rare yet critical findings. We identify this failure mode as Template Collapse. This failure stems from the unique constraints of 3D medical imaging, e.g., limited data, severe label imbalance, and weak signals from volumetric encoders. Under these constraints, text-generation objectives encourage shortcut learning and fluent but weakly grounded reports. We systematically diagnose the Template Collapse through clinical fidelity, output diversity, normal-template bias, and rare-finding survival. To mitigate it, we propose CLarGen, a decoupled framework that separates what to say (clinical detection) from how to say it (language synthesis). CLarGen uses (i) a Latent Query Transformer for multi-label pathology detection, (ii) pathology-guided retrieval for clinically matched exemplars, and (iii) a medical language model to synthesize the final report from detected findings and retrieved context. Across state-of-the-art 3D CT report generation baselines, CLarGen mitigates Template Collapse and substantially improves clinical accuracy (macro-F1 0.487 vs. 0.189; CRG 0.472 vs. 0.368) while maintaining fluent reporting. Our results suggest that explicit, measurable clinical grounding is essential for template-collapse-resistant 3D CT report generation. Code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 现代三维医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够生成流畅的放射学风格文本，但展现出极低的病理检测能力和输出多样性，会坍缩为通用模板，从而低估罕见但关键的发现。我们将这种失效模式称为“模板坍缩”。该失效源于三维医学成像的独特约束，例如数据有限、标签严重不平衡以及体素编码器的弱信号。在这些约束下，文本生成目标鼓励捷径学习以及流畅但缺乏充分依据的报告。我们从临床保真度、输出多样性、正常模板偏差以及罕见发现的存留等方面对模板坍缩进行了系统诊断。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了CLarGen——一种解耦框架，将“说什么”（临床检测）与“怎么说”（语言合成）分离。CLarGen采用：(i) 潜在查询变换器进行多标签病理检测，(ii) 病理引导的检索以获取临床匹配范例，以及(iii) 医学语言模型根据检测到的发现和检索到的上下文合成最终报告。在最新的三维CT报告生成基线中，CLarGen缓解了模板坍缩，并在保持报告流畅性的同时显著提升了临床准确性（宏F1 0.487 vs. 0.189；CRG 0.472 vs. 0.368）。我们的结果表明，明确且可测量的临床基础对于抗模板坍缩的三维CT报告生成至关重要。代码将在接收后发布。
tldr: This paper identifies 'Template Collapse' in 3D CT report generation, where models produce generic templates that miss rare findings, and proposes CLarGen, a decoupled framework that separates pathology detection from language synthesis to improve clinical accuracy and diversity.
tldr_zh: 本文识别了3D CT报告生成中的“模板崩溃”问题，即模型生成通用模板而遗漏罕见发现，并提出了CLarGen框架，将病理检测与语言生成解耦，以提高临床准确性和多样性。

title: Automated Prediction of Postoperative Pancreatic Fistula Using Preoperative Computed Tomography
summary: Postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) is a serious complication after pancreatic resection, increasing morbidity, hospital stay, and healthcare costs. We present an automatic, end-to-end deep learning pipeline-from pancreatic segmentation to classification-for preoperative POPF risk estimation and stratification using preoperative CT scans. A data set with auto-segmented pancreas volumes and surgical outcomes was used to evaluate multiple architectures, including a custom lightweight 3D CNN baseline (CNN3D), R(2+1)D ResNet-18, and ResNet-MC3-18 models. Evaluation across multiple 3D architectures demonstrated promising predictive performance. This approach offers a clinically valuable tool and a methodological benchmark for pancreas-specific CT classification, supporting improved preoperative decision-making in pancreatic surgery.
summary_zh: 术后胰瘘（POPF）是胰腺切除术后的一种严重并发症，会增加发病率、住院时间和医疗费用。我们提出了一种自动化的端到端深度学习流程——从胰腺分割到分类——利用术前CT扫描进行术前POPF风险估计与分层。使用包含自动分割胰腺体积及手术结果的数据集，评估了多种架构，包括自定义轻量级3D CNN基线模型（CNN3D）、R(2+1)D ResNet-18和ResNet-MC3-18模型。对多种3D架构的评估展现了良好的预测性能。该方法为胰腺特异性CT分类提供了具有临床价值的工具和方法学基准，有助于改善胰腺手术的术前决策。
tldr: The paper presents an end-to-end deep learning pipeline that automatically segments the pancreas from preoperative CT scans and predicts the risk of postoperative pancreatic fistula, evaluating multiple 3D CNN architectures.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种端到端的深度学习流程，能够从术前CT扫描中自动分割胰腺并预测术后胰瘘风险，评估了多种3D CNN架构。

title: A Context-Aware Middleware for Medical Image Based Reports: An approach based on image feature extraction and association rules
summary: This work proposes a context-aware middleware for medical workflow organization and efficiency improvement. In hospitals, laboratories and teleradiology companies, each physician or technician is specialized in a specific kind of diagnosis or analysis. Therefore, certain types of medical images are often forwarded to a certain physician or a certain group. This forwarding is time consuming. That is, repeatedly deciding who would be the best physician, whether he is available at a certain moment given a certain context is exhaustive and may be very inefficient. Thus, the proposed middleware has the ability to process and collect data from images analyzed by each medical staff. Based on the collected data and current clinical context, the middleware is able to infer who would be the best fit staff to receive a certain incoming medical image.
summary_zh: 本工作提出了一种上下文感知中间件，用于优化医疗工作流程并提升效率。在医院、实验室和远程放射学公司中，每位医生或技术人员均专精于特定类型的诊断或分析。因此，某些类型的医学影像常被转送至特定医生或特定团队。这一转送过程耗时且效率低下——即反复判断最佳接诊医生、考量其在特定上下文中的实时可用性，既耗精力又可能效率极低。为此，所提出的中间件能够处理并收集每位医务人员分析图像的数据。基于所收集的数据及当前临床上下文，该中间件可推断出最适合接收特定传入医学影像的医务人员。
tldr: This paper proposes a context-aware middleware that uses image feature extraction and association rules to automatically route medical images to the most appropriate physician, aiming to improve workflow efficiency in hospitals and teleradiology.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种上下文感知中间件，利用图像特征提取和关联规则，自动将医学图像分配给最合适的医生，旨在提高医院和远程放射学的工作流程效率。

title: Healthcare Mechanisms from Policy-as-Code Search under Strategic Provider Response
summary: Healthcare mechanisms are inseparable from the strategic provider response they induce: existing healthcare AI benchmarks hold this response fixed and so cannot evaluate mechanisms by the equilibrium they produce. We recast hospital mechanism design as program synthesis for language models: typed, inspectable rule programs are executed and scored by Medi-Sim, a multi-agent simulator with five strategic provider channels (coding, selection, delay, effort, triage). An incentive sweep recovers classical health-economics findings as adjacent regimes -- up-coding and low-complexity-patient selection under profit pressure, and Goodhart-style drift where measured performance becomes anti-correlated with true outcomes -- and a single audit lever exposes pressure migration: closing the coding channel more than doubles low-complexity selection. LLM-guided evolutionary code search over the same rule-program space then synthesizes an inspectable mixed-objective program that eliminates up-coding, halves rejection, and retains most of the profit-oriented baseline's funds.
summary_zh: 医疗机制与其所引发的策略性提供者反应密不可分：现有的医疗AI基准测试将这种反应固定不变，因此无法通过它们产生的均衡来评估机制。我们将医院机制设计重新表述为语言模型的程序合成：通过Medi-Sim（一个具备编码、选择、延迟、努力、分诊五种策略性提供者通道的多智能体模拟器）执行并评分可类型化、可检查的规则程序。激励扫描恢复了经典健康经济学中的相邻制度发现——利润压力下的向上编码与低复杂度患者选择，以及古德哈特式漂移（测量绩效与实际结果呈反相关）。单一审计杠杆揭示了压力转移：关闭编码通道会使低复杂度患者选择增加一倍以上。随后，在同一规则程序空间中进行的LLM引导进化代码搜索合成了一种可检查的混合目标程序，该程序消除了向上编码，拒绝率减半，并保留了大部分以利润为导向的基线资金。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for hospital mechanism design using policy-as-code search, where strategic provider responses are modeled in a multi-agent simulator (Medi-Sim) with five channels, and LLM-guided evolutionary search synthesizes inspectable rule programs that eliminate up-coding and reduce rejection while retaining funds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于策略即代码搜索的医院机制设计框架，通过多智能体模拟器（Medi-Sim）对战略提供者反应进行建模，并利用LLM引导的进化搜索合成可检查的规则程序，消除编码升级并减少拒绝，同时保留资金。

title: Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident visual answers even when the required visual evidence is missing, blank, or unrelated to the question. This failure mode, known as mirage (Asadi et al. 2026), is especially concerning in medical and document visual question answering, where plausible but visually ungrounded responses may be mistaken for image-based evidence. We study pre-release mirage detection: given an image-question pair, the goal is to determine whether a VLM should answer or abstain before producing a response. We propose Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), a model-agnostic method that probes patch-token representations across the layers of a CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder. TC-LIA projects layer-wise image patch tokens into the final CLIP embedding space and measures their similarity to the question embedding, allowing the method to track whether question-relevant visual evidence emerges across vision layers. The resulting alignment trajectory is summarized using final image-text cosine similarity, late-layer top-k patch-text alignment, early-to-late gain, and layer-wise slope. These features are combined with pixel-statistic blank/noise detection, zero-shot domain routing, and structured VLM self-assessment in an ensemble. Across five VQA domains, three input conditions, and twelve VLM backbones, the best systems achieve approximately 94.6-94.7% three-class detection accuracy with mirage rates below 3%, while baseline mirage rates range from 21.7% to 66.6%.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
视觉语言模型（VLM）即便在所需视觉证据缺失、空白或与问题无关时，仍可能给出看似可信的视觉答案。这种被称为“幻象”（mirage，Asadi et al. 2026）的失效模式，在医学和文档视觉问答中尤为令人担忧，因为看似合理但缺乏视觉依据的回答可能被误认为基于图像的证据。我们研究预发布阶段的幻象检测：给定一个图像-问题对，目标是在VLM生成回答前判断其应作答还是弃权。我们提出文本条件逐层内部对齐（Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment, TC-LIA），这是一种与模型无关的方法，通过探测CLIP ViT-H/14视觉编码器各层的补丁-令牌表示来工作。TC-LIA将逐层的图像补丁令牌投影到最终CLIP嵌入空间中，并度量它们与问题嵌入的相似性，从而追踪与问题相关的视觉证据是否在视觉各层出现。所得到的对齐轨迹通过最终图像-文本余弦相似度、后期层top-k补丁-文本对齐、早期到后期增益以及逐层斜率进行总结。这些特征与基于像素统计的空白/噪声检测、零样本领域路由以及结构化的VLM自评估相结合，构成集成系统。在五个VQA领域、三种输入条件和十二个VLM骨干网络上，最佳系统实现了约94.6-94.7%的三类检测准确率，幻象率低于3%，而基线幻象率范围在21.7%至66.6%之间。
tldr: This paper proposes TC-LIA, a model-agnostic method that probes CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder layers to detect when VLMs produce confident but visually ungrounded answers (mirage) before generation, achieving high accuracy across multiple VQA domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TC-LIA方法，通过探测CLIP ViT-H/14视觉编码器各层的补丁标记表示，在生成答案前检测视觉语言模型何时产生自信但缺乏视觉依据的回答（幻象），在多个VQA领域实现了高精度。

title: AutoIQ: An Ensemble Framework for Automatic Assessment of Geometric Distortion in Prostate Diffusion-Weighted Imaging
summary: Geometric distortion in prostate diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) can impair lesion localization and reduce the reliability of MRI-based clinical assessment. We propose AutoIQ, an ensemble machine learning framework for automatic quantification and classification of DWI geometric distortion severity. A total of 140 retrospective prostate biparametric MRI examinations were analyzed, including 33 scans with severe distortion requiring repeat acquisition and 107 scans with acceptable distortion based on expert radiologist assessment. AutoIQ combines two complementary distortion quantification strategies: a segmentation-based method measuring prostate boundary mismatch between T2-weighted imaging (T2WI) and DWI, and a registration-based method estimating deformation magnitude after DWI-to-T2WI alignment. The resulting distortion scores were used to train individual classifiers and a logistic-regression ensemble model. Both computational methods significantly differentiated severe from acceptable distortion cases (p < 0.001). On an independent test set, the ensemble model achieved an accuracy of 0.95, F1-score of 0.93, and AUC of 0.98, outperforming individual models. These results suggest that AutoIQ can provide automated, quantitative quality assessment for prostate DWI and may help identify scans that require repeat acquisition.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
前列腺弥散加权成像（DWI）中的几何形变可能损害病灶定位，并降低基于MRI的临床评估的可靠性。我们提出AutoIQ，一种用于自动量化与分类DWI几何形变严重程度的集成机器学习框架。共分析了140例回顾性前列腺双参数MRI检查，其中包括33例因严重形变而需要重复采集的扫描，以及107例基于放射科专家评估认为形变可接受的扫描。AutoIQ结合了两种互补的形变量化策略：基于分割的方法，测量T2加权成像（T2WI）与DWI之间前列腺边界的不匹配程度；以及基于配准的方法，估计DWI与T2WI对齐后的形变幅度。所得形变分数用于训练个体分类器及一个逻辑回归集成模型。两种计算方法均能显著区分严重形变与可接受形变病例（p < 0.001）。在独立测试集上，集成模型达到了0.95的准确率、0.93的F1分数及0.98的AUC，优于各单独模型。这些结果表明，AutoIQ能够为前列腺DWI提供自动化的定量质量评估，并可能有助于识别需要重复采集的扫描。
tldr: AutoIQ is an ensemble machine learning framework that automatically quantifies and classifies geometric distortion severity in prostate diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) using segmentation-based and registration-based methods, achieving high accuracy (0.95) and AUC (0.98) on an independent test set.
tldr_zh: AutoIQ 是一个集成机器学习框架，通过基于分割和配准的方法自动量化并分类前列腺弥散加权成像（DWI）中的几何变形严重程度，在独立测试集上达到 0.95 的准确率和 0.98 的 AUC。

title: Pre-Deployment Robustness Stress Testing for CT Segmentation Systems Using Clinically Motivated Multi-Corruption Augmentation
summary:
Deep learning-based CT segmentation systems often achieve high accuracy on clean benchmark images, but their performance may degrade under heterogeneous clinical imaging conditions such as noise, resolution loss, contrast variation, intensity shift, and artifacts. This instability can limit reliable deployment in real-world medical imaging workflows.
  We propose Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline (RAMP), a robustness-oriented augmentation framework for CT segmentation. RAMP combines anatomically constrained spatial perturbations, CT intensity transformations, and stochastic multi-corruption composition to expose models to clinically plausible image degradation during training.
  Across two CT segmentation evaluation settings, RAMP achieved the strongest corrupted-image performance and the smallest clean-to-corrupted robustness gap. In the five-organ noisy evaluation benchmark, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.610 to 0.753 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.264 to 0.064 compared with the nnU-Net baseline. In Abdomen1K, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.633 to 0.789 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.290 to 0.070. Although RAMP did not achieve the highest clean-image Dice, it substantially mitigated worst-case segmentation collapse under severe image degradation.
  These results suggest that multi-corruption augmentation can serve as a practical pre-deployment strategy for improving the reliability of CT segmentation systems in heterogeneous clinical environments.
summary_zh:
基于深度学习的CT分割系统在干净的基准图像上通常能达到较高精度，但在噪声、分辨率损失、对比度变化、强度偏移和伪影等异构临床成像条件下，其性能可能会下降。这种不稳定性可能限制其在真实医疗影像工作流程中的可靠部署。

我们提出了RAMP（通过增强多损坏管道实现鲁棒性），一种面向鲁棒性的CT分割增强框架。RAMP结合了解剖约束的空间扰动、CT强度变换以及随机多损坏组合，使模型在训练过程中能够接触到临床可行的图像退化。

在两个CT分割评估场景中，RAMP均达到了最强的损坏图像性能，并实现了最小的清洁到损坏鲁棒性差距。在五器官噪声评估基准中，相比nnU-Net基线，RAMP将平均损坏Dice从0.610提升至0.753，并将鲁棒性差距从0.264降至0.064。在Abdomen1K数据集中，RAMP将平均损坏Dice从0.633提升至0.789，鲁棒性差距从0.290降至0.070。虽然RAMP未取得最高的清洁图像Dice，但它显著缓解了严重图像退化下的最坏情况分割崩溃。

这些结果表明，多损坏增强可作为一项实用的部署前策略，用于提高CT分割系统在异构临床环境中的可靠性。
tldr: Proposes RAMP, a multi-corruption augmentation pipeline for CT segmentation that improves robustness to clinical image degradations, reducing the clean-to-corrupted performance gap significantly.
tldr_zh: 提出RAMP，一种针对CT分割的多重损坏增强管道，能够提高对临床图像退化的鲁棒性，显著缩小干净到损坏的性能差距。

title: The Right Inference Strategy Is All You Need: Nearly Training-Free Domain-Wise Inference for EgoCross Challenge
summary: EgoCross evaluates multimodal large language models on egocentric video question answering under substantial domain shift, where test videos come from surgery, industrial assembly, extreme sports, and animal-mounted cameras rather than ordinary daily-life scenes. In the source-limited track, the base model is fixed to Qwen3-VL-4B, while the official task-specific support set contains only 20 training samples. This setting makes the challenge less about model scaling and more about exposing the right visual, temporal, and answer-selection cues to a constrained model. Our key observation is that the frozen baseline model is not simply incapable of these rare scenarios; rather, it often fails to transfer its existing visual-language knowledge to the new task format without an appropriate interface. We therefore use a domain-wise inference strategy that treats the four target domains separately and designs different input, prompting, and answer-mapping procedures according to each domain's task characteristics. These strategies make the rare egocentric scenes more interpretable to the VLM by emphasizing the cues that matter for each domain. The resulting system is nearly training-free: surgery, and animal questions are answered with the base Qwen3-VL-4B model, while XSports and industry use only the official SFT checkpoint trained for two epochs on the provided 20 training samples. On the final evaluation, this simple strategy reaches 66.98\% overall accuracy, suggesting that careful domain-aware inference can compensate for limited base-model strength and recover much of the ability already present in the baseline model.
summary_zh: EgoCross 在显著领域迁移场景下评估多模态大语言模型在自我中心视频问答任务中的表现，其中测试视频来自手术、工业装配、极限运动以及动物佩戴相机拍摄的场景，而非日常生活中的普通场景。在有限资源赛道上，基础模型固定为 Qwen3-VL-4B，而官方任务特定的支持集仅包含 20 个训练样本。这一设置使得挑战的重点不在于模型规模的扩展，而在于如何向受限模型暴露正确的视觉、时序及答案选择线索。我们的关键发现是：冻结的基线模型并非完全无法应对这些罕见场景，而是往往缺乏合适的接口来将其现有的视觉-语言知识迁移至新的任务格式。因此，我们采用了一种领域级别的推理策略，将四个目标领域分开处理，并根据每个领域的任务特性设计不同的输入、提示词及答案映射流程。这些策略通过强调每个领域的关键线索，使得罕见的自我中心场景对视觉语言模型更具可解释性。最终的系统几乎无需训练：手术和动物类问题直接使用基础 Qwen3-VL-4B 模型回答，而极限运动和工业类问题仅使用在提供的 20 个训练样本上训练了两个 epoch 的官方 SFT 检查点。在最终评估中，这一简单策略达到了 66.98% 的整体准确率，表明精心设计的领域感知推理可以弥补基础模型能力的不足，并恢复基线模型中已存在的大部分能力。
tldr: This paper describes a nearly training-free domain-wise inference strategy for egocentric video question answering under domain shift, achieving 66.98% accuracy by tailoring input, prompting, and answer-mapping to each domain (surgery, industry, extreme sports, animal) using a frozen Qwen3-VL-4B model with minimal fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种几乎无需训练的域感知推理策略，用于处理具身视频问答中的域偏移问题，通过针对手术、工业、极限运动和动物四个域分别设计输入、提示和答案映射，使用冻结的Qwen3-VL-4B模型仅微调少量样本就达到了66.98%的准确率。

title: Literary Emotions in Motion: A Soft Robotics Installation for Tactile Storytelling
summary: Soft robotics is increasingly explored in artistic contexts, where tactile interaction provides audiences with embodied engagement beyond visual or auditory signals. This work presents an interactive installation that maps semantic emotion analysis of narrative text into variable stiffness of soft pneumatic modules. A natural language model identifies two dominant emotions from a predefined set of six, driving the inflation of seven hexagonally arranged soft actuators. The central actuator represents the primary emotion, while the surrounding ones express the secondary. We develop and mechanically characterize silicone actuators, called soft modules, featuring a thin membrane layer, demonstrating how this morphological control expands the achievable stiffness range while preserving simplicity and low-cost fabrication. A user study with ten participants further evaluates how multisensory coupling of stiffness and LEDs intensity influences emotional perception. The results suggest that stiffness modulation accompanied by color change can support emotionally meaningful and engaging tactile interaction in soft robotic installations.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
软体机器人正越来越多地被应用于艺术领域，其中触觉交互能够为观众提供超越视觉或听觉信号的具身体验。本作品展示了一个交互装置，将叙事文本的语义情感分析映射到软体气动模块的变刚度中。一个自然语言模型从预设的六种情感中识别出两种主要情感，驱动七个呈六边形排列的软体致动器充气。中央致动器代表主要情感，而周围致动器表达次要情感。我们开发并机械表征了称为软体模块的硅胶致动器，其具有薄层薄膜结构，展示了这种形态控制如何在保持简单性和低成本制造的同时扩大可实现的刚度范围。一项包含十名参与者的用户研究进一步评估了刚度与LED强度的多感官耦合如何影响情感感知。结果表明，伴随颜色变化的刚度调制能够在软体机器人装置中支持富有情感意义且引人入胜的触觉交互。
tldr: This paper presents a soft robotic installation that maps emotional sentiment from narrative text to variable stiffness in pneumatic modules, using a hexagonal arrangement of actuators and a user study to evaluate multisensory emotional perception.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种软体机器人装置，将叙事文本的情感语义分析映射到气动模块的可变刚度，采用六边形排列的致动器，并通过用户研究评估多感官情感感知。

title: A Machine-to-Machine Knowledge-Guided LLM Agent for Generalizable Radiotherapy Treatment Planning
summary: In this work, we propose a prototype machine-to-machine (M2M) knowledge-guided Large Language Model (LLM) framework for automated radiotherapy treatment planning. In the proposed paradigm, Treatment Planning Parameter (TPP) distribution knowledge discovered by a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agent is transferred to an LLM agent through in-context learning, enabling autonomous iterative planning without human intervention. While standard LLM-based planning often lacks physical intuition and struggles with convergence, the integration of DRL-derived guidance constrains the agent to a physically valid parameter space. Experimental evaluations are performed across three diverse planning scenarios: basic prostate cases, complex prostate configurations with increased organ-at-risk (OAR) constraints, and liver cases. The evaluation results demonstrate that the guided LLM agent consistently achieves optimal planning scores while significantly reducing the number of iterations compared to unguided planning. Analysis of the final TPP configurations reveals that the agent successfully learns a hierarchical priority of objectives, effectively restoring a logical "cause-and-effect" relationship between parameter tuning and dosimetric outcomes. Crucially, this prototype framework exhibits robust generalizability, maintaining high planning quality regardless of specific patient anatomy, treatment site, or initial plan quality. By bridging the specialized optimization of DRL with the adaptive reasoning of LLMs, this M2M framework establishes a scalable foundation towards generalizable autonomous treatment planning, ultimately benefiting clinical practice in realistic environments.
summary_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种面向自动化放射治疗计划的原型机器间（M2M）知识引导大语言模型（LLM）框架。在该范式中，通过深度强化学习（DRL）智能体发现的治疗计划参数（TPP）分布知识，借助上下文学习迁移至LLM智能体，从而实现在无人工干预下的自主迭代计划制定。尽管基于LLM的标准规划往往缺乏物理直觉且收敛困难，但整合DRL衍生的引导信息可将智能体约束在物理有效的参数空间内。实验评估涵盖了三种不同规划场景：基础前列腺病例、伴随器官危及（OAR）约束增加的复杂前列腺配置，以及肝脏病例。评估结果表明，与无引导规划相比，引导式LLM智能体始终能达到最优规划评分，同时显著减少迭代次数。对最终TPP配置的分析显示，该智能体成功学习了目标的层级优先级，有效恢复了参数调优与剂量学结果之间的逻辑"因果关系"。关键的是，该原型框架展现出强大的泛化能力，无论患者解剖结构、治疗部位或初始计划质量如何，均能保持高规划质量。通过弥合DRL的专门优化与LLM的适应性推理之间的鸿沟，该M2M框架为迈向可泛化的自主治疗计划奠定了可扩展基础，最终将惠及现实环境中的临床实践。
tldr: A framework combining Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and Large Language Models (LLM) for automated radiotherapy treatment planning, achieving generalizability and efficiency by transferring DRL-derived knowledge to guide the LLM agent.
tldr_zh: 结合深度强化学习（DRL）和大型语言模型（LLM）的框架，通过将DRL导出的知识传递给LLM代理，实现自动化放射治疗计划，具有通用性和高效性。

title: CAREAgent: Clinical Agent with Structured Reasoning and Tool-Integrated for Order Generation
summary: Clinical order generation serves as a critical bridge between clinical decision-making and real-world practice, translating medical decisions into concrete and executable orders. Existing agents mainly focus on coarse-grained decisions and overlook the fine-grained, executable information required for clinical orders. To address this gap, we propose CAREAgent, an agent for clinical order generation. To support its training, we introduce a two-stage agentic reasoning data construction method. First, we design an agent framework that constructs verifiable reasoning trajectories aligned with realistic clinical tool usage. Second, we filter reasoning trajectories by format compliance, order validity, and clinical plausibility. Building on the constructed data, the model is first trained via supervised fine-tuning to acquire fundamental reasoning formats and medical knowledge, and is subsequently optimized through reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional reward functions to enhance complex clinical reasoning capabilities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CAREAgent. On ClinicalBench (unseen during training), CAREAgent improves the F1 score by 5.05%, 2.09%, and 0.86% over the single-agent, multi-agent, and agentic reasoning methods, respectively.
summary_zh: 摘要：临床医嘱生成是连接临床决策与实际操作的关键桥梁，将医疗决策转化为具体且可执行的医嘱。现有智能体主要关注粗粒度决策，忽视了临床医嘱所需的细粒度、可执行信息。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了CAREAgent，一种用于临床医嘱生成的智能体。为支持其训练，我们引入了一种两阶段智能体推理数据构建方法。首先，我们设计了一个智能体框架，构建与真实临床工具使用场景一致的可验证推理轨迹。其次，我们根据格式合规性、医嘱有效性和临床合理性对推理轨迹进行筛选。基于构建的数据，模型先通过监督微调获得基本推理格式和医学知识，随后通过多维奖励函数的强化学习进一步优化，以增强复杂临床推理能力。在多个基准测试上的实验证明了CAREAgent的有效性。在ClinicalBench（训练中未见数据）上，CAREAgent相较于单智能体、多智能体和智能体推理方法，F1分数分别提升了5.05%、2.09%和0.86%。
tldr: CAREAgent is a clinical agent for order generation that uses a two-stage data construction method (verifiable reasoning trajectories with tool use, then filtering) and trains via supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning, achieving improved F1 scores on ClinicalBench.
tldr_zh: CAREAgent是一个用于医嘱生成的临床代理，采用两阶段数据构建方法（结合工具使用的可验证推理轨迹，然后过滤），并通过监督微调加强化学习训练，在ClinicalBench上取得了改进的F1分数。

title: Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time RL for Dynamical Medical Treatment
summary: Dynamic medical treatment requires deciding treatment intensity and intervention timing, while patient states evolve continuously and adverse events may occur between clinical interactions. Most existing treatment learning methods assume fixed schedules or enforce safety only at discrete decision points. We propose Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning, a framework that jointly optimizes treatment administration and clinical interaction timing under trajectory-level safety constraints. Our key idea is to reformulate the continuous time treatment problem as an option-based semi-Markov decision process, where each option specifies a continuous-time treatment policy and its duration. We develop a safety-tightening mechanism showing that suitably constructed constraints at interaction times guarantee safety over the full continuous-time trajectory with high probability. We further establish finite-sample guarantees for policy learning from logged treatment trajectories and introduce a practical data-driven conservative surrogate. Experiments show that the proposed adaptive interaction-timing mechanism improves both safety and treatment effectiveness over equidistant interaction schemes across different safe policy optimization methods.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
动态医疗决策需要同时确定治疗强度与干预时机，而患者状态持续演变，且不良事件可能在临床交互间隔期间发生。现有大多数治疗学习方法假设固定调度机制，或仅在离散决策点强制实施安全性约束。本文提出交互受限的安全连续时间强化学习框架，该框架在轨迹级安全约束下联合优化治疗实施与临床交互时机。核心思路是将连续时间治疗问题重新表述为基于选项的半马尔可夫决策过程，其中每个选项定义了连续时间治疗策略及其持续时间。我们开发了一种安全收紧机制，证明了在交互时刻合理构造的约束能够以高概率保证整个连续时间轨迹的安全性。进一步，我们建立了从历史治疗轨迹进行策略学习的有穷样本保证，并引入了一种实用的数据驱动保守替代方法。实验表明，在不同安全策略优化方法中，所提出的自适应交互时机机制相较于等间隔交互方案，在安全性和治疗效果上均有提升。
tldr: This paper proposes a continuous-time reinforcement learning framework for dynamic medical treatment that jointly optimizes treatment intensity and clinical visit timing under trajectory-level safety constraints, using an option-based semi-MDP and a safety-tightening mechanism with theoretical guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于动态医疗治疗的连续时间强化学习框架，联合优化治疗强度与临床就诊时机，并在轨迹层面满足安全约束，采用基于选项的半马尔可夫决策过程和安全收紧机制，并提供了理论保证。

title: MedGym:A Unified Continuous-Time Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals. Existing RL formulations and simulated environments, however, are based on discrete-time MDP or POMDP abstractions with fixed or pre-specified decision intervals. Thus, it remains difficult to evaluate whether RL methods can handle time-interval-dependent disease progression, personalized treatment response, and safety between consecutive measurement points. To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation. MedGym models longitudinal patient evolution in a continuous-time framework and constructs a configurable medical RL benchmark from clinical data by using Physics-Informed Neural Networks. The resulting benchmark supports both offline and online RL, and enables direct comparison between discrete-time and continuous-time methods under irregular treatment timing and patient-specific dynamics. Besides, MedGym supports evaluation from clinically important perspectives, including personalization, trajectory-level safety, and the performance gap between model-based offline learning and online deployment. By providing a standardized and configurable benchmark for continuous-time dynamic treatment, MedGym aims to facilitate more realistic and informative evaluation of medical RL methods.
summary_zh: 医疗治疗推荐对强化学习（RL）提出了若干挑战：患者生理状态随时间连续变化，测量和干预以不规则的时间间隔进行，且治疗效果在个体间存在显著差异。然而，现有的RL框架和仿真环境均基于具有固定或预设决策间隔的离散时间MDP或POMDP抽象模型。因此，目前仍难以评估RL方法能否处理依赖时间间隔的疾病进展、个性化治疗反应以及连续测量点之间的安全性问题。为解决这一不足，我们提出了MedGym——一个用于动态治疗推荐的基准环境。MedGym在连续时间框架下对患者纵向演变进行建模，并利用物理信息神经网络从临床数据中构建了一个可配置的医疗RL基准。该基准同时支持离线RL和在线RL，并能够在不规则治疗时机和患者特异性动力学条件下，直接比较离散时间方法与连续时间方法。此外，MedGym还支持从临床重要角度进行评估，包括个性化、轨迹级安全性以及基于模型的离线学习与在线部署之间的性能差距。通过为连续时间动态治疗提供标准化且可配置的基准，MedGym旨在促进对医疗RL方法进行更真实、更具信息量的评估。
tldr: MedGym introduces a continuous-time benchmark for dynamic medical treatment RL, using Physics-Informed Neural Networks to model patient physiology from clinical data, supporting both offline and online RL with evaluations on personalization and safety.
tldr_zh: MedGym 提出了一个连续时间的医学治疗强化学习基准，利用物理信息神经网络从临床数据建模患者生理，支持离线与在线 RL，并评估个性化和安全性。

title: Med-HEAL: Analyzing and Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical LLMs with Hallucination-Aware In-Context Learning
summary:
Hallucinations in medical large language models (LLMs) pose serious risks for clinical decision support, particularly when models must reason over complex electronic health records (EHRs). However, existing benchmarks often lack a realistic clinical context and provide limited insight into how hallucinations can be mitigated in practice. We introduce Med-HEAL, a framework for systematically identifying, analyzing, and mitigating hallucinations in medical LLMs using clinically grounded data. Building on the EHRNoteQA benchmark derived from MIMIC-IV discharge summaries, we construct a hallucination dataset by evaluating BioMistral-7B on open-ended clinical question answering tasks. Model outputs are labeled through a dual evaluation pipeline that combines LLM-as-a-Judge assessment (GPT-4o) with human auditing by medical student reviewers, producing correctness judgments and annotations of reasoning errors via a custom web-based evaluation system.
  We then leverage this dataset to investigate mitigation strategies: a self-critique pipeline, in which the test model reviews its own answers to detect potential errors and regenerates responses for flagged cases, and retrieval-augmented in-context learning (RA-ICL), which exposes the model to hallucinated and corrected examples. Experiments across five open-source LLMs-BioMistral, Llama-3.1, DeepSeek, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3, show that the self-critique strategy improves accuracy for three of five models (p < 0.05) without requiring parameter updates.
  Med-HEAL provides both a reusable hallucination dataset and a practical framework for studying and mitigating hallucinations in medical LLMs, supporting safer deployment of AI systems in clinical environments. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/yimingliao-blad/med-heal.git.
summary_zh: 摘要：医疗大语言模型（LLMs）中的幻觉问题对临床决策支持构成了严重风险，尤其是当模型需要基于复杂的电子健康记录（EHRs）进行推理时。然而，现有基准测试通常缺乏真实的临床背景，且对如何在实践中缓解幻觉所提供的见解有限。我们提出了Med-HEAL，一个利用临床基础数据系统性识别、分析和缓解医疗LLMs中幻觉的框架。基于源自MIMIC-IV出院小结的EHRNoteQA基准，我们通过让BioMistral-7B执行开放式临床问答任务，构建了一个幻觉数据集。模型输出通过一个双评估流程进行标注，该流程结合了LLM作为评判者（GPT-4o）的评估与医学生评审员的人工审核，借助自定义的基于Web的评估系统生成正确性判断和推理错误注释。随后，我们利用该数据集研究缓解策略：自我批判流程——测试模型自行审查其答案以检测潜在错误，并对标记案例重新生成响应；以及检索增强的上下文学习（RA-ICL）——让模型接触幻觉示例和修正后的示例。在五个开源LLM（BioMistral、Llama-3.1、DeepSeek、Qwen2.5和Qwen3）上的实验表明，自我批判策略在无需更新参数的情况下，使五个模型中的三个准确性得到提升（p < 0.05）。Med-HEAL既提供了一个可复用的幻觉数据集，也为研究和缓解医疗LLMs中的幻觉提供了实用框架，支持AI系统在临床环境中更安全地部署。我们的代码和数据于https://github.com/yimingliao-blad/med-heal.git公开提供。
tldr: Med-HEAL introduces a systematic framework to detect, analyze, and mitigate hallucinations in medical LLMs by creating a clinically grounded hallucination dataset from EHRNoteQA and evaluating self-critique and retrieval-augmented in-context learning strategies across five open-source models, showing significant accuracy improvements for three of them.
tldr_zh: Med-HEAL提出了一个系统性框架，通过从EHRNoteQA构建临床驱动的幻觉数据集，并在五个开源模型上评估自我批评和检索增强上下文学习策略，来检测、分析和减轻医学大语言模型中的幻觉，结果显示其中三个模型的准确率显著提升。

title: PINNOCHIO: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Coupled Hyperelastic Interface-Volume Simulation in Orthognathic Surgery
summary: Predicting patient-specific facial soft-tissue deformation is critical for iterative orthognathic surgery planning. However, current computational methods face a strict accuracy-efficiency trade-off: high-fidelity Finite Element Methods (FEM) are computationally prohibitive, whereas pure deep learning models often produce biomechanically inconsistent results. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a promising avenue, learning the complex heterogeneous mechanics of bone--soft-tissue interactions with only partial clinical supervision (i.e., outer facial surfaces) remains highly unstable. To overcome these challenges, we present PINNOCHIO, a novel physics-informed framework for facial soft-tissue simulation. PINNOCHIO introduces a hybrid sequential decomposition that explicitly decouples discontinuous bone--soft-tissue interface movements from continuous volumetric hyperelastic deformation. This structural separation enables stable training and facilitates a physics-enabled sim-to-real adaptation strategy, ensuring internal biomechanical consistency without requiring volumetric ground truth. Evaluated on a 40-patient clinical cohort, PINNOCHIO outperforms existing baselines in both surface accuracy and physical validity. Furthermore, it achieves a substantial speedup over FEM, successfully resolving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off to provide a highly reliable and practical tool for interactive surgical planning.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
预测患者特异性面部软组织变形对于迭代式正颌外科手术规划至关重要。然而，当前计算方法面临着严格的精度-效率权衡：高保真有限元法计算成本过高，而纯深度学习模型常常产生不符合生物力学特性的结果。尽管物理信息神经网络提供了一条有前景的路径，但在仅有部分临床监督（即外表面数据）的情况下，学习骨-软组织相互作用的复杂异质力学特性仍高度不稳定。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PINNOCHIO——一种用于面部软组织模拟的新型物理信息框架。PINNOCHIO引入了一种混合序列分解方法，明确地将不连续的骨-软组织界面运动与连续的体积超弹性变形解耦。这种结构分离实现了稳定训练，并促进了基于物理的仿真到现实自适应策略，确保内部生物力学一致性，而无需体积真值数据。在包含40名患者的临床队列上进行评估，PINNOCHIO在表面精度和物理有效性方面均优于现有基线方法。此外，它相较于有限元法实现了显著加速，成功解决了精度-效率权衡问题，为交互式手术规划提供了高度可靠且实用的工具。
tldr: PINNOCHIO introduces a physics-informed neural network framework that decouples discontinuous bone-soft tissue interface movements from continuous volumetric hyperelastic deformation to enable accurate and efficient facial soft-tissue simulation for orthognathic surgery planning.
tldr_zh: PINNOCHIO提出了一种物理信息神经网络框架，将不连续的骨-软组织界面运动与连续的体积超弹性变形解耦，从而为正颌手术规划提供准确且高效的面部软组织模拟。

title: Closed-Form Pose Estimation of Endoluminal Medical Devices via Gradiometer-Based Electromagnetic Localization System
summary: Embedded magnetic tracking holds highly attractive prospects for remote navigation of endoluminal medical devices. However, existing six-degree-of-freedom pose recovery approaches often require pre-calibrated workspace field maps or iterative nonlinear optimization. This letter presents a Gradiometer-Based Electromagnetic Localization System (GELS), a closed-form tracking framework that uses a compact magnetometer array as an embedded quasi-gradiometer to estimate local magnetic fields and gradient tensors. These quantities are mapped by the Euler homogeneous relation to displacements between source and array, from which multi-source Procrustes registration recovers the array orientation and position using at least three non-collinear sources. The algorithm requires known source positions and array geometry, but no pre-calibrated workspace field maps, initial pose guesses, or calibrated excitation-source moments. The recovered pose also enables a proof-of-concept sub-level dipole localization task by serving as a mobile magnetic reference frame. Benchtop experiments across sensor-array configurations and excitation modes demonstrate sequence-averaged position errors of \SI{10.80}{\milli\meter}--\SI{15.57}{\milli\meter}, a fastest update rate of \SI{14.49}{\hertz}, and a median solver runtime of \SI{172.00}{\micro\second}. A perturbation-based error propagation analysis further identifies inter-sensor inconsistency and dipole-model mismatch as the dominant accuracy limits, thereby informing future sensor array and magnetic source design for further reducing pose-estimation error.
summary_zh: 嵌入式磁跟踪在腔内医疗器械的远程导航中具有极具吸引力的前景。然而，现有的六自由度位姿恢复方法通常需要预先校准的工作空间场图或迭代非线性优化。本文提出了一种基于梯度仪的电磁定位系统（GELS）——一种闭式跟踪框架，该框架使用紧凑的磁力计阵列作为嵌入式准梯度仪，以估计局部磁场和梯度张量。这些量通过欧拉齐次关系映射到源与阵列之间的位移，进而利用至少三个非共线源，通过多源Procrustes配准恢复阵列的方向和位置。该算法需要已知的源位置和阵列几何结构，但无需预先校准的工作空间场图、初始位姿猜测或校准的激励源磁矩。恢复的位姿还可作为移动磁参考框架，用于概念验证的子级偶极子定位任务。跨传感器阵列配置和激励模式的台架实验表明，序列平均位置误差为10.80毫米至15.57毫米，最高更新速率为14.49赫兹，求解器中位数运行时间为172.00微秒。基于扰动的误差传播分析进一步指出，传感器间不一致性和偶极子模型失配是主要的精度限制因素，从而为未来传感器阵列和磁源的设计提供指导，以进一步减小位姿估计误差。
tldr: This paper presents a closed-form, non-iterative pose estimation method for endoluminal medical devices using a compact magnetometer array as a quasi-gradiometer, eliminating the need for pre-calibrated field maps and achieving fast update rates with millimeter-level errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于腔内医疗设备的闭式位姿估计方法，利用紧凑型磁力计阵列作为准梯度计，无需预校准场图，实现快速更新率和毫米级误差。

title: Predicting the risk of colorectal anastomotic leak based on preoperative mapping of the blood supply of the bowel
summary: Anastomotic leak remains one of the most serious complications following colorectal cancer surgery, substantially affecting patient outcomes, recovery trajectories, and healthcare costs. Despite advances in imaging technology, current preoperative assessment relies only on clinical assessment, a process that is subjective, error-prone, and highly dependent on individual expertise. To date, no validated CT-based method exists to predict anastomotic leak risk prior to surgery. This protocol paper outlines a comprehensive framework for developing and validating an AI-driven system for preoperative risk assessment using pre- and post-contrast CT imaging. The study describes the stages of data collection, ethical handling, and preprocessing of patient data in accordance with GDPR, image preprocessing, and the exploration of deep learning architectures designed to generate clinically interpretable outputs. Two integrated tools constitute the main deliverables of this workflow: 1) a risk assessment module, which quantifies the likelihood of leakage by analyzing vascular and tissue features in CT scans, and 2) a Content-Based Medical Image Retrieval (CBMIR) module, which identifies and displays similar historical cases to support evidence-based surgical decision making. The protocol paper requires close collaboration between hospitals and universities; this protocol demonstrates that such a system is technically feasible and clinically implementable within existing healthcare infrastructures. By following the proposed methodological stages and regulatory principles, other institutions can reproduce this workflow to develop analogous decision-support tools. Ultimately, this interdisciplinary framework aims to enhance surgical planning, reduce leak incidence, and contribute to a broader paradigm shift toward explainable, data-driven precision surgery.
summary_zh: 吻合口漏仍然是结直肠癌术后最严重的并发症之一，显著影响患者预后、恢复轨迹及医疗成本。尽管影像技术有所进步，目前的术前评估仍仅依赖临床评估，该过程具有主观性、易出错且高度依赖个人经验。迄今为止，尚无经过验证的基于CT的方法可用于术前预测吻合口漏风险。本方案论文概述了一个全面的框架，旨在开发并验证一种基于对比增强CT影像的AI驱动系统，用于术前风险评估。研究描述了数据收集、伦理处理及根据通用数据保护条例规范对患者数据进行预处理、图像预处理，以及探索能够生成临床可解释输出的深度学习架构等阶段。该工作流程的主要交付成果包含两个集成工具：1）风险评估模块，通过分析CT扫描中的血管和组织特征来量化漏的发生概率；2）基于内容的医学图像检索模块，用于识别并展示相似历史病例，以支持循证外科决策。本方案需要医院与大学之间的紧密合作；该方案证明了此类系统在现有医疗基础设施中的技术可行性和临床可实施性。通过遵循所提出的方法学阶段和监管原则，其他机构可重现该工作流程以开发类似的决策支持工具。最终，这一跨学科框架旨在优化手术规划、降低漏发生率，并推动向可解释、数据驱动的精准外科手术的更广泛范式转变。
tldr: This protocol paper outlines a framework for an AI-driven system that uses preoperative CT imaging to predict anastomotic leak risk in colorectal cancer surgery, integrating a risk assessment module and a content-based medical image retrieval (CBMIR) module to support surgical decision-making.
tldr_zh: 本协议论文概述了一个基于术前CT成像的AI驱动系统框架，用于预测结直肠癌手术中的吻合口漏风险，该系统集成了风险评估模块和基于内容的医学图像检索模块，以支持手术决策。

title: Learning Label-Efficient Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis via Semi-supervised Hypergraph Concept Bottleneck Model
summary: Deep learning has revolutionized medical image analysis, delivering exceptional diagnostic accuracy across diverse applications. Yet, the lack of interpretability in its decision-making hinders clinical adoption, particularly in high-stakes medical contexts where transparency is paramount for trustworthiness. For example, in Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), subtle cues in ultrasound imaging challenge reliable diagnosis, rendering black-box models untrustworthy for accurate scoring. To address this, Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) offer a promising avenue by embedding clinically meaningful intermediate concepts into the diagnosis pipeline, enabling clinicians to scrutinize and refine model outputs. However, conventional CBMs falter in capturing complex inter-concept dependencies and demand costly, expert-driven concept annotations, limiting their scalability. This study introduces a novel semi-supervised CBM framework designed for medical imaging, which leverages dual-level hypergraph learning to model high-order concept dependencies and generate domain-adaptive pseudo-labels. Our approach achieves superior interpretability and performance by integrating a concept-level hypergraph for enhanced reasoning and an image-level hypergraph for robust pseudo-label generation. Experiments on a newly annotated PAS ultrasound dataset and a breast ultrasound public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed concept label-efficient interpretable framework. Its universality is further validated on the dermoscopic image dataset SkinCon. The code is available at https://github.com/scott-yjyang/HyperCBM.
summary_zh: 深度学习技术革新了医学图像分析，在多种应用场景中展现了卓越的诊断准确性。然而，其决策过程缺乏可解释性阻碍了临床采纳，尤其是在高风险医疗环境中，透明度对建立信任至关重要。以胎盘植入谱（PAS）为例，超声图像中的细微征象给可靠诊断带来挑战，导致黑箱模型无法为准确评分提供可信依据。为此，概念瓶颈模型（CBM）通过将临床有意义的中间概念嵌入诊断流程，为临床医生审视和优化模型输出提供了可行途径。然而，传统CBM难以捕捉概念间的复杂依赖关系，且需要代价高昂、依赖专家标注的概念注释，限制了其可扩展性。本研究提出一种面向医学影像的新型半监督CBM框架，利用双层超图学习建模高阶概念依赖并生成领域自适应伪标签。该方法通过整合用于增强推理的概念级超图和用于稳健伪标签生成的图像级超图，实现了更优的可解释性与性能。在新增标注的PAS超声数据集和乳腺超声公开数据集上的实验验证了所提概念标签高效可解释框架的有效性，并在皮肤镜图像数据集SkinCon上进一步验证了其普适性。代码开源地址：https://github.com/scott-yjyang/HyperCBM。
