tldr: This paper introduces a semi-supervised hypergraph concept bottleneck model (HyperCBM) for interpretable medical image diagnosis, leveraging dual-level hypergraph learning to capture high-order concept dependencies and generate pseudo-labels, validated on PAS ultrasound, breast ultrasound, and dermoscopic datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种半监督超图概念瓶颈模型（HyperCBM），用于可解释的医学图像诊断，利用双层级超图学习捕获高阶概念依赖并生成伪标签，在PAS超声、乳腺超声和皮肤镜数据集上进行了验证。

title: RL-ACRGNet: Reinforcement Learning-Based Chest Radiology Report Generation Network
summary: Medical imaging interpretation is a foundational pillar of modern clinical diagnostics, yet the manual generation of radiology reports remains a time-consuming process prone to interpretation inconsistencies. Within the field of medical AI, automating these descriptions through deep learning promises to streamline clinical workflows and standardise diagnostic output. However, accurate disease detection and precise report generation remain significant challenges due to limitations in capturing fine-grained visual features and ensuring clinical coherence. To address these issues, we propose RL-ACRGNet, an improved encoder-decoder model that integrates a pre-trained DenseNet encoder with a multilevel LSTM decoder within an off-policy reinforcement learning framework. Using a dual-network approach to refine visual-semantic embeddings through a metric-based reward mechanism, we demonstrate that RL-ACRGNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the IU-Xray dataset, achieving quantitative improvements in BLEU-4 (0.47%), METEOR (0.17%) and ROUGE-L (0.518). Furthermore, comprehensive evaluations on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR data set confirm the robust generalisation of the model and its ability to generate high-quality, clinically relevant reports
summary_zh: 医学影像解读是现代临床诊断的基础支柱，然而手动生成放射学报告仍是一个耗时且易出现解读不一致的过程。在医学人工智能领域，通过深度学习实现这些描述的自动化有望简化临床工作流程并标准化诊断输出。然而，由于在捕获细粒度视觉特征和确保临床连贯性方面存在局限性，准确的疾病检测和精确的报告生成仍然是重大挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RL-ACRGNet，一种改进的编码器-解码器模型，它将预训练的DenseNet编码器与多层LSTM解码器集成在离策略强化学习框架中。通过采用双网络方法，利用基于度量的奖励机制优化视觉-语义嵌入，我们证明RL-ACRGNet在IU-Xray数据集上持续优于最先进的基线模型，在BLEU-4（0.47%）、METEOR（0.17%）和ROUGE-L（0.518）上实现了定量改进。此外，在大规模MIMIC-CXR数据集上的全面评估证实了该模型的强大泛化能力及其生成高质量、临床相关报告的能力。
tldr: This paper proposes RL-ACRGNet, an encoder-decoder model combining a pre-trained DenseNet with a multilevel LSTM decoder and off-policy reinforcement learning to generate chest radiology reports, achieving slight improvements over baselines on IU-Xray and MIMIC-CXR datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RL-ACRGNet，一种结合预训练DenseNet编码器和多级LSTM解码器的编码器-解码器模型，采用离策略强化学习生成胸部放射学报告，在IU-Xray和MIMIC-CXR数据集上相比基线方法略有改进。

title: Efficient Transformer-Based Localized Patch Sampling for Choroid Plexus Segmentation in Multiple Sclerosis
summary: Background: The lateral ventricle choroid plexus (LVCP) is gaining recognition as a key imaging biomarker for multiple sclerosis (MS) related to physical disability and neuroinflammation. Yet, manual segmentation of the LVCP is highly tedious, restricting its use in broad clinical trials and longitudinal assessments. This research aims to develop a SwinUNETR-driven pipeline that leverages targeted intra- and peri-ventricular small patch sampling to automatically segment the LVCP in MS from both standalone and multi-modal MRI inputs. Methods: We retrospectively assessed 3T MRI scans across three sets of data stemming from two separate MS-dominant cohorts (Dataset 1: n=177; Dataset 2: n=177; expanded test set: n=388). Our method employed a SwinUNETR architecture trained on 32x32x32 voxel patches, benchmarking it against the 3D UXNET model. The primary metric for evaluation was the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC), supplemented by computational demand (GFLOPs) and the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95). Results: On the extended test set, the SwinUNETR model secured a mean DSC of 0.868 (95% CI: 0.863-0.872) with MPRAGE and FLAIR combined, showing a statistically significant gain over UXNET (DSC: 0.858 [95% CI: 0.853-0.862], p<0.0001). When restricted to standalone FLAIR inputs, the transformer-based approach sustained a high DSC of 0.863, while the spatial localization of UXNET worsened considerably (HD95: 1.86 vs. 3.00 mm). Importantly, the proposed framework lowered computational load by 99% (91.8 vs. 22,080 GFLOPs). By integrating localized patch sampling with a SwinUNETR architecture, this methodology offers an accurate, robust, and statistically superior alternative to current leading models for LVCP segmentation. Its vast reduction in computational cost makes it ideal for widespread implementation in clinical and research environments.
summary_zh: 侧脑室脉络丛（LVCP）正逐渐被公认为与多发性硬化症（MS）患者身体残疾和神经炎症相关的重要影像生物标志物。然而，手动分割LVCP极为繁琐，限制了其在广泛临床试验和纵向评估中的应用。本研究旨在开发一种基于SwinUNETR的流程，通过靶向性的脑室内及脑室周围小样本块采样，从独立或多模态MRI输入中自动分割MS患者的LVCP。方法：我们回顾性评估了来自两个独立MS优势队列的三组3T MRI扫描数据（数据集1：n=177；数据集2：n=177；扩展测试集：n=388）。该方法采用在32×32×32体素块上训练的SwinUNETR架构，并以3D UXNET模型作为基准。主要评估指标为Dice相似系数（DSC），辅以计算需求（GFLOPs）和95百分位豪斯多夫距离（HD95）。结果：在扩展测试集中，结合MPRAGE和FLAIR输入时，SwinUNETR模型的平均DSC达到0.868（95% CI: 0.863-0.872），显著优于UXNET（DSC: 0.858 [95% CI: 0.853-0.862]，p<0.0001）。当仅限于独立FLAIR输入时，基于变换器的方法仍保持高DSC（0.863），而UXNET的空间定位显著恶化（HD95: 1.86 vs. 3.00 mm）。重要的是，所提出的框架将计算负载降低了99%（91.8 vs. 22,080 GFLOPs）。通过将局部样本块采样与SwinUNETR架构相结合，该方法为当前领先的LVCP分割模型提供了一种精准、稳健且统计上更优的替代方案。其计算成本的大幅降低使其非常适合在临床和研究环境中广泛实施。
tldr: This paper presents a SwinUNETR-based pipeline with localized intra- and peri-ventricular patch sampling for automatic segmentation of the lateral ventricle choroid plexus in multiple sclerosis from MRI, achieving high Dice scores and a 99% reduction in computational cost compared to the 3D UXNET baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SwinUNETR的局部补丁采样流水线，用于自动分割多发性硬化症MRI中的侧脑室脉络丛，相比3D UXNET基线获得了高Dice分数并降低了99%的计算成本。

title: GLINT: Sparsely Gated Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Radiology Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) for radiology have emerged as a scalable paradigm by leveraging image-report pairs naturally produced in clinical workflows. However, this pairing reveals a mismatch in scale: each finding occupies only a small region of the image, yet supervision is provided only at the global image-report level. This poses a central challenge: prior approaches spread weight densely across all patches rather than concentrating on the sparse subset relevant to a given query. To address this, we present GLINT (Gated Language-Image alignmeNT), a framework that explicitly models this sparse correspondence. On the alignment side, we introduce Sparsely Gated Alignment, a novel architecture in which a sigmoid gate over a separate gate embedding space activates only the patches relevant to each textual query, enforcing explicit sparsity. On the representation side, we add Dense Feature Regularization, which anchors the trainable encoder's intermediate features to a frozen self-supervised learning (SSL) teacher, preserving the fine-grained patch features that the gate relies on. The same recipe applies to both 2D chest X-ray (CXR) and 3D chest computed tomography (CT), built with DINOv3 and V-JEPA 2.1, respectively. GLINT enables zero-shot classification, grounding, and segmentation from free-text queries, and to our knowledge is the first to demonstrate zero-shot segmentation on 3D CT volumes without mask supervision. Notably, the most pronounced gains arise on zero-shot grounding and segmentation, where sparse, query-specific localization is required, consistent with our design intent. In downstream evaluation, GLINT outperforms both SSL encoders and medical VLMs on classification, report generation, and segmentation.
summary_zh: 放射学领域的视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过利用临床工作流中自然生成的图像-报告对，已成为一种可扩展的范式。然而，这种配对揭示了尺度上的不匹配：每个病灶仅占据图像的一小片区域，但监督信号却仅在全局图像-报告层面提供。这带来了一个核心挑战：先前的方法将权重密集地分布于所有图像块，而非集中于与给定查询相关的稀疏子集。为解决此问题，我们提出GLINT（门控语言-图像对齐）框架，显式建模这种稀疏对应关系。在对齐方面，我们引入稀疏门控对齐——一种新型架构，其中独立门控嵌入空间上的sigmoid门仅激活与每个文本查询相关的图像块，从而强制实现显式稀疏性。在表征方面，我们添加密集特征正则化，将可训练编码器的中间特征锚定到冻结的自监督学习（SSL）教师模型上，从而保留门控所依赖的细粒度图像块特征。该方案同样适用于2D胸部X光片（CXR）和3D胸部计算机断层扫描（CT），分别基于DINOv3和V-JEPA 2.1构建。GLINT支持基于自由文本查询的零样本分类、定位和分割，据我们所知，这是首个在无需掩码监督的情况下实现3D CT体素零样本分割的方法。值得注意的是，最显著的提升出现在零样本定位和分割任务上，这些任务需要稀疏的、查询特异性的定位能力，这与我们的设计意图一致。在下游评估中，GLINT在分类、报告生成和分割任务上均优于SSL编码器和医学VLM。
tldr: GLINT introduces a sparsely gated vision-language alignment framework for fine-grained radiology representations, enabling zero-shot classification, grounding, and segmentation on 2D chest X-ray and 3D CT volumes.
tldr_zh: GLINT 提出了一种基于稀疏门控的视觉-语言对齐框架，用于细粒度放射学表征，在二维胸片和三维 CT 体积上实现了零样本分类、定位和分割。

title: Gender-Dependent Diagnostic Substitution in LLM Medical Triage: Same Symptoms, Unequal Urgency
summary: We investigate whether large language models produce different medical triage recommendations for identical neurological symptoms when only the patient's stated gender and age vary. Using three model families--Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.4-mini--we present a standardized symptom profile (persistent headache, blurred vision, morning nausea, visual disturbances) across seven demographic conditions: three age groups (25, 38, 65) x two genders (male, female), plus a gender-unspecified baseline (n = 30 per condition per model, 630 total trials). We find a stark, systemic gender-dependent triage disparity: young women receive significantly lower emergency room (ER) referral rates than age-matched men (Gemini: 0% vs. 23.3%; Claude: 6.7% vs. 96.7%; GPT: 6.7% vs. 66.7%, all p < 0.001). The disparity disappears at age 65 for all models. The primary mechanism is diagnostic substitution: the models anchor on a gender-associated diagnosis, preferentially classifying young women with Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (IIH)--a condition epidemiologically linked to women of childbearing age--while diagnosing men with generic increased intracranial pressure with space-occupying lesions in the differential. This diagnostic closure routes female patients to lower-urgency care (outpatient doctor appointments) despite comparable severity ratings (7-9/10). Our findings demonstrate that clinical LLMs replicate documented human clinical biases by using epidemiological priors to suppress triage urgency, suggesting that AI triage engines must decouple urgency assessment from probabilistic diagnostic priors. We release all code, prompts, and raw results.
summary_zh: 我们研究了当仅改变患者的性别和年龄时，大语言模型是否会对相同的神经系统症状产生不同的医疗分诊建议。使用三个模型系列——Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 GPT-5.4-mini——我们在七种人口统计条件下呈现了一个标准化的症状描述（持续性头痛、视力模糊、晨起恶心、视觉障碍）：三种年龄组（25、38、65）×两种性别（男性、女性），外加一个未指定性别的基线（每个模型每个条件 n = 30，共 630 次试验）。我们发现存在显著且系统性的性别依赖分诊差异：年轻女性获得的急诊科转诊率显著低于年龄匹配的男性（Gemini：0% vs. 23.3%；Claude：6.7% vs. 96.7%；GPT：6.7% vs. 66.7%，所有 p < 0.001）。对于所有模型，这种差异在 65 岁时消失。主要机制是诊断替代：模型锚定于与性别相关的诊断，倾向于将年轻女性归类为特发性颅内高压（IIH）——一种在流行病学上与育龄女性相关的疾病——而对男性则诊断为伴有占位性病变的通用颅内压增高（鉴别诊断中）。这种诊断闭合导致女性患者被导向较低紧急程度的护理（门诊预约），尽管严重程度评分相当（7-9/10）。我们的研究结果表明，临床大语言模型通过利用流行病学先验来抑制分诊紧急程度，从而复制了已知的人类临床偏见，这表明人工智能分诊引擎必须将紧急程度评估与概率诊断先验解耦。我们已发布所有代码、提示和原始结果。
tldr: This paper investigates gender and age biases in LLM-based medical triage, finding that young women receive significantly lower emergency room referral rates than men with identical symptoms due to diagnostic substitution (e.g., IIH vs. space-occupying lesions).
tldr_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型在医疗分诊中的性别和年龄偏见，发现相同症状下年轻女性获得急诊转诊的比率显著低于男性，原因是诊断替换（如特发性颅内高压 vs. 占位性病变）。

title: Short-Acquisition Contrast-Free Super-Resolution Microvascular Imaging in Rabbit Kidney
summary: Ultrasound localization microscopy (ULM) enables micrometer-scale microvascular imaging by localizing and tracking intravascular microbubbles, but its dependence on exogenous contrast agents and long acquisition times limits clinical translation. This study presents a high-frame-rate contrast-free super-resolution ultrasound microvascular imaging method based on high-frequency ultrafast ultrasound and nonlinear beamforming of backscatter signals from native blood flow. Using only 125 milliseconds of in vivo ultrafast data per image, the proposed method achieved an imaging frame rate of 8 frames/s in a rabbit kidney model. The reconstructed microvascular images resolved vessels with a global spatial resolution of 22.2 um over a field of view of 23.04 x 15.18 mm2, where the wavelength of ultrasound was 67.5 um. This corresponds to a three-fold improvement over conventional power Doppler imaging under the same acquisition duration. Compared with conventional flow imaging, the proposed method provided improved microvascular contrast and finer vessel delineation without microbubble injection. These results demonstrate a practical pathway toward high frame rate, contrast-free super-resolution ultrasound imaging for microvascular assessment.
summary_zh: 超声定位显微镜（ULM）通过定位和追踪血管内微泡实现微米级微血管成像，但其依赖外源性造影剂且采集时间较长，限制了临床转化。本研究提出一种基于高频超快超声和原生血流背向散射信号非线性波束成形的无造影剂超分辨率超声微血管成像方法。在兔肾模型中，每幅图像仅需125毫秒的体内超快数据，即可实现8帧/秒的成像帧率。重建的微血管图像在23.04 × 15.18 mm²的视野内，可分辨全局空间分辨率为22.2 μm的血管（超声波长为67.5 μm）。在相同采集时长下，该分辨率较传统功率多普勒成像提升三倍。与传统血流成像相比，本方法无需注射微泡即可提供更优的微血管对比度和更精细的血管轮廓描绘。这些结果表明，该方法为实现高帧率、无造影剂的超分辨率超声微血管评估提供了实用途径。
tldr: This paper presents a contrast-free super-resolution ultrasound microvascular imaging method using high-frame-rate ultrafast ultrasound and nonlinear beamforming, achieving 22.2 μm resolution in rabbit kidney without microbubble injection, enabling 8 frames/s imaging from only 125 ms of data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无造影剂的超分辨率超声微血管成像方法，利用高帧率超快超声和非线性波束成形，在兔肾模型中无需微泡注射即可实现22.2微米的分辨率，仅用125毫秒数据即可达到8帧/秒的成像速度。

title: Beyond Prompt-Based Planning: MCP-Native Graph Planning-based Biomedical Agent System
summary: Biomedical agents promise to automate complex biological workflows, yet current systems face two fundamental bottlenecks: bioinformatics tools are highly heterogeneous in interfaces and execution environments, while agent planning still relies on flat prompt-retrieved tool descriptions. As biomedical software ecosystems grow, this coupling between tool coverage and context size leads to tool confusion, unstable planning, and inefficient execution. We introduce BioManus, an MCP-native biomedical agent built on graph-scaffolded planning over structured biological capabilities. BioManus first introduces the BioinfoMCP Compiler, which converts heterogeneous bioinformatics software into standardized MCP servers, yielding a large executable MCP ecosystem. It then organizes this ecosystem as a typed heterogeneous MCP graph over tools, operations, datatypes, and workflow stages. At inference time, BioManus retrieves compact task-specific subgraphs, synthesizes operation-level workflow scaffolds. This design decouples planning complexity from raw tool inventory size, achieving a context compression ratio of Theta(N / (h * m_bar)) under high-recall retrieval, where N is the total tool count, h is the workflow horizon, and m_bar (much smaller than N) is the average number of candidate tools per operation. Experiments on BioAgentBench and LAB-Bench show that BioManus improves execution accuracy, workflow validity, and context efficiency over advanced biomedical agent baselines. This work suggests a paradigm shift: scalable biomedical reasoning requires structured executable capability graphs rather than increasingly larger prompt-level tool retrieval.
summary_zh: 生物医学代理有望实现复杂生物工作流的自动化，然而当前系统面临两个根本瓶颈：生物信息学工具在接口和执行环境上高度异构，而智能体的规划仍依赖于基于简单提示检索的扁平化工具描述。随着生物医学软件生态系统的扩展，工具覆盖范围与上下文大小之间的这种耦合会导致工具混淆、规划不稳定和执行效率低下。我们提出 BioManus——一种基于结构化生物能力上的图支撑规划构建的 MCP 原生生物医学代理。BioManus 首先引入 BioinfoMCP 编译器，将异构的生物信息学软件转换为标准化的 MCP 服务器，从而形成一个可执行的大型 MCP 生态系统。随后，它将这一生态系统组织为一种带类型的异构 MCP 图，涵盖工具、操作、数据类型和工作流阶段。在推理时，BioManus 检索紧凑的任务特定子图，并合成操作级的工作流支架。这种设计将规划复杂度与原始工具库存规模解耦，在高召回率检索下实现了上下文压缩比 Θ(N / (h * m̄))，其中 N 是工具总数，h 是工作流步长，m̄（远小于 N）是每个操作的平均候选工具数。在 BioAgentBench 和 LAB-Bench 上的实验表明，相较于先进的生物医学代理基线，BioManus 在执行准确性、工作流有效性和上下文效率方面均有提升。这项工作暗示了一种范式转变：可扩展的生物医学推理需要结构化的可执行能力图，而非越来越大的提示级工具检索。
tldr: BioManus is an MCP-native biomedical agent that uses graph-scaffolded planning over structured biological capabilities, converting heterogeneous bioinformatics tools into standardized MCP servers and retrieving task-specific subgraphs to decouple planning complexity from tool inventory size, achieving improved execution accuracy and context efficiency.
tldr_zh: BioManus 是一个基于 MCP 原生的生物医学智能体，它通过图结构化的规划来组织生物能力，将异构生物信息学工具转换为标准化的 MCP 服务器，并检索任务特定子图，从而将规划复杂度与工具库存大小解耦，提高了执行准确性和上下文效率。

title: StrokeTimer: Robust Representation Learning for Ischemic Stroke Onset-Time Estimation from Non-contrast CT
summary: Ischemic stroke is a major global disease. Treatment decisions are highly time-sensitive, as eligibility for reperfusion therapies relies on the interval between stroke onset and intervention. However, the true onset time is often uncertain in clinical practice, necessitating imaging-based assessment of tissue age as a surrogate marker. Early ischemic changes on routinely acquired non-contrast CT (NCCT) are often subtle, and real-world clinical datasets exhibit pronounced onset-time class imbalance and center-scanner-related heterogeneity. In this work, we propose StrokeTimer, a fully automated framework for onset-time estimation in acute ischemic stroke. StrokeTimer integrates self-supervised disentanglement learning with energy-guided contrastive learning to capture subtle ischemic patterns while addressing long-tailed data distributions under acquisition variability. Onset time is categorized into three clinically relevant windows: <4.5 h, 4.5-6 h, and >6 h. Experimental results on a large multi-center NCCT dataset from two national cohorts, MR CLEAN Registry and MR CLEAN LATE, show that StrokeTimer achieves a macro AUC of 0.69 and a macro F1-score of 0.57, improving the strongest baseline by nearly 50% (p < 0.005). In this realistic, challenging setting, representative baseline approaches exhibit near-chance macro performance. Model explanations further highlight subtle gray-white matter blurring and hypodense regions consistent with established radiological biomarkers. These findings demonstrate the potential of StrokeTimer to support treatment decision-making in acute ischemic stroke. Code is available at https://github.com/BrainVas/StrokeTimer.
summary_zh: 缺血性卒中是一种全球性重大疾病。治疗决策具有高度时间敏感性，因为再灌注治疗的可行性取决于卒中发作至干预的时间间隔。然而，在临床实践中，真实发病时间常常不确定，因此需要基于影像的组织年龄评估作为替代标志物。常规非增强CT（NCCT）上的早期缺血性改变往往较细微，而真实世界的临床数据集表现出明显的发病时间类别不平衡以及中心-扫描仪相关的异质性。在本研究中，我们提出StrokeTimer——一个用于急性缺血性卒中发病时间估计的全自动框架。StrokeTimer整合了自监督解耦学习与能量引导对比学习，以捕捉细微的缺血模式，同时应对采集变异性下的长尾数据分布。发病时间被分为三个临床相关窗口：<4.5小时、4.5-6小时和>6小时。在两个国家级队列（MR CLEAN Registry和MR CLEAN LATE）的大型多中心NCCT数据集上的实验结果显示，StrokeTimer实现了0.69的宏观AUC和0.57的宏观F1分数，相比最强基线提升了近50%（p < 0.005）。在这一现实且具有挑战性的场景中，代表性基线方法表现出接近随机水平的宏观性能。模型解释进一步突出了与已确立的放射学生物标志物一致的细微灰白质模糊和低密度区域。这些发现证明了StrokeTimer在支持急性缺血性卒中治疗决策方面的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/BrainVas/StrokeTimer获取。
tldr: StrokeTimer is a deep learning framework that estimates ischemic stroke onset time from non-contrast CT by integrating self-supervised disentanglement learning and energy-guided contrastive learning, achieving significant improvements over baselines on multi-center datasets.
tldr_zh: StrokeTimer是一种深度学习框架，通过集成自监督解缠学习和能量引导对比学习，从非增强CT中估计缺血性卒中发病时间，在多中心数据集上取得了显著优于基线的效果。

title: A New Angle on Bones: Robust Pose Estimation in X-Ray and Ultrasound
summary: Measuring the angle between bone structures is a routine task in medical image analysis and provides a key quantitative parameter for diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated methods can reduce time and cost while improving reproducibility. In this work, we address automatic bone pose estimation using a learning-based point candidate proposal followed by a line model to extract axis parameters. Since conventional line models such as least squares are sensitive to outliers, we incorporate false-positive reduction strategies and robust fitting techniques, such as RANSAC and Hough transforms, to improve robustness. We evaluate our method on three clinically relevant paediatric angle estimation tasks: fracture fragment assessment in radiographs and ultrasound and developmental dysplasia of the hip evaluation in ultrasound using the Graf method. Our approach achieves mean errors of $4.1^\circ$, $5.4^\circ$, and $5.51^\circ$, respectively, not only remaining within the expected clinical observer variability, but also significantly outperforming landmark-based methods. Our code and annotations for fracture angle assessment in radiographs are publicly available on GitHub.
summary_zh: 测量骨结构之间的角度是医学图像分析中的常规任务，为诊断和治疗规划提供了关键的定量参数。自动化方法可减少时间和成本，同时提高可重复性。本研究提出了一种基于学习的骨姿态自动估计方法，先通过点候选提议，再利用线模型提取轴线参数。由于传统线模型（如最小二乘法）对异常值敏感，我们引入了假阳性抑制策略和鲁棒拟合技术（如RANSAC和霍夫变换）以提升稳健性。我们在三项临床相关的儿科角度估计任务上评估了该方法：X光片和超声中的骨折碎片评估，以及采用Graf法评估超声图像中的发育性髋关节发育不良。我们的方法分别实现了平均误差$4.1^\circ$、$5.4^\circ$和$5.51^\circ$，不仅保持在预期临床观察者变异范围内，而且显著优于基于标志点的方法。我们在GitHub上发布了用于X光片骨折角度评估的代码和标注。
tldr: The paper presents a learning-based method for automatic bone pose estimation in X-ray and ultrasound images, using point candidate proposal and robust line fitting (RANSAC, Hough) to measure angles between bone structures, achieving clinically acceptable accuracy on three pediatric tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于学习的自动骨骼姿态估计方法，用于X光和超声图像，通过点候选提议和鲁棒直线拟合（RANSAC、霍夫变换）测量骨骼结构角度，在三个儿科任务上达到了临床可接受的精度。

title: XSSR: Cross-Domain Self-Supervised Representative Selection for Efficient Annotation in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Acquiring labeled medical image data is resource-intensive and a challenge further exacerbated in cross-domain scenarios where source and target datasets differ in imaging equipment, population, or clinical site. This study introduces XSSR (Cross-Domain Self-Supervised Representative Selection), a framework designed to minimize annotation effort in the target domain while maintaining robust segmentation performance. XSSR comprises three stages: first, a Masked Autoencoder (MAE) is trained on unlabeled source data to establish a shared embedding space without requiring target labels; second, a greedy selection algorithm scores unlabeled target samples based on a composite density, novelty, and diversity criterion; and third, a U-Net segmentation model is trained exclusively on the selected subset. The novelty-diversity trade-off parameter, alpha, is automatically calibrated by minimizing embedding-space coverage, eliminating manual tuning. We evaluate XSSR on three public benchmarks: Chest X-ray, RIGA+ retinal fundus imaging, and multi-site Prostate MRI, each under a fixed 5% annotation budget. XSSR achieves 99.3% of full-data performance on Chest X-ray using only 22 labeled samples, surpasses random selection by up to 2.5 Dice points on Prostate MRI, and consistently outperforms the CoreSet baseline by 0.4 to 1.2 Dice points across all datasets. Ablation studies indicate that diversity is the most influential scoring component, and per-site analysis shows that performance correlates with scanner similarity to the source domain.
summary_zh: 获取带标注的医学图像数据需要大量资源，而在跨域场景（即源数据集与目标数据集在成像设备、人群或临床机构上存在差异）中，这一挑战愈发严峻。本研究提出XSSR（跨域自监督代表性选择）框架，旨在最小化目标域中的标注工作，同时保持稳健的分割性能。XSSR包含三个阶段：首先，在无标注的源数据上训练掩码自编码器（MAE），以建立无需目标标签的共享嵌入空间；其次，基于复合密度、新颖性和多样性准则，通过贪心选择算法对无标注目标样本进行评分；最后，仅在所选子集上训练U-Net分割模型。新颖性-多样性权衡参数alpha通过最小化嵌入空间覆盖率自动校准，无需人工调参。我们在三个公开基准数据集（胸部X光片、RIGA+视网膜眼底影像以及多中心前列腺MRI）上评估XSSR，每个数据集均采用固定的5%标注预算。在仅使用22个标注样本的情况下，XSSR在胸部X光片上达到全数据性能的99.3%；在前列腺MRI上相较于随机选择提升高达2.5个Dice点；在所有数据集上始终优于CoreSet基线0.4至1.2个Dice点。消融研究表明，多样性是影响最大的评分分量，而逐站点分析显示，性能与目标域扫描仪和源域的相似性相关。
tldr: XSSR is a three-stage framework for cross-domain medical image segmentation that uses a masked autoencoder to learn a shared embedding, a greedy selection algorithm based on density, novelty, and diversity to pick representative samples, and a U-Net trained on the selected subset, achieving high performance under low annotation budgets.
tldr_zh: XSSR是一个三阶段跨域医学图像分割框架，利用掩码自编码器学习共享嵌入，基于密度、新颖性和多样性的贪婪选择算法挑选代表性样本，并在所选子集上训练U-Net，在低标注预算下实现高性能。

title: Enhancing MedSAM with a Lightweight Box Predictor for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation in medical imaging is a critical yet challenging task due to data scarcity and high variability across modalities. While foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) show promise, they often struggle with medical images without specific adaptation. Moreover, point prompts, despite being the most natural form of user interaction, provide insufficient spatial context for reliable segmentation, particularly when target structures are irregular or poorly contrasted. In this paper, we propose an enhanced segmentation framework that integrates a lightweight Box Predictor module into the MedSAM architecture. The Box Predictor estimates an approximate bounding box from a single user click using localized image embedding features, providing spatial guidance that reduces the ambiguity of point prompts, while introducing only 1.6M additional parameters and negligible inference overhead. We introduce a two-stage training pipeline where the Box Predictor is trained independently before being integrated into MedSAM. To validate the generalization capability of our method, we conduct extensive evaluations on four diverse datasets (FLARE22, BRISC, BUSI, LungSegDB) spanning distinct imaging modalities, including CT, MRI, and Ultrasound. Our method improves segmentation accuracy and robustness across varied anatomical structures and imaging domains, achieving Dice scores of 0.89 (BUSI), 0.93 (FLARE22), 0.88 (BRISC), and 0.98 (LungSegDB). Code is available at https://github.com/Amirhosseinmovahedi/MedSAM-BoxPredictor
summary_zh: 摘要：医学图像中的语义分割由于数据稀缺和跨模态的高度变异性，是一项关键且具有挑战性的任务。尽管诸如分割一切模型（SAM）之类的基础模型展现出潜力，但在未经过特定适配的情况下，它们往往难以处理医学图像。此外，尽管点提示是用户最自然的交互形式，但其提供的空间上下文不足，难以实现可靠的分割，尤其是当目标结构不规则或对比度较差时。本文提出了一种增强分割框架，将轻量级边界框预测器模块集成到MedSAM架构中。该边界框预测器利用局部图像嵌入特征，从单次用户点击中估算出近似边界框，从而提供空间引导，减少点提示的模糊性，同时仅引入160万额外参数且推理开销可忽略不计。我们引入了一个两阶段训练流程：先独立训练边界框预测器，再将其集成到MedSAM中。为了验证所提方法的泛化能力，我们在涵盖不同成像模态（包括CT、MRI和超声）的四个多样化数据集（FLARE22、BRISC、BUSI、LungSegDB）上进行了广泛评估。我们的方法在不同解剖结构和成像领域均提升了分割精度与鲁棒性，在BUSI、FLARE22、BRISC和LungSegDB上分别达到了0.89、0.93、0.88和0.98的Dice分数。代码公开于https://github.com/Amirhosseinmovahedi/MedSAM-BoxPredictor。
tldr: Proposes a lightweight Box Predictor module for MedSAM that estimates bounding boxes from a single user click to improve medical image segmentation, achieving Dice scores from 0.88 to 0.98 across four diverse datasets with minimal added parameters.
tldr_zh: 提出一个轻量化的框预测器模块，结合MedSAM，从单次用户点击估计边界框，提升医学图像分割精度，在四个不同数据集上获得0.88至0.98的Dice分数，且参数增加极小。

title: Radiomic Feature Selection Using Gradient Loss of Deep Neural Network for Lung Cancer Stage Detection
summary: Radiomics enables extraction of quantitative imaging biomarkers from medical images and has become an important tool for computer-aided cancer diagnosis. However, radiomics datasets are typically high-dimensional with limited samples, making feature selection a critical step for building reliable predictive models. This study proposes a Gradient-Loss Recursive Feature Elimination (GL-RFE) framework that integrates gradient sensitivity analysis from a deep neural network to identify the most influential radiomic features for lung cancer stage detection. A total of 106 radiomic features were extracted from chest Computed Tomography (CT) scans using the PyRadiomics extension of the 3D Slicer platform. The proposed method evaluates feature importance by computing gradients of the network loss with respect to input features and recursively eliminates features with minimal contribution. The resulting top-15 radiomic features are used to train a deep neural network classifier for distinguishing early-stage and advanced-stage lung cancer. The proposed framework achieves strong classification performance, with accuracy of 90.22%, precision of 90.10%, recall of 90.24%, and F1-score of 90.16% on the test dataset. Visualization analyses, including correlation heat maps and distribution plots, further confirm reduced feature redundancy and improved class separability. Compared to conventional feature selection techniques, GL-RFE effectively captures nonlinear feature interactions and enhances model generalization. The presented protocol provides a reproducible and interpretable methodology for radiomics-based cancer stage detection and is particularly suitable for high-dimensional, small-sample biomedical datasets, with potential applications in other domains such as genomics and multimodal clinical analysis.
summary_zh: 放射组学能够从医学图像中提取定量成像生物标志物，已成为计算机辅助癌症诊断的重要工具。然而，放射组学数据集通常呈现高维度、小样本的特点，因此特征选择成为构建可靠预测模型的关键步骤。本研究提出一种梯度损失递归特征消除（GL-RFE）框架，该框架整合了深度神经网络的梯度敏感性分析，以识别对肺癌分期检测最具影响力的放射组学特征。利用3D Slicer平台的PyRadiomics扩展，从胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）图像中提取了共106个放射组学特征。所提方法通过计算网络损失相对于输入特征的梯度来评估特征重要性，并递归剔除贡献最小的特征。最终筛选出的前15个放射组学特征用于训练深度神经网络分类器，以区分早期与晚期肺癌。该框架在测试数据集上取得了优异的分类性能：准确率90.22%，精确率90.10%，召回率90.24%，F1分数90.16%。相关性热图与分布图等可视化分析进一步证实了特征冗余的降低和类别可分性的提升。与传统特征选择技术相比，GL-RFE能够有效捕捉非线性特征交互，并增强模型泛化能力。本方案为基于放射组学的癌症分期检测提供了一种可重复且可解释的方法论，尤其适用于高维度、小样本的生物医学数据集，并有望在基因组学、多模态临床分析等其他领域得到应用。
tldr: This paper proposes a Gradient-Loss Recursive Feature Elimination (GL-RFE) framework that uses gradient sensitivity from a deep neural network to select radiomic features for lung cancer stage detection, achieving strong classification performance on CT scans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络梯度损失的递归特征消除（GL-RFE）框架，用于选择放射组学特征以检测肺癌分期，在CT扫描上取得了良好的分类性能。

title: CDPM-Align: Multi-Scale Guidance-Aligned Diffusion Pretraining for Robust Few-Shot Anatomical Landmark Detection
summary: Anatomical landmark detection is a fundamental task in medical image analysis supporting a wide range of diagnostic and interventional workflows. Although recent methods have achieved sub-millimetric localisation, accuracy alone is not sufficient for clinical deployment, requiring reliability and robustness in prediction. Despite its clinical relevance, the impact of representation learning in this context is still underexplored. In this work, we introduce CDPM-align, a multi-scale guidance-aligned conditional diffusion pre-training for anatomical landmark detection. Our experimental setup focuses on a few images and a few annotation regimes. Specifically, we employ three popular heterogeneous small-scale benchmark datasets for representation learning via conditional generative pre-training. Furthermore, we consider low-annotation scenarios for the downstream task of landmark detection, with 10 and 25 annotated images, reflecting realistic trade-offs between clinical effort and resource constraints for annotations. Our results confirm that generative pre-training enables the model to learn a robust representation. This improves both accuracy and uncertainty on the downstream tasks, advancing towards safe and efficient clinical deployment.
summary_zh: 解剖标志点检测是医学图像分析中的一项基础任务，支持广泛的诊断和介入工作流程。尽管近期方法已实现亚毫米级定位，但仅凭准确性不足以支持临床部署，还需要预测的可靠性和鲁棒性。尽管具有临床相关性，但表征学习在此背景下的影响仍未被充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出CDPM-align，一种用于解剖标志点检测的多尺度引导对齐条件扩散预训练方法。我们的实验设置聚焦于少量图像和少量标注场景。具体而言，我们采用三个流行的异构小规模基准数据集，通过条件生成预训练进行表征学习。此外，我们考虑了下游标志点检测任务的低标注场景，分别使用10张和25张标注图像，反映了临床工作与标注资源约束之间的现实权衡。我们的结果证实，生成式预训练使模型能够学习到鲁棒的表示。这提高了下游任务的准确性和不确定性，朝着安全高效的临床部署迈进。
tldr: The paper proposes CDPM-Align, a multi-scale guidance-aligned conditional diffusion pretraining method for few-shot anatomical landmark detection, achieving improved accuracy and uncertainty with limited annotations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CDPM-Align，一种多尺度引导对齐的条件扩散预训练方法，用于少样本解剖标志点检测，在有限标注下提高了准确性和不确定性。

title: Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction via Latent-Space Motion Tracking from Single Measurement
summary: Prospective reconstruction is crucial in many clinical applications such as MRI-guided radiotherapy, which demands accurate image reconstruction and fast motion estimation from currently acquired measurements. However, prospective reconstruction remains challenging due to ultra-sparse sampling and stringent latency requirements. In this work, we propose PDMR, a Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction framework with latent-space motion tracking. Our core idea is to learn an efficient and generalizable latent manifold of motion fields offline, enabling rapid online adaptation for prospective reconstruction. Specifically, we parameterize the deformation vector fields (DVFs) on a low-dimensional manifold, effectively reducing the search space for fast online adaptation, and employ a tri-plane representation to achieve geometry-aware and memory-efficient encoding of 3D motion. Experiments on both XCAT digital phantoms and in-house abdominal MRI datasets demonstrate that PDMR achieves high-fidelity and temporally consistent reconstruction across multiple prospective scenarios (Immediate and After-2min), outperforming state-of-the-art retrospective and online methods. Our results suggest a promising pathway toward ultra-fast, motion-aware prospective MRI reconstruction in clinical practice.
summary_zh: 前瞻性重建在诸如MRI引导放射治疗等许多临床应用中至关重要，这些应用需要从当前采集的测量值中实现精确的图像重建和快速的运动估计。然而，由于超稀疏采样和严格的延迟要求，前瞻性重建仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们提出了PDMR——一种具有潜在空间运动跟踪的前瞻性动态3D MRI重建框架。我们的核心思想是离线学习一个高效且可泛化的运动场潜在流形，从而实现快速在线自适应前瞻性重建。具体而言，我们将变形矢量场（DVFs）参数化到低维流形上，有效缩小了快速在线自适应的搜索空间，并采用三平面表示来实现几何感知且内存高效的3D运动编码。在XCAT数字体模和内部腹部MRI数据集上的实验表明，PDMR在多种前瞻性场景（即刻和2分钟后）下实现了高保真且时间一致的重建，性能优于最先进的回顾性和在线方法。我们的研究结果为临床实践中实现超快速、运动感知的前瞻性MRI重建提供了一条有前景的途径。
tldr: A prospective dynamic 3D MRI reconstruction method using latent-space motion tracking to enable fast online adaptation from single measurements, achieving high-fidelity temporally consistent results for applications like MRI-guided radiotherapy.
tldr_zh: 一种利用潜在空间运动跟踪实现单次测量快速在线适应的前瞻性动态3D MRI重建方法，在MRI引导放疗等应用中获得了高保真、时间一致的成像结果。

title: Provably Auditable and Safe LLM Agents from Human-Authored Ontologies
summary: We introduce the LLM agent architecture Agentic Redux, intended for use with nontrivial problem domains that require linear auditability. Using the typed lambda calculus, we prove that, run on appropriate domains, Agentic Redux executions are semantically guaranteed to be correct, with all decisions recorded in an append-only ledger. We present two production-grade appropriate domains, in healthcare billing compliance, and security vulnerability disclosure. Working code for Agentic Redux run on both domains is available in a supporting code repository. We also introduce Ontology-First Agent Design, a methodology for creation of agent frameworks on a problem domain, in which a human expert ontologizes the problem domain with Basic Formal Ontology, and then assigns an LLM to derive roles that agents and humans-in-the-loop can fill, in order to work the problems in the domain.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
我们提出了LLM代理架构Agentic Redux，旨在用于需要线性可审计性的复杂问题领域。利用类型化λ演算，我们证明了在适当领域运行时，Agentic Redux的执行在语义上保证正确，且所有决策均记录在仅追加账本中。我们展示了两个生产级适用领域：医疗账单合规与安全漏洞披露。支持代码仓库中提供了在两个领域上运行Agentic Redux的工作代码。此外，我们还引入了本体优先的代理设计——一种在问题领域上创建代理框架的方法论，其中人类专家使用基本形式本体对问题领域进行本体化，随后指派LLM推导出代理和人机环参与者可承担的角色，以处理该领域中的问题。
tldr: This paper introduces Agentic Redux, an LLM agent architecture with provable correctness and auditability using typed lambda calculus, along with the Ontology-First Agent Design methodology. It demonstrates applications in healthcare billing compliance and security vulnerability disclosure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Agentic Redux的LLM智能体架构，利用类型化λ演算实现可证明的正确性和可审计性，并介绍了本体优先智能体设计方法。在医疗计费合规和安全漏洞披露领域展示了应用。

title: Visuotactile and Explicitly Force-Controlled Robotic Ultrasound for Abdominal Volumetric Reconstruction
summary: In this paper, we present a robotic ultrasound acquisition system that integrates stereo vision, touch-based feedback, and expert-informed strategies to perform autonomous and adaptive abdominal scans. The system records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists, creating a framework to capture transducer motion, applied forces, and anatomical scanning strategies. This expert data is replayed to replicate characteristic scans with the robot, forming a foundation for further autonomous capabilities. Using stereo vision, the system generates three-dimensional topography maps of the patient's abdomen, which are refined through stiffness measurements at key points to delineate the rib cage boundary. These combined techniques enable the robot to execute two distinct scanning paths: an upward-angled sweep beneath the rib cage to visualize structures near the upper abdomen and a perpendicular sweep across soft tissue regions. A compliant, torque-controlled seven degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator is controlled to maintain consistent probe contact through closed-loop force control over the varied anatomical surfaces. Physical experiments demonstrate that the system achieves high-quality imaging comparable to expert scans while dynamically adapting to patient-specific topographies. Furthermore, the robotic system surpasses expert capabilities by enabling three-dimensional volume acquisition, which enhances diagnostic potential and provides volumetric data for advanced analyses. This work highlights the integration of expert knowledge into autonomous robotic systems and underscores the potential of combining perception-based autonomy with physical reasoning for enhanced diagnostic performance.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种机器人超声采集系统，该系统融合了立体视觉、触觉反馈及专家经验策略，能够实现自主自适应的腹部扫描。系统通过记录放射科专家的徒手操作运动与力数据，构建了捕捉探头运动、施加力及解剖扫描策略的框架。这些专家数据被复现以在机器人上复现特征性扫描，为后续自主能力奠定基础。利用立体视觉，系统生成患者腹部的三维地形图，并通过关键点的刚度测量优化以勾勒肋骨边界。这些技术的结合使机器人能够执行两种不同的扫描路径：肋骨下方向上倾斜的扫描（用于显示上腹部附近结构）以及软组织区域的垂直扫描。通过闭环力控制，一个柔顺的、力矩控制的七自由度机械臂被用于在不同解剖表面上保持稳定的探头接触。物理实验表明，该系统能够实现与专家扫描相媲美的高质量成像，同时动态适应患者特定地形。此外，机器人系统通过实现三维容积采集超越了专家能力，从而增强了诊断潜力并为高级分析提供了容积数据。本研究强调了将专家知识融入自主机器人系统的价值，并揭示了将基于感知的自主性与物理推理相结合以提升诊断性能的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic ultrasound system that integrates stereo vision, tactile feedback, and expert-guided strategies to autonomously perform abdominal scans, achieving high-quality imaging and enabling 3D volumetric reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种集成立体视觉、触觉反馈和专家策略的机器人超声系统，可自主完成腹部扫描，实现高质量成像并支持三维体积重建。

title: A Novel Method with Encoder-Decoder for Cross-Sensor Adaptation in Surface Shape Sensing with Sparse Strain Sensors
summary: Performance variations in sensor arrays, caused by intrinsic differences or installation conditions, can lead to inconsistent results during shape sensing. To obtain accurate results, a large amount of data is usually required, and a separate model must be retrained for each sensor array, thereby increasing the cost and time of data acquisition, transmission, and computation. To address this issue, this work proposes an encoder-decoder architecture for surface shape sensing based on sparse strain sensors and further incorporates meta-learning and few-shot adaptation strategies to enable adaptation across different groups of sensor arrays. Experimental results demonstrate that, after the cross-sensor adaptation, a newly deployed sensor array achieves a sensing error of approximately 4.0 mm relying on less than 5.0% newly labeled data and requiring an adaptation time of under 1 second, which represents a substantial improvement from 23.0 mm error without adaptation and 20-minute data collection time required to train a new model. Moreover, the number of points with errors below 5.0 mm increased by more than 65.0%. These results indicate that the proposed method can substantially reduce the cost and training burden of surface shape sensing, and it has broad potential applications in soft robotics and wearable devices.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
传感器阵列因固有差异或安装条件导致的性能变化，会在形变感知中产生不一致的结果。为获得准确结果，通常需要大量数据，且必须为每个传感器阵列重新训练单独的模型，从而增加了数据采集、传输和计算的时间与成本。针对此问题，本文提出一种基于稀疏应变传感器的编码器-解码器架构用于表面形变感知，并进一步结合元学习与小样本自适应策略，使其能够跨不同传感器阵列组进行自适应。实验结果表明，经过跨传感器自适应后，新部署的传感器阵列仅需不到5.0%的新标注数据，且自适应时间低于1秒，即可实现约4.0 mm的感知误差——相比未自适应时的23.0 mm误差以及训练新模型所需的20分钟数据采集时间，性能显著提升。此外，误差低于5.0 mm的测量点数量增加了65.0%以上。这些结果表明，所提方法能显著降低表面形变感知的成本与训练负担，在软体机器人和可穿戴设备领域具有广阔的应用前景。
tldr: This paper proposes an encoder-decoder architecture with meta-learning and few-shot adaptation to enable cross-sensor adaptation for surface shape sensing using sparse strain sensors, significantly reducing data collection and retraining costs while achieving low error.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种结合编码器-解码器架构、元学习和少样本自适应的方法，用于稀疏应变传感器的表面形状传感中的跨传感器适应，从而显著降低数据收集和重新训练的成本，同时实现低误差。

title: A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology
summary: Medical imaging artificial intelligence has achieved strong performance in isolated image interpretation, but remains poorly aligned with radiological practice, where diagnosis and follow-up rely on comparison across prior studies and analogous reference cases. Here we formulate radiological comparison as an entity-aware cross-image reasoning problem and introduce a framework that supports both reference-case retrieval and temporal comparative interpretation. We construct MedReCo-DB, a large-scale comparative imaging resource derived from routine image-report pairs, comprising more than 690,000 images from over 160,000 patients across eight institutions, four countries and seven imaging modalities. Reports are decomposed into anatomical structures, abnormal findings and pathological conditions to provide supervision for entity-conditioned retrieval and comparative visual question answering. Using this resource, we develop MedReCo, an entity-aware visual encoder for controllable retrieval of clinically analogous cases, and MedReCo-VLM, a vision--language extension for generative interpretation of interval change. Across internal, external and cross-center evaluations, MedReCo achieved the highest Recall@1 in all 12 internal retrieval settings and improved external retrieval by a mean of 6.0 percentage points. In clinically confusable differential groups, it consistently outperformed the strongest baselines. MedReCo-VLM achieved the best performance across all comparative generation evaluations and improved longitudinal follow-up accuracy by 14.5-46.5 percentage points on chest radiographs and 13.0-27.9 percentage points on CT. These findings suggest that entity-aware comparative reasoning can be learned from routine clinical data at scale and may provide a more clinically aligned foundation for medical imaging AI.
summary_zh: 医学影像人工智能在孤立图像解读方面已展现出强劲性能，但与放射学实践仍存在显著脱节——临床诊断和随访依赖于既往影像的对比分析及相似参考病例的对照。本文将放射学比较建模为一种实体感知的跨图像推理问题，并引入一个同时支持参考病例检索和纵向对比解读的框架。我们构建了MedReCo-DB，这是一个大规模比较影像资源库，源自常规影像-报告配对数据，包含来自8家机构、4个国家、7种影像模态的超过16万患者的69万余张图像。报告被分解为解剖结构、异常发现和病理状态，为基于实体的条件检索和比较视觉问答提供监督。利用该资源，我们开发了MedReCo——一种用于临床相似病例可控检索的实体感知视觉编码器，以及MedReCo-VLM——一种用于间隔变化生成式解读的视觉-语言扩展模型。在内部、外部和跨中心评估中，MedReCo在所有12个内部检索设置中实现了最高Recall@1，并将外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点。在临床易混淆的鉴别分组中，它持续优于最强基线模型。MedReCo-VLM在所有比较生成评估中取得最佳性能，并将胸片纵向随访准确率提升14.5-46.5个百分点，CT提升13.0-27.9个百分点。这些发现表明，实体感知的比较推理可从常规临床数据中大规模习得，并可能为医学影像AI提供更贴近临床实践的基座。
tldr: Proposes MedReCo, an entity-aware cross-image reasoning framework for radiological comparison, including a large-scale dataset and vision-language models for retrieval and temporal change interpretation, achieving significant improvements on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出了MedReCo，一种用于放射学比较的实体感知跨图像推理框架，包括大规模数据集和用于检索及时间变化解释的视觉语言模型，在多个基准测试中取得了显著改进。

title: HoT-SSM:Higher-order Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning with State Space Models for Health Care
summary: Medical knowledge graphs (MKGs) infused with clinical knowledge have been increasingly used to model electronic health records (EHRs) to support interpretable predictions in healthcare domain. However, existing MKG-based approaches are limited in capturing pairwise relations between clinical concepts (e.g., conditions, procedures, and medications), and restricts their ability to model higher-order interactions among co-occurring or semantically related concepts. In addition, most representation learning methods that leverage MKGs either collapse temporal information across visits or lack an explicit mechanism for modeling long-range temporal dependencies, which is critical for clinical tasks such as mortality prediction. To mitigate these limitations, we propose HoT-SSM, a parameter efficient and higher-order temporal graph reasoning with state space models. For each visit, HoT-SSM constructs hypergraphs by grouping semantically related clinical concepts into hyperedges using domain knowledge, thereby preserving visit-level clinical context. Further, to model the temporal dynamics while learning the representations, we introduce a novel dynamic hypergraph-based state space model that explicitly captures patients latent state evolution over time while preserving long-range information. The learned representations are used for downstream clinical prediction and reasoning. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets shows significant performance improvement over the current state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling higher-order clinical interactions and long-range temporal dependencies.
summary_zh: 摘要：融入临床知识的医学知识图谱（MKGs）已被越来越多地用于对电子健康记录（EHRs）进行建模，以支持医疗领域的可解释预测。然而，现有基于MKG的方法在捕捉临床概念（如疾病、手术和药物）之间的成对关系方面存在局限，且限制了它们对共现或语义相关概念间高阶交互进行建模的能力。此外，大多数利用MKG的表示学习方法要么坍缩了不同就诊之间的时间信息，要么缺乏对长程时间依赖进行显式建模的机制，而这对死亡率预测等临床任务至关重要。为缓解这些限制，我们提出HoT-SSM——一种结合状态空间模型的参数高效高阶时序图推理方法。对于每次就诊，HoT-SSM利用领域知识将语义相关的临床概念分组为超边来构建超图，从而保留就诊级别的临床上下文。此外，为在学习表示的同时建模时序动态，我们引入了一种新颖的基于动态超图的状态空间模型，该模型在保留长程信息的同时显式捕捉患者潜在状态随时间演化的过程。学习到的表示用于下游的临床预测与推理。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验表明，与当前最先进的模型相比，性能显著提升，验证了联合建模高阶临床交互与长程时间依赖的有效性。
tldr: HoT-SSM introduces a state space model with dynamic hypergraphs to capture higher-order interactions and long-range temporal dependencies in medical knowledge graphs for clinical predictions, achieving state-of-the-art results on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.
tldr_zh: HoT-SSM提出了一种结合动态超图的状态空间模型，用于捕捉医学知识图谱中的高阶交互和长期时间依赖，在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上实现了临床预测的最佳性能。

title: Noise-Aware Visual Representation Learning for Medical Visual Question Answering
summary: Medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) has strong potential for clinical decision support by enabling AI models to interpret medical images and answer clinically relevant queries. Recent approaches typically connect off-the-shelf vision encoders with large language models (LLMs) through lightweight mapping networks to reduce computational cost. However, these methods often overlook the importance of handling noise and small irrelevant changes in visual representations. To address these challenges, we propose a noise-aware Med-VQA framework that incorporates a denoising autoencoder before visual embeddings are mapped into the input space of an LLM. The denoising autoencoder is pretrained to reconstruct clean visual embeddings from corrupted inputs, encouraging the model to learn robust visual representations that are less sensitive to noise. The resulting embeddings are then projected into the language model embedding space using a multi-layer perceptron (MLP), forming visual prefix tokens that provide image information to the LLM. To enable efficient adaptation without full retraining, we employ parameter-efficient fine-tuning using low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The proposed method is evaluated on the SLAKE and PathVQA benchmarks. Experimental results show improved robustness to noisy input embeddings while maintaining competitive clean performance across multiple evaluation criteria. These findings suggest that learning more robust visual representations can enhance Med-VQA performance and robustness.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）通过使AI模型能够解读医学图像并回答临床相关问题，在临床决策支持方面具有巨大潜力。近期方法通常通过轻量级映射网络将现成的视觉编码器与大语言模型（LLM）连接，以降低计算成本。然而，这些方法往往忽略了处理视觉表示中噪声与微小无关变化的重要性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种噪声感知的Med-VQA框架，该框架在视觉嵌入映射至LLM输入空间之前引入去噪自编码器。该去噪自编码器经过预训练，能够从受损输入中重建出干净的视觉嵌入，从而促使模型学习对噪声不敏感且鲁棒的视觉表示。随后，通过多层感知机（MLP）将所得视觉嵌入投影至语言模型嵌入空间，形成为LLM提供图像信息的视觉前缀标记。为在不进行完整重训练的情况下实现高效适配，我们采用了基于低秩适应（LoRA）的参数高效微调方法。所提方法在SLAKE和PathVQA基准上进行了评估。实验结果表明，该方法在多个评价标准下，在保持竞争力的干净性能的同时，对噪声输入嵌入的鲁棒性有所提升。这些发现表明，学习更鲁棒的视觉表示能够增强Med-VQA的性能与鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper proposes a noise-aware Med-VQA framework that uses a denoising autoencoder before mapping visual embeddings to an LLM, combined with LoRA fine-tuning, to improve robustness to noise while maintaining clean performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种噪声感知的医学视觉问答框架，在将视觉嵌入映射到大语言模型之前使用去噪自编码器，并结合LoRA微调，以提高对噪声的鲁棒性同时保持干净性能。

title: MedSIGHT: Towards Grounded Visual Comprehension in Medical Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical large vision-language models (Med-LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress in vision-language comprehension and medical image segmentation. However, existing models still struggle to unify these two capabilities, which is essential for achieving clinically reasoning that connects visual findings with semantic interpretation. We present MedSIGHT, a unified framework that equips Med-LVLMs with structured, pixel-level understanding for grounded visual comprehension. MedSIGHT introduces a novel Region Perceiver module that produces region-centric tokens, encoding spatial information directly into representation space of the language model. We further propose a medical region codebook into the LLM vocabulary, allowing the model to generate discrete region codes as symbolic representations of anatomical and pathological regions. These codes are decoded through the Region Perceiver to reconstruct segmentation mask, achieving end-to-end spatial grounding. Lastly, MedSIGHT combines Region Perceiver, Codebook and LLM using our proposed progressive training strategy to gradually aligns these modules stably. Trained on only 72K multimodal instruction pairs, MedSIGHT achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse imaging modalities on both medical comprehension and segmentation tasks.
summary_zh: 医学大视觉语言模型（Med-LVLMs）近期在视觉语言理解与医学图像分割领域取得了显著进展。然而，现有模型仍难以将这两种能力统一起来，而这对于实现连接视觉发现与语义解释的临床推理至关重要。我们提出MedSIGHT——一个统一框架，赋予Med-LVLMs结构化、像素级的理解能力，以实现有依据的视觉理解。MedSIGHT引入了一个新型区域感知器模块，该模块生成以区域为中心的标记，将空间信息直接编码到语言模型的表征空间中。我们进一步在LLM词汇表中引入了一个医学区域码本，使模型能够生成离散的区域代码，作为解剖和病理区域的符号表示。这些代码通过区域感知器解码以重建分割掩码，从而实现端到端的空间定位。最后，MedSIGHT采用我们提出的渐进训练策略，将区域感知器、码本与LLM相结合，逐步稳定地对齐这些模块。仅使用72K多模态指令对进行训练，MedSIGHT在多种成像模态的医学理解与分割任务中均达到了最先进性能。
tldr: MedSIGHT introduces a unified framework for medical large vision-language models that integrates region-level spatial understanding and segmentation via a Region Perceiver module and a medical region codebook, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both comprehension and segmentation tasks across modalities with only 72K training pairs.
tldr_zh: MedSIGHT 提出了一种统一的医学大视觉语言模型框架，通过区域感知器模块和医学区域码本实现区域级空间理解与分割，仅用7.2万训练对就在多种模态的医学理解与分割任务上达到最先进性能。

title: LLM-Guided Evolution for Medical Decision Pipelines
summary:
Adapting large language models (LLMs) to clinical workflows often requires costly fine-tuning or manual prompt and pipeline engineering. We study LLM-guided MAP-Elites evolution as an inference-time alternative for discovering medical decision strategies and provide an implementation repository at https://github.com/univanxx/llm_guided_evo_medical. We formulate urgency triage, interactive consultation, and medical image classification as evolutionary searches over executable artifacts optimized by task-specific fitness functions.
  Across all three settings, evolution improves over manually designed baselines under practical constraints. In triage, evolved programs increase Semigran accuracy from $77.3\%$ to $87.1\%$ and emergency recall from $0.60$ to $0.97$, while improving safety-weighted held-out MIMIC-ESI performance. In interactive consultation, evolved policies improve the accuracy--cost frontier across Llama-3, Qwen-3.5, and Gemma-4 and transfer to held-out iCRAFTMD. In PneumoniaMNIST, prompt-only evolution improves frozen MedGemma VLMs while preserving strict JSON outputs. Qualitative analysis shows that the gains come from interpretable program-level mechanisms, calibrated triage boundaries, targeted evidence acquisition, selective commitment, and finding-oriented visual decision rules, rather than superficial prompt rewording alone.
summary_zh: 将大型语言模型（LLMs）适配到临床工作流程通常需要昂贵的微调或手动提示词与流程工程。我们研究LLM引导的MAP-Elites演化作为一种推理时替代方案，用于发现医疗决策策略，并在https://github.com/univanxx/llm_guided_evo_medical提供实现仓库。我们将紧急分诊、交互式咨询和医学图像分类形式化为对可执行工件的演化搜索，这些工件由任务特定的适应度函数优化。在所有三种设置中，演化在实践约束下均优于手动设计的基线。在分诊中，演化程序将Semigran准确率从77.3%提升至87.1%，紧急召回率从0.60提升至0.97，同时改善了安全加权留出MIMIC-ESI性能。在交互式咨询中，演化策略优化了Llama-3、Qwen-3.5和Gemma-4的准确率-成本前沿，并迁移至留出的iCRAFTMD。在PneumoniaMNIST中，仅提示词演化改进了冻结的MedGemma VLM，同时保持严格的JSON输出。定性分析表明，性能提升源于可解释的程序级机制、校准的分诊边界、目标化证据获取、选择性承诺以及面向发现的视觉决策规则，而非仅靠表面的提示词改写。
tldr: This paper proposes using LLM-guided MAP-Elites evolution as an inference-time method to automatically discover medical decision strategies for triage, interactive consultation, and medical image classification, achieving significant performance gains over manually designed baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出使用LLM引导的MAP-Elites演化作为推理时方法，自动发现用于分诊、交互式咨询和医学图像分类的医疗决策策略，在手动的基准上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Compliance-Based Sensor Placement for Force Sensing on a Sensorized Prostate Phantom
summary: This work presents a compliance-based sensor placement method for force sensing on a sensorized prostate phantom designed for Digital Rectal Examination training. The phantom combines three internal pneumatic chambers, used as intrinsic pressure sensors, with ten surface displacement markers. A finite-element simulation dataset is generated by applying external forces at sampled surface locations, from which a compliance matrix relating force inputs to pressure and displacement responses is constructed. Based on this matrix, we propose a weighted greedy selection strategy that maximizes local force reconstructability while prioritizing the clinically relevant posterior contact region and avoiding marker placement directly within the Region of Interest. Compared with a global QR-based placement strategy, the proposed method increases the mean reconstructability score in the target region by 22.5%. These results suggest that region-aware sparse sensor placement can improve force observability in soft robotic medical phantoms while maintaining a limited and practical sensing configuration.
summary_zh: 本工作提出了一种基于柔度的传感器布置方法，用于专为直肠指检训练设计的传感器化前列腺体模的力感知。该体模将三个用作内部压力传感器的气动腔室与十个表面位移标记相结合。通过在采样表面位置施加外力生成有限元仿真数据集，由此构建了关联力输入与压力及位移响应的柔度矩阵。基于该矩阵，我们提出了一种加权贪婪选择策略，该策略在最大化局部力可重构性的同时，优先考虑临床相关的后接触区域，并避免将标记直接布置在感兴趣区域内。与基于全局QR分解的布置策略相比，所提方法将目标区域的平均可重构性评分提高了22.5%。这些结果表明，区域感知的稀疏传感器布置能够在保持有限且实用的感知配置的同时，提升软体机器人医疗体模中的力可观测性。
tldr: This paper presents a region-aware, compliance-based sparse sensor placement method for a sensorized prostate phantom used in Digital Rectal Examination training, achieving a 22.5% improvement in force reconstructability over a global QR-based strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于顺应性的区域感知稀疏传感器布局方法，用于数字直肠检查训练中的传感前列腺模型，相较于全局QR策略，力重建性能提升了22.5%。

title: C3VD-DEFCOL: A Deformable Colonoscopy Dataset with Time-Resolved 3D Ground Truth and Realistic Appearance
summary: 3D reconstruction could improve colonoscopy by estimating mucosal coverage and alerting clinicians to missed regions during screening. However, algorithm development is limited as no current datasets provide both a realistic in vivo appearance and dense, time-resolved 3D ground truth, especially under non-rigid deformation. We present C3VD-DEFCOL, a framework and dataset for evaluating deformable colonoscopy reconstruction with paired geometry and realistic texture. Starting from C3VD/C3VDv2 colon meshes and camera trajectories, we generate controlled deformations of the colon surface, including peristaltic waves and centerline motion, and render per-frame depth, surface normals, optical flow, camera poses, and time-stamped 3D meshes. We then use the rendered geometry, primarily depth, to condition an LTX-2.3-based sim-to-real translation model that produces RGB clips with in vivo-like mucosal color, texture, vasculature, and specular appearance while preserving the underlying 3D scene structure. The resulting dataset contains 110 videos from 11 unique colon mesh geometries, with varying camera trajectories, appearances, and parameterized deformation regimes, including three peristaltic severity levels that serve as controlled evaluation axes. We evaluate the generated videos using appearance realism, geometric consistency, and temporal consistency metrics, and use the paired ground truth to benchmark the downstream task of pose estimation in deformable 3D reconstruction. Our experiments show how pose estimation error increases with increasing deformation severity, providing a controlled stress test that is not possible with existing in vivo datasets. Overall, C3VD-DEFCOL is designed as a reproducible, quantitative evaluation platform for testing deformable 3D reconstruction algorithms, with the goal of reducing the domain gap between synthetic datasets and in vivo colonoscopy.
summary_zh: 3D重建可通过估算黏膜覆盖范围并在筛查期间向临床医生提示遗漏区域，从而改善结肠镜检查。然而，算法开发受到限制，因为当前没有任何数据集能同时提供逼真的体内外观和密集的时间分辨3D真值，尤其是在非刚性变形条件下。我们提出C3VD-DEFCOL，一个用于评估可变形结肠镜重建的框架与数据集，其具备配对的几何结构与逼真纹理。以C3VD/C3VDv2结肠网格和相机轨迹为基础，我们生成结肠表面的受控变形（包括蠕动波和中心线运动），并渲染每帧深度、表面法线、光流、相机位姿以及带时间戳的3D网格。随后，我们利用渲染的几何信息（主要是深度），对基于LTX-2.3的仿真到真实转换模型进行条件控制，生成具有体内样黏膜颜色、纹理、血管和镜面反射外观的RGB片段，同时保留底层3D场景结构。所得数据集包含来自11种独特结肠网格几何结构的110个视频，具有不同的相机轨迹、外观和参数化变形模式，包括三个蠕动严重度级别，作为受控评估维度。我们使用外观真实性、几何一致性和时间一致性指标评估生成的视频，并利用配对的真值，对可变形3D重建中位姿估计的下游任务进行基准测试。实验表明，位姿估计误差随变形严重度增加而增大，提供了现有体内数据集无法实现的受控压力测试。总体而言，C3VD-DEFCOL旨在作为可复现的定量评估平台，用于测试可变形3D重建算法，以缩小合成数据集与体内结肠镜之间的领域差距。
tldr: C3VD-DEFCOL is a synthetic colonoscopy dataset providing time-resolved 3D ground truth with realistic appearance under controlled deformations, enabling quantitative evaluation of deformable 3D reconstruction algorithms.
tldr_zh: C3VD-DEFCOL是一个合成结肠镜数据集，提供时间分辨的3D真实值以及受控变形下的真实外观，用于定量评估可变形三维重建算法。

title: AeroSpectra Sentinel: An Auditable LLM Prompt-Chaining Decision-Support Workflow for Acute Asthma Risk Assessment from Respiratory Sounds and Clinical Signals
summary: Acute asthma risk assessment requires rapid interpretation of respiratory sounds, oxygenation, airflow limitation, speech ability, work of breathing, mental status, and response to reliever therapy. Conventional audio-only classifiers can detect wheeze-like patterns but often lack transparent clinical reasoning and safe escalation logic. This paper presents AeroSpectra Sentinel, a client-side research prototype and decision-support workflow that combines short-time Fourier transform (STFT) respiratory sound analysis, lightweight machine-learning screening, clinical feature fusion, and a five-stage large language model (LLM) prompt-chaining process. The workflow separates signal acquisition, preprocessing, acoustic feature extraction, ML screening, clinical guardrails, and FHIR-ready reporting. We evaluated the audio screening component on a public respiratory sound dataset containing 1,211 WAV recordings from five labels. Using a stratified subset of 584 recordings, a random forest achieved 91.10% binary accuracy and 78.69% F1-score for asthma-vs-non-asthma screening, while a feature-based multilayer perceptron achieved 89.73% accuracy and 78.26% F1-score. A compact log-spectrogram CNN achieved 73.29% accuracy and 55.17% F1-score. Multiclass classification achieved 77.40% accuracy and 77.23% macro-F1. To evaluate the LLM workflow, we conducted a scenario-based audit on 40 simulated clinical vignettes comparing one-shot prompting, prompt chaining, prompt chaining with guardrails, and prompt chaining with guardrails plus FHIR schema validation. The guardrail-plus-schema variant achieved the strongest simulated safety and documentation consistency. AeroSpectra Sentinel is intended as a research prototype, not as a diagnostic medical device or clinically validated risk-assessment product.
summary_zh: 急性哮喘风险评估需要快速解读呼吸音、氧合状态、气流受限程度、言语能力、呼吸做功、精神状态以及对缓解治疗的反应。传统的纯音频分类器能够检测类似喘息的模式，但往往缺乏透明的临床推理和安全的升级逻辑。本文介绍了AeroSpectra Sentinel——一个客户端研究原型和决策支持工作流程，该流程结合了短时傅里叶变换（STFT）呼吸音分析、轻量级机器学习筛查、临床特征融合以及五阶段大语言模型（LLM）提示链式处理。该工作流程将信号采集、预处理、声学特征提取、机器学习筛查、临床安全护栏以及支持FHIR的报告生成分阶段实施。我们在一个包含1,211个WAV录音（来自五个标签）的公共呼吸音数据集上评估了音频筛查组件。使用一个分层子集（584个录音），随机森林在哮喘与非哮喘筛查中达到了91.10%的二元准确率和78.69%的F1分数，而基于特征的多层感知器达到了89.73%的准确率和78.26%的F1分数。紧凑型对数谱图CNN达到了73.29%的准确率和55.17%的F1分数。多分类任务达到了77.40%的准确率和77.23%的宏平均F1分数。为评估LLM工作流程，我们基于40个模拟临床情景进行了场景审计，比较了单次提示、提示链、带安全护栏的提示链以及带安全护栏加FHIR模式验证的提示链。带安全护栏加模式验证的变体在模拟安全性和文档一致性方面表现最强。AeroSpectra Sentinel旨在作为研究原型，而非诊断医疗设备或经临床验证的风险评估产品。
tldr: AeroSpectra Sentinel is a research prototype that combines respiratory sound analysis, machine learning, and a five-stage LLM prompt-chaining workflow for acute asthma risk assessment, demonstrating improved safety and documentation consistency through guardrails and FHIR validation on simulated vignettes.
tldr_zh: AeroSpectra Sentinel 是一个研究原型，结合呼吸音分析、机器学习和五阶段 LLM 提示链工作流，用于急性哮喘风险评估，通过护栏和 FHIR 验证在模拟场景中展示了改进的安全性和文档一致性。

title: A dual-system approach for epilepsy diagnosis: integrating mamba-Bi-LSTM architecture with SHAP-based verification
summary: This study develops a medical AI-assisted diagnosis system based on deep learning, which provides intelligent diagnostic solutions for epilepsy, a disease that seriously threatens the life and health of patients. Epilepsy has sudden and unpredictable seizures. Traditional diagnostic methods mainly rely on doctors' manual interpretation of EEG, which is time-consuming and dependent by experience. In response to the above challenges, this study designed a dual-system intelligent diagnosis framework, which includes two core components: the main discrimination system and the verification system. The main discrimination system uses a deep learning model that combines the innovative Mamba architecture with the Bi-LSTM structure to integrate and analyze heterogeneous data to achieve extremely high diagnostic accuracy; the verification system provides an explainable diagnostic basis through the SHAP method to enhance the credibility of the results. This system establishes a cross-modal database to realize intelligent analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data-fusion EEG signals and clinical text data for epilepsy. The system outputs results based on diagnostic consistency and confidence levels, and high-confidence predictions can also be used as automatic feedback sources to optimize the model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the main discriminant model of the intelligent diagnosis system for epilepsy has increased from 92.6% to 98.7% and the F1 score has increased from 0.895 to 0.992, all of which have exceeded the existing optimal methods; the average processing time for verification system feedback integration is only 220 ms, which increases the overall diagnostic accuracy by 5.1%.
summary_zh: 本研究基于深度学习开发了一套医疗人工智能辅助诊断系统，为严重威胁患者生命健康的癫痫疾病提供智能诊断方案。癫痫具有突发性和不可预测性，传统诊断方法主要依赖医生对脑电图的手动解读，耗时且依赖经验。针对上述挑战，本研究设计了一个双系统智能诊断框架，包含两大核心组件：主判别系统与验证系统。主判别系统采用结合创新Mamba架构与Bi-LSTM结构的深度学习模型，通过整合分析异构数据实现极高的诊断准确率；验证系统通过SHAP方法提供可解释的诊断依据，增强结果可信度。本系统建立了跨模态数据库，实现对多源异构数据——融合癫痫脑电信号与临床文本数据——的智能分析。系统基于诊断一致性与置信度输出结果，高置信度预测还可作为自动反馈源优化模型。实验结果表明，癫痫智能诊断系统的主判别模型准确率从92.6%提升至98.7%，F1分数从0.895提升至0.992，均超越现有最优方法；验证系统反馈集成的平均处理时间仅为220毫秒，使整体诊断准确率提升5.1%。
tldr: This paper presents a dual-system deep learning framework for epilepsy diagnosis, combining a Mamba-Bi-LSTM main model with SHAP-based verification, achieving 98.7% accuracy and 0.992 F1 score on multimodal EEG and clinical text data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于癫痫诊断的双系统深度学习框架，结合了Mamba-Bi-LSTM主模型和基于SHAP的验证系统，在多模态脑电图和临床文本数据上实现了98.7%的准确率和0.992的F1分数。

title: Active Source-free Domain Adaptation in Open-set Medical Image Segmentation via Decomposed Uncertainty and Prototype Discrepancy
summary: Deep learning (DL) methods are challenged to demonstrate robust performance across different segmentation datasets due to domain shifts, but active domain adaptation techniques enhance their generalization performance by querying a few samples from target domains for adaptation training. However in clinical practice, target domains often include private classes of new anatomical structures or pathologies that are not presented in the source data, and existing methods implement closed-set segmentation where source and target domains have the same segmentation classes. Additionally, source data are often inaccessible during adaptation due to strict data privacy regulations. To address these limitations, we propose an Active Source-free Open-set Domain Adaptation (ASFOSDA) method which is the first work to implement active learning for adapting DL models in open-set medical image segmentation without the access to source data. This method employs an active open-set query strategy to select the most informative target samples for training models based on Class-aware Decomposed Uncertainty (CDU) and Class-agnostic Prototype Discrepancy (CPD). CDU measures sample aleatoric uncertainty and model epistemic uncertainty by employing test time augmentation in stochastic processes. CPD measures cross-domain and self-domain discrepancy for selecting diverse samples. Subsequently, to boost the adaptation performance by enhancing training samples, a Target-refined Self-training strategy is proposed to generate high-quality pseudo labels for unselected samples, thus combining them with labeled samples for a semi-supervised training. We evaluated our method on cross-domain open-set volumetric medical image segmentation tasks, and it outperformed state-of-the-art adaptation methods.
summary_zh: 深度学习（DL）方法因域偏移而难以在不同分割数据集上展现稳健性能，但主动域自适应技术通过从目标域查询少量样本进行自适应训练，可提升其泛化能力。然而在临床实践中，目标域常包含源数据中未出现的新解剖结构或病理的私有类别，而现有方法在源域与目标域具有相同分割类别的情况下实现闭集分割。此外，由于严格的数据隐私规定，自适应过程中往往无法访问源数据。为解决这些限制，我们提出了一种主动无源开集域自适应（ASFOSDA）方法，这是首个在无源数据访问条件下将主动学习应用于开集医学图像分割DL模型自适应的工作。该方法采用主动开集查询策略，基于类别感知分解不确定性（CDU）和类别无关原型差异（CPD）选择最具信息量的目标样本用于模型训练。CDU通过随机过程中的测试时增强度量样本的偶然不确定性和模型的认知不确定性。CPD则通过度量跨域和自域差异来选择多样化样本。随后，为通过增强训练样本来提升自适应性能，我们提出了一种目标精炼自训练策略，为未选样本生成高质量伪标签，从而将其与标记样本结合进行半监督训练。我们在跨域开集体积医学图像分割任务上评估了该方法，其表现优于当前最先进的自适应方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel active source-free open-set domain adaptation method for medical image segmentation, using decomposed uncertainty and prototype discrepancy to select informative target samples and generate pseudo-labels, achieving state-of-the-art performance without accessing source data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的主动无源开放集域自适应方法，用于医学图像分割，通过分解不确定性和原型差异选择信息丰富的目标样本并生成伪标签，在无需源数据的情况下达到了最先进的性能。

title: Routine laboratory trajectories encode the onset of organ-level complications in cancer
summary: Routine laboratory panels drawn during cancer treatment constitute longitudinal physiological recordings of organ function, yet their temporal structure is discarded by single-timepoint prognostic tools. A transformer trained on 2,777,595 laboratory measurements from 3,905 patients with multiple myeloma or ovarian cancer predicted the two-year onset of 162 treatment-associated complications, including therapy-related myelodysplastic syndromes, spanning eight clinical categories, achieving 1.5- to 6.1-fold enrichment above prevalence at the group level. It matched or outperformed non-sequential baselines across grouped endpoints (AUROC gains up to +0.11), demonstrating that longitudinal laboratory trajectories capture evolving complication-specific physiology inaccessible from isolated measurements. Predictions generalised across both cancers, divergence concentrating in disease-specific complications, and biomarker masking recovered signatures consistent with established pathophysiology. External validation on MIMIC-IV and MMRF CoMMpass confirmed transferability across independent healthcare systems (AUROC up to 0.85). Routine oncological laboratory data encode organ deterioration weeks to months before clinical onset, enabling complication-specific surveillance without additional testing infrastructure.
summary_zh:
摘要：
癌症治疗期间常规实验室检测数据构成了器官功能的纵向生理记录，然而其时间序列结构却被单时间点的预后工具所忽略。一种基于Transformer的模型，利用来自3,905名多发性骨髓瘤或卵巢癌患者的2,777,595次实验室测量数据，预测了162种治疗相关并发症（包括治疗相关骨髓增生异常综合征）在两年内的发生，这些并发症涵盖八个临床类别，在群体水平上实现了高于患病率1.5至6.1倍的富集。在汇总终点上，该模型匹配或超越了非序列基线模型（AUROC提升高达+0.11），表明纵向实验室轨迹捕捉到了从单次测量中无法获取的、随并发症演变的特异性生理特征。预测在两个癌症类型中均具泛化能力，差异集中在疾病特异性并发症上，而生物标志物掩膜分析恢复了与已知病理生理学一致的信号特征。在MIMIC-IV和MMRF CoMMpass上的外部验证证实了其在不同独立医疗系统间的可迁移性（AUROC最高达0.85）。常规肿瘤学实验室数据编码了临床发病前数周至数月的器官功能恶化信息，从而无需额外检测设施即可实现并发症特异性监测。
tldr: A transformer model trained on 2.7 million routine lab measurements from cancer patients predicts the two-year onset of 162 treatment-associated complications, outperforming non-sequential baselines and generalizing across cancers and hospital systems.
tldr_zh: 基于270万次常规实验室测量数据训练的Transformer模型，能够预测癌症患者两年内162种治疗相关并发症的发生，优于非时序基线，且在不同癌症类型和医疗系统中具有泛化能力。

title: Baichuan-M4: A Clinical-Grade Medical Agent System for Continuous Care
summary: Baichuan-M4 is Baichuan Intelligence's clinical-grade medical large model, designed for continuous care rather than single-turn medical question answering. It is built as a coordinated medical agent system around three pillars: Baichuan-Harness, a unified runtime that keeps reinforcement-learning training and real-world deployment consistent while enforcing action constraints, tool use, long-term patient memory, and multi-agent coordination; a core reasoning model trained with a continuous-care reinforcement-learning framework that integrates span-level reward modeling (SPAR++), reasoning-path compression, curriculum learning, and stabilized policy optimization; and a clinical tool layer for patient-memory management, authoritative evidence-based retrieval, and multimodal medical perception across documents, X-rays, and dermatology. On a cross-dimensional medical evaluation suite, Baichuan-M4 attains leading results in static medical knowledge and safety, dynamic OSCE-style consultation, long-context clinical memory, evidence-based retrieval, medical document OCR, and multimodal image understanding, while lowering the hallucination rate to 3.3%.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
百川-M4是百川智能推出的临床级医学大模型，专为持续性护理设计，而非单轮医疗问答。该模型构建为一个协同式医疗智能体系统，围绕三大支柱：百川-Harness——一个统一的运行框架，确保强化学习训练与实际部署的一致性，同时强制执行动作约束、工具使用、长期患者记忆及多智能体协调；核心推理模型——采用持续性护理强化学习框架训练，融合了跨度级奖励建模（SPAR++）、推理路径压缩、课程学习与稳定策略优化；以及临床工具层——用于患者记忆管理、权威循证检索，以及涵盖文档、X光片和皮肤影像的多模态医学感知。在多维度医学评估套件中，百川-M4在静态医学知识与安全性、动态OSCE式问诊、长上下文临床记忆、循证检索、医学文档OCR及多模态图像理解方面均取得领先结果，同时将幻觉率降至3.3%。
tldr: Baichuan-M4 is a clinical-grade medical agent system designed for continuous care, integrating a unified runtime, a core reasoning model trained with a novel continuous-care reinforcement-learning framework (including SPAR++ reward modeling), and a clinical tool layer, achieving state-of-the-art results across multiple medical evaluation tasks with a hallucination rate of 3.3%.
tldr_zh: Baichuan-M4 是一个临床级医疗智能体系统，专为连续护理设计，集成了统一运行时环境、基于新型连续护理强化学习框架（包括 SPAR++ 奖励建模）训练的核心推理模型以及临床工具层，在多项医疗评估任务中取得领先结果，幻觉率降至 3.3%。

title: Deterministic Integrity Gates for LLM-Assisted Clinical Manuscript Preparation: An Auditable Biomedical Informatics Architecture
summary: As autonomous research agents and AI co-scientist systems push large language models (LLMs) from drafting toward end-to-end manuscript production, the bottleneck shifts from generation to verification. Fluent LLM output can hide fabricated citations, numbers that drift from source tables, and unmet reporting-guideline items; existing tools generate without verifying, and self-critique inherits the blind spots that produce confident fabrication. We describe an architecture pairing generation with verification, resting on three principles: decompose the workflow into self-contained skills, gate every stage transition with halt-on-failure, and resolve each integrity question with the cheapest sufficient mechanism, a deterministic, re-executable check where one suffices and a prose-level probe only where interpretation is unavoidable. This determinism-where-possible split, organized as an integrity-gate taxonomy, is the core contribution. It is realized as MedSci Skills, an open-source toolkit of 43 skills with a 21-detector deterministic tier, evaluated on three public-dataset pipelines (STARD, PRISMA, STROBE) and a seeded-defect ablation. Across the three pipelines every content-hash manifest verified clean and the gates surfaced real defects; on 27 identical injected defects the deterministic gates detected all 27 with no false positives on the matched clean fixtures, whereas a single-prompt LLM reviewer detected 11, its misses in code, bibliography, and style defects the prose hides. Determinism-where-possible verification yields an auditable, re-executable trail that exposes the evidence a human needs to check an LLM-assisted manuscript: feasibility and reproducibility evidence, not a claim of human-competitive quality, which a separate blinded study addresses. MedSci Skills is MIT-licensed and archived (v3.8.0).
summary_zh: 随着自主研究智能体与人工智能协同科学家系统将大语言模型从起草阶段推向端到端稿件生产，瓶颈已从生成转向验证。流畅的大语言模型输出可能隐藏虚构的引用、偏离源表格的数字以及未满足的报告指南条目；现有工具仅生成而未验证，自我批评则继承了产生自信虚构的盲点。我们提出了一种将生成与验证相结合的架构，基于三项原则：将工作流分解为自包含技能，对每个阶段转换设置失败即停止的门控，并以最廉价且充分的机制解决每个完整性疑问——凡能用确定性、可重执行的检查解决的，则使用该方式；仅在必须进行解释时才使用散文级探测。这种“尽可能确定性”的拆分，组织成完整性门控分类体系，是本文的核心贡献。该架构已实现为MedSci Skills，一个包含43项技能的开源工具包，其中21项为确定性检测器，并在三个公开数据集管道（STARD、PRISMA、STROBE）以及一个种子缺陷消融实验中进行了评估。在三个管道中，每个内容哈希清单均经验证为清洁，门控暴露了真实缺陷；在27个相同的注入缺陷上，确定性门控检测到全部27个，且匹配的清洁固定件上无假阳性，而单提示大语言模型审阅者仅检测到11个，其遗漏之处在于代码、参考文献和风格缺陷——这些正是散文所隐藏的。尽可能确定性的验证产生了一条可审计、可重执行的轨迹，揭示了人类检查大语言模型辅助稿件所需的证据：可行性与可再现性证据，而非人类水平质量的声明——后者由另一项独立盲法研究处理。MedSci Skills采用MIT许可协议并已存档（v3.8.0）。
tldr: This paper presents MedSci Skills, an open-source toolkit that uses deterministic integrity gates to verify LLM-generated clinical manuscripts by decomposing the workflow into skills with halt-on-failure checks, achieving perfect detection of injected defects compared to a baseline LLM reviewer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MedSci Skills，一个开源工具包，通过将工作流分解为技能并采用故障即停的确定性完整性门控来验证LLM生成的临床手稿，在注入缺陷检测上达到完美效果，优于基线LLM审查器。

title: TRIAGE: Dialectical Reasoning for Explainable Risk Prediction on Irregularly Sampled Medical Time Series with LLMs
summary: Clinical early warning systems built on electronic health records, in which clinical observations are recorded as irregularly sampled medical time series (ISMTS), must deliver both calibrated risk scores for patient triage and interpretable rationales that clinicians can verify. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been explored for this task, yet they collapse graded clinical risk into overconfident binary predictions. This risk polarization undermines both calibration and cross-patient comparability. To address this, we propose TRIAGE, a framework that trains an LLM to generate dialectical reasoning over competing clinical outcomes by eliciting outcome-specific rationales. This dialectical formulation mitigates risk polarization, enabling a single LLM to yield continuous risk scores grounded in explicit clinical reasoning. Evaluated on three ISMTS benchmarks, TRIAGE achieves an average AUPRC improvement of 3.3% and reduces calibration error by 81% compared to the competitive baselines. An LLM-as-a-judge assessment further shows that our rationales surpass post-hoc explanations from the baseline by 20% in clinical reasoning quality. The source code is available at https://github.com/HyeongWon-Jang/TRIAGE .
summary_zh: 基于电子健康记录（其中临床观察被记录为不规则采样的医学时间序列，ISMTS）构建的临床早期预警系统，必须既能提供用于患者分诊的校准风险评分，又能提供临床医生可验证的可解释依据。大语言模型（LLM）已被探索用于此任务，但这类模型会将分级的临床风险退化为过度自信的二分类预测。这种风险极化削弱了校准效果和跨患者可比性。为此，我们提出TRIAGE框架，该框架通过引导模型生成针对竞争性临床结局的辩证推理，使LLM能够产出针对特定结局的理由依据。这种辩证表述方式缓解了风险极化，使得单个LLM能够产生基于明确临床推理的连续风险评分。在三个ISMTS基准上的评估表明，与竞争基线相比，TRIAGE平均AUPRC提升3.3%，校准误差降低81%。基于LLM作为评判者的评估进一步显示，我们的推理依据在临床推理质量上比基线的后验解释高出20%。源代码可在https://github.com/HyeongWon-Jang/TRIAGE获取。
tldr: TRIAGE trains an LLM to generate dialectical reasoning over competing clinical outcomes, mitigating risk polarization and improving calibration and interpretability for risk prediction on irregularly sampled medical time series.
tldr_zh: TRIAGE训练大型语言模型对竞争性的临床结果进行辩证推理，减轻风险极化，提高对不规则采样医疗时间序列进行风险预测的校准性和可解释性。

title: PACT: Learning Diverse Diagnostic Strategies via Privileged Synthesis and Branch Consensus
summary: Clinical diagnosis requires flexible use of multiple reasoning paradigms under incomplete patient information. Existing LLM-based medical agents show strong medical reasoning ability, but single-paradigm or naively mixed dialogue supervision makes these paradigms difficult to learn without interference. We propose \textbf{PACT} (Periodic Anchor Consensus Training), a framework that couples supervised multi-paradigm dialogue synthesis with consensus-based Branch training. At the data level, \textbf{DPS} (Doctor-Patient-Supervisor) uses complete electronic medical records (EMRs) for quality control while keeping the doctor agent restricted to patient-visible information. This produces validated dialogues under four diagnostic reasoning paradigms without leaking hidden clinical answers. At the training level, PACT trains one paradigm-specific LoRA Branch per paradigm and periodically aggregates Branches into a shared Anchor through sign consensus. We further construct a dynamic multi-turn Chinese medical diagnosis benchmark for interactive consultation. Experiments show that PACT achieves state-of-the-art performance among compared proprietary, medical-specialized, and task-adapted baselines on diagnostic outcome and consultation-process metrics.
summary_zh: 临床诊断需要在患者信息不完整的情况下灵活运用多种推理范式。现有的基于LLM的医疗智能体展现出强大的医学推理能力，但单一范式或简单混合的对话监督使得这些范式在学习时难以避免相互干扰。我们提出**PACT**（周期性锚点共识训练），这是一个将监督式多范式对话合成与基于共识的分支训练相结合的框架。在数据层面，**DPS**（医生-患者-监督者）使用完整的电子病历（EMR）进行质量控制，同时将医生智能体限制在患者可见的信息范围内，从而在四种诊断推理范式下生成验证对话，且不泄露隐藏的临床答案。在训练层面，PACT为每种范式训练一个范式专属的LoRA分支，并通过符号共识定期将各分支聚合成一个共享的锚点。我们进一步构建了一个用于交互式咨询的动态多轮中文医疗诊断基准。实验表明，在诊断结果和咨询过程指标上，PACT在与专有、医疗专业和任务适配基线的比较中达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: PACT proposes a framework for training LLM-based medical agents to learn multiple diagnostic reasoning paradigms by using privileged synthesis from complete EMRs and consensus-based branch aggregation, achieving SOTA on a Chinese medical benchmark.
tldr_zh: PACT 提出一个框架，通过利用完整电子病历的特权合成和基于共识的分支聚合，训练基于 LLM 的医疗代理学习多种诊断推理范式，在中文医疗基准上取得了最先进的结果。

title: MAGIS: Evidence-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning for Interpretable Strabismus Clinical Decision-Making
summary: Strabismus is a common ocular disorder that requires fine-grained subtype diagnosis for individualized treatment planning. However, existing deep learning methods mainly provide diagnostic predictions without transparent reasoning, while recent large vision-language models (LVLMs), although promising for joint image understanding and report generation, remain highly prone to hallucination in this evidence-sensitive and rule-driven medical task. To address these challenges, we propose MAGIS, an evidence-based Multi-AGent reasoning for Interpretable Strabismus diagnosis framework. MAGIS transforms black-box end-to-end generation into a structured diagnostic process consisting of candidate hypothesis generation, dual-evidence constrained context, evidence-based corrective verification, and report generation. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-Evidence Constrained Context (DECC) mechanism that jointly organizes visual evidence from the photograph of the nine cardinal positions of gaze and evidence-based clinical diagnostic rules into a constrained context for reliable diagnostic reasoning. We further develop an Evidence-Based Corrective Verification (EBCV) mechanism that verifies whether the current diagnostic hypothesis is supported by visual evidence, heatmap-based visual cues, and evidence-based clinical diagnostic rules. Hypothesis refinement is triggered when inconsistency is detected. Experiments on a fine-grained strabismus benchmark demonstrate that MAGIS not only significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art diagnostic systems, improving the weighted F1 score from 72.0% to 91.3%, but also substantially improves the clinical reliability (consistency, alignment, and completeness) of generated diagnostic reports. These results demonstrate that MAGIS provides an effective solution for building accurate, evidence-based, and clinically interpretable strabismus diagnosis systems.
summary_zh: 斜视是一种常见的眼部疾病，需要细粒度亚型诊断以制定个性化治疗方案。然而，现有深度学习方法主要提供诊断预测，缺乏透明推理；而近期的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）虽有前景，可同时进行图像理解与报告生成，但在这一对证据敏感且规则驱动的医学任务中极易产生幻觉。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MAGIS——一种基于证据的多智能体可解释斜视诊断推理框架。MAGIS将黑箱端到端生成转化为结构化诊断过程，包括候选假设生成、双重证据约束上下文、基于证据的纠正性验证与报告生成。具体而言，我们引入双重证据约束上下文（DECC）机制，将九方位眼位照片的视觉证据与基于证据的临床诊断规则有机组织为约束上下文，以实现可靠的诊断推理。我们进一步开发了基于证据的纠正性验证（EBCV）机制，用于验证当前诊断假设是否得到视觉证据、基于热图的视觉线索以及基于证据的临床诊断规则的支持。当检测到不一致时，将触发假设修正。在细粒度斜视基准上的实验表明，MAGIS不仅显著优于其他最先进的诊断系统，将加权F1分数从72.0%提升至91.3%，而且大幅提升了生成诊断报告的临床可靠性（一致性、对齐性与完整性）。这些结果表明，MAGIS为构建准确、基于证据且临床可解释的斜视诊断系统提供了有效解决方案。
