tldr: MAGIS is a multi-agent framework that uses dual-evidence constraints and corrective verification to achieve accurate and interpretable clinical diagnosis of strabismus, significantly outperforming prior deep learning and LVLM methods.
tldr_zh: MAGIS 是一个多智能体框架，通过双重证据约束和纠错验证实现准确可解释的斜视临床诊断，性能显著优于之前的深度学习和大型视觉语言模型方法。

title: Experience Makes Skillful: Enabling Generalizable Medical Agent Reasoning via Self-Evolving Skill Memory
summary: Medical agent systems are increasingly expected to support interactive clinical decision making rather than only static question answering. In such settings, effective agents must reuse prior experience across evolving cases, yet existing memory mechanisms often retain raw historical traces that are redundant, noisy, and difficult to govern. More importantly, they rarely distinguish which memories are truly useful for future reasoning. This limits their ability to accumulate compact and reliable experience for long-horizon clinical reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SkeMex, a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights. SkeMex distills informative interaction trajectories into structured skills that encode reusable procedural knowledge, and organizes them into a multi-branch repository spanning general, task-specific, and action-level experience. To determine which memories should be reused and retained, SkeMex estimates context-dependent utility from environment feedback and uses it to guide value-aware retrieval and repository governance. A closed-loop ``Read--Write--Assess--Govern" lifecycle further supports continual evolution by writing new skills, updating utilities, promoting useful memories, and removing harmful entries. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that SkeMex consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings. It also generalizes across model backbones and supports transferable skill memory. All data and code will be released publicly.
summary_zh: 摘要：医疗代理系统日益被期望支持交互式临床决策，而不仅仅是静态的问答。在此类场景中，高效的代理必须能够在不断演变的病例中复用先前经验，然而现有的记忆机制往往保留原始历史轨迹，这些轨迹冗余、包含噪声且难以管理。更重要的是，它们很少区分哪些记忆对未来推理真正有用。这限制了它们为长期临床推理积累紧凑且可靠经验的能力。为弥补这一不足，我们提出SkeMex——一种部署后的自我进化框架，通过基于技能的记忆来改进医疗代理，且无需更新模型权重。SkeMex将信息丰富的交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化的技能，这些技能编码了可复用的程序性知识，并将其组织成一个涵盖通用、任务特定和动作层面经验的多分支知识库。为确定哪些记忆应被复用和保留，SkeMex从环境反馈中估计上下文相关的效用，并以此指导价值感知的检索与知识库管理。一个闭环的“读-写-评估-管理”生命周期通过写入新技能、更新效用、提升有用记忆和移除有害条目，进一步支持持续进化。在多种临床任务上的实验表明，SkeMex在离线和在线设置下均持续优于代表性的基于记忆的代理。它还能跨模型骨干进行泛化，并支持可迁移的技能记忆。所有数据和代码将公开发布。
tldr: SkeMex is a post-deployment self-evolution framework that enables medical agents to accumulate structured skill memory from experiences, using utility estimation and governance to improve clinical reasoning without retraining.
tldr_zh: SkeMex是一个后部署自进化框架，通过从经验中积累结构化技能记忆，并利用效用评估和治理机制，无需重新训练即可提升医学代理的临床推理能力。

title: A multi-agent system for spine MRI report generation from multi-sequence imaging
summary: Spinal pathology is a leading cause of pain and disability worldwide. Spine MRI is central to clinical evaluation, yet its interpretation remains complex and time-consuming, requiring integration of information across multiple imaging sequences and anatomical regions. Despite recent advances in automated MRI analysis, effectively combining multi-sequence data while preserving sequence-specific diagnostic information remains an open challenge. Here we present SpineAgent, a multi-agent framework for spine MRI report generation built upon a multi-sequence foundation model trained on routine clinical data from 32,047 patients and 453,683 MRI series, comprising a total of 13,441,191 MRI slices. To accommodate diverse modalities of sequences, we first pre-train two DINOv3-based encoders separately on T1- and T2-weighted sequences. We then introduce a continual training strategy that learns a synthesizer to embed images of other sequences using the T1 and T2 encoders, producing patient-level embedding that integrates various signals across MRI sequences. Using these embeddings, SpineAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance, and demonstrates strong generalizability under cross-manufacturer and cross-cohort evaluation. Beyond classification, SpineAgent enables pathology localization by identifying findings-relevant slices and segmenting pathological regions. It also supports multimodal image-report retrieval, providing a solid foundation for scalable and explainable MRI report generation. We further integrate these validated capabilities of SpineAgent into 37 specialized agents. Finally, we incorporate their outputs as structured tokens within a Medical Report Agent trained end-to-end for report generation. Through both automated metrics and expert evaluation by five radiologists, SpineAgent achieves leading performance in spine MRI report generation.
summary_zh: 脊柱病理学是全球范围内疼痛和残疾的主要原因之一。脊柱MRI是临床评估的核心手段，但其解读仍然复杂且耗时，需要整合来自多个成像序列和解剖区域的信息。尽管近年来自动化MRI分析取得了进展，但如何有效结合多序列数据同时保留序列特异性诊断信息仍是一个开放挑战。在此，我们提出SpineAgent——一个基于多序列基础模型构建的脊柱MRI报告生成多智能体框架，该模型使用来自32,047名患者和453,683个MRI序列的常规临床数据进行训练，共计13,441,191张MRI切片。为适应多样的序列模态，我们首先分别针对T1加权和T2加权序列预训练了两个基于DINOv3的编码器。随后引入一种持续训练策略，学习一个合成器以利用T1和T2编码器嵌入其他序列的图像，生成整合各MRI序列中不同信号的患者级嵌入。利用这些嵌入，SpineAgent实现了最先进的性能，并在跨厂商及跨队列评估中展现出强大的泛化能力。除分类外，SpineAgent还通过识别与发现相关的切片并分割病理区域来实现病理定位。它还支持多模态图像-报告检索，为可扩展且可解释的MRI报告生成奠定了坚实基础。我们进一步将这些经过验证的SpineAgent能力集成到37个专门智能体中。最后，我们将其输出作为结构化标记嵌入到一个端到端训练的医学报告智能体中，用于报告生成。通过自动化指标及五位放射科专家的评估，SpineAgent在脊柱MRI报告生成中取得了领先性能。
tldr: SpineAgent is a multi-agent framework that leverages a multi-sequence foundation model trained on over 13 million MRI slices to generate spine MRI reports, achieving state-of-the-art performance and enabling pathology localization and image-report retrieval.
tldr_zh: SpineAgent是一个多智能体框架，利用在超过1300万张MRI切片上训练的多序列基础模型生成脊柱MRI报告，实现了最先进的性能，并支持病理定位和图像-报告检索。

title: LLM-Orchestrated Conformance Checking in Stroke Care Without Computer-Interpretable Guidelines
summary:
Objective: Conformance checking in healthcare seeks to assess whether patient care pathways adhere to clinical guidelines. However, its practical application often depends on the availability of formal, machine-interpretable representations of guidelines, such as Computer-Interpretable Guidelines (CIGs), which are seldom available in real-world clinical settings.
  Methods: This work introduces a modular framework based on the orchestration of Large Language Models (LLMs) to support medical conformance checking directly from unstructured clinical and guideline texts, without requiring predefined CIGs. The proposed architecture integrates multiple LLMs and supporting components to extract patient traces from clinical discharge letters, identify normative rules from textual clinical guidelines, translate these rules into executable scripts, and compute a Trace Conformance Indicator to quantify compliance within the event log.
  Results: The framework was implemented and evaluated in the stroke care domain at the neurological ward of Alessandria Hospital. Hundreds of patient traces were automatically extracted from hospital data and assessed against 50 rules derived from the reference guideline. The analysis showed that more than 86\% of the available traces were conformant.
  Conclusion: The results demonstrate the feasibility of using orchestrated LLMs for practical healthcare conformance analysis. At the same time, the study provides evidence of a high level of adherence to stroke care guidelines at Alessandria Hospital.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
**目的：** 医疗领域的一致性检查旨在评估患者诊疗路径是否符合临床指南。然而，其实际应用通常依赖于正式的、机器可解释的指南表示形式（如计算机可解释指南，CIGs），而在真实临床环境中此类资源往往难以获取。  
**方法：** 本研究提出一种基于大语言模型（LLMs）编排的模块化框架，可直接从非结构化的临床文本和指南文本中支持医疗一致性检查，无需预定义CIGs。该架构整合多个LLMs及辅助组件，实现从临床出院信中提取患者轨迹、从文本化临床指南中识别规范性规则、将规则转化为可执行脚本，并计算轨迹一致性指标以量化事件日志中的合规程度。  
**结果：** 该框架在亚历山德里亚医院神经内科病房的中风护理领域进行了实施与评估。从医院数据中自动提取数百条患者轨迹，并依据参考指南推导出的50条规则进行评估。分析显示，超过86%的可获取轨迹符合要求。  
**结论：** 结果验证了使用编排式LLMs进行实用性医疗一致性分析的可行性。同时，本研究为亚历山德里亚医院中风护理指南的高度遵循提供了证据。
tldr: This paper presents a modular framework that orchestrates multiple Large Language Models to perform conformance checking in stroke care directly from unstructured clinical notes and guideline texts, eliminating the need for formal computer-interpretable guidelines and achieving over 86% conformance in a hospital evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化框架，通过编排多个大型语言模型直接从非结构化临床文本和指南文本中进行卒中护理合规性检查，无需正式的计算机可解释指南，并在医院评估中实现了超过86%的合规率。

title: Can the Environment Speak for Itself? $T^{2}$-GRPO: A Turn-Trajectory Group Relative Policy Optimization for Caregiver Agents
summary: Optimizing large language models (LLMs) for long-horizon caregiver agents requires balancing delayed task objectives with immediate environment dynamics, such as patient distress and resistance. In dementia care, this balance is especially difficult: trajectory level rewards are too sparse for turn level credit assignment, while external LLM-based evaluators are costly and can misread fragmented or indirect patient responses. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{T}urn-\textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{G}roup \textbf{R}elative \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{T$^{2}$-GRPO}), a framework that decouples caregiver RL into two normalized reward horizons and enforces safety through a binary hard veto. $T^2$-GRPO derives dense turn-level rewards directly from environment state transitions, measuring changes in patient distress and resistance from a frozen dementia patient simulator. These environment-grounded rewards are combined with trajectory-level evaluations through independent centered-rank normalization, which preserves heterogeneous reward signals and mitigates reward collapse. Extensive experiments on dementia caregivers show that T $^{2}$-GRPO outperforms competitive baselines, indicating a substantial improvement for emotionally sensitive caregiver scenarios that effectively handles immediate patient feedback, long-term care outcomes, and safety constraints.
summary_zh: 摘要：优化面向长期照护智能体的大型语言模型（LLM）需要在延迟任务目标与即时环境动态（如患者的痛苦与抗拒）之间取得平衡。在痴呆症照护中，这种平衡尤为困难：轨迹级奖励过于稀疏，难以用于回合级信用分配，而基于外部LLM的评估器成本高昂，且可能误判碎片化或间接的患者反应。为解决这一问题，我们提出**回合-轨迹组相对策略优化**（**T$^{2}$-GRPO**），该框架将照护强化学习解耦为两个归一化奖励视界，并通过二值硬否决机制保障安全性。$T^2$-GRPO直接从环境状态转移中提取密集的回合级奖励，通过一个冻结的痴呆症患者模拟器测量患者痛苦与抗拒程度的变化。这些基于环境的奖励通过独立的中心秩归一化与轨迹级评估相结合，从而保留异质奖励信号并缓解奖励崩溃。在痴呆症照护场景上的大量实验表明，T$^{2}$-GRPO优于多个竞争基线，显著提升了情感敏感的照护场景的性能，能够有效处理即时的患者反馈、长期照护结果以及安全约束。
tldr: Proposes T²-GRPO, a reinforcement learning framework for LLM-based caregiver agents in dementia care that decouples turn-level and trajectory-level rewards using environment-grounded signals and binary safety veto, outperforming baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出T²-GRPO，一种用于痴呆症护理中基于LLM的护理智能体的强化学习框架，该框架通过环境接地信号和二进制安全否决将回合级和轨迹级奖励解耦，性能优于基线。

title: Model-based Optimization of Anguilliform Swimming Gaits for Soft Robotic Applications
summary: In this paper, we introduce the Soft Lamprey-Inspired Dual Environment Robot (SLIDER) and a proper modeling and optimization procedure employed to design the robot. We represent the primary fluid environment actions - inertial effects, vortex forces, and viscous dissipation - using Lighthill's theory for large-amplitude elongated bodies. For structural design parameters such as internal pressure, tail size, and body stiffness, a fast, geometrically and materially nonlinear model is developed and validated. The fluid-structure interaction equations are solved implicitly with an efficient second-order box method. A pneumatic manifold robotic system is employed to actuate SLIDER in a quiescent water tank environment, allowing cross-comparison of computational and experimental results. We find that low-frequency swimming is dominated by resistant environmental forces, whereas higher-frequency swimming is primarily affected by inertial fluid forces. Using our efficient model alongside a genetic algorithm, we co-optimize a swimming control pattern and caudal fin design (subject to SLIDER's climbing morphology) to achieve a tethered swimming speed of 21.7 +/- 0.4 cm/s (0.59 Bl/s). Furthermore, we investigate the optimization procedure for a multimodal robot performing both swimming and climbing tasks.
summary_zh: 在本论文中，我们介绍了一种软体七鳃鳗仿生双环境机器人（SLIDER）及其设计所采用的建模与优化流程。我们利用Lighthill的大振幅细长体理论来表征主要的流体环境作用——惯性效应、涡旋力及粘性耗散。针对内部压力、尾鳍尺寸及身体刚度等结构设计参数，我们开发并验证了一种快速的几何与材料非线性模型。流固耦合方程通过高效的二阶盒式方法隐式求解。采用气动歧管机器人系统驱动SLIDER在静水槽环境中运动，从而实现了计算与实验结果的交叉对比。我们发现，低频游泳主要受阻力环境力支配，而高频游泳则主要受惯性流体力影响。利用我们的高效模型及遗传算法，我们协同优化了游泳控制模式与尾鳍设计（受限于SLIDER的攀爬形态），实现了21.7±0.4 cm/s（0.59 Bl/s）的系留游泳速度。此外，我们还研究了执行游泳与攀爬双重任务的多模态机器人的优化流程。
tldr: This paper presents SLIDER, a soft lamprey-inspired robot, and introduces a modeling and optimization framework using Lighthill's theory and a genetic algorithm to co-optimize swimming gaits and fin design, achieving a tethered speed of 21.7 cm/s.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种软体鳗鱼机器人SLIDER，并提出了基于Lighthill理论和遗传算法的建模与优化框架，协同优化游泳步态和尾鳍设计，实现了21.7厘米/秒的绳系游泳速度。

title: Improving PET/CT-Based Whole-Body Lesion Segmentation Using Prediction Uncertainty-Augmented Models
summary: Accurate lesion segmentation from whole-body Positron Emission Tomography (PET)/Computed Tomography (CT) scans is essential for cancer staging and treatment planning. PET provides functional metabolic information with different radiotracers, while CT offers anatomical localization. Lesion delineation from PET/CT imaging is clinically challenging due to subtle imaging features, confounders, and inter-reader variability. Existing deep learning approaches suffer from training-related stochasticity, inconsistent predictions, missed lesions in high tumor-burden cases, and lack uncertainty quantification, limiting their clinical reliability. Using nnU-Net as a baseline, we propose an uncertainty-aware framework for whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation that integrates (1) Bayesian ensembling to reduce training stochasticity, (2) voxel-wise uncertainty quantification with epistemic and aleatoric decomposition, and (3) epistemic uncertainty-augmented training to improve lesion detection. Two public datasets, AutoPET-III (1,611 scans) and Deep-PSMA (200 scans), comprising FDG and PSMA studies across multiple cancer types, are used for training and evaluation. Bayesian ensembling improves robustness and performance over deterministic nnU-Net models on the unseen AutoPET-III test set. Uncertainty maps highlight regions of model disagreement and correlate with misclassifications, particularly false positives. Uncertainty-augmented training improves lesion recovery at the cost of increased FPVol, reflecting a precision-recall trade-off. A case-adaptive routing strategy further improves Dice by selecting between the base and augmented models. To our knowledge, this is the first study to systematically investigate uncertainty quantification in multi-tracer, pan-cancer PET/CT segmentation and to combine Bayesian ensembling with uncertainty-aware modeling for this task.
summary_zh: 从全身正电子发射断层扫描（PET）/计算机断层扫描（CT）图像中准确分割病灶对于癌症分期和治疗规划至关重要。PET利用不同放射性示踪剂提供功能性代谢信息，而CT提供解剖定位。由于影像特征细微、存在混杂因素以及阅片者间差异，从PET/CT图像中勾画病灶在临床上具有挑战性。现有的深度学习方法存在训练相关随机性、预测不一致、高肿瘤负荷病例中漏检病灶以及缺乏不确定性量化等问题，限制了其临床可靠性。以nnU-Net为基线，我们提出了一种面向全身PET/CT病灶分割的不确定性感知框架，该框架整合了：（1）贝叶斯集成以减少训练随机性；（2）基于体素的不确定性量化，并分解为认知不确定性与偶然不确定性；（3）认知不确定性增强训练以改善病灶检测。使用两个公开数据集——AutoPET-III（1,611次扫描）和Deep-PSMA（200次扫描），涵盖多种癌症类型的FDG和PSMA研究，进行训练与评估。在未见过的AutoPET-III测试集上，贝叶斯集成相比确定性nnU-Net模型提升了稳健性和性能。不确定性图突出了模型存在分歧的区域，并与错误分类（尤其是假阳性）相关。不确定性增强训练在增加FPVol（假阳性体积）的代价下提高了病灶检出率，体现了精确率-召回率的权衡。一种病例自适应路由策略通过选择基础模型或增强模型进一步提升了Dice系数。据我们所知，本研究首次系统性地探讨了多示踪剂、泛癌种PET/CT分割中的不确定性量化，并针对该任务将贝叶斯集成与不确定性感知建模相结合。
tldr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware framework based on nnU-Net for whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation, integrating Bayesian ensembling, voxel-wise uncertainty quantification, and uncertainty-augmented training to improve robustness and lesion detection, with evaluation on multi-tracer, pan-cancer datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于 nnU-Net 的不确定性感知框架，用于全身 PET/CT 病灶分割，集成了贝叶斯集成、体素级不确定性量化和不确定性增强训练，以提高鲁棒性和病灶检测能力，并在多示踪剂、泛癌数据集上进行了评估。

title: ++nnU-Net: Scaling nnU-Net with Prefix-Based Data Augmentation
summary: The nnU-Net has demonstrated continuous success in medical segmentation tasks, which heavily rely on the availability and diversity of annotated biomedical data. However, assembling medical imaging cohorts remains challenging due to numerous factors such as privacy regulations and annotation costs. As a result, data augmentation plays a crucial role in increasing data availability while maintaining anatomical feasibility. Hence, we propose the ++nnU-Net, a novel data augmentation module based on image registration that operates prior to preprocessing and training take place. Our framework was evaluated across five different 2D datasets. In this workflow, image data go through a two-stage registration process, generating new warped images. The transformations are then applied to the respective segmentation. In addition, the pipeline computes available disk space, generates supplementary binary synthetic masks and generates checkpoints. We demonstrate that the ++nnU-Net outperforms the nnU-Net baseline, yielding improvements in Dice Similarity Coefficient scores. In the most prominent cases, we observe performance gains of approximately 22\%. These findings highlight the effectiveness of registration-based data augmentation, particularly for 2D medical imaging datasets and suggest that the ++nnU-Net provides a practical and scalable approach for enhancing segmentation performance in data-limited settings. The source code for the ++nnU-Net is available at: https://github.com/sofia-adelie/plusplusnnunet.git
summary_zh: nnU-Net在医学分割任务中持续取得成功，这高度依赖于标注生物医学数据的可用性和多样性。然而，由于隐私法规和标注成本等诸多因素，收集医学影像队列仍然具有挑战性。因此，数据增强在提高数据可用性同时保持解剖学可行性方面发挥着关键作用。为此，我们提出++nnU-Net，一种基于图像配准的新型数据增强模块，在预处理和训练之前运行。我们的框架在五个不同的2D数据集上进行了评估。在该工作流程中，图像数据经过两阶段配准过程，生成新的变形图像，然后将变换应用于相应的分割结果。此外，该流程还计算可用磁盘空间、生成补充性二元合成掩膜并创建检查点。我们证明++nnU-Net优于nnU-Net基线，在Dice相似系数得分上有所提升。在最显著的情况下，我们观察到约22%的性能提升。这些发现凸显了基于配准的数据增强的有效性，尤其适用于2D医学影像数据集，并表明++nnU-Net为数据有限场景下提升分割性能提供了实用且可扩展的方法。++nnU-Net的源代码可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/sofia-adelie/plusplusnnunet.git
tldr: This paper proposes ++nnU-Net, a registration-based data augmentation module that operates before preprocessing and training, improving segmentation performance on 2D medical imaging datasets by up to 22% over the nnU-Net baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出++nnU-Net，一种基于图像配准的预处理数据增强模块，在2D医学影像数据集上相比nnU-Net基线最高提升22%的分割性能。

title: Belief-Space Control for Personalized Cancer Treatment via Active Inference
summary: Cancer treatment is at the core a sequential decision-making problem with partial observability, latent patient heterogeneity, and explicit constraints on the budget for medical measurements. Unlike standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches that control state trajectories, cancer treatments permanently modify patients' transition dynamics, changing how states evolve over time. We model cancer treatment as a belief-space planning problem using active inference, deriving an expected free-energy objective that unifies goal-directed control and information acquisition under measurement budgets without. We implement this framework using real clinical cancer data from the AACR Project GENIE Biopharma Collaborative dataset. Results on clinical data demonstrate a simultaneous patient categorization and high treatment efficacy, under real measurement and treatment constraints.
summary_zh: 癌症治疗本质上是一个具有部分可观测性、潜在的患者异质性以及医疗测量预算明确约束的序贯决策问题。与标准强化学习（RL）方法控制状态轨迹不同，癌症治疗会永久性地改变患者的转移动态，从而改变状态随时间演化的方式。我们将癌症治疗建模为使用主动推理的信念空间规划问题，推导出一个期望自由能目标函数，该函数在测量预算约束下统一了目标导向控制与信息获取。我们利用来自AACR项目GENIE生物制药合作数据集的真实临床癌症数据实现了这一框架。在真实测量与治疗约束下，临床数据结果表明实现了患者分类与高治疗疗效的同步提升。
tldr: This paper models cancer treatment as a belief-space planning problem using active inference, optimizing an expected free-energy objective for goal-directed control and information acquisition under measurement budgets, and validates it on real clinical cancer data.
tldr_zh: 该论文将癌症治疗建模为使用主动推理的信念空间规划问题，在测量预算下优化预期自由能目标以实现目标导向控制和信息获取，并在真实临床癌症数据上进行验证。

title: Point Cloud Segmentation for Autonomous Clip Positioning in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy on a Phantom
summary: High-risk applications in robotics, such as robot-assisted surgery, present unique challenges. These systems must be both highly precise and interpretable in order to be deployed in environments with very low tolerance for error or unsafe exploration. We present the first robotic system to demonstrate autonomous clip positioning on a physical phantom in laparoscopic surgery, one of the most common interventions in general surgery. After segmentation of a colorless point cloud from a single camera, target positions for the clips are extracted using spline interpolation, and can then be adjusted by the human operator. The segmentation model is trained on only 60 hand-labeled real point clouds, reflecting data scarcity in the surgical domain. We overcome this with a combination of pre-training on 128,000 synthetic point clouds and two novel data augmentation techniques. The motion of the end-effector to each target is visualized for the operator, satisfying the unique motion constraints of minimally-invasive surgery while ensuring that the robot's actions are verifiable and interpretable. In real robot experiments, our system localizes targets with the required precision of 0.75mm at a 95% success rate and executes autonomous clip positioning with a 100% success rate. We provide insights that are applicable to many other surgical and non-surgical tasks that require identifying and navigating to a precise target. Source code and project page: https://github.com/balazsgyenes/kirurc
summary_zh: 机器人领域的高风险应用，如机器人辅助手术，带来了独特的挑战。这些系统必须同时具备高精度和可解释性，才能部署在对错误或不安全探索容忍度极低的环境中。我们提出了首个在腹腔镜手术中（这是普外科最常见的手术之一）的实体模型上展示自动夹子定位的机器人系统。在从单个摄像头分割出无色点云后，通过样条插值提取夹子的目标位置，然后可由操作员手动调整。该分割模型仅使用60个手工标注的真实点云进行训练，反映了手术领域的数据稀缺性。我们通过结合在128,000个合成点云上的预训练以及两种新颖的数据增强技术来克服这一难题。末端执行器到每个目标的运动路径会可视化呈现给操作员，这既满足了微创手术的独特运动约束，又确保了机器人动作的可验证性和可解释性。在实际机器人实验中，我们的系统以95%的成功率实现了0.75毫米所需精度的目标定位，并以100%的成功率执行了自动夹子定位。我们提供的见解适用于许多其他需要识别并导航至精确目标的外科及非外科任务。源代码与项目页面：https://github.com/balazsgyenes/kirurc
tldr: This paper presents the first robotic system for autonomous clip positioning in laparoscopic cholecystectomy on a phantom, using point cloud segmentation trained on synthetic data and novel augmentations to achieve high precision and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个在腹腔镜胆囊切除术体模上实现自主夹子定位的机器人系统，利用合成数据和新型数据增强技术训练点云分割模型，实现了高精度和可解释性。

title: Lung-R1: A Knowledge Graph-Guided LLM for Pulmonary Diagnostic Reasoning
summary: Diagnosing pulmonary diseases requires integrating heterogeneous evidence amid phenotypic variability and cross-disease overlap. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown progress on pulmonary knowledge question answering (QA) and information-processing tasks, reliable pulmonary diagnosis requires patient-specific, relation-aware reasoning over electronic medical record (EMR) evidence rather than isolated knowledge recall. We define this gap between pulmonary knowledge and case-level diagnostic reasoning as the Pulmonary Knowledge-to-Diagnosis Gap. To address it, we introduce LungKG, the first structured pulmonary knowledge graph for diagnostic knowledge organization and record-grounded reasoning. LungKG contains 59,038 nodes and 164,308 edges across 15 entity types and 112 relation types, serving as both a reusable pulmonary knowledge resource and the foundation for LungKG-guided model adaptation. Built on LungKG, we propose Lung-R1, a LungKG-guided pulmonary LLM trained through KG-constrained reasoning-chain construction and KG-guided reinforcement learning. In a 20-system evaluation, Lung-R1-14B achieves state-of-the-art performance across Choice, Pulmonary-QA, and EMR Diagnosis, reaching an EMR Diagnosis score of 4.3583 and surpassing the strongest non-Lung-R1 baseline by 0.1476 points. These results demonstrate the value of LungKG-guided training for EMR-based pulmonary diagnosis.
summary_zh: 诊断肺部疾病需要在表型变异性和跨疾病重叠中整合异质性证据。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在肺部知识问答（QA）和信息处理任务方面取得了进展，但可靠的肺部诊断需要基于电子病历（EMR）证据进行患者特异性、关系感知的推理，而非孤立的知识回忆。我们将肺部知识与病例级诊断推理之间的这一差距定义为"肺部知识-诊断鸿沟"。为解决这一问题，我们引入了LungKG——首个用于诊断知识组织和记录依据推理的结构化肺部知识图谱。LungKG包含59,038个节点和164,308条边，涵盖15种实体类型和112种关系类型，既作为可复用的肺部知识资源，又作为LungKG引导的模型适应的基础。基于LungKG，我们提出了Lung-R1——一种通过KG约束的推理链构建和KG引导的强化学习训练的、LungKG引导的肺部大语言模型。在20系统评估中，Lung-R1-14B在选择题、肺部问答和EMR诊断任务上均达到最优性能，EMR诊断得分为4.3583，超过最强非Lung-R1基线0.1476分。这些结果证明了LungKG引导训练对于基于EMR的肺部诊断的价值。
tldr: This paper introduces LungKG, the first structured pulmonary knowledge graph, and Lung-R1, an LLM trained via KG-constrained reasoning and reinforcement learning to improve pulmonary diagnostic reasoning from electronic medical records, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LungKG，首个结构化的肺部知识图谱，以及基于知识图谱约束推理和强化学习训练的Lung-R1大语言模型，用于提升基于电子病历的肺部诊断推理能力，取得了最先进的性能。

title: UniReason-Med: A Shared Grounded Reasoning Interface for 2D-to-3D Transfer in Medical VQA
summary: We study whether grounded reasoning supervision from abundant 2D medical images can improve 3D medical VQA when both input types are aligned through a common reasoning interface. We introduce UniReason-Med, a single-checkpoint framework that processes either a 2D image or a slice-serialized 3D volume at inference time, generating interleaved textual reasoning and localized visual evidence through shared box syntax, region-token injection, and a common grounded reasoning policy. To train this interface, we construct UniMed-CoT, a 220K instruction-tuning dataset with interleaved textual reasoning and grounded visual evidence, including 170K 2D and 50K 3D samples. Through supervised fine-tuning followed by outcome-level reinforcement learning, UniReason-Med learns to generate grounded reasoning traces without IoU/Dice-based localization rewards during RL. Data-mixture and component ablations show that joint 2D+3D grounded supervision substantially improves 3D reasoning over 3D-only training, while grounding and region-token injection consistently benefit both 2D and 3D tasks. These results suggest that a shared grounded reasoning interface can transfer reasoning structure from 2D images to slice-serialized volumetric medical understanding. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/unireason-med.
summary_zh: 我们研究了当两种输入类型通过共同的推理接口对齐时，来自大量二维医学图像的基于定位的推理监督能否提升三维医学视觉问答的性能。我们提出了UniReason-Med，一个单检查点框架，在推理时可处理二维图像或序列化切片的三维体积，通过共享的边界框语法、区域标记注入和共同的定位推理策略生成交错排列的文本推理和局部化视觉证据。为了训练该接口，我们构建了UniMed-CoT，一个包含22万条指令微调数据集，带有交错排列的文本推理和定位视觉证据，包括17万条二维样本和5万条三维样本。通过监督微调后接结果层面的强化学习，UniReason-Med学会了生成定位推理轨迹，而无需在强化学习过程中使用基于IoU/Dice的定位奖励。数据混合和组件消融实验表明，联合二维+三维定位监督相比仅使用三维训练能显著提升三维推理能力，而定位和区域标记注入对二维和三维任务均有持续增益。这些结果表明，一个共享的定位推理接口可以将推理结构从二维图像迁移到序列化切片的三维体积医学理解中。代码和数据已在https://github.com/IQuestLab/unireason-med公开。
tldr: UniReason-Med introduces a shared grounded reasoning interface that unifies 2D and 3D medical VQA by using common box syntax, region-token injection, and a single checkpoint, demonstrating that joint 2D+3D supervised training improves 3D reasoning over 3D-only training.
tldr_zh: UniReason-Med 提出了一个共享的接地推理接口，通过统一的边界框语法、区域标记注入和单一检查点，统一了 2D 和 3D 医学视觉问答，证明了联合 2D+3D 监督训练比仅使用 3D 训练能提升 3D 推理能力。

title: EMG-Based Adaptation of Anisotropic Virtual Fixtures for Robot-Assisted Surgical Resection and Dissection
summary: In this paper, we address the development of an adaptive assistance system for robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery, specifically for delicate tasks such as Resection and Dissection. Even if Virtual Fixtures offer significant advantages for guiding a surgeon's movements, conventional Virtual Fixtures are often defined by fixed geometries, lacking the flexibility to adapt to the surgical workflow or the surgeon's immediate intent. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for an adaptive and anisotropic virtual fixture. In addition, we introduce an intuitive control interface that modulates the fixture's geometry in real-time based on the surgeon's intent, inferred from EMG signals. This approach allows the surgeon to dynamically expand or disengage the constraint by contracting their forearm muscles, enabling seamless transitions between precise guided motion and free repositioning of the tool. Experimental results from a pilot user study, based on a standardized surgical training task, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The system showed significant improvements in task accuracy and movement consistency, alongside a reduction in perceived cognitive load, effort, and frustration.
summary_zh: 本文针对机器人辅助腹腔镜手术中的自适应辅助系统开发进行了研究，特别聚焦于切除与解剖等精细操作任务。尽管虚拟夹具为引导外科医生操作提供了显著优势，但传统虚拟夹具通常由固定几何形状定义，缺乏适应手术流程或医生即时意图的灵活性。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种新型自适应各向异性虚拟夹具框架。此外，我们引入了一个直观的控制界面，该界面通过从肌电信号推断医生的操作意图，实时调整夹具的几何形态。该方法允许医生通过收缩前臂肌肉动态扩展或解除约束，从而在精确引导运动和工具自由重新定位之间实现无缝切换。基于标准化手术训练任务的初步用户研究实验结果表明，所提方法具有良好的有效性。该系统在任务精度和运动一致性方面显著提升，同时降低了感知认知负荷、努力程度和挫败感。
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive anisotropic virtual fixture framework for robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery that uses EMG signals to infer surgeon intent and dynamically adjust constraint geometry, improving task accuracy and reducing cognitive load.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助腹腔镜手术的自适应各向异性虚拟夹具框架，通过EMG信号推断外科医生意图并动态调整约束几何形状，提高了任务精度并降低了认知负荷。

title: Point-Wise Geometry-Aware Transformer for Partial-to-Full Point Cloud Registration in Computer-Assisted Surgery
summary: Partial-to-full registration remains challenging due to varying overlap ratios, fluctuating point densities, and the presence of noise. While transformers have shown strong potential for point cloud processing, prior methods typically confine them to global context aggregation, overlooking fine-grained local geometry crucial for accurate correspondence. We propose \emph{GAPR-Net}, a learning-based point cloud registration framework with a coarse-to-fine architecture that combines convolution and transformer modules, in which local and global information is fused between the partial and full point clouds using a cross-attention mechanism. To achieve this, a transformation-invariant point-wise geometric feature representation is proposed, which can robustly capture relative geometric features for individual points with respect to their neighboring points. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, experiments are conducted on four geometrically distinct bones, including the tibia, femur, pelvis, and thoracic cartilage. The overall registration recall reaches 94.2\%, the method results in a low RMSE of 1.992 mm and $R^2$ values of 0.908 and 0.974 for rotation and translation, respectively. The results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses the partial-to-full point cloud registration problem. The proposed method enables highly accurate 3D point cloud registration using partial observation, providing a critical foundation for precise surgical navigation and robotic interventions in computer-assisted surgery. The code will be accessed after the double-blind review process.
summary_zh: 摘要：由于重叠率变化、点密度波动以及噪声的存在，部分到整体点云配准仍具有挑战性。尽管Transformer在点云处理中展现出强大潜力，但以往方法通常将其局限于全局上下文聚合，忽略了对于精确对应关系至关重要的细粒度局部几何结构。我们提出\emph{GAPR-Net}，一种基于学习的点云配准框架，采用从粗到细的架构，结合卷积与Transformer模块，并通过交叉注意力机制在部分点云与整体点云之间融合局部和全局信息。为此，我们提出了一种变换不变的点状几何特征表示，能够稳健地捕获每个点相对于其邻域点的相对几何特征。为评估所提方法的有效性，我们在四种几何形态各异的骨骼（包括胫骨、股骨、骨盆和胸软骨）上进行了实验。整体配准召回率达到94.2%，该方法实现了1.992 mm的低均方根误差，旋转和平移的$R^2$值分别为0.908和0.974。结果表明，所提方法有效解决了部分到整体点云配准问题。该方法利用部分观测实现高精度三维点云配准，为计算机辅助手术中的精准手术导航和机器人干预提供了关键基础。代码将在双盲评审后公开。
tldr: Proposes GAPR-Net, a coarse-to-fine point cloud registration framework combining convolution and transformer with a transformation-invariant point-wise geometric feature, achieving high accuracy on partial-to-full registration for multiple bones in computer-assisted surgery.
tldr_zh: 提出了GAPR-Net，一种结合卷积和Transformer的粗到细点云配准框架，并引入变换不变的点态几何特征，在计算机辅助手术中对多个骨骼实现了高精度的部分到完整配准。

title: ArogyaSutra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Medical Reasoning in Indic Languages
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising reasoning capabilities in general domains, yet their performance remains limited in specialized settings such as healthcare, especially in multilingual and low-resource scenarios. This gap is critical in regions like rural India, where patients often express complex medical queries in native Indic languages and rely on multimodal inputs such as medical images. Existing English-centric MLLMs struggle to support such use cases, limiting equitable access to AI-driven healthcare assistance. To address this challenge, we introduce ArogyaBodha, a large-scale multilingual multimodal medical question-answer dataset constructed from eight heterogeneous sources, covering 31 body systems, six imaging modalities, and 21 clinical domains across English and seven major Indian languages. We further propose ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework that integrates tool grounding with dual-memory mechanisms for step-wise, reasoning-aware decision making, and uses stored actor-critic simulation trajectories for distillation. Experiments show that our dataset and framework improve multilingual medical reasoning accuracy across all Indic languages, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. The source code and dataset are available at: https://iitp-cse.github.io/ ArogyaSutra/
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在通用领域已展现出具有前景的推理能力，但在医疗保健等专业场景中，尤其在多语言和低资源环境下，其性能仍然有限。这一差距在农村印度等地区尤为关键，当地患者通常以本土印度语言表达复杂的医疗问题，并依赖医学图像等多模态输入。现有以英语为中心的MLLMs难以支持此类用例，从而限制了AI驱动医疗服务的公平可及性。为应对这一挑战，我们引入ArogyaBodha——一个大规模多语言多模态医疗问答数据集，由八个异构来源构建，覆盖31个人体系统、六种成像模态和21个临床领域，涵盖英语及七种主要印度语言。我们进一步提出ArogyaSutra——一个基于演员-评论家的多智能体框架，该框架将工具接地与双记忆机制相结合，实现逐步、推理感知的决策，并利用存储的演员-评论家仿真轨迹进行蒸馏。实验表明，我们的数据集和框架在所有印度语言上均提升了多语言医疗推理的准确性，消融实验验证了每个组件的贡献。源代码和数据集可在以下网址获取：https://iitp-cse.github.io/ArogyaSutra/
tldr: This paper introduces ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework for multimodal medical reasoning in Indic languages, along with a large-scale multilingual multimodal dataset (ArogyaBodha) to improve healthcare AI accessibility in low-resource regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 ArogyaSutra，一个基于演员-评论家的多智能体框架，用于印度语言的 multimodal 医疗推理，并构建了大规模多语言多模态数据集 ArogyaBodha，旨在提升低资源地区的医疗 AI 可及性。

title: Deployment-Centered Evaluation: Predicting Query-Level Rejection Risk in a Clinical LLM System
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into clinical systems, making it essential to evaluate the real-world utility of these systems. However, static benchmarks tend to measure correctness rather than user acceptance, aggregate performance across queries, and require densely annotated datasets -- leading to major blind spots for evaluating clinical systems. In this work, we perform a deployment-centered evaluation of an LLM system embedded within electronic health records at an academic medical center, where user feedback is sparse but closely reflects the deployment conditions. Specifically, we train a pre-response classifier that estimates the risk that a future interaction will result in the user rejecting the LLM response, based on query content and deployment-specific context available before generation. We conduct a prospective analysis of our model over 4.5 months of user feedback, finding that our prediction model achieves an AUROC of 0.719. Further, we estimate the benefit of such predictions in two downstream use cases (guardrail triggering and abstention). Our key conceptual insight is that making use of deployment-specific context (i.e., the provider type, department name, language model used for response), as opposed to only query content, improves the ability to predict whether the user will reject the system output. Altogether, our empirical case study demonstrates the feasibility of predicting user rejection using deployment-specific context, opening the door to targeted guardrails.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正日益融入临床系统，因此评估这些系统的实际效用至关重要。然而，静态基准测试往往侧重于正确性而非用户接受度，会聚合跨查询的性能指标，并且需要密集标注的数据集——这导致了临床系统评估中的重大盲区。在本研究中，我们针对某学术医疗中心电子健康记录中嵌入的LLM系统开展了一项以部署为中心的评估，该场景中的用户反馈稀疏但能紧密反映部署条件。具体而言，我们训练了一个生成前分类器，该分类器基于查询内容及生成前可获取的部署特定上下文，预估未来交互导致用户拒绝LLM响应的风险。我们基于4.5个月的用户反馈对模型进行前瞻性分析，发现预测模型的AUROC达到0.719。此外，我们估算了此类预测在两个下游用例（护栏触发与弃权决策）中的收益。本研究的核心概念洞见在于：相较于仅使用查询内容，利用部署特定上下文（即提供者类型、科室名称、用于生成响应的语言模型）可提升对用户是否会拒绝系统输出的预测能力。总体而言，我们的实证案例研究证明了利用部署特定上下文预测用户拒绝行为的可行性，为定向护栏机制的实现打开了大门。
tldr: This paper presents a deployment-centered evaluation of a clinical LLM system by training a classifier to predict user rejection risk using query content and deployment-specific context (e.g., provider type, department). Over 4.5 months, the model achieved AUROC 0.719, demonstrating feasibility for targeted guardrails.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种以部署为中心的临床LLM系统评估方法，通过训练分类器利用查询内容和部署特定上下文（如提供者类型、科室）预测用户拒绝风险。在4.5个月的评估中，模型AUROC达到0.719，展示了针对性护栏的可行性。

title: Unified MRI Brain Image Translation via Hierarchical Tumor Structure Comparison
summary:
Multi-modal MRI brain image translation via available modalities holds significant practical importance in modern medicine, providing robust support for early diagnosis, treatment planning, and outcome assessment of diseases. For this purpose, it is important to ensure the fidelity of the tumor regions after translation. However, existing brain image translation methods ignore the structure information of different tumor regions, which could assist translation models in enhancing the quality and clinical applicability of the translated images.
  In this work, we propose a novel translation model called HTSCGAN, which is a unified multi-modal brain image translation generative adversarial model integrating the structural information within tumor regions with the aim of improving the quality of brain image translation. Specifically, the generator employs three Patch Contrast Module (PCM) with different patch sizes to capture the hierarchical structural information of the tumor regions. In addition, a pretrained Patch Classifier (PC) and a pretrained Structure-Aware Encoder (SAE) are employed to derive the generated image containing the same tumor region structure as the ground truth image via patch classification loss and tumor perceptual loss, respectively. The experiments on BraTS2020 and BraTS2021 demonstrate strong performance of our model in both translation tasks and down stream segmentation tasks, highlighting its effectiveness in enhancing the quality and clinical relevance of the translated brain images. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HTSCGAN.
summary_zh:
多模态MRI脑图像通过可用模态进行翻译在现代医学中具有重要的实际意义，为疾病的早期诊断、治疗规划和疗效评估提供了有力支持。为此，确保翻译后肿瘤区域的保真度至关重要。然而，现有的脑图像翻译方法忽略了不同肿瘤区域的结构信息，而这些信息本可帮助翻译模型提升翻译图像的质量和临床适用性。

在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的翻译模型HTSCGAN，这是一个统一的多模态脑图像翻译生成对抗网络，它整合了肿瘤区域内的结构信息，旨在提高脑图像翻译的质量。具体而言，生成器采用三个不同块大小的补丁对比模块（PCM）来捕获肿瘤区域的层次结构信息。此外，利用预训练的补丁分类器（PC）和预训练的结构感知编码器（SAE），通过补丁分类损失和肿瘤感知损失分别生成与真实图像具有相同肿瘤区域结构的图像。在BraTS2020和BraTS2021上的实验表明，我们的模型在翻译任务和下游分割任务中均表现出强劲性能，突显了其在提升翻译脑图像质量和临床相关性方面的有效性。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HTSCGAN获取。
tldr: Proposes HTSCGAN, a GAN-based multi-modal MRI brain image translation model that uses hierarchical tumor structure comparison (via patch contrast modules and structure-aware encoders) to improve fidelity of translated tumor regions, validated on BraTS datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出HTSCGAN，一种基于GAN的多模态MRI脑图像翻译模型，通过分层肿瘤结构比较（使用补丁对比模块和结构感知编码器）来提高翻译肿瘤区域的保真度，在BraTS数据集上得到验证。

title: ffdas: Volumetric ultrasound reconstruction at warp speed
summary: Volumetric ultrafast ultrasound imaging demands reconstruction of images with millions of voxels thousands of times per second, creating computational challenges that limit both real-time feedback and easy offline analysis. Graphics processing units (GPUs) are well suited to this workload, yet we show that standard delay-and-sum implementations underutilize GPU resources through fragmented memory access patterns, even when sufficient computational capacity is available. Three optimization strategies address this: aligning memory access with GPU transfer granularity, halving memory traffic through mixed-precision storage, and exploiting spatial locality to utilize tensor core arithmetic. Together, these achieve kilohertz frame rates for $128^3$-voxel grids with 1024-element arrays, substantially outperforming existing implementations while maintaining image quality. This enables real-time volumetric imaging at scales previously restricted to offline processing, supporting applications such as intraoperative brain imaging and brain-computer interfaces where immediate feedback is essential. We release our implementation as part of the open-source \texttt{ffdas} library.
summary_zh: 体积极速超声成像要求每秒数千次重建包含数百万体素的图像，这带来了计算挑战，限制了实时反馈和便捷的离线分析。图形处理器（GPU）非常适合此类工作负载，然而我们表明，标准的延迟求和实现由于碎片化的内存访问模式而未能充分利用GPU资源，即使计算能力充足。针对这一问题，我们提出了三种优化策略：使内存访问与GPU传输粒度对齐、通过混合精度存储将内存流量减半、以及利用空间局部性来使用张量核心算术。这些策略共同实现了使用1024元阵列对$128^3$体素网格进行千赫兹帧率成像，在保持图像质量的同时显著优于现有实现。这使得此前仅限于离线处理的规模能够实现实时体积成像，支持术中脑成像和脑机接口等需要即时反馈的应用。我们将该实现作为开源\texttt{ffdas}库的一部分发布。
tldr: This paper presents GPU optimization strategies (memory alignment, mixed-precision, tensor cores) to achieve kilohertz volumetric ultrasound reconstruction, enabling real-time imaging for applications like intraoperative brain imaging and brain-computer interfaces.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了GPU优化策略（内存对齐、混合精度、张量核心），实现了千赫兹体积超声重建，为术中脑成像和脑机接口等应用提供了实时成像能力。

title: Trust but Verify: Mitigating Medical Hallucinations via Post-Hoc Adversarial Auditing and Multi-Agent Feedback Loops
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in healthcare settings, yet their tendency to hallucinate poses risks when clinical decisions are involved. This study examine whether LLMs recommend recently banned or withdrawn pharmaceuticals when answering clinical questions and tests an agent-based method for reducing such errors. We developed a five-agent "Trust but Verify" system using a single LLM backbone. To measure regulatory knowledge obsolescence, we created an adversarial dataset of 103 clinical MCQs where historically correct answers now refer to banned substances. This scale ensures statistical significance across various therapeutic classes. We evaluated three open-access model families (GPT-OSS, Llama-3, Falcon-3) under vanilla and agentic conditions. Performance was measured via pointwise score, label accuracy, Hallucination Error Rate (HER), and Component Fidelity (CF) score. We also observed clinical safety regression in proprietary models. In default configurations, all models showed high hallucination rates, consistently selecting banned drugs that matched training data patterns. Our proposed agentic architecture reduced HER by approximately 53% across models. Pointwise scores shifted from -0.25 (unsafe recommendation) toward 0.0 (appropriate refusal). The safety audit intercepted dangerous outputs even when models' parametric knowledge favored the banned substance. The proposed multi-agent framework offers a model-agnostic method for enforcing regulatory compliance that prioritizes patient safety over fluent text generation. Our work demonstrates a practical approach for deploying autonomous AI systems in safety-critical healthcare settings. It shows how real-time regulatory data can be integrated into LLM pipelines to support clinical decision-making.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被部署在医疗场景中，但当涉及临床决策时，其产生幻觉的倾向会带来风险。本研究考察了LLMs在回答临床问题时是否会推荐近期被禁用或撤市的药物，并测试了一种基于代理的方法以减少此类错误。我们开发了一个基于单一LLM骨干的“信任但验证”五代理系统。为衡量监管知识的过时程度，我们构建了一个包含103道临床多项选择题的对抗性数据集，其中历史正确答案现指代违禁物质。该规模确保了跨多种治疗类别的统计显著性。我们在原始设置和代理条件下评估了三个开源模型系列（GPT-OSS、Llama-3、Falcon-3）。性能通过逐点得分、标签准确率、幻觉错误率（HER）和组件保真度（CF）得分进行衡量。我们还观察了专有模型在临床安全性上的退化。在默认配置下，所有模型均表现出高幻觉率，持续选择与训练数据模式匹配的违禁药物。我们提出的代理架构将各模型的HER降低了约53%。逐点得分从-0.25（不安全推荐）移至接近0.0（适当拒绝）。即使模型的参数知识倾向于违禁物质，安全审计也能拦截危险输出。所提出的多代理框架提供了一种模型无关的方法来强制执行监管合规性，将患者安全置于流畅文本生成之上。我们的工作展示了在安全关键的医疗场景中部署自主AI系统的实用方法，并说明了如何将实时监管数据集成到LLM流程中以支持临床决策。
tldr: This paper proposes a five-agent 'Trust but Verify' system using a single LLM backbone to reduce medical hallucinations, achieving a ~53% reduction in hallucination error rate on an adversarial dataset of banned drug questions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于单一LLM后端的五智能体“信任但验证”系统，用于减少医疗幻觉，在关于禁用药物的对抗性数据集上实现了约53%的幻觉错误率降低。

title: MedLatentDx: Latent Multi-Agent Communication for Cross-Hospital Rare-Disease Diagnosis
summary: Rare diseases affect over $300$ million patients across more than $7{,}000$ conditions, yet no single hospital encounters enough cases of any one condition for reliable diagnosis. Cross-hospital collaboration could help by allowing a diagnosing institution to use distributed, case-specific diagnostic evidence, but privacy regulations restrict the transmission of identifiable clinical text across institutional boundaries. This setting raises two challenges: existing medical agent systems often rely on textual evidence exchange, while raw latent states such as hidden states and KV caches may still reveal prompt-derived clinical content. We introduce MedLatentDx, a latent multi-agent communication framework in which hospital agents keep private clinical records and retrieved cases local, and send compact latent KV blocks to a host agent for rare-disease diagnosis. MedLatentDx supports two deployment settings: same-backbone hospital agents use latent KV distillation, while hospitals with different LLM backbones use cross-family latent alignment. On CrossRare-Bench, a self-built large-scale rare-disease benchmark with hospital-level partitions, MedLatentDx improves cross-hospital diagnostic performance while reducing reconstructable clinical content relative to raw-latent communication baselines.
summary_zh: 摘要：罕见疾病涵盖超过7,000种病症，影响逾3亿患者，然而任何单一医院都难以积累足够多的某一病例以实现可靠诊断。跨医院协作可通过允许诊断机构利用分布式、病例特定的诊断证据来提供帮助，但隐私法规限制了可识别临床文本在机构间的传输。这一场景带来两大挑战：现有医疗智能体系统常依赖文本证据交换，而原始潜在状态（如隐藏状态和KV缓存）仍可能泄露基于提示的临床内容。我们提出MedLatentDx——一种潜在多智能体通信框架，其中医院智能体将私有临床记录和检索到的病例保留在本地，并向宿主智能体发送紧凑的潜在KV块以进行罕见病诊断。MedLatentDx支持两种部署模式：采用相同骨干模型的医院智能体使用潜在KV蒸馏，而使用不同LLM骨干的医院则采用跨家族潜在对齐。在自建的大规模罕见病基准CrossRare-Bench（含医院级数据划分）上，MedLatentDx在提升跨医院诊断性能的同时，相较于原始潜在通信基线减少了可重建的临床内容。
tldr: MedLatentDx proposes a latent multi-agent communication framework that uses compact latent KV blocks for privacy-preserving cross-hospital rare-disease diagnosis, outperforming raw-latent baselines on a new benchmark.
tldr_zh: MedLatentDx 提出了一种潜在多智能体通信框架，通过紧凑的潜在 KV 块实现跨医院罕见病诊断的隐私保护，在新基准上优于原始潜在基线。

title: Robustness without Wrinkles: Parallel Simulation and Robust MPC for Certified Deformable Manipulation
summary: We present CORD-SLS, a real-time control method for safe deformable object manipulation, with a focus on ropes and cloth. At its core is a GPU-parallel differentiable simulator with contact smoothing which enables efficient gradient-based planning through intermittent contact. To robustly satisfy constraints under model and sensing uncertainty, we develop a real-time, GPU-parallel output-feedback robust model predictive control (MPC) algorithm that plans with this simulator. We further show that the simulator accelerates model-based RL for training neural manipulation policies. To improve real-world robustness, we use conformal prediction to calibrate visual-feedback and perception-error bounds for MPC, producing reachable tubes that enable high-probability safe control. We evaluate CORD-SLS on high-dimensional, contact-rich rope and cloth manipulation tasks in simulation and hardware, including obstacle avoidance, routing, folding, and smoothing. Across settings, CORD-SLS achieves millisecond-speed planning, exceeding baselines in safety, speed, and task success.
summary_zh: 我们提出CORD-SLS，一种面向绳索与布料等可变形物体安全操控的实时控制方法。其核心是一个基于GPU并行计算并具有接触平滑处理的可微分仿真器，能够通过间歇性接触实现高效的基于梯度的规划。为在模型与感知不确定性下鲁棒地满足约束条件，我们开发了一种实时、GPU并行的输出反馈鲁棒模型预测控制（MPC）算法，该算法利用该仿真器进行规划。我们进一步证明该仿真器能够加速基于模型的强化学习，用于训练神经操控策略。为提升实际环境中的鲁棒性，我们采用保形预测来校准MPC的视觉反馈与感知误差边界，生成可达管集，从而实现高概率的安全控制。我们在仿真与硬件上对CORD-SLS进行了评估，涉及绳索与布料的高维、密集接触操控任务，包括避障、布线、折叠与展平。在各种设置下，CORD-SLS均实现了毫秒级规划速度，在安全性、速度与任务成功率上均超越基线方法。
tldr: A real-time control method for safe deformable manipulation (ropes and cloth) using GPU-parallel differentiable simulation, robust MPC with output feedback, and conformal prediction for certified safety.
tldr_zh: 一种用于安全变形物体（绳索和布料）操作的实时控制方法，采用GPU并行可微仿真、带输出反馈的鲁棒模型预测控制以及保形预测来确保安全。

title: Can Post-Training Turn LLMs into Good Medical Coders? An Empirical Study of Generative ICD Coding
summary: Automated International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding is a core medical-coding task for billing, epidemiology, and clinical decision support. Generative large language models (LLMs) are often reported as weak medical coders, but this finding mainly comes from inference-time settings such as prompting, retrieval, reranking, or tool use, leaving the role of task-specific post-training underexplored. We present a controlled empirical study of post-training for generative ICD coding, comparing discriminative baselines with LLM coders across prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning under a common protocol and metric set. To our knowledge, this is the first study to evaluate RL-based post-training for generative LLM coders in ICD coding. We further introduce PHI, a diagnostic curriculum that extends GRPO to refine missed-code cases. Our results show that prompting-only evaluation substantially underestimates the potential of LLMs for ICD coding. SFT provides the main capability jump, GRPO further improves code-set prediction beyond SFT, and PHI provides targeted gains on macro-level performance. These findings suggest that the main bottleneck is not the generative formulation alone, but how the model is adapted and optimized for full-taxonomy recall. We release our code, data splits, and checkpoints at https://github.com/AlexandreWANG915/LLM4ICD.
summary_zh: 自动国际疾病分类（ICD）编码是用于计费、流行病学和临床决策支持的核心医学编码任务。生成式大语言模型（LLM）常被报道为弱医学编码器，但这一发现主要来自提示、检索、重排序或工具使用等推理时设置，而任务特定的后训练作用尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了一项关于生成式ICD编码后训练的受控实证研究，在共同的协议和度量集下，通过提示、监督微调和强化学习，将判别式基线与LLM编码器进行了比较。据我们所知，这是首个评估基于强化学习的后训练用于生成式LLM编码器在ICD编码中的研究。我们进一步引入了PHI，一种扩展GRPO以优化漏码病例的诊断课程。我们的结果表明，仅通过提示评估会严重低估LLM在ICD编码中的潜力。监督微调提供了主要的能力跃升，GRPO在监督微调基础上进一步改善了编码集预测，而PHI则在宏观性能上提供了针对性的提升。这些发现表明，主要瓶颈并非仅在于生成式公式本身，而在于模型如何针对完整分类体系召回进行适配和优化。我们在https://github.com/AlexandreWANG915/LLM4ICD发布了我们的代码、数据划分和检查点。
tldr: This paper empirically studies post-training techniques (SFT, GRPO, and a novel PHI curriculum) for generative LLMs on ICD coding, showing that prompting underestimates their potential and that post-training significantly improves performance, especially with RL-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文通过实证研究了生成式大语言模型在ICD编码任务上的后训练技术（SFT、GRPO以及新提出的PHI课程），发现仅用提示词评估低估了潜力，后训练（尤其是基于强化学习的方法）能显著提升性能。

title: More with LESS -- Local Scene Representations for Tactile Imaging
summary: Tactile imaging seeks to reconstruct the internal structure of soft objects through touch sensing, with applications in medical diagnosis and robotic manipulation. Recent self-supervised learning approaches have shown promising results, but rely on global, unstructured representations and robot-controlled sensing, limiting generalization and practical use. We propose Local Encoder for Spatial Sensing (LESS), an object-centric tactile representation that exploits the local nature of touch. The tactile scene is modeled as a grid of recurrent encoders with local receptive fields, whose states are fused to reconstruct 2D or 3D images of internal structure. This compositional design enables strong generalization: models trained on single-inclusion phantoms accurately image objects with multiple inclusions and varying sizes. The local structure further supports spatial uncertainty estimation. In addition, we enable hand-held tactile imaging via external pose tracking and human-like palpation data, and extend tactile imaging to full 3D reconstruction.
summary_zh: 触觉成像旨在通过触觉感知重建软物体的内部结构，在医学诊断和机器人操作中具有应用前景。近年来自监督学习方法已展现出潜力，但其依赖全局非结构化表示及机器人控制的传感方式，限制了泛化能力与实际应用。我们提出空间感知局部编码器（LESS），这是一种以物体为中心的触觉表示方法，利用了触觉的局部特性。触觉场景被建模为由具有局部感受野的循环编码器构成的网格，这些编码器的状态被融合以重建内部结构的二维或三维图像。这种组合设计实现了强大的泛化能力：在单内含物仿体上训练的模型能够准确成像具有多个内含物及不同尺寸的物体。局部结构还支持空间不确定性估计。此外，我们通过外部位姿跟踪和类人触诊数据实现了手持式触觉成像，并将触觉成像扩展到完整的三维重建。
tldr: This paper proposes LESS, a local encoder for spatial sensing that uses grid-based recurrent encoders to reconstruct 2D/3D internal structures of soft objects from tactile data, enabling strong generalization and hand-held operation with pose tracking.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出LESS，一种基于网格递归编码器的局部空间传感方法，通过触觉数据重建软物体的内部2D/3D结构，支持强泛化能力和手持式操作（结合位姿跟踪）。

title: Learning Dynamic Swing-Up of an Inverted Pendulum using Remote Magnetic Actuation
summary: Electromagnetic Navigation Systems (eMNS) have gained considerable attention for minimally invasive surgery and targeted drug delivery. While most of the literature relies on quasi-static control of these systems, recent work has demonstrated the benefits of dynamic approaches. However, trajectory tracking far from equilibrium states remains largely unaddressed. We close this gap by demonstrating the first swing-up of a magnetically actuated inverted pendulum using the clinically-ready Navion eMNS. Although the inverted pendulum is not clinically relevant in itself, the proposed method utilizes torques and forces as control objectives, making it applicable to other magnetically actuated devices such as catheters and guidewires. Our approach combines trajectory optimization that accounts for internal eMNS dynamics with time-varying Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) state feedback and Iterative Learning Control (ILC), which leverages previous trial data and the system's dynamic model to progressively refine the feedforward command. While LQR alone fails due to the complex phenomena of magnetic actuation, ILC enables successful swing-up within six iterations. Furthermore, post-experimental analysis reveals that the learned ILC correction closely matches the torque discrepancy predicted by high-fidelity magnetic field model calibration, suggesting learning and adaptation as a promising tool to deal with uncertainties in electromagnetic actuation arising, e.g., from patient-specific physiological motion patterns and field model calibration inaccuracies.
summary_zh: 电磁导航系统（eMNS）在微创手术和靶向药物递送领域引起了广泛关注。尽管现有文献大多依赖于这些系统的准静态控制，但近期研究已证明了动态方法的优势。然而，远离平衡态的轨迹跟踪仍未得到充分解决。我们通过利用临床级Navion电磁导航系统，首次实现了磁驱动倒立摆的摆起，从而弥补了这一空白。虽然倒立摆本身不具备临床相关性，但所提出的方法以力矩和力作为控制目标，使其可适用于其他磁驱动装置，如导管和导丝。我们的方法结合了考虑内部电磁导航系统动力学的轨迹优化、时变线性二次型调节器（LQR）状态反馈以及迭代学习控制（ILC），后者利用先前试验数据和系统动力学模型逐步优化前馈指令。单独使用LQR因磁驱动的复杂现象而失败，而ILC在六次迭代内成功实现了摆起。此外，实验后分析表明，学习得到的ILC修正量与高保真磁场模型校准所预测的力矩偏差高度吻合，这表明学习和自适应是处理电磁驱动中不确定性的有效工具，这些不确定性可能源于患者特异性生理运动模式及磁场模型校准误差等。
tldr: This paper presents the first successful dynamic swing-up of a magnetically actuated inverted pendulum using a clinically-ready electromagnetic navigation system, combining trajectory optimization, time-varying LQR, and iterative learning control to handle uncertainties.
tldr_zh: 本文首次利用临床级电磁导航系统成功实现了磁驱动倒立摆的动态摆起，结合轨迹优化、时变LQR和迭代学习控制来处理不确定性。

title: Expert-Driven Survival Machines: Improving Stratification and Interpretability in Multiple Clinical Cohorts
summary: Survival prediction plays a central role for healthcare providers and clinical researchers. Accurate risk stratification enables early intervention and improved patient management. Most existing deep survival models learn one common feature representation for all patients, which may hide important differences between patient subgroups. In contrast, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework allows different parts of the model to focus on different patient patterns, leading to more individualized representations. Therefore, in this work, we propose a mixture-of-experts enhanced adaptive deep clustering survival framework (AdaCSM) for modeling such heterogeneous survival patterns. We introduce a routing-based expert mechanism that enables conditional specialization within a parametric survival modeling framework. The proposed architecture allocates patients to specialized risk predictors dynamically while preserving the patient survival and subtype clustering objectives. We compare our method with state-of-the-art survival and deep clustering models on multiple real-world longitudinal clinical cohorts spanning diverse disease domains. The proposed method demonstrates improved predictive performance and leads to interpretable results in survival analysis.
summary_zh: 生存预测在医疗提供者和临床研究中扮演核心角色。准确的风险分层能够实现早期干预并改善患者管理。现有大多数深度生存模型为所有患者学习单一共同特征表示，这可能掩盖不同患者亚组之间的重要差异。相比之下，专家混合（MoE）框架允许模型的不同部分关注不同的患者模式，从而产生更具个性化的表示。因此，本文提出一种基于专家混合增强的自适应深度聚类生存框架（AdaCSM），用于建模此类异质性生存模式。我们引入了一种基于路由的专家机制，可在参数化生存建模框架中实现条件性专化。所提出的架构动态地将患者分配给专门的风险预测器，同时保留患者生存与亚型聚类目标。我们在涵盖多种疾病领域的多个真实世界纵向临床队列上，将我们的方法与最先进的生存模型和深度聚类模型进行了比较。所提出的方法展示了改进的预测性能，并在生存分析中产生了可解释的结果。
tldr: This paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts enhanced adaptive deep clustering survival framework (AdaCSM) that dynamically allocates patients to specialized risk predictors, improving stratification and interpretability in survival analysis across multiple clinical cohorts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合专家增强的自适应深度聚类生存框架（AdaCSM），该框架动态地将患者分配给专门的风险预测器，在多个临床队列的生存分析中提高了分层和可解释性。

title: Landmark-free Assessment of Lower-limb Alignment with Implicit Neural Shape Functions from Knee Radiographs
summary: Radiographic assessment of lower-limb alignment (LLA) is important for predicting joint health and surgical outcomes in total knee arthroplasty. Traditional measurement methods are manual and time-consuming, while recent machine learning approaches typically rely on locating a fixed set of anatomical landmarks. This dependence limits flexibility and may require re-annotation when clinical definitions change. To address this, we propose an automated workflow using Implicit Neural Shape Functions (INSF). Rather than relying on explicit landmark coordinates, we encode the anatomy into a compact latent space and regress clinical alignment measurements directly from these latent codes. This architecture allows for rapid extendability to new tasks without altering the backbone representation. We trained our method on an internal dataset of 566 knee radiographs, each annotated with the outline of the femur and tibia. We evaluated it on both an internal test dataset of 50 patients and a separate external set of 402 preoperative cases from the MRKR dataset. Manual clinical measurements are available for these data, and the MRKR measurements will be made publicly accessible. Performance was comparable to state-of-the-art landmark-based methods and manual agreement, while offering a flexible shape representation that can be extended to additional measurement tasks.
summary_zh: 下肢力线（LLA）的放射学评估对于预测全膝关节置换术中的关节健康及手术结局至关重要。传统测量方法依赖人工操作且耗时，而近期机器学习方法通常依赖于定位一组固定的解剖标志点。这种依赖性限制了灵活性，当临床定义发生变化时可能需要重新标注。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于隐式神经形状函数（INSF）的自动化工作流。该方法不依赖显式的标志点坐标，而是将解剖结构编码至紧凑的潜在空间中，并直接从这些潜在编码中回归临床力线测量值。该架构可在不更改主干表示的情况下快速扩展至新任务。我们在一个包含566张膝关节X线片的内数据集上训练了该方法，每张图像均标注了股骨和胫骨的轮廓。我们在一个由50例患者组成的内测试数据集以及来自MRKR数据集的402例独立术前病例上进行了评估。这些数据均具备人工临床测量值，且MRKR测量值将公开提供。该方法在性能上可与最先进的基于标志点的方法及人工测量一致性相媲美，同时提供了可扩展至其他测量任务的灵活形状表示。
tldr: This paper presents an automated landmark-free method for assessing lower-limb alignment from knee radiographs using Implicit Neural Shape Functions (INSF), which encodes anatomy into a latent space and directly regresses clinical measurements, achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art landmark-based approaches while offering flexibility for extension to new tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需标记点的自动下肢力线评估方法，利用隐式神经形状函数（INSF）将解剖结构编码到潜在空间并直接回归临床测量值，性能与最先进的基于标记点的方法相当，且具有可扩展至新任务的灵活性。

title: Towards Global AI-Driven Cervical Cancer Screening
summary: The global elimination of cervical cancer is a key public health goal set by the World Health Organization (WHO), with screening programs reducing mortality by up to 80%. However, access to experts and biopsy services is limited in low- to middle-income countries (LMICs). Deep learning (DL)-based algorithms offer promising support for screening, but most existing approaches have been developed and validated on private datasets from single countries. We present the first DL-based approach to cervical cancer screening validated on data from multiple countries. Technically, we phrase the problem of detecting and classifying lesions in colposcopy images as a multi-task learning problem, in which we simultaneously perform image-level classification and lesion segmentation. Our model was trained on a private data set of acid stain colposcopy images with manually generated lesion segmentation masks and corresponding histopathological results, employing extensive data augmentation to address image variability. In an in-distribution validation with pathology results serving as ground truth, our algorithm outperformed medical experts (Balanced Accuracy: 0.68 vs 0.64) in CIN1- (Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 1 or lower) versus CIN2+ (grade 2 or higher) classification. External validation on four colposcopy data sets from four countries featuring radical differences in prevalence and patient characteristics yielded superior performance of our method compared to baseline methods. Performance variability across countries was high with AUC values ranging from 0.54 - 0.80. Overall, algorithm performance varied with age, transformation zone (cervical area most prone to lesion development), presence of comorbidities and pathognomonic signs, with comorbidities having by far the largest negative effect. Future work should focus on improving model robustness and generalizability.
summary_zh: 全球消除宫颈癌是世界卫生组织（WHO）设定的重要公共卫生目标，筛查项目可使死亡率降低高达80%。然而，在中低收入国家（LMICs），获取专家和活检服务的机会有限。基于深度学习（DL）的算法为筛查提供了有前景的支持，但现有大多数方法都在单一国家的私有数据集上开发和验证。我们提出了首个基于DL的宫颈癌筛查方法，并在多国数据上进行了验证。技术上，我们将阴道镜图像中病变检测与分类问题表述为多任务学习问题，同时进行图像级分类和病变分割。模型使用带有手动标注的病变分割掩膜及相应组织病理学结果的醋酸染色阴道镜图像私有数据集进行训练，并采用广泛的数据增强以应对图像变异性。在以病理结果为金标准的分布内验证中，我们的算法在CIN1-（宫颈上皮内瘤变1级或更低）与CIN2+（2级或更高）分类上优于医学专家（平衡准确率：0.68 vs 0.64）。在来自四个国家的四个阴道镜数据集上进行的外部验证中，尽管各数据集的患病率和患者特征差异显著，我们的方法相比基线方法仍表现出更优性能。各国间算法性能差异较大，AUC值范围为0.54至0.80。总体而言，算法性能随年龄、转化区（最易发生病变的宫颈区域）、合并症及病理性体征的存在而变化，其中合并症的负面影响最为显著。未来工作应聚焦于提升模型鲁棒性和泛化能力。
tldr: This paper presents the first deep learning-based cervical cancer screening method validated on multi-country data, using multi-task learning for image-level classification and lesion segmentation on colposcopy images, achieving higher balanced accuracy than medical experts on in-distribution data but with high performance variability across different populations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了首个在多国数据上验证的基于深度学习的宫颈癌筛查方法，采用多任务学习对阴道镜图像进行图像级分类和病灶分割，在分布内数据上实现了比医学专家更高的平衡准确率，但在不同人群中性能差异较大。

title: SimWeaver: Zero-Shot RGB Sim-to-Real for Deformable Manipulation
summary: RGB sim-to-real for deformable manipulation has remained largely unsolved without real-world fine-tuning. We present SimWeaver, which trains zero-shot RGB VLA policies on 200 simulated demonstrations per task, reaching above 80% per-task and 91% average real-world success across 5 diverse deformable tasks including plastic-bag manipulation, without teleoperation or per-task calibration. SimWeaver combines a reliable measurement-backed simulator (SimWeaver-Sim) with an extensible asset framework supporting single-image generation(SimWeaver-Asset), a deterministic topology-aware trajectory synthesizer (SimWeaver-Syn), and a sim-to-real protocol with ISP-aware photometric augmentation (SimWeaver-Real). On silk grasping, the sim-trained policy reaches 100% under visual distribution shifts where real-data baselines drop to 9-70%, at two orders of magnitude lower per-trajectory cost. We will release SimWeaver and a representative asset subset. Project page: https://simweaver.github.io/
summary_zh: 针对可变形物体的RGB仿真到真实迁移，目前在没有真实环境微调的情况下仍基本未能解决。我们提出SimWeaver，该方法在每项任务仅使用200次模拟演示即可训练零样本RGB VLA策略，在包括塑料袋操作在内的5项不同可变形任务中，每任务成功率超过80%，平均真实世界成功率达91%，无需遥操作或每任务校准。SimWeaver将可靠的支持测量的模拟器（SimWeaver-Sim）与可扩展的资产框架（支持单图像生成，SimWeaver-Asset）、确定性拓扑感知轨迹合成器（SimWeaver-Syn）以及包含ISP感知光度增强的仿真到真实协议（SimWeaver-Real）相结合。在丝绸抓取任务中，模拟训练的策略在视觉分布偏移下达到100%成功率，而基于真实数据的基线方法成功率降至9-70%，同时每轨迹成本降低两个数量级。我们将开源SimWeaver及代表性资产子集。项目页面：https://simweaver.github.io/
tldr: SimWeaver enables zero-shot RGB sim-to-real transfer for deformable object manipulation using only simulated demonstrations, achieving high real-world success rates on tasks like plastic-bag and silk grasping without real-world fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: SimWeaver 实现了仅使用模拟演示的零样本 RGB 仿真到真实变形物体操作迁移，在塑料袋和丝绸抓取等任务上无需真实世界微调即取得了较高的实际成功率。

title: Enabling Real-Time Point-of-Care Ultrasound Segmentation: A GPU-Free Deployment in Resource-Limited Settings
summary: Ultrasound imaging is the most widely adopted medical modality globally due to its low cost and portability, yet artificial intelligence (AI) deployment remains constrained by reliance on GPU-accelerated models, creating a structural paradox where the cost of "intelligence" exceeds that of the imaging device itself. Here, we present the systematic adaptation and extensive evaluation of UltraSeg, an ultra-lightweight architecture originally developed for colonoscopic polyp segmentation, now engineered for point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) across ten public datasets spanning six anatomical sites (breast, thyroid, kidney, carotid, fetal, and small-animal tumor). We systematically validate both variants in ultrasound domains: UltraSeg-130K (0.13M parameters) achieves 89.7 FPS on single-core CPUs and 34.8 FPS on a refurbished mobile device, while UltraSeg-500K (0.5M parameters) delivers 44.6 FPS on CPU and 16.1 FPS on mobile device. UltraSeg-500K matches or exceeds the Dice performance of the 31M-parameter UNet and approaches 105M-parameter TransUNet in average performance, with superior zero-shot cross-dataset generalization on external validation sets (UDIAT, DDTI). By enabling clinical-grade segmentation without GPU dependency, this work brings AI costs in line with ultrasound accessibility, making advanced diagnostics available in resource-limited settings.
summary_zh: 超声成像是全球应用最广泛的医学影像模态，因其低成本和高便携性而普及，但人工智能（AI）的部署仍受限于对GPU加速模型的依赖，导致“智能化”成本高于成像设备本身的结构性矛盾。本文介绍了对UltraSeg的系统性适配与广泛评估——该架构最初为结肠镜息肉分割而设计的超轻量级架构，现经工程化改造适用于十组涵盖六个解剖部位（乳腺、甲状腺、肾脏、颈动脉、胎儿及小动物肿瘤）的公开数据集上的床旁超声（POCUS）。我们在超声领域对两种变体进行了系统性验证：UltraSeg-130K（0.13M参数）在单核CPU上达到89.7 FPS，在翻新移动设备上达到34.8 FPS；而UltraSeg-500K（0.5M参数）在CPU上达到44.6 FPS，在移动设备上达到16.1 FPS。UltraSeg-500K在Dice性能上匹配或超过31M参数的UNet，平均性能接近105M参数的TransUNet，并在外部验证集（UDIAT、DDTI）上展现出卓越的零样本跨数据集泛化能力。通过在不依赖GPU的情况下实现临床级分割，本工作使AI成本与超声的可及性相匹配，从而在资源有限的环境中实现先进诊断。
tldr: This paper adapts the ultra-lightweight UltraSeg architecture for point-of-care ultrasound segmentation across multiple anatomical sites, demonstrating real-time performance on CPU and mobile devices without GPU dependency, matching or exceeding larger models like UNet and TransUNet.
tldr_zh: 本文将超轻量级UltraSeg架构适配至多部位超声图像分割，在无GPU的CPU和移动设备上实现实时性能，性能匹敌甚至超过UNet和TransUNet等大型模型。

title: 3D Consistency Optimization for Self-Supervised Monocular Video Depth Estimation
summary: Reliable monocular video depth estimation is crucial for downstream 3D reasoning and embodied AI in endoscopic navigation. However, existing self-supervised approaches typically treat video frames independently or rely on weak temporal regularization. These methods, lacking a holistic perception of the underlying 3D scene, inevitably suffer from geometrically inconsistent predictions and severe cross-frame drift. To address these limitations, we introduce a new paradigm that recasts sequential video depth estimation as an unconstrained multi-view 3D reconstruction problem, enabling full exploitation of the powerful geometric priors embedded in recent 3D foundation models. The core of our approach is a 3D consistency optimization framework driven by three constraints: image-level photometric rendering, explicit world-coordinate geometric alignment, and multi-scale temporal gradient consistency. Such unified optimization elegantly anchors isolated frames to a globally coherent 3D structure. Our method has been validated in both the self-supervised training scenarios and challenging zero-shot clinical environments. Results show that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art spatial accuracy, outperforming the frame-based, video-based depth estimators and the multi-view 3D reconstruction baselines.
summary_zh: 可靠的单目视频深度估计对于内窥镜导航中的下游三维推理和具身人工智能至关重要。然而，现有的自监督方法通常独立处理视频帧，或依赖较弱的时间正则化。这些方法缺乏对底层三维场景的整体感知，不可避免地会导致几何预测不一致和严重的跨帧漂移。为解决这些限制，我们引入了一种新范式，将序列视频深度估计重新定义为无约束的多视图三维重建问题，从而充分利用近期三维基础模型中蕴含的强大几何先验。我们方法的核心是一个三维一致性优化框架，由三个约束驱动：图像级光度渲染、显式世界坐标几何对齐以及多尺度时间梯度一致性。这种统一优化巧妙地将孤立帧锚定到全局一致的三维结构上。我们的方法已在自监督训练场景和具有挑战性的零样本临床环境中得到验证。结果表明，所提出的方法实现了最先进的空间精度，优于基于帧、基于视频的深度估计器以及多视图三维重建基线。
tldr: This paper proposes a 3D consistency optimization framework for self-supervised monocular video depth estimation, recasting sequential video depth as an unconstrained multi-view 3D reconstruction problem. It achieves state-of-the-art spatial accuracy in endoscopic navigation by enforcing image-level photometric rendering, world-coordinate geometric alignment, and multi-scale temporal gradient consistency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自监督单目视频深度估计的3D一致性优化框架，将序列视频深度重构为无约束的多视图3D重建问题。通过强制图像级光度渲染、世界坐标几何对齐和多尺度时间梯度一致性，在内窥镜导航中实现了最先进的空间精度。

title: Calibrated Triage, Not Autonomy: Confidence Estimation for Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: A vision-language model can answer a question about a medical image fluently and confidently while barely using the image, leaning instead on language priors. In medicine this is the failure that matters most, because the answer looks trustworthy and is not, and the only protection is a confidence score reliable enough to tell the system when to abstain. We ask a deployment question rather than an accuracy one: how much imaging work a model can safely handle alone, and which confidence signal makes that possible. We evaluate seven confidence estimators across five open-weight LVLMs and three medical visual-question-answering datasets spanning broad clinical imaging, radiology, and pathology, with every probe trained only on natural images and applied without adaptation. Recast as bounded selective prediction (automate a case only when confidence clears a threshold, defer the rest), the comparison is cautionary. The standard metrics are poor guides: discrimination barely separates the methods, and the weak calibration of a cheap self-report is cheaply removed by off-domain temperature scaling without changing deployable yield. What distinguishes a usable estimator is the high-confidence region a clinician acts on: the weakest baselines are confidently wrong on 41 to 45 percent of their errors against 1 to 4 percent for the best probe, and no estimator is reliably best across domains or models. Safe handoff is governed at two levels: base-model competence sets a ceiling, so a well-calibrated score recovers roughly a third of radiology cases at a 20 percent error tolerance but almost none of pathology; the confidence layer then decides how much of that ceiling is reachable. The usable role today is calibrated triage, not autonomy: automate the cases a calibrated score marks safe, route the rest to a clinician. We release all outputs, correctness judgments, and confidence scores, with code.
summary_zh: 一个视觉-语言模型能够流畅且自信地回答关于医学图像的问题，却几乎不依赖图像本身，而是更多借助语言先验。在医学领域，这是最关键的失败模式，因为答案看起来可信实则不然，而唯一的保护是足够可靠的置信度分数，以便系统在必要时选择弃权。我们提出的不是准确率问题，而是部署问题：模型能安全独立处理多少影像工作，以及哪些置信度信号能够实现这一点。我们在五个开源大型视觉-语言模型和三个覆盖广泛临床影像、放射学与病理学的医学视觉问答数据集上，评估了七种置信度估计方法，所有探针仅在自然图像上训练且未经适配直接应用。将其重新定义为有界选择性预测（仅在置信度超过阈值时自动化处理病例，其余则延迟处理），这一比较具有警示意义。标准指标是糟糕的指南：区分度几乎无法区分不同方法，而廉价自我报告的不良校准可被域外温度缩放轻易消除，且不改变可部署产出。区分可用估计器的关键在于临床医生所依据的高置信区域：最弱基线在41%到45%的错误上表现出高置信错误，而最佳探针仅为1%到4%，且没有任何估计器在跨领域或跨模型时稳定最优。安全交接受两个层面制约：基础模型能力设定了上限——因此校准良好的分数在20%错误容忍度下能恢复约三分之一的放射学病例，但病理学病例几乎为零；置信度层则决定该上限有多少可达。当前可用的角色是校准后的分诊，而非自主：自动化处理校准分数标记为安全的病例，其余病例转给临床医生。我们公开所有输出、正确性判断、置信度分数及代码。
tldr: This paper evaluates seven confidence estimators for medical vision-language models, showing that standard discrimination metrics are poor and that safe triage depends on base-model competence and a well-calibrated confidence score, recommending calibrated triage over autonomy.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了医学视觉语言模型的七种置信度估计方法，发现标准判别指标效果不佳，安全分流依赖于基础模型能力和校准良好的置信度分数，建议采用校准分流而非自主决策。

title: NeRD: Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation for Efficient Ontology-Grounded Chain-of-Thought in Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Interpretability is essential for trustworthy medical image diagnosis. However, existing concept-driven interpretable methods have key limitations: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) require scoring all predefined concepts at inference time and for manual intervention, imposing a substantial burden on clinicians, while rationale-based generative approaches often select concepts by class discriminability, which can drift from diagnostic ontologies. To address these issues, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation (NeRD), a framework that produces efficient, ontology-grounded reasoning chains that are sufficient yet non-redundant, without manually crafting diagnostic rules. Experiments on two skin datasets demonstrate strong diagnostic performance and interpretability, and blinded expert evaluation confirms the clinical plausibility of NeRD rationales. Our method further enables a first expert-in-the-loop study for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought-based diagnosis, achieving efficient and effective concept-level intervention.
summary_zh: 摘要：可解释性对于可信的医学图像诊断至关重要。然而，现有基于概念的可解释方法存在关键局限性：概念瓶颈模型（CBM）需要在推理时对所有预定义概念进行评分并支持人工干预，给临床医生带来沉重负担；而基于理据的生成方法通常根据类别可区分性选择概念，这可能会偏离诊断本体。为解决这些问题，我们提出了神经符号规则蒸馏（NeRD）框架，该框架能够生成高效、基于本体的推理链，这些推理链充分且无冗余，无需手动制定诊断规则。在两个皮肤数据集上的实验证明了其强大的诊断性能和可解释性，盲法专家评估确认了NeRD理据的临床合理性。该方法还首次实现了基于多模态思维链诊断的专家在环研究，实现了高效且有效的概念级干预。
tldr: NeRD introduces a neuro-symbolic framework that distills ontology-grounded reasoning chains for interpretable medical image diagnosis, reducing clinician burden and improving plausibility over existing concept bottleneck and rationale-based methods.
tldr_zh: NeRD提出了一种神经符号框架，通过蒸馏本体驱动的推理链实现可解释的医学图像诊断，减轻临床医生负担，并在合理性和效率上优于现有的概念瓶颈和基于理由的方法。

title: Learning a Sampling-Free Variational DNN Plugin from Tiny Training Sets to Refine OOD Segmentation With Uncertainty Estimation
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) frequently fail to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) medical images because of variations in scanners and acquisition protocols. Retraining DNN models to address these distribution shifts is often impractical due to the high cost of acquiring and annotating new medical datasets. To address this, we introduce VarDeepPCA, a novel lightweight variational DNN framework designed to restore/refine degraded segmentation maps by leveraging intrinsic geometric priors. Unlike existing approaches that require target-domain data or extensive pre-training, our VarDeepPCA explicitly learns a distribution of valid anatomical geometries using only small in-distribution (ID) datasets. Theoretically, our novel variational learning framework leverages a reinterpretation of the softmax mapping to implicitly perform exact distribution modeling, thereby enabling computationally efficient, sampling-free learning and inference. This also enables VarDeepPCA to provide uncertainty estimates associated with its restored segmentation maps. We empirically validate our framework across 4 distinct clinical applications, using 14 publicly available datasets, involving segmentation of the myocardium, neuroretinal rim, prostate, and fetal head. Comparisons against 15 existing methods demonstrate that VarDeepPCA consistently restores segmentation maps produced by the existing methods on OOD data to (i) significantly improve anatomical plausibility of geometries and clinical utility of the segmentations, and (ii) significantly reduce errors, without needing any more training data than that used by existing methods.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络（DNNs）常因扫描仪和采集协议的差异而无法泛化至分布外（OOD）医学图像。由于获取和标注新医学数据集成本高昂，重新训练DNN模型以应对这些分布偏移通常不可行。为此，我们提出VarDeepPCA——一种新型轻量级变分DNN框架，旨在通过利用内在几何先验来恢复/优化退化的分割图。与需要目标域数据或大量预训练的现有方法不同，我们的VarDeepPCA仅利用少量分布内（ID）数据集即可显式学习有效解剖几何的分布。理论上，我们新颖的变分学习框架借助对softmax映射的重新解释来隐式执行精确分布建模，从而实现计算高效、无需采样的学习与推理。这还使VarDeepPCA能够为其恢复的分割图提供不确定性估计。我们在4项不同的临床应用中（使用14个公开数据集，涉及心肌、神经视网膜边缘、前列腺和胎儿头部的分割）对框架进行了实证验证。与15种现有方法的比较表明，VarDeepPCA能够在无需比现有方法更多训练数据的前提下，持续恢复现有方法在OOD数据上产生的分割图，从而（i）显著提高解剖几何的合理性与分割的临床实用性，并（ii）显著减少误差。
tldr: VarDeepPCA is a lightweight variational DNN that refines out-of-distribution (OOD) segmentation maps using only small in-distribution datasets, providing uncertainty estimates without sampling, and is validated across four medical imaging applications.
tldr_zh: VarDeepPCA 是一种轻量级变分深度神经网络，仅使用小规模分布内数据集来优化分布外（OOD）分割图，无需采样即可提供不确定性估计，并在四个医学影像应用中得到了验证。

title: LiteOdyssey: A Lightweight Reasoning AI Agent for Interpretable Rare-Disease Diagnosis
summary: Most medical AI systems improve by scaling additional machinery: more fine-tuning data, more agents, and/or larger retrieval databases. In rare-disease diagnosis, however, such scaling can produce systems that are difficult to deploy, audit, and maintain. We asked whether state-of-the-art diagnostic performance could instead be achieved by extending the reasoning chain of a single AI agent: guiding it with a diagnostic policy, developed through human-AI collaboration and augmenting with freely available biomedical tools. We introduce LiteOdyssey, a lightweight rare-disease diagnostic framework that guides reasoning language model through a clinical genetics workflow. This framework was developed through Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) and uses dynamic access to public biomedical tools. On two challenging benchmarks that provide only patient clinical features, LiteOdyssey achieved state-of-the-art performance, with an overall disease Recall@1 of 59.3% over the combined 1,243 cases of LIRICAL (n = 370) and the PhenoPacket Store (n = 873). Both benchmarks have a high proportion of ultra-rare disease (a prevalence below 1 in 1,000,000, with ultra-rare shares of approximately 45% and 52.8%, respectively). On the more difficult PhenoPacket subset, where causal diseases were not mapped to Orphanet in our rarity-mapping pipeline, LiteOdyssey achieved 60.7% Recall@1, compared with 10.7% for the same baseline model (GPT-5.4) without tools. This performance was achieved without fine-tuning, multi-agent ensembles, or a large case-retrieval database. Gains were also observed in the following: on cases never seen during development, on a private cohort of real-world rare disease patients, and on a smaller open-weights model. LiteOdyssey suggests a path toward rare-disease AI systems that are accurate, easier to deploy, and more transparent for physician review.
summary_zh: 大多数医学人工智能系统通过扩展额外机制来提升性能：更多微调数据、更多代理和/或更大的检索数据库。然而，在罕见病诊断中，这种扩展可能导致系统难以部署、审计和维护。我们探究了是否可以通过延长单一人工智能代理的推理链来实现最先进的诊断性能：通过人机协作开发诊断策略来引导该代理，并利用免费可用的生物医学工具进行增强。我们引入了LiteOdyssey，这是一个轻量级的罕见病诊断框架，通过临床遗传学工作流程引导推理语言模型。该框架通过人类反馈策略迭代（PIHF）开发，并动态访问公共生物医学工具。在两个仅提供患者临床特征且具有挑战性的基准测试中，LiteOdyssey达到了最先进的性能，在LIRICAL（n=370）和PhenoPacket Store（n=873）的共计1,243例病例上，总体疾病Recall@1达到59.3%。这两个基准测试中超罕见疾病（患病率低于百万分之一，超罕见比例分别约为45%和52.8%）占比很高。在难度更大的PhenoPacket子集上（其中因果疾病在我们的罕见性映射流程中未映射到Orphanet），LiteOdyssey实现了60.7%的Recall@1，而未使用工具的相同基线模型（GPT-5.4）仅为10.7%。这一性能的达成无需微调、多代理集成或大型病例检索数据库。在以下方面同样观察到性能提升：在开发过程中从未见过的病例上、在真实世界罕见病患者的私人队列中、以及在较小的开源权重模型上。LiteOdyssey为构建准确、易于部署且更便于医生审查的罕见病人工智能系统指明了一条路径。
tldr: LiteOdyssey is a lightweight, interpretable AI agent for rare-disease diagnosis that achieves state-of-the-art performance by extending a single reasoning language model's chain with a clinical genetics workflow and dynamic biomedical tool access, developed via human-AI policy iteration, without requiring fine-tuning or multi-agent ensembles.
tldr_zh: LiteOdyssey 是一个轻量级、可解释的罕见病诊断AI智能体，通过扩展单个推理语言模型的推理链，结合临床遗传学工作流程和动态生物医学工具访问，并采用人类-AI策略迭代开发，在无需微调或多智能体集成的情况下达到了最先进的性能。

title: Attention-Based Prototype Calibration for Multi-Rater Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Few-shot medical image segmentation methods typically assume a single ground-truth annotation, overlooking systematic variability across expert raters commonly observed in clinical datasets. We propose an attention-based prototype calibration framework for few-shot multi-rater segmentation that models rater-specific deviations from a consensus representation in prototype space.
