Although we significantly simplified the robot's model and its environment, we still implemented some of the features of the environment based on the real robot prototype. In particular, one of the environments has single- as well as multi-path points, and other consists of the multi-path points only. The results show that, in contrast to A star, the performance time of Genetic algorithm does not depend on the environment's cardinality. It generates more diverse paths, which increases the robot's resilience.
summary_zh: 本文针对弹性连续体机器人的运动规划进行了实验研究。研究重点聚焦于多准则决策及其在路径规划算法中的应用、对生成路径的影响以及执行时间。为此，我们采用两种著名的路径规划算法——遗传算法与A*算法，并通过引入层次分析法算法对其加以改进，以评估所生成路径的质量。实验中，层次分析法考虑了四个不同准则：距离、电机损伤、机器人臂的机械损伤以及精度，每个准则均被认为有助于提升连续体机器人的弹性。采用不同准则对于延长连续体机器人维护操作间隔时间是必要的。我们在两种不同的机器人模拟环境下开展了实验。尽管对机器人模型及其环境进行了大幅简化，但仍基于真实机器人原型实现了部分环境特征。具体而言，其中一个环境包含单路径点与多路径点，另一个环境则仅包含多路径点。结果表明，与A*算法不同，遗传算法的执行时间不受环境基数影响，且能生成更多样化的路径，从而增强机器人的弹性。
tldr: This paper studies motion planning for continuum robots by incorporating multi-criteria decision-making (AHP) into Genetic Algorithm and A* to improve resilience, focusing on distance, motor damage, mechanical damage, and accuracy. Experiments in simulated environments show GA produces more diverse paths with execution time independent of environment complexity.
tldr_zh: 本文研究通过将多准则决策（AHP）融入遗传算法和A*算法，为连续体机器人进行运动规划以增强其韧性，重点关注距离、电机损伤、机械损伤和精度。模拟实验表明，遗传算法生成更多样化的路径，且执行时间不受环境复杂度影响。

title: MedRLM: Recursive Multimodal Health Intelligence for Long-Context Clinical Reasoning, Sensor-Guided Screening, Evidence-Grounded Decision Support, and Community-to-Tertiary Referral Optimization
summary: Real-world clinical decision support requires reasoning over heterogeneous and longitudinal patient information rather than answering isolated medical questions. However, current medical large language models and retrieval-augmented generation systems often rely on single-step prompting or retrieval, which can be fragile when clinical evidence is distributed across long electronic health records, medical images, sensor streams, guidelines, and referral constraints. This paper proposes MedRLM, a Recursive Multimodal Health Intelligence framework for long-context clinical reasoning, sensor-guided screening, and community-to-tertiary referral support. Instead of compressing all patient information into one prompt, MedRLM treats the patient case as an external clinical environment that can be recursively inspected, decomposed, retrieved, verified, and synthesized. The framework coordinates specialized agents for clinical text, longitudinal EHR, medical imaging, physiological sensor signals, guideline retrieval, uncertainty auditing, and referral planning. It further introduces a Clinical Evidence Graph Memory to connect patient-specific observations with retrieved evidence, standardized definitions, sensor-derived biomarkers, and referral criteria. A sensor-guided recursive triggering mechanism activates deeper reasoning when abnormal physiological or behavioral patterns are detected, while uncertainty-gated refinement supports clinician review for high-risk or low-confidence cases. We also outline a real-data evaluation design using public and credentialed clinical datasets spanning EHR, radiology, ECG, ICU time series, and referral-proxy outcomes. MedRLM aims to move medical AI from static question answering toward auditable, multimodal, and workflow-aware clinical decision support.
summary_zh: 真实世界的临床决策支持需要跨异构和纵向患者信息进行推理，而非仅回答孤立的医学问题。然而，当前的医学大语言模型与检索增强生成系统常依赖于单步提示或检索，当临床证据分布于冗长的电子健康记录、医学影像、传感器数据流、诊疗指南及转诊约束中时，此类方法可能表现脆弱。本文提出MedRLM——一种面向长程临床推理、传感器引导筛查及社区至三级转诊支持的递归式多模态健康智能框架。该框架无需将所有患者信息压缩至单一提示，而是将患者病例视为可递归检查、分解、检索、验证与综合的外部临床环境。其协调了面向临床文本、纵向电子健康记录、医学影像、生理传感器信号、指南检索、不确定性审计及转诊规划的专用智能体。进一步地，本文引入临床证据图记忆，将患者特异性观察结果与检索到的证据、标准化定义、传感器衍生生物标志物及转诊标准相连接。当检测到异常生理或行为模式时，传感器引导的递归触发机制会激活更深层推理，而不确定性门控精炼机制则支持临床医生对高风险或低置信度病例进行审查。我们还概述了一项真实数据评估设计，使用涵盖电子健康记录、放射影像、心电图、重症监护病房时序数据及转诊代理结果的公共与认证临床数据集。MedRLM旨在推动医学AI从静态问答转向可审计、多模态且工作流感知的临床决策支持。
tldr: MedRLM proposes a recursive multimodal framework for clinical decision support that coordinates specialized agents to inspect, decompose, retrieve, and synthesize heterogeneous patient data (EHR, imaging, sensors, guidelines) over long contexts, using a Clinical Evidence Graph Memory and sensor-guided recursive triggering to enable auditable, workflow-aware reasoning.
tldr_zh: MedRLM 提出了一种递归多模态临床决策支持框架，通过协调专用智能体对异构患者数据（电子病历、影像、传感器、指南）进行递归检查、分解、检索和综合，利用临床证据图记忆和传感器引导的递归触发机制，实现可审计、工作流感知的推理。

title: Confidence Calibration for Multimodal LLMs: An Empirical Study through Medical VQA
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show great potential in medical tasks, but their elicited confidence often misaligns with actual accuracy, potentially leading to misdiagnosis or overlooking correct advice. This study presents the first comprehensive analysis of the relationship between accuracy and confidence in medical MLLMs. It proposes a novel method that combines Multi-Strategy Fusion-Based Interrogation (MS-FBI) with auxiliary expert LLM assessment, aiming to improve confidence calibration in Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA). Experiments demonstrate that our method reduces the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by an average of 40\% across three Medical VQA datasets, significantly enhancing MLLMs' reliability. The findings highlight the importance of domain-specific calibration for MLLMs in healthcare, offering a more trustworthy solution for AI-assisted diagnosis.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在医学任务中展现出巨大潜力，但其表达出的置信度常与实际准确性不符，可能导致误诊或忽略正确建议。本研究首次对医学MLLMs中准确性与置信度之间的关系进行了全面分析，并提出了一种将多策略融合式询问（MS-FBI）与辅助专家大语言模型评估相结合的新方法，旨在改善医学视觉问答（VQA）中的置信度校准。实验表明，我们的方法在三个医学VQA数据集上将期望校准误差（ECE）平均降低了40%，显著提升了MLLMs的可靠性。研究结果凸显了领域特定校准对医疗领域MLLMs的重要性，为AI辅助诊断提供了更可信的解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents the first comprehensive study of confidence calibration in medical MLLMs, proposing a Multi-Strategy Fusion-Based Interrogation (MS-FBI) method with auxiliary expert LLM assessment, achieving a 40% average reduction in Expected Calibration Error across three Medical VQA datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文首次对医学多模态大语言模型的置信度校准进行了全面研究，提出了一种结合多策略融合式询问与辅助专家大语言模型评估的方法，在三个医学视觉问答数据集上将期望校准误差平均降低了40%。

title: LLM Doesn't Know What It Doesn't Know: Detecting Epistemic Blind Spots via Cross-Model Attribution Divergence on Clinical Tabular Data
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to structured clinical data, yet whether they can recognize the limits of their own knowledge on such tasks remains unexplored. We study this question through the lens of cross-model attribution divergence with the goal of reducing epistemic uncertainty for structured tasks, comparing Qwen 2.5 7B and XGBoost on a prediction task via attribution divergence analysis. We report four findings. First, LLM verbalized confidence is epistemically vacuous, it outputs a near-constant (0.856-0.937) regardless of whether accuracy is 49% or 75.3%, tracking prompt format rather than prediction quality. Second, the LLM exhibits an inverse difficulty effect: accuracy drops to 64.8% when XGBoost is 99% correct, but matches XGBoost (73.8% vs. 73.1%) when it is moderately uncertain. Third, few-shot examples and SHAP-derived feature evidence are orthogonal, super-additive interventions: they reduce the Attribution Disagreement Score (ADS) from 1.54 to 0.38 and improve accuracy from 49% to 75.3% without training. Fourth, a cross-model calibrator that determined LLM reliability using attribution divergence signals reduces expected calibration error from 0.254 to 0.080, replacing uninformative verbalized confidence with patient-specific reliability estimates, without accessing model internals or requiring repeated inference. We frame these findings as a cold start problem for LLMs on structured data and outline a path toward genuine epistemic self-awareness.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被应用于结构化临床数据，然而它们能否识别自身在这些任务上的知识边界仍未被探索。我们通过跨模型归因分歧的视角研究这一问题，旨在降低结构化任务中的认知不确定性，通过归因分歧分析比较了Qwen 2.5 7B与XGBoost在预测任务上的表现。我们报告了四项发现：第一，LLM的口头置信度在认知上是空洞的——无论准确率是49%还是75.3%，它输出的置信度近乎恒定（0.856-0.937），追踪的是提示格式而非预测质量。第二，LLM表现出逆难度效应：当XGBoost以99%的正确率预测时，LLM准确率降至64.8%；但在XGBoost中度不确定时，LLM与其表现相当（73.8%对73.1%）。第三，少量样本示例与基于SHAP的特征证据是正交的、超加性的干预措施：它们将归因不一致分数（ADS）从1.54降至0.38，并将准确率从49%提升至75.3%，且无需训练。第四，一种利用归因分歧信号确定LLM可靠性的跨模型校准器，将预期校准误差从0.254降至0.080，用患者特定的可靠性估计替代了无信息量的口头置信度，且无需访问模型内部或重复推理。我们将这些发现归纳为LLM在结构化数据上的冷启动问题，并勾勒出一条通往真正认知自我意识的路径。
tldr: This paper investigates how large language models (LLMs) fail to recognize their own knowledge limits on structured clinical tabular data, proposing cross-model attribution divergence analysis between an LLM and XGBoost to detect epistemic blind spots, and demonstrates that LLM verbalized confidence is uninformative while a cross-model calibrator can improve reliability.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在结构化临床表格数据上无法识别自身知识局限的问题，提出了通过LLM与XGBoost之间的跨模型归因分歧分析来检测认知盲点，并证明LLM的言语化置信度毫无信息量，而跨模型校准器可提高可靠性。

title: Scalable Training of Spatially Grounded 2D Vision-Language Models for Radiology
summary: We study how to train visually grounded vision-language models (VLMs) for radiology without manual spatial annotations. We introduce RefRad2D, a large-scale bilingual (German/English) dataset of 1.2M CT and MR image-text pairs derived from clinical practice, with task-specific VQA and spatial grounding subsets generated automatically via LLM-based curation and automated segmentation. Trained on this data, our model RadGrounder jointly performs report generation, visual question answering, and spatial grounding via bounding-box detection or segmentation. On external VQA benchmarks (Slake, VQA-RAD), RadGrounder achieves competitive results with specialized medical VLMs. Adding our clinical data to the training mixture improves open-ended VQA over fine-tuning on the downstream datasets alone, showing the transferability of our dataset. Crucially, adding grounding supervision does not degrade language quality, enabling spatially verifiable outputs at no cost to VQA performance.
summary_zh: 我们研究了如何训练用于放射学的视觉接地视觉语言模型（VLM），而无需手动空间标注。我们提出了RefRad2D，这是一个大规模双语（德语/英语）数据集，包含来自临床实践的120万对CT和MR图像-文本对，并通过基于LLM的自动整理和自动分割生成了任务特定的VQA及空间接地子集。基于该数据训练的模型RadGrounder能够联合完成报告生成、视觉问答以及通过边界框检测或分割实现的空间接地。在外部VQA基准测试（Slake、VQA-RAD）上，RadGrounder取得了与专业医学VLM相竞争的结果。将我们的临床数据加入训练混合集后，在开放域VQA上优于仅在下游数据集上进行微调，证明了我们数据集的可迁移性。关键在于，添加接地监督并不会降低语言质量，从而在不牺牲VQA性能的前提下实现空间可验证的输出。
tldr: This paper introduces RefRad2D, a large bilingual dataset for radiology, and trains a model (RadGrounder) that jointly performs report generation, VQA, and spatial grounding without manual annotations. It shows competitive results and transferability, with grounding supervision not harming language quality.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了RefRad2D，一个大规模双语放射学数据集，并训练了RadGrounder模型，该模型无需手动标注即可联合执行报告生成、VQA和空间定位。结果显示具有竞争力且可迁移，且空间定位监督不影响语言质量。

title: When Calibration Fails the Vulnerable Hospital: Federated Conformal Risk Control via Risk-Curve Shrinkage
summary: Conformal risk control (CRC) provides distribution-free guarantees on segmentation quality by calibrating a prediction-set threshold on held-out data. In federated deployments, the standard approach pools calibration scores across sites into a single threshold. We provide the first quantification, on real multi-institutional brain tumor data (FeTS-2022, 1,251 subjects, 20 institutions), showing that this naive pooled CRC protects the average hospital but violates coverage at 40% of individual institutions, with the worst site exceeding the target false-negative rate by 7.8 percentage points. The naive alternative, per-site local CRC, largely restores coverage but inflates prediction sets by 83x, rendering them clinically useless. We propose a shrinkage-based federated CRC protocol: each site transmits only its empirical risk curve (G scalars) to a server, which computes a shrinkage-regularized threshold per site. A single hyperparameter n0 smoothly trades worst-case coverage for prediction-set efficiency; leave-one-site-out sensitivity analysis identifies n0=19, achieving 2.7/20 violations at 2.0x stretch. We further show that direct Lagrangian optimization of coverage budgets fails, concentrating risk on vulnerable hospitals, and that the finite-sample correction term is essential: removing it triples violations. The marginal CRC guarantee is preserved by construction under the stated site-mixture assumption; per-site coverage is validated across four targets with three seeds. No patient-level images, masks, or per-volume scores leave any site.
summary_zh: 保形风险控制（CRC）通过在校准留出数据上设定预测集阈值，为分割质量提供无分布假设的保证。在联邦部署场景中，标准方法将各站点的校准分数合并为单一阈值。我们首次基于真实多机构脑肿瘤数据（FeTS-2022，1,251名受试者，20个机构）进行量化分析，表明这种朴素合并式CRC能保护医院平均水平，但在40%的个体机构中违反了覆盖率要求，其中最差站点的假阴性率超出目标值7.8个百分点。另一种朴素方法——各站点本地CRC——基本恢复了覆盖率，但使预测集膨胀了83倍，导致临床不可用。我们提出了一种基于收缩的联邦CRC协议：每个站点仅将其经验风险曲线（G个标量）传输至服务器，服务器为每个站点计算经收缩正则化的阈值。单一超参数n0在保证最坏情况覆盖率与预测集效率之间平滑权衡；留一站点敏感性分析确定n0=19，在2.0倍膨胀下实现2.7/20的违规次数。我们进一步证明，对覆盖率预算的直接拉格朗日优化会失败，将风险集中在脆弱医院上；并且有限样本校正项至关重要：移除后违规次数增加三倍。在所述站点混合假设下，边际CRC保证通过构造得以保留；针对三个随机种子在四个目标上的各站点覆盖率均得到验证。没有任何患者级别的图像、掩膜或逐体素分数离开站点。
tldr: This paper identifies that standard federated conformal risk control (CRC) fails to protect individual hospitals, with 40% of sites violating coverage, while per-site local CRC inflates prediction sets by 83x. It proposes a shrinkage-based federated CRC protocol that trades worst-case coverage for efficiency, achieving 2.7/20 violations at 2.0x stretch.
tldr_zh: 本文发现标准联邦保形风险控制（CRC）未能保护个别医院，40%的站点违反覆盖，而每个站点的本地CRC将预测集膨胀83倍。提出基于收缩的联邦CRC协议，以最差覆盖换取效率，达到2.7/20违规和2.0倍拉伸。

title: 2D Versus 3D Diffusion for In Silico Training of Interventional X-ray AI Models
summary: The ability to synthesize realistic X-ray images has catalyzed the development of AI models for X-ray image-guided procedures, which otherwise suffer from a lack of available annotated data. Prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of mechanistic simulation of digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) as a training data source for a myriad of tasks, including segmentation and anatomical landmark detection, with comparable or superior performance to real data training. However, mechanistic DRR synthesis still relies on the availability of annotated high-resolution anatomical models. Deriving these from CT images of real patients or specimens imposes an undesirable bottleneck on data quantity and variability. In this work, we explore two methods for synthesizing training data: (1) a 3D conditional latent diffusion model that generates CT volumes to use as inputs for mechanistic DRR generation without real, 3D anatomical models, and (2) a view-conditioned 2D diffusion model that produces synthetic X-rays. In controlled experiments, we demonstrate that synthetic 2D diffusion-based X-rays can be used to train an anatomical landmark detection model that generalized to real X-ray images with performance rivaling that of a model trained on real X-ray images. Thus, we provide preliminary evidence that synthetic, 2D diffusion-based training data can substitute for real X-ray data, identifying a promising avenue towards generating large, diverse datasets for training robust AI models in interventional X-ray imaging.
summary_zh: 合成逼真X射线图像的能力推动了用于X射线图像引导手术的AI模型的发展，而这类模型原本受限于缺乏可用的标注数据。已有研究表明，数字化重建放射影像（DRRs）的机械仿真作为训练数据源，在分割、解剖标志点检测等多项任务中表现有效，其性能可与真实数据训练相媲美甚至更优。然而，机械DRR合成仍依赖于标注的高分辨率解剖模型。从真实患者或样本的CT图像中获取这些模型，对数据量和多样性造成了不利的瓶颈。在本研究中，我们探索了两种合成训练数据的方法：（1）一种三维条件潜扩散模型，用于生成CT体积数据，作为机械DRR生成的输入，无需真实的三维解剖模型；（2）一种视图条件化二维扩散模型，用于生成合成X射线图像。在受控实验中，我们证明基于二维扩散的合成X射线图像可用于训练解剖标志点检测模型，该模型能够泛化到真实X射线图像，其性能可与在真实X射线图像上训练的模型相媲美。因此，我们提供了初步证据，表明基于二维扩散的合成训练数据可以替代真实X射线数据，为生成大规模、多样化的数据集以训练鲁棒的介入X射线成像AI模型指明了有前景的方向。
tldr: This paper compares 2D vs 3D diffusion models for generating synthetic X-ray training data, showing that 2D diffusion-based synthetic X-rays can train anatomical landmark detection models to perform comparably to models trained on real X-ray data, offering a scalable alternative to real data.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了2D和3D扩散模型生成合成X射线训练数据的效果，发现基于2D扩散的合成X射线能够训练出性能与真实数据相当的解剖标志检测模型，为替代真实数据提供了可扩展的方案。

title: Discrete Geometric Modeling and Extended State Estimation of Continuum Robots
summary: In this paper, we present a fully discrete approach for the accurate and numerically efficient dynamical modeling and state estimation of continuum robots. The model is based on geometrically exact beams in a minimal, strain-based formulation and derived in the framework of Lie group variational integrators, allowing to preserve important geometric properties that we exploit to achieve high accuracy and numerical efficiency. We then propose a disturbance observer based on an extended Kalman filter formulation that reliably estimates system states as well as model uncertainties and external disturbances. Experiments on a real system validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed model and observer.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种全离散方法，用于实现连续体机器人精确且数值高效的动力学建模与状态估计。该模型基于最小应变公式中的几何精确梁，并在李群变分积分器框架下推导，从而能够保留重要的几何特性，我们利用这些特性实现了高精度与高数值效率。随后，我们提出了一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波公式的干扰观测器，可可靠估计系统状态以及模型不确定性和外部扰动。在实际系统上的实验验证了所提模型与观测器的精度与效率。
tldr: Presents a discrete geometric modeling approach for continuum robots using Lie group variational integrators and an EKF-based disturbance observer for state estimation, validated on a real system.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于李群变分积分的连续机器人离散几何建模方法，并结合扩展卡尔曼滤波扰动观测器进行状态估计，在真实系统上验证了其准确性和效率。

title: Learning-Based Modeling of Soft Robots via Cosserat Rod Theory
summary: Modeling soft robot dynamics is challenging due to their continuum structure and typically nonlinear dynamics. Creating models based on first-order principles is typically time-demanding, and their expressiveness is limited, whereas data-driven models lack interpretability and physical consistency. This work aims to overcome these challenges by introducing a port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Process Regression framework for learning and simulating the dynamics of planar, rod-like soft robots. In detail, the proposed model integrates Cosserat rod theory and Hamiltonian physics with data-driven inference to preserve the system's energy structure while accurately learning the rod dynamics. Numerical simulations show that we can achieve accurate and energy-consistent representations of a rod-like soft robot, showing the potential for a robust and interpretable pathway for modeling complex continuum mechanics.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于软体机器人具有连续体结构和典型的非线性动力学特性，其动力学建模颇具挑战性。基于第一性原理的建模方法通常耗时且表达能力有限，而数据驱动模型则缺乏可解释性和物理一致性。本研究旨在通过引入一种端口哈密顿高斯过程回归框架来克服这些挑战，用于学习和模拟平面杆状软体机器人的动力学行为。具体来说，所提出的模型将Cosserat杆理论与哈密顿物理学相结合，并借助数据驱动推理，在精确学习杆动力学的同时保持系统的能量结构。数值模拟表明，我们能够实现对杆状软体机器人准确且能量一致的表示，展示了为复杂连续介质力学建模提供稳健且可解释途径的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Process Regression framework that integrates Cosserat rod theory with data-driven inference to model planar, rod-like soft robots, achieving accurate and energy-consistent dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合Cosserat杆理论与数据驱动推理的端口-哈密顿高斯过程回归框架，用于模拟平面杆状软体机器人，实现了准确且能量一致的动力学建模。

title: Neurosymbolic Clinical Trial Matching via LLM-Driven Abduction and Logical Verification
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path to automate Clinical Trial Matching (CTM), but still struggle with the deterministic verification required for complex eligibility criteria. Conversely, purely symbolic methods provide formal rigour but break down when faced with incomplete patient records and noisy clinical evidence. To bridge this gap, we investigate a hybrid framework for CTM combining LLMs with logical verification. In particular, we introduce an abductive neurosymbolic CTM framework (αNeSy-CTM), which leverages the linguistic and world knowledge in LLMs to support reasoning over noisy and underspecified clinical text. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that αNeSy-CTM substantially outperforms standalone LLM baselines, achieving up to 30% relative improvement over zero-shot baselines. In addition, our analyses confirm the impact of abductive reasoning on CTM, with αNeSy-CTM exhibiting improved accuracy, specificity, and robustness over a non-abductive neurosymbolic setting. Furthermore, αNeSy-CTM and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning prove highly complementary, highlighting the potential for a hybrid routing policy. Ultimately, this paper demonstrates the impact of neurosymbolic methods for automating CTM, providing a path toward the next generation of auditable, LLM-driven clinical applications.
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLM）为自动化临床试验匹配（CTM）提供了有前景的路径，但在处理复杂入组标准所需的确定性验证方面仍存在困难。相比之下，纯符号方法具有形式严谨性，但在面对不完整的患者记录和有噪声的临床证据时则会失效。为弥合这一差距，我们研究了一种结合LLM与逻辑验证的混合CTM框架。具体而言，我们提出了一种溯因神经符号CTM框架（αNeSy-CTM），该框架利用LLM中的语言知识和世界知识，支持对带有噪声且信息不明确的临床文本进行推理。大量评估表明，αNeSy-CTM显著优于独立的LLM基线，相比零样本基线实现了最高30%的相对改进。此外，我们的分析证实了溯因推理对CTM的影响，与非溯因神经符号设置相比，αNeSy-CTM展现出更高的准确性、特异性和鲁棒性。同时，αNeSy-CTM与思维链（CoT）推理被证明具有高度互补性，突显了混合路由策略的潜力。最终，本文证明了神经符号方法在自动化CTM中的影响力，为下一代可审计、由LLM驱动的临床应用指明了方向。
tldr: This paper presents αNeSy-CTM, a neurosymbolic framework that combines LLMs with logical verification and abductive reasoning for clinical trial matching, achieving up to 30% relative improvement over zero-shot LLM baselines and demonstrating complementary benefits with Chain-of-Thought reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了αNeSy-CTM，一种结合LLM与逻辑验证和溯因推理的神经符号框架，用于临床试验匹配，相比零样本LLM基线实现了高达30%的相对改进，并展示了与Chain-of-Thought推理的互补优势。

title: PROTON: Prototype-Based Test-Time Online OOD Detection for Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot clinical image classification, yet reliably detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs at deployment remains an open problem. No static scoring method works across all shift types: Maximum Concept Matching (MCM) on FLAIR achieves 76.4% AUROC for far-OOD but only 42.4% for covariate shifts such as ultra-wide-field fundus images, effectively random. We trace this to a structural mismatch: covariate-shifted inputs are indistinguishable from in-distribution samples in softmax space, yet occupy distinct regions in the VLM embedding space. To exploit this untapped signal, we propose PROTON (PROtotype-based Test-time ONline OOD detection), a lightweight post-hoc module that maintains an online prototype bank from high-confidence test predictions and adaptively fuses prototype distance with MCM scoring via stream-level variance statistics, requiring no model modification, training data, or prompt engineering. On the ophthalmology benchmark FLAIR + FIVES, PROTON improves MCM by +23.9 AUROC on covariate shift, +8.8 on semantic shift, and +8.1 on far-OOD, making it the only zero-shot method to improve all three without hierarchical prompts or labeled data. Code is available at https://github.com/GenMI-Lab/PROTON, and the project page is available at https://genmi-lab.github.io/PROTON.
summary_zh: 医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够实现零样本临床图像分类，但在部署时可靠检测分布外（OOD）输入仍是一个悬而未决的问题。没有任何静态评分方法能适用于所有偏移类型：FLAIR数据集上的最大概念匹配（MCM）对远OOD的AUROC达到76.4%，但对超宽视野眼底图像等协变量偏移仅达到42.2%，实际上相当于随机猜测。我们将其归因于结构失配：协变量偏移的输入在softmax空间中与分布内样本难以区分，但在VLM嵌入空间中却占据不同的区域。为利用这一未被开发的信号，我们提出PROTON（基于原型测试时在线OOD检测），一种轻量级的后处理模块，通过高置信度测试预测维护在线原型库，并利用流级方差统计自适应融合原型距离与MCM评分，无需修改模型、训练数据或提示工程。在眼科基准FLAIR + FIVES上，PROTON将MCM在协变量偏移上提升+23.9 AUROC，在语义偏移上提升+8.8，在远OOD上提升+8.1，使其成为唯一无需分层提示或标注数据即可同时改善这三种偏移的零样本方法。代码可在https://github.com/GenMI-Lab/PROTON获取，项目主页为https://genmi-lab.github.io/PROTON。
tldr: PROTON is a lightweight post-hoc module for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical vision-language models (VLMs) that adaptively fuses prototype distances with maximum concept matching, achieving significant AUROC gains across covariate, semantic, and far-OOD shifts without requiring model modification or training data.
tldr_zh: PROTON是一种轻量级事后模块，用于医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的分布外（OOD）检测，通过自适应融合原型距离与最大概念匹配，在协变量、语义和远OOD偏移上均实现了显著的AUROC提升，无需修改模型或训练数据。

title: Translating Inference-Time Control to Radiology Vision-Language Models: Activation Steering for Pneumonia Classification on Chest X-rays
summary: Inference-time engineering can alter model behavior without fine-tuning. However, its utility for improving diagnostic performance in medical vision-language models (VLMs) remains unclear. We aim to evaluate whether Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) can improve pneumonia classification in chest radiograph VLMs without updating model weights. Three frozen chest radiograph VLMs (MedGemma-4B-IT, NV-Reason-CXR-3B, and CheXOne-3B) were evaluated on the public Kermany pneumonia test set. Classification was based on the logits of the tokens Yes and No under a binary prompt. Steering vectors included a 30-pair answer-bias control, a 30-pair pneumonia text contrast, and an image-conditioned contrast derived from 30 pneumonia and 30 normal development images. A deterministic 200-image development set was used for layer and scale selection (100 images) and threshold calibration (100 images). Performance was assessed using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, F1 score, threshold analyses, reverse-vector controls, random-vector controls, and conditional bootstrap confidence intervals. Fixed-threshold F1 improvements were frequently observed but did not consistently indicate improved diagnostic performance. For MedGemma-4B-IT. NV-Reason-CXR-3B showed the strongest benefit: calibrated F1 improved from 0.7692 in the zero-shot setting to 0.8619 with pneumonia-text steering and to 0.8727 with image-conditioned steering. For CheXOne-3B, pneumonia-text steering increased calibrated F1 from 0.8528 to 0.8666, although the confidence interval crossed zero. On this public pneumonia benchmark, CAA substantially altered prediction score distributions and operating characteristics without fine-tuning. Meaningful performance gains were observed in one of three evaluated VLMs, suggesting that activation steering may serve as a lightweight approach for adapting medical VLM behavior.
summary_zh: 推理时工程可以在不进行微调的情况下改变模型行为。然而，其在提升医学视觉语言模型（VLM）诊断性能方面的效用尚不明确。本研究旨在评估对比激活加法（CAA）能否在不更新模型权重的情况下改善胸部X光片VLM的肺炎分类性能。我们在公开的Kermany肺炎测试集上评估了三种冻结参数的胸部X光片VLM（MedGemma-4B-IT、NV-Reason-CXR-3B和CheXOne-3B）。分类基于二元提示下“Yes”和“No”标记的对数几率。引导向量包括一组30对答案偏置控制、一组30对肺炎文本对比向量，以及由30张肺炎和30张正常发展图像生成的图像条件对比向量。使用一个确定的200张图像的发展集进行层与尺度的选择（100张图像）以及阈值的校准（100张图像）。通过ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、F1分数、阈值分析、逆向向量控制、随机向量控制以及条件自助法置信区间评估性能。固定阈值的F1提升虽频繁出现，但并未一致性地指示诊断性能的改善。对于MedGemma-4B-IT，NV-Reason-CXR-3B显示出最显著的收益：校准后的F1从零样本设置下的0.7692提升至肺炎文本引导下的0.8619，以及图像条件引导下的0.8727。对于CheXOne-3B，肺炎文本引导将校准后的F1从0.8528提升至0.8666，尽管置信区间跨越了零。在该公开肺炎基准上，CAA在不进行微调的情况下显著改变了预测分数分布和操作特性。三个评估的VLM中有一个展现出有意义的性能提升，表明激活引导可作为调整医学VLM行为的轻量级方法。
tldr: This paper evaluates Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) as an inference-time steering method to improve pneumonia classification in chest X-ray vision-language models without fine-tuning, finding meaningful gains in one of three models.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了对比激活添加（CAA）作为一种推理时间控制方法，在不微调的情况下改善胸部X光视觉语言模型的肺炎分类性能，在三个模型中的一个上取得了显著提升。
authors: Eduardo Moreno Judice de Mattos Farina

title: Anatomically Consistent TMJ Disc Segmentation via Semantic Anchoring and Clinical Priors
summary: Segmenting the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disc from MRI is essential for accurate diagnosis of internal derangement, yet it remains unreliable in practice due to its small size, low contrast, and morphological variability. Existing methods, primarily adapted from general segmentation architectures, often produce fragmented or anatomically inconsistent masks, leading to unstable measurements of disc position and shape for downstream diagnosis. To address these challenges, we propose TISC, a TMJ disc segmentation framework that integrates semantic anchoring with clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement. The framework first establishes robust disc localization in the foundation model feature space via a Prototypical Semantic Anchoring (PSA) module that aggregates adjacent-slice MedDINOv3 features and derives a prototype-driven similarity map. It then performs targeted boundary refinement through a Clinical-Metadata Point Refinement (C-MPR) module, with point-wise predictions modulated by Mouth Open Limitation (MOL), a clinical indicator associated with disc displacement without reduction. On a large-scale cohort of 2,488 PD MRI volumes from 1,300 patients, our method achieves up to a 4.96 Dice improvement over strong baselines across diverse architectures, delivering more anatomically coherent and clinically reliable TMJ disc segmentation.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
从MRI中分割颞下颌关节（TMJ）盘对于准确诊断内紊乱至关重要，但由于其体积小、对比度低及形态多变，在实践中仍不可靠。现有方法主要改编自通用分割架构，常产生碎片化或解剖结构不一致的掩膜，导致下游诊断中盘位置和形状的测量不稳定。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TISC——一个整合了语义锚定与临床元数据引导边界细化的TMJ盘分割框架。该框架首先通过原型语义锚定（PSA）模块在基础模型特征空间中建立稳健的盘定位，该模块聚合相邻切片的MedDINOv3特征并生成原型驱动的相似性图；随后通过临床元数据点细化（C-MPR）模块进行定向边界细化，该模块利用与不可复性盘移位相关的临床指标——张口受限（MOL）来调节逐点预测。在包含1,300名患者的2,488个PD MRI体素的大规模队列中，我们的方法在多种架构上相较于强基线实现了高达4.96的Dice提升，提供了解剖一致性更强且临床可信度更高的TMJ盘分割结果。
tldr: A TMJ disc segmentation framework that uses semantic anchoring via prototype similarity maps and clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement to achieve anatomically consistent and clinically reliable results on a large MRI cohort.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种颞下颌关节盘分割框架，通过原型语义锚定和临床元数据引导的边界细化，在大型MRI队列上实现了解剖学一致且临床可靠的颞下颌关节盘分割。

title: OpenPINT: Open-source Planning for Isoeffective Nuclear Treatments in BNCT research
summary:
Objective: Present OpenPINT (Open-source Planning for Isoeffective Nuclear Treatments), an open-source treatment planning system for nuclear therapies that integrates Monte Carlo dose calculations with modular dosimetric and radiobiological models for photon-isoeffective dose evaluation.
  Approach: We describe the software architecture, implementation choices, and data flow from segmented geometry and source configuration to NIfTI dose outputs. We define BNCT-relevant dosimetric metrics and evaluate the workflow with reproducible analytic and voxelized cylindrical-phantom benchmarks, supplemented by a geometric patient-positioning example.
  Main results: The module provides a reproducible and scriptable path for generating MCNP-ready inputs, extracting component-wise BNCT dose maps, and computing analysis-ready outputs for quality checks and decision support. Fine-resolution voxelized configurations reproduced the 1 mm analytic reference within 0.13% for the brain-limited irradiation-time endpoint, whereas the full voxelized sweep exposed deviations up to 4.42% in coarse 8--10 mm configurations. Patient-wide gamma pass rates were at least 99.60% for the evaluated mesh/interpolation cases, while low-dose DVH-tail quantities remained sensitive to boundary discretization.
  Significance: This first paper isolates and validates the simulation-preparation and dosimetric-analysis core of an open-source BNCT treatment-planning platform. It establishes a foundation for subsequent work on optimization, biological weighting, and clinical workflow integration.
summary_zh:
摘要  
目的：介绍OpenPINT（开源等有效核治疗计划系统），一个用于核治疗的开源治疗计划系统，该系统将蒙特卡洛剂量计算与模块化剂量学及放射生物学模型相结合，用于光子等有效剂量评估。  
方法：本文描述了软件架构、实现选择以及从分段几何和源配置到NIfTI剂量输出的数据流。我们定义了与硼中子俘获治疗相关的剂量学指标，并通过可复现的解析和体素化圆柱形模体基准测试对工作流程进行了评估，同时辅以一个几何患者定位示例。  
主要结果：该模块提供了一条可复现且可脚本化的路径，用于生成MCNP就绪输入、提取分分量BNCT剂量图、以及计算可用于质量检查和决策支持的分析就绪输出。精细分辨率的体素化配置在脑部受限照射时间终点上，与1 mm解析参考值的偏差在0.13%以内；而全体素扫描在粗分辨率8–10 mm配置中显示出高达4.42%的偏差。对于所评估的网格/插值情况，患者整体伽马通过率至少为99.60%，而低剂量区的剂量体积直方图尾部量值仍对边界离散化敏感。  
意义：这是首篇独立验证开源BNCT治疗计划平台中模拟准备与剂量学分析核心的论文。它为后续关于优化、生物学加权及临床工作流程集成的研究奠定了基础。
tldr: OpenPINT is an open-source treatment planning system for Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT), integrating Monte Carlo dose calculations with radiobiological models for photon-isoeffective dose evaluation, validated with phantom benchmarks.
tldr_zh: OpenPINT 是一个用于硼中子俘获治疗（BNCT）的开源治疗计划系统，它集成了蒙特卡洛剂量计算与放射生物学模型，用于光子等效剂量评估，并通过体模基准进行了验证。

title: Surgical Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations
summary: Accurate recognition of anatomical structures is essential for safe and effective minimally invasive surgery (MIS), yet it remains underexplored in surgical computer vision due to limited annotated data and methods tailored primarily to natural scenes. In this work, we present a combined dataset and model framework to advance anatomy-aware perception in MIS. First, we introduce ATLAS-120k, a large-scale clip-level semantic segmentation dataset comprising over 120,000 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos spanning 14 procedures and multiple modalities, including laparoscopic and robot-assisted surgery. The dataset captures substantial procedural variability and was created using a scalable annotation pipeline that integrates expert manual labeling, automated propagation, iterative refinement, and surgeon verification to ensure high-quality annotations. Second, we propose ATLAS (Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations), a video semantic segmentation model specifically designed for surgical anatomy recognition. Unlike conventional approaches that emphasize object tracking, ATLAS leverages foundation-model embeddings together with lightweight temporal reasoning to incorporate contextual cues such as procedure type, surgical phase, and short-term visual memory. This design enables temporally consistent and accurate predictions while maintaining real-time feasibility. Together, the dataset and model establish a practical foundation for robust surgical scene understanding and support the development of clinically applicable guidance systems for minimally invasive surgery. The models, dataset annotations and annotation platform are publicly available at: https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS.
summary_zh: 准确的解剖结构识别对于安全有效的微创手术（MIS）至关重要，然而，由于标注数据有限且现有方法主要针对自然场景，该问题在外科计算机视觉领域仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出了一种联合数据集与模型框架，以推进微创手术中的解剖感知视觉识别。首先，我们引入了ATLAS-120k，一个大规模片段级语义分割数据集，包含来自100个手术视频的超过12万帧标注，涵盖14种手术类型及多种模态，包括腹腔镜手术和机器人辅助手术。该数据集体现了显著的手术变异性，并通过一套可扩展的标注流程构建而成，该流程整合了专家手动标注、自动传播、迭代优化及外科医生验证，以确保高质量的标注。其次，我们提出了ATLAS（利用基础模型表征进行上下文学习的解剖识别），一种专为手术解剖识别设计的视频语义分割模型。与强调目标跟踪的传统方法不同，ATLAS利用基础模型嵌入结合轻量级时间推理，以融入手术类型、手术阶段及短期视觉记忆等上下文线索。这种设计在保持实时可行性的同时，实现了时间上一致且准确的预测。该数据集与模型共同为稳健的手术场景理解奠定了实践基础，并支持开发适用于临床的微创手术引导系统。模型、数据集标注及标注平台公开于：https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS。
tldr: The paper introduces ATLAS-120k, a large-scale clip-level semantic segmentation dataset for surgical anatomy, and ATLAS, a video semantic segmentation model that leverages foundation-model embeddings and temporal reasoning for accurate and real-time anatomy recognition in minimally invasive surgery.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ATLAS-120k，一个大规模的手术解剖语义分割数据集，以及ATLAS模型，该模型利用基础模型嵌入和时间推理实现微创手术中准确且实时的解剖结构识别。
authors: Ronald L. P. D. de Jong

title: THREAD: Trajectory Planning for Hybrid Rigid-Soft Manipulators with Environment-Aware Diffusion
summary: Manipulation in confined environments, such as threading a manipulator through narrow apertures, remains a fundamental challenge, especially for conventional rigid robots. Hybrid rigid-soft manipulators offer promise but face two compounding planning challenges: backbone shapes feasible in free space become infeasible under environmental contact, and planning rigid and soft segments independently ignores their kinematic coupling. We present THREAD, the first diffusion-based trajectory planner for hybrid manipulation, learning a generative prior over physically realizable backbone trajectories conditioned on local environment geometry, with physics-inspired losses encoding curvature, smoothness, and collision constraints jointly across both segments. Trained in simulation, THREAD achieves 92.4% task success with 5x fewer collisions than the strongest baseline. We show cross-embodiment real-world transfer with minimal online updates, successfully threading through apertures as small as 1.3x the soft segment diameter.
summary_zh: 在受限环境中的操控任务（例如将机械臂穿过狭窄孔洞）仍然是一项根本性挑战，尤其对于传统刚性机器人而言。混合刚柔机械臂展现出潜力，但面临两个叠加的规划难题：自由空间中可行的骨架形状在与环境接触时变得不可行，且分别规划刚性段与柔性段会忽略其运动学耦合。我们提出THREAD——首个基于扩散的混合操控轨迹规划器，它学习一个基于局部环境几何条件、物理可实现骨架轨迹的生成先验，并通过物理启发的损失函数在两类机械臂段上联合编码曲率、平滑度与碰撞约束。经过仿真训练，THREAD实现了92.4%的任务成功率，碰撞次数比最强基线方法减少5倍。我们展示了跨形态的真实世界迁移能力，仅需极少的在线更新，即可成功穿过直径仅为柔性段直径1.3倍的孔洞。
tldr: THREAD is the first diffusion-based trajectory planner for hybrid rigid-soft manipulators, learning a generative prior conditioned on local environment geometry and enforcing physical constraints jointly across both segments. It achieves 92.4% task success with 5x fewer collisions than baselines and demonstrates cross-embodiment real-world transfer.
tldr_zh: THREAD是首个针对混合刚柔机械臂的基于扩散的轨迹规划器，学习以局部环境几何为条件的生成先验，并在两个段上联合施加物理约束。它实现了92.4%的任务成功率，碰撞次数比最强基线少5倍，并展示了跨本体的真实世界迁移。

title: OphthaDT: Generative Digital Twins for Forecasting Visual Acuity Trajectories in Ophthalmology
summary: Precision medicine in ophthalmology requires accurate longitudinal predictions, but the fragmented nature of multimodal clinical data remains a barrier to forecasting. We introduce OphthaDT, an LLM-based digital twin for ophthalmology that serializes longitudinal patient histories from 3,220 patients across four Phase III clinical trials into structured narratives to forecast best corrected visual acuity (BCVA). In benchmarks spanning up to 100 weeks, OphthaDT demonstrated the lowest prediction error in neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD), achieving an average mean absolute error (MAE) reduction of 6.0% compared to all baselines. In diabetic macular edema (DME), OphthaDT demonstrated competitive performance against all baselines while outperforming Random Forest and XGBoost by an average MAE reduction of 2.6% and 6.9%, respectively. Results reveal that OphthaDT's predictive advantage scales with trajectory complexity: whereas linear models remain effective for the more stable treatment responses of DME, OphthaDT's capacity is better suited for capturing the high longitudinal variability of nAMD. Finally, OphthaDT handles irregular sampling without imputation, positioning LLM-based clinical trajectory modeling as a methodology that could reduce patient burden and accelerate drug development.
summary_zh: 眼科学中的精准医疗要求对纵向病程进行准确预测，但多模态临床数据的碎片化特征始终是预测的障碍。我们提出OphthaDT——一种基于大语言模型的眼科学数字孪生系统，该系统将来自四项III期临床试验的3220例患者的纵向病史序列化，转化为结构化叙事，以预测最佳矫正视力（BCVA）。在长达100周的基准测试中，OphthaDT在新生血管性年龄相关性黄斑变性（nAMD）的预测中展现出最低的预测误差，与所有基线模型相比，平均绝对误差（MAE）平均降低6.0%。在糖尿病性黄斑水肿（DME）中，OphthaDT与所有基线模型相比表现相当，同时相较于随机森林和极限梯度提升模型，MAE平均分别降低2.6%和6.9%。结果表明，OphthaDT的预测优势随病程轨迹复杂性递增：线性模型对DME相对稳定的治疗反应仍保持有效，而OphthaDT的能力更适合捕捉nAMD的高纵向变异性。最后，OphthaDT无需插补即可处理非规则采样，使基于大语言模型的临床轨迹建模成为可能，该方法有望减轻患者负担并加速药物研发。
tldr: OphthaDT uses LLMs to create digital twins from longitudinal ophthalmology data, forecasting visual acuity trajectories with improved accuracy over baselines, especially for nAMD.
tldr_zh: OphthaDT利用大语言模型从纵向眼科数据创建数字孪生，预测视力轨迹，相比基线方法（尤其是nAMD）提高了准确性。

title: Do Rigid-Body Simulators Dream of Soft Robots? Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Learning contact-rich, whole-body manipulation for soft continuum robots is held back by the lack of simulation infrastructure that has accelerated rigid-robot manipulation. Existing soft robot simulators are physically grounded but lack the contact handling, actuation support, or learning integration needed for contact-rich manipulation; rigid-body approximations offer these capabilities but sacrifice physical grounding. We bridge this gap for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) by deriving a continuum-mechanics-informed discretization that places the soft robot natively inside MuJoCo, unifying tendon forces, body contact, and dynamics in a single physics pipeline. We validate the simulator against a Cosserat rod reference (static and dynamic) and real TDCR hardware. We then train state-based imitation learning policies via teleoperation in simulation and deploy them zero-shot to a physical 3-segment TDCR on a 7-DoF Franka arm across two contact-rich manipulation tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation with continuum robots.
summary_zh: 针对软体连续体机器人的接触丰富全身操控学习，因缺乏加速刚性机器人操控的仿真基础设施而受到制约。现有软体机器人仿真器虽具有物理基础，但缺少接触丰富操控所需的接触处理、驱动支持或学习集成能力；刚体近似方法虽能提供这些功能，却牺牲了物理基础。我们针对肌腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR），通过推导基于连续介质力学的离散化方法，将软体机器人原生嵌入MuJoCo中，在单一物理管线内统一肌腱力、机体接触与动力学。我们基于Cosserat杆参考模型（静态与动态）及真实TDCR硬件对仿真器进行验证，随后在仿真中通过遥操作训练基于状态的模仿学习策略，并将其零样本部署到安装在7自由度Franka机械臂上的物理三节段TDCR上，完成两项接触丰富操控任务。据我们所知，这是首次在连续体机器人接触丰富操控中实现仿真到现实的迁移演示。
tldr: This paper presents a simulation approach for tendon-driven continuum robots in MuJoCo, enabling sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation tasks, demonstrated on a physical 3-segment robot arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在MuJoCo中模拟腱驱动连续机器人的方法，实现了接触丰富操作的仿真到现实迁移，并在物理三段式连续机器人上进行了验证。

title: Human and AI collaboration for pulmonary nodule segmentation
summary: Medical expert annotators are scarce, and blind reliance on artificial intelligence (AI) can be misleading, motivating approaches in which humans, particularly junior medical trainees or even non-medical personnel, collaborate with AI to achieve robust medical segmentation. Although the Segment Anything Model (SAM) shows promise for general-purpose image segmentation, its performance in human-AI collaboration for specialized medical tasks has not been thoroughly evaluated. Here we present Hi-Seg, a human-in-the-loop segmentation framework for pulmonary nodules built on SAM. Humans iteratively refine prompts through trial-and-error learning and semantic reasoning, progressively guiding SAM toward higher-quality masks. Using chest CT scans from 1,179 patients across 12 centers, we conducted the first large-scale external validation of collaborative human-SAM segmentation. Across all annotator groups, Hi-Seg achieved a mean Dice score of almost 85%, outperforming five state-of-the-art deep learning models by 10-22% and 13 SAM variants by 1-29%. Hi-Seg improved segmentation accuracy while reducing annotation time for medical annotators, and briefly trained non-medical annotators achieved performance comparable to that of the junior medical student. These findings suggest that human-in-the-loop segmentation can reduce clinician workload, enable scalable crowdsourced annotation, and transform clinical workflows by facilitating the safe and efficient integration of foundation models into routine clinical practice.
summary_zh: 医学专家标注员资源稀缺，而盲目依赖人工智能可能产生误导，这促使人们探索让人类（尤其是初级医学受训者甚至非医学人员）与人工智能协作，以实现稳健的医学分割。尽管分段任意模型在通用图像分割领域展现出潜力，但其在针对专业医学任务的人机协作中的表现尚未得到充分评估。本文提出Hi-Seg——一种基于SAM的肺结节人在回路分割框架。人类通过试错学习和语义推理迭代优化提示，逐步引导SAM生成更高质量的掩膜。利用来自12个中心共1179名患者的胸部CT扫描数据，我们首次开展了人类与SAM协作分割的大规模外部验证。在所有标注员组中，Hi-Seg的平均Dice得分接近85%，比五种最先进的深度学习模型高出10–22%，比13种SAM变体高出1–29%。Hi-Seg在提升分割精度的同时，减少了医学标注员的标注时间；经简短培训的非医学标注员其表现与初级医学生相当。这些发现表明，人在回路分割能够减轻临床医生工作负担，实现可扩展的众包标注，并通过将基础模型安全高效地整合到常规临床实践中，重塑临床工作流程。
tldr: Hi-Seg is a human-in-the-loop framework built on SAM for pulmonary nodule segmentation, achieving near 85% Dice score and outperforming existing models, enabling scalable annotation by non-medical personnel.
tldr_zh: Hi-Seg是一种基于SAM的人机协同肺结节分割框架，实现了近85%的Dice分数，优于现有模型，并允许非医学人员进行可扩展的标注。

title: BiliVLA: Scene-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model with Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Biliary Endoscopic Navigation
summary: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) demands precise endoscopic navigation and stable biliary cannulation within a narrow monocular field characterized by specular reflections, partial occlusions, and frequent tissue contact. Although recent robotic systems and vision-based assistance techniques improve operator ergonomics and provide perceptual cues, their performance degrades under pronounced anatomical variability and safety-critical visual artifacts, which hinders reliable autonomy in cannulation-grade procedures. Here, we present BiliVLA, a scene-aware Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that formulates biliary endoscopic navigation as an instruction-conditioned visuomotor learning problem. Given an endoscopic observation and a stage-specific language instruction, BiliVLA jointly predicts the target category, a grounded bounding box, and a discrete three degrees of freedom (DoF) motor command for a continuum endoscope. The proposed framework incorporates scene-aware supervision to enhance semantic target consistency and safety-aware recovery supervision to induce conservative retreat behaviors under luminal wall contact. A key component of BiliVLA is a two-stage training paradigm that combines grounding-enhanced supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which significantly improves action reliability and decision consistency during closed-loop navigation. Across three ERCP subtasks, BiliVLA achieves an average action precision of 91.96\% and an overall success rate (SR) of 84.85\% in real-world phantom experiments. These results indicate that integrating semantic grounding, scene-aware learning, and reward-guided optimization improves perception-action alignment and enables robust autonomous endoscopic navigation.
summary_zh: 内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）要求在具有镜面反射、部分遮挡和频繁组织接触的狭窄单目视野内实现精准的内镜导航和稳定的胆管插管。尽管近年来的机器人系统和基于视觉的辅助技术改善了操作者的人体工程学并提供了感知线索，但在显著的解剖变异和影响安全性的视觉伪影下，其性能会下降，从而阻碍了插管级手术中可靠的自主性。本文提出BiliVLA——一种场景感知的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，它将胆道内镜导航建模为指令条件化的视觉运动学习问题。给定内镜观察图像和阶段特定的语言指令，BiliVLA联合预测目标类别、锚定边界框以及连续内镜的离散三自由度（DoF）运动指令。该框架引入场景感知监督以增强语义目标一致性，并引入安全感知恢复监督以在管腔壁接触时诱导保守的退缩行为。BiliVLA的一个关键组件是两阶段训练范式，该范式将定位增强的有监督微调（SFT）与群体相对策略优化（GRPO）相结合，显著提高了闭环导航过程中的动作可靠性和决策一致性。在三个ERCP子任务中，BiliVLA在真实体模实验中达到了91.96%的平均动作精度和84.85%的总体成功率（SR）。这些结果表明，整合语义定位、场景感知学习和奖励引导优化可改善感知-动作对齐，并实现稳健的自主内镜导航。
tldr: BiliVLA is a scene-aware Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework for autonomous biliary endoscopic navigation, combining grounding-enhanced supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (GRPO) to achieve high action precision and success rate in ERCP phantom experiments.
tldr_zh: BiliVLA是一个场景感知的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，用于自主胆道内窥镜导航，结合了接地增强的监督微调和强化学习（GRPO），在ERCP体模实验中实现了高动作精度和成功率。

title: DBT-Bleed: Dual-Branch Temporal Modeling with Key-Frame Selection for Surgical Bleeding Detection
summary: Intraoperative Adverse Events (IAEs) detection is critical for improving surgical safety, with bleeding being among the most frequent events across many surgery types. Existing methods struggle to distinguish bleeding IAE from visually similar residual blood due to limited temporal reasoning. Moreover, modeling long surgical videos while preserving fine-grained temporal dynamics remains computationally challenging. We propose DBT-Bleed, a dual-branch multi-scale temporal modeling framework disentangling bleeding and normal representations using layer-wise temporal adapters for short- and long-term bleeding progression. To efficiently process long surgical videos without sacrificing fine-grained temporal information, we introduce HiRED, a Hierarchical Entropy-Driven frame selection strategy that retains temporally informative segments while removing redundancy. Experiments on the MultiBypass dataset demonstrate gains of 6.53% in F1, 5.62% in Recall and 9% in MCC values for bleeding IAE detection, consistently outperforming video-level baselines. Additionally, we evaluate cross-procedure generalization on a newly curated dataset from a different surgical procedure type, where DBT-Bleed demonstrates robust transferability by achieving gain of 6% in F1 and 8% in MCC under zero-shot setting. To support this evaluation, we introduce EndoPit-IAE, an Endonasal Pituitary Surgery dataset annotated for IAEs, representing the first IAE-annotated dataset in neurosurgery. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 术中不良事件（IAEs）检测对于提高手术安全性至关重要，其中出血是多种手术类型中最常见的事件之一。现有方法因时间推理能力有限，难以将出血不良事件与视觉上相似的残留血液区分开来。此外，在保留细粒度时间动态的同时对长手术视频进行建模仍存在计算挑战。我们提出DBT-Bleed，一种双分支多尺度时间建模框架，通过逐层时间适配器分离出血与正常表征，以捕捉短期和长期的出血进展过程。为在不损失细粒度时间信息的前提下高效处理长手术视频，我们引入HiRED（分层熵驱动帧选择策略），该策略在保留时间信息丰富的片段的同时去除冗余。在MultiBypass数据集上的实验表明，出血不良事件检测的F1值提升6.53%，召回率提升5.62%，MCC值提升9%，持续优于视频级基线方法。此外，我们在一个来自不同手术类型的新标注数据集上评估了跨手术泛化能力，DBT-Bleed在零样本设置下F1值提升6%、MCC值提升8%，展现出稳健的迁移能力。为支持该评估，我们引入了EndoPit-IAE——一个为IAEs标注的经鼻垂体手术数据集，这是神经外科领域首个IAE标注数据集。代码将在录用后公开。
tldr: DBT-Bleed introduces a dual-branch temporal modeling framework with hierarchical entropy-driven key-frame selection (HiRED) to detect surgical bleeding by distinguishing it from visually similar residual blood, achieving significant improvements on multiple surgery datasets.
tldr_zh: DBT-Bleed 提出了一种双分支时间建模框架，结合分层熵驱动的关键帧选择（HiRED），通过区分手术出血与视觉上相似的残余血液，在多个手术数据集上实现了显著改进。

title: PanoVine: Whole-Body Visuomotor Control for Soft Growing Vine Robot
summary: Vine robots, a class of soft, growing robots, are suitable for navigating complex and confined environments due to their compliant bodies and self-supporting growth mechanism. However, hysteresis, tether interactions, and deformations make them difficult to predict and model, which in turn limits the effectiveness of conventional planning and control approaches. In this work, we present a data-driven, vision-based control framework for the first autonomous vine robot system. Our system integrates 19 cameras distributed along the robot's body to provide comprehensive feedback of both the robot state and the surrounding environment. Using this rich whole-body vision feedback, we train an end-to-end visuomotor policy from demonstrations for closed-loop autonomous control in complex environments. The policy efficiently aggregates information from distributed sensing while maintaining robustness to inaccurate robot states and actuation. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned policy enables robust navigation and manipulation in challenging scenarios, including steering through branched structures, climbing up slopes, traversing unsupported terrain, reaching objects precisely, and maneuvering through confined spaces and obstacles. Project website https://panovine-bot.github.io
summary_zh: 藤蔓机器人作为一种软体生长型机器人，凭借其柔性本体与自支撑生长机制，适用于在复杂受限环境中导航。然而，迟滞效应、绳索交互及形变特性导致其难以预测和建模，进而限制了传统规划与控制方法的有效性。本研究提出了一种基于数据驱动与视觉控制的框架，用于构建首个自主藤蔓机器人系统。该系统集成沿机器人本体分布的19个摄像头，实现对机器人状态及周围环境的全面反馈。利用丰富的全身视觉反馈，我们通过示教学习训练了端到端视觉运动策略，用于复杂环境中的闭环自主控制。该策略能够高效聚合分布式传感信息，同时保持对不精确机器人状态与驱动的鲁棒性。实验结果表明，该学习策略使机器人能够在具有挑战性的场景中实现稳健的导航与操作，包括在分支结构中转向、爬坡、跨越无支撑地形、精确目标抓取，以及在狭窄空间与障碍物中穿行。项目网站：https://panovine-bot.github.io
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven, vision-based control framework for autonomous soft growing vine robots, using 19 body-mounted cameras and an end-to-end visuomotor policy trained from demonstrations, enabling robust navigation and manipulation in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的、基于视觉的自主软体藤蔓机器人控制框架，利用机器人本体上的19个摄像头和从示范中学习的端到端视觉运动策略，在复杂环境中实现了鲁棒的导航和操作。

title: Evo-RAD: Navigating Rare Retinal Disease Diagnosis via Self-Evolving Agentic Retrieval
summary: Large-scale pretrained foundation models have revolutionized general medical screening, but often falter on rare diseases because such conditions are underrepresented in real-world clinical datasets. While retrieval-augmented diagnosis attempts to mitigate this, conventional static methods frequently succumb to the hubness problem, retrieving visually similar but semantically incorrect common diseases. To address this, we propose Evo-RAD, a self-evolving agentic framework that transforms evidence acquisition into a dynamic decision-making task. We formulate retrieval as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) where a graphbased agent observes the reference set state and executes actions to purge discordant evidence (DELETE), acquire pathologically consistent samples (INSERT), or conclude the evolution (TERMINATE). Optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a homogeneityaware reward, the agent learns to maximize the diagnostic homogeneity of the support reference set. Experiments on retinal disease benchmarks show that Evo-RAD substantially improves rare-disease diagnosis, outperforming retinal foundation models by +21.04%, while also surpassing retrieval-based and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods by +3.56%. Code is available at https://github.com/SDH-Lab/Evo-RAD.
summary_zh: 大规模预训练基础模型已彻底改变了通用医学筛查，但在罕见疾病上常常表现不佳，因为此类疾病在真实临床数据集中代表性不足。尽管检索增强诊断试图缓解这一问题，但传统的静态方法往往陷入“中心性”问题，检索到视觉相似但语义错误的常见疾病。为此，我们提出Evo-RAD——一种自进化智能体框架，将证据获取转化为动态决策任务。我们将检索过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中基于图的智能体观察参考集状态，并执行动作以清除不一致证据（DELETE）、获取病理一致的样本（INSERT）或终止演化（TERMINATE）。通过基于同质性感知奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化，智能体学会最大化支持参考集的诊断同质性。在视网膜疾病基准上的实验表明，Evo-RAD显著提升了罕见疾病诊断性能，比视网膜基础模型高出21.04%，同时优于基于检索和参数高效微调的方法3.56%。代码可在 https://github.com/SDH-Lab/Evo-RAD 获取。
tldr: Evo-RAD is a self-evolving agentic framework for rare retinal disease diagnosis that formulates retrieval as a Markov Decision Process and uses GRPO with homogeneity-aware reward to dynamically purge, insert, or terminate evidence, achieving substantial improvements over static retrieval and foundation models.
tldr_zh: Evo-RAD是一个自我进化的智能体框架，用于罕见视网膜疾病诊断，将检索建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并利用组相对策略优化（GRPO）和同质性奖励动态删除、插入或终止证据，显著优于静态检索和基础模型。

title: TTFT-Aware Graph Chain-of-Thought:Distance-Indexed Neural A* for Low-Hallucination Multi-Hop Medical Reasoning
summary: Hallucinations and opaque reasoning remain unacceptable failure modes for clinical LLMs. We present a production-grade GraphRAG stack that constrains answers to verifiable graph chain-of-thought paths in a heterogeneous, ~700K-node medical knowledge graph powering a fertility assistant. The core idea is targeted navigation: a directed Pruned Landmark Labeling (PLL) oracle provides exact distances for sub-millisecond feasibility checks and simple-path enumeration, while a lightweight AStarNet heuristic operates strictly within the PLL corridor to prioritize clinically plausible expansions. We score and pack a small, diverse set of paths (CUI/semantic-type overlap, length prior, provenance priors) to condition generation, yielding compact prompts and improved Time to First Token (TTFT). On fertility-focused queries, the hybrid (PLL+AStarNet) establishes a better latency/recall Pareto frontier than text-only RAG and single-component baselines, lowers TTFT, and reduces clinician-audited hallucinations while preserving explanation clarity. The result is a practical recipe for explainable, low-hallucination multi-hop medical reasoning ready for real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 幻觉和不透明推理仍然是临床大语言模型中不可接受的失败模式。我们提出了一种生产级GraphRAG堆栈，该堆栈将答案约束为可验证的图链式推理路径，这些路径来源于一个支撑生育助手的异质约70万节点医学知识图谱。核心思想是定向导航：一个有向剪枝地标标记（PLL）预言机提供亚毫秒级可行性检查和简单路径枚举的精确距离，而一个轻量级AStarNet启发式严格在PLL通道内运行，以优先选择临床合理的扩展。我们对一组小而多样的路径（基于CUI/语义类型重叠、长度先验、来源先验）进行评分和打包以调节生成，从而得到紧凑的提示和更优的首令牌时间（TTFT）。在聚焦生育的查询上，混合方法（PLL+AStarNet）建立了比纯文本RAG和单一组件基线更好的延迟/召回帕累托前沿，降低了TTFT，并在保持解释清晰度的同时减少了临床医生审核的幻觉。结果是为可解释、低幻觉的多跳医学推理提供了实用的方案，已准备好投入实际部署。
tldr: This paper presents a production-grade GraphRAG stack for clinical LLMs that uses a hybrid approach combining Pruned Landmark Labeling (PLL) for efficient distance queries and a lightweight AStarNet heuristic to navigate a medical knowledge graph, reducing hallucinations and improving Time to First Token (TTFT) for multi-hop reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个用于临床大语言模型的生产级GraphRAG框架，通过结合剪枝地标标记（PLL）高效距离查询和轻量级AStarNet启发式方法，在医学知识图谱中导航，减少幻觉并改善多跳推理的首个令牌生成时间（TTFT）。

title: Concept Alignment Contrast and Long-Short Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation of SAM3 in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Concept segmentation models like Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) show strong generalization on natural images, yet their performance degrades in medical imaging due to the domain gap caused by different imaging principles and styles. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) is essential for improving the testing performance by updating the model on the fly without annotations. However, existing vision-language TTA methods are mainly driven by image-level uncertainty minimization, which does not necessarily reflect region-level semantic correctness in medical segmentation. Moreover, they often lack mechanisms to maintain stability in continual one-pass adaptation, leading to limited performance when reliable dense supervision is missing for segmentation. To address these issues, we propose Concept Alignment Contrast and LongShort Prompt Memory for Test-Time Adaptation (CM-TTA) of SAM3 for medical images. First, for a test sample with multiple augmentations, we introduce a novel Concept Alignment Contrast (CAC) metric, which leverages textual-visual semantic consistency to robustly evaluate prediction quality to select the best augmented view as the supervision. Second, to balance rapid and stable adaptation, we design a Long-Short Prompt Memory (LSPM) module. The short memory dynamically fuses recent prompts based on CAC scores for agile local adaptation, while the long memory maintains a stable global prompt to generate enhanced pseudo-labels. Finally, a Densely Supervised Prompt Update (DSPU) strategy is proposed to optimize the prompt embeddings with enhanced pseudo labels as dense supervision. Extensive experiments on prostate and skin lesion segmentation demonstrate that our CM-TTA framework significantly outperforms existing methods for TTA of SAM3.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
概念分割模型（如Segment Anything Model 3，SAM3）在自然图像上展现出强大的泛化能力，但由于不同成像原理与风格造成的领域差异，其在医学影像中的性能有所下降。测试时自适应（TTA）通过在不依赖标注的情况下动态更新模型，对于提升测试性能至关重要。然而，现有的视觉-语言TTA方法主要基于图像级别的不确定性最小化，这未必能反映医学分割中区域级别的语义正确性。此外，这些方法通常缺乏在连续一次性自适应过程中保持稳定性的机制，导致在缺乏可靠密集监督的分割任务中性能有限。为解决上述问题，我们提出了面向SAM3医学图像测试时自适应的概念对齐对比与长短时提示记忆方法（CM-TTA）。首先，针对经过多种数据增强的测试样本，我们引入了一种新型的概念对齐对比（CAC）度量，该度量利用文本-视觉语义一致性稳健评估预测质量，从而选择最佳增强视图作为监督信号。其次，为平衡快速自适应与稳定自适应，我们设计了长短时提示记忆（LSPM）模块。其中，短时记忆基于CAC得分动态融合近期提示，实现灵活的局部自适应；长时记忆则维护稳定的全局提示，用于生成增强伪标签。最后，我们提出密集监督提示更新（DSPU）策略，利用增强伪标签作为密集监督来优化提示嵌入。在前列腺和皮肤病变分割任务上的大量实验表明，我们的CM-TTA框架在SAM3的TTA性能上显著优于现有方法。
tldr: This paper introduces CM-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework for SAM3 in medical image segmentation, featuring Concept Alignment Contrast (CAC) for robust prediction quality evaluation and Long-Short Prompt Memory (LSPM) for stable adaptation, outperforming existing methods on prostate and skin lesion segmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CM-TTA框架，用于医学图像分割中SAM3的测试时自适应，包含概念对齐对比（CAC）进行鲁棒预测质量评估，以及长短期提示记忆（LSPM）实现稳定自适应，在前列腺和皮肤病变分割任务上优于现有方法。

title: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Audio-Language Models from Decentralized Medical Audio
summary: Clinical audio diagnosis in low-resource settings requires models that identify conditions from minimal examples without large annotated corpora. We propose Federated Self-Contextualization (FSC), a multimodal language model framework for in-context clinical audio diagnosis across federated hospital clients. FSC constructs pseudo-label episodes via unsupervised clustering of audio representations, bypassing scarce real diagnostic labels, and enables contextual reasoning from support-query pairs. Our progressive three-stage pipeline first aligns audio embeddings with the language model via caption-based pretraining, then adapts it for episodic in-context inference through federated optimization. At test time, given a small labeled support set, the model diagnoses an unseen query through multimodal reasoning. On held-out respiratory and cardiac conditions, FSC achieves 71.6% accuracy in 2-way 2-shot evaluation, outperforming audio-language baselines by over 9%.
summary_zh: 在低资源环境下的临床音频诊断，需要能够通过极少量样本识别病症的模型，而无需依赖大规模标注语料库。我们提出联邦式自情境化（FSC）框架，这是一种面向跨联邦医院客户端的上下文临床音频诊断的多模态语言模型框架。FSC通过无监督音频表示聚类构建伪标签片段，绕开稀缺的真实诊断标签，并实现基于支持-查询对的上下文推理。其渐进式三阶段流程首先通过基于描述的预训练将音频嵌入与语言模型对齐，再通过联邦优化使其适应片段式上下文推理。在测试阶段，给定少量已标注的支持集，模型通过多模态推理诊断未见过查询样本。在保留的呼吸与心脏疾病评估中，FSC在2-way 2-shot设置下达到71.6%的准确率，较音频-语言基线模型提升超过9%。
tldr: Proposes Federated Self-Contextualization (FSC), a multimodal language model that enables in-context learning for clinical audio diagnosis using decentralized hospital data, achieving 71.6% accuracy on 2-way 2-shot tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出联邦自上下文学习（FSC），一种多模态语言模型，利用分散的医院数据实现临床音频诊断的上下文学习，在2路2样本任务中达到71.6%的准确率。

title: CADRE: Stable, Parameter Efficient Adaptation of Medical Vision Language Models with Bounded Forgetting and Prior Drift
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) such as BiomedCLIP generalize broadly, but adapting them to a clinical service is as much a safety problem as an accuracy one. Updating a deployed model for a new imaging modality can fail silently in two ways that harm patients: it can forget modalities it already handled (catastrophic forgetting), and it can drift from its trustworthy pretrained prior toward modality-specific shortcuts. We study parameter-efficient continual adaptation through these two properties rather than leaderboard accuracy, presenting CADRE: a frozen-backbone framework combining low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with an online, self-scaling, similarity-aware elastic weight consolidation term that bounds retained-competence loss, and an anchor-to-prior penalty bounding embedding drift from the frozen prior. Two short guarantees, a bound on total consolidation mass and a scale-invariance property, remove the scale-related sources of vanilla EWC's order fragility. Using breast cancer across three maximally dissimilar modalities (histopathology, ultrasound, chest radiography) as a controlled cross-modality stress test, under a multi-seed, multi-order protocol with paired significance testing and training approximately 0.23% of parameters, CADRE attains the highest accuracy, SPQ, and backward transfer and the lowest forgetting among adapting methods, reducing forgetting roughly sevenfold versus the strongest regularized baseline (0.075 to 0.011; paired p=0.023) and achieving positive backward transfer where every baseline is negative. We frame these as stability properties aligned with clinical-safety desiderata, not a deployment guarantee; robustness to distribution shift and adversarial inputs is out of scope.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学视觉语言模型（VLM，如BiomedCLIP）具有广泛的泛化能力，但将其适配到临床服务中，不仅涉及准确性，更是一个安全问题。针对新成像模态更新已部署模型时，可能以两种方式无声地失效，从而对患者造成伤害：一是遗忘已处理过的模态（灾难性遗忘），二是从可信的预训练先验偏移至模态特定的捷径。我们通过这两种属性（而非排行榜准确性）研究参数高效的持续适应，提出CADRE框架：一种冻结主干框架，结合低秩适配（LoRA）与一种在线、自缩放、相似性感知的弹性权重整合项（用于约束保留能力损失），以及一项锚定先验惩罚项（用于约束冻结先验的嵌入漂移）。两项简短保证——总整合质量的界与尺度不变性——消除了传统弹性权重整合（EWC）因尺度问题导致的阶数脆弱性。我们以乳腺癌为测试对象，采用三种最大程度不相似的模态（组织病理学、超声、胸部X光）作为受控的跨模态压力测试，在多种子、多阶协议下进行配对显著性检验，并仅训练约0.23%的参数。结果表明，CADRE在适应方法中取得了最高准确性、SPQ、反向迁移以及最低遗忘率，遗忘率相比最强正则化基线降低约七倍（0.075降至0.011；配对p=0.023），并实现了所有基线均为负值的反向迁移的正向结果。我们将这些视为与临床安全需求相一致的稳定性属性，而非部署保证；分布偏移与对抗输入的鲁棒性不在研究范围内。
tldr: CADRE is a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for medical vision-language models that uses LoRA combined with two terms to bound catastrophic forgetting and prior drift, achieving significantly lower forgetting and positive backward transfer on a cross-modality breast cancer stress test.
tldr_zh: CADRE是一个针对医学视觉语言模型的参数高效微调框架，结合LoRA与两个约束项分别限制灾难性遗忘和先验漂移，在跨模态乳腺癌压力测试中显著降低遗忘并实现正向反向迁移。

title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
summary:
We introduce VISTA Architect, a database-oriented AI architecture for integrating large language models (LLMs) with longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). At ingestion, it transforms complex clinical documentation into a persistent, provenance-linked knowledge graph, eliminating repeated reprocessing of raw records at query time. The architecture has two layers: a source-faithful MEDS Graph preserving granular EHR structure with full provenance, and a clinically abstracted Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) that uses graph-guided LLM extraction to synthesize a concise timeline of deduplicated, temporally coherent clinical events. This addresses key limitations of direct long-context prompting and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which often miss temporal relationships and incur high cost and latency from repeated raw-text processing. By precomputing clinical synthesis once, downstream queries access an organized patient state and traverse to source documentation only when detailed verification is needed.
  We demonstrate the system in multidisciplinary thoracic oncology tumor boards at Stanford Medicine, where precise reconstruction of patient histories is critical. Across 1,180 patients, VISTA Architect achieved 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10) on 15 tumor board-salient variables (17,700 evaluations; 95% CI 96.1-96.7%), surpassing a matched BM25 RAG baseline and recent benchmarks for LLM-based clinical extraction. An agentic interface reduced preparation for a 30-patient held-out cohort to about 2.2 minutes without sacrificing accuracy. While configured here for thoracic oncology, the modular design adapts to other specialties through customizable event definitions, episode structures, and agentic tools; validation beyond thoracic oncology remains future work.
summary_zh:
我们将VISTA Architect引入一种面向数据库的AI架构，用于将大语言模型与纵向电子健康记录相集成。在数据摄入阶段，它把复杂的临床文档转化为持久化、具备溯源关联的知识图谱，从而消除查询时对原始记录的重复处理。该架构包含两层：一是忠实于原始数据的MEDS图，保留细粒度的EHR结构并附带完整溯源；二是临床抽象化的时间线对象架构，利用图引导的LLM提取来合成去重且时间连贯的临床事件的简明时间线。这解决了直接长上下文提示和检索增强生成的关键局限——后者常遗漏时间关系，且因重复处理原始文本而带来高昂成本与延迟。通过一次性预计算临床综合信息，下游查询可访问组织化的患者状态，仅在需要详细验证时才回溯到源文档。
我们在斯坦福医学中心的多学科胸部肿瘤肿瘤委员会中展示了该系统，该场景中患者病史的精确重建至关重要。针对1180名患者，VISTA Architect在15个肿瘤委员会关键变量上达到了96.4%的准确率（均值9.75/10，共17700次评估，95%置信区间96.1-96.7%），超越了匹配的BM25 RAG基线以及近期基于LLM的临床提取基准。一个代理式界面将30名患者预留队列的准备工作缩短至约2.2分钟，且未牺牲准确性。尽管本文以胸部肿瘤为配置场景，但其模块化设计可通过可定制的事件定义、情节结构和代理工具适配其他专科；在胸部肿瘤之外的验证仍是未来工作。
tldr: VISTA Architect is a graph database-oriented AI system that integrates LLMs with EHRs by precomputing a persistent knowledge graph to enable efficient, accurate clinical timeline extraction, demonstrated in thoracic oncology tumor boards with 96.4% accuracy and a 2-minute agentic preparation.
tldr_zh: VISTA Architect 是一个面向图数据库的人工智能系统，通过预计算持久化知识图谱将大语言模型与电子健康记录集成，实现高效准确的临床时间线提取，在胸外科肿瘤委员会演示中达到96.4%准确率和约2分钟的智能体准备时间。

title: Polynomial Dice Loss for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation is a fundamental task for medical image processing and computer-assisted intervention, yet data imbalance and small lesion detection pose significant challenges. Dice Loss, which measures the overlap between predicted and ground truth regions, is widely used to mitigate these issues. To further emphasize its properties, we propose Polynomial Dice Loss, a polynomial extension of Dice Loss. Specifically, by leveraging the geometric characteristics of Dice Loss and formulating the loss function as a polynomial representation via Taylor expansion, we enable the adjustment of the contribution of higher-order components to the loss function. In our experiments, we evaluate the proposed method against loss functions derived from conventional Dice and Tversky coefficients. Experimental results and further analysis show that the polynomial formulation provides a simple way to control the loss shape and achieves competitive performance across multiple segmentation settings.
summary_zh: 医学图像分割是医学图像处理与计算机辅助干预中的一项基础任务，但数据不平衡和小病灶检测带来了显著挑战。Dice损失通过衡量预测区域与真实区域之间的重叠度，被广泛用于缓解这些问题。为进一步凸显其特性，我们提出了多项式Dice损失——一种Dice损失的多项式扩展。具体而言，利用Dice损失的几何特征，并通过泰勒展开将损失函数表示为多项式形式，从而能够调整高阶分量对损失函数的贡献。实验中，我们将所提方法与基于传统Dice系数和Tversky系数推导的损失函数进行了评估。实验结果及进一步分析表明，该多项式公式提供了一种简单的方式来控制损失形状，并在多种分割场景下取得了具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: This paper proposes Polynomial Dice Loss, a polynomial extension of Dice Loss using Taylor expansion, which allows adjusting the contribution of higher-order components to improve segmentation performance in medical imaging.
tldr_zh: 本文提出多项式Dice损失，通过泰勒展开将Dice损失扩展为多项式形式，从而能够调整高阶分量的贡献，以提升医学图像分割的性能。

title: Self-Stigma Is Not a Monolith, but Generic Empathy Is: Persona-Conditioned LLM Support for People Who Use Drugs
summary: Self-stigma predicts treatment avoidance and disengagement among people who use drugs (PWUD), yet conversational systems aiming to provide support typically treat self-stigma expression as a uniform signal. We present a three-phase, proof-of-concept study of a persona-aware approach to LLM support. Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) on indicator-level features from 1,174 self-stigma expressors on Reddit yields a four-persona typology validated against held-out behavioral and linguistic features. Sequential Bayesian and recurrent neural classifiers recover these personas from limited posting histories, substantially outperforming batch and few-shot LLM baselines (macro-F1 = 0.74 at 30 posts). Evaluation by eight clinical experts across three contemporary LLMs revealed a misalignment: persona-matched responses successfully achieved targeted behavioral shifts, yet raters holistically preferred the generic empathy of the persona-neutral baseline. Our findings suggest that holistic empathy judgments and clinically-aligned response design can pull in opposite directions, and that evaluating LLM-based stigma support requires rubrics capable of decomposing the two.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自我污名与药物使用人群（PWUD）的治疗回避及脱离行为存在关联，然而旨在提供支持的对话系统通常将自我污名表达视为单一信号。我们提出了一项三阶段的概念验证研究，采用人格感知方法进行大语言模型（LLM）支持。基于Reddit上1,174名自我污名表达者的指标级特征，通过潜在剖面分析（LPA）得出四类人格类型，并在保留的行为与语言特征上得到验证。序列贝叶斯分类器与递归神经网络分类器能够从有限发帖历史中恢复这些人格特征，显著优于批量与少样本LLM基线（30条帖子时宏F1=0.74）。八位临床专家对三个当代LLM的评估揭示了不一致性：人格匹配的回应成功实现了目标行为转变，但评估者整体上更偏好人格中性基线的泛化同理心。本研究表明，整体同理心判断与临床对齐的回应设计可能相互冲突，评估基于LLM的污名支持时需采用能够分解这两者的评分标准。
tldr: This paper presents a proof-of-concept study on persona-aware LLM support for people who use drugs, identifying four self-stigma personas via Latent Profile Analysis, but finds that clinical experts prefer generic empathy over persona-matched responses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向吸毒人群的、基于人格感知的LLM支持概念验证研究，通过潜在剖面分析识别出四种自我污名人格，但临床专家更偏好通用共情而非人格匹配的回应。

title: A specialized reasoning large language model for accelerating rare disease diagnosis: a randomized AI physician assistance trial
summary: Rare diseases affect millions of individuals worldwide, yet timely diagnosis remains a major public health challenge due to scarcity of specialized clinical expertise. While large language models (LLMs) show promise to support rare disease diagnosis, current models are constrained by insufficient clinical deployability, limited clinically grounded evidence, and scarcity of training data. Here we present RaDaR (Rare Disease navigatoR), an open-source, compact reasoning LLM (32B parameters) for rare disease diagnosis. RaDaR was trained with 49,170 publicly available free-text cases and 104,666 synthetic cases with reasoning-enhanced training. RaDaR showed the strongest performance among evaluated open-source models, including the 671B DeepSeek-R1, across public benchmarks and four external validation centers. In a retrospective cohort, RaDaR prioritized the final diagnosis before documented clinical suspicion in 61.06 percent of cases, corresponding to a potential lead time of 1.87 months and 50.18 percent of the within-center interval. In a randomized physician-assistance trial, RaDaR assistance improved physicians' rare-disease diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points compared with internet search alone. Synthetic-data ablations suggested that phenotype-anchored narratives provide useful training signal for long-tail rare diseases, with a monotonic scaling trend within the tested data range. Together, RaDaR and its development and validation framework provide a deployable rare-disease reasoning model and a reproducible development framework for diagnostic AI under data scarcity.
summary_zh: 罕见病影响着全球数百万人，但由于缺乏专业临床知识，及时诊断仍是一个重大公共卫生挑战。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在支持罕见病诊断方面展现出潜力，但当前模型受限于临床可部署性不足、临床循证依据有限以及训练数据匮乏。在此，我们提出RaDaR（罕见病导航器），一个用于罕见病诊断的开源、紧凑型推理大语言模型（320亿参数）。RaDaR基于49,170例公开可用的自由文本病例和104,666例经推理增强训练的合成病例进行训练。在公开基准测试和四个外部验证中心中，RaDaR在评估的开源模型（包括6710亿参数的DeepSeek-R1）中表现出最强性能。在一项回顾性队列中，RaDaR在61.06%的病例中优先于临床记录的可疑诊断之前给出最终诊断，对应潜在提前时间1.87个月，占中心内诊断间隔的50.18%。在一项随机医师辅助试验中，与仅使用互联网搜索相比，RaDaR辅助将医师的罕见病诊断准确率提高了21.44个百分点。合成数据消融实验表明，表型锚定叙述为长尾罕见病提供了有用的训练信号，且在测试数据范围内呈现单调扩展趋势。综上，RaDaR及其开发与验证框架提供了一个可部署的罕见病推理模型，以及在数据稀缺条件下实现诊断AI的可复现开发框架。
tldr: RaDaR is an open-source, 32B-parameter reasoning LLM for rare disease diagnosis, trained on public and synthetic data, that improved diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points in a randomized physician-assistance trial and enabled earlier diagnosis in 61% of cases.
tldr_zh: RaDaR是一个开源、32B参数的推理大语言模型，用于罕见病诊断，通过公开和合成数据训练，在随机医生辅助试验中将诊断准确率提高了21.44个百分点，并在61%的病例中实现了更早的诊断。

title: E-MRL: Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Reliable 3D Tumor Analysis
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show great promise in volumetric medical report generation, they frequently suffer from visual hallucinations and a lack of grounding in 3D CT data. Current Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) strategies typically optimize text fidelity alone, essentially rewarding correct diagnoses derived from language priors rather than genuine visual perception. To address this, we propose cross-view aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning (Evidence-MRL, noted as E-MRL), a reliable RL reasoning framework that formulates the generation process as a Markov Decision Process of "diagnosis-localization-verification". Unlike standard approaches, our model is explicitly trained to identify a "key evidence slice" alongside the global diagnostic report, grounding its findings in verifiable visual evidence. Crucially, we introduce a novel cross-view consistency reward, which validates the semantic alignment between the golden-standard report and a local visual re-query of the selected key slice, providing additional rewards for correctly-localized reasoning. Experiments on large-scale 3D CT tumor datasets demonstrate that E-MRL significantly reduces hallucinations and improves diagnostic accuracy compared to SFT and RL baselines, offering a clinically interpretable solution for visually-grounded and tumor analysis.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）在三维医学报告生成领域展现出巨大潜力，但它们常出现视觉幻觉且缺乏对3D CT数据的可信依据。当前的监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）策略通常仅优化文本保真度，实质上是奖励源自语言先验而非真实视觉感知的正确诊断。为解决这一问题，我们提出跨视角对齐的循证多模态强化学习（Evidence-MRL，简称E-MRL），这是一种可靠的强化学习推理框架，将生成过程形式化为“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程。与标准方法不同，我们的模型被明确训练为在生成全局诊断报告的同时识别“关键证据切片”，从而将诊断结果锚定于可验证的视觉证据。关键之处在于，我们引入了一种新颖的跨视角一致性奖励，该奖励通过验证金标准报告与所选关键切片的局部视觉再查询之间的语义对齐，为正确定位的推理提供额外奖励。在大型3D CT肿瘤数据集上的实验表明，与SFT和RL基线方法相比，E-MRL显著减少了幻觉现象并提升了诊断准确率，为基于视觉证据的肿瘤分析提供了一种临床可解释的解决方案。
tldr: Proposes E-MRL, a multimodal RL framework for 3D CT tumor analysis that uses cross-view consistency reward to ground reports in visual evidence, reducing hallucinations.
tldr_zh: 提出了E-MRL，一种用于3D CT肿瘤分析的多模态强化学习框架，通过交叉视图一致性奖励将报告基于视觉证据，减少幻觉。

title: MedPCFM: Improving Medical Point Cloud Completion by Integrating Point Transformers and Flow Matching
summary: Medical point cloud completion is important for anatomical reconstruction and downstream clinical workflows, yet generative modeling in this setting remains insufficiently studied. We investigate completion through continuous-time generative modeling and introduce PCFM, a PTv3-backed flow matching approach for medical point cloud completion. We evaluate on SkullFix and SkullBreak, and additionally on the more recent Mandibular Defect dataset. We build strong baselines by adapting PTv3 to a deterministic encoder-decoder completion model and by instantiating diffusion completion (PCDiff) with both PVCNN and PTv3 denoisers. PCFM with PTv3 is competitive with the deterministic PTv3 baseline and achieves state-of-the-art generative performance across datasets, while requiring substantially fewer sampling steps than diffusion. At the best operating points, PTv3 also yields clear throughput gains, providing up to a 7$\times$ speed-up for PCFM compared to a PVCNN backbone. Finally, we study empirical scaling trends by varying model size and point cardinality, showing consistent gains with higher point resolution and informative trade-offs across model scales.
summary_zh: 摘要：医学点云补全对于解剖结构重建和下游临床工作流程至关重要，然而该场景下的生成建模研究仍不充分。我们通过连续时间生成建模探索补全问题，并引入PCFM——一种基于PTv3的流匹配方法，用于医学点云补全。我们在SkullFix和SkullBreak数据集上进行评估，并额外在最新的下颌骨缺损数据集上进行了验证。通过将PTv3适配为确定性编码器-解码器补全模型，并利用PVCNN和PTv3去噪器实例化扩散补全（PCDiff），我们构建了强大的基线方法。基于PTv3的PCFM与确定性PTv3基线方法具有竞争力，并在多个数据集上实现了最先进的生成性能，同时所需的采样步数远少于扩散方法。在最佳运行点，PTv3还带来了显著的吞吐量增益，相比PVCNN骨干网络，PCFM最高可实现7倍加速。最后，我们通过改变模型规模和点数量研究了经验缩放趋势，结果表明更高的点分辨率能带来持续的性能提升，且不同模型规模间存在有信息量的权衡。
tldr: This paper introduces PCFM, a flow matching approach using Point Transformer v3 for medical point cloud completion, achieving state-of-the-art generative performance on skull and mandibular defect datasets with fewer sampling steps than diffusion models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PCFM，一种基于Point Transformer v3和流匹配的医学点云补全方法，在颅骨和下颌骨缺损数据集上实现了生成性能的最优，且采样步数远少于扩散模型。

title: T2D-Bench: Evidence-Gated Evaluation of LLM Outputs for Type 2 Diabetes Using a Multi-Layer Clinical-Lifestyle Knowledge Graph
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can produce clinically fluent recommendations for type 2 diabetes while failing to satisfy guideline constraints or explicitly justify lifestyle-related glycemic claims. We present T2D-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evidence-gated evaluation framework for testing whether LLM outputs satisfy explicit, graph-checkable evidence requirements. T2D-Bench is built on a multi-layer clinical-lifestyle knowledge graph that combines a biomedical spine (UMLS, DrugBank, SIDER), computable ADA Standards of Care rules, and lifestyle knowledge connected through a mechanistic bridge to glycemic laboratory effects. Across 100 structured vignettes spanning diagnosis, medication safety, and adversarial lifestyle conflicts, baseline outputs failed benchmark-defined evidence-path checks in 35% of cases for GPT-4o-mini and 33% for GPT-4o. The evidence gate detects unsupported omissions and uses constrained revision to bring outputs into verifier-level compliance with benchmark-defined evidence requirements. These results show that computable evidence constraints can make unsupported clinical omissions explicit, measurable, and correctable in diabetes-focused LLM outputs.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够为2型糖尿病生成临床流畅的建议，但往往无法满足指南约束或明确论证与生活方式相关的血糖主张的合理性。我们提出T2D-Bench——一个可重复的基准测试与证据门控评估框架，用于检验LLM输出是否满足显式、可图化检查的证据要求。T2D-Bench基于多层临床-生活方式知识图谱构建，该图谱融合了生物医学主干（UMLS、DrugBank、SIDER）、可计算的ADA诊疗标准规则，以及通过机制桥梁与血糖实验室效应相连接的生活方式知识。在涵盖诊断、用药安全及对抗性生活方式冲突的100个结构化病例中，基线输出在GPT-4o-mini上35%的案例、在GPT-4o上33%的案例未能通过基准定义的证据路径检查。证据门控机制可检测无依据的遗漏，并通过约束性修订使输出达到与基准定义证据要求相一致的验证器级合规性。这些结果表明，可计算的证据约束能够使无依据的临床遗漏在针对糖尿病的LLM输出中变得显式、可测量且可纠正。
tldr: T2D-Bench is a benchmark and evidence-gated evaluation framework for LLM outputs on type 2 diabetes, built on a multi-layer clinical-lifestyle knowledge graph. It detects unsupported omissions in LLM outputs and shows that computable evidence constraints can make clinical omissions measurable and correctable.
tldr_zh: T2D-Bench是一个针对2型糖尿病LLM输出的基准测试和证据门控评估框架，基于多层临床-生活方式知识图谱构建。它能检测LLM输出中无依据的遗漏，并表明可计算的证据约束可使临床遗漏变得可测量和可纠正。

title: RASC+: Retrieval-Constrained LLM Adjudication for Clinical Value Set Authoring
summary: Clinical value sets define the standardized terminology codes used in quality measurement, phenotyping, cohort construction, and clinical decision support. The recently introduced Retrieval-Augmented Set Completion (RASC) benchmark showed that direct zero-shot large language model (LLM) generation is poorly suited to this task: clinical code systems are large, version-controlled, and not reliably memorized by language models. We study a stage-wise alternative in which candidate-pool construction is optimized for recall and a constrained LLM adjudicator is optimized for candidate selection. On the full 3,744-value-set RASC test split, Qwen3-based retrieval with vocabulary-aware expansion and code-display rescue retrieval increases candidate-pool recall from the original RASC retrieval baseline of 0.553 to 0.730; on the held-out-publisher stratum, pool recall is 0.655. The higher-recall pool alone is not sufficient: applying the original SAPBert cross-encoder to this expanded pool gives full-test macro F1 of 0.287 and held-out-publisher macro F1 of 0.233. Replacing the stage-2 selector with blinded GPT-5 adjudication over the same pool increases full-test macro F1 to 0.549 and held-out-publisher macro F1 to 0.533. These results show that retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication can substantially improve value set completion while preserving the safety constraint that all returned codes must come from an auditable candidate pool.
summary_zh: 临床价值集定义了用于质量测量、表型分析、队列构建和临床决策支持的标准化术语代码。近期引入的检索增强集完成（RASC）基准表明，直接使用零样本大语言模型（LLM）生成并不适合此任务：临床代码系统规模庞大、具有版本控制，且语言模型无法可靠记忆。我们研究了一种分阶段替代方案，其中候选池构建针对召回率进行优化，而受约束的LLM裁决器则针对候选选择进行优化。在完整的3744个价值集RASC测试集上，基于Qwen3的检索结合词汇感知扩展和代码显示救援检索，将候选池召回率从原始RASC检索基线的0.553提升至0.730；在保留出版者层级上，候选池召回率为0.655。仅靠高召回率候选池并不足够：将原始SAPBert交叉编码器应用于此扩展候选池后，全测试集的宏平均F1为0.287，保留出版者层的宏平均F1为0.233。用盲化GPT-5裁决替换阶段二选择器后，在同一候选池上全测试集宏平均F1提升至0.549，保留出版者层宏平均F1提升至0.533。这些结果表明，受检索约束的LLM裁决能够显著改进价值集完成，同时保留所有返回代码必须来自可审计候选池的安全性约束。
