tldr: This paper introduces a retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication approach for clinical value set authoring, demonstrating that separating candidate-pool construction (optimized for recall) from constrained LLM selection (optimized for precision) significantly improves performance over direct LLM generation on the RASC benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种检索约束的大语言模型裁决方法用于临床值集编撰，通过将候选池构建（优化召回率）与受限的LLM选择（优化精确率）分离，在RASC基准上显著优于直接LLM生成。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Enhanced Event-Triggered Data-Driven Predictive Control for a 3D Cable-Driven Soft Robotic Arm
summary: Soft robots are challenging to control due to their nonlinear and time-varying dynamics. Data-enabled predictive control (DeePC) offers a model-free alternative by directly leveraging measured input-output trajectories to construct a predictive controller. However, its receding-horizon formulation requires solving a constrained optimization problem at every sampling instant, which can be computationally demanding for real-time deployment on resource-limited robotic platforms.To address this limitation, we propose an adaptive reinforcement-learning-based event-triggered DeePC (RL-ET-DeePC) framework for soft robotic control. A model-free RL policy is trained to determine when to invoke the DeePC optimizer based on the current system state representation, thereby reducing unnecessary optimization calls while preserving closed-loop performance.Simulation results show that RL-ET-DeePC reduces optimization frequency by up to 66% compared to periodic DeePC, while maintaining comparable tracking accuracy. Hardware experiments on a three-dimensional cable-driven soft robotic arm demonstrate zero-shot transfer, achieving a 34% reduction in optimization frequency with tracking accuracy comparable to periodic DeePC and more consistent performance than a static threshold-based event-triggered baseline.
summary_zh: 摘要：软体机器人因其非线性和时变动力学特性而难以控制。数据驱动预测控制（DeePC）通过直接利用测量的输入-输出轨迹构建预测控制器，提供了一种无模型的替代方案。然而，其滚动时域公式需要在每个采样时刻求解一个带约束的优化问题，这在资源受限的机器人平台上进行实时部署时计算负担较大。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种基于自适应强化学习的事件触发DeePC（RL-ET-DeePC）框架用于软体机器人控制。该框架训练一个无模型的强化学习策略，根据当前系统状态表示决定何时调用DeePC优化器，从而在保持闭环性能的同时减少不必要的优化调用。仿真结果表明，与周期性DeePC相比，RL-ET-DeePC将优化频率降低高达66%，同时保持相当的跟踪精度。在三维绳驱动软体机械臂上的硬件实验验证了零样本迁移能力，实现了优化频率降低34%，跟踪精度与周期性DeePC相当，且性能比基于静态阈值的事件触发基线更加稳定。
tldr: Proposes an RL-based event-triggered data-driven predictive control framework for soft robotic arms, reducing optimization frequency by up to 66% while maintaining accuracy, validated in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于强化学习的事件触发数据驱动预测控制框架，用于软体机器人手臂，将优化频率降低高达66%同时保持精度，并在仿真和硬件上验证。

title: MedGuards: Multi-Agent System for Reliable Medical Error Detection and Correction
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in healthcare settings, accurate error detection and correction in generated or existing text becomes critical, as even minor mistakes can pose risks to patient safety. Existing methods for error detection and correction, including automated checks and heuristic-based approaches, do not generalize well across unseen datasets. In this paper, we propose MedGuards as a medical safety guardrail, which is a new framework that treats medical error detection and correction as a multi-agent in-context learning task. Specialized agents separately detect, localize, and correct errors, while a confidence-guided arbitration mechanism resolves disagreements using reasoning traces and confidence scores. This design enhances interpretability, robustness, and adaptability, without requiring additional training of the base LLMs. Additionally, we introduce the Keyword-Prioritized Correction Score (KPCS), a new evaluation metric that considers whether critical keywords within the reference text are generated correctly, providing a more comprehensive assessment than conventional metrics. Experiments across four multilingual medical datasets consisting of clinical notes demonstrate significant improvements by the proposed framework across several metrics and models. Our aim is to enable safer deployment of LLMs in real-world healthcare applications. For reproducibility, we make our code publicly available at https://github.com/congboma/MedErrBench.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型在医疗场景中的部署日益增多，对生成文本或现有文本进行准确的错误检测与纠正变得至关重要，因为即使是微小的错误也可能对患者安全构成风险。现有的错误检测与纠正方法（包括自动化检查与基于启发式的方法）在面对未见过的数据集时泛化能力不足。本文提出MedGuards作为一种医疗安全护栏，这是一个将医疗错误检测与纠正视为多智能体上下文学习任务的新框架。专门化的智能体分别负责错误检测、定位与纠正，同时一个置信度引导的仲裁机制通过推理轨迹与置信度分数来消除分歧。该设计增强了可解释性、鲁棒性与适应性，且无需对基础大型语言模型进行额外训练。此外，我们引入了关键词优先修正分数（KPCS）这一新的评估指标，该指标考虑了参考文本中的关键关键词是否被正确生成，从而相比传统指标提供了更全面的评估。在包含临床笔记的四个多语言医疗数据集上的实验表明，所提出的框架在多个指标和模型上均取得了显著改进。我们的目标是使大型语言模型在真实医疗应用中实现更安全的部署。为便于复现，我们在 https://github.com/congboma/MedErrBench 上公开了代码。
tldr: MedGuards is a multi-agent framework for detecting and correcting errors in medical text generated by LLMs, using specialized agents and a confidence-guided arbitration mechanism, and introduces a new evaluation metric (KPCS). Experiments on multilingual clinical notes show improvements over baselines.
tldr_zh: MedGuards是一个多智能体框架，用于检测和纠正LLM生成的医疗文本中的错误，使用专门的智能体和置信度引导的仲裁机制，并引入了新的评估指标KPCS。在多语言临床笔记上的实验表明，该方法优于基线。

title: Bridging the Post-discharge Gap: A Traceable Multi-agent Framework for Safe and Continuous Care
summary: Post-discharge clinical follow-up is critical for maintaining continuity of care and mitigating long-term health risks. However, traditional follow-up paradigms suffer from shortage of health workforce, fragmented patient histories, and information silos across clinical departments. While large language models have demonstrated potential in medical question-answering, their deployment in continuous care is hindered by hallucination risks and a fundamental inability to reason over longitudinal, patient-specific constraints. Here we present Healink, a memory-enhanced multi-agent framework to support AI-assisted post-discharge follow-up by generating prescription-grounded, traceable responses that improved completeness and perceived clinical utility in retrospective and physician-blinded evaluations. The architecture seamlessly integrates a triage routing mechanism, a unified memory enhancement module utilizing a robust relational database for optimal latency, and a strict constraint-based retrieval-augmented generation engine. By vectorizing historical clinical records and employing weighted similarity functions across diverse phenotypic and intervention dimensions, Healink ensures precise inter-patient and intra-patient case matching while actively preventing cross-departmental drug conflicts. We evaluated Healink on a dataset comprising 400 continuous and 85 highly complex real-world follow-up cases, alongside the webMedQA benchmark. In a rigorous single-blind evaluation conducted by clinical experts, the framework outperformed human physician baselines in both authoritativeness and clinical safety. By generating a traceable, white-box evidence chain, Healink provides a scalable, safe, and highly effective paradigm for intelligent patient management, ultimately enhancing societal healthcare outcomes.
summary_zh: 摘要：出院后临床随访对于维持护理连续性及降低长期健康风险至关重要。然而，传统随访模式面临卫生人力资源短缺、患者病史碎片化以及各临床科室之间信息孤岛等问题。尽管大语言模型在医学问答领域已展现出潜力，但其在连续性护理中的应用仍受制于幻觉风险以及无法对纵向、患者特定约束条件进行推理的根本性缺陷。我们提出Healink——一种记忆增强型多智能体框架，通过生成基于处方且可追溯的响应来支持AI辅助的出院后随访，在回顾性及医生盲法评估中显著提升了响应完整性与临床实用性。该架构无缝集成了分诊路由机制、利用稳健关系数据库实现最优延迟的统一记忆增强模块，以及基于严格约束的检索增强生成引擎。通过向量化历史临床记录，并跨不同表型与干预维度采用加权相似度函数，Healink能够确保精准的跨患者及患者内部病例匹配，同时主动预防跨科室药物冲突。我们基于包含400例连续随访病例和85例高度复杂真实世界随访病例的数据集，以及webMedQA基准对Healink进行了评估。在临床专家进行的严格单盲评估中，该框架在权威性与临床安全性方面均优于人类医生基线水平。通过生成可追溯的白盒证据链，Healink为智能化患者管理提供了一种可扩展、安全且高效的范式，最终提升了社会医疗健康结局。
tldr: Healink is a memory-enhanced multi-agent framework for safe, continuous post-discharge follow-up, integrating triage routing, relational database memory, and constraint-based RAG to produce traceable, prescription-grounded responses that outperformed human physicians in clinical evaluations.
tldr_zh: Healink是一个基于记忆增强的多智能体框架，用于安全、持续的患者出院后随访，集成分诊路由、关系数据库记忆和约束检索增强生成，生成可追溯、基于处方的响应，在临床评估中优于人类医生。

title: Morphology-Specific Closed-Loop Control of Logarithmic-Spiral Continuum Arms via Online Jacobian Error Compensation
summary: Logarithmic spirals are ubiquitous in biological appendages and provide an attractive morphology for continuum manipulators capable of reaching, wrapping, and grasping. Recently reported logarithmic-spiral robots demonstrated scalable fabrication and versatile grasping but lacked inverse kinematics and closed-loop control. This work presents the first morphology-specific closed-loop task-space control framework for logarithmic-spiral continuum arms. A segmented tendon-driven model with a centerline backbone and equilateral tendon routing is developed in MuJoCo to capture tapered compliance and contact dynamics. An analytical task-space Jacobian is derived directly from the logarithmic-spiral kinematics and combined with online Jacobian error compensation using a Broyden secant update and Kalman-filter estimation. The resulting controller continuously corrects modeling errors arising from nonlinear deformation, contact, and geometric mismatch. The framework is validated through planar and spatial simulations, including trajectory tracking, attitude regulation, disturbance rejection, three-dimensional position tracking, and simultaneous position-orientation control. Compared with a piecewise-constant-curvature (PCC) baseline, the proposed method consistently reduces tracking errors, suppresses attitude drift, and maintains a bounded Jacobian estimation error. The controller is further applied to morphology-enabled manipulation tasks, including obstacle-assisted reach-wrap-release motions, adaptive whole-arm grasping, and cooperative multi-arm object handling. Results demonstrate that combining logarithmic-spiral morphology with online Jacobian compensation enables accurate, robust, and scalable control of highly underactuated continuum manipulators. The proposed framework establishes a physics-grounded baseline for future hardware implementation and learning-augmented soft robotic control.
summary_zh: 对数螺旋在生物附肢中普遍存在，并为具备伸展、缠绕和抓取能力的连续体机械臂提供了极具吸引力的形态学结构。近期报道的对数螺旋机器人展示了可扩展的制造工艺与多功能抓取能力，但缺乏逆运动学与闭环控制。本文提出了首个面向对数螺旋连续体臂的形态特异性闭环任务空间控制框架。我们在MuJoCo中开发了一种基于中心线骨干与等边腱索布线的分段腱驱动模型，以捕获锥形柔顺性与接触动力学。直接从对数螺旋运动学推导出解析任务空间雅可比矩阵，并结合在线雅可比误差补偿——采用Broyden割线更新与卡尔曼滤波估计。所得控制器持续校正由非线性变形、接触及几何失配引起的建模误差。通过平面与空间仿真验证该框架，包括轨迹跟踪、姿态调节、扰动抑制、三维位置跟踪以及同步位姿控制。与分段常曲率（PCC）基线相比，所提方法持续降低跟踪误差、抑制姿态漂移，并保持有界的雅可比估计误差。该控制器进一步应用于形态赋能的操作任务，包括障碍辅助的“伸-绕-放”运动、自适应全臂抓取以及多臂协同物体操作。结果表明，将对数螺旋形态与在线雅可比补偿相结合，能够实现对高度欠驱动连续体机械臂的精确、鲁棒且可扩展的控制。所提框架为未来的硬件实现与学习增强型软体机器人控制奠定了基于物理的基线。
tldr: This paper presents the first morphology-specific closed-loop control framework for logarithmic-spiral continuum arms, combining an analytical Jacobian with online Broyden/Kalman-filter error compensation to achieve accurate trajectory tracking and manipulation in simulation, outperforming the PCC baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个针对对数螺旋连续体臂的形态特异性闭环控制框架，结合分析雅可比矩阵与在线Broyden/卡尔曼滤波误差补偿，在仿真中实现了精确的轨迹跟踪和操作，优于PCC基线。

title: Enhancing Brain MRI Anomaly Detection and Reasoning with ROI Rethink and Synthetic Data
summary: Medical vision-language models typically generate diagnoses through single-pass inference without indicating which image regions support their conclusions. This lack of spatial grounding limits clinical utility: outputs cannot be audited, and models may hallucinate findings on normal scans. We present BrReMark (Brain Rethink via ROI Marking), a framework that introduces explicit region marking into brain MRI diagnosis. The model first generates hypotheses about potential abnormalities and grounds them through explicit bounding box marking, then verifies conclusions by re-examining the marked evidence. Training combines supervised fine-tuning on structured reasoning trajectories with reinforcement learning using a composite reward over localization accuracy and diagnostic reasoning. Furthermore, we integrate a domain randomization-based pathology synthesis augmentation strategy to improve the model's generalizability to out-of-distribution (OOD) data. On internal benchmark, BrReMark improves mAP50 from 0.74% to 37.54% compared to the base model, while achieving 21.57% Clinical F1 and 45.26% diagnostic accuracy. On NOVA OOD benchmark, it also achieves competitive overall performance with a 45.7% reduction in false positives compared to the state-of-the-art, indicating reduced hallucination on rare pathologies. These findings suggest that explicit hypothesis-verification grounding is a practical path toward trustworthy open-ended brain MRI diagnosis across both in-distribution and OOD settings.
summary_zh:
摘要：
医学视觉语言模型通常通过单次推理生成诊断，而未能指出哪些图像区域支持其结论。这种空间基础性的缺失限制了临床实用性：输出结果无法被审计，模型可能在正常扫描中产生幻觉性发现。我们提出BrReMark（通过ROI标记实现脑部再思考）框架，该框架将显式区域标记引入脑部MRI诊断中。模型首先生成关于潜在异常的假设，并通过显式边界框标记进行定位，然后重新检查所标记的证据来验证结论。训练过程结合了基于结构化推理轨迹的有监督微调，以及基于定位准确性和诊断推理的复合奖励的强化学习。此外，我们集成了一种基于域随机的病理合成增强策略，以提升模型对分布外（OOD）数据的泛化能力。在内部基准测试中，与基础模型相比，BrReMark将mAP50从0.74%提升至37.54%，同时实现了21.57%的临床F1分数和45.26%的诊断准确率。在NOVA OOD基准测试中，它也取得了具有竞争力的整体性能，与现有最优方法相比，假阳性降低了45.7%，表明在罕见病理上幻觉现象有所减少。这些发现表明，显式假设-验证定位是在分布内和分布外场景下实现可信赖的开放式脑部MRI诊断的实用路径。
tldr: BrReMark introduces a hypothesis-verification framework for brain MRI diagnosis that explicitly marks bounding boxes of potential abnormalities, uses reinforcement learning for localization accuracy, and incorporates synthetic data augmentation to reduce false positives and enhance OOD generalization.
tldr_zh: BrReMark 提出了一种用于脑部 MRI 诊断的假设-验证框架，显式标记潜在异常的边界框，利用强化学习优化定位精度，并引入合成数据增强以减少假阳性并提高对分布外数据的泛化能力。

title: Pulmonary Embolism Risk Stratification from CTPA and Medical Records: Vascular Graphs Are Not All You Need
summary: Risk stratification for pulmonary embolism (PE) is critical for clinical decision-making. Stratification guidelines are based on patient medical records, parameters measured from computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA), and blood tests. However, blood tests are often missing in routine practice. This work studies whether state-of-the-art models can accurately classify risk stratification from only medical records and biomarkers extracted from CTPA images. We benchmark different approaches to combine medical records and cardiac biomarkers with rich pulmonary vascular information; we add vascular biomarkers to tabular models and apply graph neural networks (GNNs) on the vascular tree's intrinsic graph representation. We use a private dataset (n=353) with uniquely complete data for PE risk stratification. Our results show that, among global features, medical records and cardiac biomarkers are the most significant predictors, while vascular biomarkers do not further improve stratification. Even more surprising, even GNNs on vascular graphs fail to outperform strong tabular baseline on global features. We consider hypotheses, on both models and data, that could explain this suboptimal performance. Our investigation suggests that, counter-intuitively, vascular graphs might hold no discriminative information for PE risk stratification. Code is available from https://github.com/creatis-myriad/GENESIS.
summary_zh: 肺栓塞（PE）的风险分层对于临床决策至关重要。分层指南基于患者病历、CT肺动脉造影（CTPA）测量的参数以及血液检测结果。然而，常规诊疗中常缺失血液检测数据。本研究探讨现有最优模型能否仅凭病历和从CTPA图像中提取的生物标志物准确实现风险分层分类。我们对比了将病历和心脏生物标志物与丰富的肺血管信息相结合的不同方法：将血管生物标志物纳入表格模型，并在血管树的内在图表示上应用图神经网络（GNN）。我们使用了一个包含完整独特数据的私人数据集（n=353）进行PE风险分层。结果表明，在全局特征中，病历和心脏生物标志物是最重要的预测因子，而血管生物标志物并未进一步改善分层效果。更令人意外的是，即使基于血管图的GNN也未能超越基于全局特征的强表格基线模型。我们从模型和数据两个角度探讨了可能导致此次优性能的假设。本研究表明，与直觉相反，血管图可能对PE风险分层不具有判别性信息。代码可从https://github.com/creatis-myriad/GENESIS获取。
tldr: This paper benchmarks deep learning models for pulmonary embolism risk stratification using CTPA and medical records, finding that vascular graphs and graph neural networks do not improve over strong tabular baselines, suggesting limited discriminative value of vascular structure for this task.
tldr_zh: 该论文基准测试了基于CTPA和医疗记录的肺栓塞风险分层深度学习模型，发现血管图和图神经网络未能优于强表格基线，表明血管结构对此任务区分价值有限。

title: Mask to Concept: Auto-Promptable SAM3 via Efficient Test-Time Concept Embedding Search for Few-Shot Annotation
summary: Transforming foundation segmentation models from human-prompted tools into auto-promptable annotators is critical for scalable medical data annotation. Current methods commonly depend on external feature matchers or auxiliary networks to automate geometric prompting, but introducing architectural overhead and limiting performance scalability. Although SAM3 natively supports concept segmentation via reusable text prompts, its direct use in medical imaging is hindered by a lack of fine-grained clinical knowledge and the ambiguity of human-written descriptions. In this work, we propose Mask to Concept (M2C), an efficient framework that adapts SAM3 for medical few-shot annotation without external modules, parameter retraining, or manual text engineering. Using only a few labeled images, M2C enables SAM3 to automatically search for transferable visual concepts entirely within its frozen architecture: it initializes a learnable concept embedding, uses it to prompt segmentation, and updates the embedding by gradients of minimizing the concept segmentation error. We further introduce a Hybrid Uncertainty Estimation (HUE) module that calculates the prediction entropy and maps concept predictions back to the box prompts, measuring concept-geometry prompting inconsistency. Highly uncertain samples are flagged actively for human correction, and the corrected masks are then fed back to M2C to continuously search for more precise concept embeddings, forming a self-enhancing annotation loop with minimal expert effort. Experiments on medical segmentation benchmarks show that our method achieves SOTA few-shot segmentation performance and outstanding annotation efficiency, offering a practical and efficient pathway toward scalable medical image labeling. Codes are at https://github.com/Huster-Hq/M2C.
summary_zh: 摘要：将基础分割模型从人工提示工具转化为可自动提示的标注器，对于可扩展的医学数据标注至关重要。当前方法通常依赖外部特征匹配器或辅助网络来实现几何提示的自动化，但这会引入架构开销并限制性能的可扩展性。尽管SAM3通过可复用的文本提示原生支持概念分割，但其在医学影像中的直接应用受到缺乏细粒度临床知识以及人工描述歧义性的阻碍。在本工作中，我们提出Mask to Concept (M2C)，一种高效的框架，无需外部模块、参数重训练或手动文本工程，即可将SAM3适配于医学小样本标注。仅使用少量标注图像，M2C便能使SAM3在其冻结的架构内自动搜索可迁移的视觉概念：它初始化一个可学习的概念嵌入，利用该嵌入提示分割，并通过最小化概念分割误差的梯度来更新嵌入。我们进一步引入混合不确定性估计（HUE）模块，该模块计算预测熵并将概念预测映射回框提示，从而衡量概念-几何提示的不一致性。高不确定性样本被主动标记以供人工修正，修正后的掩码随后反馈至M2C，持续搜索更精准的概念嵌入，形成以最少专家努力实现自我增强的标注循环。在医学分割基准上的实验表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的小样本分割性能和卓越的标注效率，为可扩展的医学图像标注提供了一条实用且高效的路径。代码地址：https://github.com/Huster-Hq/M2C。
tldr: Proposes M2C, a framework that adapts SAM3 for medical few-shot annotation by searching for transferable visual concepts within its frozen architecture via learnable embeddings and hybrid uncertainty estimation, enabling an auto-promptable, self-enhancing annotation loop with minimal human effort.
tldr_zh: 提出M2C框架，通过在冻结的SAM3架构内搜索可迁移的视觉概念（使用可学习嵌入和混合不确定性估计），实现医疗少样本标注中的自动提示和自增强标注循环，仅需极少的人工校正。

title: LayersReg: A Layer-by-Layer Progressive Regressor for Reliable Intraoperative 3D/2D Registration
summary: 3D/2D registration serves as a cornerstone technique in surgical navigation. Traditional iterative optimization algorithms suffer from low efficiency and high failure rates in intraoperative settings. Deep learning-based methods reformulate registration from iterative optimization to a regression problem that maps image appearance features to spatial pose, typically achieving improved real-time performance and accuracy. However, such learnable methods are confined to memory-driven retrieval of specific pose features rather than understanding the task of image alignment itself, which limits their generalization in complex scenarios. We propose LayersReg, a pioneering regression paradigm that endows the model with 3D anatomical awareness and searches for the correct pose in a progressive, layer-by-layer manner. Inspired by the iterative pose-searching optimization criterion of classical registration, LayersReg searches for correlations between the moving and fixed images in feature space, capturing the trend of pixel flow and thereby converging iteratively toward the correct spatial pose transformation. We further design a coupling of node-wise regression with the progressive registration framework to enhance the model's perception of spatial pose changes. Experimental results demonstrate that under large offsets and multimodality conditions, LayersReg achieves high accuracy on both X-ray/CT registration (0.68°, 1.41 mm) and slice localization (0.73°, 1.55 mm) tasks, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods while meeting the intraoperative demands for precision and real-time capability.
summary_zh: 3D/2D配准是手术导航中的核心技术。传统迭代优化算法在术中环境下存在效率低、失败率高的问题。基于深度学习的方法将配准从迭代优化重构为回归问题，通过映射图像外观特征到空间位姿，通常能实现更优的实时性与精度。然而，这类可学习方法局限于基于记忆的特定位姿特征检索，而非理解图像对齐任务本身，这限制了其在复杂场景下的泛化能力。我们提出LayersReg，一种开创性的回归范式，赋予模型3D解剖感知能力，并以逐层渐进的方式搜索正确位姿。受经典配准中迭代位姿搜索优化准则的启发，LayersReg在特征空间中搜索运动图像与固定图像之间的相关性，捕捉像素流动趋势，从而逐步迭代收敛至正确的空间位姿变换。我们进一步设计了节点回归与渐进式配准框架的耦合机制，以增强模型对空间位姿变化的感知能力。实验结果表明，在大偏移和多模态条件下，LayersReg在X射线/CT配准（0.68°，1.41 mm）和切片定位（0.73°，1.55 mm）任务上均实现了高精度，超越现有最先进方法，同时满足术中操作对精度与实时性的要求。
tldr: LayersReg introduces a progressive, layer-by-layer regression paradigm for intraoperative 3D/2D registration that mimics iterative optimization by searching for pixel flow correlations in feature space, achieving high accuracy and real-time performance under large offsets and multimodality.
tldr_zh: LayersReg 提出了一种逐层递进的回归范式用于术中 3D/2D 配准，通过模仿迭代优化在特征空间中搜索像素流相关性，在较大偏移和多模态条件下实现了高精度和实时性能。

title: Temporally Consistent Label Interpolation for Robust Surgical Multi-Task Learning under Challenging Conditions
summary: Effective multi-task learning for surgical scene understanding is fundamentally hindered by annotation granularity mismatch; temporal workflow tasks such as phase recognition, step recognition and anticipation benefit from dense frame-level supervision, whereas pixel-level spatial tasks including instrument segmentation and action recognition are only sparsely annotated on selected keyframes due to prohibitive labeling costs. This supervision imbalance undermines shared representation learning and limits joint optimization across heterogeneous surgical tasks. To address this, we propose Flow-guided Annotation for Robust Operating Scenes (FAROS), a flow-guided label interpolation framework, that combines zero-shot segmentation-based mask propagation with optical flow estimation to overcome the limitations of appearance-based propagation under challenging surgical conditions such as occlusion, smoke, and motion blur, generating temporally consistent dense pseudo labels from sparse keyframe annotations. The densified instrument masks and action labels are integrated into a unified Transformer-based multi-task framework that jointly learns surgical phase recognition, step recognition, anticipation, instrument segmentation, and action recognition, enabling balanced optimization between dense temporal supervision and sparse spatial supervision. The label interpolation quality of FAROS is first validated on the DAVIS 2017 benchmark under a sparse ground-truth protocol, confirming robust propagation beyond the surgical domain. Extensive experiments on GraSP, MISAW, and AutoLaparo benchmarks further demonstrate that FAROS significantly improves cross-task representation learning and enhances holistic surgical scene understanding performance across spatio-temporal tasks.
summary_zh: 有效多任务学习在手术场景理解中面临的根本障碍是标注粒度不匹配：时间维度的工作流任务（如阶段识别、步骤识别与预测）受益于密集的帧级监督，而像素级的空间任务（包括器械分割与动作识别）由于标注成本过高，仅在选定的关键帧上进行稀疏标注。这种监督不平衡削弱了共享表示学习，并限制了异构手术任务间的联合优化。为此，我们提出面向鲁棒手术场景的流程引导标注（FAROS）——一种基于光流引导的标签插值框架，该框架结合了基于零样本分割的掩膜传播与光流估计，克服了在遮挡、烟雾及运动模糊等具有挑战性的手术条件下依赖外观传播方法的局限性，从而从稀疏关键帧标注中生成时间一致性的密集伪标签。经密集化处理的器械掩膜与动作标签被整合到一个统一的基于Transformer的多任务框架中，该框架联合学习手术阶段识别、步骤识别、预测、器械分割及动作识别，实现了密集时间监督与稀疏空间监督之间的平衡优化。首先在DAVIS 2017基准测试上，采用稀疏真值协议验证了FAROS的标签插值质量，证实了其在手术领域之外的鲁棒传播能力。在GraSP、MISAW及AutoLaparo基准上的大量实验进一步表明，FAROS显著提升了跨任务表示学习，并增强了跨时空任务的整体手术场景理解性能。
tldr: The paper proposes FAROS, a flow-guided label interpolation framework that generates temporally consistent dense pseudo labels from sparse keyframe annotations for surgical multi-task learning, improving representation learning across phase recognition, instrument segmentation, and action recognition under challenging conditions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了FAROS，一种流引导的标签插值框架，从稀疏关键帧标注生成时间上一致的密集伪标签，用于手术多任务学习，在挑战性条件下改进相位识别、器械分割和动作识别的表示学习。

title: RobOralScan: Learning Active Intraoral Scanning for Robotic Dental Reconstruction
summary:
Intraoral scanning is widely used for digital optical impressions in prosthodontic, implant, and orthodontic treatment, but full-arch and long-span scanning remain labor-intensive tasks with limited automation. In the confined oral cavity, operators must continuously adjust scanner motion while accumulating narrow field-of-view observations, making reconstruction quality sensitive to missing tooth surfaces and operator workload.
  We propose RobOralScan, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first reinforcement learning (RL)-based pipeline for robotic automatic intraoral scanning. RobOralScan introduces a geometric memory-based observation space that accumulates partial scan observations into a tri-state geometric representation, allowing the policy to reason over scan history and insufficiently observed regions. It further introduces tooth-wise coverage learning, combining coverage-aware reward signals and a progressive training scheme to improve global reconstruction coverage while reducing uneven coverage across individual teeth. The learned policy selects relative scanner motions from accumulated geometric memory and robot proprioception for closed-loop scan control within the oral workspace.
  RobOralScan achieves a Chamfer Distance of 0.00838, an average coverage of 92.58%, a lower-tail per-tooth coverage of 88.45%, and a normalized AUC of 0.6674, completing the scan criterion in 8 of 10 evaluation episodes. Furthermore, zero-shot sim-to-real experiments demonstrate its practical feasibility on a physical robot-scanner setup.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
口内扫描广泛应用于修复、种植及正畸治疗中的数字化光学印模，但全牙弓及长跨度扫描仍属于劳动密集型任务，自动化程度有限。在受限的口腔环境中，操作者需在累积狭小视野观测数据的同时持续调整扫描仪运动轨迹，使得重建质量易受牙面缺失及操作者工作负荷影响。  
我们提出RobOralScan系统——据我们所知，这是首个基于强化学习（RL）的机器人自动口内扫描流程。RobOralScan引入基于几何记忆的观测空间，将局部扫描观测累积为三态几何表征，使策略能够推理扫描历史及观测不足的区域。该系统进一步提出牙位级覆盖学习，结合覆盖感知奖励信号与渐进式训练方案，在提升全局重建覆盖度的同时减少各牙位覆盖不均。学习后的策略根据累积几何记忆与机器人本体感知选择相对扫描仪运动，实现口腔工作空间内的闭环扫描控制。  
RobOralScan达到0.00838的倒角距离、92.58%的平均覆盖度、88.45%的牙位覆盖下尾端值及0.6674的归一化AUC，在10次评估中完成扫描准则的次数为8次。此外，零样本虚拟到现实实验证明了其在实体机器人装置上的实际可行性。
tldr: RobOralScan introduces a reinforcement learning-based pipeline for autonomous intraoral scanning, using geometric memory and tooth-wise coverage rewards to improve reconstruction quality and reduce operator workload, achieving high coverage and successful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: RobOralScan 提出了基于强化学习的自主口内扫描管道，利用几何记忆和牙齿级覆盖奖励来提升重建质量并减少操作员负担，在仿真和实物实验中均取得了高覆盖率。

title: TAVR-VLM: Risk-Conditioned Causal Grounding for Hallucination-Resistant Report Generation
summary: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) planning requires meticulous multimodal reasoning. However, adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to this high-stakes domain is severely impeded by diagnostic hallucinations, where generated text lacks anatomical grounding. To address this, TAVR-VLM is introduced: a novel framework featuring Risk-Conditioned Causal Grounding Attention (R-CGA) that instantiates a model-internal ``Risk $\rightarrow$ Region $\rightarrow$ Word'' structural grounding pathway. R-CGA compresses multimodal inputs into a causal risk bottleneck, purifying dense visual features into a global risk mask. During autoregressive generation, a support-projected causal consistency objective constrains token-level grounding within the risk-defined support mask. Evaluated on $\text{M}^3\text{TAVR}$, a comprehensive 1,482-patient cohort, TAVR-VLM establishes a new state-of-the-art. It achieves an AUROC of 0.896, boosts CIDEr to 0.936, and drastically reduces the hallucination rate to 8.1\%, thereby improving interpretability for evidence-based surgical AI.
summary_zh: 经导管主动脉瓣置换术（TAVR）规划需要精细的多模态推理。然而，将多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）应用于这一高风险领域受到诊断幻觉的严重阻碍——生成文本缺乏解剖学依据。为此，本文提出TAVR-VLM：一种新颖框架，其核心是风险条件因果基础注意力（R-CGA），该机制实例化了模型内部的“风险→区域→词语”结构化基础推理路径。R-CGA将多模态输入压缩为因果风险瓶颈，将密集视觉特征纯化为全局风险掩码。在自回归生成过程中，通过支持投影的因果一致性目标，在风险定义的支持掩码内约束词元级别的基础依据。在涵盖1,482名患者的综合数据集M³TAVR上评估，TAVR-VLM达到了新的最优性能：AUROC为0.896，CIDEr提升至0.936，同时将幻觉率大幅降低至8.1%，从而提升了循证手术人工智能的可解释性。
tldr: TAVR-VLM introduces a Risk-Conditioned Causal Grounding Attention mechanism to reduce hallucinations in multimodal report generation for TAVR planning, achieving state-of-the-art results on a large cohort.
tldr_zh: TAVR-VLM 提出了一种风险条件因果接地注意力机制，用于减少TAVR规划中多模态报告生成的幻觉，在大规模队列上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Fiber Bragg grating-based acoustic sensing system enabled by ML-trained, sub-picometer-tunable hybrid III-V/SiN lasers
summary: Distributed acoustic emission (AE) sensing is critical for early detection of structural degradation, yet conventional electrical sensors are difficult to scale and fiber-based approaches are limited by interrogation complexity and resolution. Here, we report an intelligent fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensing system enabled by machine learning (ML)-trained hybrid III-V/SiN tunable lasers that achieve uniform, mode-hop-free, sub-picometer wavelength control. A supervised gradient-descent algorithm is used to learn the nonlinear electro-thermal tuning space of Vernier-based external-cavity lasers, enabling continuous tuning with <0.1 pm resolution and <0.5 dB power variation. This capability allows precise alignment to FBG reflection slopes for high-sensitivity acoustic detection. We demonstrate a four-laser interrogation system monitoring 16 FBG sensors distributed across multiple metallic structures, operating over a 35 nm wavelength span. The system autonomously identifies sensor resonances, dynamically tracks spectral shifts, and reconfigures interrogation wavelengths in response to localized acoustic events. Using pencil-lead break tests as calibrated AE sources, we show simultaneous multi-channel detection and adaptive spatial localization. The combination of narrow linewidth (<10 kHz), wide tunability, and ML-driven calibration enables robust, scalable, and high-resolution sensing. This approach establishes a pathway toward fully autonomous, distributed photonic sensing networks for real-time structural health monitoring.
summary_zh: 分布式声发射（AE）传感对于结构退化的早期检测至关重要，但传统电传感器难以规模化，而基于光纤的方法则受限于解调复杂度与分辨率。本文报道了一种由机器学习（ML）训练的混合III-V/SiN可调谐激光器驱动的智能光纤布拉格光栅（FBG）传感系统，实现了均匀、无模式跳变、亚皮米级的波长控制。采用有监督梯度下降算法学习基于Vernier效应的外腔激光器的非线性电热调谐空间，从而实现了分辨率<0.1 pm、功率变化<0.5 dB的连续调谐能力。这种能力使得激光器能够精确对准FBG反射斜率，实现高灵敏度声学检测。我们演示了一个四激光器解调系统，该系统可监测分布在多个金属结构上的16个FBG传感器，工作波长跨度达35 nm。系统能够自主识别传感器谐振峰、动态跟踪光谱漂移，并根据局部声学事件重新配置解调波长。以铅笔芯断裂试验作为校准声源，我们展示了多通道同步检测与自适应空间定位能力。窄线宽（<10 kHz）、宽调谐范围与ML驱动标定的结合，实现了稳健、可扩展且高分辨率的传感。该方法为构建用于结构健康监测的全自主分布式光子传感网络开辟了道路。
tldr: This paper presents an intelligent FBG-based acoustic sensing system using ML-trained hybrid III-V/SiN tunable lasers, achieving sub-picometer wavelength control for high-resolution distributed acoustic emission detection and structural health monitoring.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的混合III-V/SiN可调谐激光器驱动的智能FBG声学传感系统，实现了亚皮米级波长控制，用于高分辨率分布式声发射检测和结构健康监测。

title: Just how sure are you? Improving Verbalized Uncertainty Calibration in Medical VQA
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) applied to Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) tend to produce overconfident outputs regardless of actual correctness, and existing verbalized confidence calibration methods, developed primarily for text only LLMs, do not account for the multimodal nature of medical image understanding.
  This work proposes a training based framework that finetunes MLLMs to improve their calibration using a composite loss function combining a Brier style calibration term, an anchor regularizer that prevents confidence collapse toward extreme values, a contrastive image text alignment term, and a KL based model stabilization term. The alignment signal is derived from a $2 \times 2$ factorial perturbation design that crosses image presence with text integrity, probing the reliance of the model on visual modality input versus language priors. Finally, a top K KL divergence regularizer is used to protect the answering ability of the model during finetuning.
  Across three Medical VQA benchmarks and two architectures (MedGemma 4B IT and Qwen2 VL 7B Instruct), our method reduces calibration error by 60% or more, and improves discrimination by 26% or more, while preserving predictive accuracy. On average across benchmarks, the technique outperforms prompting based, sampling based, and training based approaches, and ablation experiments confirm that each component of the loss function is indeed necessary for improving the calibration. All code for the experiments is publicly available.
summary_zh: 应用于医学视觉问答（VQA）的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）往往会产生过于自信的输出，而无论实际正确性如何；现有的口头置信度校准方法主要针对纯文本LLMs开发，未能考虑医学图像理解的多模态特性。本文提出一种基于训练的框架，通过微调MLLMs来改进其校准性能，该框架使用组合损失函数，包含Brier风格的校准项、防止置信度向极值塌缩的锚定正则化项、对比图像-文本对齐项以及基于KL的模型稳定项。对齐信号源自一个$2 \times 2$因子扰动设计，该设计交叉了图像存在性与文本完整性，探究模型对视觉模态输入与语言先验的依赖程度。最后，使用Top-K KL散度正则化项来保护微调过程中模型的回答能力。在三个医学VQA基准测试和两种架构（MedGemma 4B IT和Qwen2 VL 7B Instruct）上，我们的方法将校准误差降低了60%以上，并将区分度提高了26%以上，同时保持了预测准确性。在基准测试的平均结果上，该技术优于基于提示、基于采样和基于训练的方法，消融实验证实损失函数的每个组成部分对于改进校准确实都是必要的。实验的所有代码均已公开。
tldr: This work proposes a training-based framework to improve verbalized uncertainty calibration in Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) by combining multiple loss terms including a Brier-style calibration term, anchor regularizer, contrastive alignment, KL stabilization, and a top-K divergence regularizer, reducing calibration error by 60% or more across benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该工作提出了一种基于训练的框架，通过组合多种损失项（包括Brier风格校准项、锚点正则化、对比对齐、KL稳定化和Top-K散度正则化）来改善医学视觉问答中的语言化不确定性校准，在多个基准上将校准误差降低了60%以上。

title: Pseudo-Text-Conditioned 3D Grounding DINO for Organ Localization in Abdominal CT
summary: Reliable organ localization in abdominal CT can provide spatial priors for downstream trauma analysis. We propose CT-3GDINO, a lightweight 3D detector that adapts a Grounding-DINO-style query-based architecture to fixed organ localization using frozen pseudo-text class tokens instead of a real text encoder. The model combines a Swin3D visual backbone, bidirectional feature enhancement, pseudo-text-guided query selection, and a cross-modality decoder to predict normalized 3D boxes for liver, spleen, left kidney, right kidney, and bowel. We train and evaluate on 193 matched RSNA/RATIC CT volumes with segmentation-derived boxes. The best multi-scale model, trained from scratch, achieves 0.5830 overall top-1 class-wise mAP over 3D IoU thresholds from 0.1 to 0.7, outperforming fixed- and trainable-backbone classification-pretrained variants with 0.5570 and 0.4657 mAP. Performance is strong for coarse localization, with 0.9649 AP at IoU 0.1, but remains limited for strict box alignment, with 0.1552 AP at IoU 0.7. These results establish CT-3GDINO as an open-source baseline for pseudo-text-conditioned 3D organ localization and motivate future work on localization-aware pretraining, richer multimodal conditioning, and injury-focused detection.
summary_zh: 在腹部CT中实现可靠的器官定位可为下游创伤分析提供空间先验。我们提出CT-3GDINO，一种轻量级3D检测器，它将基于查询的Grounding-DINO架构适配到固定器官定位任务，使用冻结的伪文本类别令牌替代真实文本编码器。该模型结合Swin3D视觉骨干网络、双向特征增强、伪文本引导的查询选择以及跨模态解码器，以预测肝脏、脾脏、左肾、右肾和肠道的归一化3D边界框。我们在193对RSNA/RATIC CT影像（配有分割导出的边界框）上进行训练与评估。从零训练的最佳多尺度模型在3D IoU阈值0.1至0.7范围内取得了0.5830的总体top-1类平均精度（mAP），优于固定骨干与可训练骨干的分类预训练变体（分别为0.5570和0.4657 mAP）。该模型在粗定位上表现强劲，IoU为0.1时AP达0.9649，但在严格边框对齐上仍有局限，IoU为0.7时AP仅为0.1552。这些结果确立了CT-3GDINO作为伪文本条件3D器官定位的开源基线，并为后续关于定位感知预训练、更丰富的多模态条件以及损伤重点检测的研究提供了动力。
tldr: This paper introduces CT-3GDINO, a lightweight 3D detector for organ localization in abdominal CT that adapts Grounding DINO’s query-based architecture using frozen pseudo-text class tokens instead of a real text encoder. It achieves strong coarse localization but limited strict box alignment, serving as an open-source baseline for pseudo-text-conditioned 3D organ localization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CT-3GDINO，一种用于腹部CT器官定位的轻量级3D检测器，它通过使用冻结的伪文本类别标记替代真实文本编码器，改编了Grounding DINO的基于查询的架构。该方法在粗略定位上表现出色，但在严格框对齐上效果有限，为伪文本条件3D器官定位提供了开源基线。

title: Clinical Harness for Governable Medical AI Skill Ecosystems
summary: Medical AI remains organized around isolated models, whereas clinical care requires accountable capabilities that persist across time. We propose clinical AI skills and the Clinical Harness: a runtime governance architecture for registering, orchestrating, guarding and monitoring AI-enabled clinical capabilities. Using osteoporosis as an exemplar, we show how knowledge-driven, data-driven and physics-enhanced skills can support lifecycle care under runtime governance.
summary_zh: 医学人工智能仍以孤立模型的形式组织，而临床照护需要可问责且持续存在的能力。我们提出临床AI技能与临床管控系统（Clinical Harness）：一种用于注册、编排、守护和监控AI驱动临床能力的运行时治理架构。以骨质疏松症为例，我们展示了知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强的技能如何在运行时治理下支持全周期照护。
tldr: This paper introduces the Clinical Harness, a runtime governance architecture for registering, orchestrating, guarding, and monitoring AI-enabled clinical capabilities (called skills), using osteoporosis as an exemplar to demonstrate knowledge-, data-, and physics-enhanced skills across lifecycle care.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了临床护栏（Clinical Harness），一种运行时治理架构，用于注册、编排、防护和监控AI赋能的临床能力（称为技能），并以骨质疏松症为例，展示了知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强技能在全生命周期护理中的应用。

title: Latent Visual Diffusion Reasoning with Monte Carlo Tree Search
summary: Analyzing fine-grained skill activities (e.g., sports, surgery) requires not only recognizing visual patterns but also performing step-by-step visual reasoning that leads to the final judgment. While recent advances in action quality assessment have achieved remarkable progress in evaluating performance, existing models remain black boxes, where they lack the ability to explicitly reveal the reasoning processes underlying their judgments. To address this limitation, we propose Latent Visual Diffusion Reasoning (LVDR), a novel framework that integrates keypoint-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to model and visualize the latent visual reasoning process. LVDR not only produces more accurate skill assessments but also uncovers the critical visual reasoning sequences that contribute to the final evaluation. Extensive experiments across four datasets spanning diverse sports and surgical domains demonstrate that LVDR achieves competitive quantitative performance while providing interpretable visual reasoning trajectories leading to the final predictions. Source codes and models can be found through the following link: https://github.com/XiruiTeng/LVDR_Official.git.
summary_zh: 分析细粒度技能活动（例如体育、外科手术）不仅需要识别视觉模式，还需执行逐步的视觉推理以得出最终判断。尽管动作质量评估的最新进展在性能评价方面取得了显著成果，但现有模型仍是黑箱，缺乏明确揭示其判断背后推理过程的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出潜在视觉扩散推理（LVDR），这是一种新颖框架，它结合了关键点引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）来建模并可视化潜在视觉推理过程。LVDR不仅能产生更准确的技能评估，还能揭示对最终评价起关键作用的视觉推理序列。跨越多个体育和外科领域的四个数据集上的大量实验表明，LVDR在提供可解释的视觉推理轨迹以支撑最终预测的同时，实现了具有竞争力的量化性能。源代码和模型可通过以下链接获取：https://github.com/XiruiTeng/LVDR_Official.git。
tldr: This paper proposes a Latent Visual Diffusion Reasoning (LVDR) framework that integrates keypoint-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to model and visualize step-by-step visual reasoning for fine-grained skill assessment, achieving competitive quantitative performance and interpretable reasoning trajectories across sports and surgical datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种潜在视觉扩散推理（LVDR）框架，该框架结合关键点引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）来建模和可视化细粒度技能评估中的逐步视觉推理过程，在多个体育和手术数据集上取得了有竞争力的定量性能，并提供了可解释的推理轨迹。

title: From Black-Box to Clinical Insight: A Multi-Stage Explainable Framework for Speech-Based Cognitive Impairment Detection
summary: Speech-based cognitive impairment detection offers a noninvasive, accessible alternative to costly biomarker assays, yet transformer-based models remain clinically uninterpretable. We propose a multi-stage explainability framework that translates black-box transformer predictions into clinically grounded narratives by integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based token attribution, theory-informed linguistic features, and a four-stage LLM reasoning pipeline using LLaMA-3.1-70B-Instruct. Built on the SpeechCARE-Adaptive Gating Network multimodal screening model (F1 = 72.11% on the NIA PREPARE benchmark), the framework maps model outputs to four cognitive-linguistic dimensions, including lexical richness, syntactic complexity, and semantic coherence. Physician evaluation on 70 stratified English samples demonstrated strong alignment with patient-level cognitive profiles, and a System Usability Scale score of 82/100 indicated high potential for clinical workflow integration.
summary_zh: 基于语音的认知障碍检测提供了一种无创、便捷的替代方案，可替代昂贵的生物标志物检测，然而基于Transformer的模型在临床上仍难以解释。我们提出了一种多阶段可解释性框架，通过整合基于SHAP的令牌归因、理论驱动的语言特征以及使用LLaMA-3.1-70B-Instruct的四阶段大语言模型推理流程，将黑箱Transformer模型的预测结果转化为具有临床依据的叙述。该框架基于SpeechCARE自适应门控网络多模态筛查模型（在NIA PREPARE基准上F1得分为72.11%），将模型输出映射到四个认知-语言维度，包括词汇丰富度、句法复杂度和语义连贯性。医生对70个分层英语样本的评估表明，该框架与患者个体认知特征高度吻合，系统可用性量表得分82/100，显示出其在临床工作流程整合中的巨大潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-stage explainability framework that integrates SHAP, theory-informed linguistic features, and an LLM reasoning pipeline to transform black-box transformer predictions for speech-based cognitive impairment detection into clinically interpretable narratives, achieving a high System Usability Scale score.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多阶段可解释性框架，整合了SHAP、理论驱动的语言特征和大型语言模型推理流水线，将基于语音的认知障碍检测的黑箱Transformer预测转化为临床可解释的叙述，并获得了较高的系统可用性评分。

title: An AI agent for treatment reasoning over a biomedical tool universe
summary: Treatment reasoning underpins every therapeutic decision, integrating disease context, comorbidities, medications, contraindications, and evolving biomedical knowledge to select an appropriate therapy. It is inherently iterative: candidates are weighed against many constraints, revised as evidence emerges, and grounded in verifiable sources. Here we introduce ATHENA-R1, an AI agent for treatment reasoning across all FDA approved drugs since 1939, trained by reinforcement learning over a universe of 212 biomedical tools. At each step it identifies missing information, selects and runs relevant tools, and incorporates the evidence. To train it without human-annotated traces, we build a two-level self-learning framework: multi-agent systems construct the tools, tasks, and reasoning trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then reinforcement learning with scientific feedback rewards reasoning quality (evidence gathering, grounded tool use, logical non-redundancy). Across five benchmarks of 3,168 drug reasoning tasks and 456 patient treatment cases, ATHENA-R1 outperforms language models and tool-use systems, reaching 94.7% accuracy on open-ended drug reasoning and 82.9% on treatment reasoning, 17.8 and 10.7 points above GPT-5. In blinded evaluations by experts from 28 rare disease organizations, it is preferred over reference models on all criteria, and physicians rated it favorably on complex hospitalized cardiovascular and infectious-disease cases. Adverse-event hypotheses it generated, tested in electronic health records from 5.4 million patients, reached adjusted odds ratios of 1.48-1.84, with no elevation among negative controls. Because it requires knowing what evidence to seek before concluding, treatment reasoning has long been hard for AI; we show it can be reframed as a learnable process of iterative evidence gathering that reinforcement learning can train AI to perform.
summary_zh: 治疗推理支撑着每一项治疗决策，它整合疾病背景、合并症、用药情况、禁忌证及不断发展的生物医学知识，以选择适当的治疗方案。这一过程本质上是迭代的：候选方案需权衡多重约束，随证据出现而调整，并基于可验证的来源。在此我们介绍ATHENA-R1——一个面向自1939年以来所有FDA批准药物的治疗推理AI智能体，通过对212项生物医学工具集合的强化学习训练而成。每一步中，它识别缺失信息，选择并运行相关工具，整合所得证据。为在无人工标注轨迹的情况下训练该模型，我们构建了双层自学习框架：多智能体系统构建工具、任务及推理轨迹以进行监督微调，随后通过带有科学反馈的强化学习来奖励推理质量（证据收集、基于工具的推理、逻辑非冗余性）。在涵盖3,168项药物推理任务与456个患者治疗案例的五个基准测试中，ATHENA-R1优于语言模型及工具使用系统，在开放式药物推理任务上达到94.7%的准确率，在治疗推理任务上达到82.9%，分别超过GPT-5达17.8和10.7个百分点。在来自28个罕见病组织的专家盲评中，该模型在所有评价指标上均优于参考模型，且医生对其在复杂住院心血管及感染性疾病案例中的表现评价积极。其生成的不良事件假说在540万患者的电子健康记录中测试后，调整后的比值比达到1.48-1.84，阴性对照组则无升高。由于需要在得出结论前明确应寻找何种证据，治疗推理长期以来对AI而言颇为困难；我们证明，这可以被重新定义为可学习的迭代证据收集过程，而强化学习能够训练AI完成这一过程。
tldr: ATHENA-R1 is an AI agent for treatment reasoning trained via reinforcement learning over 212 biomedical tools, achieving high accuracy on drug and treatment reasoning benchmarks and outperforming GPT-5, with expert and physician preference and validated adverse-event hypotheses in electronic health records.
tldr_zh: ATHENA-R1是一个通过强化学习在212个生物医学工具上训练的治疗推理AI智能体，在药物和治疗推理基准上取得高准确率并超越GPT-5，得到专家和医生的青睐，并在电子健康记录中验证了不良事件假设。

title: Detecting Clinical Hallucinations in LVLMs via Counterfactual Visual Grounding Uncertainty
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly used for clinical image understanding, yet they remain vulnerable to \emph{hallucinations}--producing textual findings or attributes not supported by the image. We present a vision-traceable hallucination detection framework that audits arbitrary LVLM responses via visual evidence grounding, requiring neither modification nor internal access to the hidden states of LVLMs. Given an LVLM response, we extract visually verifiable entities and use a medical-domain-adapted Qwen-VL grounding verifier to localize each entity on the input image. To enhance the robustness of our detection method, we introduce a counterfactual entity perturbation method and estimate visual evidence uncertainty by contrasting factual and counterfactual grounding results. Specifically, we compute an entity-level uncertainty score from the positive confidence, counterfactual confidence, and their grounding overlap for binary hallucination decision-making. Experiments on multiple medical imaging modalities and LVLM backbones demonstrate that our method consistently improves hallucination detection performance over recent baselines, while providing interpretable localization evidence and strong cross-model transferability. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Agentic-CliniAI/CounterVHD.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）越来越多地应用于临床图像理解，但它们仍然容易产生“幻觉”——即生成图像中不存在的文本发现或属性。我们提出了一种视觉可追溯的幻觉检测框架，通过视觉证据基础来审计任意LVLM的响应，无需修改或访问LVLM的隐藏状态。给定一个LVLM响应，我们提取视觉可验证的实体，并使用适应医学领域的Qwen-VL基础验证器在输入图像上定位每个实体。为了增强检测方法的鲁棒性，我们引入了一种反事实实体扰动方法，并通过对比事实与反事实的基础结果来估计视觉证据的不确定性。具体而言，我们基于正向置信度、反事实置信度及其基础重叠计算实体级不确定性得分，用于二元幻觉决策。在多种医学成像模态和LVLM骨干网络上的实验表明，我们的方法相较于近期基线模型持续提升了幻觉检测性能，同时提供了可解释的定位证据和强大的跨模型迁移能力。代码和数据集可从 https://github.com/Agentic-CliniAI/CounterVHD 获取。
tldr: The paper presents a hallucination detection framework for large vision-language models (LVLMs) in clinical image understanding, using counterfactual visual grounding uncertainty to verify textual entities against the image without requiring model internal access.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于临床图像理解中大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉检测框架，通过反事实视觉基础不确定性来验证文本实体是否与图像一致，无需访问模型内部状态。

title: Envisage: Diffusion-Based Rhinoplasty Goal Visualization with Mask-Decomposed Evaluation
summary: Localized generative editing needs localized evaluation: full-image identity metrics are structurally confounded under hard-composited edits. We present Envisage, a FLUX.1-Fill inpainting reference pipeline for rhinoplasty goal visualization from a single frontal photograph. The pipeline combines 8 rhinoplasty clinical presets (the released framework also includes 8 blepharoplasty and 8 rhytidectomy presets), MediaPipe masks, and hard-mask compositing. The composite preserves outside-mask pixels by construction, so full-face identity scores are dominated by copied pixels rather than by the diffusion backbone. Because full-face identity metrics cannot grade localized edits, we introduce SurgicalScore, a mask-decomposed 0-1 protocol scoring edit direction, edit magnitude, masked LPIPS, realism, and outside-mask preservation; SS_raw assigns 0.919 [0.918, 0.920] to a perfect-predictor control , anchoring the ceiling. On N=211, the paired ArcFace gain (output-to-GT minus input-to-GT) is negative for all methods (Envisage -0.048 smallest, vs. ICEdit -0.139, Kontext -0.242, InstructPix2Pix -0.294; p < 1e-4), with external validation on a 457-pair ASPS/PCA corpus showing a larger negative gap. With SurgicalScore, Envisage achieves the highest score (0.599 [0.579, 0.619]) and leads on both metrics, but the all-negative ArcFace gap shows that full-face identity is poorly aligned with localized surgical accuracy under hard compositing. A 5-seed GT-oracle (an upper bound, not a deployable result) reduces the residual ArcFace gap by 73% (-0.054 to -0.015), with positive output-to-GT gain on 33.9% of cases, indicating candidate-space headroom for a learned ranker. For localized edits, progress should be measured with edit-region fidelity rather than full-face identity metrics. We release Envisage, SurgicalScore, preset definitions, and matched split manifests.
summary_zh: 局部化生成编辑需要局部化评估：在硬合成编辑下，全脸身份指标存在结构性混淆。我们提出Envisage，一种基于FLUX.1-Fill修复参考流程，用于从单张正面照片实现鼻整形目标可视化。该流程整合了8种鼻整形临床预设（已发布框架还包括8种眼睑整形和8种面部除皱预设）、MediaPipe掩膜以及硬掩膜合成。合成结果通过结构设计保留了掩膜外像素，因此全脸身份得分主要来源于复制像素而非扩散主干。由于全脸身份指标无法评估局部化编辑，我们引入SurgicalScore——一种掩膜分解的0-1协议，用于评估编辑方向、编辑幅度、掩膜LPIPS、真实感以及掩膜外保留度；SS_raw对完美预测对照赋予0.919 [0.918, 0.920]，确立了天花板基准。在N=211上，所有方法的配对ArcFace增益（输出-真实值减去输入-真实值）均为负值（Envisage -0.048最小，对比ICEdit -0.139、Kontext -0.242、InstructPix2Pix -0.294；p < 1e-4），在457对ASPS/PCA语料库上的外部验证显示更大的负差距。使用SurgicalScore，Envisage取得最高分（0.599 [0.579, 0.619]）并在两项指标上领先，但全负的ArcFace差距表明，在硬合成条件下全脸身份与局部手术准确性之间的一致性较差。一个5种子真实值预言机（上界，非可部署结果）将残余ArcFace差距缩小73%（从-0.054降至-0.015），在33.9%的案例中实现了正向输出-真实值增益，表明候选空间存在用于学习排序器的提升空间。对于局部化编辑，进展应以编辑区域保真度而非全脸身份指标衡量。我们发布了Envisage、SurgicalScore、预设定义及匹配的分割清单。
tldr: Envisage presents a diffusion-based inpainting pipeline for rhinoplasty goal visualization from a single frontal photo, using clinical presets and hard-mask compositing. It introduces SurgicalScore, a mask-decomposed evaluation protocol that reveals full-face identity metrics are inadequate for assessing localized surgical edits.
tldr_zh: Envisage 提出了一种基于扩散模型的图像修复流水线，用于从单张正面照片进行鼻整形目标可视化，采用临床预设和硬遮罩合成。它引入了 SurgicalScore，一种遮罩分解评估协议，揭示了全脸身份指标不足以评估局部手术编辑。

title: A French OSCE Dialogue Dataset and Controllable Virtual Patient System for Clinical Training
summary: The clinical and communication skills of medical students are commonly assessed through Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs), which consist of brief scenario-driven simulations of doctor-patient interactions. However, training is often limited by the low availability of human standardized patients, motivating the development of realistic virtual patients (VPs). To address this gap, we introduce a French OSCE dialogue dataset comprising 240 student-patient training interactions. We build upon it a controllable LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic OSCE dialogues. The pipeline integrates modular components, such as retrieval-based grounding and a reflection loop, to ensure patient fidelity, coherence, and realism. Additionally, we propose a multi-level evaluation framework assessing patient simulation quality, student performance, and linguistic quality, using an LLM-as-a-Judge approach. Experiments suggest that controllability modules generally improve patient fidelity and student evaluation consistency. Finally, we implement an interactive prototype in which students can practice with a VP and receive automatic feedback.
summary_zh: 摘要：医学生的临床与沟通技能通常通过客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）进行评估，该考试由一系列基于场景的简短医患互动模拟组成。然而，由于人类标准化患者可用性较低，培训往往受到限制，这推动了逼真虚拟患者（VP）的开发。为弥补这一不足，我们引入了一个包含240次学生-患者培训互动的法语OSCE对话数据集。在此基础上，我们构建了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的可控流水线，用于生成合成OSCE对话。该流水线集成了模块化组件（如基于检索的锚定机制和反思循环），以确保患者真实性、连贯性和逼真度。此外，我们提出了一种多层级评估框架，采用“LLM作为评判者”的方法，评估患者模拟质量、学生表现和语言质量。实验表明，可控性模块通常能提升患者真实性和学生评估一致性。最后，我们实现了一个交互式原型，使学生能够与虚拟患者进行练习并接收自动反馈。
tldr: This paper introduces a French OSCE dialogue dataset of 240 student-patient interactions and a controllable LLM-based pipeline to generate synthetic dialogues for virtual patient training, including a multi-level evaluation framework and an interactive prototype.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个包含240次学生-病人交互的法语OSCE对话数据集，以及一个可控的基于LLM的流程来生成用于虚拟病人训练的合成对话，包括多级评估框架和交互式原型。

title: Mitigating Batch Effects in Histopathology via Language-Mediated Robust Embedding Generation
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have demonstrated strong potential across clinical and scientific applications, yet their performance is often hindered by batch effects, which are non-biological variations across tissue source institutions (TSIs) that distort learned feature representations and impair generalization. Conventional mitigation strategies, such as stain normalization, offer limited success in addressing these high-dimensional, complex artifacts. We present GLMP (General-purpose LLM-Mediated Pathology model), a novel framework that generates robust numerical embeddings from histology image patches through an intermediate textual representation. By leveraging pretrained general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and text encoders, GLMP effectively prioritizes biologically meaningful signals over TSI-specific artifacts, thereby improving cross-institutional generalization. To our knowledge, GLMP is the first pathology model to use text descriptions of histological features as an intermediate representation for generating numerical embeddings from histology images. Our results highlight the untapped potential of broad-domain, non-specialized MLLMs in computational pathology and introduce a new paradigm for building versatile, generalizable, and robust pathology models.
summary_zh: 摘要：病理基础模型（PFMs）在临床与科研应用中展现出巨大潜力，但其性能常受批次效应影响——即组织来源机构（TSIs）间存在的非生物学变异会扭曲学得的特征表征并削弱泛化能力。传统缓解策略（如染色归一化）在应对这些高维复杂伪影时效果有限。我们提出GLMP（通用大语言模型介导的病理模型），这是一种通过中间文本表征从组织图像块生成鲁棒数值嵌入的新框架。通过利用预训练的通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）及文本编码器，GLMP有效优先关注具有生物学意义的信号而非TSI特异性伪影，从而提升跨机构泛化能力。据我们所知，GLMP是首个将组织学特征文本描述作为中间表征，用于从组织图像生成数值嵌入的病理模型。我们的研究结果揭示了广域非专用MLLMs在计算病理学中尚未被充分挖掘的潜力，并为构建通用、可泛化且鲁棒的病理模型开创了新范式。
tldr: This paper proposes GLMP, a framework that uses pretrained multimodal LLMs to generate robust numerical embeddings from histology images via intermediate textual representations, effectively mitigating batch effects across institutions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GLMP框架，利用预训练的多模态大语言模型，通过中间文本表示从组织学图像生成稳健的数值嵌入，有效缓解跨机构的批次效应。

title: Multi-Contact Force Estimation for Continuum Robots via Gaussian-Parameterized Factor Graphs
summary: Continuum robots offer key advantages in navigating unstructured environments, but their safe operation requires accurate estimation of the external contact forces acting anywhere along the robot body. Estimating these forces at unknown locations is an ill-conditioned problem, particularly for multiple contacts. We propose a unified shape and force estimation framework formulated on a factor graph. By incorporating a Gaussian mixture force parameterization into a discretized probabilistic Cosserat rod model, we reduce the dimensionality of the unknown external forces and mitigate the ill-conditioning of node-wise force estimation. The framework fuses strain, tendon tension, and pose measurements to simultaneously estimate the robot's shape and external forces while accounting for modeling and sensor uncertainties. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing methods in terms of force location and magnitude estimation for both single and multi-contact scenarios. We further present a progressive variant that introduces basis functions on demand to estimate contact forces sequentially during a simulated confined-navigation task.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人在非结构化环境导航中具有关键优势，但其安全运行需要精确估计作用于机器人本体任意位置的外部接触力。在未知位置估计这些力是一个病态问题，尤其是在多接触情况下。我们提出了一种基于因子图构建的统一形状与力估计框架。通过将高斯混合力参数化融入离散化的概率Cosserat杆模型，我们降低了未知外力的维度，并缓解了节点力估计的病态性。该框架融合应变、肌腱张力和位姿测量，在考虑模型与传感器不确定性的同时，同步估计机器人形状和外力。数值仿真表明，在单接触和多接触场景下，所提方法在力的位置和大小估计方面均优于现有方法。我们进一步提出一种渐进变体，该变体按需引入基函数，在模拟受限导航任务中顺序估计接触力。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified shape and force estimation framework for continuum robots using Gaussian-parameterized factor graphs, which reduces ill-conditioning in multi-contact force estimation and fuses strain, tendon tension, and pose measurements, outperforming existing methods in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高斯参数化因子图的连续机器人统一形状与力估计框架，通过减少多点接触力估计中的病态问题，融合应变、肌腱张力和位姿测量，在仿真中优于现有方法。

title: BTI-Net: Bidirectional Decoder-Level Task Interaction via Uncertainty-Aware Gating for Multi-Task Medical Image Analysis
summary: Jointly learning to segment and classify medical images demands cross-task synergy, yet encoder-sharing architectures limit decoder reconstruction to task-private representations, permanently discarding the boundary cues and semantic priors each branch could supply to the other. This work introduces BTI-Net, which establishes bidirectional communication at every decoder level through two parallel pathways via Task Interaction Modules (TIM). Spatial boundary context is gated into the classification branch, while global semantic priors multiplicatively modulate the decoder, with refined features propagating progressively from coarse semantics to fine boundary detail across all four decoder resolutions. Since cross-task interaction is not equally reliable for every input, Uncertainty Proxy Attention (UPA) gates each TIM output per instance and per level using three signals that capture cross-task alignment, scene complexity, and prediction confidence, without external annotations or additional inference passes. Experiments on three medical benchmarks spanning ultrasound, dermoscopy, and brain MRI demonstrate consistent improvements in segmentation IoU and classification accuracy over both encoder-sharing and decoder-interaction baselines. Ablation confirms adaptive gating contributes +2.36 IoU over fixed bidirectional interaction, and classification accuracy improves by up to +2.26 points over the strongest multi-task baseline. UPA's uncertainty proxies serve as reliable single-pass task-failure signals without the overhead of stochastic sampling. Code: https://github.com/C-loud-Nine/BTI-Net_MTL
summary_zh: 联合学习医学图像分割与分类需要跨任务协同，但编码器共享架构将解码器重建限制为任务私有表示，永久丢弃了各分支可相互提供的边界线索和语义先验。本文提出BTI-Net，该网络通过任务交互模块（TIM）在每条解码器层级建立两条并行路径的双向通信。空间边界上下文被门控注入分类分支，而全局语义先验则通过乘法方式调节解码器，精炼特征从粗粒度语义逐步传播到跨四个解码器分辨率的精细边界细节。由于跨任务交互对每个输入并非同样可靠，不确定性代理注意力（UPA）利用三种信号（捕获跨任务对齐、场景复杂度及预测置信度）对每个实例和每个层级的TIM输出进行门控，无需外部标注或额外推理过程。在超声、皮肤镜和脑部MRI三项医学基准上的实验表明，相较于编码器共享和解码器交互基线，分割IoU和分类精度均持续提升。消融实验证实，自适应门控相较于固定双向交互贡献了+2.36 IoU，分类精度比最强多任务基线提升了多达+2.26个百分点。UPA的不确定性代理可作为可靠的单次任务失败信号，且无需随机采样的开销。代码：https://github.com/C-loud-Nine/BTI-Net_MTL
tldr: BTI-Net introduces bidirectional decoder-level task interaction with uncertainty-aware gating for joint segmentation and classification in medical images, achieving improvements across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: BTI-Net 提出了一种具有不确定性感知门控的双向解码器级任务交互方法，用于医学图像的联合分割与分类，在多个基准上取得改进。

title: Interventional Flow Matching: Prospective Dose-Response Forecasting with Velocity-Field Jacobian Regularization
summary:
Predicting a patient's physiological trajectory under a planned treatment sequence is a prospective interventional problem, not standard time-series extrapolation. We study this problem in glucose management, where insulin and carbohydrate records are policy-dependent: future drivers are coupled to patient state, behavior, and clinical decision rules, so observational forecasting accuracy alone does not guarantee correct responses to planned interventions.
  We introduce Interventional Flow Matching (IFM), a continuous-time generative framework for physiologically constrained prospective forecasting. IFM conditions a flow-matching velocity field on patient history and planned future drivers in a bounded latent glucose space. Rather than embedding strict mechanistic glucose--insulin ODE equations or enforcing causality through rollout-based simulations, IFM uses a solver-free regularization: it penalizes the Jacobian of the instantaneous velocity field with respect to smoothed treatment drivers. This imposes signed, dose-bounded local sensitivities directly on the learned dynamics: insulin lowers glucose, carbohydrates raise it, and both responses remain within plausible ranges.
  On a simulated UVA/Padova type 1 diabetes cohort, IFM achieves the strongest balance between observed-driver RMSE and interventional response metrics. Across experiments, it consistently produces physiologically correct responses to both insulin and carbohydrate drivers while maintaining high directional, and ranking consistency.
summary_zh:
预测患者在计划治疗方案下的生理轨迹是一个前瞻性干预问题，而非标准的时间序列外推。我们在血糖管理领域研究该问题，其中胰岛素和碳水化合物记录依赖于治疗策略：未来的驱动因素与患者状态、行为和临床决策规则耦合，因此仅凭借观测预测的准确性并不能保证对计划干预做出正确响应。

我们提出干预流匹配（IFM），一种用于生理约束下前瞻性预测的连续时间生成框架。IFM在有界潜在血糖空间中，基于患者历史信息和计划的未来驱动因素，对流匹配速度场进行条件化。IFM并未嵌入严格的机制性血糖-胰岛素常微分方程，也未通过基于展开的模拟来强制因果关系，而是采用一种无求解器的正则化方法：它惩罚瞬时速度场相对于平滑处理驱动因素的雅可比矩阵。这直接将带符号、剂量有界的局部敏感性施加于学习到的动态过程：胰岛素降低血糖，碳水化合物升高血糖，且两者的响应均保持在合理范围内。

在模拟的UVA/Padova 1型糖尿病队列上，IFM在观测驱动因素的均方根误差与干预响应指标之间实现了最强的平衡。在各项实验中，它始终对胰岛素和碳水化合物驱动因素产生生理学上正确的响应，同时保持了高方向一致性和排序一致性。
tldr: This paper introduces Interventional Flow Matching (IFM), a continuous-time generative framework that uses velocity-field Jacobian regularization to enforce physiologically correct dose-response relationships for prospective forecasting in glucose management, achieving strong performance on a simulated type 1 diabetes cohort.
tldr_zh: 本文提出介入式流匹配（IFM），一种连续时间生成框架，通过速度场雅可比正则化强制实现生理上正确的剂量-响应关系，用于葡萄糖管理中的前瞻性预测，在模拟的1型糖尿病队列上表现优异。

title: Vision-Language Procedural Reasoning for Context-Aware Reward Modeling of Robotic Endovascular Guidewire Navigation
summary: Robotic-assisted endovascular interventions demand accurate, stable, and context-aware guidewire navigation in complex and patient-specific vascular anatomies. Despite recent advances in robotic precision and learning-based control, existing autonomous navigation methods remain limited by their reliance on static reward functions and the lack of explicit procedural reasoning regarding anatomical context and task progression. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a vision-language procedural reasoning (VL-PR) framework for autonomous guidewire navigation. The framework integrates a multimodal large language model (MLLM) as a procedural reasoning module that interprets real-time visual observations to infer high-level navigation contexts. Instead of generating low-level control commands, the inferred procedural insights enable context-aware reward adaptation by dynamically adjusting the importance of reward components across different navigation phases. This approach allows a single policy to resolve competing objectives and handle complex transitions while preserving a consistent global task goal. Experiments on a physical robotic platform across diverse vascular scenarios demonstrate enhanced task reliability and streamlined navigational efficiency, highlighting the advantages over static-reward methods and offering a scalable solution for complex and multi-task robotic endovascular procedures.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助血管内介入治疗需要在复杂且患者特异性的血管解剖结构中实现精准、稳定且具有环境感知能力的导丝导航。尽管近期在机器人精度与基于学习的控制方面取得了进展，但现有自主导航方法仍受限于对静态奖励函数的依赖，且缺乏针对解剖语境与任务进程的显式程序推理能力。为解决上述挑战，本文提出一种面向自主导丝导航的视觉-语言程序推理（VL-PR）框架。该框架集成多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为程序推理模块，通过解读实时视觉观测推断高层级导航语境。所推断的程序性洞察并非生成低级控制指令，而是通过动态调整不同导航阶段中奖励分量的重要性，实现环境感知的奖励自适应。该方法使单一策略能够解决竞争性目标，同时处理复杂状态转换，并维持一致的全局任务目标。在物理机器人平台上开展的多样化血管场景实验表明，该方法增强了任务可靠性并提升了导航效率，凸显出相较于静态奖励方法的优势，为复杂多任务机器人血管内手术提供了可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: The paper proposes a Vision-Language Procedural Reasoning (VL-PR) framework that uses a multimodal large language model to infer procedural context and adapt reward weights dynamically, enabling more reliable and efficient autonomous guidewire navigation in robotic endovascular interventions compared to static-reward methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种视觉语言程序推理（VL-PR）框架，利用多模态大语言模型推断程序上下文并动态调整奖励权重，相比静态奖励方法实现了更可靠、高效的机器人血管内导丝自主导航。

title: HTC-SGA Former: A Hybrid Transformer-CNN Network with Self-Guided Attention and a New Boundary-Weighted Adaptive Loss for Coronary DSA Vessel Segmentation
summary: Accurate coronary Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) vessel segmentation is essential for computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning of coronary artery disease (CAD). However, thin low-contrast vessels, background interference, and severe vessel-background class imbalance make reliable segmentation of weak distal branches and vessel boundaries challenging. Existing methods struggle to balance global contextual reasoning with preservation of weak vessels, vessel continuity, and fine boundaries. To address these limitations, we propose HTC-SGA Former, a lightweight hybrid Transformer-CNN framework for coronary DSA vessel segmentation. It employs a CNN encoder for local vessel morphology extraction and a Transformer decoder for contextual feature modeling. A Multi-Scale Global-Local Window Attention (MS-GLWA) block performs efficient global-local contextual modeling, while a Self-Guided Feature Attention (SGFA) module enhances weak-vessel responses. In addition, a Boundary-Weighted Adaptive Compound Loss (BWACL) emphasizes thin-vessel boundaries and adaptively balances vessel recovery and boundary refinement. Experiments on private right and left coronary artery DSA subsets show that HTC-SGA Former outperforms 14 state-of-the-art segmentation methods while maintaining a compact architecture with only 0.81M parameters. BWACL also improves performance over binary cross-entropy and Dice losses across four encoder-decoder architectures, demonstrating strong cross-backbone applicability. HTC-SGA Former improves thin-vessel recovery, vessel continuity, and boundary localization through complementary global-local contextual modeling, vessel-focused refinement, and adaptive optimization, supporting reliable and computationally efficient coronary vessel analysis for future computer-assisted cardiovascular interventions.
summary_zh: 精确的冠状动脉数字减影血管造影（DSA）血管分割对于冠状动脉疾病（CAD）的计算机辅助诊断和治疗规划至关重要。然而，细小的低对比度血管、背景干扰以及严重的血管-背景类别不平衡，使得对弱远端分支和血管边界的可靠分割面临挑战。现有方法难以平衡全局上下文推理与弱血管、血管连续性及精细边界的保持。为解决这些限制，我们提出HTC-SGA Former，一种轻量级混合Transformer-CNN框架，用于冠状动脉DSA血管分割。该框架采用CNN编码器提取局部血管形态，并利用Transformer解码器进行上下文特征建模。多尺度全局-局部窗口注意力（MS-GLWA）模块实现高效的全局-局部上下文建模，而自引导特征注意力（SGFA）模块增强弱血管响应。此外，边界加权自适应复合损失（BWACL）强调细小血管边界，并自适应平衡血管恢复与边界细化。在私有左右冠状动脉DSA子集上的实验表明，HTC-SGA Former在保持仅有0.81M参数的紧凑架构的同时，优于14种最先进的分割方法。BWACL在四种编码器-解码器架构上相较于二元交叉熵损失和Dice损失也提升了性能，展现出强大的跨骨干网络适用性。HTC-SGA Former通过互补的全局-局部上下文建模、聚焦血管的细化以及自适应优化，改善了细小血管恢复、血管连续性和边界定位，为未来计算机辅助心血管介入治疗提供可靠且计算高效的冠状动脉血管分析。
tldr: HTC-SGA Former is a lightweight hybrid Transformer-CNN framework with self-guided attention and a boundary-weighted adaptive loss for accurate coronary DSA vessel segmentation, outperforming 14 state-of-the-art methods with only 0.81M parameters.
tldr_zh: HTC-SGA Former 是一种轻量级混合 Transformer-CNN 框架，结合自引导注意力与边界加权自适应损失，用于冠状动脉 DSA 血管分割，在仅有 0.81M 参数的情况下优于 14 种最新方法。

title: Real-Time Compliance and Position Control of a Hyper-redundant Soft Robotic Arm
summary: Robots working in unstructured or partially unobservable environments must combine accurate motion with physical compliance that can passively correct contact misalignment. Soft robots provide this compliance but have struggled to precisely control their tip compliance and position. This paper presents a robot architecture designed around that control problem: a 7-link arm whose six articulated joints provide twelve independently driven revolute axes, each actuated by an antagonistic pair of pneumatic muscles, so that every axis can simultaneously change its angle and linearly adjust its stiffness. The rigid articulated backbone makes the tip compliance and position of the arm predictable enough to be commanded quantitatively in real time. The robot employs a unified iterative inverse-kinematics and inverse-compliance controller to achieve simultaneous, quantitative control of both compliance and position. The task-space compliance and kinematics models and the control law are derived and verified on both the physical arm and a matched simulation. Simulation is then used to study how the same framework extends to other arm morphologies. Finally, the arm demonstrates tasks that have been difficult for both rigid and soft arms: rejecting disturbances while writing on a moving whiteboard, and passively correcting hidden misalignment during a key-insertion and drawer-opening task. That these tasks succeed under so straightforward a controller is evidence for the advantage of this algorithm-informed structural design.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在非结构化或部分不可观测环境中工作的机器人必须将精确运动与能够被动纠正接触偏差的物理柔顺性相结合。软体机器人提供了这种柔顺性，但在精确控制其末端柔顺性和位置方面存在困难。本文提出了一种围绕该控制问题设计的机器人架构：一条七连杆机械臂，其六个关节提供十二个独立驱动的旋转轴，每个轴由一对拮抗气动肌肉驱动，从而使每个轴能够同时改变角度并线性调节其刚度。刚性铰接骨架使机械臂的末端柔顺性和位置具有足够的可预测性，进而能够实时进行定量控制。该机器人采用统一的迭代逆运动学与逆柔顺控制器，实现了对柔顺性和位置的同时定量控制。推导了任务空间柔顺性模型、运动学模型及控制律，并在实物机械臂及相应仿真中进行了验证。随后利用仿真研究了同一框架如何扩展到其他机械臂形态。最后，该机械臂展示了对于刚性和软体机械臂均具挑战性的任务：在移动的白板上书写时抵抗干扰，以及在钥匙插入和开抽屉任务中被动纠正隐藏偏差。这些任务在如此简单的控制器下成功完成，证明了这种基于算法驱动的结构设计的优势。
tldr: This paper presents a 7-link hyper-redundant soft robotic arm with antagonistic pneumatic muscles, enabling simultaneous real-time control of position and stiffness via a unified inverse-kinematics and inverse-compliance controller, validated on disturbance rejection and hidden misalignment tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有7个连杆的超冗余软体机械臂，采用拮抗式气动肌肉驱动，通过统一逆运动学与逆柔顺控制器实现位置和刚度的同步实时控制，并在干扰抑制和隐藏错位任务中得到验证。

title: DEEPMED Search: An Open-Source Agentic Platform for Medical Deep Research with Introspective Verification
summary: Navigating the deluge of heterogeneous medical data, from academic literature (PubMed) to clinical guidelines (Web) and private knowledge bases, remains a critical bottleneck for evidence-based medicine. While commercial black-box tools lack transparency, standard open-source RAG implementations frequently suffer from reasoning drift when handling complex, long-tail queries. We present DEEPMED Search, a fully open-source, agentic platform designed for transparent medical deep research. Built on a high-performance Next.js architecture, DEEPMED Search features a source-adaptive router that autonomously dispatches sub-queries to PubMed, web search, or local graph-based knowledge bases based on information density. Crucially, the platform integrates an introspective verification module, powered by a causal-consistent multi-agent debate framework, to validate retrieved evidence against diagnostic logic before synthesis. To demonstrate its robustness, we showcase DEEPMED Search's ability to autonomously decompose high-difficulty rare disease queries, filter out confounding noise, and generate structured, citation-backed research reports in minutes. By open-sourcing this software, we provide the community with a robust infrastructure to democratize access to trustworthy, glass-box medical reasoning in research and prototyping settings.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
从学术文献（PubMed）到临床指南（Web）再到私有知识库，海量异构医疗数据的处理始终是基于证据医学的关键瓶颈。尽管商业黑箱工具缺乏透明度，标准开源RAG实现处理复杂长尾查询时却常出现推理漂移。我们提出DEEPMED Search——一个完全开源、具备代理能力的平台，专为透明的医学深度研究设计。该平台基于高性能Next.js架构，配备源自适应路由器，能根据信息密度自动将子查询分发至PubMed、网络搜索或本地图知识库。关键在于，平台集成了内省验证模块，该模块由因果一致性多代理辩论框架驱动，可在综合生成前依据诊断逻辑验证检索证据。为展示其鲁棒性，我们演示了DEEPMED Search如何自主分解高难度罕见病查询、滤除混杂噪声，并在数分钟内生成结构化、附引用的研究报告。通过开源此软件，我们为社区提供强大基础设施，以在研究及原型设计场景中实现可信、透明化医疗推理的可及性民主化。
tldr: DEEPMED Search is an open-source agentic platform for transparent medical deep research that uses a source-adaptive router to query PubMed, web, and graph knowledge bases, and integrates an introspective verification module based on causal-consistent multi-agent debate to validate evidence and generate structured reports.
tldr_zh: DEEPMED Search是一个完全开源的智能体平台，用于透明的医学深度研究。它通过源自适应路由器查询PubMed、网页和图谱知识库，并结合基于因果一致性多智能体辩论的内省验证模块来验证证据并生成结构化报告。

title: Latent-CURE for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal Large Models have significantly advanced automated breast ultrasound diagnosis. However, most existing frameworks utilize opaque, end-to-end paradigms prioritizing global statistical correlations over structured clinical reasoning. Consequently, these models remain susceptible to shortcut learning amid extreme real-world epidemiological imbalances, often bypassing rare but decisive malignant indicators for dominant benign patterns. To address this disconnect, we propose Latent-CURE, a novel diagnostic framework driven by asymmetric weighted chain-of-thought methodology grounded in latent space reasoning. Unlike traditional approaches, our framework constructs an implicit reasoning trajectory forcing the model to sequentially infer standardized BI-RADS morphological descriptors before converging on a final diagnosis. Furthermore, to combat the extreme scarcity of critical malignant features, we couple this architecture with a dual-asymmetric optimization strategy. By dynamically adjusting margins and weights, this strategy safeguards high-specificity malignant descriptors from being overshadowed by common benign priors. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our knowledge-injected approach provides transparent clinical evidence while achieving robust, accurate diagnostic performance in imbalanced medical cohorts.
summary_zh: 多模态大模型显著推进了自动乳腺超声诊断的发展。然而，现有大多数框架采用不透明的端到端范式，优先考虑全局统计相关性而非结构化临床推理。因此，在现实世界中极端流行病学不均衡的情况下，这些模型仍易受捷径学习影响，往往忽略罕见但具有决定性意义的恶性指标，而偏向占主导地位的良性模式。为解决这一脱节问题，我们提出Latent-CURE——一种基于潜在空间推理的非对称加权思维链方法驱动的新型诊断框架。不同于传统方法，该框架构建了一条隐式推理轨迹，迫使模型在得出最终诊断前依次推断标准化的BI-RADS形态学描述符。此外，为应对关键恶性特征的极端稀缺性，我们将此架构与双非对称优化策略相结合。通过动态调整边际和权重，该策略可保护高特异性恶性描述符不被常见良性先验所掩盖。全面评估表明，我们注入知识的方案在提供透明临床证据的同时，能在不均衡医学队列中实现稳健、准确的诊断性能。
tldr: Latent-CURE is a breast cancer diagnostic framework that uses an asymmetric weighted chain-of-thought reasoning in latent space to force the model to infer BI-RADS descriptors sequentially before diagnosis, and employs a dual-asymmetric optimization strategy to handle class imbalance, outperforming standard end-to-end models.
tldr_zh: Latent-CURE 是一个乳腺癌诊断框架，利用潜在空间中的非对称加权思维链推理，强制模型在得出最终诊断前逐步推断 BI-RADS 形态学描述符，并通过双非对称优化策略应对类别不平衡，优于标准端到端模型。

title: Clinical Reasoning Graphs: Structured Evaluation of LLM Diagnostic Reasoning Reveals Competence Without Consistency
summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) reach 60-70% diagnostic accuracy on complex clinical case benchmarks, but accuracy alone cannot distinguish stable clinically-grounded reasoning from pattern matching. We introduce clinical reasoning graphs, structured graph representations extracted from free-text LLM diagnostic traces using a domain-grounded ontology with 5 node types and 7 edge types. We apply this pipeline to 750 traces from five LLMs across 50 New England Journal of Medicine Clinicopathological Conference cases and three prompt conditions, and test whether diagnostic traces show stable structured reasoning patterns, or diagnostic schemas, for clinically similar cases. We operationalize this as higher graph similarity among clinically similar cases than among clinically dissimilar ones. Across 15 model-condition comparisons, within-cluster and between-cluster composite similarity are nearly equal, and no comparison survives multiple-testing correction; a component-level analysis finds any residual content signal far below schema scale. Graph similarity is also nearly identical for pairs of models that are both correct (0.488) and both incorrect (0.484), suggesting that graph structure captures a dimension not reflected in diagnostic accuracy. Structured reflection prompting increases explicit discriminating-feature analysis within traces (+33%) but does not increase cross-case consistency. These results show diagnostic competence without schema-scale reasoning consistency, and indicate that final-answer accuracy should be complemented by process-level evaluation. We release the ontology, extraction pipeline, validation protocol, and the extracted reasoning graphs and similarity artifacts as resources for structured evaluation of LLM clinical reasoning.
summary_zh: 现代大型语言模型（LLM）在复杂临床病例基准测试中可达到60-70%的诊断准确率，但仅凭准确率无法区分稳定的临床依据推理与模式匹配。我们引入临床推理图——基于包含5种节点类型和7种边类型的领域本体，从自由文本LLM诊断轨迹中提取的结构化图表示。将该流程应用于50个《新英格兰医学杂志》临床病理研讨会病例、三种提示条件下的五个LLM的750条轨迹，检验诊断轨迹是否对临床相似病例展现出稳定的结构化推理模式（即诊断模式）。我们将其操作化为：临床相似病例之间的图相似度高于临床不相似病例。在15个模型-条件对比中，聚类内与聚类间复合相似度近乎相等，且无任何对比通过多重检验校正；成分层面分析发现任何残余内容信号远低于模式尺度。正确对（0.488）与错误对（0.484）的模型图相似度也几乎相同，表明图结构捕捉了诊断准确率未反映的维度。结构化反思提示使轨迹中显式区分特征分析增加33%，但未提升跨病例一致性。这些结果表明诊断能力存在但缺乏模式尺度的推理一致性，并提示最终答案准确率应辅以过程层面评估。我们发布本体、提取流程、验证协议以及提取的推理图与相似度工件，作为LLM临床推理结构化评估的资源。
tldr: The paper introduces clinical reasoning graphs, a structured method to evaluate LLM diagnostic reasoning from free-text traces, and finds that LLMs show diagnostic competence without consistent reasoning schemas across similar cases, highlighting the need for process-level evaluation beyond accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了临床推理图，一种从自由文本LLM诊断轨迹中提取结构化表示的方法，发现LLM在诊断能力上表现出色，但在相似病例间缺乏一致的推理模式，强调了过程级评估的必要性。

title: DrivenMorph: Bridging Attention Mechanism and Variational Image Registration via Difference Modeling
summary: Medical image registration benefits significantly from deep learning, yet existing approaches often lack physical explainability and fine-grained deformation control. Motivated by Demons algorithms, we propose a novel DrivenMorph framework that bridges attention mechanisms with variational image registration by incorporating difference modeling as a physically inspired inductive bias. The resulting driving force, computed from local differences in the latent feature space, provides explicit semantic guidance throughout the registration process. It directly drives the registration process through a neural Demons layer that simulates force-displacement interactions to generate smooth and anatomically consistent deformation. Unlike previous methods, our approach not only integrates traditional registration principles with popular deep networks, providing an explainable and efficient solution for learning-based medical image registration, but also separates difference modeling from deformation, improving modularity and explainability. Extensive experiments on multiple 3D brain MRI datasets demonstrate superior performance over state of-the-art learning-based and optimization-based methods. Furthermore, visualizations and statistical analyses confirm that the learned driving force aligns closely with actual deformation patterns, supporting its explanatory value.
summary_zh: 医学图像配准显著受益于深度学习，然而现有方法往往缺乏物理可解释性和细粒度形变控制。受Demons算法启发，我们提出了一种新颖的DrivenMorph框架，通过将差异建模作为物理启发的归纳偏置，将注意力机制与变分图像配准相结合。由此产生的驱动力由潜在特征空间中的局部差异计算得出，在整个配准过程中提供显式的语义引导。该驱动力通过模拟力-位移交互的神经Demons层直接驱动配准过程，生成平滑且解剖学上一致的形变。与以往方法不同，我们的方法不仅将传统配准原理与流行的深度网络相融合，为基于学习的医学图像配准提供了可解释且高效的解决方案，还将差异建模与形变分离，增强了模块化与可解释性。在多个三维脑部MRI数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法优于最先进的基于学习与基于优化的方法。此外，可视化分析与统计结果证实，学习到的驱动力与实际形变模式高度一致，进一步支持了其解释价值。
tldr: DrivenMorph proposes a medical image registration framework that bridges attention mechanisms with variational methods by introducing a physically inspired driving force derived from latent feature differences, improving explainability and performance on brain MRI datasets.
tldr_zh: DrivenMorph 提出了一种医学图像配准框架，通过从潜在特征差异中引入物理启发的驱动力，将注意力机制与变分方法结合起来，提高了可解释性并在脑部MRI数据集上表现出优越性能。

title: MAM-AI: An On-Device Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Nurses and Midwives in Zanzibar
summary: Maternal and newborn mortality remain among the highest in sub-Saharan Africa, where midwifery care is often delivered by nurses who lack midwifery training to international standards, and consulting authoritative guidance at the point of care is hard: the guidelines are long and connectivity is intermittent. We present MAM-AI, a medical question-answering assistant for nurse-midwives in Zanzibar that runs entirely on a commodity Android device: a question is embedded (EmbeddingGemma, 300M) and matched against a curated corpus of 87 guideline documents (63,650 passages), then answered with citations by a 4B int4 generator (Gemma 4 E4B), fully offline, with no query leaving the device. We evaluate the exact deployed configuration with a layered methodology -- retriever, generator under oracle context, end-to-end, and latency -- scored by LLM judges validated against physician rubrics. The evaluation relocates the hard problem. On-device retrieval is essentially solved: the 300M embedder ranks third of seven retrievers and rivals cloud systems, so the passages the system needs are usually found.
