tldr: This paper introduces surgical affordance prediction to identify actionable regions for basic surgical actions (aspiration, clipping, retraction) from visual data, and proposes an adaptive multimodal feature fusion framework combining self-supervised vision transformer and generative model encoders with hierarchical prompt learning and a scene-guided attention decoder, achieving state-of-the-art performance on a new dataset and demonstrating downstream autonomy on realistic phantoms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出手术可供性预测（surgical affordance prediction），从视觉数据中识别基本手术动作（抽吸、夹持、牵拉）的可执行区域；设计了自适应多模态特征融合框架，结合自监督视觉Transformer和生成模型编码器，引入分层提示学习和场景引导注意力解码器，在新数据集上达到最优性能，并在真实肺部和前列腺模型上验证了下游自主手术的执行能力。

title: Beyond Random Sampling: Distribution-Aware Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Precise medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, yet relies heavily on expensive expert annotations. Semi-supervised medical image segmentation (SSMIS) offers a cost-effective solution but typically operates under the assumption of independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) data, defaulting to random sampling. While statistically valid at scale, this strategy suffers from severe representation bias in low-data regimes, failing to capture the heterogeneous medical data manifold. To address this, we propose a highly data-efficient framework driven by distribution alignment. First, we introduce an offline Distribution-Aware Sample Selection strategy. By leveraging Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) and our designed Density-K-Center algorithm, we explicitly identify representative structural anchors, establishing a more representative labeled domain. Second, to bridge the remaining distribution gap, we propose the Memory-guided Copy-Paste (MCP) module. Tailored for the inherent class imbalance in medical scans, MCP leverages a semantic memory mechanism to retrieve historically consistent priors for cross-domain alignment, encouraging semantic consistency. Coupled with an easy-to-hard progressive schedule, this framework effectively mitigates early-stage pseudo-label noise. Extensive experiments on six diverse 2D and 3D datasets demonstrate strong segmentation performance, particularly in extremely low-labeled scenarios (\eg, 1/16 ratio).
summary_zh: 精确的医学图像分割对于临床诊断和治疗规划至关重要，但严重依赖于昂贵的专家标注。半监督医学图像分割（SSMIS）提供了一种经济有效的解决方案，但其通常基于独立同分布（i.i.d.）数据假设，默认采用随机采样策略。尽管该策略在大规模数据下具有统计合理性，但在低数据场景中会出现严重的表征偏差，难以捕捉医学数据流形的异质性。针对此问题，我们提出了一种由分布对齐驱动的高数据效率框架。首先，我们引入了一种离线式分布感知样本选择策略。通过利用视觉基础模型（VFMs）和我们设计的密度-K-中心算法，我们明确识别具有代表性的结构锚点，从而建立更具代表性的标注域。其次，为弥合剩余的分布差距，我们提出了记忆引导的复制粘贴（MCP）模块。针对医学影像中固有的类别不平衡问题，MCP利用语义记忆机制检索历史一致性先验进行跨域对齐，促进语义一致性。结合从易到难的渐进式训练策略，该框架有效缓解了早期伪标签噪声问题。在六个不同的2D和3D数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架在极低标注率场景（例如1/16比例）下仍表现出强大的分割性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a distribution-aware semi-supervised medical image segmentation framework that uses a Density-K-Center algorithm with Vision Foundation Models for representative sample selection and a Memory-guided Copy-Paste module to handle class imbalance, achieving strong performance in extremely low-label scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布感知的半监督医学图像分割框架，利用视觉基础模型和密度K中心算法进行代表性样本选择，并通过记忆引导的复制粘贴模块处理类别不平衡，在极低标注场景下取得了优异性能。

title: Topology-Driven Transferability Estimation for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models
summary: The growing number of medical vision foundation models highlights the need for effective model selection. However, mainstream selection methods rely on exhaustive fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive. Most of the existing Transferability Estimation (TE) metrics are primarily designed for image-level classification. They fail to preserve spatial relationships and fine-grained boundary details, which are crucial for the segmentation task. Additionally, while image-level tasks typically process a single feature vector per input, dense prediction tasks in 3D medical imaging require voxel-wise evaluation against dense annotations. To bridge these gaps, we propose a \textit{non-parametric, topology-driven} framework that estimates transferability directly from the alignment between the sparse 1-skeleton graph of dense features and semantic labels via Minimum Spanning Trees (MST). We decouple the alignment into two complementary geometric scales: Local Boundary-Aware Topological Consistency (LBTC) to assess boundary separability, where we prove that the MST leakage rate serves as a finite-sample lower bound on the Bayes error; and Global Representation Topology Divergence (GRTD) to evaluate the overall anatomical layout. Crucially, we formally justify a counterintuitive mechanism: Although without fine-tuning, the randomly initialized segmentation decoder acts as a topology-preserving spatial projector, reducing the variance of pairwise distance estimates and stabilizing global alignment evaluation. Fused via a task-adaptive gating mechanism, these dual metrics adapt to diverse clinical complexities. Evaluated on a large-scale benchmark of 114,000 3D medical volumes across diverse anatomical tasks, our topological framework achieves state-of-the-art transferability estimation with an average weighted Kendall (outperforming by 0.36) while accelerating evaluation by 56 times.
summary_zh: 随着医学视觉基础模型数量的不断增长，对有效模型选择的需求日益凸显。然而，主流的选择方法依赖穷举式微调，计算成本高昂。现有的可迁移性估计（TE）指标主要针对图像级分类设计，无法保留对分割任务至关重要的空间关系和细粒度边界细节。此外，图像级任务通常对每个输入处理单个特征向量，而3D医学成像中的密集预测任务则需要针对密集标注进行体素级评估。为弥补这些不足，我们提出了一种**非参数化、拓扑驱动的**框架，通过最小生成树（MST）直接基于密集特征的稀疏1-骨架图与语义标签之间的对齐来估计可迁移性。我们将对齐解耦为两个互补的几何尺度：局部边界感知拓扑一致性（LBTC）用于评估边界可分离性——我们证明了MST泄露率是贝叶斯误差的有限样本下界；全局表示拓扑散度（GRTD）用于评估整体解剖布局。关键的是，我们正式论证了一个反直觉的机制：尽管未经微调，随机初始化的分割解码器充当了拓扑保持的空间投影器，可降低成对距离估计的方差并稳定全局对齐评估。通过任务自适应门控机制融合后，这些双指标能够适应多样化的临床复杂性。在涵盖114,000个3D医学体积的大规模基准（涉及多种解剖任务）上的评估表明，我们的拓扑框架实现了最先进的可迁移性估计，平均加权肯德尔系数（超越0.36），同时将评估速度提升了56倍。
tldr: This paper proposes a non-parametric, topology-driven framework for transferability estimation of 3D medical vision foundation models, using minimum spanning trees to assess boundary separability and anatomical layout, achieving state-of-the-art performance with 56x speedup.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种非参数、拓扑驱动的迁移性评估框架，用于3D医学视觉基础模型，通过最小生成树评估边界可分性和解剖布局，在56倍加速下实现了最先进的迁移性估计性能。

title: IRIS: An Intelligent Vision-Language System for Ocular Surface Diseases via Topic Tree and Scene-Driven VQA Generation
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable generic capabilities, their clinical reasoning in specialized domains like ocular surface diseases (OSDs) is severely hindered by a paucity of high-fidelity, multimodal instruction-tuning data. To dismantle this data bottleneck, we introduce IRIS, an Intelligent Recognition and Interaction System tailored for fine-grained OSD understanding via external eye photography. First, we curate IRIS-120K, the largest and most comprehensive OSD visual question-answering (VQA) dataset to date. Crucially, to overcome the semantic shallowness of conventional image-caption pairs, we propose a synergistic data generation paradigm to explicitly inject clinical priors. Our data engine operates via a dual-branch framework: 1) a Topic Finding Tree (TFT) that hierarchically anchors visual features to precise anatomical and pathological concepts, enforcing rigorous medical deduction logic; and 2) a Scene-driven strategy that synthesizes role-adaptive clinical dialogues to ensure pragmatic generalization. By explicitly aligning a compact 4B-parameter VLM on this structurally enriched corpus, IRIS achieves state-of-the-art performance, comprehensively outperforming both generalist and specialized medical VLMs with up to 34B parameters. Our findings underscore that structured knowledge injection profoundly prevails over sheer parameter scaling, unlocking the potential for resource-efficient, expert-level AI deployment on mobile edge devices for scalable OSD screening. Code, datasets, and model weights will be publicly released by this repo.
summary_zh: 尽管大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）展现出卓越的通用能力，但在眼表疾病（OSD）等专业领域，其临床推理能力因缺乏高保真、多模态指令微调数据而严重受限。为突破这一数据瓶颈，我们提出IRIS——一种通过外眼摄影实现细粒度OSD理解的智能识别与交互系统。首先，我们构建了IRIS-120K，这是迄今为止规模最大、最全面的OSD视觉问答（VQA）数据集。关键在于，为克服传统图像-文本对的语义浅层性问题，我们提出了一种协同数据生成范式，以显式注入临床先验知识。我们的数据引擎通过双分支框架运行：1）主题发现树（TFT），通过层次化地将视觉特征锚定到精确的解剖和病理概念上，强制遵循严谨的医学推理逻辑；2）场景驱动策略，合成角色自适应临床对话以确保实用泛化能力。通过将紧凑的4B参数VLM与此结构丰富的语料库显式对齐，IRIS实现了最先进的性能，全面超越了包括高达34B参数的通用型和专用型医学VLM。我们的研究结果表明，结构化知识注入远胜于单纯扩大参数规模，为实现资源高效、专家级AI在移动边缘设备上的部署以及可扩展的OSD筛查解锁了潜力。代码、数据集和模型权重将通过此仓库公开发布。
tldr: IRIS introduces a structured knowledge injection approach using a Topic Finding Tree and scene-driven VQA generation to create a large, high-fidelity instruction-tuning dataset for ocular surface disease recognition, achieving state-of-the-art performance with a compact 4B-parameter VLM.
tldr_zh: IRIS 通过主题发现树和场景驱动的VQA生成方法，引入了结构化知识注入，创建了最大的高质量指令微调数据集用于眼表疾病识别，以紧凑的4B参数VLM实现了最先进的性能。

title: HeartVolMesh: Cardiac Volumetric Mesh Reconstruction via Covariance-Guided Graph Deformation
summary: Accurate patient-specific tetrahedral cardiac meshes are essential for in-silico trials, yet common segmentation-then-modelling pipelines can blur thin-wall anatomy and offer limited cross-case correspondence. We propose HeartVolMesh, which lifts each template vertex to an anisotropic Gaussian kernel and uses a 3D CNN-GNN to predict per-vertex displacements and Cholesky-parameterized covariances from volumetric images. Training is guided by a covariance-aware negative log-likelihood loss with lightweight mesh regularization. For volumetric meshing, we warp a fixed tetrahedral template to the reconstructed surface via staged alignment, non-rigid registration, and deformation propagation, preserving connectivity and correspondence by construction, with resolution controlled by template density. Experiments show consistent gains over deformation-based baselines in surface mesh accuracy and volumetric mesh fidelity.
summary_zh: 摘要：精准的患者特异性四面体心脏网格对于计算机模拟试验至关重要，然而常见的先分割后建模流程可能会模糊薄壁解剖结构，且跨案例的对应关系有限。我们提出HeartVolMesh方法，将每个模板顶点提升为各向异性高斯核，并利用三维卷积-图神经网络从体图像中预测逐顶点位移及Cholesky参数化的协方差。训练过程由协方差感知的负对数似然损失引导，并辅以轻量网格正则化。在体网格生成方面，我们通过分阶段对齐、非刚性配准和变形传播，将固定四面体模板扭曲至重建表面，从而在结构上保持连通性和对应关系，分辨率由模板密度控制。实验表明，与基于变形的基线方法相比，本方法在表面网格精度和体网格保真度方面均取得一致提升。
tldr: A method for reconstructing patient-specific tetrahedral cardiac meshes from volumetric images using a template deformation framework with anisotropic Gaussian kernels and a 3D CNN-GNN, achieving consistent accuracy gains over baselines.
tldr_zh: 一种从体积图像重建患者特异性四面体心脏网格的方法，采用各向异性高斯核和3D CNN-GNN的模板变形框架，在基准方法上取得一致的精度提升。

title: Geometry-Aware Visual Odometry for Bronchoscopic Navigation via High-Gain Observer Fusion
summary: Navigational bronchoscopy is critical for pulmonary interventions, yet current platforms depend heavily on pre-operative CT or external sensors, limiting their use in critical care and resource-constrained settings. Vision-only navigation offers a scalable alternative, but conventional visual odometry (VO) struggles with texture-poor airway images, specularities, and the vanishing-point singularities of tubular anatomy, leading to frequent tracking failures and drift. We present a geometry-aware VO framework that explicitly leverages vanishing-point cues from airway lumens. Detected lumens are back-projected to 3D rays, whose weighted fusion yields a stable forward heading even when parallax cues are absent. This heading, together with looming-based velocity estimates, is fused with noisy VO outputs using a bespoke high-gain observer that enforces airway-following priors and rejects drift. We validate the method on ex-vivo mechanically ventilated human lungs with electromagnetic tracking ground truth. Compared to state-of-the-art pipelines (ORB-SLAM2, LoFTR-VO, DPVO), our approach reduces absolute trajectory error by more than 50% and achieves the lowest relative pose error across all test sequences.
summary_zh: 导航支气管镜检对肺部介入治疗至关重要，但现有平台严重依赖术前CT或外部传感器，限制了其在重症监护和资源受限环境中的应用。纯视觉导航提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，然而传统视觉里程计（VO）难以处理纹理贫乏的气道图像、镜面反射以及管状解剖结构中的灭点奇异性，导致频繁的跟踪失败与漂移。本文提出一种几何感知的视觉里程计框架，显式利用气道管腔的灭点线索。检测到的管腔被反投影至三维射线，其加权融合可生成稳定的前进朝向，即使在缺乏视差线索时亦能实现。该朝向与基于临近效应的速度估计相结合，通过定制的高增益观测器融合带有噪声的视觉里程计输出，该观测器强化了气道跟随先验并抑制漂移。我们在离体机械通气人类肺脏上进行了验证，以电磁跟踪结果为真值。与最先进算法（ORB-SLAM2、LoFTR-VO、DPVO）相比，本方法将绝对轨迹误差降低超过50%，并在所有测试序列中实现了最低的相对位姿误差。
tldr: Proposes a geometry-aware visual odometry framework for bronchoscopic navigation that uses vanishing-point cues from airway lumens and a high-gain observer to fuse heading/velocity estimates with noisy VO, reducing trajectory error by over 50% compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于几何感知的支气管镜导航视觉里程计框架，利用气道管腔消失点线索和高增益观测器将航向/速度估计与噪声VO融合，相比最先进方法将轨迹误差降低超过50%。

title: Toward Trustworthy Large Language Model Agents in Healthcare
summary: Healthcare appointment scheduling remains a persistent operational bottleneck, driven by manual coordination, fragmented legacy systems, and high administrative overhead. These inefficiencies constrain provider availability and degrade patient access to care. This paper presents CareConnect, a safety-first conversational agent for healthcare logistics automation that leverages large language model (LLM) function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and layered deterministic safety guardrails. The system orchestrates eight domain-specific tools to support appointment booking, modification, cancellation, and facility information retrieval, while enforcing strict scope constraints that prohibit medical advice or diagnosis. Safety-critical situations are handled through deterministic short-circuit mechanisms for emergency detection and medical intent refusal. We evaluate CareConnect on a comprehensive benchmark of 680 task-oriented scenarios spanning end-to-end workflows, multi-turn interactions, and edge cases. Experimental results demonstrate a 91.8% task completion rate with a median per-request latency of 2.2 seconds, 96.0% safety compliance on the dedicated safety-critical evaluation subset, and an average operational cost of $0.0324 per appointment, yielding a significant cost reduction compared to manual human scheduling. These findings show that carefully scoped and rigorously safeguarded LLM-based agents can reliably automate complex healthcare operational workflows while maintaining safety guarantees and achieving substantial cost efficiency. The source code and system implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/Hadi-Hsn/CareConnect.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医疗预约调度仍是持续存在的运营瓶颈，其根源在于人工协调、碎片化的遗留系统以及高昂的管理开销。这些低效问题制约了医疗服务提供者的可用性，并降低了患者获得医疗服务的便利性。本文提出CareConnect——一个以安全为先的医疗物流自动化对话代理，其核心技术包括大语言模型函数调用、检索增强生成以及分层确定性安全护栏。该系统整合了八个领域专用工具，支持预约挂号、修改、取消及设施信息检索，同时通过严格的范围约束禁止提供医疗建议或诊断。对于安全关键场景，系统通过确定性短路机制处理紧急情况检测和医疗意图拒绝。我们在涵盖端到端流程、多轮交互及边缘案例的680个面向任务场景的综合基准上对CareConnect进行了评估。实验结果表明，任务完成率达91.8%，每次请求中位延迟为2.2秒，在专门的安全关键评估子集上安全合规率为96.0%，每次预约的平均运营成本为0.0324美元，相比人工调度实现了显著的成本降低。这些发现表明，经过精心划定范围并严格保障安全的基于大语言模型的代理，能够在维持安全保证和实现显著成本效益的同时，可靠地自动化复杂的医疗运营工作流程。源代码及系统实现已在https://github.com/Hadi-Hsn/CareConnect 公开提供。
tldr: CareConnect is a safety-first LLM-based agent for healthcare appointment scheduling that uses function calling, RAG, and deterministic guardrails to achieve 91.8% task completion, 96.0% safety compliance, and low cost.
tldr_zh: CareConnect 是一个以安全为先的基于大语言模型的医疗预约调度代理，利用函数调用、RAG 和确定性安全护栏实现了 91.8% 的任务完成率、96.0% 的安全合规性和较低的成本。

title: RUFNet: Query-Guided Support Mask Refinement and Uncertainty Fusion based on Hybrid Mamba for Few-Shot Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Few-shot brain tumor segmentation remains challenging due to noisy support masks, inter-patient variations between support and query images, and the lack of pixel-wise confidence estimation. This study proposes RUFNet, a Hybrid Mamba-based few-shot framework that combines support mask refinement with uncertainty-aware posterior fusion. To preserve support-query dependencies with manageable cost, RUFNet adopts a Hybrid Mamba interaction backbone with linear complexity. To reduce support-mask noise, an Attention-Guided Mask Refinement module (AGMR) uses query features to recalibrate support masks and improve prototype consistency. To handle ambiguous predictions, an Uncertainty-Aware Posterior Fusion module (UAPF) estimates pixel-wise variance and adaptively balances few-shot predictions with query-aligned priors. On the Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge (BraTS) 2020 dataset, RUFNet achieves Dice coefficients of 84.3% and 86.1% in the 1-way 1-shot and 1-way 5-shot settings, respectively, outperforming the compared state-of-the-art methods. These results suggest that Hybrid Mamba interaction, mask refinement and uncertainty modelling can improve the robustness of few-shot medical image segmentation. The official implementation code is available at https://github.com/hdy6438/RUFNet.
summary_zh: 摘要：由于支持掩码存在噪声、支持图像与查询图像之间存在患者间差异，以及缺乏像素级置信度估计，少样本脑肿瘤分割仍面临挑战。本研究提出RUFNet——一种基于混合Mamba的少样本框架，将支持掩码精化与不确定性感知后验融合相结合。为在可控成本下保持支持-查询依赖关系，RUFNet采用具有线性复杂度的混合Mamba交互主干。为减少支持掩码噪声，注意力引导掩码精化模块（AGMR）利用查询特征重新校准支持掩码并提升原型一致性。为处理模糊预测，不确定性感知后验融合模块（UAPF）估计像素级方差，并自适应平衡少样本预测与查询对齐先验。在Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge (BraTS) 2020数据集上，RUFNet在1-way 1-shot和1-way 5-shot设置下分别实现了84.3%和86.1%的Dice系数，优于当前最先进方法。这些结果表明，混合Mamba交互、掩码精化与不确定性建模可提升少样本医学图像分割的鲁棒性。官方实现代码见https://github.com/hdy6438/RUFNet。
tldr: RUFNet is a few-shot brain tumor segmentation framework using Hybrid Mamba for interaction, query-guided support mask refinement (AGMR), and uncertainty-aware posterior fusion (UAPF), achieving state-of-the-art results on BraTS 2020.
tldr_zh: RUFNet是一个基于混合Mamba的少样本脑肿瘤分割框架，结合查询引导的支持掩码细化（AGMR）和不确定性感知后验融合（UAPF），在BraTS 2020数据集上取得了最优结果。

title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in high-stakes clinical settings remains limited by structural hallucinations, weak deterministic reasoning over tabular patient data, and omissions in vector retrieval. This paper presents the architecture and validation of Medi-Gemma, a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for wound pathology triage and workflow automation. The platform introduces a decoupled framework that separates clinical perception from data orchestration while preserving traceable reasoning. Medi-Gemma uses a multi-stage pipeline coordinated by a centralized ClinicalOrchestrator. Data requests are handled without generative inference by a DataManager that cleans unstructured Electronic Medical Record (EMR) files through type coercion. Natural language queries are processed by a hierarchical IntentRouter, which routes requests to deterministic analytics paths executed by a PandasQueryEngine or to patient-specific reasoning managed by a ClinicalRAGEngine using a CPU-optimized vector store. A key contribution is the Ground Truth Injection Module, which intercepts patient-specific queries, extracts numeric identification tokens, queries the structured dataframe via Pandas, retrieves the latest validated clinical state, and embeds this snapshot as an overriding context block in the LLM prompt before generation. Safety compliance is enforced by a deterministic ProtocolManager that maps clinical terminology to fixed evidence-based risk pathways, while a SafetyVerifier phrase filter prevents output rule violations. Validation shows that this architecture eliminates semantic context drift, prevents database compilation crashes, and improves factual adherence to backend clinical repositories. These results support Medi-Gemma as a safer pattern for LLM-based clinical decision support where structured data fidelity, retrieval grounding, and deterministic safeguards are essential.
summary_zh: 在高风险临床环境中部署大型语言模型仍受限于结构性幻觉、对表格化患者数据的弱确定性推理以及向量检索中的遗漏。本文介绍了Medi-Gemma的架构与验证，这是一种用于创面病理分诊和工作流程自动化的临床决策支持系统。该平台引入了一种解耦框架，将临床感知与数据编排分离，同时保留可追溯的推理过程。Medi-Gemma采用由集中式ClinicalOrchestrator协调的多阶段流水线。数据请求由DataManager在不进行生成式推理的情况下处理，该管理器通过类型强制转换清理非结构化电子病历文件。自然语言查询由分层IntentRouter处理，该路由器将请求路由至由PandasQueryEngine执行的确定性分析路径，或路由至由ClinicalRAGEngine管理的患者特定推理（后者使用经CPU优化的向量存储）。一项关键贡献是真实数据注入模块，该模块拦截患者特定查询，提取数字标识令牌，通过Pandas查询结构化数据框，检索最新已验证的临床状态，并将该快照作为覆盖性上下文块嵌入到LLM提示词中，然后再进行生成。安全性合规由确定性ProtocolManager强制执行，该管理器将临床术语映射至固定的循证风险路径，同时SafetyVerifier短语过滤器防止输出违反规则。验证表明，该架构消除了语义上下文漂移，防止了数据库编译崩溃，并提高了对后端临床知识库的事实遵循程度。这些结果支持Medi-Gemma作为一种基于LLM的临床决策支持的安全模式，其中结构化数据保真度、检索基础锚定和确定性安全保障至关重要。
tldr: Medi-Gemma is a clinical decision support system for wound pathology triage that combines deterministic EMR analytics with retrieval-augmented generation, using a decoupled architecture with Ground Truth Injection and safety safeguards to eliminate hallucinations and improve factual adherence.
tldr_zh: Medi-Gemma 是一个用于伤口病理分诊的临床决策支持系统，结合了确定性电子病历分析与检索增强生成，采用解耦架构和真值注入模块以及安全保障措施，以消除幻觉并提高事实准确性。

title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
summary: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that prompt LLMs to produce discrete scores for candidate solutions, LLM-as-a-Verifier computes the expectation over the distribution of scoring token logits to generate continuous scores. This probabilistic formulation enables verification to scale along multiple dimensions: (1) score granularity, (2) repeated evaluation, and (3) criteria decomposition. In particular, we show that scaling the scoring granularity leads to better separation between positive and negative solutions, resulting in more calibrated comparisons. Moreover, scaling repeated evaluation and criteria decomposition consistently lead to additional gains in verification accuracy through variance and complexity reduction. We further introduce a cost-efficient ranking algorithm for selecting the best solution among candidates using the verifier's continuous scores. LLM-as-a-Verifier achieves state-of-the-art performance on Terminal-Bench V2 (86.5%), SWE-Bench Verified (78.2%), RoboRewardBench (87.4%), and MedAgentBench (73.3%). Beyond verification, the fine-grained signals from LLM-as-a-Verifier can also serve as a proxy for estimating task progress. We build an extension for Claude Code, enabling developers to monitor and improve their own agentic systems. Finally, we show that LLM-as-a-Verifier can provide dense feedback for RL, improving the sample efficiency of SAC and GRPO on robotics and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 扩展预训练、后训练及测试时计算已成为提升大语言模型能力的核心范式。本研究将验证能力——即判断解决方案正确性的能力——识别为一个新的扩展维度。为解锁并展示其有效性，我们提出了通用验证框架LLM-as-a-Verifier，该框架无需额外训练即可为智能体任务提供细粒度反馈。与标准语言模型评判方法（即提示大语言模型对候选方案生成离散评分）不同，LLM-as-a-Verifier通过计算评分词元对数概率分布的期望值来生成连续评分。这种概率化表述使验证能够在多个维度上扩展：（1）评分粒度、（2）重复评估、（3）标准分解。特别地，我们证明扩展评分粒度能更好地区分正负解决方案，从而实现更校准的比较。此外，扩展重复评估和标准分解通过降低方差与复杂度，持续提升验证准确率。我们进一步提出一种成本高效的排序算法，利用验证器的连续评分从候选方案中选出最优解。LLM-as-a-Verifier在Terminal-Bench V2（86.5%）、SWE-Bench Verified（78.2%）、RoboRewardBench（87.4%）和MedAgentBench（73.3%）上取得了最先进性能。除验证外，LLM-as-a-Verifier生成的细粒度信号还可作为估计任务进度的代理。我们为Claude Code构建了扩展功能，使开发者能够监控并改进其智能体系统。最后，我们证明LLM-as-a-Verifier可为强化学习提供密集反馈，提升SAC和GRPO在机器人学及数学推理基准上的样本效率。
tldr: This paper proposes LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that computes continuous scores from LLM scoring token logits to enable scalable fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks, achieving state-of-the-art on several benchmarks including medical and robotic agent tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LLM-as-a-Verifier，一种通用验证框架，通过计算LLM评分token logits的期望来生成连续分数，为智能体任务提供可扩展的细粒度反馈，在包括医疗和机器人智能体任务在内的多个基准上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Displacement Preserving Relational Distillation for Robust Medical Segmentation
summary: Accurate 3D medical segmentation is limited by anatomical variability and high computational costs. While knowledge distillation (KD) offers a route for model compression, conventional methods often fail to preserve complex structures and are overwhelmed by background noise. We propose Displacement-Preserving Relational Distillation (DPRD), which distills latent anatomical trajectories via vector based alignment to preserve the orientation and relative scale of the teacher's manifold, and prevents signal dilution by anchoring distillation in task-relevant structures. Integrated into nnU-Net, DPRD outperforms established baselines on ISLES 2022 and AMOS 2022 benchmarks. Notably, on the AMOS dataset, DPRD achieves a Dice score of 85.46%, edging out the high-capacity MedNeXt teacher while significantly reducing boundary errors. Despite utilizing only ~5% of the teacher's parameters and ~3% of its FLOPs, our approach maintains high structural consistency. This provides a robust, efficient solution for deploying high performance segmenters in resource-constrained clinical environments. Code: https://github.com/ClinicaAlpha/DPRD-3D-MedSeg
summary_zh: 准确的3D医学分割受限于解剖变异性与高计算成本。尽管知识蒸馏（KD）为模型压缩提供了途径，但传统方法往往难以保留复杂结构，且容易受到背景噪声的干扰。我们提出位移保持关系蒸馏（DPRD），该方法通过基于向量的对齐蒸馏潜在解剖轨迹，以保留教师流形的方向与相对尺度，并通过将蒸馏锚定于任务相关结构来防止信号稀释。集成至nnU-Net后，DPRD在ISLES 2022和AMOS 2022基准测试中优于已有基线。值得注意的是，在AMOS数据集上，DPRD实现了85.46%的Dice分数，略超高容量的MedNeXt教师模型，同时显著降低了边界误差。尽管仅使用了教师模型约5%的参数和约3%的FLOPs，我们的方法仍保持了较高的结构一致性。这为在资源受限的临床环境中部署高性能分割模型提供了一种稳健、高效的解决方案。代码：https://github.com/ClinicaAlpha/DPRD-3D-MedSeg
tldr: Proposes Displacement-Preserving Relational Distillation (DPRD) for 3D medical segmentation, which preserves anatomical structure and reduces background noise via vector-based alignment, achieving high performance with ~5% teacher parameters and ~3% FLOPs on ISLES 2022 and AMOS 2022.
tldr_zh: 提出了位移保持关系蒸馏（DPRD）用于3D医学分割，通过基于向量的对齐保留解剖结构并减少背景噪声，在ISLES 2022和AMOS 2022上以教师模型约5%的参数和约3%的FLOPs实现了高性能。

title: MAC-XA: Multi-view Anatomy-Correspondence Fusion for Coronary Stenosis Reporting from X-ray Angiography
summary: Multi-view reasoning in coronary X-ray angiography is inherently a cross-projection geometric problem, yet automated report generation in this setting remains largely unexplored. The 3D vascular topology leads to projection-dependent branch overlap and foreshortening, rendering single-view modeling fundamentally incomplete and unstable for lesion localization and stenosis grading. Although multi-view fusion appears promising, learning anatomically consistent fusion from real angiograms is impeded by a critical limitation: cross-view alignment is unobservable and cannot be explicitly supervised. Consequently, conventional fusion relies on implicit correlations rather than verified anatomical correspondence. We address this by reformulating multi-view stenosis reporting as an alignment-constrained aggregation problem. A controllable synthetic angiography generation strategy is introduced to expose geometry-derived patch-level correspondence supervision unavailable in real data. An anatomy-correspondence module learns cross-view correspondence matrices that explicitly align auxiliary features within the main-view coordinate space prior to fusion, thereby constraining evidence aggregation to anatomically consistent regions. Experiments on synthetic data and zero-shot transfer to real angiograms show that this alignment-constrained design improves correspondence consistency and structured stenosis reporting compared to single-view modeling and conventional multi-view fusion methods. The code will be publicly available upon publication.
summary_zh: 冠状动脉X射线血管造影中的多视图推理本质上是一个跨投影几何问题，但该场景下的自动报告生成仍鲜有探索。三维血管拓扑结构导致投影依赖的血管分支重叠与透视缩短，使得单视图建模在病灶定位和狭窄分级方面存在根本性的不完整和不稳定性。尽管多视图融合看似前景广阔，但从真实血管造影中学习解剖一致性融合却面临一个关键限制：跨视图对齐不可观测且无法显式监督。因此，传统融合方法依赖隐式相关性而非经过验证的解剖对应关系。我们通过将多视图狭窄报告重构为对齐约束的聚合问题来解决这一挑战。引入了一种可控的合成血管造影生成策略，以暴露真实数据中无法获取的、基于几何的补丁级对应监督。设计了解剖对应模块，在融合之前学习跨视图对应矩阵，将辅助特征显式对齐到主视图坐标空间，从而将证据聚合约束到解剖一致的区域。在合成数据上的实验以及向真实血管造影的零样本迁移表明，与单视图建模和传统多视图融合方法相比，这种对齐约束设计改进了对应一致性和结构化狭窄报告。代码将在发表后公开。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-view fusion method for automated coronary stenosis reporting from X-ray angiography, using synthetic data to learn explicit cross-view anatomical correspondence and alignment-constrained aggregation, improving lesion localization and stenosis grading.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于X射线冠状动脉造影自动狭窄报告的多视图融合方法，利用合成数据学习显式的跨视图解剖对应关系和对齐约束聚合，从而改善病变定位和狭窄分级。

title: SafeImpute: Reliable Clinical Data Imputation via Conformal Selection
summary: Clinical care often relies on key laboratory indicators, yet real-world patient visits are sparse and tests are ordered irregularly, leading to pervasive missingness. While many imputation methods improve average accuracy, they provide limited guidance on which imputed values are reliable enough for high-stakes downstream use. In this work, we study reliable clinical imputation, aiming to produce accurate imputations while selectively releasing the reliable results, with statistical control over clinically unacceptable errors. To achieve this goal, we propose SafeImpute, a reliable imputation framework for irregular and sparse clinical longitudinal records. SafeImpute constructs an event graph that captures both intra-patient temporal trajectories and inter-patient clinical similarity, and learns imputations with a two-relation GNN and adaptive fusion, regularized by an auxiliary masked reconstruction objective. For reliability guarantees, SafeImpute converts a proxy risk score into conformal p-values and applies the Benjamini--Hochberg procedure to control the false discovery rate (FDR) of unacceptable errors among released imputations at a user-specified tolerance. Experiments on our Mayo Clinic data, the public MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets show that SafeImpute achieves strong imputation accuracy while providing reliable error control, outperforming diverse baselines in both standard imputation evaluation and FDR-controlled selective-release evaluation.
summary_zh: 临床诊疗通常依赖关键实验室指标，但真实场景中患者就诊稀疏、检测医嘱不规律，导致数据普遍缺失。现有插补方法虽能提升平均准确率，却难以指导哪些插补值足够可靠以用于高风险下游任务。本研究聚焦可靠临床插补，目标是在精准完成插补的同时，对可信结果进行选择性释放，并实现对临床不可接受错误的统计控制。为此，我们提出SafeImpute框架——一种面向不规律且稀疏的临床纵向记录的可靠插补方案。该框架构建事件图以捕捉患者内部时间轨迹与患者间临床相似性，通过双关系图神经网络与自适应融合学习插补值，并辅以掩码重建损失进行正则化约束。在可靠性保障方面，SafeImpute将代理风险分数转化为共形p值，并应用Benjamini-Hochberg程序控制已释放插补值中不可接受错误的错误发现率（FDR），使其满足用户指定的容差水平。在梅奥诊所数据、公共MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验表明，SafeImpute在保持强插补精度的同时实现了可靠的错误控制，在标准插补评估与FDR控制的选择性释放评估中均优于多种基线方法。
tldr: SafeImpute is a reliable clinical data imputation framework that uses a two-relation GNN with adaptive fusion and conformal prediction to control the false discovery rate of clinically unacceptable errors, selectively releasing only trustworthy imputed values for high-stakes use.
tldr_zh: SafeImpute是一个可靠的临床数据插值框架，利用双关系图神经网络与自适应融合，结合共形预测来控制临床上不可接受错误的假发现率，仅选择性释放可信的插值结果用于高风险场景。

title: OBBSeg: Irregular Lesion Segmentation under Oriented Bounding Box Annotations
summary: Pixel-level annotation remains a major bottleneck in medical image segmentation, making weak supervision an attractive yet under-constrained alternative. We propose OBBSeg, an intermediate supervision paradigm guided by Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBBs) that bridges the gap between full and weak supervision. By jointly encoding spatial extent and orientation, OBBs provide compact geometric supervision that better aligns with elongated or anisotropic lesions, reducing the ambiguity of coarse box annotations. To mitigate the inherent rectangular bias of OBBs, we introduce a Mask-to-OBB loss, a differentiable formulation that enforces geometric consistency between predicted masks and OBB regions. Furthermore, we incorporate prompt-driven semantic guidance through two complementary modules-PAFE and DBFE-which enhance foreground representation and suppress background interference. Extensive experiments on 13 datasets across 5 imaging modalities show that OBBSeg not only outperforms existing weakly supervised methods but also achieves performance comparable to fully supervised approaches, demonstrating its potential for efficient and scalable medical image segmentation. The code is available at https://github.com/StarLxc3/OBBSeg.
summary_zh: 像素级标注仍是医学图像分割中的主要瓶颈，这使得弱监督成为一种有吸引力但约束不足的替代方案。我们提出OBBSeg，一种由有向边界框（OBBs）引导的中间监督范式，填补了全监督与弱监督之间的空白。通过联合编码空间范围与方向，OBBs提供了紧凑的几何监督，能更好地适配细长或不规则病变，从而降低了粗糙边界框标注的模糊性。为缓解OBBs固有的矩形偏差，我们引入了掩码到有向边界框损失（Mask-to-OBB loss），这是一种可微的公式，强制预测掩码与OBB区域之间的几何一致性。此外，我们通过两个互补模块——PAFE和DBFE——引入提示驱动的语义引导，增强了前景表示并抑制了背景干扰。在涵盖5种成像模态的13个数据集上的大量实验表明，OBBSeg不仅优于现有弱监督方法，而且达到了与全监督方法相当的性能，展现了其在高效可扩展的医学图像分割中的潜力。代码已开源：https://github.com/StarLxc3/OBBSeg。
tldr: OBBSeg introduces a weakly-supervised medical image segmentation method using oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) as an intermediate supervision, achieving performance comparable to fully-supervised methods through a Mask-to-OBB loss and prompt-driven feature enhancement.
tldr_zh: OBBSeg提出了一种利用定向边界框（OBB）作为中间监督的弱监督医学图像分割方法，通过掩模到OBB损失和提示驱动的特征增强，实现了与全监督方法相当的性能。

title: X-FEMR: A Token-level Explainable Approach for Electronic Health Records Foundation Models using Transformer-based Models
summary: Foundation Models for Electronic Health Records (FEMRs) are pretrained on large-scale structured patient data, enabling them to convert longitudinal patient trajectories into generalizable representations for diverse clinical prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, FEMRs remain black-box models, raising concerns about bias, interpretability, and clinical trust. To address this, we propose the first token-level explainability approach for FEMRs. We train a Transformer-based surrogate model on input-output pairs from the FEMR across two prediction tasks, approximating its behavior while preserving temporal dynamics. We identify the most influential tokens, providing insights into how FEMRs leverage different aspects of patient history for predictions. To evaluate clinical relevance, we introduce a novel clinical alignment metric that quantifies the correspondence between the surrogate model's key tokens and clinically validated features. Our results demonstrate that the surrogate closely approximates FEMR predictions and that token-level explanations align well with clinical knowledge, offering a practical framework for interpretable and trustworthy clinical AI.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
电子健康记录基础模型（FEMRs）在大规模结构化患者数据上进行预训练，能够将纵向患者轨迹转化为可用于多种临床预测任务的通用表示。尽管这些模型有效，但它们仍是黑箱模型，引发了关于偏见、可解释性和临床信任的担忧。为解决这一问题，我们提出了首个针对FEMR的令牌级可解释性方法。我们在两个预测任务上，基于FEMR的输入-输出对训练了一个基于Transformer的替代模型，在保留时间动态特性的同时近似其行为。我们识别出最具影响力的令牌，从而揭示FEMR如何利用患者历史的不同方面进行预测。为评估临床相关性，我们引入了一种新的临床对齐度量，该度量量化了替代模型关键令牌与临床验证特征之间的对应关系。结果表明，该替代模型能很好地逼近FEMR的预测，且令牌级解释与临床知识高度一致，为可解释且可信赖的临床AI提供了实用框架。
tldr: This paper proposes X-FEMR, the first token-level explainability method for Electronic Health Records foundation models, using a Transformer-based surrogate to identify influential tokens and introducing a clinical alignment metric to evaluate relevance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了X-FEMR，首个针对电子健康记录基础模型的词元级可解释性方法，通过基于Transformer的代理模型识别重要词元，并引入临床对齐指标评估相关性。

title: Cross-Contextual Vision-Language Adaptation with LoRA for Personalized Severe Adverse Event Detection in Clinical Wound Monitoring
summary: Wound monitoring is a critical yet underserved clinical challenge, where timely identification of severe adverse events (SAEs) such as infection, tissue deterioration, and delayed healing can significantly impact patient outcomes. While vision-language models (VLMs) show strong multimodal reasoning, they often lack domain-specific grounding to integrate wound imagery with heterogeneous clinical information, and provide limited mechanisms for detecting cases that diverge from the training distribution. We present a multimodal framework for automated wound monitoring and SAE detection. Our approach leverages paired clinical notes and wound descriptions capturing visual characteristics such as appearance, surrounding skin condition, color changes, and signs of inflammation or healing progression, encoded through a dual-stream Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) framework built on a frozen BiomedCLIP backbone. We introduce a cross-contextual LoRA fusion mechanism enabling information exchange between clinical semantics and visual wound descriptors, producing context-aware multimodal representations without full model fine-tuning. To identify personalized SAEs, we propose a wound-specific out-of-distribution (OOD) detection framework combining semantic matching, visual typicality, caption-text alignment, and caption-visual alignment into a unified SAE (OOD) score. To capture healing dynamics, we incorporate covariate consistency and temporal drift penalties that leverage changes in wound characteristics across visits. Experiments on a longitudinal wound dataset collected through clinical visits show promising performance on both wound healing assessment and SAE detection, highlighting the potential of semantically enriched, temporally aware vision-language systems for clinical wound monitoring and early risk identification.
summary_zh: 摘要：伤口监测是一项关键但尚未得到充分满足的临床挑战，及时识别感染、组织恶化及愈合延迟等严重不良事件可显著影响患者预后。尽管视觉语言模型具有较强的多模态推理能力，但其往往缺乏领域特定的基础支撑，难以将伤口影像与异质性临床信息整合，且对偏离训练分布的异常案例检测机制有限。我们提出了一种用于自动化伤口监测与严重不良事件检测的多模态框架。该方法利用配对临床记录与伤口描述（涵盖外观、周围皮肤状况、颜色变化及炎症或愈合进展等视觉特征），通过基于冻结BiomedCLIP主干构建的双流低秩适应框架进行编码。我们引入了一种跨上下文低秩适应融合机制，实现临床语义与视觉伤口描述符之间的信息交互，在不进行全模型微调的情况下生成上下文感知的多模态表示。为识别个性化严重不良事件，我们提出了一种伤口特异性分布外检测框架，将语义匹配、视觉典型性、描述文本对齐以及描述-视觉对齐统一为单一严重不良事件分布外评分。为捕捉愈合动态，我们纳入了协变量一致性与时间漂移惩罚项，利用多次就诊间伤口特征的变化。在通过临床就诊收集的纵向伤口数据集上的实验表明，该方法在伤口愈合评估与严重不良事件检测方面均取得了有前景的性能，凸显了语义丰富且具有时间感知能力的视觉语言系统在临床伤口监测与早期风险识别中的潜力。
tldr: This work presents a multimodal framework for wound monitoring and severe adverse event (SAE) detection using a dual-stream LoRA adaptation on a frozen BiomedCLIP backbone, with cross-contextual fusion, OOD detection combining multiple alignments, and temporal drift penalties. Experiments on longitudinal wound data show promising results for healing assessment and early risk identification.
tldr_zh: 该工作提出了一种用于伤口监测和严重不良事件（SAE）检测的多模态框架，采用基于冻结BiomedCLIP骨干网络的双流LoRA自适应方法，包含跨上下文融合、结合多种对齐的分布外检测以及时间漂移惩罚。在纵向伤口数据上的实验显示了伤口愈合评估和早期风险识别的良好效果。

title: Measuring the practice of shared-decision making (OPTION12): An Investigation into Open-sourced Smaller LLMs (OS-sLLMs) for Better Privacy and Sustainability
summary: We present LLM4SDM, the first study of open-source smaller language models (OS-sLLMs) for automated assessment of shared decision making (SDM) using the Observer OPTION12 framework. Unlike previous work that relies on large commercial models and the shorter OPTION5 instrument, our study focuses on privacy-preserving locally deployable models and Dutch melanoma consultation transcripts. Using expert-annotated clinical consultations, we evaluate three general-domain and two medical-domain OS-sLLMs during a development-phase pilot study. Results show that general-domain models outperform medical-domain models, which exhibit substantial hallucination and instruction-following failures. Gemma3:12b achieves the strongest agreement with human annotations (Pearson r=0.51, Spearman \r{ho}=0.59). Item-level and qualitative analyses reveal systematic challenges related to temporal discourse reasoning, conversational role attribution, and evidence grounding. We further introduce a Judge-LLM consensus framework designed to support disagreement resolution among multiple models. Our findings suggest that while current OS-sLLMs cannot replace human annotators, they offer a promising foundation for privacy-preserving human-in-the-loop SDM assessment.
summary_zh: LLM4SDM——首次针对开源小型语言模型（OS-sLLMs）在共享决策制定（SDM）自动化评估中的研究，基于Observer OPTION12框架。与以往依赖大型商业模型及较短OPTION5工具的研究不同，本研究聚焦于隐私保护、可本地部署的模型以及荷兰语黑色素瘤咨询转录文本。利用专家标注的临床咨询记录，我们在开发阶段试点研究中评估了三个通用领域和两个医学领域的OS-sLLMs。结果显示，通用领域模型优于医学领域模型，后者存在显著的幻觉现象及指令遵循失败。Gemma3:12b与人工标注的一致性最强（Pearson r=0.51，Spearman ρ=0.59）。项目级和定性分析揭示了与时间话语推理、对话角色归因及证据基础相关的系统性挑战。我们进一步引入了一种Judge-LLM共识框架，旨在支持多模型间的分歧解决。研究结果表明，尽管当前OS-sLLMs无法替代人工标注者，但它们为隐私保护的人机协同SDM评估提供了有前景的基础。
tldr: This paper presents LLM4SDM, the first study using open-source smaller LLMs to assess shared decision making via the OPTION12 framework, finding that general-domain models like Gemma3:12b outperform medical-domain models and introducing a Judge-LLM consensus framework for privacy-preserving human-in-the-loop assessment.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LLM4SDM，这是首个使用开源小型语言模型通过OPTION12框架评估共享决策的研究，发现通用领域模型（如Gemma3:12b）优于医学领域模型，并提出了一个Judge-LLM共识框架，用于隐私保护的人机协作评估。

title: Dual Attention Heads for Personalized Federated Learning in ECG Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, the inherent heterogeneity of electrocardiogram (ECG) data across healthcare providers presents significant technical challenges for robust classification. We propose FedDualAtt, a personalized federated learning approach that splits transformer attention heads into global and local branches. Global heads are aggregated via FedAvg to capture shared cross-site patterns, while local heads remain client-specific to adapt to institution-level recording characteristics. Experiments on FedCVD, an FL benchmark for cardiovascular disease detection, demonstrate that FedDualAtt outperforms existing FL and personalized FL methods in ECG classification tasks. Analysis of global-local head ratios reveals that different clients benefit from varying levels of architectural personalization.
summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）使得在不共享敏感患者数据的情况下，跨机构协同训练模型成为可能。然而，各医疗机构心电图（ECG）数据固有的异质性为鲁棒分类带来了显著的技术挑战。我们提出FedDualAtt，一种将Transformer注意力头拆分为全局分支和局部分支的个性化联邦学习方法。全局头通过FedAvg聚合以捕获跨站点的共享模式，而局部头则保留客户端特异性以适应机构层面的记录特性。在心血管疾病检测联邦学习基准FedCVD上的实验表明，FedDualAtt在心电图分类任务中优于现有的联邦学习和个性化联邦学习方法。对全局-局部头比例的分析揭示，不同客户端受益于不同程度的架构个性化。
tldr: FedDualAtt splits transformer attention heads into global (aggregated via FedAvg) and local (client-specific) branches for personalized federated learning in ECG classification, outperforming existing methods on a benchmark.
tldr_zh: FedDualAtt将Transformer注意力头拆分为全局（通过FedAvg聚合）和局部（客户端特定）分支，用于心电图分类中的个性化联邦学习，在基准测试中优于现有方法。

title: Sectorial customized corneal crosslinking for keratoconus: an inverse biomechanical design study with an anisotropic reduced shell finite-element surrogate
summary: We propose an inverse biomechanical design framework for sectorial customized corneal crosslinking in keratoconus. The cornea is modeled as an anisotropic reduced shell with spatially varying crosslinking-induced stiffening, enabling the optimization of localized treatment patterns rather than uniform irradiation profiles. Numerical simulations show that sectorial stiffening can redistribute curvature, reduce localized steepening, and improve corneal regularity in decentered keratoconus models while preserving biomechanical plausibility. These results support the use of patient-specific computational planning for customized crosslinking protocols and provide a basis for future integration with corneal tomography and programmable ultraviolet delivery systems.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于圆锥角膜扇形定制角膜交联的逆生物力学设计框架。角膜被建模为具有空间变化交联诱导硬化的各向异性简化壳，从而能够优化局部治疗模式，而非均匀照射方案。数值模拟表明，扇形硬化可以重新分布曲率、减少局部陡峭，并在保持生物力学合理性的同时改善偏心圆锥角膜模型的角膜规则性。这些结果支持使用患者特异性计算规划来定制交联方案，并为未来与角膜断层扫描及可编程紫外线输送系统的集成奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper proposes an inverse biomechanical design framework for sectorial customized corneal crosslinking in keratoconus, using an anisotropic reduced shell finite-element surrogate to optimize localized treatment patterns and improve corneal regularity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于圆锥角膜扇形定制角膜交联的逆生物力学设计框架，使用各向异性缩减壳有限元代理来优化局部治疗模式并改善角膜规则性。

title: A Continual Learning Framework for Adaptive Control of Modular Soft Robots
summary: Soft robots have attracted significant attention in applications such as medical intervention, rehabilitation, and robotic manipulation due to their inherent compliance, flexibility, and high degrees of freedom. Modular soft robots (MSRs), composed of multiple interconnected segments, represent an emerging class of robotic systems with highly deformable and reconfigurable structures capable of performing complex tasks. However, designing controllers for MSRs remains challenging due to their nonlinear dynamics, modeling complexity, and hyper-redundant nature. Existing approaches typically require controllers to be retrained from scratch whenever the robot morphology changes. In this work, we address these challenges through a continual learning inspired control framework capable of incrementally adapting to changes in robot morphology while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Specifically, the proposed framework enables the controller to sequentially learn new MSR configurations without forgetting previously learned ones. In addition, for MSRs with fixed configurations, the same framework can be employed in a distributed manner to learn module-specific dynamics, enabling localized control and improved precision. The proposed approach is validated through closed-loop trajectory tracking experiments in simulation using a tendon-driven soft robot, as well as on a real-world three-module pneumatic soft robotic arm. Furthermore, we demonstrate the adaptive capabilities of the framework through a reaching experiment in which the controller selectively activates only the necessary modules to reach a virtual target position, thereby reducing computational overhead.
summary_zh: 软体机器人因其固有的柔顺性、灵活性和高自由度，在医疗干预、康复和机器人操作等应用中受到了广泛关注。模块化软体机器人（MSRs）由多个相互连接的段组成，代表了一类具有高度变形和可重构结构的新型机器人系统，能够执行复杂任务。然而，由于MSRs的非线性动力学、建模复杂性和超冗余特性，为其设计控制器仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常要求每当机器人形态发生变化时，控制器需从头开始重新训练。在本工作中，我们通过一种受持续学习启发的控制框架来应对这些挑战，该框架能够逐步适应机器人形态的变化，同时保留先前获取的知识。具体而言，所提出的框架使控制器能够顺序学习新的MSR配置，而不会遗忘先前学到的知识。此外，对于固定配置的MSR，同一框架可以以分布式方式使用，以学习模块特定的动力学，从而实现局部控制并提高精度。所提出的方法通过使用腱驱动软体机器人的仿真闭环轨迹跟踪实验，以及真实世界中的三模块气动软体机械臂进行了验证。此外，我们通过一个到达实验展示了该框架的自适应能力：在该实验中，控制器仅选择性地激活必要的模块以到达虚拟目标位置，从而降低了计算开销。
tldr: This paper proposes a continual learning framework for adaptive control of modular soft robots, enabling incremental adaptation to morphology changes without forgetting prior knowledge, validated through simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模块化软机器人的持续学习控制框架，能够在不遗忘先前知识的情况下逐步适应形态变化，并通过仿真和真实实验验证。

title: Context-Aware Force Estimation for Deformable Tool Manipulation in Robotic Environmental Swabbing via Few-Shot Continual Adaptation
summary: Robotic surface swabbing requires sustained interaction between a compliant tool and heterogeneous environments, where accurate estimation of tip-level contact force is critical for consistent sampling performance. However, deformable tool dynamics introduce nonlinear viscoelastic hysteresis that decouples wrist-mounted force measurements from true contact forces, while tool-integrated sensors are impractical for deployment due to sterility and disposability constraints. This paper presents a data-driven framework for contact force estimation in Deformable Tool Manipulation (DTM) that leverages proprioceptive sensing without requiring explicit physical models or permanent embedded sensing hardware at the tool tip. A recurrent architecture is first identified through a comparative evaluation of temporal models, where a compact LSTM achieves the lowest estimation error and sub-millisecond inference latency. To address generalization across unseen surfaces and tool compliance conditions, we introduce a parameter-isolated few-shot adaptation strategy that augments a frozen recurrent backbone with low-dimensional context embeddings using feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). Experiments on a UR5e platform across nine tool-surface interaction regimes demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves robustness under domain shift, reducing zero-shot estimation error by up to 63\% while preserving baseline performance without catastrophic forgetting. These results show that separating shared deformation-history dynamics from domain-specific conditioning enables reliable force estimation for DTM in non-stationary environments.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人表面擦拭要求在柔性工具与异质环境之间维持持续交互，其中精确估计尖端接触力对于实现一致的采样性能至关重要。然而，可变形工具动力学引入了非线性粘弹性滞后，使得腕部安装的力传感器测量值与实际接触力之间产生解耦，而工具集成式传感器因无菌性和一次性使用的限制而难以实际部署。本文提出了一种数据驱动的接触力估计框架，适用于可变形工具操作（DTM），该框架利用本体感觉传感，无需显式物理模型或工具尖端的永久嵌入式传感硬件。通过对时序模型的比较评估，首先确定了一种循环架构，其中紧凑型LSTM实现了最低的估计误差和亚毫秒级推理延迟。为解决在未见表面和工具顺应性条件下的泛化问题，我们引入了一种参数隔离的少样本适应策略，该策略通过特征线性调制（FiLM）利用低维上下文嵌入来增强冻结的循环骨干网络。在UR5e平台上进行了九种工具-表面交互机制的实验，结果表明，所提出的方法显著提升了域迁移下的鲁棒性，将零样本估计误差降低了高达63%，同时在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下保持了基线性能。这些结果表明，将共享的变形历史动态与领域特定条件分离，能够在非平稳环境中实现可靠的DTM力估计。
tldr: A data-driven framework using a compact LSTM with few-shot continual adaptation (FiLM) estimates tip-level contact force for deformable tools in robotic environmental swabbing, reducing zero-shot estimation error by 63% without catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 一个数据驱动框架，使用紧凑型LSTM和少样本持续适应（FiLM），估计机器人环境擦拭中可变形工具的尖端接触力，将零样本估计误差降低63%，且不会灾难性遗忘。

title: AA-ViT: Anatomically Aware Vision Transformer with Structural and Frequency Guidance for Contrast Enhanced Brain MRI Synthesis
summary: Accurate tumour localization and diagnosis is a critical component of clinical care for brain cancers. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the most commonly used imaging modality due to its superior soft-tissue contrast. However, standard MRI often exhibits limited contrast and imaging artifacts, which necessitates the use of contrast agents to enhance lesion visibility. The administration of chemical contrast agents is not always feasible and may be contraindicated in patients with renal impairment or other health conditions. As a result, developing accurate and non-invasive contrast enhanced MRI (CEMRI) synthesis methods has clinical importance. In recent years, numerous approaches for CEMRI synthesis have been proposed, predominantly relying on generative artificial intelligence models. While these methods demonstrate promising performance, their dependence on implicit feature learning often limits their ability to preserve anatomical boundaries and tumour-specific fine structures. To address these challenges, we propose an anatomically aware frequency-and-structure-guided vision transformer (AA-ViT), for CEMRI synthesis using pre-contrast MRI modalities (T1, T2, and FLAIR). Experiments on the BraTS 2021 dataset demonstrate that the proposed method preserves anatomical and lesion boundaries, achieving higher PSNR and SSIM than state-of-the-art approaches. Clinical evaluation by three neuroradiologists and a neurosurgeon on 19 randomly selected cases across diverse gliomas yielded a mean score of 3.94/5, providing preliminary clinical validation rarely seen in prior studies. Synthetic post-contrast scans from our model could lower scanning costs, shorten imaging time, and avoid the potential risks of using gadolinium-based contrast agents.
summary_zh: 准确的肿瘤定位与诊断是脑癌临床治疗中的关键环节。磁共振成像（MRI）因其优异的软组织对比度而成为最常用的成像方式。然而，标准MRI常存在对比度有限和成像伪影的问题，这需要使用对比剂来增强病灶可视性。化学对比剂的给药并非总是可行，且对于肾功能不全或其他健康问题的患者可能存在禁忌。因此，开发准确且无创的对比增强MRI（CEMRI）合成方法具有重要的临床意义。近年来，已提出了多种CEMRI合成方法，主要依赖于生成式人工智能模型。尽管这些方法展现出令人鼓舞的性能，但它们对隐式特征学习的依赖往往限制了其保留解剖边界和肿瘤特异性精细结构的能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种解剖感知的频率与结构引导的视觉变换器（AA-ViT），用于利用平扫MRI模态（T1、T2和FLAIR）合成CEMRI。在BraTS 2021数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法保留了解剖和病灶边界，在PSNR和SSIM指标上均优于现有最先进方法。由三位神经放射科医生和一位神经外科医生对19例随机选取的不同胶质瘤病例进行的临床评估给出了平均3.94/5分的评分，这提供了以往研究中罕见的初步临床验证。我们的模型生成的合成增强后扫描可降低扫描成本、缩短成像时间，并避免使用钆基对比剂的潜在风险。
tldr: AA-ViT is an anatomically aware vision transformer that uses structural and frequency guidance to synthesize contrast-enhanced MRI from non-contrast scans, achieving higher quality metrics and clinical validation on brain tumor cases.
tldr_zh: AA-ViT是一种解剖感知的视觉Transformer，利用结构和频率引导从非增强扫描合成对比增强MRI，在脑肿瘤病例中取得了更高的质量指标和临床验证。

title: SHTA: Semantic Hard Token Correction and Center Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in semi-supervised medical image segmentation have achieved remarkable performance through prediction consistency, pseudo-label supervision, and hard-region supervision. However, these methods primarily improve supervision quality rather than explicitly enforcing semantic consistency in the learned representations of hard regions. Consequently, even under increasingly stronger prediction-level supervision, difficult regions exhibiting unstable semantic assignment often fail to establish semantically consistent representations during training, thereby limiting further segmentation improvement. To address this issue, we propose SHTA (Semantic Hard Token Correction and Center Alignment), a lightweight training-time semantic representation branch. Instead of introducing additional prediction supervision, SHTA refines intermediate semantic representations through Semantic Assignment, Hard Token Refinement, and Semantic Center Alignment, thereby improving semantic consistency in hard regions while preserving the original prediction pathway and introducing no additional inference cost. We integrate SHTA into representative semi-supervised segmentation frameworks, including GA-CPS, CPS, URPC, and MagicNet, and conduct evaluations on the Synapse and AMOS datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that SHTA delivers consistent paired improvements across frameworks, with especially clear gains in segmentation accuracy, weak-organ recovery, and semantic ambiguity reduction, while incurring only training-time overhead. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/release_SHTA-42D5/.
summary_zh: 半监督医学图像分割的最新进展通过预测一致性、伪标签监督和困难区域监督取得了显著性能。然而，这些方法主要提升监督质量，而非显式地在困难区域的学习表示中强制语义一致性。因此，即使在越来越强的预测级监督下，表现出不稳定语义分配的困难区域也常常无法在训练过程中建立语义一致的表示，从而限制了分割性能的进一步提升。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SHTA（语义困难令牌修正与中心对齐），一个轻量级的训练时语义表示分支。SHTA不引入额外的预测监督，而是通过语义分配、困难令牌修正和语义中心对齐来优化中间语义表示，从而在保持原始预测路径且不增加推理成本的同时，提升困难区域的语义一致性。我们将SHTA集成到具有代表性的半监督分割框架中，包括GA-CPS、CPS、URPC和MagicNet，并在Synapse和AMOS数据集上进行评估。实验结果表明，SHTA在不同框架中均带来一致的成对改进，在分割精度、弱器官恢复和语义模糊减少方面尤为显著，且仅增加训练时间开销。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/release_SHTA-42D5/获取。
tldr: Proposes SHTA, a lightweight training-time semantic representation branch for semi-supervised medical image segmentation that improves semantic consistency in hard regions via semantic assignment, hard token refinement, and center alignment, achieving consistent segmentation gains across multiple frameworks without extra inference cost.
tldr_zh: 提出SHTA，一种轻量级的训练时语义表示分支，通过语义分配、困难标记修正和语义中心对齐来提高半监督医学图像分割中困难区域的语义一致性，在不增加推理成本的情况下，在多个框架上实现一致的分割性能提升。

title: A hierarchical memory architecture overcomes context limits in long-horizon multi-agent computational modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet their stateless architecture fundamentally limits deployment in long-horizon research workflows requiring multi-session continuity and quantitative rigor. Here we present Ensemble QSP, a multi-agent framework featuring a three-layer hierarchical memory architecture that keeps injected context bounded and constant in project duration (mid-term project state: median 301 tokens, max 4,050, across 104 runs) by capping each state category and evicting completed work, enabling continuous autonomous operation without context degradation. The system orchestrates five specialist worker agents under domain-expert principal investigators, enforcing physical constraints through physics-based checklists and structured-domain knowledge. Comprehensive benchmarking demonstrates robust autonomous pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic model selection without human intervention, consistent result quality across both lower-cost and frontier LLMs, improved PK parameter recovery relative to single-agent baselines, and stable model selection across linguistically diverse prompts of the same task. Feature-level ablation across physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models spanning a broad complexity range shows that PI-agent oversight improves debugging efficiency while preserving final accuracy across conditions. The architecture is structurally domain-agnostic, adding a new scientific domain requires only a new PI agent configuration.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现了卓越的推理能力，但其无状态架构从根本上限制了其在需要多会话连续性和定量严谨性的长周期研究工作流中的部署。本文提出Ensemble QSP，一个多智能体框架，其采用三层分层记忆架构，通过限制每个状态类别并驱逐已完成工作，使注入的上下文在项目周期内保持有界且恒定（中期项目状态：中位数301个令牌，最大值4,050个令牌，共104次运行），从而在没有上下文退化的情况下实现连续自主运行。该系统在领域专家首席研究员的指导下协调五个专业工作智能体，通过基于物理的检查清单和结构化领域知识强制执行物理约束。全面的基准测试表明：无需人工干预即可实现鲁棒的自主动药代动力学-药效学模型选择；在低成本模型和前沿LLM上均获得一致的结果质量；相对于单智能体基线，PK参数恢复能力得到改善；对于同一任务的语言多样化提示，模型选择保持稳定。在涵盖广泛复杂度范围的基于生理的药代动力学（PBPK）模型上进行的特征级消融实验显示，PI智能体的监督提高了调试效率，同时在不同条件下保持了最终准确性。该架构在结构上独立于具体领域，添加一个新的科学领域仅需配置新的PI智能体。
tldr: This paper introduces Ensemble QSP, a multi-agent framework with a three-layer hierarchical memory architecture that keeps context bounded and constant, enabling continuous autonomous operation for long-horizon scientific modeling tasks such as pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic model selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Ensemble QSP，一种具有三层分层记忆架构的多智能体框架，该架构保持上下文受限且恒定，从而实现长期自主运行，适用于药代动力学-药效学模型选择等科学建模任务。

title: Track2Map: Online Deformable SLAM with Motion-Aware Pose Optimization in Robotic Surgery
summary: Gaussian splatting is the current state-of-the-art for dense, deformable 3D anatomy reconstruction in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS); however, most pipelines are offline and depend on accurate camera trajectory priors (often from robotic kinematics), limiting applicability when priors are missing or noisy. To address these limitations, we propose Track2Map, an online 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline that jointly optimizes camera trajectory and 3D deformable scene representation directly from surgical video. Track2Map is therefore capable of robust 3D reconstructions when camera trajectory priors are either absent or noisy, and due to its online nature it effectively works as a Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping (SLAM) method. To stabilize optimization in the presence of tissue motion and ambiguous visual cues, we introduce a track-anchored deformation initialization using dense 2D point tracks. Track statistics are further utilized to disentangle camera motion from scene deformation by detecting static camera periods and reducing drift during incremental mapping. Experiments on StereoMIS show improved reconstruction quality and camera trajectory against competing SLAM methods, as well as compared to non-SLAM methods that utilize camera trajectory priors. The code is available at https://track2map.github.io/.
summary_zh: 高斯泼溅是当前机器人辅助微创手术（RAMIS）中密集、可变形三维解剖重建的最先进技术；然而，大多数流水线是离线运行的，且依赖于精确的相机轨迹先验（通常来自机器人运动学），这限制了其在先验信息缺失或存在噪声时的适用性。为解决这些限制，我们提出了Track2Map——一种在线三维高斯泼溅流水线，可直接从手术视频中联合优化相机轨迹和三维可变形场景表征。因此，当相机轨迹先验缺失或存在噪声时，Track2Map能够实现鲁棒的三维重建，并且由于其在线特性，它可有效地作为一种同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）方法运行。为了在组织运动和模糊视觉线索存在的情况下稳定优化，我们引入了一种利用密集二维点轨迹的轨迹锚定变形初始化方法。进一步利用轨迹统计信息，通过检测静态相机周期并减少增量建图过程中的漂移，将相机运动与场景变形解耦。在StereoMIS上的实验表明，与竞争性SLAM方法以及利用相机轨迹先验的非SLAM方法相比，本方法在重建质量和相机轨迹方面均有提升。代码已公开于https://track2map.github.io/。
tldr: Track2Map proposes an online deformable SLAM method for robotic surgery using 3D Gaussian splatting and motion-aware pose optimization, achieving robust 3D reconstruction without camera trajectory priors.
tldr_zh: Track2Map 提出了一种用于机器人手术的在线可变形SLAM方法，结合3D高斯溅射和运动感知位姿优化，无需相机轨迹先验即可实现鲁棒的3D重建。

title: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance
summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a common malignancy and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Current guidelines and staging systems provide coarse categories, but often miss within-stage heterogeneity and the clinical context in electronic medical records (EMRs). We present HCC-STAR (Hepatocellular Carcinoma Staging, Treatment And pRognosis), a clinically aligned large language model that reads routine EMR narratives and jointly outputs risk score-based staging, ranked guideline-consistent treatments with evidence-based rationales, and individualized survival estimates. We curated about 30,000 HCC cases from SEER and expanded them into EMR-style narrative training data using a clinician-validated, prompt-based augmentation workflow. On this corpus, we developed a knowledge-aligned reasoning framework optimized with a step-verifiable composite reward, moving beyond text-level memorization of clinical guidelines. In a multi-center cohort of 6,668 patients from 12 hospitals in China, HCC-STAR achieved state-of-the-art performance in treatment recommendation and risk stratification compared with clinical guidelines and competitive models, including GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5 Pro. Hypothetical overall-survival analysis showed a median survival of 51 months under adherence to HCC-STAR recommendations, compared with 29 and 32 months under BCLC and CNLC. In clinician-centric evaluations, blinded hepatobiliary specialists rated HCC-STAR's reasoning and evidence-based justifications as trustworthy. The model surpassed resident and attending physicians in treatment accuracy and helped physicians make more accurate decisions faster when used as an assistant. These findings support HCC-STAR as a reliable and verifiable decision-support system for risk stratification and precision therapy in HCC.
summary_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是一种常见恶性肿瘤，也是癌症相关死亡的主要原因。当前指南和分期系统提供了粗略的分层类别，但往往忽略了分期内部的异质性以及电子病历（EMR）中的临床背景。我们提出HCC-STAR（肝细胞癌分期、治疗与预后系统），这是一个与临床对齐的大语言模型，能够读取常规电子病历叙述，并联合输出基于风险评分的分期、按指南排序并附有循证依据的治疗方案，以及个体化生存期预测。我们从SEER数据库中收集了约30,000例HCC病例，并采用经临床验证的基于提示的增强工作流程，将其扩展为电子病历风格的叙述性训练数据。在该语料库上，我们开发了一个知识对齐的推理框架，通过可逐步验证的复合奖励进行优化，超越了临床指南的文本级记忆。在一项涵盖中国12家医院共6,668名患者的多中心队列中，与临床指南及包括GPT-5和Gemini-2.5 Pro在内的竞品模型相比，HCC-STAR在治疗推荐和风险分层方面达到了最优性能。假设性总生存分析显示，遵循HCC-STAR推荐方案的中位生存期为51个月，而BCLC和CNLC方案分别为29个月和32个月。在临床医生为中心的评价中，盲法肝胆专科医生认为HCC-STAR的推理和循证依据可信。该模型在治疗准确性上超越住院医师和主治医师，且作为辅助工具时，能帮助医生更快做出更准确的决策。这些结果表明，HCC-STAR可作为肝细胞癌风险分层和精准治疗中一个可靠且可验证的决策支持系统。
tldr: This paper presents HCC-STAR, a clinical LLM that reads EMR narratives to provide risk stratification, treatment recommendations, and survival estimates for hepatocellular carcinoma, achieving superior performance over existing guidelines and GPT-5/Gemini in multi-center evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HCC-STAR，一个临床大语言模型，通过读取电子病历文本为肝细胞癌提供风险分层、治疗建议和生存预测，在多中心评估中优于现有指南及GPT-5/Gemini。

title: A safety-oriented hypothetico-deductive framework for AI-assisted differential diagnosis
summary: Diagnostic error is a major threat to patient safety, yet current large language model (LLM) systems often treat diagnosis as a one-shot prediction task, lacking safeguards against missed high-risk alternatives or rigorous verification of their reasoning. Here, we present AegisDx, a safety-oriented framework for hypothetico-deductive clinical reasoning. AegisDx coordinates specialized LLM components through role-specific contracts, structured intermediate outputs, evidence-retrieval interfaces, and verification gates to generate broad differential diagnoses, enforce explicit screening for dangerous "must-not-miss" conditions, verify reasoning against grounded medical evidence, and structure actionable next steps. We evaluated AegisDx across three layers. On literature-derived case reports from NEJM and JAMA, with GPT-oss-120B as the shared backbone, Top-3 diagnostic accuracy was 59.9% versus 52.1% for the standalone LLM on JAMA cases and 62.7% versus 51.4% on NEJM cases. On cases from Annals of Emergency Medicine, Top-3 accuracy was 85.7% versus 68.6%; against physician-consensus must-not-miss diagnosis sets, AegisDx captured at least one such condition among its top three diagnoses in 78.0% of cases versus 52.0%. In a blinded physician evaluation of 43 real-world emergency department notes from the Yale New Haven Health System compared against GPT-5, AegisDx improved the physician-rated composite safety score from 4.31 to 4.55 on a 5-point scale (adjusted p = 2.1x10^-4), with qualitative gains in must-not-miss identification and reasoning safety. Our findings suggest that engineering diagnostic AI as a safety-oriented reasoning framework, rather than optimizing raw predictive accuracy alone, can provide a safer, more transparent, and clinically meaningful layer of bedside decision support for acute care workflows.
summary_zh: 诊断错误是患者安全的主要威胁，然而当前的大语言模型（LLM）系统通常将诊断视为一次性预测任务，缺乏对高危遗漏情况的防护机制，也无法对其推理过程进行严格验证。在此，我们提出AegisDx——一种面向安全的假设-演绎临床推理框架。AegisDx通过角色特定协定、结构化中间输出、证据检索接口和验证门来协调专门的LLM组件，以生成广泛的鉴别诊断、强制实施对危险“不可遗漏”病症的显式筛查、基于可靠医学证据验证推理，并构建可操作的后续步骤。我们从三个层面评估了AegisDx。在以GPT-oss-120B为共享基础模型的NEJM和JAMA文献病例中，JAMA病例的Top-3诊断准确率为59.9%（独立LLM为52.1%），NEJM病例为62.7%（独立LLM为51.4%）。在《急诊医学年鉴》病例中，Top-3准确率为85.7%（独立LLM为68.6%）；针对医生共识的不可遗漏诊断集合，AegisDx在78.0%的病例中将其前三项诊断之一识别为至少一种此类病症（独立LLM为52.0%）。在针对耶鲁纽黑文卫生系统43份真实世界急诊科病历的盲法医生评估中，与GPT-5相比，AegisDx将医生评定的综合安全评分从4.31提升至4.55（5分制，校正后p = 2.1×10⁻⁴），并在不可遗漏识别和推理安全性方面取得定性改善。我们的研究结果表明，将诊断AI设计为面向安全的推理框架，而非仅优化原始预测准确性，可为急性诊疗流程提供更安全、更透明且更具临床意义的床边决策支持层。
tldr: AegisDx is a safety-oriented AI framework for differential diagnosis that uses role-specific LLM components, structured intermediate outputs, and verification gates to improve diagnostic accuracy and capture must-not-miss conditions, outperforming standalone LLMs in multiple evaluations.
tldr_zh: AegisDx 是一个面向安全的 AI 鉴别诊断框架，通过角色特定的 LLM 组件、结构化中间输出和验证门控，提高了诊断准确率并更好地捕捉了不可遗漏的病症，在多项评估中优于独立 LLM。

title: Attribute Retrieving for Open-Vocabulary Endoscopic Compositional Referring Segmentation
summary: Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) aims to segment image regions specified by natural language, enabling fine-grained and controllable visual understanding. Extending RIS to endoscopic imagery, however, presents unique challenges, including scarce high-quality annotations and complex, domain-specific image-text relationships. Although recent vision-language models demonstrate strong cross-domain alignment, they often fail to capture fine-grained textual cues in endoscopic settings, resulting in suboptimal performance and limited generalization. To address these challenges, we introduce ReferEndoscopy, a large-scale benchmark for RIS in the endoscopy field. Building on this dataset, we propose the Attribute Retrieval-based Endoscopic-RIS (AR-ERIS) framework for open-vocabulary endoscopic compositional referring segmentation. AR-ERIS leverages attribute retrieval for open-vocabulary endoscopic compositional referring segmentation and is pretrained on the curated ReferEndoscopy dataset, achieving state-of-the-art performance with strong generalization across both simulated and real-world endoscopic data. The dataset and code will be publicly released upon completion of the review process.
summary_zh: 指代图像分割（RIS）旨在通过自然语言指定图像区域进行分割，实现细粒度且可控的视觉理解。然而，将RIS扩展到内窥镜图像领域面临独特挑战，包括高质量标注稀缺以及复杂的领域特定图文关系。尽管最近的视觉语言模型展现出强大的跨领域对齐能力，但它们往往无法捕捉内窥镜场景中的细粒度文本线索，导致性能欠佳且泛化能力有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ReferEndoscopy——一个面向内窥镜领域RIS的大规模基准数据集。基于该数据集，我们进一步提出了基于属性检索的内窥镜RIS框架（AR-ERIS），用于开放词汇的内窥镜组合式指代分割。AR-ERIS利用属性检索实现开放词汇的内窥镜组合式指代分割，并在精心构建的ReferEndoscopy数据集上预训练，在模拟和真实内窥镜数据上均实现了最先进的性能与强泛化能力。数据集和代码将在审稿流程完成后公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces ReferEndoscopy, a large-scale benchmark for referring image segmentation in endoscopy, and proposes an attribute retrieval-based framework (AR-ERIS) for open-vocabulary compositional referring segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ReferEndoscopy，一个用于内窥镜图像指代分割的大规模基准数据集，并基于属性检索提出了AR-ERIS框架，用于开放词汇的复合指代分割，取得了最先进性能和强泛化能力。

title: ConRad: Efficient Conformal Prediction for Radiomics
summary: Radiomic features derived from medical images and segmentation masks are used to support decision making in clinical imaging pipelines. In practice, these features are often computed from predicted masks, but segmentation models can be overconfident or poorly calibrated, making derived measurements appear more reliable than they are. Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free prediction intervals with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees, but black-box intervals for segmentation-derived radiomics can be inefficient because they ignore test-time information about image appearance, mask geometry, and segmentation uncertainty. We propose ConRad, a conformal framework for scalar radiomic targets that uses covariates derived from the predicted mask, input image, predicted radiomics, and boundary uncertainty to construct adaptive intervals while maintaining coverage. Across five 2D medical imaging datasets and 171 retained radiomic targets, we show that ConRad improves feature-level efficiency compared to baselines while maintaining near-nominal empirical coverage. Ablation results further indicate that segmentation boundary uncertainty features are the largest contributors to interval efficiency.
summary_zh: 从医学图像和分割掩膜中提取的放射组学特征用于支持临床影像流程中的决策制定。实际应用中，这些特征通常基于预测掩膜计算，但分割模型可能过度自信或校准不良，导致衍生测量结果看似比实际更可靠。保形预测（CP）提供了无分布假设的预测区间，并具有有限样本边际覆盖保证，但针对分割衍生放射组学的黑箱区间效率低下，因其忽略了测试时关于图像外观、掩膜几何形状及分割不确定性的信息。我们提出ConRad框架——一种针对标量放射组学目标的保形方法，通过整合源自预测掩膜、输入图像、预测放射组学及边界不确定性的协变量，构建自适应区间并保持覆盖保证。在五个二维医学影像数据集和171个保留放射组学目标上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，ConRad在保持接近标称经验覆盖率的同时提升了特征级效率。消融研究进一步指出，分割边界不确定性特征对区间效率的贡献最大。
tldr: ConRad is a conformal prediction framework that leverages covariates from segmentation masks, images, and boundary uncertainty to produce efficient and coverage-guaranteed prediction intervals for radiomic features, outperforming baselines across multiple medical imaging datasets.
tldr_zh: ConRad 是一种共形预测框架，利用来自分割掩膜、图像和边界不确定性的协变量，为影像组学特征生成高效且具有覆盖保证的预测区间，在多个医学影像数据集上优于基线方法。

title: In vivo feasibility study of humanoid robots in surgery
summary: Recent advances in actuation, control and learning have rapidly pushed humanoid robots from a distant vision towards near-term real-world deployment. Healthcare is a particularly pressing domain, in which staffing shortages and increasing care demand are widening the gap between clinical workload and available skilled labour. Although current automation has largely focused on digital and logistical tasks, much hospital work remains embodied, requiring mobility, manipulation and safe interaction in human-designed environments. Humanoid form factors offer unique potential, particularly for assisting with surgical tasks. Traditionally, robotic systems for surgery are purpose-built platforms such as Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci Surgical System, and it remains unclear how close current humanoid systems are to meeting the precision, control and safety requirements of minimally invasive surgery. Here we present a systematic evaluation of contemporary humanoid technology for laparoscopic surgical tasks. We develop a humanoid-based laparoscopic teleoperation framework using general-purpose instruments and assess its abilities through benchtop characterization, dry-laboratory user studies spanning diverse surgical experience levels and in vivo porcine studies. Across these evaluations, we quantify technical feasibility, task performance and clinical readiness relative to established surgical platforms. Together, our study provides an evidence-based assessment of current humanoid abilities and limitations for surgical applications, highlighting both their promise and key technical challenges that must be addressed before clinical deployment.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
近年来，驱动、控制与学习领域的进展正迅速将人形机器人从遥远愿景推向近期现实部署。医疗保健领域尤为紧迫，人员短缺与日益增长的护理需求正不断拉大临床工作量与可用技术劳动力之间的差距。尽管当前自动化技术主要聚焦于数字化与后勤任务，但医院大量工作仍依赖具身操作，需要在人类设计的环境中完成移动、操控及安全交互。人形形态因具备独特潜力，尤其适用于辅助外科手术任务。传统上，手术机器人系统是专用平台，如直觉外科公司的达芬奇手术系统；而当前人形系统在满足微创手术所需的精度、控制及安全性方面究竟达到何种水平尚不明确。本文对当代人形机器人技术用于腹腔镜手术任务进行了系统性评估。我们开发了一套基于人形机器人的腹腔镜遥操作框架，采用通用器械，并通过台架表征、涵盖不同手术经验水平的干实验室用户研究以及体内猪模型研究对其能力进行了评估。在这些评估中，我们对照现有手术平台，量化了技术可行性、任务性能及临床就绪度。综上，本研究基于证据评估了当前人形机器人在手术应用中的能力与局限，既凸显了其前景，也指出了在临床部署前必须攻克的关键技术挑战。
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates the feasibility of using contemporary humanoid robots for laparoscopic surgical tasks through benchtop tests, user studies, and in vivo porcine experiments, comparing performance to established surgical platforms like the da Vinci system.
tldr_zh: 本文通过台式测试、用户研究及猪体内实验，系统评估了当代人形机器人用于腹腔镜手术任务的可行性，并与达芬奇等成熟手术平台进行了性能比较。

title: Learning Adaptive Solvers for Distributed Factor Graph Optimization on Matrix Lie Groups
summary: Modern robotic perception increasingly involves large-scale geometric optimization problems distributed across multiple robots or sessions. However, existing distributed solvers often depend on brittle hand tuning and primarily target rigid body pose graphs. To address this, we present DeepCORD, a learning-augmented framework for distributed factor graph optimization on general matrix Lie groups. By unfolding a parallel and accelerated Riemannian optimizer into differentiable iterations, DeepCORD learns a self-supervised feedback policy that dynamically adapts solver parameters according to the optimization phase and communication status. The resulting method enables adaptive distributed optimization over matrix Lie groups under both synchronous and asynchronous communication regimes. Extensive experiments on real-world $\mathrm{SE}$(3) pose graph optimization and $\mathrm{SL}$(4) projective submap alignment show that our method achieves lower objective values than existing distributed baselines on most benchmarks across realistic operating scenarios.
summary_zh: 现代机器人感知日益涉及分布在多个机器人或会话中的大规模几何优化问题。然而，现有的分布式求解器通常依赖于脆弱的参数手工调整，且主要针对刚体位姿图。为解决这一问题，我们提出DeepCORD——一种用于一般矩阵李群上分布式因子图优化的学习增强框架。通过将并行加速的黎曼优化器展开为可微迭代，DeepCORD学习一种自监督反馈策略，该策略能够根据优化阶段和通信状态动态调整求解器参数。所得到的方法能够在同步和异步通信模式下实现矩阵李群上的自适应分布式优化。在真实世界的$\mathrm{SE}$(3)位姿图优化和$\mathrm{SL}$(4)投影子图对齐任务上的大量实验表明，在大多数基准测试中，我们的方法在现实操作场景下均取得了比现有分布式基线更低的优化目标值。
tldr: DeepCORD is a learning-augmented framework that adaptively solves distributed factor graph optimization on matrix Lie groups, outperforming baselines on SE(3) pose graph and SL(4) submap alignment benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DeepCORD 是一个学习增强的分布式因子图优化框架，可在矩阵李群上进行自适应求解，在 SE(3) 位姿图和 SL(4) 子图对齐基准上优于现有基线。

title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on isolated psychiatric tasks, including dialogue, diagnosis, and treatment planning, yet existing benchmarks rarely simulate complete psychiatric clinical encounters. We introduce $\textbf{MentalHospital}$, a virtual evaluation environment for LLM-based psychiatric clinical encounters. MentalHospital instantiates the Subjective Interviewing, Objective Examination, Diagnostic Assessment, and Treatment Planning (S.O.A.P.) workflow, using skill-augmented standardized patients constructed from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric electronic health record (EHR) cases spanning all major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders. Each encounter is assessed through a dual-track protocol that combines objective comparison against EHR-derived references with subjective assessment of clinical process quality. To scale specialist judgment, we develop $\textbf{MentalEval}$, five domain-specific evaluators covering communication empathy, interviewing professionalism, clinical-note quality, diagnostic rigor, and treatment appropriateness, trained with rubric-grounded SFT and expert-guided DPO. Survey responses from 22 clinicians support MentalHospital's clinical fidelity (3.88/5), while MentalEval achieves strong expert alignment with an average QWK of 0.944. Benchmarking shows that even the strongest LLM trails clinicians by 37.28 percentage points in objective psychiatric competence, with mental status assessment as a key bottleneck.
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
大型语言模型在孤立的 psychiatry 任务中（包括对话、诊断和治疗规划）展现出强劲性能，然而现有基准测试很少模拟完整的临床接诊过程。我们提出 **$\textbf{MentalHospital}$**，一个基于大型语言模型的模拟精神病学临床接诊的虚拟评估环境。MentalHospital 实例化了主观问诊、客观检查、诊断评估与治疗规划工作流程，使用由 1,193 例去标识化的精神病学电子健康档案病例构建的技能增强型标准化患者，涵盖所有主要 ICD-11 类别及 76 种疾病。每次接诊通过双轨评估协议进行评估，该协议将基于电子健康档案参考标准的客观比较与临床过程质量的主观评估相结合。为扩展专家级评判能力，我们开发了 **$\textbf{MentalEval}$**，五个领域特定评估器分别覆盖沟通共情、问诊专业性、临床记录质量、诊断严谨性和治疗适切性，采用基于评分准则的监督微调及专家指导的直接偏好优化进行训练。来自 22 位临床医生的调查反馈支持 MentalHospital 的临床保真度（3.88/5），而 MentalEval 实现了与专家高度一致，平均加权卡帕系数为 0.944。基准测评显示，即使最强的大型语言模型在客观精神科能力上仍落后临床医生 37.28 个百分点，其中精神状态评估是关键瓶颈。
tldr: MentalHospital is a virtual evaluation environment for LLM-based psychiatric clinical encounters, incorporating S.O.A.P. workflow with EHR-based standardized patients and a dual-track assessment protocol, showing that even the best LLMs significantly underperform clinicians.
tldr_zh: MentalHospital是一个用于评估基于大语言模型的精神科临床会谈的虚拟评估环境，采用S.O.A.P.工作流程和基于电子健康记录的标准患者，通过双轨评估协议发现即使最强大的大语言模型也显著落后于临床医生。

title: SAGEAgent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Cost-Aware Modality Acquisition in Multimodal Survival Prediction
summary: Does every cancer patient truly need a complete diagnostic workup for accurate survival prediction? In multimodal clinical oncology, diagnostic modalities follow a clinically mandated order of escalating burden -- from demographics collected at intake to genomic profiling requiring specialized tissue analysis. Current multimodal survival methods either assume all modalities are available or passively handle missing data, but none actively reason about whether acquiring the next modality is justified for a given patient along this ordered workflow. We formulate this as a sequential decision problem and propose SAGEAgent (Sequential Acquisition Guided by Experience), a self-evolving LLM-based clinical agent that decides which diagnostic modalities to acquire for each patient, balancing predictive accuracy against clinical invasiveness. SAGEAgent reasons about each patient's evolving diagnostic state through clinical tools that translate numerical predictions into text, an episodic memory that retrieves similar past cases, and a semantic memory that accumulates reusable decision patterns from experience. Experiments on a glioma cohort combining TCGA-LGG, TCGA-GBM, and BraTS with four diagnostic modalities demonstrate that SAGEAgent achieves competitive survival prediction accuracy while reducing average acquisition burden by 55%.
summary_zh: 每一位癌症患者是否真的需要完整的诊断检查才能实现准确的生存预测？在多模态临床肿瘤学中，诊断方式遵循临床规定的递增负担顺序——从入院时收集的人口统计学数据，到需要专门组织分析的基因组检测。当前的多模态生存方法要么假设所有模态均可用，要么被动处理缺失数据，但没有任何方法能主动推理：沿着这一有序工作流程，对于特定患者而言，获取下一模态是否合理。我们将此问题形式化为一个序贯决策问题，并提出SAGEAgent（经验引导的序贯获取智能体），一种基于大语言模型的自我进化临床智能体，它能决定为每位患者获取哪些诊断模态，在预测准确性与临床侵入性之间取得平衡。SAGEAgent通过以下方式推理每位患者不断演变的诊断状态：将数值预测转化为文本的临床工具、检索相似既往病例的情节记忆，以及从经验中积累可复用决策模式的语义记忆。在结合TCGA-LGG、TCGA-GBM和BraTS四个诊断模态的胶质瘤队列上的实验表明，SAGEAgent在实现具有竞争力的生存预测准确性的同时，将平均获取负担降低了55%。
tldr: SAGEAgent is a self-evolving LLM-based clinical agent that sequentially decides which diagnostic modalities to acquire for each cancer patient, balancing predictive accuracy against clinical invasiveness, achieving a 55% reduction in acquisition burden on a glioma cohort.
tldr_zh: SAGEAgent是一个基于LLM的自我进化临床代理，它依次决定每位癌症患者应获取哪些诊断模态，在预测准确性与临床侵入性之间取得平衡，在胶质瘤队列上实现了55%的获取负担降低。

title: Deceptive Grounding: Entity Attribution Failure in Clinical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation evaluation checks whether model claims are factually grounded in retrieved documents. It does not check whether retrieved evidence is attributed to the correct entity.
  A clinical RAG response can pass every automated check (zero hallucinations, near-perfect faithfulness, real citations) while presenting drug Y's clinical evidence as evidence about queried drug X. We term this deceptive grounding (DG): a failure invisible to faithfulness, hallucination, and citation checks because every claim is sourced from a real document, about the wrong entity.
  Using a controlled factorial benchmark across 13 models, we find DG rates spanning 8-87% at peak adversarial conditions. Medical and biomedical fine-tuned models reach up to 86.7%; domain specialization amplifies the failure rather than mitigating it.
  A controlled ablation identifies the mechanism: removing entity-specific clinical evidence from retrieved documents eliminates entity-attribution failure entirely, shifting all failures to confabulation. The two failure modes respond to the same trigger, taking different paths.
  Production measurement across 740 drug-disease pairs finds 7.8% overall DG in a deployed RAG system, rising to 13.6% for recently approved drugs. Entity-attribution verification (checking that cited evidence applies to the queried entity) detects DG at 97.0% precision and 98.7% DG recall (IPW-adjusted human gold standard); no existing framework implements it.
summary_zh:
检索增强生成评估仅检查模型声明是否在事实上基于检索到的文档，并不检查检索到的证据是否归因于正确的实体。  
临床RAG响应可以通过所有自动化检查（零幻觉、近乎完美的忠实性、真实引用），同时将药物Y的临床证据呈现为针对查询药物X的证据。我们将此称为欺骗性基础（DG）：一种对忠实性、幻觉和引用检查均不可见的失败，因为每个声明均源自真实文档，但针对的是错误实体。
