通过使用13个模型的控制因子基准测试，我们发现DG率在极端对抗条件下介于8%至87%之间。医学和生物医学微调模型的DG率最高达86.7%；领域专业化不仅未缓解失败，反而加剧了失败。  
控制消融实验揭示了其机制：从检索到的文档中移除特定实体的临床证据完全消除了实体归因失败，将所有失败转变为虚谈。两种失败模式对同一触发因素作出响应，但路径不同。  
在740个药物-疾病对的生产环境测量中，一个已部署的RAG系统总体DG率为7.8%，而针对近期获批药物的DG率升至13.6%。实体归因验证（检查所引用的证据是否适用于查询实体）以97.0%的精确率和98.7%的DG召回率（经IPW调整的人工金标准）检测出DG；现有框架均未实现该验证。
tldr: This paper identifies a new failure mode in clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) called deceptive grounding, where model outputs cite correct evidence but for the wrong entity. It demonstrates high failure rates across models, especially in domain-fine-tuned ones, and proposes an entity-attribution verification method that achieves high precision and recall.
tldr_zh: 本文识别了临床检索增强生成（RAG）中的一种新的失败模式——欺骗性基础（deceptive grounding），即模型输出引用正确证据但指向错误实体。研究展示了高失败率（尤其是领域微调模型），并提出了一种实体归因验证方法，实现了高精度和召回率。

title: Vascular Geometry Characterization for AI-Based Endovascular Navigation
summary: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is a time-critical intervention for acute ischemic stroke; however, access remains limited due to a shortage of neuroradiologists and specialized centers. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers potential to automate endovascular navigation and improve accessibility, yet current models lack standardized frameworks to assess navigation difficulty for model training and evaluation. This study aims to identify vascular metrics associated with navigation difficulty and to develop an automated pipeline for quantitative vascular feature extraction, enabling future complexity grading. Vascular trees were segmented from computed tomography angiograms from 61 patients, and vascular metrics including aortic arch type, presence of bovine arch, vessel length, tortuosity, take-off angle, number of reverse curves, were measured using a custom pipeline. A Soft Actor-Critic RL algorithm was used for 120 s autonomous navigation. Outcomes were analyzed using both mixed effects linear and logistic regression. On the left side, the presence of a bovine arch and aortic arch type II/III increased navigation time by 30.19 s and 37.92 s, respectively, while greater tortuosity (\b{eta} = 118.20) further prolonged the procedure and reduced success probability. On the right side, type II/III arches extended procedure time by 45.94 s, while each additional reverse curve was associated with 3.96 s longer navigation time and lower probability of success. These findings demonstrate for the first time that MT agent navigation difficulty is strongly influenced by vascular geometry. The proposed automated pipeline enables objective and quantitative characterization of vascular features, providing a foundation for future development of standardized complexity grading and RL model evaluation, without aiming to demonstrate clinically generalizable autonomous navigation.
summary_zh: 机械血栓切除术（MT）是急性缺血性卒中的时间关键型干预措施；然而，由于神经放射科医生和专科中心的短缺，其可及性仍然受限。强化学习（RL）有望实现血管内导航的自动化并提升可及性，但现有模型缺乏用于模型训练和评估导航难度的标准化框架。本研究旨在识别与导航难度相关的血管度量指标，并开发一种用于定量血管特征提取的自动化流程，为未来复杂程度分级奠定基础。从61例患者的计算机断层扫描血管造影中分割出血管树，并使用定制流程测量了包括主动脉弓类型、牛型主动脉弓存在与否、血管长度、迂曲度、起始角度、反向弯曲数量在内的血管度量指标。采用Soft Actor-Critic RL算法进行120秒自主导航。使用混合效应线性回归和逻辑回归分析结果。在左侧，牛型主动脉弓和II/III型主动脉弓分别使导航时间增加30.19秒和37.92秒，而更大的迂曲度（β=118.20）进一步延长了操作时间并降低了成功概率。在右侧，II/III型弓使操作时间延长45.94秒，而每增加一个反向弯曲与导航时间延长3.96秒及成功概率降低相关。这些发现首次证明，MT代理导航难度受血管几何形态的强烈影响。所提出的自动化流程能够客观定量地表征血管特征，为未来标准化复杂程度分级和RL模型评估的发展奠定基础，但并非旨在证明临床可推广的自主导航。
tldr: This paper identifies vascular geometry metrics (e.g., aortic arch type, tortuosity) that influence the difficulty of reinforcement-learning-based autonomous endovascular navigation for mechanical thrombectomy, and proposes an automated pipeline for quantitative feature extraction to enable future complexity grading.
tldr_zh: 本文识别出影响基于强化学习的自主血管内导航难度的血管几何指标（如主动脉弓类型、迂曲度），并提出了一个自动量化特征提取流程，为未来复杂度分级提供基础。

title: A Personalized Computational Framework for Assessing the Sufficiency of Partially Observed Data in Healthcare AI models
summary: Achieving early and timely diagnosis and treatment for disease is a major challenge. Recent applications of machine learning (ML) algorithms trained on patient data have shown promise in many different settings for predicting the patient health state. A challenge often faced when applying these ML algorithms is that at any given time, not all clinical variables (features) needed as input to perform prediction tasks are available. We define the concept of full-feature-capacity (FFC) to refer to prediction performance when such algorithms make use of all features on which they were trained. We then introduce Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA) - an analysis for determining whether a subset of all clinical features needed by an AI model is sufficient to achieve FFC. FSA estimates the underlying distributions of missing variables conditioned on features that are available. FSA provides a patient-specific assessment of whether the existing set of measured features achieves FFC. If yes, then there is no need to acquire further inputs and a ML-based prediction. We provide two case studies: prediction of need for postoperative prolonged ventilation in patients recovering from heart surgery; 10-year mortality prediction in an outpatient cohort. We also demonstrate that FSA also provides a clinically interpretable feature-ranking methodology based on prediction sufficiency, identifies intrinsically hard-to-predict patient populations, and has the potential to perform cost-aware optimization for clinical data acquisition. FSA provides a generic computational approach for determining whether incomplete clinical information is sufficient to support trustworthy AI-assisted clinical decision-making, thereby facilitating the prospective deployment of healthcare AI systems across diverse clinical settings.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
实现疾病的早期及时诊断与治疗是一项重大挑战。近期，基于患者数据训练的机器学习算法在多个场景中展现出预测患者健康状态的潜力。应用这些机器学习算法时常面临的一个问题是：在任意给定时间点，并非所有用于执行预测任务所需的临床变量（特征）都具备可用性。我们将此类算法利用其训练时所有特征所达到的预测性能定义为“全特征容量”（FFC）。进而引入“特征充分性分析”（FSA）——一种用于判定人工智能模型所需全部临床特征中的某个子集是否足以实现FFC的分析方法。FSA基于可用特征估计缺失变量的潜在分布，并提供针对特定患者的评估，判断现有测量特征集是否达到FFC。若达到，则无需获取更多输入即可进行基于机器学习的预测。我们提供了两个案例研究：预测心脏手术患者术后是否需要长期通气支持；以及在外周门诊队列中预测10年死亡率。我们还证明，FSA提供了一种基于预测充分性且具有临床可解释性的特征排序方法，能够识别内在难以预测的患者群体，并具有对临床数据采集进行成本感知优化的潜力。FSA提供了一种通用计算方法，用于判定不完整的临床信息是否足以支持可信赖的AI辅助临床决策，从而促进医疗AI系统在不同临床场景中的前瞻性部署。
tldr: This paper introduces Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA), a computational framework to determine whether a subset of available clinical features is sufficient to achieve prediction performance equivalent to using all features, enabling earlier and more efficient AI-based clinical decision-making when data is partially observed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了特征充分性分析（FSA），这是一种计算框架，用于判断可用临床特征的子集是否足以达到使用所有特征时的预测性能，从而在数据部分缺失的情况下实现更早、更高效的基于AI的临床决策。

title: Decoupling Language Guidance from Backbones for Text-Guided Medical Segmentation
summary: Text-guided medical image segmentation leverages clinical semantics to improve lesion delineation, yet many existing models bind cross-modal fusion, supervision, and decoder design into a task-specific architecture. Such tight coupling makes it difficult to reuse language guidance modules across heterogeneous vision and text backbones, and often requires redesigning the network when the encoder pair changes. This paper presents BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. BTHA is built around a stable feature-level interface: given multi-scale visual features and a text representation, it injects semantic guidance through shape-preserving adapters while maintaining the decoder-side tensor contract. To make this interface effective, we introduce a Hierarchical Coarse-to-Fine Supervision Strategy that decomposes learning into global image-text alignment, multi-scale auxiliary localization, and boundary-aware final mask refinement. We further design a Scale-Adaptive Gated Semantic Guidance (SAGSG) adapter, where resolution-specific gates adaptively control textual injection and channel recalibration suppresses redundant cross-modal responses. Evaluations across diverse vision and text backbones show that the same adapter and supervision design remains effective across convolutional and transformer-based visual encoders as well as different language encoders. Experiments on four public datasets further demonstrate that BTHA improves strong text-guided baselines with modest computational overhead.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
文本引导的医学图像分割利用临床语义改善病灶勾勒，然而现有许多模型将跨模态融合、监督机制与解码器设计绑定为特定任务架构。这种紧耦合方式使得语言引导模块难以在不同视觉与文本骨干网络间复用，且编码器对更换时常需重新设计网络。本文提出BTHA——一种面向文本引导医学图像分割的骨干可迁移分层适配器框架。BTHA以稳定的特征级接口为核心：给定多尺度视觉特征与文本表征，通过保持形状的适配器注入语义引导，同时维持解码端张量结构。为使该接口有效，我们引入分层由粗到细监督策略，将学习分解为全局图像-文本对齐、多尺度辅助定位以及边界感知最终掩膜精炼。进一步设计了尺度自适应门控语义引导（SAGSG）适配器，其中分辨率特异性门控自适应控制文本注入，通道重校准抑制冗余跨模态响应。跨多种视觉与文本骨干网络的评估表明，相同适配器与监督设计在基于卷积与Transformer的视觉编码器以及不同语言编码器上均保持有效性。在四个公开数据集上的实验进一步证明，BTHA以适度计算开销提升了强文本引导基线方法。
tldr: This paper introduces BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation that decouples language guidance from specific vision and text backbones, enabling reusable cross-modal fusion across diverse encoder pairs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了BTHA，一种用于文本引导的医学图像分割的骨干可迁移分层适配器框架，将语言指导与特定的视觉和文本骨干解耦，使得跨模态融合能够在不同编码器对之间复用。

title: From Classification to Localization and Clinical Validation: Large-Scale Development of a Deep Learning System for Thoracic Disease Detection on Chest Radiographs in Thailand
summary: Chest radiography (CXR) remains the most widely used thoracic imaging modality, yet expert interpretation is constrained by a severe shortage of radiologists in Thailand and across Southeast Asia. Local adaptation of deep learning models to Thai data has been shown to substantially improve accuracy on Thai populations. Here we present the development and comprehensive validation of the chest radiograph analysis model in Inspectra CXR version 5, a deep learning system that performs multi-label thoracic disease classification and weakly supervised lesion localization within a single model. The architecture couples a DenseNet-121 backbone with Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) and a Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) aggregation layer, producing a per-condition classification score and heatmap simultaneously. The model was developed on 874,858 frontal chest radiographs with paired radiologist reports from Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok. On a held-out, radiologist-verified in-domain test set of 19,871 cases, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.994 (mean sensitivity 92.4%, specificity 98.6%) across nine clinically important conditions. On an independent generalization set of 5,992 cases from 13 hospitals across Thailand, the mean AUROC was 0.970, indicating robust transfer across sites. For localization, evaluated on 4,549 radiologist-annotated cases, the model attained a mean lesion-localization fraction (LLF) of 77.9% at 0.59 non-lesion localizations per image. In a usability evaluation with five thoracic radiologists, the system reached a classification concordance of 93.6%, a localization concordance of 94.7%, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 89. These results indicate that a locally developed, localization-capable CXR system can deliver high accuracy, generalize across heterogeneous Thai hospitals, and earn the trust of practicing radiologists.
summary_zh: 胸部X线摄影（CXR）仍是最广泛使用的胸部影像学检查手段，然而在泰国及整个东南亚地区，放射科医生的严重短缺制约了专家判读能力。将深度学习模型本地化适配泰国数据已被证明能显著提升其在泰国人群中的准确性。本文介绍Inspectora CXR 5.0版胸部X线分析模型的开发与综合验证——该深度学习系统可在单一模型中实现多标签胸部疾病分类与弱监督病灶定位。其架构将DenseNet-121骨干网络与注意力比较模块（ACM）及概率类激活图（PCAM）聚合层相结合，同时输出每种病变的分类评分与热力图。模型基于曼谷Siriraj医院的874,858张正面胸部X线影像及配对放射科医生报告开发。在由19,871例病例组成的保留放射科医生验证域内测试集上，其对九种临床重要病变的平均AUROC达0.994（平均敏感度92.4%，特异度98.6%）。在来自泰国13家医院的5,992例独立泛化测试集中，平均AUROC为0.970，表明跨机构迁移稳健性。定位性能方面，在4,549例经放射科医生标注的病例上评估，模型在每幅图像0.59个非病灶定位点的条件下，平均病灶定位分数（LLF）达77.9%。在五名胸部放射科医生参与的可操作性评估中，系统分类一致率达93.6%，定位一致率达94.7%，系统可用性量表（SUS）平均得分为89分。上述结果表明，本地开发的具备病灶定位能力的CXR系统可实现高精度、在泰国不同医院间泛化，并赢得执业放射科医生的信任。
tldr: This paper presents a deep learning system (Inspectra CXR v5) for thoracic disease classification and lesion localization on chest radiographs, developed on a large Thai hospital dataset and validated across multiple sites, achieving high accuracy and usability scores.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种深度学习系统（Inspectra CXR v5），用于胸片上的胸部疾病分类和病灶定位，基于泰国一家医院的大规模数据集开发，并在多个地点验证，取得了高准确率和可用性评分。

title: Super-Generalist: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate Medical Image Understanding via Generalist-Specialist Synergy
summary: Medical images require comprehensive and accurate interpretation to support the diagnosis of diverse clincial conditions. Recent vision-language generalist models offer broad task coverage and promising zero-shot capabilities, yet often lack fine-grained anatomical and lesion awareness for reliable diagnosis and spatial interpretability. In contrast, supervised specialist models achieve strong performance on specific tasks but typically lack generalization across diseases and anatomies. In this work, we present SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist objectives, enabling both broad generalization and specialist-level diagnostic capability. We perform specialist-enhanced vision-language alignment in SuG by incorporating spatial priors from multiple segmentation experts, including anatomy, class-specific lesion and class-agnostic lesion segmentors that captures lesions beyond anatomies annotated during training. To improve lesion grounding capability, we leverage lesion masks as spatial priors to calibrate text-conditioned visual attention, encouraging disease-related semantics to focus on clinically relevant regions. We evaluate SuG on extensive chest and abdominal CT benchmarks, including CT-RATE, Merlin, MedVL-CT69K, and several in-house tumor datasets. SuG achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of disease diagnosis tasks and surpasses specialist models on several critical tumor diagnosis benchmarks. Furthermore, SuG demonstrates strong lesion grounding capability, including robust generalization to lesion types lacking class-specific supervision.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学图像需要全面而准确的解读，以支持多种临床状况的诊断。现有的视觉-语言通才模型虽然覆盖广泛任务并具备有前景的零样本能力，但往往缺乏细粒度的解剖和病灶感知能力，难以实现可靠诊断与空间可解释性。相比之下，有监督的专家模型在特定任务上表现优异，但通常缺乏跨疾病和解剖部位的泛化能力。在本研究中，我们提出了SuG，一个超通才框架，它将通才型的视觉-语言学习与专家目标相统一，同时实现了广泛的泛化能力与专家级别的诊断性能。我们在SuG中通过引入来自多个分割专家的空间先验，实现了专家增强的视觉-语言对齐，这些专家包括解剖分割器、类别特异性病灶分割器以及类别无关的病灶分割器，后者能够捕捉训练中标注解剖结构之外的病灶。为了提升病灶定位能力，我们利用病灶掩膜作为空间先验来校准文本驱动的视觉注意力，促使与疾病相关的语义聚焦于临床相关区域。我们在多个胸部与腹部CT基准数据集上评估了SuG，包括CT-RATE、Merlin、MedVL-CT69K以及若干内部肿瘤数据集。SuG在广泛的疾病诊断任务中达到了最先进的性能，并在多个关键肿瘤诊断基准上超越了专家模型。此外，SuG展现出强大的病灶定位能力，包括对缺乏类别特异性监督的病灶类型的鲁棒泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist segmentation objectives for comprehensive and accurate medical image understanding, achieving state-of-the-art performance on chest and abdominal CT benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SuG，一个超级通才框架，将通才视觉-语言学习与专家分割目标统一起来，实现全面准确的医学图像理解，在胸部及腹部CT基准测试上达到了最先进性能。

title: ShapKO: Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout for Robust Multimodal Learning
summary: Multimodal medical models often degrade when inputs are missing, a common scenario in real-world clinical workflows. Separately, even when all modalities are present, modality dominance is observed during training, where optimization over-relies on a highly predictive modality and undertrains complementary sources, resulting in poor robustness under partial availability. While training-time modality knockout improves missing-modality robustness, existing approaches use static masking rates that cannot adapt to evolving modality utility during training. We introduce ShapKO (Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout), a dynamic training strategy that learns modality-specific knockout probabilities based on validation utility. ShapKO periodically evaluates performance across modality subsets, estimates modality importance via Shapley values, and updates masking probabilities to suppress dominant modalities more frequently. This adaptive process promotes complementary representations, while requiring no architectural modifications. We evaluate ShapKO on three datasets covering multitask clinical classification, survival prediction, and cancer detection. ShapKO consistently improves performance under modality absence and yields interpretable trajectories of learned masking behavior. Code is available at: https://github.com/sumona00/ShapKO
summary_zh: 多模态医疗模型在输入缺失时性能往往会下降，而这在真实临床工作流中是一种常见情况。此外，即使所有模态都存在，训练过程中也会观察到模态主导现象——优化过程过度依赖某一高预测性模态，而忽略了对互补模态的训练，导致模型在部分模态可用时鲁棒性较差。尽管在训练时进行模态剔除可以提高对缺失模态的鲁棒性，但现有方法使用固定的遮蔽率，无法在训练过程中适应模态效用的动态变化。我们提出ShapKO（基于Shapley的自适应模态剔除），一种动态训练策略，能够根据验证集效用学习模态特定的剔除概率。ShapKO周期性地评估各模态子集的性能，通过Shapley值估计模态重要性，并更新遮蔽概率以更频繁地抑制主导模态。这一自适应过程促进了互补表征的学习，且无需修改模型架构。我们在三个数据集上评估了ShapKO，涵盖多任务临床分类、生存预测和癌症检测。ShapKO在模态缺失情况下持续提升了性能，并生成了可解释的遮蔽行为学习轨迹。代码获取地址：https://github.com/sumona00/ShapKO
tldr: ShapKO introduces a dynamic training strategy that uses Shapley values to adaptively adjust modality knockout probabilities, improving robustness of multimodal medical models when modalities are missing.
tldr_zh: ShapKO提出了一种动态训练策略，利用Shapley值自适应调整模态淘汰概率，提高多模态医学模型在模态缺失时的鲁棒性。

title: Information-seeking failures of large language models in agentic clinical reasoning
summary: Large language models achieve high scores on medical knowledge assessments, yet clinical reasoning requires actively deciding what to investigate under uncertainty. We developed an agentic evaluation framework in hematologic oncology in which models must proactively request clinical data across three sequential rounds before committing to a diagnosis and treatment plan. Across 32 frontier models, the best achieved only 68% overall accuracy. Information utilization, the fraction of available data actually requested, was the strongest predictor of diagnostic accuracy (R = 0.69, P < 0.001), yet utilization collapsed from 57% to 26% in the final round, leaving molecular and cytogenetic data critical for treatment selection unexamined. Reasoning traces scored high on a clinical reasoning rubric (91% above threshold) but decorrelated from accuracy, revealing a gap between locally coherent rationales and globally correct conclusions. Error analysis identified search satisficing, anchoring and premature closure as the dominant failure modes, the same cognitive biases that characterize novice clinicians under dual-process models of diagnostic reasoning. These findings demonstrate that the primary limitation of current models in clinical oncology is not insufficient medical knowledge but a systematic failure of information-seeking under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型在医学知识评估中取得高分，但临床推理需要在不确定性下主动决定应调查哪些信息。我们开发了一个血液肿瘤学的代理评估框架，模型必须在连续三轮中主动请求临床数据，然后才做出诊断和治疗计划。在32个前沿模型中，表现最佳的模型总体准确率仅为68%。信息利用率，即实际请求的可用数据比例，是诊断准确性的最强预测因子（R=0.69，P<0.001），但该利用率在最后一轮从57%骤降至26%，导致对治疗选择至关重要的分子和细胞遗传学数据未被检查。推理轨迹在临床推理评分表上得分较高（91%高于阈值），但与准确性不相关，揭示了局部连贯的理据与全局正确结论之间的差距。错误分析发现搜索满意化、锚定和过早闭合是主要的失败模式，这些正是双过程模型下新手临床医生诊断推理中典型的认知偏差。这些发现表明，当前模型在临床肿瘤学中的主要限制并非医学知识不足，而是在不确定性下系统性信息寻求的失败。
tldr: This paper evaluates LLMs on agentic clinical reasoning in hematologic oncology, finding that models fail to proactively seek critical information (e.g., molecular/cytogenetic data) under uncertainty, with cognitive biases like anchoring and premature closure being the dominant failure modes.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了大语言模型在血液肿瘤学中的主动临床推理能力，发现模型在不确定情况下未能主动寻求关键信息（如分子/细胞遗传学数据），主要失败模式为认知偏差（如锚定和过早闭合）。

title: Faithful by Design: Evaluating and Improving LLM-Generated Clinical Trial Summaries for Multi-Stakeholder Audiences
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to summarize clinical trial results for healthcare providers, patients, and payers, but their tendency to hallucinate poses significant risks in this high-stakes context. This study introduces a benchmark evaluation framework for measuring the faithfulness of LLM-generated clinical trial summaries across three stakeholder audiences. The framework consists of 200 stratified trials drawn from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov database, evaluated using audience-specific prompt templates and a six-dimension faithfulness annotation schema. Baseline measurements were established for GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash across 1,800 generated summaries scored using a cross-encoder natural language inference (NLI) model. Unsupported Claims was identified as the dominant failure mode across all three models, with a mean annotation score of 1.55 out of three. A knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval system was developed and evaluated against the baseline, producing statistically significant improvements in NLI-based faithfulness scores (entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001). Improvement pathways were model-dependent, with GPT-4o improving primarily through contradiction reduction while Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Flash improved through increased entailment.
summary_zh:
摘要：
大语言模型越来越多地被用于为医疗提供者、患者和支付方总结临床试验结果，但在此高风险场景中，其产生幻觉的倾向构成了重大风险。本研究引入了一个基准评估框架，用于衡量大语言模型生成的临床试验摘要针对三类利益相关方受众的忠实度。该框架包含从ClinicalTrials.gov聚合分析数据库中提取的200项分层试验，采用针对特定受众的提示模板和六维度忠实度标注方案进行评估。针对GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 2.5 Flash在1800份生成的摘要上建立了基线测量结果，这些摘要使用交叉编码器自然语言推理（NLI）模型进行评分。在所有三个模型中，“无依据陈述”被确定为主要的失效模式，其平均标注得分为1.55分（满分3分）。本研究开发了一个知识图谱增强检索系统并与基线进行对比评估，该系统在基于NLI的忠实度评分上产生了统计学显著改善（蕴含+0.0125，忠实度+0.0130，p < 0.0001）。改进路径因模型而异：GPT-4o主要通过减少矛盾来提升，而Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 2.5 Flash则通过增加蕴含来提升。
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate faithfulness of LLM-generated clinical trial summaries for different audiences, identifies unsupported claims as a major failure, and proposes a knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval system that improves faithfulness scores.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个基准测试，用于评估LLM生成的临床试验摘要对不同受众的忠实度，发现未支持的声明是主要失败模式，并提出了一个知识图谱增强的检索系统，可改善忠实度评分。

title: Policy-Driven CT-Agent: Modeling Phase-Aware Diagnostic Control for Clinically Consistent CT Reasoning
summary: Computed Tomography (CT) diagnosis often relies on dynamic selection of imaging phases, such as non-contrast, arterial, or venous phases, based on preliminary findings, clinical suspicion, and diagnostic guidelines. This phase-wise decision process is critical for reducing unnecessary radiation exposure while supporting timely staging and treatment planning. However, phase-selection protocols can vary across hospitals, regions, and guidelines, while most existing CT-based AI methods assume that all phases are available and focus on static tasks under a fixed imaging phase, failing to model whether additional phases are required. This limitation stems from heterogeneous multi-phase representations, the need for knowledge-guided phase control beyond visual cues, and the lack of supervision for phase-sufficiency decisions in existing datasets. To address these challenges, we propose Policy-Driven CT-Agent (PD-CTAgent) for clinically consistent CT phase selection and diagnostic reasoning. PD-CTAgent introduces a Clinical Structure Abstraction Module (CSAM) to harmonize heterogeneous CT phases into a unified, phase-aware evidence representation. Based on this representation, a Knowledge-Guided Diagnostic Control Model (KDCM) evaluates phase sufficiency and iteratively requests additional phases when necessary. The policy-driven agent design further allows PD-CTAgent to flexibly follow different institutional, regional, or guideline-specific diagnostic protocols. Together, PD-CTAgent bridges static CT analysis and real-world clinical workflows. Experiments on two public datasets, LIDC and MCT-LTDiag, and one private dataset demonstrate its effectiveness and clinical consistency. Code will be made public upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 摘要：计算机断层扫描（CT）诊断通常依赖于根据初步发现、临床怀疑和诊断指南动态选择成像期相，如平扫期、动脉期或静脉期。这种分阶段的决策过程对于减少不必要的辐射暴露，同时支持及时的分期和治疗规划至关重要。然而，不同医院、地区及指南的期相选择方案可能存在差异，而现有大多数基于CT的AI方法假设所有期相均可用，并专注于固定成像期相下的静态任务，未能建模是否需要额外期相。这一局限性源于异质的多期相表示、需要超越视觉线索的知识引导期相控制，以及现有数据集中缺乏对期相充分性决策的监督。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了策略驱动型CT智能体（Policy-Driven CT-Agent, PD-CTAgent），用于实现临床一致的CT期相选择与诊断推理。PD-CTAgent引入了临床结构抽象模块（CSAM），将异质的CT期相统一为一致的、感知期相的证据表示。基于该表示，知识引导的诊断控制模型（KDCM）评估期相充分性，并在必要时迭代请求额外期相。策略驱动的智能体设计进一步使PD-CTAgent能够灵活遵循不同机构、地区或指南特定的诊断方案。综上，PD-CTAgent弥合了静态CT分析与真实临床工作流程之间的差距。在LIDC、MCT-LTDiag两个公开数据集及一个私有数据集上的实验证明了其有效性和临床一致性。代码将在录用后公开。
tldr: This paper proposes PD-CTAgent, a policy-driven agent for CT diagnosis that models phase-aware diagnostic control, using a clinical structure abstraction module and knowledge-guided control to dynamically select imaging phases, improving clinical consistency and reducing radiation exposure.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PD-CTAgent，一种用于CT诊断的策略驱动智能体，通过临床结构抽象模块和知识引导控制动态选择成像期相，提高临床一致性并减少辐射暴露。

title: Projection-Domain Sensitivity Analysis of Vertebral DRRs Under Intrinsic Calibration Perturbation
summary:
Accurate geometric calibration is essential for fluoroscopy-guided spinal imaging, digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) generation, and 2D--3D vertebral registration. Although calibration quality is typically evaluated using reconstruction-based metrics such as reprojection error, its influence on projection-domain consistency remains poorly understood. This study presents a synthetic framework for evaluating how intrinsic calibration perturbations affect vertebral fluoroscopic projections and downstream registration performance.
  CT-derived vertebral models and controlled cone-beam imaging geometry were used to generate DRRs with both ground-truth and perturbed intrinsic calibration parameters while maintaining identical anatomy and acquisition pose. Projection-domain changes were quantified using anatomical landmark displacement, contour distance, silhouette overlap, image similarity, and landmark-based 2D--3D registration accuracy in anterior--posterior (AP) and lateral (LAT) views.
  Results show that even small intrinsic calibration perturbations produce measurable changes in vertebral projection geometry, contour morphology, landmark localization, and DRR appearance. Sensitivity is strongly view dependent, with LAT projections exhibiting substantially greater deformation and anatomical displacement than AP projections. These projection inconsistencies also degrade downstream 2D--3D registration, particularly rotational alignment accuracy.
  The findings demonstrate that projection-domain consistency complements conventional reconstruction-based calibration metrics and provides a practical framework for assessing calibration robustness. This approach may improve the reliability of DRR generation and fluoroscopy-guided vertebral registration in image-guided spinal applications.
summary_zh:
准确的几何校准对于荧光透视引导的脊柱成像、数字重建放射影像（DRR）生成以及二维-三维椎骨配准至关重要。尽管校准质量通常通过基于重建的指标（如重投影误差）来评估，但其对投影域一致性的影响仍知之甚少。本研究提出一个合成框架，用于评估内参校准扰动如何影响椎骨荧光透视投影及下游配准性能。

采用CT衍生的椎骨模型和受控的锥束成像几何，在保持相同解剖结构和采集姿态的同时，使用真实内参参数和受扰动的内参参数生成DRR。通过前后位（AP）和侧位（LAT）视图的解剖标志点位移、轮廓距离、轮廓重叠、图像相似度以及基于标志点的二维-三维配准精度，量化投影域的变化。

结果表明，即使微小的内参校准扰动也会导致椎骨投影几何、轮廓形态、标志点定位及DRR外观产生可测量的变化。敏感性强烈依赖于视图方向，LAT投影相较于AP投影表现出明显更大的形变和解剖位移。这些投影不一致性还会降低下游二维-三维配准性能，尤其是旋转对齐精度。

研究结果证明，投影域一致性补充了传统的基于重建的校准指标，并为评估校准鲁棒性提供了实用框架。该方法可提高图像引导脊柱应用中DRR生成和荧光透视引导椎骨配准的可靠性。
tldr: This paper presents a synthetic framework to evaluate how intrinsic calibration perturbations affect vertebral fluoroscopic projections and downstream 2D-3D registration, showing view-dependent sensitivity and that projection-domain consistency complements conventional calibration metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个合成框架，评估内参校准扰动如何影响椎骨荧光透视投影及下游的二维-三维配准，结果表明灵敏度与视角相关，且投影域一致性可补充传统校准指标。

title: RED-Sphere: Hyperspherical Residual Edge Debiasing for Cross-Population Fundus Disease Domain Generalization
summary: Medical image classifiers are often trained within one source population, yet clinical deployment requires robustness to patients whose appearance, acquisition style, and disease prevalence differ from the source cohort. Existing fairness and robustness methods often require group supervision or treat appearance variation as an undifferentiated nuisance, which is insufficient when population-correlated low-level cues and lesion evidence share edge and texture structure. We study a strict source-only cross-population setting, where external populations are unseen during optimization, validation, scheduling, hyperparameter and model selection. We propose RED-Sphere, a plug-and-play robustness framework for image classification under unseen population shifts. It estimates shortcut-sensitive nuisance responses with an edge and feature energy prior, attenuates dominant responses through residual soft gating, regularizes masked nuisance views with counterfactual-inspired consistency and separation losses, and predicts labels with normalized spherical prototypes. It favours angular semantic evidence over source-correlated activation magnitude while preserving lesion structure. Although demonstrated on 2D Scanning Laser Ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus classification for Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) and Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), RED-Sphere is not tied to retinal anatomy: the same principle can be adapted with modality-specific nuisance priors wherever appearance shortcuts and semantic evidence are entangled. Under a strict White-only Harvard-FairVision protocol, RED-Sphere improves held-out macro-F1 across all 20 task and backbone comparisons, with average gains of 1.28 and 2.98 F1 points on AMD and DR. Gains in AUC and PR-AUC, visual diagnostics, ablations, and sensitivity analyses further support stronger external semantic alignment and more stable angular disease geometry.
summary_zh:
摘要：
医学图像分类器通常仅在单一源人群上进行训练，但临床部署要求对患者群体在外观、采集方式和疾病流行率方面与源队列存在差异时仍保持鲁棒性。现有的公平性和鲁棒性方法往往需要群体监督，或将外观变异视为无差异的干扰因素，但在人群相关的低级线索与病灶证据共享边缘和纹理结构时，这些方法存在不足。我们研究了一种严格的“仅源域”跨人群设置——在优化、验证、调度、超参数及模型选择过程中，外部人群均不可见。我们提出RED-Sphere，一种面向未见人群偏移下图像分类的即插即用鲁棒性框架。该框架利用边缘与特征能量先验估计捷径敏感的干扰响应，通过残差软门控衰减主导响应，借助反事实启发的一致性与分离损失对掩码后的干扰视图进行正则化，并利用归一化球形原型进行标签预测。该方法在保留病灶结构的同时，更倾向于角度语义证据而非源域相关的激活强度。虽然该方法在年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）和糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）的二维扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）眼底分类任务中得到验证，但RED-Sphere并不局限于视网膜解剖结构：只要外观捷径与语义证据相互纠缠，同一原理即可通过适配模态特定的干扰先验进行推广。在严格的仅白人哈佛-FairVision协议下，RED-Sphere在所有20项任务及骨干网络对比中提升了留出集宏F1分数，在AMD和DR上分别获得平均1.28和2.98个F1点的提升。AUC与PR-AUC的增益、可视化诊断、消融实验及敏感性分析进一步支持了更强的外部语义对齐性和更稳定的角度疾病几何结构。
tldr: RED-Sphere is a plug-and-play robustness framework for medical image classification under unseen population shifts, using edge and feature energy priors and normalized spherical prototypes to mitigate shortcut learning, demonstrated on fundus disease classification for AMD and DR.
tldr_zh: RED-Sphere是一个即插即用的鲁棒性框架，用于在未见人群偏移下的医学图像分类，利用边缘和特征能量先验以及归一化球面原型来减轻捷径学习，在年龄相关性黄斑变性和糖尿病视网膜病变的眼底疾病分类中进行了验证。

title: CR-Solver: GPU-Accelerated Kinematics Solver for Tendon-driven Continuum Robots
summary: Continuum robots provide intrinsic compliance, high dexterity, and safe physical interaction, enabling navigation and manipulation in confined and unstructured environments. Despite recent advances in sensing and control, heightening the need for precise motion generation, most widely used planning libraries are grounded in rigid-body assumptions, creating a critical gap for fast and practical tools for continuum robots. To address this, we present CR-Solver, a two-stage, optimization-based solver for the motion generation of tendon-driven continuum robots. Our method unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning within a single constrained nonlinear optimization framework. Leveraging GPU-accelerated parallel optimization, CR-Solver delivers fast, accurate, and constraint-aware solutions. We validate our approach on three tasks, demonstrating significant speedups over traditional CPU-based solvers while achieving a consistently high success rate above 95% and millimeter-level accuracy. The solver is implemented in pure Python, reducing the barrier to adoption and offering a practical, extensible foundation for continuum robots' high-performance motion planning.
summary_zh: 连续体机器人具有内在柔顺性、高灵巧性和安全的物理交互能力，能够在受限和非结构化环境中进行导航与操作。尽管近年来传感与控制技术取得了进展，日益需要精确的运动生成，但大多数广泛使用的规划库仍基于刚体假设，这为连续体机器人快速实用的工具开发造成了关键空白。为此，我们提出CR-Solver——一种基于优化的两阶段求解器，用于腱驱动连续体机器人的运动生成。该方法将逆运动学、路径跟踪和轨迹规划统一在单个约束非线性优化框架内。利用GPU加速的并行优化，CR-Solver能够提供快速、准确且满足约束的求解方案。我们在三项任务上验证了该方法，相比传统基于CPU的求解器实现了显著的加速，同时保持了始终高于95%的成功率和毫米级精度。该求解器采用纯Python实现，降低了应用门槛，为连续体机器人的高性能运动规划提供了一个实用且可扩展的基础。
tldr: CR-Solver is a GPU-accelerated, optimization-based kinematics solver for tendon-driven continuum robots that unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning in pure Python, achieving over 95% success rate and millimeter accuracy with significant speedups over CPU solvers.
tldr_zh: CR-Solver 是一个基于 GPU 加速的优化求解器，专为腱驱动连续体机器人设计，它将逆运动学、路径跟踪和轨迹规划统一在一个纯 Python 框架中，实现了超过 95% 的成功率和毫米级精度，相比传统 CPU 求解器大幅提升了速度。

title: X-GuideAR: An Augmented Reality Framework to Mitigate Radiation Exposure during Fluoroscopic Guidance
summary: Achieving optimal screw placement for orthopedic surgeries requires frequent alignment checks and multiple anatomical views under X-ray -- a process known as "fluoro-hunting" that increases radiation exposure to patients and surgical teams. This work introduces X-GuideAR, an augmented reality (AR) framework for identifying optimal X-ray views, aimed at reducing radiation exposure while ensuring accurate screw placement. To exemplify the benefits of X-GuideAR, we focus on S2 alar-iliac (S2AI) screw placement. Our system provides radiation-free guidance for view acquisition and drilling by generating synthetic X-ray previews that accelerate fluoro-hunting. Once the required anatomical views are identified using these previews, a real X-ray is acquired, and the preview of the drilling trajectory is augmented onto it, facilitating precise screw placement with minimal additional radiation. A preliminary study involving eight S2AI trajectories performed by an expert spine surgeon demonstrated a 62.3% reduction in the number of X-rays. Post-procedure evaluations showed that trajectories done with X-GuideAR supported an average safe screw diameter of 12.95 mm compared to 5.9 mm under the conventional workflow, suggesting improved bony containment and potential biomechanical benefit. X-GuideAR shows great potential to reduce radiation exposure and streamline S2AI screw placement, offering a promising direction toward safer and more efficient surgeries.
summary_zh: 摘要：骨科手术中实现最佳螺钉置入需要频繁的对齐检查和多角度X射线解剖视图——这一过程被称为“透视搜索”，会增加患者和手术团队的辐射暴露。本文介绍了一种名为X-GuideAR的增强现实（AR）框架，用于识别最佳X射线视图，旨在减少辐射暴露的同时确保精确的螺钉置入。为展示X-GuideAR的优势，我们聚焦于S2骶翼-髂骨（S2AI）螺钉置入。该系统通过生成合成X射线预览来加速透视搜索，从而为视图获取和钻孔提供无辐射引导。一旦利用这些预览确定了所需的解剖视图，便会采集真实X射线图像，并将钻孔轨迹的预览叠加到图像上，从而以最少的额外辐射实现精确螺钉置入。一项由一名资深脊柱外科医生实施8个S2AI轨迹的初步研究表明，X射线数量减少了62.3%。术后评估显示，使用X-GuideAR完成的轨迹支持的平均安全螺钉直径为12.95毫米，而传统工作流程下为5.9毫米，表明骨包容性改善并具有潜在的生物力学优势。X-GuideAR在减少辐射暴露和简化S2AI螺钉置入方面展现出巨大潜力，为实现更安全、更高效的手术提供了有前景的方向。
tldr: X-GuideAR uses augmented reality to generate synthetic X-ray previews for S2AI screw placement, reducing radiation exposure by 62.3% while improving screw containment accuracy.
tldr_zh: X-GuideAR利用增强现实生成合成X射线预览，用于S2AI螺钉置入，将辐射暴露减少62.3%，同时提高螺钉的骨内包容精度。

title: Feature-Space Guided Diffusion for Realistic Ultrasound Image Synthesis
summary: Conditional diffusion models can generate anatomically plausible medical ultrasound (US) images, but anatomical plausibility alone does not ensure realistic B-mode appearance. Most US pipelines adapt standard generative architectures and condition them on anatomical masks, or use guidance mechanisms that reinforce the same anatomical signal. However, B-mode US images are shaped by acquisition-dependent properties such as speckle texture, tissue contrast, and attenuation. Using a frozen US foundation model, we show that standard conditional diffusion baselines remain separated from real images in representation space. In this work, we propose Feature-Space Candidate Guidance (FSCG), a training-free sampling strategy to reduce this gap. At sampling time, FSCG applies local k-NN feature correction and selects the best of multiple stochastic candidates according to their feature-space energy. In this way, the mask defines the anatomy, while FSCG steers samples toward the real US domain. Across three different datasets, FSCG reduces average FID64 by 56\%, FID192 by 57\%, and nearest-neighbour feature distance by 47\% over standard conditional diffusion sampling, outperforming alternative inference-time guidance baselines. The results suggest that domain-aware feature representations can reveal and reduce realism gaps in medical diffusion synthesis without retraining the generator. Our code is available at https://github.com/marinadominguez/FSCG.
summary_zh: 条件扩散模型能够生成解剖学上合理的医学超声图像，但仅解剖合理性不足以保证真实的B型超声表现。大多数超声生成流程采用标准生成架构，并以解剖掩膜为条件，或使用强化相同解剖信号的引导机制。然而，B型超声图像受到采集相关特性的影响，如散斑纹理、组织对比度和衰减。利用冻结的超声基础模型，我们表明标准条件扩散基线在表征空间中仍与实际图像存在距离。本研究提出特征空间候选引导（FSCG），这是一种无需训练的采样策略，旨在缩小这一差距。在采样时，FSCG应用局部k近邻特征校正，并根据特征空间能量从多个随机候选中选出最优者。如此，掩膜定义了解剖结构，而FSCG将样本引导至真实的超声域。在三个不同数据集上，与标准条件扩散采样相比，FSCG使平均FID64降低56%，FID192降低57%，最近邻特征距离降低47%，表现优于其他推理时引导基线。结果表明，领域感知的特征表示能够揭示并减少医学扩散合成中的真实感差距，而无需重新训练生成器。我们的代码见https://github.com/marinadominguez/FSCG。
tldr: This paper introduces Feature-Space Candidate Guidance (FSCG), a training-free sampling strategy that uses a frozen ultrasound foundation model to reduce the realism gap between generated and real ultrasound images, achieving significant improvements in FID and feature distance across three datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了特征空间候选引导（FSCG），一种无需重新训练的采样策略，利用冻结的超声基础模型缩小生成图像与真实超声图像之间的真实感差距，在三个数据集上显著降低了FID和特征距离。

title: Multi-Catheter Digitization in Brachytherapy via Few-Shot Synthetic-to-Real Learning and Structure-Aware Tracking
summary: Accurate catheter digitization in CT-guided interstitial brachytherapy is a critical but time-consuming task, especially for complex implant configurations. We developed a data-efficient, physics-guided framework for automated multi-catheter digitization with minimal clinical annotation. The pipeline consists of two stages. First, an implant region-aware network was pretrained on synthetic CT volumes with simulated metallic signatures and then fine-tuned using only 10 clinical cases. Second, a structure-aware reconstruction module combined a direction-constrained 3D Hough transform with synchronous physics-constrained inward tracking to separate adherent catheter trajectories. The method was evaluated by patient-level five-fold cross-validation on 203 treatment fractions from 38 patients. The fine-tuned network achieved an HD95 of 0.853 +/- 0.362 mm. End-to-end evaluation yielded an F1 score of 0.891 +/- 0.178, with shaft and tip errors of 0.334 +/- 0.367 mm and 0.896 +/- 0.680 mm, respectively. In cases with severe catheter adhesion, the tracking F1 score remained 0.843 +/- 0.190. The complete workflow required approximately 11.6 s per case. These results indicate that combining few-shot synthetic-to-real learning with physics-guided structural tracking can provide robust and efficient multi-catheter digitization for time-sensitive clinical workflows.
summary_zh: 在CT引导下的组织间近距离治疗中，准确的导管数字化是一项关键但耗时的任务，尤其对于复杂植入构型。我们开发了一种数据高效、物理引导的框架，用于在最少临床标注下实现自动化多导管数字化。该流程包含两个阶段：首先，一个植入区域感知网络在带有模拟金属伪影特征的合成CT体积上预训练，然后仅使用10个临床病例进行微调。其次，一个结构感知重建模块将方向约束的三维霍夫变换与同步物理约束的内向追踪相结合，以分离粘连的导管轨迹。该方法通过来自38名患者的203个治疗分次进行患者级五折交叉验证评估。微调网络的HD95达到0.853±0.362 mm。端到端评估的F1分数为0.891±0.178，导管体和尖端误差分别为0.334±0.367 mm和0.896±0.680 mm。在导管严重粘连的情况下，追踪F1分数仍保持在0.843±0.190。完整工作流程每例耗时约11.6秒。这些结果表明，将小样本合成到真实学习与物理引导的结构追踪相结合，能够为时间敏感的临床工作流程提供稳健高效的多导管数字化。
tldr: A two-stage framework for automated multi-catheter digitization in CT-guided brachytherapy, using few-shot synthetic-to-real learning (pretrained on synthetic CT, fine-tuned on 10 clinical cases) and physics-constrained tracking to separate adherent catheters, achieving high accuracy and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 一种用于CT引导下插植近距离治疗中多导管自动数字化的两阶段框架，采用少样本合成到真实学习（在合成CT上预训练，在10例临床病例上微调）和物理约束跟踪来分离粘连导管，实现了高精度和高效率。

title: A Compact Top-Loading Robot for Endovascular Interventions: Design, Control and Evaluation
summary: Robot-assisted endovascular intervention can potentially reduce radiation exposure, improve surgeon ergonomics, enable telesurgery, support active assistance and autonomy, and enhance procedural precision. However, existing systems often suffer from limited procedural coverage because constrained patient-side setups, restricted flexibility, and complex instrument exchange hinder clinical workflow integration. This work presents a compact robotic system for endovascular interventions that enables continuous translational and rotational manipulation of standard endovascular instruments. The system consists of two alternating carts with pneumatically actuated membrane grippers integrated into rotating gripper gears. Its top-loading design allows rapid exchange of instruments such as guidewires and catheters without changing the robotic setup. A leader-follower control strategy enables continuous motion despite the finite stroke of each cart. The system was evaluated in motion-tracking experiments with guidewires and catheters and in an in vitro vascular phantom. The motion-tracking experiments showed generally smooth translational and rotational motion profiles. Across all tested guidewire and catheter experiments, the mean relative tracking errors were 3.6% for translational motion and 4.1% for rotational motion. In the vascular phantom, robot-assisted navigation reached the target in most trials, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed manipulation concept under in vitro conditions. The presented robotic system demonstrates technical feasibility for continuous manipulation of standard endovascular instruments in bench-top and in vitro experiments. The compact top-loading design may ease instrument exchange and clinical workflow integration. Future work will focus on improving gripping performance, actuation speed, force feedback, and evaluation in more clinically realistic settings.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
机器人辅助血管内介入治疗有望减少辐射暴露、改善外科医生人体工学、实现远程手术、提供主动辅助与自主功能，并提升操作精度。然而，现有系统常因患者端布局受限、灵活性不足以及器械交换复杂而难以覆盖全部手术流程，阻碍了临床工作流的整合。本文提出了一种用于血管内介入治疗的紧凑型机器人系统，能够实现对标准血管内器械的连续平移与旋转操作。该系统由两个交替移动的推车组成，集成有气动膜片夹具，并安装于旋转夹具齿轮上。其顶部装载设计允许快速更换导丝、导管等器械，无需调整机器人设置。通过主从控制策略，即便每个推车行程有限，仍能实现连续运动。该系统在导丝与导管的运动跟踪实验以及体外血管模型上进行了评估。运动跟踪实验显示出总体平滑的平移与旋转运动曲线。在所有测试的导丝与导管实验中，平移运动的平均相对跟踪误差为3.6%，旋转运动为4.1%。在血管模型中，机器人辅助导航在多数试验中成功到达目标，验证了所提出的操控概念在体外条件下的可行性。本机器人系统在台架与体外实验中展现了操控标准血管内器械进行连续运动的技术可行性。其紧凑的顶部装载设计可能有助于简化器械交换与临床工作流整合。未来工作将聚焦于改进抓取性能、驱动速度、力反馈，并在更接近临床实际的环境中进行评估。
tldr: This paper presents a compact top-loading robotic system for endovascular interventions that uses two alternating carts with pneumatic grippers for continuous instrument manipulation, and evaluates it in motion-tracking and in vitro phantom experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种紧凑型顶部装载式血管介入机器人系统，利用两个交替推车和气动夹持器实现连续器械操作，并在运动追踪和体外模型实验中进行了评估。

title: NVAITC AI Scientist: A Governed End-to-End Research System -- A Hypertension GWAS Case Study
summary: Agentic research systems are emerging as a new paradigm for coordinating scientific workflows beyond isolated model inference, code generation, or statistical analysis. However, deployment in institutional biomedical environments requires governed mechanisms for research planning, data access, workflow orchestration, evidence tracking, reproducibility, and human oversight. We present NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS), a governed end-to-end agentic research system designed to support domain-general scientific workflows while keeping protected data within institutional privacy boundaries. NAIS integrates proposal review, execution planning, governed computational routing, reproducible workflow orchestration, evidence generation, and scientist-in-the-loop oversight. We validate NAIS in a real-world hypertension genome-wide association study (GWAS) using hospital-linked genotype and electronic health record (EHR) data from 286,422 individuals under an aggregate-only data policy. The agent planned cohort extraction, orchestrated GWAS execution, generated quality-control summaries, and drafted publication-oriented outputs. Human-AI review identified phenotype discrepancies and enabled iterative refinement of the hypertension definition. After reconciliation, the agent-orchestrated GWAS reproduced established hypertension loci, including FGF5, ATP2B1, CNNM2, FTO, and GRB14, with the strongest signal at FGF5 reaching $-\log_{10}(p) \sim 70$. As a secondary demonstration, NAIS also supported a drug-induced liver injury prediction workflow, achieving a multimodal graph neural network AUC of 0.842. These results demonstrate that governed agentic research systems can support scalable AI-assisted biomedical discovery while producing outputs comparable to expert-led workflows.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自主研究系统正作为一种新范式出现，用于协调超越孤立模型推理、代码生成或统计分析的科学工作流程。然而，在机构生物医学环境中部署此类系统需要具备受治理的机制，以支持研究规划、数据访问、工作流编排、证据追踪、可重复性及人工监督。我们提出NVAITC AI科学家（NAIS），这是一个受治理的端到端自主研究系统，旨在支持通用科学工作流，同时将受保护数据保留在机构隐私边界内。NAIS集成了提案评审、执行规划、受治理的计算路由、可重复工作流编排、证据生成以及科学家参与式监督。我们在一个真实的高血压全基因组关联分析（GWAS）中验证了NAIS，该分析使用了与医院关联的基因型及电子健康记录（EHR）数据，涵盖286,422名个体，并遵循仅聚合数据政策。该自主系统规划了队列提取、编排GWAS执行、生成质量控制摘要，并起草了面向发表的结果。人机联合评审识别了表型不一致之处，并实现了对高血压定义的迭代优化。经调和后，自主系统编排的GWAS复现了已知的高血压相关基因座，包括FGF5、ATP2B1、CNNM2、FTO和GRB14，其中FGF5的最强信号达到$-\log_{10}(p) \sim 70$。作为二次展示，NAIS还支持了一项药物性肝损伤预测工作流，实现了多模态图神经网络AUC为0.842。这些结果表明，受治理的自主研究系统能够支持可扩展的AI辅助生物医学发现，同时产出与专家主导工作流相当的结果。
tldr: This paper presents NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS), a governed end-to-end agentic research system that coordinates scientific workflows (proposal review, execution, evidence tracking) with human oversight, demonstrated on a hypertension GWAS using hospital data and a drug-induced liver injury prediction task.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了NVAITC AI Scientist (NAIS)，一个受管控的端到端代理研究系统，可协调科学工作流（提案审核、执行、证据追踪）并加入人类监督，通过高血压GWAS（利用医院数据）和药物性肝损伤预测任务进行了验证。

title: FlowPET: Physics-Informed Symplectic Flow Matching for Low-Count PET Reconstruction
summary: Low-count Positron Emission Tomography (PET) reconstruction is severely hindered by the dissipative nature of prevailing generative models, where the inherent phase-space contraction leads to the numerical extinction (``wash-out'') of weak but diagnostically critical lesion signals. To overcome this geometric limitation, we propose \textbf{FlowPET}, a physics-informed framework that reformulates reconstruction as volume-preserving transport in a symplectic phase space. By parameterizing the posterior dynamics via a Separable Hamiltonian System, our approach guarantees a divergence-free vector field by construction, theoretically immunizing weak signals against probability mass collapse. To steer this conservative flow, we introduce conjugate boundary conditions based on the Range-Null space decomposition of the PET operator; this strictly enforces data consistency in the range space while confining stochastic uncertainty injection to the unobserved null space. We train the model via symplectic flow matching and perform inference using a symplectic leapfrog integrator. Extensive experiments on BrainWeb, clinical pediatric, and UDPET datasets demonstrate that \textbf{FlowPET} not only surpasses state-of-the-art deterministic and stochastic baselines in SSIM and PSNR but, more crucially, exhibits superior recovery of low-contrast lesions. The results confirm that imposing Hamiltonian structural constraints offers a robust geometric safeguard for medical inverse problems in high-noise regimes.
summary_zh: 低计数正电子发射断层扫描（PET）重建受到当前主流生成模型耗散特性的严重制约，其固有的相空间收缩导致微弱但具有诊断关键意义的病灶信号出现数值性消失（“冲刷”）。为克服这一几何局限性，我们提出**FlowPET**——一种基于物理信息的框架，将重建问题重新表述为辛相空间中的体积保持输运。通过利用可分离哈密顿系统对后验动力学进行参数化，我们的方法从构造上保证了无散向量场，理论上使弱信号免受概率质量坍缩的影响。为引导这一保守流，我们基于PET算子的值域-零空间分解引入共轭边界条件；这在值空间内严格强制数据一致性，同时将随机不确定性注入限制在未观测的零空间中。我们通过辛流匹配训练模型，并利用辛跳点积分器进行推理。在BrainWeb、临床儿科及UDPET数据集上的大量实验表明，**FlowPET**不仅在SSIM和PSNR上超越了最先进的确定性和随机基线方法，更重要的是，它在低对比度病灶的恢复上展现出卓越性能。结果证明，施加哈密顿结构约束为高噪声环境下的医学逆问题提供了稳健的几何保障。
tldr: FlowPET proposes a physics-informed symplectic flow matching framework for low-count PET reconstruction that enforces volume-preserving transport via Hamiltonian dynamics, preventing loss of weak lesion signals and achieving superior reconstruction quality.
tldr_zh: FlowPET 提出了一种基于物理信息的辛流形匹配框架用于低计数 PET 重建，通过哈密顿动力学保证体积守恒传输，防止弱病变信号丢失，并实现了更优的重建质量。

title: LaGuadia: Language-Guided Adaptive Distillation from Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology Foundation Models (PFMs) offer powerful Whole Slide Image (WSI) representations but suffer from massive computational costs. While Knowledge Distillation (KD) can create efficient student models, existing multi-teacher methods often use suboptimal uniform weighting that ignores tissue heterogeneity. We propose LaGuadia (Language-Guided Adaptive DistillAtion), a framework that develops a compact pathology image encoder by dynamically integrating expertise from multiple PFMs under clinical linguistic guidance. Our approach utilizes a multi-stage pipeline: first, extracting visually observable clinical keywords from pathology reports; second, aligning visual features with these keywords via a Vision-Language meta-teacher (MedSigLIP) to provide dense semantic guidance; and finally, performing adaptive KD where teacher contributions are weighted based on their semantic alignment with the clinical narrative. Experiments on WSI captioning, visual question answering, and slide-level classification tasks demonstrate that an 87M parameter LaGuadia student model matches or exceeds foundation-scale models such as GigaPath and UNI, achieving strong factual consistency and robust generalization. These results highlight clinical language as an effective semantic anchor for building efficient and reliable digital pathology systems. Code is available at https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia.
summary_zh: 病理基础模型（PFMs）提供了强大的全切片图像（WSI）表示，但面临巨大的计算成本。虽然知识蒸馏（KD）可以创建高效的学生模型，但现有的多教师方法通常使用次优的均匀加权，忽略了组织异质性。我们提出LaGuadia（语言引导的自适应蒸馏），一个通过动态整合多个病理基础模型在临床语言指导下的专业知识来开发紧凑的病理图像编码器的框架。我们的方法采用多阶段流水线：首先，从病理报告中提取视觉上可观察的临床关键词；其次，通过视觉-语言元教师（MedSigLIP）将视觉特征与这些关键词对齐，以提供密集的语义指导；最后，执行自适应蒸馏，其中教师贡献基于它们与临床叙述的语义对齐程度进行加权。在全切片图像字幕生成、视觉问答和切片级分类任务上的实验表明，一个87M参数的LaGuadia学生模型匹配或超越了基础规模的模型如GigaPath和UNI，实现了强事实一致性和稳健的泛化能力。这些结果突显了临床语言作为构建高效可靠数字病理系统的有效语义锚点。代码可在 https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia 获取。
tldr: LaGuadia uses language-guided adaptive knowledge distillation to create a compact pathology image encoder that matches large foundation models, leveraging clinical keywords and vision-language alignment for efficient WSI analysis.
tldr_zh: LaGuadia 利用语言引导的自适应知识蒸馏，创建了一个紧凑的病理图像编码器，其性能可与大型基础模型媲美，通过临床关键词和视觉-语言对齐实现高效的WSI分析。

title: Vectorial driving of multistable materials: singularities, pt-graphs, and non-generic paths
summary: Describing and predicting the response of multistable materials to external driving is central to memory formation, programmable metamaterials, soft robotics, and in-materia computing. While scalar driving is captured by transition graphs (t-graphs), vectorial driving produces path-dependent responses that require the recently introduced path-transition graphs (pt-graphs). In both cases, transitions are governed by singularities in the energy landscape: for scalar driving these correspond to saddle-node bifurcations, but for vectorial driving, higher-order singularities become important. Combining experiments on chain-like metamaterials with a minimal spring model, we investigate how higher-order singularities shape pt-graphs and the resulting path-dependent responses. We moreover discuss the role of non-generic driving paths through higher-order singularities, where the response is governed by spontaneous symmetry breaking. Finally, we demonstrate how t-graphs emerge as the one-dimensional limit of pt-graphs, unifying scalar and vectorial driving within a common graph-based framework. These results establish a singularity-based approach to path-dependent responses and provide a foundation for designing multistable materials with programmable sequential functionality for smart sensing, soft robotics, and in-materia computation.
summary_zh: 描述和预测多稳态材料对外部驱动的响应是记忆形成、可编程超材料、软体机器人以及材料内计算的核心问题。标量驱动可通过跃迁图（t-graphs）进行描述，而矢量驱动则会产生路径依赖的响应，需要用到近期提出的路径跃迁图（pt-graphs）。在这两种情况下，跃迁由能量景观中的奇点控制：对于标量驱动，这些奇点对应于鞍结分岔；但对于矢量驱动，高阶奇点变得重要。通过将链状超材料的实验与最小弹簧模型相结合，我们研究了高阶奇点如何塑造pt-graphs以及由此产生的路径依赖响应。此外，我们讨论了通过高阶奇点的非通用驱动路径的作用，此时响应由自发对称破缺控制。最后，我们展示了t-graphs如何作为pt-graphs的一维极限涌现，从而在统一的基于图的框架下统一标量驱动和矢量驱动。这些结果建立了一种基于奇点的路径依赖响应方法，并为设计具有可编程顺序功能的多稳态材料提供了基础，这些材料可用于智能传感、软体机器人和材料内计算。
tldr: This paper extends the concept of transition graphs for scalar driving to path-transition graphs (pt-graphs) for vectorial driving of multistable materials, revealing how higher-order singularities govern path-dependent responses and unifying both frameworks.
tldr_zh: 本文将为标量驱动开发的转移图（t-graphs）概念扩展到多稳态材料的矢量驱动，引入了路径-转移图（pt-graphs），揭示了高阶奇点如何控制路径依赖响应，并统一了两种框架。

title: Streamlining stereo differentiable rendering for marker-free real-time tracking of surgical robots
summary: Purpose: Marker-based tracking of surgical robots is occlusion-prone in cluttered operating rooms. We evaluate stereo differentiable rendering for marker-free, real-time robot pose tracking, potentially improving safety, reducing setup time, and enabling multi-robot interaction. Methods: We extend the markerless pose estimation framework roboreg to online dynamic tracking via (i) sequential optimisation that propagates pose estimates across frames with motion-adaptive hyperparameter tuning, and (ii) CUDA stream parallelisation of segmentation and optimisation, combined with CUDA-graph accelerated segmentation. We evaluate on 38 unobstructed and 5 occluded displacement sequences with static start/end ground-truth calibrations and dynamic marker-based reference tracking. Results: We achieve real-time 1080p tracking at 30 fps (up from 14 fps for vanilla roboreg), matching the camera frame rate. Accuracy reaches 1.7 cm / 0.6 deg against static ground truth and 1.2 cm mean 3D error over 27,460 frames against the marker-based reference (1.53 cm over 1,242 occluded frames). Our method outperforms FoundationPose by 11% in dynamic estimation (63% under occlusion) and 250% in static estimation, with 6x faster inference. Conclusions: Stereo differentiable rendering enables real-time, high-resolution marker-free surgical robot tracking, on par with marker-based approaches and surpassing foundation-model baselines.
summary_zh:
摘要  
目的：在杂乱的手术室环境中，基于标记的外科机器人追踪容易受到遮挡影响。本文评估了立体可微分渲染在无标记、实时机器人位姿追踪中的性能，有望提升安全性、减少设置时间，并支持多机器人交互。  
方法：我们基于无标记位姿估计框架 roboreg 扩展至在线动态追踪，采用以下两项改进：(i) 顺序优化——通过运动自适应超参数调整跨帧传播位姿估计值；(ii) CUDA 流并行化处理分割与优化，并结合 CUDA 图加速分割。我们在 38 个无遮挡序列和 5 个遮挡位移序列上进行评估，采用静态起点/终点真实值标定以及基于标记的动态参考追踪。  
结果：我们实现了 30 帧/秒（较原版 roboreg 的 14 帧/秒提升）的实时 1080p 追踪，与相机帧率一致。静态真实值对比下的精度达到 1.7 cm / 0.6°；在 27,460 帧上与基于标记的参考对比，平均 3D 误差为 1.2 cm（其中 1,242 帧遮挡场景下为 1.53 cm）。我们的方法在动态估计中优于 FoundationPose 11%（遮挡场景下为 63%），在静态估计中优于 250%，且推理速度提升 6 倍。  
结论：立体可微分渲染实现了实时、高分辨率、无标记的外科机器人追踪，性能与基于标记的方法相当，并超越了基础模型基线。
tldr: This paper extends a markerless pose estimation framework for surgical robots to achieve real-time, high-resolution tracking using stereo differentiable rendering, outperforming marker-based methods and foundation models at 30 fps with improved accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文通过立体可微渲染技术，将无标记姿态估计框架扩展到手术机器人的实时高分辨率跟踪，以30 fps的速度实现优于有标记方法和基础模型的精度。

title: ExtraGS: Enhancing Endoscopic View Extrapolation via Diffusion-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (MIS) critically depends on reliable endoscopic perception for navigation and safety. However, conventional endoscopes provide only a limited field of view, leaving large portions of the surrounding anatomy unobserved. Recent neural rendering approaches, such as Neural Radiance Fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting, enable novel view synthesis from endoscopic videos, but their reliance on sparse observations often leads to severe artifacts when extrapolating beyond the training trajectory. In this work, we propose ExtraGS, a framework for enhancing endoscopic view extrapolation through diffusion-guided 3D Gaussian Splatting. Starting from an initial reconstruction, we introduce an uncertainty-guided virtual camera sampling strategy to actively explore blind spots and maximize information gain. The rendered views from these sampled locations are refined using a diffusion model to recover plausible anatomical structures, producing pseudo-observations that guide further optimization. To prevent the generated content from degrading reliable regions, we adopt a confidence-weighted fine-tuning strategy when incorporating these pseudo-observations. Extensive experiments on multiple public endoscopic datasets demonstrate that ExtraGS significantly reduces extrapolation artifacts and achieves state-of-the-art performance in endoscopic novel view synthesis.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助微创手术（MIS）的导航与安全性高度依赖于可靠的內镜感知。然而，传统内窥镜仅提供有限的视野，导致周围解剖结构的大部分区域未被观测。近期神经渲染方法（如神经辐射场和3D高斯泼溅）可从内窥镜视频中合成新视角，但这类方法依赖于稀疏观测，在泛化至训练轨迹以外的视角时往往产生严重伪影。本文提出ExtraGS——一种通过扩散引导的3D高斯泼溅增强内窥镜视角外推的框架。从初始重建出发，我们引入不确定性引导的虚拟相机采样策略，以主动探索盲区并最大化信息增益。利用扩散模型对采样位置的渲染视图进行优化，以恢复合理的解剖结构，生成引导进一步优化的伪观测。为防止生成内容退化可靠区域，我们在融入这些伪观测时采用置信度加权微调策略。在多个公开内窥镜数据集上的大量实验表明，ExtraGS显著减少了外推伪影，并在内窥镜新视角合成中实现最先进性能。
tldr: ExtraGS enhances endoscopic view extrapolation by combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with diffusion model refinement, using uncertainty-guided virtual camera sampling and confidence-weighted fine-tuning to reduce artifacts in unseen regions.
tldr_zh: ExtraGS通过结合3D高斯泼溅与扩散模型精化，利用不确定性引导的虚拟相机采样和置信度加权微调，减少内窥镜视野外推中的伪影。

title: MAGE: Color-Invariant and Spatial Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Neoplasm Classification
summary: Accurate differentiation between gastric adenoma and carcinoma during endoscopy is critical for clinical decision-making. Yet, this task is highly challenging due to high inter-class similarity and ambiguous boundaries between the two classes. Existing ROI-based classification methods often suffer from detection/segmentation error propagation and loss of surrounding global context. In contrast, full-image classification lacks the necessary spatial focus. Furthermore, we observe that deep neural networks gravitate towards domain-specific texture biases(e.g. bleeding, lighting artifacts), often causing models to predict based on spurious correlations instead of intrinsic morphological features. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework, Masked Achromatic Guidance Expert (MAGE). During training, we introduce an auxiliary local expert branch trained on masked achromatic views of the neoplasm. By suppressing background context and color, this branch is forced to learn highly discriminative, purely structural features. We then employ a dual-objective distillation strategy, transferring both classification logits and spatial attention maps to provide implicit spatial supervision to the main branch that receives full WLI as input. This dual-objective distillation forces the model to ground its predictions in morphology rather than relying on shortcuts, while still retaining clinically relevant color cues. At inference time, our deployable model operates on images without annotated masks, ensuring real-time deployability . Extensive experiments on a clinical gastric endoscopy dataset show that our method significantly outperforms existing detection-based methodologies (e.g. YOLO) and classification-based methodologies (e.g. Swin-Transformer), providing not only superior classification performance but also interpretable attention maps for clinical reliability.
summary_zh: 在内镜检查中准确区分胃腺瘤与胃癌对于临床决策至关重要。然而，由于两类病变间的高度类间相似性和模糊的边界，这一任务极具挑战性。现有的基于感兴趣区域（ROI）的分类方法常面临检测/分割误差传播及周围全局上下文丢失的问题。相比之下，全图像分类缺乏必要的空间聚焦。此外，我们观察到深度神经网络倾向于关注特定领域的纹理偏差（如出血、光照伪影），常导致模型基于虚假相关性而非内在形态特征进行预测。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种新颖框架——掩膜消色引导专家（MAGE）。在训练阶段，我们引入一个辅助局部专家分支，该分支在肿瘤的掩膜消色视图上进行训练。通过抑制背景上下文和颜色，该分支被迫学习高度判别性的纯结构特征。随后，我们采用双目标蒸馏策略，同时转移分类逻辑值和空间注意力图，为接收全白光内镜（WLI）输入的主分支提供隐式空间监督。这种双目标蒸馏迫使模型基于形态学而非捷径进行预测，同时保留临床相关的颜色线索。在推理时，我们的可部署模型直接处理无标注掩膜的图像，确保实时部署能力。在临床胃镜数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有基于检测的方法（如YOLO）和基于分类的方法（如Swin-Transformer），不仅提供了卓越的分类性能，还为临床可靠性提供了可解释的注意力图。
tldr: A framework using masked achromatic views and dual-objective distillation to improve gastric neoplasm classification from endoscopy images, achieving better performance and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 一个利用掩膜消色视图和双目标蒸馏的框架，用于改善内窥镜图像中胃肿瘤的分类，实现更优性能和可解释性。

title: Seeing Globally, Refining Locally: Global Visual Guidance and Local Ultrasound Cues for Robust Freehand 3-D Ultrasound Reconstruction
summary: Freehand 3-D ultrasound (US) imaging has attracted increasing attention owing to its intuitive volumetric visualization, ease of use, and low cost. However, accurate 3-D reconstruction critically depends on stable probe pose estimation, yet existing trackerless methods remain susceptible to accumulated pose errors, particularly over long scanning trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose a global-to-local pose estimation framework that exploits external camera observations for globally stable localization and B-mode US images for anatomy-aware local refinement. Specifically, the framework comprises a dual-camera branch that performs contextual feature aggregation across camera views and temporal observations to estimate a globally consistent probe trajectory, and a B-mode branch that performs anatomical feature aggregation from sequential US images to capture tissue-dependent local motion cues. A cross-modal fusion module subsequently integrates the contextual camera features and anatomical US features to predict pose residuals and refine the camera-derived estimates in the transformation space. Furthermore, a multi-scale pose loss constrains relative motion over multiple temporal horizons to suppress accumulated drift during extended scans. The proposed framework is validated on phantom and in vivo datasets. On two in-house datasets (FUSION-J and FUSION-L) collected using different machines, the proposed US + Dual-Cam model reduces average trajectory drift to 1.67 mm and 1.29 mm, representing improvement of 16.50% and 27.12%, respectively, over a strong dual-camera baseline, while substantially outperforming US-only pose estimation (>13 mm drift). In in vivo forearm arteries reconstruction, it achieves Hausdorff distances of 1.58 mm, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method on real clinical scenarios.
summary_zh: 自由手三维超声成像因其直观的容积可视化、易用性和低成本而受到越来越多的关注。然而，精确的三维重建关键依赖于稳定的探头位姿估计，现有无跟踪器方法仍易受累积位姿误差的影响，尤其是在长扫描轨迹中。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种全局到局部的位姿估计框架，该框架利用外部相机观测实现全局稳定的定位，并利用B模式超声图像实现解剖感知的局部细化。具体而言，该框架包含一个双目摄像头分支，通过跨相机视角和时间观测进行上下文特征聚合，以估计全局一致的探头轨迹；以及一个B模式分支，从连续超声图像中聚合解剖特征，以捕捉组织依赖的局部运动线索。随后，一个跨模态融合模块整合上下文相机特征和解剖超声特征，在变换空间中预测位姿残差并细化相机估计结果。此外，多尺度位姿损失在多个时间跨度上约束相对运动，以抑制长时间扫描中的累积漂移。所提框架在体模和活体数据集上进行了验证。在使用不同设备采集的两个内部数据集（FUSION-J和FUSION-L）上，所提出的超声+双目摄像头模型将平均轨迹漂移降低至1.67 mm和1.29 mm，相较于强双摄像头基线分别提升了16.50%和27.12%，同时显著优于仅使用超声的位姿估计（漂移>13 mm）。在活体前臂动脉重建中，该方法实现了1.58 mm的豪斯多夫距离，证明了所提方法在真实临床场景中的有效性。
tldr: A global-to-local pose estimation framework for freehand 3D ultrasound reconstruction that combines external camera observations for global stability and B-mode ultrasound images for local refinement, achieving substantial drift reduction on phantom and in vivo datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出一种全局到局部位姿估计框架，用于自由手3D超声重建，结合外部相机观测实现全局稳定性和B模式超声图像实现局部细化，在体模和体内数据集上显著减少了漂移。

title: Evidence-Grounded AI for Musculoskeletal Care
summary: Musculoskeletal diseases are among the leading causes of disability worldwide and create the greatest global need for rehabilitation. Because recovery, remodelling and degeneration often unfold over months to years, musculoskeletal care requires longitudinal management that repeatedly integrates evolving patient evidence, external medical knowledge and stage-specific functional goals. In routine practice, this evidence is fragmented across visits, departments and hospital systems, limiting individualized, evidence-based care. Here we report OrthoPilot, a clinical artificial intelligence system powered by a large language model that integrates hospital data streams with authoritative external knowledge for continuous musculoskeletal management. OrthoPilot autonomously retrieves real-time imaging, laboratory, pathology and order data and converts evolving patient states into evidence-based decisions from admission diagnosis to rehabilitation planning. We established a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world electronic health records spanning 1,000 disease codes. In a reader study across the complete care pathway, OrthoPilot was compared with 81 orthopaedic physicians and surpassed experts with 25 years of experience in diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making and management planning. It also outperformed all evaluated intelligent systems across 60 external clinical centres. In a prospective study of 1,870 complex cases, OrthoPilot increased full-chain management success by 10.6%. During an 8-month randomised deployment involving 8,240 inpatients, it increased cumulative cases per bed by 9.7% and improved patient-reported access to health information. These results move clinical AI from predicting isolated events toward executing longitudinal management across complete musculoskeletal care pathways.
summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼疾病是全球范围内致残的主要原因之一，也是全球康复需求的最大来源。由于恢复、重塑和退变过程通常持续数月乃至数年，肌肉骨骼诊疗需要纵向管理，反复整合不断变化的患者证据、外部医学知识以及特定阶段的康复目标。在常规实践中，这些证据分散在不同就诊、科室和医院系统之间，限制了个性化、循证医学的实施。本文报告了OrthoPilot——一种基于大语言模型的临床人工智能系统，它整合医院数据流与权威外部知识，实现持续的肌肉骨骼管理。OrthoPilot可自主检索实时影像、实验室、病理和医嘱数据，将从入院诊断到康复规划的动态患者状态转化为循证决策。我们基于覆盖1000种疾病编码的真实世界电子健康记录，构建了一个经专科医生验证的基准数据集。在一项覆盖完整诊疗路径的读者研究中，将OrthoPilot与81名骨科医师进行比较，其在诊断推理、临床决策和管理规划方面超越了具有25年经验的专家。在60个外部临床中心，它同样优于所有接受评估的智能系统。在一项涉及1870例复杂病例的前瞻性研究中，OrthoPilot使全链条管理成功率提升10.6%。在为期8个月、涉及8240名住院患者的随机部署中，它使每床位累计病例数提升9.7%，并改善了患者报告的健康信息获取能力。这些结果将临床人工智能从预测孤立事件推向在完整肌肉骨骼诊疗路径中执行纵向管理。
tldr: OrthoPilot is an LLM-powered clinical AI system that integrates hospital data with external knowledge to manage musculoskeletal care longitudinally, outperforming experienced physicians and increasing management success by 10.6% in prospective studies.
tldr_zh: OrthoPilot 是一个基于大语言模型的临床AI系统，整合医院数据与外部知识对肌肉骨骼疾病进行纵向管理，在研究中超越资深医生，并将全链路管理成功率提升10.6%。

title: Agentic systems for breast cancer treatment recommendations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for clinical decision support, but their reliability in complex oncology treatment planning remains unclear. We evaluated agentic LLM systems for breast cancer treatment recommendation generation using 72 real clinical cases across stages I to IV and 1,147 case-specific rubrics generated through Asymmetric Information Rubric Generation (AIRG), in which the rubric generator had access to real clinical decisions unavailable to the evaluated models. Seven pipelines were compared, including single-LLM baselines, tool-augmented systems, and multi-agent architectures with fact checking and autonomous subagent spawning. The best-performing configuration, Claude Opus 4.8 with the D&C+SA pipeline, achieved a global score of 0.594 $\pm$ 0.025. Tool use and increased agent autonomy had mixed effects, improving performance in some settings but degrading it in others. Performance varied by clinical domain and disease stage, and oncologist-led error analysis revealed persistent clinically relevant failures, including incorrect or missing recommendations, flawed justifications, citation errors, outdated claims, and overconfidence. These findings suggest that agentic LLM systems can generate clinically relevant breast cancer recommendations, but remain insufficient for unsupervised clinical use.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持中的应用日益受到关注，但其在复杂肿瘤治疗规划中的可靠性尚不明确。我们利用72例涵盖I至IV期的真实临床病例，以及通过非对称信息评分标准生成（AIRG）方法构建的1147项病例特异性评分标准，对基于智能体的大语言模型系统在乳腺癌治疗推荐生成中的表现进行了评估。其中，评分标准生成者可获取被评估模型无法获得的真实临床决策。研究比较了七种管道，包括单大语言模型基线、工具增强系统，以及具备事实核查与自主子智能体生成功能的多智能体架构。性能最佳的配置——采用D&C+SA管道的Claude Opus 4.8——实现了0.594 ± 0.025的全局得分。工具使用与智能体自主性提升产生了混合效应：在某些场景下改善性能，但在其他场景下则导致性能下降。性能因临床领域和疾病分期而异，而肿瘤学家主导的误差分析揭示了持续存在的临床相关缺陷，包括推荐内容错误或遗漏、论证依据有缺陷、引用错误、过时断言以及过度自信。这些发现表明，基于智能体的大语言模型系统能够生成具有临床相关性的乳腺癌治疗推荐，但仍不足以用于无监督的临床实践。
tldr: Evaluates agentic LLM systems for breast cancer treatment recommendations using 72 real clinical cases and a novel rubric generation method (AIRG), finding that the best pipeline achieves a global score of 0.594 but remains unreliable for unsupervised clinical use due to persistent errors.
tldr_zh: 评估了基于智能体的大语言模型系统在乳腺癌治疗推荐中的应用，使用72个真实临床案例和一种新的评分生成方法（AIRG），发现最佳管线得分为0.594，但由于持续存在的错误，仍不适合无监督的临床使用。

title: Medical Image Segmentation based on Deep Active Contour and Mean Curvature Loss Function
summary: Medical image segmentation is a crucial task in the field of clinical analysis and applications. Though deep learning techniques recently play a crucial role in several scenarios, the training at the individual pixel level leads to a lack of geometric prior information. Scholars proposed to integrate the Chan-Vese model into the loss function for training which can take into account the region and length of the region inside and outside the segmentation process and then improve the performance in medical image segmentation. However, these methods still lack an effective characterization of the segmented region. To overcome this problem, we introduce the mean curvature as a geometric natural constraint and propose a Deep Active Contour and Mean Curvature (DACMC) loss function where the convolution kernel is used to approximate the mean curvature to save computational cost. We have validated the performance of our method on the liver and spleen dataset. Our proposed method demonstrates new state-of-the-art performance on several segmentation datasets.
summary_zh: 医学图像分割是临床分析及应用领域中的一项关键任务。尽管深度学习技术近期在多种场景中发挥了重要作用，但基于单个像素级别的训练导致其缺乏几何先验信息。学者们提出将Chan-Vese模型融入损失函数进行训练，从而在分割过程中兼顾区域内部与外部的面积及长度，进而提升医学图像分割的性能。然而，这些方法仍缺乏对分割区域的有效表征。为解决这一问题，我们引入平均曲率作为几何自然约束，并提出一种深度主动轮廓与平均曲率（DACMC）损失函数，其中利用卷积核近似计算平均曲率以节省计算成本。我们在肝脏和脾脏数据集上验证了该方法的性能。我们的方法在多个分割数据集上展现了新的最优性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel loss function incorporating mean curvature as a geometric constraint for deep active contour-based medical image segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results on liver and spleen datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合平均曲率作为几何约束的深度主动轮廓损失函数，用于医学图像分割，在肝脏和脾脏数据集上取得了最新最优结果。

title: UniMedSeg: Unified In-Context Learning for Multi-Paradigm 2D/3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation foundation models are expected to generalize across diverse clinical scenarios, yet existing universal methods remain fragmented by prompt paradigms and spatial dimensions. Visual in-context learning, interactive segmentation, and language-guided segmentation are typically handled by paradigm-specific models, while 2D and 3D images are also modeled separately. Such isolation prevents heterogeneous annotations and data from being jointly absorbed by a single scalable model and limits cross-paradigm knowledge transfer. To address this bottleneck, we propose UniMedSeg, a Transformer-centric universal segmentation framework that maps visual examples, geometric interactions, language instructions, and 2D/3D images into a shared sequence space, enabling heterogeneous medical supervision to be jointly learned through a unified in-context interface without prompt- or dimension-specific branches. To overcome the long-sequence memory bottleneck caused by visual contexts, we introduce Decoupled Split Attention, which reduces attention complexity to linear while preserving hardware-friendly computation and focused context-target interaction. Extensively trained and evaluated on a large corpus curated from 27 public datasets, UniMedSeg achieves state-of-the-art performance across visual in-context, interactive, and language-guided segmentation without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization on diverse held-out tasks. The code and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/Lii1228/UniMedSeg
summary_zh: 医学图像分割基础模型预期能够泛化至多样的临床场景，然而现有的通用方法仍受提示范式与空间维度的碎片化制约。视觉上下文学习、交互式分割与语言引导分割通常由特定范式的模型处理，而2D与3D图像也被分别建模。这种隔离导致异构标注与数据无法被单一可扩展模型联合吸收，并限制了跨范式的知识迁移。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出UniMedSeg——一个以Transformer为核心的通用分割框架，将视觉示例、几何交互、语言指令以及2D/3D图像映射至共享的序列空间，使得异构的医学监督信号能够通过统一的上下文接口被联合学习，无需针对提示或维度的分支。为克服视觉上下文带来的长序列内存瓶颈，我们引入解耦分离注意力机制，将注意力复杂度降至线性，同时保持硬件友好的计算与聚焦的上下文-目标交互。基于从27个公开数据集中整理的大规模语料库进行充分训练与评估，UniMedSeg在视觉上下文、交互式与语言引导分割任务上均达到最先进性能，无需任务特定的微调，并在多种留出任务上展现出强大的泛化能力。代码与模型权重已在https://github.com/Lii1228/UniMedSeg 公开。
tldr: UniMedSeg is a unified Transformer-based framework that handles visual in-context, interactive, and language-guided segmentation for both 2D and 3D medical images using a shared sequence space and Decoupled Split Attention, achieving state-of-the-art performance without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: UniMedSeg是一个统一的基于Transformer的框架，通过共享序列空间和解耦拆分注意力机制，处理视觉上下文、交互式、语言引导的2D/3D医学图像分割，无需任务特定微调即可达到最先进性能。

title: Virtual Chromoendscopy with Tunable Visibility Enhancement
summary: Chromoendoscopy (CE) is a common clinical practice that sprays indigo carmine blue dye onto the gastric surface to improve the visibility of gastric lesions, such as an early cancer. While CE is effective in detecting the lesions, preparing and spraying the dye needs additional cost and time, which is undesirable both for patients and medical practitioners. To overcome this issue, virtual chromoendoscopy (V-CE) was recently proposed, which applies a learned image translation model to virtually generate a CE image from a standard endoscopy (SE) image. In this paper, we propose virtual enhanced chromoendoscopy (V-ECE) that combines V-CE with image enhancement techniques to further improve the visibility of gastric lesions. Because a desired enhancement level depends on the inspected lesion and the practitioner's preference, we introduce a novel image translation model that can generate V-ECE images using an enhancement level tunable by a user. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model can plausibly generate V-ECE images with various enhancement levels using a unified model.
summary_zh: 色素内镜（CE）是一种临床常用技术，通过将靛胭脂蓝染料喷洒于胃黏膜表面，以提升胃部病变（如早期癌症）的可视性。尽管CE能有效检出病变，但染料的配制与喷洒过程需额外的时间与成本，这对患者和医务人员而言均不理想。为克服这一问题，近期提出了虚拟色素内镜（V-CE）技术，该技术应用经过学习的图像转换模型，从标准内镜（SE）图像虚拟生成CE图像。本文提出虚拟增强色素内镜（V-ECE），将V-CE与图像增强技术相结合，以进一步提升胃部病变的可视性。由于理想的增强程度取决于所检查的病变及操作者的偏好，我们引入一种新型图像转换模型，可生成由用户调节增强程度的V-ECE图像。实验结果表明，所提模型能够使用统一模型合理生成具有多种增强程度的V-ECE图像。
tldr: The paper proposes Virtual Enhanced Chromoendoscopy (V-ECE), a novel image translation model that generates virtual chromoendoscopy images with user-tunable enhancement levels from standard endoscopy images, aiming to improve visibility of gastric lesions without the cost and time of dye spraying.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出虚拟增强色素内镜（V-ECE），一种新颖的图像翻译模型，可从标准内镜图像生成具有用户可调增强水平的虚拟色素内镜图像，旨在提高胃部病变的可见性，同时避免染料喷洒的成本和时间。

title: From Many to Meaningful: Feature-Guided Zero-Shot Chronic Kidney Disease Screening Using Large Language Models
summary: Early screening of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is essential for preventing irreversible progression; however, many machine learning (ML)-based screening methods remain difficult to deploy in community and resource-limited screening settings due to their reliance on large labeled datasets, resource-intensive pathology tests, or high-dimensional clinical features, and limited robustness to population and distributional shifts. This study examines the feasibility of using large language models (LLMs) for early-stage CKD screening in a zero-shot setting, without dataset-specific training. We propose a feature-guided zero-shot framework that evaluates LLM performance using a selected set of clinically meaningful, readily available community-based features, rather than exhaustive clinical inputs. Feature selection was guided by ML-based analysis to identify a compact, clinically relevant subset of variables. Tabular patient records were subsequently serialized into text using standardized prompt templates to enable zero-shot inference. The zero-shot performance of four LLMs (LLaMA-3, Qwen-3, Mistral, and GPT-4o-mini) was evaluated using both the full feature set and the selected subset. Generalizability was assessed across three heterogeneous CKD datasets spanning three countries. Across models and datasets, the selected feature set yielded consistent and statistically significant improvements in balanced accuracy and probability estimates, achieving performance levels suitable for screening purposes. These findings suggest that LLMs can support clinically meaningful, training-free CKD screening using minimal community-accessible patient features, offering a practical complement to conventional ML methods in real-world screening contexts.
summary_zh: 摘要：慢性肾脏病（CKD）的早期筛查对于防止不可逆的病情进展至关重要；然而，许多基于机器学习（ML）的筛查方法由于依赖大规模标注数据集、资源密集型的病理检测或高维临床特征，且对人群和分布变化的鲁棒性有限，仍难以在社区和资源有限的筛查环境中部署。本研究探讨了在无需数据集特定训练的情况下，利用大语言模型（LLMs）进行零样本早期CKD筛查的可行性。我们提出了一种特征引导的零样本框架，该框架使用一组经过筛选的、临床意义明确且易于获取的社区特征（而非全面的临床输入）来评估LLM的性能。特征选择基于机器学习分析，以确定一组简洁且临床相关的变量子集。随后，通过标准化提示模板将表格形式的患者记录序列化为文本，以实现零样本推理。使用完整特征集和所选特征子集对四种LLM（LLaMA-3、Qwen-3、Mistral和GPT-4o-mini）的零样本性能进行了评估。跨三个国家三个异质性CKD数据集评估了其泛化能力。在各模型和数据集上，所选特征集在平衡准确率和概率估计方面均产生了一致且统计学显著的改进，达到了适合筛查目的的性能水平。这些发现表明，LLM能够利用最少的社区可获取患者特征，支持无需训练的临床有意义的CKD筛查，为实际筛查场景中传统机器学习方法提供了实用的补充。
tldr: This paper proposes a feature-guided zero-shot framework using large language models (LLMs) for early chronic kidney disease (CKD) screening with minimal community-accessible features, achieving consistent performance improvements across multiple datasets without training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的特征引导零样本框架，利用少量社区可获取的特征进行早期慢性肾病（CKD）筛查，在多个数据集上无需训练即可实现一致的性能提升。

title: DermDepth: Toward Monocular Metric Scale 3D Reconstruction Models for Dermatology
summary: Dermatological practice routinely involves measuring and tracking lesion size, morphology and texture, as critical components of wound or skin cancer screening, monitoring and diagnosis. To accomplish this task, practitioners often image the skin surface with commonly available off-the-shelf camera sensors. This has led to an overwhelming research focus on 2D methods while these objectives naturally benefit from 3D information. In this paper, we demonstrate that dense monocular 3D reconstructions, metric scale measurements and rich surface normal texture estimates are achievable for both dermoscopic and macroscopic cases without the need for additional hardware or multiple captures. We present DermDepth, the first single-view metric scale 3D model for the dermatological domain and D-Synth, the first synthetic dermoscopic dataset with pixel-perfect 3D information. Our experiments show training DermDepth on D-Synth corrects metric scale error from over 16x to under 1.1x for real dermoscopic data, while preserving geometric quality and increasing texture richness. Fine-tuning on a small amount of real clinical samples generalizes our method across three real-world benchmarks spanning the few mm to hundred cm range, diverse skin-tones, chronic wound cases and produces measurements broadly consistent with disease size reported in medical literature. All code, data and models are available at https://github.com/hectorcarrion/dermdepth.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
皮肤科临床工作通常涉及测量和追踪病灶的大小、形态及纹理，这是伤口或皮肤癌筛查、监测与诊断的关键环节。为完成此任务，临床医生常使用市售的普通相机传感器对皮肤表面进行成像。这导致研究过度聚焦于二维方法，而事实上这些目标自然能从三维信息中获益。本文证明，对于皮肤镜及宏观病例，无需额外硬件或多重拍摄即可实现稠密单目三维重建、公制尺度测量及丰富的表面法向纹理估计。我们提出了DermDepth——首个面向皮肤科领域的单视图公制尺度三维模型，以及D-Synth——首个包含像素级完美三维信息的合成皮肤镜数据集。实验表明，在D-Synth上训练DermDepth，可将真实皮肤镜数据的公制尺度误差从超过16倍纠正至低于1.1倍，同时保持几何质量并提升纹理丰富度。通过在少量真实临床样本上进行微调，我们的方法可泛化至三个覆盖毫米至百米跨度、多种肤色及慢性伤口病例的真实世界基准测试，其测量结果与医学文献中报道的病灶尺寸基本一致。所有代码、数据和模型均可在 https://github.com/hectorcarrion/dermdepth 获取。
tldr: DermDepth is the first monocular metric-scale 3D reconstruction model for dermatology, using a synthetic dataset D-Synth to correct scale errors and achieve accurate lesion measurements without additional hardware.
tldr_zh: DermDepth 是首个用于皮肤科的单目度量尺度三维重建模型，利用合成数据集 D-Synth 校正尺度误差，无需额外硬件即可实现精确的病灶测量。

title: Decouple and Reason: Anatomically Guided Two-Stage Voxel-Level Grounding of Free-Text Findings in 3D Chest CT
summary: Automatic voxel-level grounding of free-text findings in 3D chest Computed Tomography (CT) is critical for clinical interpretability. However, this task remains highly challenging due to the intricate spatial complexity of large 3D volumes and the heterogeneity of free-text findings.
