Existing end-to-end approaches often struggle to simultaneously learn the localized feature representations required for accurate 3D segmentation and the complex semantic understanding needed for text alignment, leading to suboptimal grounding performance. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose a novel decoupled framework that disentangles the problem into two specialized stages: (1) class-agnostic lesion segmentation and (2) text-volume reasoning. This structural separation allows the model to first extract candidate sub-volumes by localizing potential abnormalities. Subsequently, intensive cross-modal reasoning is performed to align these localized sub-volumes with free-text medical findings. To resolve the spatial ambiguities inherent in local regions, the reasoning module is augmented with explicit anatomical guidance, utilizing relative spatial coordinates and lung lobe priors. Evaluated on the ReXGroundingCT benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in overall grounding quality on the official leaderboard. These results demonstrate that decoupling detection from reasoning is a highly effective paradigm for handling the complexity of 3D medical visual grounding. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/khuhm/DAGG.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在三维胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）中，对自由文本发现进行自动体素级定位对于临床可解释性至关重要。然而，由于三维大体积数据的复杂空间结构以及自由文本发现的异质性，该任务仍极具挑战性。现有端到端方法往往难以同时学习精确三维分割所需的局部化特征表示和文本对齐所需的复杂语义理解，导致定位性能欠佳。为克服这一根本性局限，我们提出了一种新颖的解耦框架，将问题分解为两个专门阶段：（1）类别无关的病变分割和（2）文本-体积推理。这种结构分离使模型能够首先通过定位潜在异常来提取候选子体积。随后，执行密集的跨模态推理以将这些局部子体积与自由文本医学发现对齐。为解决局部区域固有的空间模糊性，推理模块通过显式解剖学引导进行增强，利用相对空间坐标和肺叶先验知识。在ReXGroundingCT基准上的评估表明，我们的方法在官方排行榜上的整体定位质量达到了最先进水平。这些结果证明，将检测与推理解耦是处理三维医学视觉定位复杂性的高效范式。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/khuhm/DAGG。
tldr: Proposes a two-stage decoupled framework for voxel-level grounding of free-text findings in 3D chest CT, separating class-agnostic lesion segmentation from text-volume reasoning with anatomical guidance, achieving state-of-the-art on the ReXGroundingCT benchmark.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种两阶段解耦框架，用于3D胸部CT中自由文本发现的体素级定位，将类别无关的病变分割与文本-体积推理分离，并加入解剖引导，在ReXGroundingCT基准上达到最优性能。

title: Active Learning for Efficient Annotation of Surgical Videos with Weak Supervision
summary: Precise spatial-temporal annotation of laparoscopic videos is time-consuming and requires expert knowledge. We propose a human-in-the-loop knowledge acquisition framework that combines active learning with dual-loss optimization to significantly reduce the annotation effort needed for automatic localization and segmentation of objects in the surgical field. Our method employs a foundation model to generate temporally consistent class activation maps (CAMs) from video using two complementary training objectives: a weak supervision loss on video-level tool presence labels for weakly annotated data, and an image-level mask loss on human-corrected annotations obtained through active learning. Rather than requiring dense pixel-level annotation upfront, our pipeline iteratively proposes pseudo-masks that guide the expert annotator to refine the knowledge previously captured by the model. We demonstrate that our framework reduces the effort of surgical video annotation by 50% by the end of training in comparison to fully manual annotation. Through eliminating the need for large, fully annotated datasets from the start, this framework enables scalability to the development of surgical tool segmentation models. This iterative human-in-the-loop refinement supports efficient knowledge acquisition with minimal expert input, providing a practical and deployable strategy for expanding tool segmentation to larger, more diverse datasets and real-world clinical settings.
summary_zh: 腹腔镜视频的精确时空标注耗时且需要专业知识。我们提出了一种人在回路的知识获取框架，该框架结合主动学习与双损失优化，显著减少了手术视野中物体自动定位与分割所需的标注工作量。我们的方法采用基础模型，通过两个互补的训练目标从视频中生成时序一致的类激活图：针对弱标注数据的视频级工具存在标签的弱监督损失，以及通过主动学习获取的人工修正标注的图像级掩码损失。该流程无需预先密集的像素级标注，而是迭代地提出伪掩码，引导专家标注者完善模型先前捕获的知识。我们证明，与完全人工标注相比，该框架在训练结束时将手术视频标注工作量减少了50%。通过消除初始阶段对大规模完全标注数据集的需求，该框架实现了手术工具分割模型的可扩展开发。这种迭代式人在回路优化策略以最少的专家输入支持高效知识获取，为将工具分割扩展到更大规模、更多样化的数据集及真实临床环境提供了实用且可部署的策略。
tldr: Proposes a human-in-the-loop active learning framework with weak supervision to reduce surgical video annotation effort by 50% via iterative refinement of pseudo-masks from a foundation model.
tldr_zh: 提出一种结合主动学习和弱监督的人机协同框架，通过迭代优化基础模型生成的伪掩模，将手术视频标注工作量减少50%。

title: Marker-free deformable registration and fusion for augmented reality-guided positive margin localization during tumor resection surgery
summary: Positive margins in head and neck oncologic surgery require mapping specimen-side pathology findings to the patient resection bed. This is challenging because pathologists identify the positive margin on slices of the resected, deformed specimen, while surgeons must relocate the corresponding site on the resection bed using only verbal descriptions and no visual guidance. We present a marker-free augmented reality (AR) workflow for mapping a margin label from a three-dimensional specimen scan to the resection bed. The method combines contour-constrained deformation, residual alignment to a depth scan, surface-based fusion to a head-mounted display, and target projection onto the reconstructed bed. Bead-suture correspondences estimate specimen deformation, whereas patient-to-display fusion does not require external fiducial markers. Following formative experiments, five residents and surgeons performed cadaveric cheek and scalp re-resection tasks under verbal guidance, verbal guidance with specimen examination, and AR guidance. Deformation target errors were $7.63 \pm 3.74$ mm for the cheek and $3.72 \pm 1.02$ mm for the scalp; residual specimen-to-bed distances were $2.43 \pm 2.15$ mm and $2.19 \pm 1.06$ mm, respectively. Fusion error did not differ significantly between marker-free and marker-based methods on either cadaver; overall marker-free fusion error was $2.15 \pm 0.87$ mm. End-to-end margin localization error decreased from $21.40 \pm 3.84$ mm with verbal guidance and $16.09 \pm 4.30$ mm with specimen examination to $6.19 \pm 1.79$ mm with AR guidance ($p < 0.001$). Online fusion required $5.23 \pm 0.34$ s. These results demonstrate effective marker-free AR guidance for positive-margin localization and support more precise tumor resection.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
头颈肿瘤外科手术中的阳性切缘问题要求将标本侧的病理学发现映射到患者切除床。这一过程极具挑战性，因为病理学家是在切除后变形的标本切片上识别阳性切缘，而外科医生仅凭口头描述且无视觉引导，必须在切除床上重新定位对应部位。我们提出了一种无标记增强现实工作流程，用于将三维标本扫描中的切缘标记映射至切除床。该方法结合了轮廓约束变形、深度扫描残余对齐、头戴式显示器的表面融合以及目标在重建切除床上的投影。缝线珠对应关系用于估计标本变形，而患者与显示器的融合无需外部基准标记。经过预实验后，五名住院医师和外科医生在口头引导、口头引导联合标本检查以及增强现实引导下，完成了尸体颊部和头皮再切除任务。颊部变形目标误差为7.63 ± 3.74 mm，头皮为3.72 ± 1.02 mm；标本到切除床的残余距离分别为2.43 ± 2.15 mm和2.19 ± 1.06 mm。在两名尸体上，无标记方法与有标记方法的融合误差无显著差异；整体无标记融合误差为2.15 ± 0.87 mm。端到端切缘定位误差从口头引导下的21.40 ± 3.84 mm和标本检查下的16.09 ± 4.30 mm降低至增强现实引导下的6.19 ± 1.79 mm（p < 0.001）。在线融合所需时间为5.23 ± 0.34秒。这些结果表明，无标记增强现实引导能有效定位阳性切缘，并支持更精准的肿瘤切除。
tldr: Presents a marker-free augmented reality workflow that uses deformable registration and surface fusion to map positive margin labels from resected specimen scans to the patient's resection bed, achieving significantly lower localization error than verbal guidance in cadaver experiments.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无标记增强现实工作流程，利用变形配准和表面融合将切除标本扫描中的阳性切缘标签映射到患者手术切除床，在尸体实验中实现了比口头引导显著更低的定位误差。

title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
summary: Surgical tissue retraction requires effective manipulation planning under partial and noisy perception. We study state estimation for deformable tissue retraction, where only sparse observations of the tissue surface are available at decision time. We propose a learned state estimator that reconstructs the full deformable mesh state from 40 noisy vertex observations. The estimator combines a multilayer perceptron with a low-dimensional PCA latent representation and is trained using geometry-aware regularization that encourages smooth and physically plausible deformations. We evaluate the approach in a 2D deformable sheet simulation using single-step and multi-step retraction planning. Results show that the learned estimator achieves 98.1% of oracle performance in multi-step retraction while supporting efficient inference. These results demonstrate that learned, geometry-regularized state estimation can support effective deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.
summary_zh: 手术组织牵拉需要在部分且嘈杂的感知条件下进行有效的操作规划。我们研究了可变形组织牵拉的状态估计问题，其中在决策时刻仅能获得组织表面的稀疏观测。我们提出了一种学习型状态估计器，该估计器能从40个带有噪声的顶点观测中重建完整的可变形网格状态。该估计器将多层感知器与低维PCA潜在表示相结合，并采用几何感知正则化进行训练，以鼓励光滑且物理合理的变形。我们通过单步和多步牵拉规划在二维可变形薄片模拟中评估了该方法。结果表明，在多步牵拉中，学习型估计器达到了理想性能的98.1%，同时支持高效推理。这些结果证明了在现实感知约束下，基于几何正则化的学习型状态估计能够支持有效的可变形操作。
tldr: Proposes a learned state estimator combining MLP and PCA latent representation with geometry-aware regularization to reconstruct full deformable mesh from sparse observations, achieving 98.1% of oracle performance in simulated surgical tissue retraction.
tldr_zh: 提出一种结合MLP和PCA潜在表示与几何感知正则化的学习型状态估计器，从稀疏观测中重建完整形变网格，在模拟手术组织牵拉中达到98.1%的oracle性能。

title: Towards end-to-end optimization in multimaterial 3D printing
summary: Multimaterial 3D printing enables the fabrication of functionally graded components, but optimizing their spatial material distribution alongside structural topology remains a formidable challenge due to high-dimensional design spaces and complex constitutive modeling. This paper presents an end-to-end computational framework integrating sparsified physics-augmented neural networks with finite-element-based topology optimization. By extracting closed-form, composition-aware hyperelastic constitutive laws from experimental data, this approach facilitates exact symbolic differentiation via the adjoint state method implemented with FEniCSx, efficiently circumventing the bottlenecks of applying neural network constitutive models. This pipeline is deployed on soft robotic gripper applications, demonstrating continuous composition optimization for highly anisotropic contact responses, and the concurrent optimization of macroscopic topology and material distribution under non-failure stretch constraints. This methodology could replace laborious empirical prototyping, establishing interpretable machine-learning models as practical, robust design primitives for advanced multimaterial additive manufacturing.
summary_zh: 多材料3D打印技术能够制造功能梯度构件，但由于高维设计空间和复杂本构建模，优化其空间材料分布与结构拓扑仍是一项艰巨挑战。本文提出了一种端到端计算框架，将稀疏化物理增强神经网络与基于有限元的拓扑优化相结合。通过从实验数据中提取封闭形式的、成分感知的超弹性本构定律，该方法利用FEniCSx实现的伴随状态法实现精确符号微分，有效规避了应用神经网络本构模型的瓶颈。该流程被部署于软体机器人夹爪应用，展示了针对高度各向异性接触响应的连续成分优化，以及在非破坏拉伸约束下宏观拓扑与材料分布的协同优化。该方法可替代繁冗的经验原型设计，将可解释机器学习模型确立为先进多材料增材制造的实用、稳健的设计基元。
tldr: This paper proposes an end-to-end computational framework that integrates sparsified physics-augmented neural networks with topology optimization to simultaneously optimize material distribution and structural topology in multimaterial 3D printing, demonstrated on soft robotic grippers for anisotropic contact responses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种端到端计算框架，将稀疏化的物理增强神经网络与拓扑优化相结合，以同时优化多材料3D打印中的材料分布和结构拓扑，并在软体机器人夹爪上展示了各向异性接触响应的优化。

title: A Self-Evolving Agent for Longitudinal Personal Health Management
summary: Personal health management unfolds over repeated encounters, yet most health AI systems treat each request in isolation. We developed HealthClaw, an open-source agent architecture that updates support as a person's routines, preferences, measurements and risks change. It separates shared safety rules and medical knowledge from private longitudinal memory containing profile facts, reusable procedures and episodic traces. After each episode, induction determines what should update the profile, revise a procedure, remain episodic or be excluded. We evaluated HealthClaw with a synthetic year-long benchmark and nine 200-case biomedical tasks. Across 900 longitudinal support probes, answer accuracy increased from 0.2% with current-query prompting to 45.7% with HealthClaw, while prompt-side context exposure was 71.7% lower than with full-history prompting. In 100 privacy probes, HealthClaw produced higher privacy-aware answer quality and fewer unsafe disclosures than both baselines. Across the biomedical tasks, the mean absolute gain in the task-specific primary metric was 27.0 percentage points, and seven gains remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. These offline benchmarks support governed, self-evolving memory for longitudinal personal health agents, although clinical effectiveness requires prospective evaluation. HealthClaw is publicly available at https://github.com/HC-Guo/HealthClaw.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
个人健康管理在反复的交互中逐步展开，然而大多数健康人工智能系统却孤立地处理每次请求。我们开发了HealthClaw，这是一种开源智能体架构，能够随着个人日常习惯、偏好、测量指标和风险的变化而更新支持策略。该架构将共享的安全规则和医学知识与私有的纵向记忆（包括个人档案事实、可复用流程及情节痕迹）分离开来。每次交互后，归纳机制会判断哪些信息应更新档案、修订流程、保留为情节记录或予以排除。我们通过一个合成的一年期基准测试和九项200例生物医学任务对HealthClaw进行了评估。在900次纵向支持探测中，回答准确率从基于当前查询提示的0.2%提升至HealthClaw的45.7%，同时提示侧上下文暴露量比基于完整历史记录的提示降低了71.7%。在100次隐私探测中，HealthClaw相较于两个基线方法，产生了更高的隐私感知回答质量，且不安全披露更少。在生物医学任务中，任务特定主要指标的平均绝对增益为27.0个百分点，其中七项增益在错误发现率校正后仍具显著性。这些离线基准测试支持了面向纵向个人健康智能体的受控、自演进记忆机制，但其临床有效性仍需前瞻性评估。HealthClaw已公开于 https://github.com/HC-Guo/HealthClaw。
tldr: HealthClaw is an open-source, self-evolving agent architecture for longitudinal personal health management that separates shared knowledge from private memory and uses induction to update profiles, procedures, and episodic traces, achieving large accuracy gains and privacy improvements over baseline methods.
tldr_zh: HealthClaw 是一个开源、自我进化的智能体架构，用于纵向个人健康管理，它将共享知识与私人记忆分离，并通过归纳更新个人档案、操作流程和事件轨迹，相比基线方法在准确性和隐私保护方面取得了显著提升。

title: Towards Enhancing 3D Spatial Reasoning in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in 2D medical image understanding, their extension to 3D volumetric imaging remains hindered by prohibitive annotation costs and dataset opacity. Current data formats, predominantly consisting of rigid Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs or unstructured final clinical reports, typically fail to capture explicit clinical reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce a large-scale structured reasoning dataset constructed via a novel slice-wise data synthesis paradigm. Inspired by the genuine diagnostic workflow of radiologists, this paradigm models visual cognition by decomposing the complex 3D reading process, translating global clinical priors into fine-grained, per-slice observations that are subsequently synthesized into an interpretable Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Crucially, this synthesized reasoning framework enforces essential clinical principles: sequential spatial tracking, multi-slice spatial awareness for artifact mitigation, and differential exclusion. To validate this approach, we instruction-tune a standard 2D-pretrained MLLM baseline using the synthesized data to enhance its volumetric comprehension. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple 3D medical benchmarks demonstrate that our method yields significant performance improvements over the 2D baseline. Furthermore, the resulting model exhibits robust spatial reasoning capabilities and rivals resource-intensive native 3D architectures, effectively bridging the performance gap. Ultimately, this data-centric strategy unlocks deep volumetric understanding and highly interpretable clinical logic without requiring computationally expensive 3D-specific pre-training. The complete repository, including datasets and training workflows, is publicly available at https://github.com/2020420145009/hounsfield.
summary_zh: 摘要：尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在二维医学图像理解方面取得了显著成功，但其向三维体成像的扩展仍受到高昂标注成本和数据集不透明性的阻碍。当前的数据格式主要由固定的视觉问答（VQA）对或非结构化的最终临床报告构成，通常无法捕捉显式的临床推理过程。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种通过新颖的逐切片数据合成范式构建的大规模结构化推理数据集。该范式受放射科医生真实诊断流程启发，通过分解复杂的3D阅读过程来模拟视觉认知，将全局临床先验转化为细粒度的逐切片观察，随后将这些观察综合成可解释的思维链（CoT）。至关重要的是，这一合成推理框架强制执行了关键的临床原则：顺序空间追踪、用于伪影减轻的多切片空间感知，以及鉴别性排除。为验证该方法，我们利用合成数据对标准2D预训练MLLM基线进行指令微调，以增强其体理解能力。在多个3D医学基准上的全面评估表明，我们的方法相较于2D基线取得了显著的性能提升。此外，所得模型展现出强大的空间推理能力，可与资源密集型的原生3D架构相媲美，有效弥合了性能差距。最终，这种以数据为中心的策略无需进行计算昂贵的3D专用预训练，即可实现深层的体理解释和高度可解释的临床逻辑。完整代码库（包括数据集和训练工作流）已公开于 https://github.com/2020420145009/hounsfield。
tldr: The paper introduces a slice-wise data synthesis paradigm and Chain-of-Thought reasoning to enhance 3D spatial reasoning in medical multimodal large language models, achieving performance comparable to native 3D architectures without 3D-specific pre-training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于逐切片数据合成范式和推理链的方法，增强医学多模态大语言模型的3D空间推理能力，无需3D特定预训练即可达到与原生3D架构相当的性能。

title: SARFA: Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated strong generalizability across a variety of segmentation tasks. However, SAM often struggles in situations where the target to be segmented is ambiguous. This poses a problem in medical imaging, where accurate delineation of targets such as tumors is vital, but even expert radiologists can disagree on the appropriate boundary for a target. Addressing this, we propose SARFA (Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment), a novel framework for improved medical image segmentation. Via probabilistic prompting, SARFA generates a diverse set of plausible masks for each input image and optimizes them with a radiomics-driven training objective based on Fréchet Radiomic Distance (FRD) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). By minimizing the FRD between masked predicted and ground truth regions within each image, SARFA encourages segmentation outputs whose anatomical and textural characteristics align with clinically meaningful ground truth representations, without relying solely on pixel-level overlap. Evaluated on computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) benchmarks, SARFA outperforms existing ambiguous segmentation methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of radiomic feature alignment and DPO-style candidate mask ranking as a training objective. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbwa233/SARFA.
summary_zh:
摘要：
Segment Anything Model（SAM）已在多种分割任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，当待分割目标存在歧义时，SAM常会陷入困境。这在医学影像中尤为突出——准确勾勒肿瘤等目标边界至关重要，但即使是资深放射科医生也可能对目标的合适边界存在分歧。针对这一问题，我们提出SARFA（放射组学特征对齐的任意分割模型），一种用于改进医学图像分割的新型框架。通过概率提示，SARFA为每张输入图像生成一组多样化的合理掩膜，并基于Fréchet放射组学距离（FRD）和直接偏好优化（DPO），以放射组学驱动的训练目标对掩膜进行优化。通过最小化每张图像中掩膜预测区域与真实区域之间的FRD，SARFA促使分割输出的解剖和纹理特征与临床有意义的真实标注对齐，而不仅仅依赖像素级重叠。在计算机断层扫描（CT）和磁共振成像（MRI）基准数据集上的评估表明，SARFA优于现有的模糊分割方法，验证了放射组学特征对齐和DPO式候选掩膜排序作为训练目标的有效性。我们的代码开源在https://github.com/tbwa233/SARFA。
tldr: SARFA improves SAM for ambiguous medical image segmentation by using radiomic feature alignment (Fréchet Radiomic Distance) and DPO-based candidate mask ranking, outperforming existing methods on CT and MRI.
tldr_zh: SARFA通过放射组学特征对齐（Fréchet Radiomic Distance）和基于DPO的候选掩膜排序，改进了SAM在模糊医学图像分割中的表现，在CT和MRI上优于现有方法。

title: Layered Risk Mapping for Autonomous Patient Transport in Expeditionary Medical Facilities
summary: In expeditionary medical facilities, routine patient transport imposes a compounding burden of personal protective equipment consumption, staff diversion, and elevated infection risk that becomes unsustainable under surge conditions. While autonomous wheelchairs could absorb this operational load, the safety-critical nature of patient transit within these highly unstructured and dynamic environments poses complex navigational challenges. To address this, we present a layered risk mapping framework that fuses four heterogeneous environmental hazards (terrain slope, static and dynamic obstacles, and semantic traversability) into a unified probabilistic cost surface via a Noisy-OR fusion model. In a paired Monte-Carlo evaluation, risk-informed fusion reduces collision rates from over 73% to under 32% and more than doubles obstacle clearance relative to a risk-unaware baseline. Additionaly, Noisy-OR achieves the highest clearance to obstacles and the lowest conditional peak risk across all tested hazard densities. We further validate the framework on a commercial powered wheelchair across three representative mission profiles in indoor and outdoor deployments, demonstrating that this architecture successfully meets the planning requirements of this previously unaddressed operational regime.
summary_zh: 在远征医疗设施中，常规患者运输会带来个人防护装备消耗、人员分流和感染风险增加的复合负担，在激增条件下将变得不可持续。尽管自动轮椅可承担这一操作负荷，但在这些高度非结构化且动态变化的环境中进行患者转运具有安全关键性，面临复杂的导航挑战。为此，我们提出一种分层风险映射框架，通过噪声或（Noisy-OR）融合模型将四种异质环境危害（地形坡度、静态与动态障碍物以及语义可穿越性）统一为概率代价曲面。在配对蒙特卡洛评估中，与不感知风险的基线相比，风险感知融合将碰撞率从超过73%降至低于32%，并将障碍物避让距离提升一倍以上。此外，在所有测试危害密度下，噪声或模型实现了最高的障碍物避让距离和最低的条件峰值风险。我们进一步在一款商用电动轮椅上，针对室内与室外部署中的三种代表性任务场景验证了该框架，结果表明该架构成功满足了这一此前未被涉及的操作场景的规划需求。
tldr: This paper proposes a layered risk mapping framework using Noisy-OR fusion to combine terrain, static/dynamic obstacles, and semantic traversability for autonomous wheelchair navigation in expeditionary medical facilities, reducing collision rates from 73% to under 32% in simulation and validated on a real wheelchair across indoor/outdoor missions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层风险映射框架，采用Noisy-OR融合方法将地形坡度、静态/动态障碍物和语义可通行性结合，用于远征医疗设施中自主轮椅导航，在模拟中将碰撞率从73%降至32%以下，并在真实轮椅的室内外任务中验证。

title: AI-Augmented Adaptive Digital Twin Modeling for Brain Tumor Evolution Prediction and Treatment Scheduling
summary: Brain tumor progression exhibits spatially heterogeneous growth, patient-specific treatment response, and complex interactions with surrounding anatomy, making accurate long-term prediction challenging. We propose an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin (DT) framework for brain tumor evolution prediction and treatment scheduling. The framework integrates an interpretable reaction--diffusion (RD) model, a 3D residual learning module for model-form correction, patient-specific DT updating during recursive rollout, and model predictive control (MPC) for constrained chemotherapy and radiotherapy scheduling. Experiments on 387 synthetic tumor trajectories with 120-step evolution show that the baseline RD model captures tumor location and overall temporal behavior but underestimates heterogeneous tumor burden during long-horizon prediction. Hybrid RD--residual modeling reduces masked voxel-wise mean squared error by 84.3% and increases Dice overlap by 43.5% relative to the RD baseline under dense simulated observations. Online DT updating further reduces mean squared error by 45.9% and improves Dice overlap by 9.6% compared with the non-updated hybrid model. In MPC-based scheduling simulations, the updated DT controller reduces final tumor burden by 22.4% relative to a fixed treatment schedule under the terminal-burden objective. Together, these results demonstrate a unified framework for patient-specific initialization, mechanistic modeling, adaptive learning, and constrained treatment optimization. Although validated using patient-data-informed synthetic trajectories rather than clinical longitudinal data, the proposed framework establishes a foundation for future translation to real-world adaptive treatment planning.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
脑肿瘤进展表现出空间异质性生长、患者特异性治疗反应以及与周围解剖结构的复杂相互作用，这使得准确的长期预测极具挑战性。我们提出了一种基于人工智能增强的自适应数字孪生（DT）框架，用于脑肿瘤演化预测及治疗调度。该框架集成了可解释的反应-扩散（RD）模型、用于模型形式校正的3D残差学习模块、递归展开过程中的患者特异性DT更新，以及用于约束性化疗和放疗调度的模型预测控制（MPC）。在包含387条合成肿瘤轨迹（每轨迹120步演化）的实验中，基线RD模型能够捕捉肿瘤位置与整体时间行为，但在长期预测中低估了异质性肿瘤负荷。在密集模拟观测条件下，混合RD-残差建模相较于RD基线将掩膜体素级均方误差降低了84.3%，并使得Dice重叠度提升了43.5%。与非更新的混合模型相比，在线DT更新进一步将均方误差降低了45.9%，并将Dice重叠度提升了9.6%。在基于MPC的调度仿真中，相较于终端负荷目标下的固定治疗方案，更新后的DT控制器将最终肿瘤负荷降低了22.4%。综合来看，这些结果展示了一个集患者特异性初始化、机理建模、自适应学习与约束性治疗优化于一体的统一框架。尽管该框架使用的是基于患者数据生成的合成轨迹而非临床纵向数据，但它为未来向真实世界自适应治疗规划的转化奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper proposes an AI-augmented adaptive digital twin framework for brain tumor evolution prediction and treatment scheduling, integrating a reaction-diffusion model, 3D residual learning, online updating, and model predictive control, achieving significant error reduction in synthetic experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种AI增强的自适应数字孪生框架，用于脑肿瘤演化预测和治疗调度，集成了反应-扩散模型、3D残差学习、在线更新和模型预测控制，在合成实验中实现了显著的误差降低。

title: TEDDY: A Pediatric Foundation Model for Risk Forewarning from ICD-Coded Diagnostic Histories
summary: Pediatric electronic health records capture developmentally structured clinical trajectories, yet their potential for generative healthcare foundation models remains largely unexplored. Here we present TEDDY (Temporal Event Decoder for Disease in Youth), a 1.84-million-parameter decoder transformer trained on approximately 73 million ICD-10 diagnoses from 1.6 million children at a single pediatric institution. TEDDY models longitudinal diagnosis trajectories and visit timing. Predictions were made before visit codes were revealed, limited to first occurrences, and evaluated against sex- and age-matched controls. Across 797 disease-onset prediction tasks spanning 16 ICD-10 chapters, TEDDY achieved a median AUC of 72.0%, outperforming same-data DenseNet (50.0%), CNN (57.2%), RNN (60.1%), and LSTM (62.7%) baselines on 96-99% of tasks. Performance held across sex and age and was strongest among lower-prevalence diagnoses; 202 of the 225 rarest conditions (90%) had 95% confidence intervals above chance. Predictive signal remained detectable more than two years before first recorded diagnosis, with median AUCs of 59.7% in the unrestricted analysis and 64.4% in a fixed-cohort sensitivity analysis. In asthma and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder benchmarks, AUCs were 79.3% and 84.7%, compared with 62.7% and 71.7% for the strongest comparators, including a general-purpose language model three orders of magnitude larger. Visit-timing predictions had a 3.0-day mean absolute restricted mean survival-time error over 365 days, although median and long-tail return intervals remained miscalibrated. Together, these results establish pediatric diagnostic histories as a substrate for compact generative models supporting broad, rare-disease, and long-horizon risk forecasting without population-scale data or billion-parameter models.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
儿科电子健康记录记录了基于发育结构的临床轨迹，但其在生成式医疗基础模型中的潜力尚待探索。本文提出TEDDY（青少年疾病时间事件解码器），这是一个包含184万个参数的解码器变换器模型，基于单一儿科机构约160万名儿童的约7300万条ICD-10诊断数据进行训练。TEDDY对纵向诊断轨迹和就诊时间进行建模。预测在就诊代码揭示前完成，仅针对首次发病事件，并与性别和年龄匹配的对照组进行对比评估。在涵盖16个ICD-10章节的797项疾病发病预测任务中，TEDDY的中位AUC达72.0%，在96%-99%的任务上优于同一数据集的DenseNet（50.0%）、CNN（57.2%）、RNN（60.1%）和LSTM（62.7%）基线模型。其性能在性别和年龄分层中保持稳定，且在低患病率诊断中表现最强；225种最罕见疾病中有202种（90%）的95%置信区间高于随机水平。预测信号在首次记录诊断前两年以上即可检测到，无限制分析的中位AUC为59.7%，固定队列敏感性分析中为64.4%。在哮喘和注意力缺陷/多动症基准测试中，AUC分别达到79.3%和84.7%，而最强对比模型（包括规模大三个数量级的通用语言模型）分别为62.7%和71.7%。就诊时间预测在365天内的平均绝对受限平均生存时间误差为3.0天，但中位和长尾返回间隔仍存在校准偏差。综上，这些结果表明儿科诊断历史可作为紧凑生成模型的基座，无需群体规模数据或数十亿参数模型即可支持广泛、罕见疾病及远期风险预测。
tldr: TEDDY is a 1.84-million-parameter decoder transformer trained on 73 million ICD-10 diagnoses from 1.6 million children, achieving median AUC of 72% across 797 disease-onset prediction tasks and outperforming larger models, demonstrating that compact generative models can support broad and rare-disease risk forecasting from pediatric diagnostic histories.
tldr_zh: TEDDY是一个184万参数的解码器Transformer，在160万儿童的7300万条ICD-10诊断记录上训练，在797个疾病发病预测任务中达到中位AUC 72%，优于更大模型，表明紧凑的生成模型能够从儿科诊断历史支持广泛和罕见疾病的风险预测。

title: FM$^2$: Unified Federated Foundation Models for Heterogeneous Multimodal Medical Imaging
summary: Building foundation models for medical imaging requires pooling data across institutions, yet privacy regulations prohibit centralized aggregation. Existing Federated Foundation Models either fine-tune natural-image models with poor medical-domain transfer, or train from scratch within a single modality, lacking the flexibility to unify tasks. We identify an under-explored challenge, Imaging Modality Heterogeneity, where clients operate under two structural regimes: Overlapped (shared modalities with heterogeneous label distributions) and Non-overlapped (fully disjoint modalities per client). We propose FM$^2$, a unified framework that trains the core backbone from scratch to preserve medical domain fidelity while optionally incorporating biomedical pretrained encoders for vision-language alignment. FM$^2$ equips each client with dual Mixture-of-Experts modules (a Class-wise MoE for personalized category knowledge and a Domain-wise MoE for shared cross-modality representations), coupled with a Heterogeneous Modality Alignment (HMA) regularizer that explicitly aligns modality-specific expert parameters, admitting provable $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence and generalization guarantees. FM$^2$ further incorporates Caption-Enhanced Learning (CEL), where locally retained GPT-4o-generated captions serve as a textual semantic bridge enabling representation transfer across clients with disjoint modalities, and demonstrates extensibility to Federated Medical VQA. Experiments on our MIMH benchmark (classification and CEL) and real-world medical VQA datasets confirm consistent superiority over state-of-the-art federated baselines and strong out-of-modality generalization across all three tasks.
summary_zh: 为医学影像构建基础模型需要跨机构汇集数据，但隐私法规禁止集中式数据聚合。现有联邦基础模型要么对医学领域迁移效果欠佳的自然图像模型进行微调，要么在单模态内从头训练，缺乏统一任务的灵活性。我们发现了一个尚未充分探索的挑战——成像模态异质性，在此场景下各客户端运行于两种结构模式：重叠模式（共享模态但标签分布异质）和非重叠模式（各客户端拥有完全不相交的模态）。我们提出FM$^2$，一个统一框架，从头训练核心骨干网络以保留医学领域保真度，同时可选地集成生物医学预训练编码器以实现视觉-语言对齐。FM$^2$为每个客户端配备双专家混合模块（类别级MoE用于个性化类别知识，领域级MoE用于共享跨模态表示），并引入异质模态对齐（HMA）正则化器，显式对齐模态特定的专家参数，可证明具有$O(1/\sqrt{T})$的收敛速度和泛化保证。FM$^2$进一步集成描述增强学习（CEL），其中本地保留的GPT-4o生成的描述作为文本语义桥梁，使不相交模态的客户端间能够进行表示迁移，并展现出扩展到联邦医学视觉问答的可扩展性。在MIMH基准测试（分类和CEL）以及真实医学VQA数据集上的实验证实，该方法在所有三项任务中均持续优于最先进的联邦基线方法，并具备强大的跨模态泛化能力。
tldr: A federated learning framework (FM^2) for training multimodal medical imaging foundation models across clients with heterogeneous modalities, using mixture-of-experts and a modality alignment regularizer to handle overlapped and non-overlapped modality settings, with demonstrated superiority on classification and VQA tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种联邦学习框架FM^2，用于在具有异构模态的客户端之间训练多模态医学影像基础模型，通过混合专家模型和模态对齐正则化处理重叠和非重叠模态设置，在分类和VQA任务上表现优于现有方法。

title: MamaBench: Benchmarking LLM Robustness in Maternal and Child Health Diagnosis through Counterfactual Clinical Perturbation
summary: Large language models achieve strong scores on medical benchmarks, yet these benchmarks evaluate each question in isolation, providing no measure of whether a system can distinguish clinically similar presentations requiring different interventions. We introduce MamaBench, the first counterfactual benchmark for maternal and paediatric AI: 434 expert-authored clinical narratives in 217 pairs across 371 pathologies, evaluated via the Bias Trap Rate (BTR), the conditional probability that a model fails the counterfactual given success on the base case. We propose Evidence-Anchored RAG (EA-RAG), a three-stage retrieval method that replaces aggregate similarity with an evidence coverage objective through clinical parameter extraction, coverage auditing, and contrastive sub-queries. Across eight configurations of four frontier LLMs, base accuracy overstates robust accuracy by 16-28 percentage points in every model. EA-RAG achieves 20.3% BTR and 65.0% robust accuracy on Claude Sonnet 4.6, a 5.5 percentage point BTR reduction without degrading base accuracy. The residual 20% BTR confirms that counterfactual robustness in clinical AI remains an open challenge. Keywords: counterfactual evaluation, clinical AI, maternal healthcare, retrieval-augmented generation, diagnostic robustness
summary_zh: 大语言模型在医学基准测试中取得了较高的得分，然而这些基准测试孤立地评估每一道题目，无法衡量系统是否能区分临床表现相似但需要不同干预措施的病例。我们提出了MamaBench——首个面向母婴AI的反事实基准测试：包含由专家撰写的434份临床叙述，构成217对病例对，涵盖371种病理，并通过偏倚陷阱率（BTR）进行评估，即模型在基础病例正确的前提下反事实病例失败的 conditional 概率。我们提出了证据锚定检索增强生成（EA-RAG），一种三阶段检索方法，通过临床参数提取、覆盖率审计和对比性子查询，以证据覆盖目标替代聚合相似度。在四种前沿大语言模型的八种配置中，每个模型的基础准确率均高估了稳健准确率16至28个百分点。EA-RAG在Claude Sonnet 4.6上实现了20.3%的BTR和65.0%的稳健准确率，BTR降低了5.5个百分点，且未降低基础准确率。残余的20% BTR证实，临床AI中的反事实稳健性仍是一个开放挑战。关键词：反事实评估，临床AI，母婴医疗，检索增强生成，诊断稳健性
tldr: Introduces MamaBench, the first counterfactual benchmark for maternal and pediatric AI, and proposes Evidence-Anchored RAG (EA-RAG) to improve LLM diagnostic robustness, achieving a 20.3% Bias Trap Rate on Claude Sonnet 4.6 while highlighting that counterfactual robustness remains an open challenge.
tldr_zh: 提出首个针对母婴AI的反事实基准测试MamaBench，并设计了基于证据锚定的检索增强生成方法（EA-RAG），在Claude Sonnet 4.6上实现了20.3%的偏差陷阱率，同时指出反事实鲁棒性仍是临床AI的未解难题。

title: Stitch-Inferencer: Enhance Endoscopic Video Segmentation and Tracking via Panoramic Reconstruction
summary: Surgical video understanding is fundamental to navigation systems. Endoscopic perception is often hindered by a limited field-of-view and frequent instrument occlusions, making spatio-temporal context essential for robust inference. These challenges have motivated video models that aggregate information across frames. However, existing video models typically store past observations implicitly in learned feature representations, often requiring task-specific video training, substantial annotated data, and increased computational cost. We propose Stitch-Inferencer, a real-time, model-agnostic inference framework that replaces implicit feature memory with an explicit image-space panoramic canvas. By stitching valid observations across frames, Stitch-Inferencer preserves previously observed pixels in an online, instrument-free view, expanding the effective field-of-view and providing direct access to regions that are temporarily occluded or absent from the current frame. Downstream segmentation or tracking models are applied to a compact region of interest on the panorama, and their predictions are reprojected to the current frame, enabling existing models to exploit long-range context without retraining. Experiments on anatomy segmentation and point/box tracking demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse baselines while preserving real-time throughput. The stitching module alone runs at over 60 FPS, providing a practical inference-time solution to enhance endoscopic perception in computationally constrained intraoperative environments. Source code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 外科手术视频理解是导航系统的基础。内窥镜感知常受限于有限的视场和频繁的器械遮挡，这使得时空上下文对于鲁棒推理至关重要。上述挑战推动了能够跨帧聚合信息的视频模型的发展。然而，现有视频模型通常将历史观测隐式存储在学习的特征表示中，这往往需要特定任务的视频训练、大量标注数据以及更高的计算成本。我们提出Stitch-Inferencer——一种实时的、与模型无关的推理框架，该框架通过显式的图像空间全景画布取代隐式特征记忆。通过跨帧拼接有效观测，Stitch-Inferencer以在线方式保留先前观测到的像素，形成无器械的视野，从而扩展有效视场，并提供对当前帧中暂时被遮挡或缺失区域直接访问的能力。下游的分割或跟踪模型被应用于全景图上的紧凑感兴趣区域，其预测结果被重投影至当前帧，使现有模型无需重新训练即可利用长程上下文。在解剖分割与点/框跟踪上的实验表明，该方法在保持实时吞吐量的同时，能够在多种基线模型上实现一致提升。拼接模块单独运行速度超过60 FPS，在计算受限的术中环境中为增强内窥镜感知提供了一种实用的推理阶段解决方案。源代码将公开发布。
tldr: Stitch-Inferencer is a real-time, model-agnostic inference framework that uses an explicit panoramic canvas to stitch past observations across frames, enhancing endoscopic video segmentation and tracking without retraining, and achieving over 60 FPS.
tldr_zh: Stitch-Inferencer 是一个实时、模型无关的推理框架，通过显式的全景画布拼接各帧的过往观测，增强内窥镜视频分割与追踪，无需重新训练，且处理速度超过60 FPS。

title: One-for-All Adaptive Radiotherapy Planning Agent: A Foundation Framework for Daily CBCT-guided Radiotherapy
summary: In this work, we introduce the One-for-All Adaptive Radiotherapy Planning Agent, a unified foundation-model-based system that performs complete, treatment-specific online adaptive planning directly from daily cone-beam CT in under two minutes. The agent first autonomously predicts all essential planning components, including synthetic CT generation, multimodal alignment, and tumor/organ segmentation. It then intelligently leverages these outputs to execute the final clinical plan design, providing a comprehensive, automated solution for daily treatment. We also demonstrate that the agent enables clinicians to define planning with intent and intervene at critical decision points, ensuring a "human-in-the-loop" framework that generates acceptable plans before final approval. Evaluated on multiple datasets spanning head-and-neck, lung, abdominal, and prostate cancers with both photon and proton therapy, the proposed framework achieves clinically acceptable accuracy and plan quality comparable to clinically generated treatment plans, with target dose errors (D98) generally within 2.0 Gy of the reference plan. The strong performance of the One-for-All agent highlights the promise of a unified foundation-model approach and opens opportunities for fast, scalable, and fully automated online adaptive radiotherapy across diverse clinical scenarios.
summary_zh: 在此研究中，我们提出了“通用自适应放疗规划智能体”——一个基于统一基础模型的系统，能够直接从每日锥形束CT图像出发，在两分钟内完成完整且针对具体治疗方案的在线自适应规划。该智能体首先自主预测所有关键规划要素，包括合成CT生成、多模态对齐及肿瘤/器官分割；随后智能利用这些输出结果执行最终的临床计划设计，为每日治疗提供全面自动化的解决方案。我们还证明，该智能体使临床医生能够按治疗意图定义规划，并在关键决策点进行干预，确保形成“人在环中”的框架，在最终审批前生成可接受的计划。在涵盖头颈部、肺部、腹部及前列腺癌的光子与质子治疗多个数据集上的评估表明，所提框架达到了临床可接受的精度，且计划质量与临床生成的计划相当，靶区剂量误差（D98）通常控制在参考计划的2.0 Gy以内。“通用智能体”的优异性能彰显了统一基础模型方法的潜力，并为在不同临床场景中实现快速、可扩展且完全自动化的在线自适应放疗开辟了新机遇。
tldr: A unified foundation-model-based agent that performs complete online adaptive radiotherapy planning from daily CBCT in under two minutes, achieving clinically acceptable accuracy across multiple cancer types and therapy modalities.
tldr_zh: 一个基于基础模型的统一智能体，能够在两分钟内根据日常CBCT图像完成完整的在线自适应放疗计划，且在多种癌症类型和治疗模式中达到临床可接受的准确性。

title: ViPSAM: Visual Prompting Medical Image Segmentation Using Segment Anything Model
summary: In proton therapy planning, respiratory-gated non-contrast CT (NCCT) is commonly used for lesion segmentation; however, accurate delineation remains challenging due to low lesion-to-background contrast. Although learning-based methods have shown strong performance, they often struggle with non-contrast image segmentation. Inspired by clinical practice, where contrast-enhanced MRI is referenced to delineate lesions on NCCT, we propose ViPSAM, a visual prompting framework that leverages complementary cross-modality information. Built upon the Segment Anything Model (SAM), ViPSAM introduces a visual prompt encoder to extract guidance features from contrast-enhanced images and a visual-guided cross-attention module to integrate non-contrast and contrast-enhanced features, thereby enhancing lesion-relevant representations in low-contrast regions. The mask decoder is further adapted in a parameter-efficient manner to utilize visual prompts effectively. We evaluate the proposed method on liver lesion segmentation using NCCT acquired for proton therapy. Experimental results demonstrate that ViPSAM outperforms representative U-Net- and SAM-based methods, indicating that cross-modality visual prompting enables more robust and accurate segmentation in non-contrast images.
summary_zh: 在质子治疗计划中，呼吸门控非对比CT（NCCT）常用于病灶分割；然而，由于病灶与背景之间的对比度较低，准确勾画仍具挑战性。尽管基于学习的方法已展现出强劲性能，但在非对比图像分割中仍常面临困难。受临床实践中参考对比增强MRI在NCCT上勾画病灶的启发，我们提出了ViPSAM——一种利用互补跨模态信息的视觉提示框架。ViPSAM基于Segment Anything模型（SAM）构建，引入视觉提示编码器以从对比增强图像中提取引导特征，并设计视觉引导交叉注意力模块以融合非对比与对比增强特征，从而增强低对比度区域中与病灶相关的表征。掩码解码器进一步以参数高效的方式进行调整，以有效利用视觉提示。我们在质子治疗中获取的NCCT肝脏病灶分割任务上评估了所提方法。实验结果表明，ViPSAM优于代表性的基于U-Net和SAM的方法，说明跨模态视觉提示能够实现更鲁棒、更准确的非对比图像分割。
tldr: ViPSAM proposes a visual prompting framework built on the Segment Anything Model (SAM) that uses contrast-enhanced MRI features to guide non-contrast CT liver lesion segmentation for proton therapy, achieving better accuracy than U-Net and standard SAM methods.
tldr_zh: ViPSAM提出了一种基于Segment Anything Model（SAM）的视觉提示框架，利用增强MRI特征引导非增强CT肝脏病灶分割，用于质子治疗规划，相比U-Net和标准SAM方法取得了更高的准确性。

title: MonteRET: AI Agent Enhancing Multimodal LLMs with Multi-granularity Knowledge Retrieval for Chest CT Report Generation
summary: Automated chest CT report generation remains challenging because clinically faithful reporting requires both whole-volume understanding and accurate description of localized anatomical findings. Here we developed and retrospectively evaluated MonteRET, a region-aware retrieval-enhanced framework for generating chest CT findings sections. MonteRET integrates global CT features with region-level anatomical representations, retrieves clinically relevant knowledge using predicted medical conditions and region-level vision-language alignment, and refines initial reports through a knowledge-guided report rewriting agent. We trained our model on a public cohort with 24,128 CT scans from RadGenome-ChestCT. We evaluated MonteRET on the public RadGenome-ChestCT test set of 1,564 CT scans and an external cohort of 82 CT scans from NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center. MonteRET improved report quality, semantic similarity, and clinical efficacy compared with a matched baseline and several state-of-the-art methods. Gains were most pronounced for recall, suggesting fewer omitted findings. Human expert evaluation by radiology residents also favored MonteRET.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自动化胸部CT报告生成仍具挑战，因为临床可靠的报告既需要理解全肺容积，又需要准确描述局部解剖学发现。我们开发并回顾性评估了MonteRET——一种区域感知的检索增强框架，用于生成胸部CT检查所见部分。MonteRET将全局CT特征与区域级解剖表示相结合，利用预测的医学条件和区域级视觉-语言对齐检索临床相关知识，并通过知识引导的报告重写智能体优化初始报告。我们在包含24,128次CT扫描的公开队列（来自RadGenome-ChestCT）上训练了模型。在RadGenome-ChestCT公开测试集（1,564次CT扫描）和来自纽约长老会/威尔康奈尔医学中心的外部队列（82次CT扫描）上评估了MonteRET。与匹配的基线及多种前沿方法相比，MonteRET在报告质量、语义相似性和临床效能方面均有提升。召回率的提升最为显著，表明遗漏发现减少。放射科住院医师进行的人类专家评估也倾向于MonteRET。
tldr: MonteRET is a region-aware retrieval-enhanced framework that uses multimodal LLMs and a knowledge-guided rewriting agent to generate chest CT findings reports, achieving improved quality and clinical efficacy on public and external cohorts.
tldr_zh: MonteRET是一个区域感知的检索增强框架，利用多模态大语言模型和知识引导的改写代理生成胸部CT报告，在公共和外部队列上提升了报告质量和临床效能。

title: Beyond scalar losses: calibrating segmentation models via gradient vector field surgery
summary: Region-based loss functions, such as the Dice loss, have established themselves as the de facto standard for highly class- and region-imbalanced segmentation tasks. However, models trained using region-based loss functions are notoriously miscalibrated and typically yield over-confident predictions. In medical imaging applications, such as defining tumor resection margins, this miscalibration is hindering clinical adoption. In this work, we outline a novel gradient perspective on this overconfidence and show how it affects region-based loss functions. We propose a "surgery" on the gradient vector field as a simple, yet effective intervention to mitigate calibration issues. This surgery adds a factor to the loss's partial derivative, scaling the gradient's magnitude linearly with the prediction error. In empirical evaluations across 2D and 3D medical segmentation tasks, we demonstrate the effectiveness of this intervention while maintaining high prediction accuracy when used in conjunction with any region-based loss function.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于区域的损失函数（如Dice损失）已成为高度类别与区域不平衡分割任务的事实标准。然而，使用此类损失函数训练的模型普遍存在校准不良问题，通常产生过度自信的预测。在医学影像应用（如定义肿瘤切除边缘）中，这种校准偏差阻碍了临床采纳。本研究针对该过度自信现象提出了一种新颖的梯度视角，并揭示了其如何影响基于区域的损失函数。我们提出在梯度向量场上进行“手术”，作为一种简单而有效的干预措施以缓解校准问题。该手术通过在损失的偏导数中引入一个因子，使梯度大小随预测误差线性缩放。在二维和三维医学分割任务的实证评估中，我们证明了该干预措施的有效性，且在与任何基于区域的损失函数结合使用时，仍能保持较高的预测精度。
tldr: Proposes a gradient vector field 'surgery' to calibrate overconfident predictions from region-based segmentation losses (e.g., Dice loss) by scaling gradients linearly with prediction error, improving calibration without sacrificing accuracy in medical imaging tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种梯度向量场‘手术’方法，通过将梯度大小与预测误差线性缩放，校准区域分割损失（如Dice损失）导致的过度自信预测，在不牺牲精度的情况下改善医学图像分割的校准性。

title: 3D Geometric Tooth Alignment Planning via Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: 3D geometric tooth alignment planning, which determines sequential trajectories from initial malocclusion to the final target alignment, is a cornerstone of modern digital orthodontics. This paper presents a novel deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework to automate the generation of these alignment paths. We formulate the planning process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) to capture its sequential decision-making nature, focusing on optimizing geometric trajectories while integrating essential spatial constraints, such as inter-dental collision avoidance and path efficiency. The proposed method leverages the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm, enhanced by three key innovations: (1) a Transformer-based agent to model complex spatial interactions between teeth and manage high-dimensional state-action spaces; (2) a dynamic masking scheme that restricts movement to a sparse subset of teeth per step, better reflecting the clinical logic of sequential alignment; and (3) a two-stage curriculum learning strategy that gradually increases task difficulty to ensure training stability and efficient path discovery. We evaluate our approach on a dataset of 10K expert-designed treatment plans based on clinical data. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines in terms of path safety and geometric efficiency, providing a robust and automated solution for 3D geometric orthodontic alignment planning.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
3D几何牙齿正畸排齐规划，即确定从初始错颌畸形到最终目标排齐的连续运动轨迹，是现代数字化正畸治疗的基石。本文提出了一种新颖的深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于自动生成这些排齐路径。我们将规划过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），以捕捉其序列决策的本质，重点在优化几何轨迹的同时整合关键空间约束，例如牙间碰撞避免和路径效率。所提方法基于深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）算法，并通过三项关键创新加以增强：（1）基于Transformer的智能体，用于建模牙齿间复杂的空间交互并管理高维状态-动作空间；（2）动态掩码机制，将每一步的运动限制在稀疏的牙齿子集上，更好地反映序列排齐的临床逻辑；（3）两阶段课程学习策略，逐步增加任务难度以确保训练稳定性和高效路径发现。我们在基于临床数据的10,000个专家设计治疗计划数据集上评估了该方法。实验结果表明，我们的方法在路径安全性和几何效率方面优于现有基线，为3D几何正畸排齐规划提供了稳健且自动化的解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning framework for automated 3D tooth alignment planning, using DDPG with a Transformer-based agent, dynamic masking, and curriculum learning to optimize geometric trajectories while avoiding collisions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的3D牙齿正畸规划框架，采用DDPG算法，结合Transformer代理、动态掩码和课程学习，以优化几何轨迹并避免碰撞。

title: Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning For False Negative Mitigation in 3D Medical Imaging
summary: Multimodal Contrastive Learning (CL) has shown significant performance in aligning representations across various data modalities and improving downstream tasks, especially in healthcare. It works by minimizing the distance between matched (positive) data modalities, while maximizing the distance between mismatched (negative) samples. Traditional CL frameworks typically assume instance-based correspondence within data batches, treating all non-paired samples as negatives. However, this assumption often fails in medical settings, where samples may share high-level semantic attributes, leading to false negatives that degrade representation quality. In this paper, we propose Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning (MseaCL), a CL framework trained on a pediatric cohort of 3D brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans and radiology reports. The goal of this framework is to mitigate the impact of semantically similar false negative samples by incorporating semantic similarity between radiology reports, as a guiding signal during the learning process. Our results indicate that applying this framework as a pretraining stage can achieve notable improvements in downstream tasks, e.g., at least a 22.6\% increase in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of pediatric brain tumor molecular classification, demonstrating its potential for more robust and semantically aligned multimodal representations in clinical applications.
summary_zh: 多模态对比学习（CL）在跨多种数据模态对齐表征以及改进下游任务方面展现出显著性能，尤其在医疗领域。其原理是通过最小化匹配（正例）数据模态间的距离，同时最大化不匹配（负例）样本间的距离。传统的CL框架通常假设数据批次内存在基于实例的对应关系，将所有非配对样本视为负例。然而，这一假设在医疗场景中常常失效——样本可能共享高层语义属性，导致产生虚假负例，从而降低表征质量。本文提出多模态语义感知对比学习（MseaCL），该框架基于包含三维脑部磁共振成像（MRI）扫描影像与放射学报告的儿科队列进行训练。其目标是通过引入放射学报告间的语义相似度作为学习过程中的引导信号，减轻语义相似虚假负例样本的影响。结果表明，将该框架作为预训练阶段，能够在下游任务中取得显著提升——例如，儿童脑肿瘤分子分类的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）至少提高22.6%，展现了其在临床应用中构建更稳健且语义对齐的多模态表征的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning (MseaCL) to mitigate false negatives in multimodal contrastive learning for 3D brain MRI and radiology reports, achieving significant improvements in downstream tumor classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出多模态语义感知对比学习（MseaCL），以缓解三维脑部MRI和放射学报告的多模态对比学习中的假阴性问题，在下游肿瘤分类任务中取得了显著改进。

title: Motion-Conditioned Multi-View Fusion for Myocardial Infarction Localization from Echocardiography
summary: Myocardial infarction (MI) remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide. Echocardiography (Echo) is a widely available modality for MI assessment, where regional wall motion abnormality is a key indicator. Prior learning based methods for myocardial motion analysis often use handcrafted descriptors or densely supervised estimation, but the need for extensive annotation limits applicability. Foundation models have recently improved vision-based Echo analysis; however, most methods operate on single views and segment-level localization remains unreliable under view-dependent ambiguity, especially in apical views. To address this, we propose MCF-Net, a novel motion-guided multi-view fusion framework that fuses myocardial motion cues with foundation model representations to localize infarction. Visual features are extracted using EchoPrime, a pretrained Echo foundation model shared across dual views. Cardiac motion is modeled with extremely sparse supervision: a single annotated template frame is transferred across videos to initialize point tracking, avoiding dense labels. Motion-derived segment-aware soft masks provide coarse spatial priors that selectively enhance features for challenging myocardial segments. A motion-conditioned fusion mechanism then integrates motion and vision across views, refining predictions without overriding strong appearance cues. On segment-level MI localization, MCF-Net achieves 72.4\% F1 and 84.9\% accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art motion-only, vision-only, and fusion baselines.
summary_zh: 心肌梗死（MI）仍是全球范围内的主要死亡原因。超声心动图（Echo）是一种广泛用于MI评估的检查手段，其中局部室壁运动异常是关键指标。以往基于学习的心肌运动分析方法常使用手工设计的描述符或密集监督估计，但对大量标注的需求限制了其适用性。基础模型近期提升了基于视觉的Echo分析；然而，多数方法仅处理单一切面，且节段级定位在视图依赖性模糊下仍不可靠，尤其是在心尖切面中。为解决此问题，我们提出MCF-Net，一种新颖的运动引导多视图融合框架，将心肌运动线索与基础模型表示相融合以实现梗死定位。视觉特征使用EchoPrime提取，EchoPrime是一个预训练的、在双视图中共享的Echo基础模型。心脏运动通过极稀疏监督建模：单个标注的模板帧在视频间传递以初始化点追踪，从而避免密集标注。源自运动的节段感知软掩码提供了粗略空间先验，可选择性增强具有挑战性的心肌节段的特征。随后，运动条件融合机制跨视图整合运动与视觉信息，在不覆盖强外观线索的前提下优化预测。在节段级MI定位任务上，MCF-Net达到了72.4%的F1分数和84.9%的准确率，优于最先进的仅运动、仅视觉及融合基线方法。
tldr: MCF-Net uses motion-conditioned multi-view fusion with a pretrained Echo foundation model and sparse supervision to localize myocardial infarction from echocardiography, achieving 72.4% F1 and 84.9% accuracy.
tldr_zh: MCF-Net 利用运动引导的多视图融合、预训练的 Echo 基础模型和稀疏监督对超声心动图中心肌梗死进行定位，实现了 72.4% 的 F1 分数和 84.9% 的准确率。

title: CRISP: Constrained Refinement via Iterative Squeezing Process for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift
summary: Distribution shift in medical imaging remains a central bottleneck for the clinical translation of medical AI. Failure to address it can lead to severe performance degradation in unseen environments and exacerbate health inequities. Existing methods for domain adaptation are inherently limited by exhausting predefined possibilities through simulated shifts or pseudo-supervision. Such strategies struggle in the open-ended and unpredictable real world, where distribution shifts are effectively infinite. To address this challenge, we adopt the "Rank Stability of Positive Regions" as a working assumption under distribution shift, and use it to derive robust spatial hints for source-only segmentation. Guided by this assumption, we propose CRISP, a model-agnostic framework that, unlike deployment-time adaptation, requires no test-time parameter updates and no target-domain data--a target-free, plug-in refinement framework that segments with frozen weights. Rather than using ranking to directly output masks, CRISP exploits the stability of probability rankings under distribution shift to derive robust spatial priors. Via latent feature perturbation, perturbation-invariant high-grade regions define a high-precision (HP) core, while voxels that remain potentially foreground under at least one perturbation define a high-recall (HR) support; these dual priors are then recursively refined under perturbation. We then design an iterative training framework that progressively squeezes HP and HR toward the final segmentation. Extensive evaluations on multi-center cardiac MRI and CT-based lung vessel segmentation demonstrate CRISP's superior robustness, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods with striking HD95 reductions of up to 0.14 (7.0% improvement), 1.90 (13.1% improvement), and 8.39 (38.9% improvement) pixels across multi-center, demographic, and modality shifts, respectively.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学影像中的分布偏移仍是医学人工智能临床转化的核心瓶颈。未能解决此问题可能导致模型在未见环境中性能严重下降，并加剧健康不平等。现有领域自适应方法因依赖通过模拟偏移或伪监督来穷举预定义可能性而固有受限。这些策略在面对开放式且不可预测的真实世界时力不从心——真实世界中的分布偏移实际上是无限的。为应对这一挑战，我们采纳“正区域排序稳定性”作为分布偏移下的工作假设，并据此推导出用于仅源域分割的鲁棒空间线索。在该假设指导下，我们提出CRISP——一种模型无关框架，与部署时自适应不同，它无需测试时参数更新，也不需要目标域数据：一种无目标、即插即用的精炼框架，使用冻结权重进行分割。CRISP并非直接利用排序输出掩膜，而是利用概率排序在分布偏移下的稳定性导出鲁棒的空间先验。通过潜在特征扰动，对扰动不变的高等级区域定义了高精度（HP）核心，而在至少一次扰动下仍可能为前景的体素定义了高召回（HR）支撑；这两种先验随后在扰动下递归精炼。接着，我们设计了一个迭代训练框架，逐步将HP和HR压缩至最终分割。在多中心心脏MRI和基于CT的肺血管分割上的大量评估表明，CRISP具有卓越的鲁棒性，显著优于现有最优方法，在多中心、人群和模态偏移下分别实现了高达0.14像素（提升7.0%）、1.90像素（提升13.1%）和8.39像素（提升38.9%）的HD95降低。
tldr: CRISP proposes a model-agnostic, target-free framework for robust medical image segmentation under domain shift, using rank stability of positive regions to derive spatial priors and iterative refinement without requiring target-domain data or test-time adaptation.
tldr_zh: CRISP 提出了一种模型无关、无需目标域数据的医学图像分割域自适应框架，利用正区域排名稳定性来推导空间先验并进行迭代优化，显著提升了在多种分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
summary: Annotation quality is a major bottleneck in building reliable and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) systems for mental health research. In depression-related datasets, labels are often assigned without structured evidence, symptom-level justification, or traceable alignment with the criteria of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, Text Revision (DSM-5-TR), limiting both transparency and downstream model interpretability. We propose a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop annotation framework for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) that combines large language model (LLM)-assisted labeling with expert verification. The framework is intended to support the construction of explainable, DSM-5-TR-aligned datasets rather than to perform clinical diagnosis. It operates in three stages: candidate evidence selection from textual records, criterion-level DSM-5-TR analysis, and case-level synthesis that produces label-level diagnostic and severity annotations. A dual-memory architecture, composed of Example Memory and Reflection Memory, is designed to internalize expert feedback and iteratively improve future annotations without retraining. We describe this mechanism and leave its evaluation across multiple feedback cycles to future work. In addition to final labels, the framework exports clinical evidence, reasoning traces, and edit histories, enabling comprehensive auditability. In a pilot study using expert-reviewed samples, the proposed approach improves annotation consistency and explainability while reducing manual revision effort.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
标注质量是构建用于心理健康研究的可靠且可解释人工智能（XAI）系统的主要瓶颈。在抑郁症相关数据集中，标签通常是在缺乏结构化证据、症状级依据或与《精神障碍诊断与统计手册（第五版修订版）》（DSM-5-TR）标准可溯源对齐的情况下分配的，这限制了透明度和下游模型的可解释性。我们提出了一种针对重度抑郁症（MDD）的自演化、专家在环标注框架，该框架结合了大语言模型（LLM）辅助标注与专家验证。该框架旨在支持构建符合DSM-5-TR标准且可解释的数据集，而非执行临床诊断。它分三个阶段运行：从文本记录中筛选候选证据、进行DSM-5-TR标准级分析，以及生成标签级诊断和严重程度标注的案例级综合。一个由示例记忆和反思记忆组成的双记忆架构旨在内化专家反馈，并在无需重新训练的情况下迭代改进未来的标注。我们描述了这一机制，并将其在多个反馈循环中的评估留待未来工作。除最终标签外，该框架还导出临床证据、推理过程和编辑历史，实现全面的可审计性。在一项使用专家审核样本的初步研究中，所提出的方法提高了标注一致性和可解释性，同时减少了人工修订工作量。
tldr: This paper proposes a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop annotation framework for Major Depressive Disorder that uses LLMs and a dual-memory architecture to produce explainable, DSM-5-TR-aligned symptom labels with reasoning traces, aiming to improve annotation consistency and auditability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种自我演化、专家参与的抑郁症标注框架，利用大语言模型和双记忆架构生成可解释、符合DSM-5-TR标准的症状标签及推理轨迹，旨在提高标注一致性和可审计性。

title: Scalable Open-Source Visuotactile Sensor for 6-Axis Contact Wrench Estimation in Tensegrity Robots
summary: This paper presents a scalable, open-source visuotactile sensing system for tensegrity robots that enables six-axis wrench estimation and contact detection. The proposed endcap sensor integrates an elastomeric shell, a 3D-printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) interface, and a rigid base housing an embedded camera and LED illumination ring. A novel gyroid-infill bonding technique is introduced to form a durable elastomer-TPU interface without adhesives, yielding a lightweight and modular design compatible with large-scale tensegrity structures. A tactile-to-wrench neural network maps shear vector fields to six-dimensional force and torque measurements. Experimental results demonstrate accurate and stable wrench estimation with a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.1531 on static validation data and out-of-domain generalization under dynamic motion. Furthermore, full-system integration on a 12 kg tensegrity robot confirms the sensor's ability to reliably identify ground contacts. The system substantially improves the practicality of tactile feedback for tensegrity robots, offering a low-cost, reproducible, and physically interpretable pathway toward contact-aware proprioception and state estimation. Open source files are available at \href{https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}{github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}
summary_zh: 本文提出一种适用于张拉整体机器人的可扩展开源视触觉传感系统，可实现六轴力旋量估计与接触检测。该端盖传感器集成了弹性体外壳、3D打印热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）接口以及内置摄像头和LED照明环的刚性底座。引入了一种新型螺旋填充粘合技术，可在不使用粘合剂的情况下形成耐久的弹性体-TPU界面，从而实现轻量化与模块化设计，适用于大型张拉整体结构。通过触觉到力旋量的神经网络将剪切矢量场映射为六维力与力矩测量值。实验结果表明，该传感器在静态验证数据上实现了均方误差（MSE）为0.1531的精确稳定力旋量估计，并在动态运动下展现出域外泛化能力。此外，在12公斤级张拉整体机器人上的全系统集成验证了该传感器可靠识别地面接触的能力。该系统显著提升了张拉整体机器人触觉反馈的实用性，为面向接触的感知与状态估计提供了一条低成本、可复现且具有物理可解释性的途径。开源文件可在 \href{https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}{github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot} 获取。
tldr: This paper presents an open-source visuotactile sensor for tensegrity robots that estimates 6-axis contact wrench using a neural network, with a novel adhesive-free bonding technique and validated on a 12 kg robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于张力集成机器人的开源视觉触觉传感器，通过神经网络估计六轴接触力/力矩，采用无胶粘合技术，并在12公斤机器人上进行了验证。

title: A Model-Based Decoupling Strategy for Proprioception and Contact Sensing in an Architected Soft Manipulator
summary: Soft continuum robots require embedded sensing for proprioception and contact detection, yet integrating sensors into sparse, highly deformable architected structures remains challenging. We present a model-based strategy that decouples proprioceptive and contact signals from a common set of fluidic pressure sensors embedded in a soft architected segment. Each segment of the Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH) contains six air channels routed in a localized zigzag pattern along the circumference. With only three principal kinematic degrees of freedom (axial compression, bending in x, bending in y), the six pressure readings form an overdetermined system. A piecewise constant curvature model maps pressures to shape, and Huber regression identifies outlier channels whose residuals indicate external contact. On a single ITH segment, this approach achieves proprioceptive shape estimation with a relative bending error of 0.11 +/- 0.02 and a contact detection rate of 97% across 178 trials. We integrate eight ITH segments into Air-Helix, a tendon-driven soft continuum manipulator, and present exploratory whole-arm demonstrations that include tactile teaching by demonstration, admittance-controlled force regulation, and tactile object reconstruction. The results suggest that localized fluidic innervation combined with model-based redundancy resolution is a practical path toward concurrent proprioception and contact sensing in architected soft robots.
summary_zh:
摘要：
软体连续体机器人需要嵌入式传感以实现本体感知和接触检测，但将传感器集成到稀疏且高度可变形的人工结构中仍具有挑战性。我们提出一种基于模型的策略，从嵌入软体人工结构段的一组公共流体压力传感器中解耦本体感知和接触信号。每个神经化修剪螺旋体（ITH）段包含六个沿圆周呈局部锯齿形分布的空气通道。仅凭借三个主要运动自由度（轴向压缩、x方向弯曲、y方向弯曲），六组压力读数构成一个过定系统。分段恒定曲率模型将压力映射为形状，Huber回归识别出残差指示外部接触的异常通道。在单个ITH段上，该方法实现了本体感知形状估计，相对弯曲误差为0.11±0.02，在178次试验中接触检测率达97%。我们将八个ITH段集成到Air-Helix（一种腱驱动软体连续体操作臂）中，并展示了全臂探索性演示，包括基于示教的触觉教学、导纳控制力调节以及触觉物体重建。结果表明，局部流体神经支配与基于模型的冗余解析相结合，是实现人工结构软体机器人同时进行本体感知和接触传感的实用途径。
tldr: This paper proposes a model-based method using fluidic pressure sensors in a soft architected manipulator to simultaneously estimate shape (proprioception) and detect external contacts by exploiting an overdetermined system and Huber regression, achieving high contact detection rates and low bending errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于模型的方法，利用软体结构操作器中的流体压力传感器，通过超定系统和Huber回归同时估计形状（本体感知）并检测外部接触，实现了高接触检测率和低弯曲误差。

title: NeuroCommitSSM: Decision-Centric Shared Autonomy for Safe Assistive Manipulation via EEG-EMG-ET Commit Readiness
summary: We present NeuroCommitSSM, a decision-centric framework that models when to execute, not just what to do, for safe commit-to-execute control in assistive robotic manipulation. NeuroCommitSSM predicts a continuous commit-readiness score c_t in [0,1] from synchronized electroencephalography (EEG), electromyography (EMG), and eye-tracking (ET), and converts it into discrete commit events through dwell and hysteresis filtering. A three-state finite-state supervisor, HOLD-ASSIST-COMMIT (HAC), gates execution by requiring both a sustained commit-readiness signal from the neural model and real-time perception and robot-state feasibility, including target visibility, inverse kinematics solvability, and collision-free planning, before initiating motion. We evaluate the framework on N=32 subjects performing five activities of daily living (ADL) tasks aligned with the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF), using leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation and seven sensor-dropout scenarios (S0-S6). NeuroCommitSSM achieves 0.950 action-balanced accuracy with 0.75 false commit events per 1000 REST windows (FP/1k REST), and maintains low false commits and stable state transitions under sensor loss. For example, in the EEG-only condition, it achieves 0.785 balanced accuracy and 0.29 FP/1k REST, whereas the Temporal Convolutional Network baseline produces 99.95 FP/1k REST under the same condition. Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation on a Kinova Gen3 arm shows that feasibility-checked execution reduces false starts and decision instability without sacrificing task success. Supplementary materials, including code, datasets, videos, and additional analyses, are available at https://madibabaiasl.github.io/NeuroCommitSSM/.
summary_zh: 我们提出了NeuroCommitSSM，这是一种以决策为中心的框架，不仅建模要执行什么动作，还建模何时执行，以实现辅助机器人操作中的安全“承诺-执行”控制。NeuroCommitSSM从同步的脑电图（EEG）、肌电图（EMG）和眼动追踪（ET）中预测一个连续的承诺就绪分数c_t ∈ [0,1]，并通过驻留和迟滞滤波将其转换为离散的承诺事件。一个三态有限状态监督器HOLD-ASSIST-COMMIT（HAC）通过要求同时满足来自神经模型的持续承诺就绪信号以及实时感知和机器人状态可行性（包括目标可见性、逆运动学可解性和无碰撞规划）来门控执行，之后才启动运动。我们在N=32名受试者上评估了该框架，这些受试者执行了与国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）相一致的五项日常生活活动（ADL）任务，采用了留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）和七种传感器缺失场景（S0-S6）。NeuroCommitSSM实现了0.950的动作平衡准确率，每1000个REST窗口仅有0.75个虚假承诺事件（FP/1k REST），并在传感器缺失情况下保持了低虚假承诺和稳定的状态转移。例如，在仅使用EEG的条件下，它实现了0.785的平衡准确率和0.29 FP/1k REST，而时序卷积网络基线在相同条件下产生了99.95 FP/1k REST。在Kinova Gen3机械臂上的硬件在环（HIL）验证表明，经过可行性检查的执行减少了误启动和决策不稳定性，同时不牺牲任务成功率。补充材料（包括代码、数据集、视频和额外分析）可在https://madibabaiasl.github.io/NeuroCommitSSM/获取。
tldr: NeuroCommitSSM is a decision-centric shared autonomy framework that predicts a continuous commit-readiness score from EEG, EMG, and eye-tracking to gate robotic manipulation execution, achieving high accuracy and low false commitments in assistive tasks with sensor dropout robustness.
tldr_zh: NeuroCommitSSM 是一个以决策为中心的共享自主框架，通过 EEG、EMG 和眼动追踪预测连续的执行就绪度分数，从而控制机器人辅助操作的执行，在传感器缺失情况下实现了高精度和低误触发。

title: When Can Test-Time Adaptation Help Zero-Shot CT Vision-Language Models?
summary: 3D CT vision-language models (VLMs) classify abnormalities from text prompts in a zero-shot manner, enabling cross-institution deployment where labels are scarce and clinical tasks shift faster than supervised models can be retrained. A real CT scan, however, typically contains several co-occurring abnormalities, and the reliability of zero-shot multi-label prediction under distribution shift remains poorly understood. Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model on unlabeled target scans without source data or target annotations, yet existing TTA methods target multi-class softmax prediction on natural images or 2D medical segmentation, and none addresses unsupervised multi-label adaptation for zero-shot 3D CT VLMs. We study when TTA helps zero-shot 3D CT VLMs. A controlled diagnostic analysis shows that TTA is conditional: the volumetric input must preserve the encoder's depth structure, and the base representation must transfer to the target cohort, with depth reduction alone lowering internal AUROC by more than 0.12. We then focus on the regime where the base model already separates present from absent abnormalities. We introduce CARVE (Cardinality-Aware Retained-View Entropy), the first TTA method for this setting. CARVE estimates a sample-specific positive-label cardinality $\hat{k}$, optimizes a top-$\hat{k}$ objective to preserve co-occurring abnormalities, and performs memory-efficient multi-view adaptation by scoring weak 3D views without gradients before updating on a retained subset. Across contrastive CT-CLIP and anatomy-aware fVLM, CARVE provides the most consistent improvements across multi-label, three-class, and binary CT tasks when the base model is already discriminative. These results establish multi-label TTA for zero-shot 3D CT VLMs as a distinct problem and CARVE as a cardinality-aware solution.
summary_zh: 3D CT视觉语言模型（VLM）能够以零样本方式根据文本提示对异常进行分类，从而在标签稀缺且临床任务变化速度快于监督模型重新训练速度的跨机构部署场景中发挥作用。然而，实际CT扫描通常包含多个共现的异常，在分布偏移下零样本多标签预测的可靠性仍知之甚少。测试时适应（TTA）可在无源数据或目标标注的情况下，基于未标注的目标扫描更新模型，但现有TTA方法主要针对自然图像或2D医学分割的多类softmax预测，尚无方法解决零样本3D CT VLM的无监督多标签适应问题。我们研究了TTA何时能帮助零样本3D CT VLM。一项受控诊断分析表明，TTA具有条件性：体积输入必须保留编码器的深度结构，且基础表示必须能够迁移至目标队列，仅减少深度就会导致内部AUROC下降超过0.12。随后，我们聚焦于基础模型已能区分异常存在与否的场景。我们提出CARVE（基数感知的保留视图熵），这是首个针对该场景的TTA方法。CARVE估计样本特定的正标签基数$\hat{k}$，优化top-$\hat{k}$目标以保留共现异常，并在更新前通过无梯度评分弱3D视图再基于保留子集进行更新，实现内存高效的多视图适应。在对比的CT-CLIP和具有解剖感知能力的fVLM上，当基础模型已具备判别能力时，CARVE在多标签、三分类和二分类CT任务中提供了最一致的改进。这些结果将零样本3D CT VLM的多标签TTA确立为一个独特问题，并将CARVE确立为一种基数感知的解决方案。
tldr: This paper studies when test-time adaptation (TTA) helps zero-shot 3D CT vision-language models for multi-label abnormality classification, and introduces CARVE, a cardinality-aware TTA method that preserves co-occurring abnormalities via top-k optimization and memory-efficient multi-view adaptation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了测试时自适应（TTA）何时有助于零样本3D CT视觉语言模型进行多标签异常分类，并提出了CARVE方法，通过top-k优化保留共现异常并进行内存高效的多视图自适应。

title: HTT-Net: Hierarchical Text-guided Transition Modeling for Surgical Video Phase Recognition
summary: Surgical video phase recognition is a fundamental task in computer-assisted intervention, supporting workflow understanding, intraoperative guidance, and surgical quality assessment. Although recent visual-temporal models have achieved promising progress, accurate and temporally coherent phase recognition remains challenging due to local visual ambiguity, transient prediction noise, and insufficient use of procedural semantics. To address these challenges, we propose HTT-Net, a Hierarchical Text-guided Transition modeling Network for surgical video phase recognition. The key idea is to introduce structured surgical semantic knowledge into phase-aware segment construction and semantic refinement. Specifically, we construct a hierarchical surgical semantic memory with intra-phase descriptions, inter-phase transition descriptions, and fine-grained semantic units. Based on this memory, the proposed Transition-Aware Segment Construction (TAS-Con) organizes frame-level evidence into coherent segment representations and handles boundary clips with inter-phase transition descriptions. Furthermore, we introduce Transition-Aware Segment Calibration (TAS-Calib), which calibrates phase-aware segment representations through hierarchical surgical semantics and improves discrimination under visual ambiguity without dense frame-level vision-language fusion. Experiments on Cholec80 and LCRS-100 demonstrate the effectiveness of HTT-Net for robust surgical video phase recognition.
summary_zh: 手术视频阶段识别是计算机辅助干预中的一项基础任务，支持工作流程理解、术中引导和手术质量评估。尽管最近的视觉-时序模型取得了显著进展，但由于局部视觉模糊、瞬态预测噪声以及程序语义利用不足，准确且时序连贯的阶段识别仍然面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HTT-Net，一种用于手术视频阶段识别的层次化文本引导的过渡建模网络。其核心思想是将结构化的手术语义知识引入阶段感知的片段构建和语义优化中。具体而言，我们构建了一个层次化手术语义记忆库，包含阶段内描述、阶段间过渡描述以及细粒度语义单元。基于该记忆库，所提出的过渡感知片段构建（TAS-Con）将帧级证据组织为连贯的片段表示，并利用阶段间过渡描述处理边界片段。此外，我们引入了过渡感知片段校准（TAS-Calib），通过层次化手术语义校准阶段感知片段表示，在无需密集帧级视觉-语言融合的情况下，提升视觉模糊条件下的判别能力。在Cholec80和LCRS-100上的实验证明了HTT-Net在鲁棒的手术视频阶段识别中的有效性。
tldr: Proposes HTT-Net, a hierarchical text-guided network for surgical video phase recognition, using intra-phase and inter-phase descriptions to improve segment construction and calibration, achieving robust results on Cholec80 and LCRS-100.
tldr_zh: 提出HTT-Net，一种分层文本引导的手术视频阶段识别网络，利用阶段内和阶段间描述改进片段构建与校准，在Cholec80和LCRS-100上取得鲁棒结果。

title: OFD-Net: Teacher-Free Reliable Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation with Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Net of Foreground-Background
summary: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is an effective solution for medical image segmentation with limited annotations. Existing SSL methods mainly rely on pseudo-labels generated by teacher-student supervision or cross-network consistency. However, these methods lack an explicit structural reference for judging pseudo-label quality. Low-quality pseudo-labels may lead to unreliable training, error accumulation and confirmation bias when processing unlabeled data with substantial appearance variations. To address this issue, we proposed OFD-Net, a teacher-free single-network framework for reliable semi-supervised medical image segmentation. OFD-Net employs an Orthogonal Feature Disentanglement Module (OFDM) to capture OFD features for reliable SSL by disentangling unlabeled data into background and foreground representations with a reliable structural distribution, thereby effectively reducing error accumulation and alleviating confirmation bias among unlabeled data. Specifically, OFD-Net explicitly employs a Disentanglement Guidance Module (DGM) to inject the resulting structural priors of foreground-background into the decoder by deformable convolution processing, and outputs predictions with clearer foreground representations. Based on DGM and the OFDM, we further develop a reliability-aware pseudo-label learning mechanism that evaluates unlabeled supervision according to the structural consistency between the main prediction and the disentangled foreground-background responses, and then down-weights unreliable regions during training. Extensive experiments on four public medical image segmentation benchmarks, namely ISIC-2016, Kvasir-SEG, Synapse, and ACDC, validate the effectiveness of OFD-Net. These results confirm that orthogonal foreground-background disentanglement enables OFD-Net to establish an efficient and reliable training paradigm within a teacher-free single-network framework.
summary_zh: 半监督学习（SSL）是解决医学图像分割中标注稀缺问题的有效方案。现有SSL方法主要依赖教师-学生监督或跨网络一致性生成的伪标签。然而，这些方法缺乏用于判断伪标签质量的显式结构参考。在处理外观变化显著的无标注数据时，低质量伪标签可能导致不可靠训练、误差累积及确认偏差。针对该问题，我们提出了OFD-Net——一种无需教师网络的单框架可靠半监督医学图像分割方法。OFD-Net采用正交特征解耦模块（OFDM），通过将无标注数据解耦为具有可靠结构分布的背景与前景表征，捕获OFD特征以实现可靠的SSL，从而有效减少误差累积并缓解无标注数据中的确认偏差。具体而言，OFD-Net显式地使用解耦指导模块（DGM），通过可变形卷积处理将所得前景-背景结构先验注入解码器，并输出具有更清晰前景表征的预测结果。基于DGM与OFDM，我们进一步开发了一种可靠性感知的伪标签学习机制，该机制根据主预测与解耦的前景-背景响应之间的结构一致性评估无标注监督的质量，进而在训练过程中对不可靠区域进行降权处理。在四个公开医学图像分割基准（即ISIC-2016、Kvasir-SEG、Synapse和ACDC）上的大量实验验证了OFD-Net的有效性。这些结果证实，正交前景-背景解耦使OFD-Net能够在无需教师网络的单框架中建立高效可靠的训练范式。
tldr: OFD-Net proposes a teacher-free single-network framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation, using orthogonal feature disentanglement to separate foreground and background, improving pseudo-label reliability and reducing error accumulation.
tldr_zh: OFD-Net提出了一种无教师单网络半监督医学图像分割框架，通过正交特征解耦分离前景与背景，提高伪标签可靠性并减少误差累积。

title: A Research Prototype for Closed-Loop Generative Design of Customized Foot Orthoses via Semantic-Physics Alignment
summary: Translating unstructured clinical prescriptions into patient-specific foot orthoses (FOs) is hindered by a semantic-physical misalignment: high-level clinical intent is not mapped deterministically onto the 3D geometric parameters of the orthosis, and existing design workflows remain dependent on manual expertise with no instantaneous biomechanical validation. We present TANS-FO, a research prototype-a modular pipeline with closed-loop feedback for computational design automation of customized FOs, not a clinically validated therapeutic device. A Text-Aligned Neural Surrogate (TANS) uses cross-attention to project clinical-text embeddings onto a continuous lattice-density field, while a Graph Neural Network (GNN) surrogate predicts plantar stress in real time as a substitute for Finite Element Analysis (FEA). The framework is anchored on the open-access PicoFoot-5K anthropometric database (5,230 subjects; 30+ anatomical parameters). Under standardized quasi-static loading, the GNN surrogate agrees with an Abaqus reference solver (R^2 = 0.94), and the full pipeline synthesizes manufacturing-ready lattice insoles within minutes. On the Male 18-40 cohort, the proposed system attains a surrogate-predicted peak-pressure reduction of 34.7% over parametric CAD, with a fit error of 0.42 mm. Separately, an exploratory feasibility observation (n = 12; 2-week follow-up; no control group) using VAS pain reporting indicates short-term comfort improvement (VAS 6.4 -> 2.1), but this data is explicitly classified as preliminary observational evidence only-not evidence of clinical efficacy.
summary_zh: 将非结构化临床处方转化为患者专用足部矫形器（FO）的过程，受到语义-物理错位的阻碍：高级别的临床意图无法确定性映射到矫形器的三维几何参数，且现有设计工作流仍依赖人工经验，缺乏即时生物力学验证。本文提出TANS-FO——一个研究原型，即带有闭环反馈的模块化流水线，用于定制化足部矫形器的计算设计自动化，而非经临床验证的治疗设备。文本对齐神经代理（TANS）利用交叉注意力将临床文本嵌入投影到连续网格密度场，而图神经网络（GNN）代理则实时预测足底应力，作为有限元分析（FEA）的替代方案。该框架基于开放获取的PicoFoot-5K人体测量数据库（5230名受试者；30余项解剖参数）。在标准化准静态加载条件下，GNN代理与Abaqus参考求解器的一致性良好（R² = 0.94），完整流水线可在数分钟内合成可制造的网格鞋垫。在男性18-40岁队列中，与参数化CAD相比，所提系统实现代理预测的峰值压力降低34.7%，贴合误差为0.42 mm。此外，一项探索性可行性观察（n=12；2周随访；无对照组）采用VAS疼痛报告显示短期舒适度改善（VAS从6.4降至2.1），但该数据明确归类为仅初步观察证据——而非临床疗效证据。
tldr: TANS-FO is a prototype pipeline that uses a text-aligned neural surrogate and GNN to automate the design of customized foot orthoses from clinical descriptions, achieving real-time biomechanical prediction and significant pressure reduction, but with only preliminary clinical observations.
tldr_zh: TANS-FO 是一个原型流水线，利用文本对齐的神经代理和 GNN 从临床描述自动化设计定制足部矫形器，实现实时生物力学预测和显著的足底压力降低，但临床观察仅为初步探索。

title: Can Experts Adapt Without Training? On Test-Time Modality Generalization in MVLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (MVLMs) promise broad zero-shot generalization, yet their reliability collapses when confronted with unseen modalities and domains, precisely where clinical robustness matters most. To address this gap, we revisit test-time modality generalization from the perspective of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and ask: can experts route-and-adapt without any optimization during inference? We identify a fundamental specialization-generalization dilemma at test time, where blindly aggregating modality experts dilutes modality-specific knowledge, while selecting one highly confident expert risks mismatch under shift. To address this, we propose MoBE: a fully optimization-free framework that performs dynamic expert selection and adaptation at test time. MoBE combines entropy-guided dynamic routing in MoE settings with expert-wise Bayesian adaptation, enabling experts to update their confidence and adapt online without gradient updates. Without parametric updates, MoBE augments a static MVLM with test-time routing and online statistics, achieving average accuracy gains of +4.72, +7.17, and +4.3 over state-of-the-art TTA methods across seen, unseen, and heterogeneous medical benchmarks, highlighting the effectiveness of training-free expert adaptation for robust modality generalization.
summary_zh: 医学视觉语言模型（MVLMs）在零样本泛化方面展现出广阔前景，但其在面对未见模态和领域时可靠性急剧下降，而恰恰是这些场景对临床鲁棒性最为关键。为解决这一不足，我们从混合专家（MoE）的视角重新审视测试时模态泛化问题，并提出问题：专家能否在推理过程中无需任何优化即可实现路由与自适应？我们发现在测试时存在一个根本性的专业化-泛化困境：盲目聚合模态专家会稀释模态特定知识，而选择单一高置信度专家则可能在分布偏移下导致失配风险。为此，我们提出MoBE：一种完全免优化的框架，可在测试时执行动态专家选择与自适应。MoBE将MoE设置中的熵引导动态路由与专家级贝叶斯自适应相结合，使专家能够在无需梯度更新的情况下在线更新其置信度并进行自适应。在不进行参数更新的前提下，MoBE通过测试时路由和在线统计增强静态MVLM，在已知、未知及异质性医学基准测试中，相较于最先进的TTA方法分别实现了+4.72、+7.17和+4.3的平均准确率提升，凸显了免训练专家自适应在实现稳健模态泛化方面的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes MoBE, a training-free framework for test-time modality generalization in medical vision-language models (MVLMs) that uses entropy-guided dynamic routing and Bayesian adaptation to improve robustness across seen, unseen, and heterogeneous medical benchmarks without gradient updates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MoBE，一种无需训练即可在医学视觉语言模型（MVLM）中实现测试时模态泛化的框架，通过熵引导动态路由和贝叶斯适应，在不进行梯度更新的情况下提高了在已见、未见和异构医学基准上的鲁棒性。

title: DS@GT ARC at eRisk 2026: Hybrid Multi-Agent LLM System with Structured Algorithmic Guidance for Conversational Depression Screening
summary: We describe DS@GT's submission to the eRisk 2026 Task 1 challenge on conversational depression screening, in which systems interview LLM personas that simulate individuals with varying depression profiles and produce a Beck Depression Inventory II (BDI-II) score plus four key symptoms per persona, without directly asking sensitive mental health questions. Our pipeline evolved through three stages: a monolithic single-model prototype to start off, a baseline multi-agent architecture that separates conversational interviewing from BDI-II scoring under a coordinating orchestration layer, and a final hybrid configuration that replaces the paid GPT-5-nano interviewer with the open-source Gemma 27B. To offset the model's weaker reasoning and instruction-following, the hybrid adds three algorithmic components: a precomputed dialogue tree that standardizes interview openers and follow-ups, a reliability-weighted consensus aggregation inspired by the Weaver framework, and a cluster-based imputation step for unprobed symptoms. We submitted three fully automated runs across all 20 personas, with Run 1 from the paid baseline and Runs 2 and 3 from the hybrid. Hybrid Run 3 achieved an ADODL of 0.9063, ranking 3rd among all complete-submission runs and placing DS@GT 2nd among the 21 teams overall, while outperforming our paid baseline Run 1 (0.8841) at roughly one-quarter of the per-persona API cost. These results support our central hypothesis that with sufficient algorithmic supervision, a weaker open-source model can compete with a stronger proprietary model in the conversational interviewer role. Our source code is available at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/erisk-task1-2026.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了DS@GT在eRisk 2026任务1（会话式抑郁筛查挑战）中的提交方案。在该任务中，系统需访谈模拟不同抑郁程度的LLM角色，并在不直接询问敏感心理健康问题的情况下，为每个角色生成贝克抑郁量表第二版（BDI-II）评分及四项关键症状。我们的流程经历了三个阶段：最初为单体单模型原型，随后演进为基于多智能体的基线架构——该架构在协调编排层下分离了会话访谈与BDI-II评分功能，最终采用混合配置，用开源模型Gemma 27B替换了付费的GPT-5-nano访谈模型。为弥补该模型在推理和指令遵循方面的不足，混合配置增加了三个算法组件：预计算对话树（用于标准化访谈开场白与追问）、受Weaver框架启发的可靠性加权共识聚合，以及针对未探测症状的基于聚类的插补步骤。我们提交了覆盖全部20个角色的三个全自动运行：运行1基于付费基线，运行2和运行3基于混合配置。其中混合配置的运行3取得了0.9063的ADODL值，在所有完整提交运行中排名第三，使DS@GT在全部21支队伍中位列第二，同时其每个角色的API成本约为付费基线运行1（0.8841）的四分之一，性能却优于后者。这些结果支持了我们的核心假设：在有足够算法监督的情况下，较弱的开源模型能够在会话访谈角色中与更强的专有模型竞争。我们的源代码已公开于https://github.com/dsgt-arc/erisk-task1-2026。
tldr: The paper presents a hybrid multi-agent LLM system for conversational depression screening that uses algorithmic guidance (dialogue tree, consensus aggregation, cluster-based imputation) to enable an open-source model (Gemma 27B) to match or outperform a paid GPT-5-nano baseline at lower cost, ranking 2nd overall in the eRisk 2026 challenge.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合多智能体大语言模型系统，用于对话式抑郁筛查，通过算法指导（对话树、共识聚合、基于聚类的插补）使开源模型（Gemma 27B）在更低成本下匹配或超越付费GPT-5-nano基线，在eRisk 2026挑战中整体排名第二。

title: Understanding From Human Perspective: A Multi-agent System for Interactive Egocentric Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Interactive egocentric medical image segmentation (IEMIS) plays an important role in smart-glasses-assisted medical image review, segmenting the medical targets a clinician refers to from their egocentric view.
